8.english_pathavurai: I do not worship You everyday. I do not speak of Your great qualities. I do not offer many flowers at Your feet and surrender myself. I do not meditate at all. Your devotees whose hearts are never bereft of Your grace, their whereabouts are never known to me. I never walk around Your hilly abode with devotion. I do not desire to praise Your Glory with delight. The mountain-like buffalo grunts and comes towards me on whose back ride the dark and angry messengers of Death-God (Yaman); they throw around my neck the thick noose and fight with me using their cruel weapon (gathai), (to take my life away). At that time, I lose my heart and become immobilized, with my consciousness rapidly fading away, and with all the suffering I lose my perspective. At that last moment, to allay my fear You must come to my rescue, riding on Your peacock. In the battlefield, the devils were dancing, and the eagles were preying on the scattered pieces of flesh from the corpses, and the demons (asuras) with spread-out hair were conquered in the war with Your Spear, Vela! VaLLi, with a voice like cuckoo singing many tunes, is the beautiful damsel of the mountain: on her vermillion-soaked chest, press Your mountain-like shoulders, fragrant with sandal paste and kasthUri (musk) scent! Everyday, in accordance with the rules laid out by BrahmA, who founded the Four VEdAs, through pouring water and with plenty of flowers, You are worshipped by DEvAs and sages who have banished anger; and You rejoice at their worship! With the humming sound of "thenaththe nanthana" beetles suck honey until they lose the taste for it at the lovely groves in ThirupparangkundRam, which is Your favourite abode, Oh Great Saravana!

9.english_pathavurai: Being conceived in my mother's womb, I spent ten months over there and developed into a full form; finally, I arrived in this world as a little baby. They took me out, washed me and made me suck my mother's breast for milk. I was laid on the floor and I cried; I clapped my little hands; I crawled; I walked; I wore golden chains around my waist; I wore chadhangai (a type of anklet) and earstuds; I put on golden ornaments and thandai (another type of anklet); and so adorned, I matured and grew up glowingly. I reached adulthood. I sought the company of dear girls. I suffered from numerous diseases. Had enough of running around. When will I ever get Your Gracious Blessings? (Hereafter, the Poet describes scenes from RAmAyaNA) The Sun God (with his aspect as Sugreevan) and IndrA (with his aspect as VAli), were born as the valorous Monkey Kings; BrahmA, the God who came from the unique navel of Vishnu, was born as the leader of the bear dynasty (JambavAn); tall Neelan was the form taken by the Fire God (Agni); RudrA (a form of SivA) came as Great HanumAn; and all peerless DEvAs came in this way, descending on this earth. They were appointed as the leaders of His great armies, and the demons (asuras), with their entire dynasties, were conquered, by Hari Mukundan (who came as Rama); He constantly praises Your virtues; and You are His Nephew! After punishing BrahmA* angrily, (and after imprisoning him) You took over the duty of creation in this world. With love, You came unto ThirupparangkundRam and flourish there, Oh Great One!

11.english_pathavurai: There is plenty of gold accumulated at Mount MEru (KailAsh); You came there and threw the shining golden cane (CheNdAyutham) that was glittering and glowing*. You are the ultimate refuge for all! He is easily excitable and devours a variety of eatables; He takes His food scoop by scoop (with His trunk); and He is elephant-faced. You are His younger brother, Oh Muruga. He lays on the serpent, AdhisEshan, half-asleep and half-awake; He, the Supreme One, churned the milky ocean all by Himself (in KUrmAvathAram); and He has the complexion of dark cloud. You are His nephew! My mind is reeling under a multitude of miseries. I am a base creature, a lousy meat-eater and a murderer. To destroy all the sins I have committed till now, please come and save me by showering Your grace. His name is the Purest for ever; In order to conquer Thiripuram, which is constantly in rotation He cast His benign smile, and the whole place was burnt down; such was His power. You are that SivA's son! Strongly came the procession of drums in the battlefield and made a noise like "dududuNdudu duNdudu duNd"; the earth trembled as the demons (asuras) marched on, and there was stampede all over the world. Their hearts were burnt down by fire, and on that day, their bodies and intestines were torn to shreds as You fought mounting Your peacock, Oh Revered One! The Sun and the Moon are almost brushing the tall trees in the groves abounding in the fertile town of ThirupparangkundRam which You have chosen as Your residence to radiate Your grace, Oh Great One!

12.english_pathavurai: Keeping in mind those beautiful kayal-fish-like eyes that extend right up to, and compress their ears, with my fixation for those whores and with all the five sensory organs tantalised by the arrows wielded by Manmathan (God of Love), I have been carrying a fear in my heart; their reddish anklets dazzle like a million stars that shine in the sky at the time of moonrise to dispel the darkness; their rings and bracelets are also prominently displayed while Manmathan, with his long bow, confronts me, waging a war and leaving me dazed; I have been chasing these whores who alternately bicker and flirt sweetly; lest I indulge in the evil act of pressing my chest on their bosom, kindly bless me by granting Your hallowed feet which are adorned by devotees coming to You every day with fragrant and soft garlands of kadappa flowers in their hands, intertwined with tinkling ornaments, praying for their prosperity, Oh Lord! Knocking so hard with Your knuckles on the head of Lord Brahma, seated on the lotus, that it became swollen and reddish, You have the unique honour of having shackled Him too! You preached the ultimate core of Knowledge (PraNava ManthrA) to Lord SivA SankarA, for His assimilation! Her beautiful neck is soft like the betelnut tree and the conch; She is the myna-like daughter DEvayAnai of the celesatial king, IndrA; Your twelve shoulders are sprinkled with her ornaments along with those of VaLLi, the celebrated damsel of the KuRavAs, Oh Lord! You went ahead on the battlefield confronting and scaring away the demons known for their evil mind, unabated treachery and the arrogance of having obtained several boons from Lord SivA previously; and then You killed them all by dint of Your valour, Oh Lord! Predominantly cool and fragrant groves surround this town where learned people gather along with the celestials to worship; this is the beautiful place, Thirupparang KundRam, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

14.english_meanings_list: ["As the God of Love, Manmathan, stood with an intention to wage war, as the moon stored up burning fire within itself,", "as I fell victim to the eyes of the whores,", "as the southerly wind gently drifting through the fragrant groves in the mountainside blew over the water surface on the wide and lovely pond, gathering gusty speed,", "and as the cuckoo came there to sing the tune of \"thenthena\" steadily, without any hurry, during all the three times of the day, namely, morning, evening and dusk;", "both my eyes lost their ability to sleep, making me exhausted;", "my mind was agitated, and I suffered miserably due to an obsessive passion; will such a treacherous person like myself", "be ever able to attain Your hallowed blooming feet?", "He stole curd from the homes of the wealthy cowherds and ate it;", "His fame is worldwide in all the eight directions; He roams* behind the experts in the chaste language of Tamil;", "His complexion is that of dark cloud; He has the ability to win in (wrestling) duels, displaying enormous strength; He is Mukunthan known for His victory and purity; You are the favourite nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "Like the roaring sea, the drums called 'thunthupi' and other pot-like percussion instruments made tremendous noise sounding like \"kumin kumin\",", "when You came to the prosperous place ThiruchchendhUr and took Your seat there, Oh MurugA!", "For the benefit of this world, this mountain soars high in the sky obstructing daily the path of the moon, the sun and the clouds;", "this is ThirupparangkundRam, Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
14.english_pathavurai: As the God of Love, Manmathan, stood with an intention to wage war, as the moon stored up burning fire within itself, as I fell victim to the eyes of the whores, as the southerly wind gently drifting through the fragrant groves in the mountainside blew over the water surface on the wide and lovely pond, gathering gusty speed, and as the cuckoo came there to sing the tune of "thenthena" steadily, without any hurry, during all the three times of the day, namely, morning, evening and dusk; both my eyes lost their ability to sleep, making me exhausted; my mind was agitated, and I suffered miserably due to an obsessive passion; will such a treacherous person like myself be ever able to attain Your hallowed blooming feet? He stole curd from the homes of the wealthy cowherds and ate it; His fame is worldwide in all the eight directions; He roams* behind the experts in the chaste language of Tamil; His complexion is that of dark cloud; He has the ability to win in (wrestling) duels, displaying enormous strength; He is Mukunthan known for His victory and purity; You are the favourite nephew of that Lord VishNu! Like the roaring sea, the drums called 'thunthupi' and other pot-like percussion instruments made tremendous noise sounding like "kumin kumin", when You came to the prosperous place ThiruchchendhUr and took Your seat there, Oh MurugA! For the benefit of this world, this mountain soars high in the sky obstructing daily the path of the moon, the sun and the clouds; this is ThirupparangkundRam, Your abode, Oh Great One!

I am an earthen pot containing spoiled foodstuff inside! I am a miserable stupid fool! I am also like a fragile vessel ready to break! I lead a life fully dictated by my five sensory organs! You have to come to my rescue at a moment's notice to fix my mind and bless me to serve Your two feet adorned by victorious anklets. For Creation, You chose BrahmA on the Lotus; for Destruction, You appointed Sankaran; and for Protection, You nominated Vishnu, consort of Lakshmi; after allocating these duties to them, You put their concerns to rest and You presided over the Cosmic Sky at all times, Oh, Lord with the unique spear! You reside at the beautiful mountain in ThirupparangkundRam, West of Madhurai! You are the son of Ganga, belonging to the great lineage of rivers! You sought VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavAs, at the millet field and joined Your lovely hands to prostrate to her, Oh Great One!

22.english_pathavurai: To postpone the day of my reckoning with the God of Death (Yaman); to end the frequent going in and out, seeing women and having a passionate liaison with them; to get rid of the three characteristics, namely sathwam (tranquility), rAjasam (aggressiveness) and thAmasam (sluggishness); to do away with the night (when the soul is inactive and asleep) and the day (when the soul is active and agitated); to sever the sufferings caused by the five sensory organs; to sing the glory of Your hallowed lotus feet; to contemplate the greatness of ThiruchchendhUr deeper and deeper until wisdom dawns; to understand You, KandhA, more and more, until that knowledge leads to the final destination with immaculate clarity; to disentangle my uncontrolled mind from each and every knot; to put an end to my speech and to let my action fade out gradually; and to attain the Real Wisdom; when will I be granted Your vision (to accomplish all the above)? Saying that Your holy feet, immersed in bunches of flowers, are the ultimate refuge, IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs, worshipped You and regained the capital (AmarAvathi) of his land. The damsel of the DEvAs, DEvayAnai, brought up by an elephant, won Your broad shoulders for her bosom. All the demons were killed, and Mount Krounchagiri, was smashed into powder. Your waist-band, made of lovely gold, produced lilting sound like "kiNin kiNin kiNin"; Your swinging ear-drops radiated luminous rays over the petite studs on Your ears; Your reddish little anklets made musical sounds to the tune of "thananthanan thanan thana"; and Your thandais (another type of anklet), made of gems, sounded like "galin galin galin" when You came to kiss Your mother, beautiful Sankari, sending Her into ecstatic pleasure. You are Her Son walking towards Her with a strong and relaxed gait! You are worshipped all over the world, Oh SaravanA, the Great One!

23.english_pathavurai: His red eyes emit the poison that came from the milky ocean; His white teeth shine like the crescent moon; He has curly tufted hair on His head; He is Yaman (God of Death) who is loud, armed and angry. At the time of the arrival of His summons, life swings between His world and the earth; drums and other percussion instruments like "thambattam" make a loud noise; all the relatives lament (walking along in the funeral procession); there is no illusion as to my belonging when the body is taken along the street; not having shared even a tiny bit of the morsel with the poor, to erase the old curse that I have been a miser, having lost the consciousness of spontaneously offering alms without vascillating between today and tomorrow, I do not want my body to be taken in procession to the beat of "dududududu dududududu duNdut duNdut". As my mind is scared of that mode of departure, would I not be able to share my wealth with the needy? As the Lord of the white water-lily, namely the Moon, shed nectar from his crescent body, as the anklets on His feet chanted the VEdAs liltingly, as the coiled hair of His tresses oscillated in accordance with the beats, as the creeper-like consort, PArvathi, danced at His side, as the sacred river Ganga swayed and moved about, as the waves of music leapt boundlessly, as the stones in the victory anklets rattled noisily, as the drums and trumpets were banged to (this) beat, and as the hand-drum held in His reddish hand clattered, He danced the Cosmic Dance; He is the Master of Bharatha Natya who blesses His devotees forever; You are worshipped by that Lord SivA, Oh Great Master! The shores of this town are embraced by the wavy sea which hurls heaps of gems and precious stones to settle on the tall coconut trees, which sacred sea contains many a fish and treasures of conch shells; That town is ThiruchchendhUr, Your abode, Oh KandhA, the Great One!

29.english_pathavurai: Those were smooth as anichcham* flower, those were like the soft cotton freshly ginned by the ginning bow, after removal of the waste materials; those were like the tender feather of the young swans that never left the water surface of the pond; and those were the supple and petite feet of the deer-like whores. Their pretty jewels, studded with precious emeralds, were dazzling like the sun; I am the sinner who pressed my face against their bosom wearing tightly fitted blouses; I am the lowly one who never pondered about the salvation of my soul in this birth; I am a total waste; I am an arrogant fool carried away by my big wealth; I am a sordid flop, gobbling up meat with relish; I am a depraved loafer speaking immorally, instead of chanting the unique ManthrA of six letters (SaravaNabava); I am the worst disaster never treading the righteous path; (despite all my defects), will You kindly call me by Your side and place Your holy feet on my head, and will I ever get Your blessing? The large blue sea, across which battle bugles are blown, was blocked and a bridge built to LankA; the undaunted king RAvaNa's ten strong heads were knocked off by a single powerful arrow of RAmA; and You are that Vishnu's nephew! The crescent and cool moon which rose from the milky ocean, a serpent, wide and wavy river GangA, Aththi (mountain ebony) flower and vilvam (bael) leaves are all stacked on His matted hair; Your emergence was due to that Lord SivA's infinite grace, Oh MurugA! The hunters of the rich forest living near the millet-field (of VaLLimalai) were astonished and exclaimed "What a wonder!" when You stood cleverly before them in the disguise of a neem tree, Oh KanthA! VaLLi is passionately in love with You standing there handsomely with Your lovely spear! On the great lotus ponds, on lofty terraces, and on the gorgeous shoreline, waves splash white pearls contained in pregnant shells in the town of ThiruchchendhUr, which is Your abode, Oh Brave One! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

30.english_pathavurai: All the people who saw me were scared and dismayed (looking at my disease); even though they chased me away in disgust and anger; I persisted and followed their footsteps. My body was rotting from the disease, stinking like a corpse, with worms oozing out and the bones shaking. I carried this miserable tottering body everywhere, going from door to door and saying flattering things. Day after day, I went to new places for my feast, roaming at my will. To put an end to this scandal of my deterioration, I must learn the essence of the four VEdAs and properly pay my obeisance to Your lotus feet adorned with lilting anklets. Will I ever be able to do that? VaLLi, looking like a peacock, was engaged in guarding the millet-field by scaring away the parrots; with Your broad chest, You hugged her two bosoms that were blooming like tender coconuts. Once, in the presence of Your Father, You went around the entire universe in a circular orbit, in competition with the elephant-faced Ganapathi; You are the valorous one who mounted the beautiful peacock of reddish golden hue! You belong to all mountains where monkeys strew about sweet fruits! Your abode is ThiruchchendhUr, Oh Lord! GuhA! KanthA! You are ever youthful! The seven seas, the eight mountains and the demons were all terrified while You gave refuge to the petrified Celestials by saying "Fear Not", Oh Great One!

I would like to drown myself in the ocean of eternal bliss attained as a result of Your great compassion and to realise You within my heart; that requisite love can only be given by You. That girl VaLLi was guarding the millet-field belonging to the hunters who lived in a mountainous region, full of peacocks and sheep, and she (VaLLi) was beautiful like Lakshmi; You went and bowed before her and later embraced her! You live in ThiruchchendhUr which is as holy as Mount Kailas. You are the younger brother of the elephant-faced God, VinAyagA, Oh Great One!

33.english_pathavurai: Spreading out their black and dark hair to dry, loosening and revealing their tightly-fitting garment, casting an arrogant look from the corner of their eyes, dramatically soliciting the betel leaves and nuts from men, shooting out many verbal responses willingly and spontaneously, showing their grinning faces from time to time, saying "this is our house; please do step in" and ensnaring their suitors, making love by hugging their suitors in their wide and flower-filled beds, showing concern and flirtation in proportion to the money offered, and (later) using words of disdain and chasing away men who dared enter their decorated homes, these evil whores practise unilateral love (on their own terms); will there be a day when I shall escape from their abuse and begin to praise Your hallowed feet? The current (in the river) splashes many colourful diamonds and gems and the foam is whiter than the curved and young bamboo shoot; the little river makes such resounding music, with gushing flood and water flowing in abundance; deep in the middle of the wild river, there is an islet formed by dunes of dry sand on which stands a grove; stirring the waterfall in the grove, girls make merry by trussing the flowers into garlands and playing around; in the millet-field that shoots out fragrant bunches of millet-flowers, She remains conspicuous standing high on a bamboo-platform in the middle; You became totally captivated by that damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi, with blossoming bosom, Oh Lord of ThiruchchendhUr! He took the budding crescent moon and held it on His matted hair; and You graciously preached the VEdic principle to that Lord SivA, Oh Lord MurugA! You are the Lord of those sages who have maintained their posture of penance, Oh Great One!

38.english_pathavurai: The handsome and robust body became emaciated. The five sensory organs that once ruled the body were thrown into confusion and disarray. The body turned into a corpse that was carried by a few for a fee. Large drums were beaten in a ritualistic manner to the meter of "vettavida vettak kidanjang kidanjam". People marched in a group following the corpse, and a few simply rolled along the path, while some cleared the way for the funeral procession. When will I escape from this myth called life and learn to seek the way to attain Your hallowed feet? The tall and arrogant Mount Krouncha was hit by Your spear which pierced right through shattering it to pieces. The entire sea, with dissipated waves, dried up, shrinking into a muddy puddle. Upon impact of Your sharp spear, the strong and aggressive demons were completely uprooted, with their heads chopped off. The truncated bodies of the demons danced on the battlefield along with large eagles. Pools of blood filled up everywhere. From the crowns of the demons, precious gems were knocked down. You planted the seed of prosperity for the celestials and the sages in ThiruchchendhUr, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

39.english_pathavurai: Their speech is sweet like sugar candy; their bosoms are like the ivory tusks of the elephant; their waist is slender like the creeper vanji (rattan reed); their eyes are comparable to arrow and poison; and their hair is like the dark cloud. - so on and so forth, for a long time, I was seeking similarities and so raking my brains to find them. 40.english_pathavurai: These women are more beautiful than Saraswathi, who has Her seat on the lotus, and Lakshmi. Day and night, I keep lusting after their cool bosom splashed with sandal paste, their lovely arms; their clandestine eyes which display the black mascara and stealthy knowledge of love-making; their provocative, fragrant and dark hair; and their moon-like faces. Lest I am enticed by them, I would like to obtain a spotless mind. I would like to learn thoroughly the guiding treatises, which are vast and imperishable, on the fundamentals of DharmA, Arththa and KAma; in that process, I would like to extinguish all my desires; then, I would like to know about Your Grace all by myself; and for all that, I seek Your love and Your feet, which bear the anklets making a sweet sound with the reddish-golden beads! She is forever youthful virgin; She is dark complexioned KALi; She is the destroyer of all fears; She gives happiness to all souls; She is gold and blue complexioned; She is the most Supreme of all supreme principles; She is the Mother of the Universe; She is delusion in the purest form; She takes the form of yOgA; She is ferocious to all sinners; She is the Kundalini power; She is our Mother; She has no wants whatsoever; She is UmAdEvi; She is the One who delivers the paradise; She has no end; and She is the beautiful One worshipped by all the SivA AkamAs (foremost scriptures). She is PArvathi who delivered You, Oh KumarA! The five-armed One; Ganapathi, who mounts the big rat (MUshikam); our beloved VinAyagan; He wears as a belt the poisonous cobra around His waist; He wears the crescent moon on His head; He is the elephant-faced One; and He cherishes You in His heart and loves You dearly as a Younger brother! There are plenty of tall plantain trees, turmeric plants and ginger plants, which are so close to each other that there is always an auspicious aura around this great city of ThiruchchendhUr, which is Your favourite abode, Oh Great One!

You are seated in the rich and fertile town, ThiruchchendhUr, Oh Great One!

61.english_pathavurai: The beetles are humming with pleasure, sucking cool honey from the flowers donning the hair (like black cloud) of women. I am flirting with those women openly, chatting with them; and am I not baser than a dog? This so-called healthy body of mine is made of five elements, namely, earth, water, fire, air and sky; and before my life departs this mythical hut of my body for its final journey to the cremation ground, please come to me and grant Your lotus feet! SUran, who enjoyed the company of those flattering him, was killed by You, Oh Victorious KumaresA! At this hill, the beetles make great music around the flowers, and it is a very famous mount called 'Mandral giri' - VaLLimalai*, where You belong! You imbibed the sacred milk of PArvathi, which was sweet as jaggery. You punish all Your enemies, Oh KandhA, the strong shouldered! Oh KumarA, Your shoulders are solid as a pillar and are also terrific! Oh, KandhA, Your abode is ThiruchchendhUr, Oh Great One!

62.english_pathavurai: Thandai and Vendaiyam (two types of anklet) kiNkiNi and cathangai (two other types of anklet) gracious kazhal and cilampu (two other anklets) all these anklets making a pleasant sound together, You went earnestly in front of Your Father, SivA, and went around Him happily; and embraced Him with ardent love. Like that steady love, I too should be able to see You and lose myself in You; with kadampa flowers, beautiful and ornate crowns, reddish hands like lotus flowers, the spear that destroyed cUran (demon), twelve eyes and six Divine faces, and the moonlit shining colours on those, all these should cool my eyes, and would they not manifest before me? The earth which was created by BrahmA (who sits on a lotus flower), and the encircling Universe which gobbled up the earth jumped with joy when You entered the battlefield. You stood like a golden mountain* and expanded in all directions and elated the minds of Vishnu and Your father, SivA. Those dancing feet of Yours are in this place, ThiruchchendhUr, and also dance in front of my eyes lovingly, Oh Kanda, handsome one like Manmatha! You indulge in the sandal-fragrant bosom of VaLLi, the KuRava girl. You are also worshipped by the sage, Agasthya, Oh Great One!

63.english_pathavurai: She knew when I would be hungry and breast-fed me with nectar-like milk; she then caressed my back - she is my mother! My younger brother, obedient servants, dear younger sister, nephews, my sons who love me as if I am their life, my wives and other relatives - all of them carry out their duties calling me according to their relationship. They assemble in agony, their hair falling on the floor in disarray, some of them swooning, when the blind God of Death, Yaman, mounting a buffalo, closes in on me. At that time, ascending on Your strong peacock and announcing "Fear Not", You must declare to that Yaman "This man is my favourite and he is my devotee"; You must come to me with these words! She was exhilarated when PArvathi, daughter of HimavAn, breast-fed You, and You drank that nectar-like milk gushing from Her, Oh Warrior-God with the Spear! He wears the crescent moon, the snake and the river Ganga, compactly packed in His tresses; that SivA delivered You to us! You reside happily in ThiruchchendhUr, Oh Great One!

66.english_pathavurai: Hanging out in the streets, standing as if they are enthralled, these women keep shaking their mountain-like bosom; they speak with a giggle, melting the hearts of men and, at times, they talk arrogantly, leading a life of stale garbage; these young women (of the profession of prostitution) speak soothing words as though they are the great protectors; with their mind set on grabbing money, they look for solvent men and make them pine for them with passion by speaking tantalisingly; at once, they lead them to their house, put out the lamp in the terrace, lie down on the bed and make their suitors on top of them; they act out, feigning provocatively, and not being content with the money offered, they demand more money for this and that, casting a spell of magical words; they extract the entire belongings of the suitors, literally seizing them from their hand, rendering them weak and eventualy throw them out of their house; kindly bless me so that I avoid the company of such whores, Oh Lord! With his twenty huge mountainous shoulders and ten heads supported by those shoulders, the demon RAvaNan fought the war in a fit of rage; all the warring demons who angrily jumped on to the battlefield like mountains were destroyed and scared away when Lord VishNu (coming as RAmA) beat them all and severed their lives; You are the favourite nephew of that VishNu, Oh Lord! The bunch of sEl fish living here jump over the mud-boundaries of the paddy fields and gather rich pearls in the circular islet making a heap; such fields abound in the greatest place in this world, namely, ThiruththaNigai, where You reside triumphantly! You are immortal, Oh Lord! Your abode is ThiruchchendhUr, Oh Lord GuhA!

68.english_pathavurai: With my paunch sagging, my hair graying, erstwhile perfect teeth shaking, my back hunched, my lips drooping, and one hand resting on a supporting cane, (I will be moving). The girls will be giggling and wondering who this old man is! With metallic sound in my cough and incoherent speech, my eyes dimmed due to blindness and ears deafening, I will be afflicted by all diseases, and, to add to my woe, will be this native doctor intruding! I will suffer so much pain all over my body. Young sons pestering me for details of my assets and liabilities, overcome by grief, my wife will cry and faint. Messengers of Death-God (Yama) will be standing there waiting to snatch my life away. Faeces will be getting excreted without my control. At that very last minute of my life's fading away, You, MurugA, must come to me fast on Your Peacock! "Come to me, Oh Lord, come to me, the jewel of Raghu Dynasty, come, my son, come fast, my darling child, Come, my eye, come to me, my life, Oh handsome Rama, come here, my king, come to drink milk, and come to be adorned with flowers", so beseeched Kousalya with love inviting Rama to come; and that mystic Rama (Vishnu) came along, whose favourite nephew You are, Oh MurugA! You, handsome one, embrace VaLLi, the young damsel of KuRavas, who is like a vanji (rattan reed) creeper. You liberated the DEvAs and killed the entire dynasties of demons (asuras), Oh Brave One! You are the son of SivA, who wears the moon, the serpent and Ganga river on his tresses. On the shores of ThiruchchendhUr lashed by waves, You happily reside, Oh Great One!

69.english_pathavurai: The harlots depend upon this body which is but a shell covered by skin; the games played by these women are replete with deceit; in order to shower them with riches, people run around and are at pains to compose newer versions of ThUthu, NAn maNi mAlai, Prabandham, Kovai, UlA and Madal*, becoming totally obsessed with them. My legs hurt after walking door to door of these wicked youth. I am a vain fellow and an immoral liar; I am a shameless person with a degenerating mind; I am a miser, abusing others; I am utterly useless; and I am a disreputable lowly person. For the removal of all miseries arising in this world due to the phenomenon of cause and effect, and for the sake of good life, will You not willingly grant me a little of the true wisdom that is the flawless treasure? He is seated on the swan, white as milk, and has four faces; He has a reddish-golden complexion and His job is creation; That BrahmA was once punished by You by knocking His heads with Your knuckles! Once, He sat on the shoulders of mighty HanumAn and fought in the battlefield; He knocked off the heads of the sinner, RAvaNan; He blessed virtuous Vibhishana with prosperous life; and He hugged the shoulders of His consort, Seetha; that RAmA (Vishnu) is Your uncle, and You are very dear to His heart! The sage Naradha, renowned for his upright character, came to You and showed You the millet-field where VaLLi was living; You then rushed over there to the honey-tongued VaLLi and embraced her beautiful mountainous bosoms, fragrant with the aroma of camphor! The various fish of the variety of sEl, vALai and varAl vault so high as to caress the bunches of betelnuts in the PUgam trees in this joyful town of ThiruchchendhUr, which is Your abode, Oh KandhA, the Great One!

70.english_pathavurai: This body has nine portals* in it and is full of blemish. The legs and arms got attached to this body which is made up of nerves and bones. To this body, an organ meant for sound got affixed. Also other five prime sensory organs required for all functions, this body enacted several dramas in this world! Before this body grows to a point where the exit of life from it is not known to anyone in this world, this body searches for millions of books and goes through them; the mind gets confused; and this body heaps a lot of praise on so many wealthy people in this world, changes its mind and suffers the consequences! I do not want to suffer that life full of several diseases. I want You to mingle with my mind so that I could recite and understand the complete treatise of True Knowledge; and that is the life I want from You. Yaman, the Death-God, came to take the life of MarkandEyan, and when he threw the Cord of Bondage (PAsakkayiRu), He (Lord SivA), the foremost God, came with the words "Fear not, fear not"; When Manmathan (Love God) attacked Him, he was cursed to burn along with his five flowery arrows by Lord SivA, sitting in silence as DhakshinAmUrthy, who looked at him with His fiery eye of the forehead; He has blue-tinged throat (due to His imbibing the fierce poison); and You preached to that SivA the significance of the VEdAs (scriptures)! He (Vishnu) reclines on the Milky Ocean which once generated the fierce poison; when the elephant GajEndran screamed for help, He came to his aid; He holds the weapon of Chakra (disc) in His hand; and He belongs to the family of shepherds. You are the nephew of that mystic Vishnu! All the VEdAs worship Your lotus feet! You hold a staff of the Rooster! You are the most primordial One! You have Your abode at ThiruchchendhUr, Oh Great One!

72.english_pathavurai: Deeming the transient things as solid gold, I wasted so many days. I lost my concentration, became deaf and blind, my body was filled with diseases, and my five senses became confused. Faeces and urine were involuntarily discharged on my bed. I was dying. For me, the right path towards salvation is the expansive bright light, beyond description for the Scriptures, emanating from Your Lotus-Feet, which You must kindly grant me. The demons (asuras), who were murderers, were destroyed; the big ocean dried up as a little pond; and the old mango tree (in which disguise was SUran) was hit and split into two; when You threw the burning Spear with a firm grip. You happily reside on the shore of ThiruchchendhUr, Oh KumarA, Lord SivA, with everlasting pure form, was taught by You the meaning of OM, which is beyond everything. But You are so easy to reach for Your devotees, Oh Great One!

86.english_pathavurai: My five perceptory senses are the outlets of my mind; my character is built on those senses and my body is the pillar to which the perceptory organs are tied. To knock off (my mind and body), KAlan, Messenger of the God of Death, comes; with a spark of fire sprouting from his red flowery eyes; picking up the powerful mace in his hand; he is coming fiercely, piercing the sky, today, to take my life away. All the relatives residing in my home try to loot my property, saying, "this is mine and that is yours; sharing my property to the various groups," So fighting, they become exhausted, destroying their love for me. Before my body decays in those circumstances, I should not waste the musical and poetical Tamil words in the infamy of beseeching others for alms. That misery must be excluded, and You must bless me with the bliss of Your grace! The white conch-shell PAnchajanyam, that came from the cold, roaring ocean, adorns the hand of Vishnu; and He reclines on the Snakebed, feigning sleep, to remove the misery of souls everywhere. BrahmA, whose origin was on the bright lotus from the navel of Vishnu. Both of them (Vishnu and BrahmA) lost their prestige when You interpreted the great meaning of the PraNava ManthrA musically to Lord SivA who was ecstatic! She lives in the millet-field near the hill; She is the young lass, VaLLi; and her bosom smeared with vermilion paste was embraced by Your lovely golden shoulders! The deep and serene sea, full of a variety of conchshells, and the cool groves of sandalwood trees are present at ThiruchchendhUr, Your favourite abode, Oh Great One!

95.english_pathavurai: With an evil design, strong RAvaNA assembled a troop of robust horses (capable of sprinting like balls), chariots, elephants and many regiments of soldiers arrayed like tiers of clouds; they came to the battlefield to face the clusters of the enemy's arrows; even then, he kept on bragging about his valour, talking excessively in vain and ridiculing his opponent. When he fiercely fought the whole day with the army of the opponent, the monkeys were enraged and displayed their anger like the steadily-burning fire by throwing boulders and rocks from the mountains and branches of rough trees. With the rocks chipped from the hills, they shattered and cast away the bodies, heads, arms, chests and other prominent limbs of the enemy. The entire clan of the demons was driven to the South, the direction ruled by YamA (the God of Death). The messengers of YamA went after them to YamA's land and kept pushing the demons further and further. Some fiends got the sight and taste of the demons' flesh, fat and brains and began to jump about in exhilaration, dancing to the meter of "diN diN". This victory was achieved by the lofty arrows wielded by Rama (Vishnu), and You are His nephew! I surrender to You, I surrender to You; my intellect is very very meagre, Oh Lord, kindly bless me with the blissful liberation that is everlasting! Conch shells, lotus and kayal fish are abundant in the surrounding tanks which are filled with water to the brim everywhere in this sacred place, ThiruchchendhUr, which is Your abode, Oh Exalted and Great One!

97.english_pathavurai: Coming to me again and again, he crawls and gives me immense pleasure; he repeatedly cries for milk; - he is my child. It is so huge that its sheer weight causes tremor on the earth, and its gold-laden halls are tall, piercing the skies; - it is my house. Her hair, adorned with bunches of flowers, unfurls loosely and her bosom is splashed with vermilion; - she is my dear wife with a vanji (rattan reed) creeper-like waist. I have been thinking that these are my permanent support. At the time of my death, when my consciousness fades, kindly bless me with Your lotus feet, adorned with pollen (kongu) of flowers of fragrant and fresh kadambu, and lilting anklets and reddish ornaments of the ankles (sadhangai). There are sandalwood trees, manthAram trees with rich blossoms, ripe sugarcanes, and plantains with bunches of fruits that have grown skyhigh in ThiruchchendhUr, which is Your abode. You went across the cool forest to VaLLi, whose sweet words sound like a symphony of rich melodies; You entered the rich millet-field to see and beseech her, Oh Lord! She comes to the aid of Your devotees to the consternation of Yaman (God of Death) and resides graciously in the caves of their hearts; She has the complexion of vermilion; She is DEvayAnai who hugs Your broad chest with ecstatic relish, Oh Lord! Naradha, Your friend, who went to the beautiful millet-field (for Your sake), Lord SivA, the good celestial king IndrA, many worthy celestials and Agasthya, the sage who emerged from a pot, always rely on You, Oh Great One!

The so-called gentle breeze from the north is scorching me like fire. Vengeful women keep on blabbering their gossips. Poor myself (like VaLLi), living in the mountain of KuRavas, am consumed by tormenting love for You; to pacify me, You must come in the cool evening to give me Your kadappa garland (as a token of Your love). Will You not come to me to remove my blemish? Lord SivA, who holds a young deer in His hand, is elated to worship You (for Your teaching Him the meaning of OM), Oh Learned One! 103.english_pathavurai: Are those (eyes) the most desirable lotus, venomous poison, kayal fish, vast sea of bliss or the cleft in the baby-mangoes? or are those eyes the arrows once shot, conquering Lord SivA, by the old God of Love (Manmathan) who was burnt to ashes? Or black lilies? Is their bosom the place where everyone seeks refuge or is it the heart of the messengers of the God of Death (Yaman)? In order to kill the thought of drowning in the lustful bosom of those whores who hanker after passionate union, will there be a day when You will graciously grant me Your hallowed feet, adorned by the fragrant garland of kUthaLa (thUthuvaLai - a bushy shrub) flowers and also by anklets? The evil demon, Tharukan, notorious for five heinous sins***, who resembled the God of Death, was destroyed to pieces; the celestials were able to resettle in their capital amarAvathi like before; and BrahmA, seated on the lotus, and Lord VishNu were reassured by You to remain without fear when You wielded the spear upon the mount Krouncha, capable of many sorcerous tricks, and shattered it to smithereens, Oh Young Lord! On His reddish matted hair, He wears the River Gangai, kurukkaththi (a flowering creeper) and Aththi (mountain ebony) leaves, and the crescent moon; You are the treasure delivered by that Leader, Lord SivA! Around this place there are forests of sheNbaga (champak) trees and many tall and huge fortress walls; this is ThiruchchendhUr, Your abode, Oh Great One!

104.english_pathavurai: I am not intelligent enough to challenge and debate with the zealots of the six* religious sub-sects who are subject to the impact of the wide gamut of past deeds**; I am like a worm with a uni-sense, mired in the company of whores with large bosom who display their love on their unique bed, exuding the aroma of incense and musk, to the extent only of the money they receive; will I be able to go to Your great shrine in Pazhani, which is the Supreme form of Effulgence of SivA, attained by those devotees in Your service, day and night, and who have renounced all attachments; in order that the deed of birth is done away with, will I be able one day to hold on to Your hallowed feet adorned with vetchi and kurA flowers dripping with honey? He brought a lot of name and fame to his birth place, SeegAzhi; he was able to lessen the fever of King KUn PANdiyan of Madhurai who fell at his feet; with the bright holy ash, he was able send the ChamaNas, clad in mats of dry grass, to the gallows; You were able to debate and win over them, Oh Smart One (who came as ThirugnAna Sambandhar)! When many poets were caught by a treacherous she-devil with the face of a horse, You came, Oh Lord, to the aid of Nakkeerar***, one of those poets (imprisoned by the devil). The hostile and huge places called Thiripuram were burnt down to ashes by His gracious smile alone; He is the brother-in-law of Lord VishNu who had devoured the seven worlds; and You are that Lord SivA's child, Oh Lord! To derive benefit successfully after removing all sufferings, ThEvAram is a far superior text when compared to ThirukkuraL (that expounds the three basic traits of life, namely, righteousness, material wealth and love); You wrote that ThEvAram (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) on a dry palm-leaf and let it proceed upstream in River Vaigai, Oh Great One!

105.english_pathavurai: The stone-hearted women line up in the street and accost me casting enticing looks at me with arrow-like eyes. Love God Manmathan with a sugarcane bow whose string is made of humming beetles keeps on shooting his flowery arrows to arouse me. My mind gets sick, wisdom takes leave, and I feel miserable. My vices take over leading me to the Death-God. I am about to die; and I want to be liberated from the ocean of birth. Only You can show the grace to lead me to the exalted blissful state of self-realisation. You took the form of a neem tree to woo VaLLi, the damsel of the mountain, and appeared before her. You asked BrahmA, seated on the lotus, to interpret the meaning of OM; and when He failed to do so, You imprisoned Him. Lord SivA, who wears a serpent and River GangA on His tresses, paid obeisance to You when You kindly explained to Him the significance of OM. The fortress walls are multi-coloured, coral, white and golden hues, at Pazhani, which is Your abode, KumarA, Oh Great One!

113.english_pathavurai: From the corners of their evil eyes, comparable to AlakAla poison and lethal spears that have executed many a murder, they create an aura of passion; they make many false promises to young men, pretending to tell the truth and captivate them without letting them free; they arouse erotic desire to an extreme degree and the succumbing men are firmly held under their control; in a variety of ways, they leave the men dazed and loot their belongings by alternately fighting with them and cajoling; they embrace men indiscriminately without regard to caste or creed; I wish to give up my lust for such whores; kindly bless me to become Your devoted servant and to follow the righteous path of worship so as to contemplate Your hallowed feet everyday. He wears on His matted hair a young crescent-moon, Umaththa flower, erukku leaf, aRugam (cynodon) grass, River Gangai and pULai (Indian laburnum) flower; He is SokkEsan (SivA), the Lord of Madhurai; and You are His son, Oh wonderful MurugA! He destroyed MAreechan, who came in the disguise of a mystic deer, along with many demons; He took the bow in His hand and wielded an arrow that pierced through the heart of VAli; He has strong shoulders ready to wrestle; and You are the nephew of that RAmA (Lord VishNu)! In the forest (of VaLLimalai) pointed out to You by Sage NArathar, who has methodically learnt the four VEdAs and is capable of reciting them, and who holds in his hand the musical instrument, VeeNA, You went running across everywhere in search of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and finally brought her home as Your consort, Oh Lord! In this town called Pazhani which is surrounded by groves showering ripe coconuts and jack fruits, You are seated, holding in Your hand the Spear, the symbol of the highest knowledge and consummate power, Oh Great One!

114.english_pathavurai: After saying ARumukam six times, they take the Holy Ash (VibUthi) and apply it on their bodies, the great sages; their devotees prostrate before the sages' lotus feet; such devotees' feet are the only solace to us. Every day, (we pray to You saying) "You, the great peacock rider! GuhA! SaravaNA! my God! My dignity is entirely Yours" and we ask "The mental anguish of ours, the poor souls - why is it like this?" - Even then (if You are silent) who will praise You? What will the VEdAs speak about You? Adorned with the holy ash on Your golden body, Oh VElA! The rider of the beautiful blue peacock! Oh MurugavEL, the son of UmAdEvi! Along with the Asuras, destroy my evil Karma too; for that You fling Your long and unique Spear! Oh, VElA, whose Spear is fierce like VatavAgni (the Cosmic Fire which destroyed the Universe once). The giant asura (GajamukAsuran) came furiously (before) the elephant-headed VinAyagA, who took the Asura's life - You are the younger brother of that VinAyagA! With mountain peaks reaching the roof of the sky, is beautiful Pazhani, which is Your abode, Oh KumarA! You gave a boon to BrahmA! MurugA! Oh Lord of Lords!

115.english_pathavurai: Born as a human seed on this earth, crying, choking under long breaths and lying on the lap (of the mother), crawling, taking many a wobbly step, running around in the streets, learning millions of modern texts in an exemplary manner on this earth, after attaining the age of sixteen, befriending many beautiful girls who are well-seasoned with all the attributes of that youthful period, being haunted by the mischievous deeds of Manmathan (God of Love) holding the bow of sugarcane and a bunch of rare arrows of flowers, singing many songs from texts like kalambakam (on rich people) and flattering them, roaming in all directions to the end of the frontiers in order to earn plentiful wealth, slumbering on fragrant flowery beds, melting in the desire for bliss offered (by the whores), sinking in the middle of their round and solid bosom and drowning deeply under the influence of passionate delusion, I have been afflicted by many diseases, with my intelligence completely wrecked; now, Yaman (God of Death) pursues me in order to drag my life tying it with the rope of bondage, ready to take it away; my parents surrounding me begin to sob and the relatives wail uncontrollably; some people say "This man never listened to anyone in the town, and now he is subjugated by Yaman, and his life is not going to last for long; he is destined to die according to what is written by Lord Brahma; (as predetermined) Yaman has sent his messenger today at the appointed time, and he is no more"; some others say "It is getting late; take the body to the cremation ground"; some people run around and bring new drums as pre-planned and begin to beat them loudly; for proper cremation to singe the body into ashes, dried cow-dung cakes are stacked neatly; all assembled hug one another sobbing and stating that he has been burnt down by the fire and then dip in the water washing away their attachment; getting out of that bondage, I would like to hold, as my refuge, Your hallowed lotus feet that is a repository of true knowledge and sing songs in Tamil worshipping You; for that You have to kindly manifest before me to grant that devotion in which I should melt, Oh Lord! Mounting the matchless peacock making sounds to the meter "thiththA thiriththikuda thaththA thanaththakutha thAthath thananthathana thAnath thananthathana secchE sekucchekuku thiththA thimiththathiku thAthath thasenthikutha theethath thasentharika thiththA kidakkaNaka dakkA kukukkukuku thOthak kaNangaNaka kUkuk kiNangiN", You fought with the demons who came riding powerful chariots in a confronting manner, and killed them all; You dehydrated the sea and stood there after splitting the seven mountains, Oh Lord ChiththA!* You are the great leader of all the celestials! Oh Pure One, You hugged the bosom of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and by means of Your playful activities wore her fragrance (upon Your shoulders)! You came into existence as a pearl of Mother PArvathi, earned fame as the Master-child-prodigy and ran around playfully wearing the garland of kadappa flowers, Oh Lord! He has the face of an elephant from which bile of frenzy oozes; and You are the younger brother of that Lord GaNapathi, Oh Lord GuhA! He wielded arrows severing and felling the head of the foolish demon RAvaNan who ruled LankA, full of sins; He has the hue of black cloud; Janakar's daughter Seethai, whose natural fragrance is that of the lotus, was hugged by Him with His chest; and You are the dear nephew of that Lord RaghurAman; With a compassion equal to the perennial flow of honey, You studied the VEdic texts faultlessly and researched into the language Tamil to compose devotional hymns (ThEvAram) in praise of Your Father (Lord SivA), (coming as ThirugnAnasambandhar), Oh Master! Revealing to the entire world what constitutes the Supreme Principle, You remained as the gracious beacon of glorious light surrounding all lives; You wear several garlands of devotional songs on the multitude of Your hallowed shoulders on which leans the powerful spear, Oh Lord! In this mount Pazhani, the pleasant aroma of civet always pervades; seated here with relish, You enter, and roam within the souls of Your devotees, Oh Great One!

116.english_pathavurai: It can be compared to the sun, or the inferno coming from the north at the end of the aeon or the terrible poison (AlakAlam); such is the hideous form of the moon that transits the sky; Manmathan (God of Love), the consort of Rathi DEvi, keeps on shooting the arrows of four flowers; like His trumpet (ekkAlam), the cuckoo keeps cooing; His drums are roaring like the seven seas; the jarring sound of the flute and the bells tied to the bulls is piercing the ears like warring arrows; not realising her torment of passion, the women-folk heckle her, spreading evil gossip; uttering Your name as "Hara Hara", my girl suffers immeasurable grief that is beyond description; my daughter, who is normally sweet like nectar and beautiful like peacock, is hostile to everyone because of her situation; she swoons again and again and has become very weak and thin due to the build-up of scandal in the town; she is destitute and directionless; even if she is destined to suffer, there is no question of her leaving Your presence; it is Your responsibility to take charge of her; her love is unabated, and to embrace this lonesome girl, kindly mount the OM-shaped peacock and come to her rescue, Oh MurugA! In the mountain, herds of cow came around Him in worship; He knocked down the unique marutha tree and kicked the demon (SakatAsuran) to his death, when he came charging in the disguise of a cart-wheel to kill Him; To ward off the torrential rain that came down hard to kill the cattle, He lifted the mount GOvardhan like an umbrella; You are the nephew of that Lord GopAlan with lotus-like hand. She is absolutely without blemish; She has three eyes; She is Kumari who radiates light as She moves about; She is Gowri and KALi, wearing the serpent as jewel; She is presiding over the three worlds; She is the daughter reared by HimavAn, the Mountain-King of the closely packed Mount HimAlayAs; and She is the Omnipresent Goddess, UmA; You are Her Son! You fought in the war by wielding the spear and shattered the seas, mountains and large armies of the demons, thereby removing the misery of the celestials; Your hands are like lotus, Oh MurugA! You are like the jewel in the crown of knowledge of the enlightened ones who are well-versed in the four vEdAs, Oh Warrior, mounting the Peacock! She is the damsel of the KuRavAs, with blooming bosom splattered with the paste of sandal mixed with camphor and musk; Your flirtatious sports with that VaLLi elated her, Oh Lord! The great text of hymns (ThEvAram), full of powerful diction and sweet meaning, was dedicated by You (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) to this world, Oh Lord! You are seated, with joy, in Pazhani as Your abode, and You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

123.english_pathavurai: Even once, at Your two hallowed feet I failed to prostrate with devotion. Towards Your abode called Pazhani I have never worshipped. In this vast world, a lofty and rare way of life was never pursued by me as a goal. (Despite all my shortcomings,) I still desire not to be reborn! When will I put an end to my desires? The asuras (demons) were always committing sins; their dwellings were destroyed by You like a hurricane, Oh Great One! For those devotees who bow down and worship You, You are their Saviour, Oh Great One! The Poet, who gave to this world songs of victory wonderfully - (that ThirugnAna Sambandhar)* is Yourself, Oh Great One! For VaLLi, the damsel of the valorous KuRavas, You are the timely protector, Oh Great One!

124.english_meanings_list: ["Those people doing research in religion are such that one's statement is not understood by the others;", "those with a mind not capable of abiding by any one principle;", "and those who believe in the perpetuity of the body and keep on committing sins like stealing, lying and murder;", "ultimately, will all fall into hell controlled by the God of Death (Yaman).", "After that phase, they will assume whatever shape or body destined for them,", "suffering deep inside the sea of good and bad deeds and will become extinct.", "Be their status as it may,", "(lest I suffer like them - ) in order that I attain the ultimate wisdom of Destination SivA, kindly bless me with holy ash,", "bestowing me with good position, and grant me Your hallowed feet.", "He burnt down Thiripuram and Manmathan, holding the bow of sugarcane,", "by His mere smile and the fiery eye (in His forehead); that eye generated sparks from which You were born, Oh Master!", "The consorts of Lakshmi, Saraswathi and Maheswari (namely, Vishnu, BrahmA and Rudra) sang His glory while", "He (NadarAjA), the great leader, performed the cosmic dance; You are that SivA's child!", "When IndrA, the Chief of the Celestials, BrahmA and Vishnu appealed and sought Your refuge,", "You shattered the millions of demons into dust by wielding Your Spear, which is nothing but True Wisdom!", "Several scriptures worship You as the Consort of VaLLi, the delectable belle of the KuRavAs.", "You have chosen the ancient town Pazhani as Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
124.english_pathavurai: Those people doing research in religion are such that one's statement is not understood by the others; those with a mind not capable of abiding by any one principle; and those who believe in the perpetuity of the body and keep on committing sins like stealing, lying and murder; ultimately, will all fall into hell controlled by the God of Death (Yaman). After that phase, they will assume whatever shape or body destined for them, suffering deep inside the sea of good and bad deeds and will become extinct. Be their status as it may, (lest I suffer like them - ) in order that I attain the ultimate wisdom of Destination SivA, kindly bless me with holy ash, bestowing me with good position, and grant me Your hallowed feet. He burnt down Thiripuram and Manmathan, holding the bow of sugarcane, by His mere smile and the fiery eye (in His forehead); that eye generated sparks from which You were born, Oh Master! The consorts of Lakshmi, Saraswathi and Maheswari (namely, Vishnu, BrahmA and Rudra) sang His glory while He (NadarAjA), the great leader, performed the cosmic dance; You are that SivA's child! When IndrA, the Chief of the Celestials, BrahmA and Vishnu appealed and sought Your refuge, You shattered the millions of demons into dust by wielding Your Spear, which is nothing but True Wisdom! Several scriptures worship You as the Consort of VaLLi, the delectable belle of the KuRavAs. You have chosen the ancient town Pazhani as Your abode, Oh Great One!

127.english_meanings_list: ["Nuts, fried rice, beans, a variety of fruits and sugarcane are consumed", "in His tough pot-belly;", "He has strange track-marks of tears of fury due to three kinds of rage;*", "His eyes are small like the petals of lotus; and", "He is the elephant-faced VinAyagA, with You as His younger brother.", "The peaks of the northern mountain MEru were vibrating", "when You flew around the world in a second, mounting Your emerald-green peacock!", "DEvayAnai, the daughter of DEvEndrA, and", "VaLLi, the lightning-like damsel of the KuRavAs, are both flanking You,", "and You tease them romantically as their Consort!", "Dynasties of the strong demons (asuras) were completely destroyed; and", "the great DEvAs were liberated from their imprisonment;", "when You wielded the exceedingly elegant Spear that sparkles like the Sun's rays!", "Oh Hara Hara, SaravaNabhavA, the Playful One!", "He, who adorns His tresses with the Moon, the Master of the vast multitude of stars, and with kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers, -", "that Pasupathi (Leader of the souls) SivA, the eternal river GangA,", "and the pretty, ancient and pure Mother UmAdEvi have together delivered You as their babbling baby!", "You have Your abode at Mount Pazhani, Oh Great One!"]
127.english_pathavurai: Nuts, fried rice, beans, a variety of fruits and sugarcane are consumed in His tough pot-belly; He has strange track-marks of tears of fury due to three kinds of rage;* His eyes are small like the petals of lotus; and He is the elephant-faced VinAyagA, with You as His younger brother. The peaks of the northern mountain MEru were vibrating when You flew around the world in a second, mounting Your emerald-green peacock! DEvayAnai, the daughter of DEvEndrA, and VaLLi, the lightning-like damsel of the KuRavAs, are both flanking You, and You tease them romantically as their Consort! Dynasties of the strong demons (asuras) were completely destroyed; and the great DEvAs were liberated from their imprisonment; when You wielded the exceedingly elegant Spear that sparkles like the Sun's rays! Oh Hara Hara, SaravaNabhavA, the Playful One! He, who adorns His tresses with the Moon, the Master of the vast multitude of stars, and with kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers, - that Pasupathi (Leader of the souls) SivA, the eternal river GangA, and the pretty, ancient and pure Mother UmAdEvi have together delivered You as their babbling baby! You have Your abode at Mount Pazhani, Oh Great One!

128.english_pathavurai: The women of dubious character who hinder my path to salvation, and their newly bejewelled bosom looking like huge mounts, provoked me highly with passion and disturbed my mind. Nevertheless, (I am now thinking about) Your famous Supreme body (1) which is like a golden treasure; Your six hallowed faces (2); Your extremely strong shoulders (3); Your sharp and victorious Spear (4); Your Peacock (5), holding a snake in its legs; Your Rooster (6) which crows (on the staff) with a roar, reverberating in the seven worlds; and Your fresh lotus feet (7) being praised by Your prostrating devotees who have attained salvation. How can I ever forget all these? Sugrivan, whose lineage is of the Sun, became violent and took on VAli in a fierce battle which he lost; appreciating his innocence and bravery, the younger brother (Sugrivan) was blesssed with the Crown and the Kingdom graciously by RAghavan; and You are His nephew! Your Temple is illuminated so brightly as if the Eleven RudrAs* have come together! You are standing in that Temple very gracefully, Oh Lord! In the land of DEvAs, there is a forest of fragrant KaRpaga trees besieged by humming beetles, shaking the flowers that are falling on Mount Pazhani, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

129.english_pathavurai: One who comes mounting a black and huge buffalo, one who is harsh and cruel holding a sharp trident in his hand, one who angrily tightens the noose around my neck, that Yaman (Death-God) - when he closes in fast advancing towards me to snatch my life, roaming foxes and fire claim their right to consume my body and approach me very speedily; to prevent that, Your hallowed Feet which represent fullness, knowledge and genuine relationship should be granted to me. Lord SivA, who married PArvathi, the daughter of Himagiri, the loftiest mountain, blessed us with You, Oh MurugA! The fertile fields are ploughed by farmers in good old Pazhani, which is Your abode. Vishnu and BrahmA were scared when You pierced the rare Mount Krouncha with Your spear! You are the Spear, the Peacock, the Valour, the Brightness and the Beauty, Oh Great One!

You are the Consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, whom You hug with love, Oh Great One!

134.english_pathavurai: I took a form in my mother's womb and grew up with age through various stages; I learnt a number of arts (including) the art of Love God (Manmathan). Women with black locks of hair, I fell for them with my bosom under their feet. My worries multiplied, and I was distressed. The famous SivaManthrA, Hara Hara SivAya, was never uttered by me even on a single day. Not even one tenet of the six Sub-religions (namely, Sauram, GANApathyam, KaumAram, Saivam, Vaishnavam and ShAktham) was known to me. (Do I have to wait) at the doors of those who would give me food every day, without shame, and degenerate? The Great Vishnu, who slumbers on the Serpent-bed (AdhisEshan), He is also Ranganathan (in Srirangam) and He measured the whole world with one foot (in VAmana avathAram), You are His favourite nephew! On both sides of Your lineage (Mother's and Father's side) You are bright and pure! As the Great Poet like a Royal Lion (ThirugnAna Sambandhar) You were born once in PugaliyUr (also known as SeegAzhi)! Once, (for the sake of Sundarar) SivA went to the house of Paravai (Sundarar's Lover) as a personal messenger; by the Grace of that SivA, You prospered, Oh Kumaresa! You destroyed the armies of all the hostile demons (asuras) and liberated the DEvAs from prison, and stood on top of the Mount Pazhani, Oh Great One!

150.english_pathavurai: These women smear the paste of musk on their bosom that dwarfs the mountains and makes the bunches of flowers wither. The faces of these whores are like the moon and the beautiful, cool and reddish lotus. These women resort to flirting, cajoling and many other unique treacherous acts to create an atmosphere of congeniality. These women are wicked, in groups and filled with many characteristics such as deceit, gregariousness, prank, beauty and arrogance. They keep pestering, with the question "Where is our share?", and only after establishing their rightful dues, they condescend to hug exchanging pleasantries. They offer very trivial coital pleasure but manage to grab my entire belongings cleverly. I am tormented by this passionate obsession, being plagued at all times with a wretched feeling in my heart; to enable me to praise Your two hallowed flower-like feet, to feel always good in my mind, to acquire this trait in my intellect by Your grace propelling me to (Your temple for) worship, and to attain a blissful, virtuous and energetic state filled with Your gracious association, kindly show me the way beforehand where You will lead me, Oh Lord! Kamsan, besieged by fear, was a trecherous and mean fellow; (to kill KrishNa,) he sent the mystical fiend (PUthanai) who was conquered by Him, killed and torn to pieces; He is Lord VishNu; once, He came in the form of a man-lion (Narasimhan) and devoured the life of the strong demon, HiraNyan; He slumbers on the serpent-boat (on the milky ocean), named AdhisEshan; Lord Brahma, who mounts the swan as His vehicle, was delivered by Him; He is of the hue of the dark cloud; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Mount Krouncha that stood tall right up to the unique solar zone was split; the body of the demon TharakAsuran, with an elephant's face spewing frenzy, was smashed and destroyed; the seven worlds, that were in the nick of being toppled, shuddered with a noise "duN duN duN duN diN diN diN diN didi"; the bright conch made a lilting sound of "sanj sanj sanj sanj"; and Indra worshipped as You killed all the demons, Oh Lord! Oh Six-faced Lord, delivered graciously by Lord SivA who dances to the meter of "thomtham thomtham", You are worshipped by the sages praying "You are our solace at all times, Oh Great Master full of knowledge, who preached to that Lord SivA!" You have broad shoulders on which garlands adorn containing the fragrant kurA flowers where beetles swarm sucking honey, Oh Valorous One! The SamaNAs, without consideration, ridiculed Your devotees declaring that none of the religions other than theirs offered salvation and stuck to their own way; You sent them to the gallows where they were maimed and made to shed their bodies and lives; You made the palm leaves swim against the current in the foaming flood of the River Vaigai and (by such deeds) dissemenated the Saivite principle everywhere; You brought to life the skeleton which turned into the damsel, PUmpAvai, by the power of Your poem; and You (came as ThirugnAnasambandhar and) graciously composed the great hymns of ThEvAram, Oh Wise One! He created all the worlds; once upon a time, He devoured them all; in the ensuing war, He drove the chariot of Arjunan; He is an unblemished Lord who destroys evil people by means of deception; He holds the conch, PAncha janyam; that Lord VishNu's son is Lord Brahma whose son is sage NAradhar; in a sacrifice performed by that NAradhar, a goat was born, and You mounted that goat as Your vehicle, Oh Mighty One! The abundant ponds in this fertile town Sivagiri (Pazhani) have their distinct mark, namely, lotus and conch; and You are seated here, Oh Great One!

You are seated in Veerai, a place surrounded by paddy-fields and ponds; and You are also having an abode in Pazhani, Mountain of True Knowledge, Oh Great One!

155.english_pathavurai: They danced so vigorously that their breasts, sharp as the ivory tusk of the elephant, shook and their arms, on which neat rows of bangles glided, quivered; enthusiastically tying sheNbaga (champak) garlands to their hair, these whores walk along the beautiful streets, loudly singing songs of the chinthu variety; these whores roll their red eyes that look like kayal fish and wrap around their lion-like waist red attire of the colour of coral; they are out to grab the belongings (of the suitors); they inquire as to who has come (as the suitor) and alternately cover their bosom with glee and expose it by loosening the knot of their blouse; they drench their clothes with turmeric water conspicuously, climb the cotton mattress and cast a magic spell instantly on the suitors driving them to the point of beseeching; they lock the front door and expose themselves shamelessly; kindly remove my obsession for these women by granting me Your glorious and hallowed feet, Oh Lord! The demons in the dark KANdava forest under the guard of Indra were all burnt down; all people living in this great earth and other planets were protected from the harassment of the demons; the considerably immense distress of the celestials was removed and their land was redeemed for them graciously; He drove as the charioteer the beautiful chariot of ArjunA, who was previously in the disguise of an eunuch*; the fertile land of Kuru was restored to the five PANdavAs; and He enjoyed the status of the friendly leader of those PANdavAs; and You, Lord MurugA, are the handsome nephew of that Lord VishNu! He is lauded by the Sun, the Moon and the eight cardinal directions; He shines with an immortal life; and into the hallowed ears of that Lord SivA You graciously preached the PraNava ManthrA, Oh Great Master! She is the damsel of the KuRavAs with all virtues; seeking the blissful bosom of that VaLLi, You cleverly enticed her, Oh Handsome One! In this Mount Pazhani, that offers plenty of cool Tamil literature, You are seated with relish, Oh Great One!

156.english_pathavurai: Lord SivA was exhilirated when You explained the Sacred ManthrA (OM) into His two ears, Oh Great Master! You are the great son of SivagAma Sundhari (PArvathi), Oh Kandaswamy! Not interested in thinking of being in Your service only, I am possessed by harmful illusions and am roaming in this world aimlessly as a wastrel. You must come to rescue me with the words "Fear not"! In order that my inner knowledge is kindled, and to put an end to all my miseries, You have to grant me the bliss of wisdom attainable by Your grace. (Your Uncle Krishna) stole butter and also willingly bonded Himself to the grinding-stone (ural); that Hari, He was also known as Raghuramar, You are His favourite Nephew! All people in the Nine Continents worship You as the Real God! You are grandly attired! You make myriads of births happen in this world by Your mystic power, Oh Leader! You are the consort of both Devayani and VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavas! You are the Great warrior with complete bravery! You hold the brightest and sharpest Spear! 157.english_pathavurai: The little drums, large drums, hand-drums and several other percussion instruments made a banging noise "mogu mogu" as the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) sprang to catch the hair and tying it with a short rope of bondage, began to pull it for a long time; concluding that he had no chance of survival, some relatives stood at a distance while a few close relatives and siblings began to wail; after the body was carried to the cremation ground and burnt down by consigning it to the ritualistic fire, people were urged to take a dip in the wavy sea (before dispersing); my mortal body being subject to such verbal dispensation, will there be no end at all to this kind of birth? According to the directions laid down decisively in the scriptures for attaining ultimate liberation, and in order that bodies, souls and the four inner states of instincts (namely, mind, intellect, will and egotism) all join with the Supreme Cosmos, and, (as a consequence) the three characteristics (namely, sathwa - tranquility, rajas - aggressiveness and thamas - lethargy) are guided to worship, kindly make me, Your slave, yearn for You by taking control of me; will there be a day like that for me? Making Your horse-like vehicle, the peacock, dance with its jewellery-beads jingling, and with Your twelve shoulders prominently displaying the honey-oozing garlands, kindly elate me by preaching to me the sweet and true principle, granting Your reddish hallowed feet! He adorns elegantly His great matted hair with fragrant kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers, aRugam (cynodon) grass, heaps of many flowers, the crescent moon, the serpent and the beautiful river Gangai; that Lord SivA ardently praises You as You mount the peacock and fly noisily stirring up the nine* famous rivers, making the clusters of mountains spin, sending severe shock waves along the earth and the seven worlds, making the serpents spew out the nine** precious gems and chasing all the demons, Oh MurugA! Destroying the hostility of the hunters and making them feel ashamed, You cornered the young belle, VaLLi, in her cottage and on the platform in the millet-field around the mountain and wedded her as her consort, praising her curved-in bosom and slender waist! The dwarf-sage Agasthyar attained liberation by worshipping You everyday in the morning and in the evening; You guided him along the path to realisation and taught him the discipline of penance; You are the sweet master of Tamil, Oh KumarA! You have Your abode in the grace-filled mountain of Pazhani, Oh Great One!

158.english_pathavurai: This body is filled with puss, blood and unstable faeces crammed with worms, serving as the receptacle of all diseases. Can it escape the ultimate fate of being devoured by fire, jackals, vultures and crows? Attachment that breeds all vices, combined with delusory growth of the skin, flesh, bones, and veins makes this body unsteady. When life from such a body reaches Yaman, (God of Death), even at the very last minute, there is attachment to this body which is about to rot and stink; thinking that this body is indestructible, I hanker after women with lust; being obsessed with too much carnal desire to the point of swooning, I fall into the deep sea of distress leading to death. Will You kindly shower Your grace on me? The elephant (KuvalayApeetam) sent out by Kamsan, notorious for his trickery, came charging with anger; it bleated at full throttle sending shock waves throughout the world and stood there menacingly; as if it was going to sweep everything with its trunk of black-cloud hue, it made loud noise arrogantly; it charged in with rage as though it was going to drink all the water in a gulp; the elephant's two tusks were broken by Krishna, the tall lord, who overpowered it triumphantly; He played the bamboo flute and herded the cattle of cows; He has eyes like the red lotus; You are the nephew of that Lord Vishnu! Oh Lord with the immaculate spear, to smash the large mount Krouncha to pieces, You wielded that spear, Oh Kandha! The mighty king of the prosperous and fertile town, Kalisai*, on the banks of the river KAvEri, worshipped You, You have Your seat at Veerainagar*, and Your abode is Pazhani, Oh Great One!

160.english_pathavurai: You, the great Omniscient, are the preacher of the tranquil silence permeating the crest of the VEdAs. You materialised with the Saivite body, full of Wisdom, being the Supreme non-dualistic entity. You prevailed as the radiance of the ethereal light, without any shape, form or attribute. You are primordial! You are the matchless and blissful Saiva way of life! In the lotus of heart of the liberated souls who have attained Self-Realisation (turiya) and have witnessed the Truth, "These" wonderful things are brought into view; "These" are the ones that give the Supreme Knowledge and bliss; "These" are like naturally evolving crystals, giving pure delight and are none other than Your Hallowed Lotus Feet; not knowing the right way to attain those feet, I found my form in (my mother's) womb wherein rested (my father's) semen, fired up by the Pranic Air (oxygen); to that form were fitted, the three attributes (Sathvam, Rajas and Thamas - namely, tranquility, aggressiveness and lethargy) in various proportions; unthinkable deceit and treachery covered (that form); the evil deeds that accompanied this body played havoc on it; notwithstanding its association with the three rubbish slags (of arrogance, karma and delusion), I roamed about believing that this body is immortal; ignoring the fact that this body is the birthplace of all delusions, I, the lowly dog, deemed it to be indestructible; will You not kindly bless this stupid one? Of the VEdAs, holding within their realm the six religions, all of which have a common precept, You are the base, the body and the crest; You manifest in all the worlds and also in the ether beyond those worlds; You are the inner life of all souls, besides being their body and intellect; You are all-pervading and immortal! You bestow the fresh nectar of SivA's blissful world, springing like a fountain with unvarying delight. You are the unstained form of pleasure, my Great Lord! You hold the powerful Spear in Your hand! You are the wisest personification of the PraNava ManthrA, coming out as the primeval meaning of that ManthrA, Oh Great Master! The anklets on Your magnanimous and holy feet radiate the sun's rays, making lilting sound; It (Your Peacock) dances making all the worlds swing in tandem with its beat; It is proud of Its eminent feet; It is immaculate and triumphant; You mount that Peacock with matchless ability! The hearts of the devotees worshipping You echo the only true ManthrA, namely, "SaravaNabavA", which six letters expand into the most powerful effulgence (dispelling the darkness of ignorance) in Mount Pazhani, on which You stand as SubramaNiyan; You are the Lord of the DEvAs, Oh Great One!
