162.english_pathavurai: All my organs that perceive knowledge must converge. They should reach the cosmos that is bright without a sun or a moon. Then they should climb to the top of the Mount NamasivAya. The waterfall of bliss should flow sweetening my tongue. In that Siva-yogic trance, they should mingle with several sounds and play around. Consciousness about my body, that lusted over flesh and skin, should be gone. It should take the form of the effulgent PraNava ManthrA "OM", and both of us, namely myself (JeevAthma) and You (ParamAthma), should merge as one! Then I should mount on the horseback of True Knowledge and majestically go around all the world by Your Grace! On His tresses, He wears beautiful kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers oozing with honey, garland of Aththi (mountain ebony) flowers, the crescent moon and River GangA; He has a fine body; He is my Father; She is the unique mother; She is a pretty combination of Five MahA Sakthis*; She is the beloved of SivA; She is the Light seen by the silent Yogis deeply immersed in Siva-yOgA; and She has shared half of His body; and He is the purest Leader, Lord SivA. You are the Son of that SivA! Forests, mountains, islands and seas were all shattered when Your blue, fierce and beautiful Peacock flew around with You mounted on it! Manmathan (Love God) sent out his flowery arrows which were put to shame when You joined VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, in the flowery bed at our favourite place Pazhani, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

163.english_pathavurai: The hair of these whores with henna was fragrant with scented flowers; it was destined that I was to be ensnared by their disturbing and arrogant eyes; but still I had to remain in marital life with my wife; and, therefore, the thoughts of my children, mother, relatives, wives, friends, cattle and others occupied my mind. To end the misery arising out of my drowning in the sea of desires, You have to teach me the significance of the PraNava ManthrA commencing with the letter 'A' (A+U+M = AUM = OM); as my two hands are united in worship, with my heart melting and softening, and as I pray loudly "Hara, Hara" remaining either side of Yours, kindly grant me Your hallowed feet! With Your gracious blessings, my delusion and ignorance will be removed; with the dazzling Spear in Your hand, the staff displaying the Rooster in another hand, kindly consent to give me Your vision, mounted on the beautiful emerald-green peacock! He is an expert flautist who played the flute under the Mount GOvardhan where herds of cow gathered; He came to Vithuran's home as a guest*; He is the little kid who stole butter and got a beating for that; He assumed the gigantic shape of a tall one (Thrivikraman); He destroyed the demon called Madhu; He holds five kinds of weapons, namely, the disc, the conch-shell, the mace, the sword and the bow; He is of the hue of dark cloud; He danced upon the beautiful hood of the serpent KALingan to the meter of "Dhimitha Dhimi Dhimi"; He is Lord VishNu, and You are His nephew! Once, Ganapathi, came, charging with rage, as a beautiful elephant, with a pretty dotted face, scaring VaLLi, the damsel delivered by a deer; it was upon Your request, Oh GuhA! Oh Supreme Lord and the Great Master! You are the son of the peacock-like PArvathi, the daughter of Mount HimavAn! The fields in this place are filled with honey seeping from the ripe jack fruits; and there are many betelnut trees in the dense groves of Mount Pazhani, which is Your abode, Oh King! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

(To avoid that, I need) Your lotus feet, pure and sparkling like emerald and gold; Your grace is needed to make me think of Your feet constantly. You also have to grant me the wisdom to get rid of my helpless loneliness. Oh KumarA, Oh Warrior, MurugA, and Supreme God, You belong to this beautiful Pazhani Hill. You deliberately arranged to bring a wild elephant* and married VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavas. The miseries of DEvAs and the bodies of asuras were both destroyed when You graciously fought! You possess DharmA (righteousness), reddish complexion, spear, peacock and charm, Oh Great One!

166.english_pathavurai: Head ache, diseases caused by sorcery, jaundice, anaemia, fever, eye sickness, stomach ache known as vaRaL, tuberculosis, breathlessness, diabetes, several poisonous diseases and various peculiar ailments caused by worldly delusion - I did not want any of these to afflict me. For that purpose, I consulted many people in the medical field on the earth requesting them to suggest remedies; they turned a deaf ear to me. Some people questioned the use of medicines at my advanced age and asked me as to how much I was prepared to pay; and I do not want to be destined to listen to such people. Fragrant flowers of many varieties are plucked enthusiastically from large gardens and are festooned into many garlands by great ascetics to place them with pleasure as ornaments at Your feet; I want to firmly place their feet in my heart in order to intelligently sing Your glory and to pay obeisance. Kindly offer me Your hallowed feet and come to me mounting the Peacock that dances after casting away the serpent! He built a bridge across the wavy seas; He knocked down the crowned heads of the extremely hideous Ravana; He rescued JAnaki, dear to Him as His life, through His prowess and took her home; Oh MurugA, You address that mystic Rama (Vishnu) as Your Uncle! He wears the aRugam (cynodon) grass on His tresses; He is the basic cause of all lives; He holds a pick-axe and a deer in His arms; Once, on the stage, He danced so exquisitely that Mother KALi was put to shame; You address that SivA as Your Great Father! On the tongues of poets who are well-versed with many arts, Your hallowed feet prevail, Oh Wizard! You hold the Spear as Your weapon! The damsel of the KuRavAs is seated on the high guarding-plank in the millet field; You love to hug her shoulders, Oh Consort of VaLLi! The varAl fish sleep on the lotus in the field and on top of the betelnut trees; there is abundant water in the River KAveri which surrounds the prosperous town of Pazhani, which is Your abode! You love to adorn Yourself with the fragrance of camphor! You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!

169.english_pathavurai: "Oh Peacock, with a beautiful plume! You are a deer-like damsel resembling Lakshmi on the lotus! He is a great leader known for giving alms like the showering cloud; He is comparable to King PAri, who was bestowed with hands that gave away swiftly for charity his sea of belongings like the blowing wind; he is handsome like the famous God of Love, Manmathan; he lives in Kalisai* as the protector of KAvEri; and You reside with relish in his heart, Oh valorous One! You are the Brave One that annihilated the great demon SUran and his clan in the war, Oh KumarA! You are seated in Veerainagar, filled with fields surrounded by brooks where lilies blossom abundantly, Oh Lord of Pazhani, with the spear in Your hand! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

171.english_pathavurai: Not knowing even a little bit of the meaning of VEdic scripture, some people roam about stealing others' texts from here and there and compose fake poems; learning those trivial words, they assume several pompous titles for themselves; they obtain, as gift, heavy palanquin (that bends the backs of the bearers) and go about (in procession) accompanied by the paraphernalia of ornamental umbrella and fan; with rings on their fingers and bright and long ear-studs dangling from their ears, they move about proudly; if one asks them whether they could explain a particular poem, mixed with prose, or a stanza from old texts like ThirukkuRaL, their faces turn pale with embarrassment for not knowing anything, and they are ultimately humiliated; that is the extent of their so-called erudition! Enough of this type of education, and to put an end to such learning, kindly bless me with the gift of the choicest words that should sprout in my mind in abundance so that I could praise Your glory prolifically and with steadfast devotion! When scorching flames of fire afflicted the body of PANdiya King Nedunchezhiyan (in the form of high fever), many samaNa priests from all directions were summoned, but they could not lessen the fever despite best efforts; however, when a speck of holy ash from the small lotus hand of Yours (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) was sprinkled on the body (of the PANdiya King), the fever remitted; later, being vanquished (in the debate of words), the unwise samaNa priests went to the gallows; to accomplish all this, You were born in this world, Oh Master! I am such a dumb fool indulging repeatedly in carnal pleasure and straying away everyday from the path of Your grace; I am a sinner agitated by the faeces of arrogance day after day; nevertheless, kindly take charge of me as Your bonded slave! Oh Lord with the triumphant spear, You have chosen Your abode in Pazhani where great sages who have performed many penances reside, Oh Great One!

173.english_pathavurai: In order that I could ardently learn to sing a few songs in Tamil whose beauty is beyond description, I never bothered to study several epics in that language. Instead, I thought only about the beautiful mouths of maidens, red like coral and the veezhi fruit; and my lust for them caused my skin to change its colour! In this beautiful world surrounded by oceans dug out by Sagara's sons, I do not want to roam about like this as a dry leaf caught in a cyclone. Before I lose heart and go down in my health, dancing in accordance with the meter "thaga thiththimi dhAgi NangiNa", mounted on the lovely horse-like peacock with soaring plumes, You must come before me wonderfully and bestow grace on me! UmAdEvi told You "Drink this Milk of Wisdom; this will give You Great Knowledge"; with those words She gave You Her milk and You became GnAna Pandithan (Wizard of Knowledge); and all scriptures praise You as Her Great Son, Oh Young One! When the crocodile with sharp teeth attacked the elephant, GajEndran, Lord Vishnu came down instantly to save the elephant; and You are His nephew! The three letters a, u and m combine to form this PraNava ManthrA, and it is the foremost syllable of any ManthrA, which is OM, and its significance was preached sweetly to Lord SivA, by You, Oh Master! IndrA, the Lord of all DEvAs, worshipped this place which is ThiruvAvinankudi, at the foothills of Mount Pazhani; and You have taken up Your residence over there to shower grace on Your devotees, Oh Great One!

You are the Lord of the pure Celestials, Oh Great One!

203.english_pathavurai: The insatiable greed for land is binding me like chains around my wrists; and arrogance is like a huge delusive spell around me; and I want both of them broken. I want to mingle with It as one; It is that light, which is Supreme Knowledge, spread like the wide sky; and It is also known as ParAsakthi, my goal, after reaching which my thinking should cease. It is above the thirty-six tenets* (ThathvAs), presiding over them. The experts in yOgA meditating daily have never realised It. It is beyond the supreme ThuriyA** stage. It is without any shape. It is for ever rising (never setting). It is extremely enchanting. It is the extensive life in all the elements beginning with the wide sky. It is the beginning and the end of the universe. It is the True Knowledge. For the Trinity of BrahmA, Vishnu and SivA, It has the distinction of being their fundamental cause. Doubtless, It shall remain immortal and as the only Truth. It is the rarest One. It is absolutely independent. It is indestructible. It is self-luminous as the Torch of Truth. It is formless. It is changeless. It is a perennial flood of bliss known as ThANu (SivA). When will I be able to unite with It? A variety of weapons (like swords, spears, bows and arrows) were used by several armies led by great warriors (from Kishkintha). They built a bridge (to LankA) across the sea in which large ships sailed. When they reached the other side, the mighty country LankA fell. The evil king RavaNA, with ten crowns, was killed by SriRAman; and You are His nephew! In the shady groves of VayalUr, there is a pleasant fragrance wafting through; and the presiding deity at VayalUr, Lord AgnEswar***, delivered You as His Son! You wear garlands of kadamba flowers and hold Your spear in hand! She grew up among the hunters who inhabit and rule the forests; You desired to rejoice in the company of VaLLi, that damsel of KuRavAs, saying "The scary arrows from your eyes, stretching up to your ears, are piercing my heart; and you are indifferent to my suffering. I pray that you give up your pride and spare my life graciously!" This moving statement was made to VaLLi by You with abundant love, Oh Young One! You chose as Your abode, SwAmimalai, on the northern banks of river KAvEri, Oh unique Lord!

204.english_pathavurai: With their hair black like the pitch dark night, their eyes sharp as the arrows of Rama, their musical voice, their heavy bosoms, and their waistline so thin as if the waist does not exist for them, (those whores) torment the hearts of the youth like a rasping saw; both in the morning and in the evening, these men spread around the women and fall for them; and they demand exorbitant price for their services. I do not want to be victimised by lust for them. Instead, I am seeking the feet of the Lord, which feet symbolise the true knowledge without origin. Kindly bless me with that knowledge. You are the Treasure of those loving devotees who praise You daily saying "Oh Kumara, You are seated under the shade of KurA Tree (at Thiruvidaikkazhi)!" The huge heads of the haughty and loud-mouthed demon, SUran, were pierced and shattered by the Spear wielded by You! Like the dry leaves placed in intense fire are completely burnt down, the karmas flee away from the wise sages, leaving them unscathed; these sages have imbibed good virtues and assemble in SwAmimalai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

205.english_pathavurai: I would like to accomplish the rare fete of Siva-yOgA; the central eye in my forehead, representing knowledge, should be opened up; the miserable karmas (good and bad deeds) should depart from me permanently; the slags of arrogance and ignorance should be removed, making me sparkle with true knowledge. and I should mingle with the radiant grace of Your six faces! There should be no distinction between the two of us, namely, You (the ParamAthma) and me (the JeevAthma). Our happy union should be like that of the beautiful flower and its sweet fragrance! As the DEvAs worship You and the Celestial girls shower flowers at Your feet, and as the countless million sages sing Your glory with devotion, You must come to me happily mounted on Your strong Peacock! His feet could not be found by Vishnu and BrahmA; and with those rosy feet, that are the foremost in all worlds, NadarAjan, the light of grace, performs the dance of ecstasy; His body has the complexion of glinting red hot iron on fire; PArvathi, with emerald-green complexion is in love with Him, and He, Lord SivA, has Her seated by His side; and He conquered Thripuram! You are His beloved Son! The mighty and adorned bodies and heads of the hostile demons (asuras) shivered with fear, and they were devoured by Death-God (Yaman), when You threw Your victorious Spear! On the Northern banks of the River KAvEri, where shiny conch shells are abundant, there is this place, SwAmimalai, Your abode, Oh Great One and Master of all DEvAs!

206.english_pathavurai: In any cardinal direction, or any mountain, or any land abutting a sea, or under any roof, whatever life exists in any body, I do not want to be born again and suffer. In order to stabilise my life in this very body, (I want to prostrate) at Your holy lotus feet, by offering fragrant flowers, with my intellect and mind totally molten, and in accordance with the methods stipulated in the great scriptures; seeing Your vision, I shall chant "Hara Hara, Siva, Siva, I surrender to You", worshipping Your hallowed feet so that they are firmly placed on my head, enthralling my body and senses, with tears gushing out of my eyes like a waterfall. DEvayAnai, the beautiful damsel with a waist like lightning, is seated in Your front while You dance delightfully with Your charming feet! Kindly come to this august congregation simply to melt my heart! (To the sound of the above meter) the great directions, the mountains and the seas vibrated with the chiming of sallari (JAlra - metallic hand-cymbals) and beating of bEri (a kind of drum); the ringing bells made a noise like "gala gala galin"; the celestials showered flowers and BrahmA chanted the VEdAs in praise of You; and the demons were scathed and sent to the land of the God of Death (Yaman) as You hurled the Spear, Oh Lord! He has a fragrant tress, the body of the hue of fire and a symbol of victory; He is our Lord SivA whose life-like consort is PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn; She has an emerald-green complexion and fragrant bosoms; That UmAdEvi delivered You as Her Younger child! She mounts the lotus to have Her seat; She is the Goddess of Wealth; She is of a great lineage; She has a beautiful creeper-like waist; that Lakshmi is married to Vishnu; and You are their nephew! This mountain has sweet-scented groves; and You reside here in Gurumalai (SwAmimalai), Oh Great One!

207.english_pathavurai: I used to roam around secretly visiting the whore-house so that no one else could see my movement; I suffered and felt wretched, agonising from the impact of my two deeds (both good and bad); like the wax dropped in the fire, I melted; As a result of my misdeeds in previous births, I looked like a flashy puppet made of wood, dancing in compliance with the manipulation of the attached strings; like the flash of lightning in the sky, my body too fades away in a flicker and burns away; even then, kindly consider me as one of Your devotees and preach to me in both my ears declaring "This is the matchless Supreme thing"; all the deeds that I carried forward into this birth with this human form and all the three blemishes (arrogance, karma and delusion) must be shattered to pieces; with Your six great lotus faces, that are cool, soft and showering compassion; Your garland of kadappa flowers, the dazzling crowns studded with rubies and gems, the anklets in Your feet jingling, You must mount the peacock and come with relish to bless me! He burnt down to ashes Thiripuram and the body of Manmathan (God of Love); He has the young and robust bull (Nandi) as His vehicle; He is Lord NadarAjan who danced the blissful cosmic dance (at the golden shrine in Chidhambaram); He is Omnipresent in the form of the radiant and reddish Mount AruNagiri; the top and the bottom of that AruNagiri, could not be discerned by VishNu and BrahmA; He is the primordial causal substance and meaning of the five sacred letters "SivAyanama"; (on chanting that ManthrA) the nectar of True Knowledge wells up which is graciously distributed to us by Him; He is the Protector, Lord SivA, our Father. On His left side our Divine Mother PArvathi is concorporate, and You are Her child! Holding the staff of Rooster in Your Hand and mounting the Peacock, making all the mountains of the world, including Mount Mandharam, spin, against the loud chanting of "Oh Kumara! Oh Master!" by thousands of vEdAs, and scaring away the powerful serpent, AdhisEshan, You flew around! Making the waist of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, give way and rattling the reddish anklets on her feet, and uniting with DevayAnai, the daughter of Sasi, IndrA's wife, You are seated in the sturdy mountain of SwAmimalai, Oh Master! You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!

208.english_meanings_list: ["One who mounts the buffalo bravely with pleasure", "and has the dark buffalo's complexion is Yaman (Death-God);", "he has commanded his messenger to take my life, and he never misses his way.", "Just like the play in the dream fizzles out when one wakes up,", "and just like the disappearance of the wealth amassed by misers who seek so many things without giving alms,", "life in this world is very transient and temporary;", "and I delude myself that this life is a lasting pleasure!", "Day and night, I should always praise You with the choicest words,", "and You must see to it that from today I sing Your Glory!", "He dances continuously everyday along with KALi;", "He is Lord SivA, an authority on the art of dancing; and You are His son!", "The demented SUran lost his pride, prestige and life", "when You threw Your spear to destroy that demon.", "Their inhaled air is untouchable, runs unhindered long and deep inside,", "and they control the five sensory organs through Yogic exercises of breathing.", "The destination of those wise and evolved souls is", "SwAmimalai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
208.english_pathavurai: One who mounts the buffalo bravely with pleasure and has the dark buffalo's complexion is Yaman (Death-God); he has commanded his messenger to take my life, and he never misses his way. Just like the play in the dream fizzles out when one wakes up, and just like the disappearance of the wealth amassed by misers who seek so many things without giving alms, life in this world is very transient and temporary; and I delude myself that this life is a lasting pleasure! Day and night, I should always praise You with the choicest words, and You must see to it that from today I sing Your Glory! He dances continuously everyday along with KALi; He is Lord SivA, an authority on the art of dancing; and You are His son! The demented SUran lost his pride, prestige and life when You threw Your spear to destroy that demon. Their inhaled air is untouchable, runs unhindered long and deep inside, and they control the five sensory organs through Yogic exercises of breathing. The destination of those wise and evolved souls is SwAmimalai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

209.english_meanings_list: ["Among all fragrant flowers, these flowers drip the sweetest honey and heighten affection;", "these are the famous kadappa flowers, closely interlaced in a garland", "that adorns Your twelve shoulders, which are like the great Mount MEru, Oh Compassionate One!", "You hold in Your hand the fierce and sparkling spear!", "On the lovely feet of VaLLi, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs,", "You place Your cool tresses everyday in blissful prostration!", "To Poet Nakkeeran, who was capable of composing poetical treatises with choicest words of wisdom and truth,", "You willingly taught, from Your own flower-like mouth, the subtlety of grammar;", "synchronising with meter and rhyme, You aptly chose the words \"ulagam uvappa\"* (meaning, \"to the delight of this world\")", "and happily blessed him with those opening words, Oh Wise One!", "The worthless utterances by the lowly me", "may kindly be accepted by You every day with abundant and cool grace, and You should come to me happily!", "The sinful shell of my body is afflicted", "by many miseries in this world; is it fair that I suffer like this?", "Gifted people, with many penances to their credit and a mature heart, have attained Your lotus feet in", "ThiruvEragam (SwAmimalai), which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
209.english_pathavurai: Among all fragrant flowers, these flowers drip the sweetest honey and heighten affection; these are the famous kadappa flowers, closely interlaced in a garland that adorns Your twelve shoulders, which are like the great Mount MEru, Oh Compassionate One! You hold in Your hand the fierce and sparkling spear! On the lovely feet of VaLLi, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs, You place Your cool tresses everyday in blissful prostration! To Poet Nakkeeran, who was capable of composing poetical treatises with choicest words of wisdom and truth, You willingly taught, from Your own flower-like mouth, the subtlety of grammar; synchronising with meter and rhyme, You aptly chose the words "ulagam uvappa"* (meaning, "to the delight of this world") and happily blessed him with those opening words, Oh Wise One! The worthless utterances by the lowly me may kindly be accepted by You every day with abundant and cool grace, and You should come to me happily! The sinful shell of my body is afflicted by many miseries in this world; is it fair that I suffer like this? Gifted people, with many penances to their credit and a mature heart, have attained Your lotus feet in ThiruvEragam (SwAmimalai), which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

210.english_pathavurai: I went searching, walking all the way up to the boundary of the rising sun's path, to the edge of the vast sea with splashing waves, and to the frontier of the great serpent-king, AdhisEshan, having a bunch of hoods; my feet wore down due to excessive wandering everywhere and my looks deteriorated; thinking that this would be the nice place, I approached the homes of misers hoping, with a sinking heart, that this would be the ideal destination; when I stood there praising them with musical poems and felicitations, those big shots used to slip away quietly; is it fair that I have to knock about their doors, day and night, and droop down after all that roaming about? The beetles in this place gather together to imbibe fragrant honey and settle down in the rich pALai flowers of the betelnut trees; and then they sing, in well-formed groups, the SAma VEdA in a wonderful chorus! The moon beams its cool rays on Mount SwAmimalai (ThiruvEragam), and You are its Treasure! It marches like the typhoon that shakes the entire world; it has dark blue plumes; and You mount that beautiful peacock with relish, Oh Young One! You are the son of DEvi PArvathi who has created the entire universe in an orderly way and ensures its stability! You are the Lord of all celestials, Oh Great One!

211.english_pathavurai: Ceasing to think that the body, the source of blemishes, will not be everlasting, (in order that the body could last for ever) one holds the inhaled breath by means of certain ThAnthrik ManthrAs*; the fundamental and intrinsic fire is aroused within the body; this kind of worrisome Yogic exercises should not occupy my mind; my five senses that cause so much trouble should be annihilated; my actions should cease to exist; I must reach the ultimate bliss after attaining the most satisfying tranquility and a stage bereft of any characteristic (vice or virtue). (For that) I must say "Oh the Greatest and Wisest Master, seated in the hill of SwAmimalai, Oh Kumara, I surrender to You" offering fresh KUthaLa flowers at Your two hallowed feet. Meditating on them shall I realise You! The celestials beginning from IndrA suffered in prisons, all shackled up; in order that they could be released, and for the return to their golden land (of AmarAvathi), You waged the war; the dark seas made a loud noise; several mountains were burnt down to pieces; Lord Vishnu, who holds the disc (Sudharsanam) in His hand and wears the golden crown, beseeched You, saying "Oh the son of Lord SivA who wears the crescent moon, kindly save us all (by killing the demon SUran)"; You were so enraged with Brahman that You imprisoned Him; in a moment, You fought and conquered the menacingly advancing demon SUran! The powerful elephant AirAvadham was large and elegant, with fluid oozing from his jaws denoting its ferocity; the young damsel, DEvayAnai, was reared by that white elephant, and You married Her, Oh valorous and Great One!

213.english_pathavurai: "Oh KumarA, the Great Master, MurugA, GuhA, the consort of VaLLi who is the damsel of the KuRavAs, Oh SaravaNA, You devastated the demons; You are the Master of Lord SivA, wearing the crescent moon on His matted hair, and You preached to Him the great PraNava ManthrA; You mount the peacock, Oh Lord!" - with these words I should have praised You everyday with a melting heart; instead, (I went after) good-looking girls, with a sweet voice like the cuckoo's, capable of melting one's heart by their mere looks; they always walk the streets with a gait like the swan's; they instantly snatch the belongings and minds of the men who admire them with glee; they entrap one and all with their enticing faces laced with a glittering make-up; standing right in the middle of the street, they deliberately slide off the cloth covering their bosom; they belittle those men dropping in without money and slip away from them elusively; they deviously spread the net of their eyes for men, dissolving them in pleasure on the bed in proportion to the money doled out; I hankered after such whores and became their slave, running menial errands for them; I have been a big fool; kindly bless me graciously with the ability to praise Your hallowed feet! When the armies of the demons came aggressively to them to wage a war, You wielded the spear destroying those armies in a second, rolling the heads of the demons on the earth and smashing the battlefield into smithereens; thirsty devils danced about; veerabhadrAs (armies of Lord SivA) made a roaring noise; Goddess KALi who devours blood with flesh screamed rapturously; rows and rows of devils, numbering several million, became excited about the meal of flesh and shrieked ecstatically; the jackals, crows and eagles began to dance; and the blood-thirsty bhairavAs roamed about menacingly when You wielded the unique spear, Oh Lord; You are like the sun that dispels the darkness of ignorance! Oh MurugA, You made it possible for IndrA, the Lord of the celestials, to regain His domain and roam about freely! Lord VishNu, whose shoulders are hugged by Goddess Lakshmi, BrahmA and IndrA, mounting the elephant AirAvatham, come to worship You in Your abodes at Mount Pazhani and KadhirgAmam, Oh Epitome of the Saiva Religion, with six hallowed faces! You are seated in SwAmimalai, Oh Great One!

Will I ever do that? When You preached the sacred word, peerless SivA praised You, His Master. You fell in love with and married DEvayAnai, who is Lakshmi-incarnate, and reared as daughter by IndrA. Around Your mount are bamboos, devathAru (KaRpagam), makizham, mango, fig, and sandalwood trees, and Lord Vishnu worships Your mount, SwAmimalai, where You are seated as the Preaching Guru in the yOgA position, Oh Great One!

223.english_pathavurai: I am thinking only about Your lotus feet carrying the fragrance of the flowery poems emanating from my tongue. There are twenty-eight* types of Saiva scriptures (AgamAs) which mingle with four phases** which interpret the method to attain Liberation and Eternal Bliss as directed by those scriptures; and that is the method I would like to practise everyday. Just so that there is no difference between You and me, a state in which the JeevAthma and ParamAthma have merged and to lead a straightforward life by Your grace, I want to transcend the great Kundalini ChakrAs*** (Six transcendental zones) and go one step higher to SahasrAram; there, You said, I could see SivA who is superior to all things supreme. I want to hear from You that great - expression denoting Unity between SivA and Sakthi. When SivA, who mounts on the Bull, Nandi, went around You praying, the greatest Knowledge contained in the Vedas was preached by You expertly, Oh Great Master! You slashed to death the asuras who burnt the land of DEvAs. Oh valorous One, GuhA, You married VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavAs. On the northern bank of River KAveri, there are tanks with fragrant flowers and plenty of groves at SwAmimalai, which is Your abode, Muruga. MahA KALi, with dark cloud's complexion, Ever young Sakthi, and who dwells on the left side of SivA (who burnt down Manmathan) - that PArvathi delivered You as Her Son, Oh Great One!

228.english_pathavurai: With half a moon, river (Ganga) and flowers adorning His tress, Lord SivA has graciously delivered You to us, Kumaresa! That KuRavA damsel, VaLLi, whose voice is sweeter than sugar and fruits, - You are her consort, gently caressing her feet. (In RAmAyaNA) the devilish crow (KAkAsuran)* was spared at least one pupil, being punished by removal of the other one graciously by that mystic Hari (as RAmA); You are the nephew of Hari and Lakshmi. In order that Yaman (Death-God) never approaches me, I have to surrender at Your two feet by Your grace. There are many groves full of mango trees in SwAmimalai, which is Your abode. You destroyed SUran's body and dried up the entire sea, by throwing Your powerful spear, Oh Great One!

231.english_meanings_list: ["I lost my heart to those whores whose two spear-like eyes have imbibed the gushing and evil poison;", "forgetting my passion for drowning in their fragrant bosom that looks like the lotus bud,", "I wish to have the vision of Your six hallowed faces that radiate the bright light of the great Knowledge", "by showering, without tiring, plenty of aRugam (cynodon) grass, Umaththai flower, the fragrant lily and the green vilvam (bael) leaves dipped in the holy ash filled with aroma on Your hallowed feet which I am seeking with great devotion!", "Kindly grant me the good fortune of mingling with Your devotees who spontaneously lose themselves and melt their heart so that I could abide by their great discipline and be deemed as Your servant in bondage of love, Oh Lord!", "The demon SUran fought the war by severing the heads of many fearless warriors; by splitting his body into two, You triumphantly wielded the spear, which also dried up the roaring sea, Oh Lord!", "After copiously imbibing the nectar-like breast-milk of Goddess UmA, whose teeth are like pearls, You went around the seven worlds, mounting the powerful peacock, Oh valorous One!", "She never left the millet-field that produced unblemished crops of millet; She was seated on the raised bamboo platform in the millet-field and zealously guarded the crops; and You are the consort of that damsel, VaLLi!", "The flower garden in this place has aptly fitting kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers of the variety of tiger's claws and beautiful cherunthi flowers; mango forests also abound in SwAmimalai (ThiruvErakam), and You are seated here, Oh Great One!"]
231.english_pathavurai: I lost my heart to those whores whose two spear-like eyes have imbibed the gushing and evil poison; forgetting my passion for drowning in their fragrant bosom that looks like the lotus bud, I wish to have the vision of Your six hallowed faces that radiate the bright light of the great Knowledge by showering, without tiring, plenty of aRugam (cynodon) grass, Umaththai flower, the fragrant lily and the green vilvam (bael) leaves dipped in the holy ash filled with aroma on Your hallowed feet which I am seeking with great devotion! Kindly grant me the good fortune of mingling with Your devotees who spontaneously lose themselves and melt their heart so that I could abide by their great discipline and be deemed as Your servant in bondage of love, Oh Lord! The demon SUran fought the war by severing the heads of many fearless warriors; by splitting his body into two, You triumphantly wielded the spear, which also dried up the roaring sea, Oh Lord! After copiously imbibing the nectar-like breast-milk of Goddess UmA, whose teeth are like pearls, You went around the seven worlds, mounting the powerful peacock, Oh valorous One! She never left the millet-field that produced unblemished crops of millet; She was seated on the raised bamboo platform in the millet-field and zealously guarded the crops; and You are the consort of that damsel, VaLLi! The flower garden in this place has aptly fitting kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers of the variety of tiger's claws and beautiful cherunthi flowers; mango forests also abound in SwAmimalai (ThiruvErakam), and You are seated here, Oh Great One!

239.english_meanings_list: ["Instead of willingly sharing food, with a mind at peace, with people who are hunger-stricken,", "I held fast to all my wealth tightly in my fist with the express object of enjoying my youth.", "I was devoid of grace and overcome by selfishness and arrogance.", "When all my relatives gather crying around my body; with the funeral drums beating;", "and when Death-God (Yaman) begins to take my life on its final journey,", "how can I think that this body of mine is going to last for ever!", "Then why am I so concerned about my body which is sure to deteriorate and degenerate?", "He gave one side of His body to PArvathi, the peahen born to HimavAn;", "and to that Lord SivA You explained the substance of scriptures to His heart's content!", "You feed the parts of the bodies of those attacking You in the battlefield to vultures, Oh valorous One with the Great Spear!", "I want to steer clear of all those who quarrel in the name of religion;", "I want to meditate upon You and enter Your domain of grace seeking", "Your six Great faces looking like lotus, Oh GuhA!", "(After marrying VaLLi), You entered Your abode, the great place called ThiruththaNigai, Oh KumarA, You Great One!"]
239.english_pathavurai: Instead of willingly sharing food, with a mind at peace, with people who are hunger-stricken, I held fast to all my wealth tightly in my fist with the express object of enjoying my youth. I was devoid of grace and overcome by selfishness and arrogance. When all my relatives gather crying around my body; with the funeral drums beating; and when Death-God (Yaman) begins to take my life on its final journey, how can I think that this body of mine is going to last for ever! Then why am I so concerned about my body which is sure to deteriorate and degenerate? He gave one side of His body to PArvathi, the peahen born to HimavAn; and to that Lord SivA You explained the substance of scriptures to His heart's content! You feed the parts of the bodies of those attacking You in the battlefield to vultures, Oh valorous One with the Great Spear! I want to steer clear of all those who quarrel in the name of religion; I want to meditate upon You and enter Your domain of grace seeking Your six Great faces looking like lotus, Oh GuhA! (After marrying VaLLi), You entered Your abode, the great place called ThiruththaNigai, Oh KumarA, You Great One!

240.english_meanings_list: ["The Trinity of SivA (remover of sins), Vishnu and BrahmA", "prostrate before You,", "praying \"Oh Shanmukha, Saravanabhava\" -", "they chant like this everyday.", "You throw the fiery spear to destroy all the demons (asuras), Oh Great Warrior!", "Your devotees hold in esteem Your lotus feet (that wear the anklets of valour)", "in their hearts by Your grace, Oh Murugesa!", "Oh GuhA, You are the son of Bhagavathi, the great daughter of Mount of HimavAn.", "SivA's both ears were filled with joy when", "You interpreted to Him the meaning of the rare PraNava ManthrA (OM) which is cherished by all, Oh Great Master!", "All those countless animate beings in this world,", "along with DEvAs and Sages", "bow and happily offer worship to You everyday.", "You reside at lovely ThiruththaNigai which was also worshipped by the Great Serpent VAsuki*.", "The famous damsel of KuRavAs, namely VaLLi,", "and the maiden, DEvayAnai, who was reared under the KaRpaga Tree,", "flank You on both sides**, Oh Great One!"]
240.english_pathavurai: The Trinity of SivA (remover of sins), Vishnu and BrahmA prostrate before You, praying "Oh Shanmukha, Saravanabhava" - they chant like this everyday. You throw the fiery spear to destroy all the demons (asuras), Oh Great Warrior! Your devotees hold in esteem Your lotus feet (that wear the anklets of valour) in their hearts by Your grace, Oh Murugesa! Oh GuhA, You are the son of Bhagavathi, the great daughter of Mount of HimavAn. SivA's both ears were filled with joy when You interpreted to Him the meaning of the rare PraNava ManthrA (OM) which is cherished by all, Oh Great Master! All those countless animate beings in this world, along with DEvAs and Sages bow and happily offer worship to You everyday. You reside at lovely ThiruththaNigai which was also worshipped by the Great Serpent VAsuki*. The famous damsel of KuRavAs, namely VaLLi, and the maiden, DEvayAnai, who was reared under the KaRpaga Tree, flank You on both sides**, Oh Great One!

241.english_meanings_list: ["With a brief and soft smile, they simply melt the mind of the suitors destroying their inner thought; with the signs emanating from their pitch dark eyes,", "they invite their guests ensnaring them in their net and take away all their belongings; making the blunder of visiting such whores,", "pretending to be wise men, talking nonsense extensively,", "wise-cracking with newly coined words and boasting that no one in any town is famous like them in speaking lofty truths,", "these men disappear in a flash of a second like someone quickly lies down and gets up; is this sort of birth worthwhile at all?", "The sea dried up revealing the parched basin; the multitude of demons was annihilated;", "and the magical spell that had gripped the mount Krouncha was broken and destroyed when You held the spear in Your strong hand, Oh Lord!", "You graciously looked after the celestial land of the KaRpaga trees, Oh Lord with the beautiful dazzling spear!", "You stand as the matchless testimony of all poems composed in the three branches of Tamil!", "In the millet-field of hilly VaLLimalai, You embraced VaLLi, whose eyes were embellished with black pigment, Oh Lord!", "As Your reddish staff of Rooster was beaming with pride, You took Your seat in ThiruththaNigai, famous for its pond where blue lily blossoms, Oh Great One!"]
241.english_pathavurai: With a brief and soft smile, they simply melt the mind of the suitors destroying their inner thought; with the signs emanating from their pitch dark eyes, they invite their guests ensnaring them in their net and take away all their belongings; making the blunder of visiting such whores, pretending to be wise men, talking nonsense extensively, wise-cracking with newly coined words and boasting that no one in any town is famous like them in speaking lofty truths, these men disappear in a flash of a second like someone quickly lies down and gets up; is this sort of birth worthwhile at all? The sea dried up revealing the parched basin; the multitude of demons was annihilated; and the magical spell that had gripped the mount Krouncha was broken and destroyed when You held the spear in Your strong hand, Oh Lord! You graciously looked after the celestial land of the KaRpaga trees, Oh Lord with the beautiful dazzling spear! You stand as the matchless testimony of all poems composed in the three branches of Tamil! In the millet-field of hilly VaLLimalai, You embraced VaLLi, whose eyes were embellished with black pigment, Oh Lord! As Your reddish staff of Rooster was beaming with pride, You took Your seat in ThiruththaNigai, famous for its pond where blue lily blossoms, Oh Great One!

242.english_meanings_list: ["\"The Glory of Lord (Thiruppugazh) is like fried rice packed to last a long journey (of life unto death);", "it removes all obstacles of those who read it with relish\".", "so declare the following -", "specialists in Tamil Music, Tamil Drama,", "experts in other branches of Tamil romantic literature,", "grammarians, literatuers and poets who are capable of composing four most difficult branches of Tamil poetry*.", "These great people cherish this truth in their heart, speak about it and always think about it.", "Not caring to laud these people adequately in this world,", "I indulge in women who melt my mind with their bosoms and faces;", "how can I fall prey to their enticing lure?", "(The Love God) bent the bow of sugar cane and sent out arrows of flowers; and", "proudly hiding himself, that Manmathan aimed the arrows (at SivA).", "SivA read Manmathan's thought", "and burnt him with the fire spewing from the third eye on His forehead;", "and He resides at Mount KailAsh.", "That SivA gave His left side to UmA, Himavan's daughter, and also brought forth You, His son, to us.", "The town where clouds gather in the groves and paddy-fields are aplenty -", "that enchanting town, ThiruththaNigai,", "is Your favourite mount, Oh Great One!"]
242.english_pathavurai: "The Glory of Lord (Thiruppugazh) is like fried rice packed to last a long journey (of life unto death); it removes all obstacles of those who read it with relish". so declare the following - specialists in Tamil Music, Tamil Drama, experts in other branches of Tamil romantic literature, grammarians, literatuers and poets who are capable of composing four most difficult branches of Tamil poetry*. These great people cherish this truth in their heart, speak about it and always think about it. Not caring to laud these people adequately in this world, I indulge in women who melt my mind with their bosoms and faces; how can I fall prey to their enticing lure? (The Love God) bent the bow of sugar cane and sent out arrows of flowers; and proudly hiding himself, that Manmathan aimed the arrows (at SivA). SivA read Manmathan's thought and burnt him with the fire spewing from the third eye on His forehead; and He resides at Mount KailAsh. That SivA gave His left side to UmA, Himavan's daughter, and also brought forth You, His son, to us. The town where clouds gather in the groves and paddy-fields are aplenty - that enchanting town, ThiruththaNigai, is Your favourite mount, Oh Great One!

243.english_pathavurai: Acute cough, a kind of fits called muyalakan, rheumatic pain, burning nose, poisonous and toxic diseases, diabetes, nagging head-ache, anaemia, blisters around the neck, and in addition, edema in the stomach, congestion in the lungs, heartburn, acute stomach ache, and similar extremely painful diseases should not afflict and debilitate me in every birth. For that, You must kindly grant me Your hallowed feet! The millions of soldiers in the demons' armies advanced against You and died; and singing many songs praising the glory of the war, KAla Bhairavar (Lord SivA) came to the battlefield and danced; when You hurled the sharp and shining Spear! IndrA, who rides the clouds and resides in the shade of wish-yielding KaRpaga trees of the Celestial land, brought up this lovely damsel, DEvayAnai, and You are her consort. In this world, encircled by waters of the oceans, this place is renowned and is called Mount ThiruththaNigai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

244.english_meanings_list: ["It is inside the body; It is inside the life that gets in and out of the body;", "It is in the imperishable consciousness; It is in the Sky; It is in the fierce Fire;", "It is in the Air, the Water and the Earth.", "It is in the unique glow of Wisdom that can never be perceived by religious fanatics arguing among themselves;", "It is intermingled in the crests of the four VEdAs (Scriptures);", "It is the Vision of SivA that is above the thuriya* stage and beyond all miseries.", "I am a stupid fool, incapable of severing my endless desires and blemishes;", "is there any way for me to behold that vision and will You kindly teach me that way?", "It swam into the forest of fully bloomed lotus flowers and destroyed the forest;", "It fought with and drove away the hostile crowd of striped varAl fish;", "It jumped over all barricades in water, escaping the attack by peasants working in the fields;", "It collided with the barriers on the way and swam along the current in the river;", "upon entering the sea, It confronted the large fish and chased them away;", "It is the unique VALai fish that returned triumphantly to its home, the lotus pond.**", "That lotus pond, where a blue lily with divine fragrance blossoms daily without fail, is in ThiruththaNigai protected by You, Oh valorous One!", "You are compassionate like the Mount MEru! You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!"]
244.english_pathavurai: It is inside the body; It is inside the life that gets in and out of the body; It is in the imperishable consciousness; It is in the Sky; It is in the fierce Fire; It is in the Air, the Water and the Earth. It is in the unique glow of Wisdom that can never be perceived by religious fanatics arguing among themselves; It is intermingled in the crests of the four VEdAs (Scriptures); It is the Vision of SivA that is above the thuriya* stage and beyond all miseries. I am a stupid fool, incapable of severing my endless desires and blemishes; is there any way for me to behold that vision and will You kindly teach me that way? It swam into the forest of fully bloomed lotus flowers and destroyed the forest; It fought with and drove away the hostile crowd of striped varAl fish; It jumped over all barricades in water, escaping the attack by peasants working in the fields; It collided with the barriers on the way and swam along the current in the river; upon entering the sea, It confronted the large fish and chased them away; It is the unique VALai fish that returned triumphantly to its home, the lotus pond.** That lotus pond, where a blue lily with divine fragrance blossoms daily without fail, is in ThiruththaNigai protected by You, Oh valorous One! You are compassionate like the Mount MEru! You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!

245.english_pathavurai: Going everywhere in search of wealthy people, singing their praise in lyrical poems* just to please them, and saying that their fame is comparable to the loftiness of Mount MEru people indulge in excessive flattery! After so many trips to the rich, they are still returning empty-handed! They are hurt hearing the words "Come tomorrow", and their faces lose colour. Before I am doomed like this, please bless me graciously with Your lotus feet that radiate reddish and compassionate glow! He mounts the bull, Nandi; He is purity personified; He holds in His hand the trident; He is the Greatest; He is the Supreme Yogi; He wears the crescent moon, vilvam (bael) leaf, little pULai (Indian laburnum) flower, the skull with teeth, the river Ganga and the poisonous snake on His weighty tresses; and while that SivA is watching, and to the exhilaration of Mother UmA, You walk before them in gentle gait reflecting wisdom! This place has a pond where blue lilies blossom in plenty; and this is the ancient Mount ThiruththaNigai without a beginning, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

246.english_meanings_list: ["I always want to pursue the route to True Knowledge that will make me prosper.", "I want to chant the contemporary scriptures to enlighten my intellect.", "To dispel the delusory darkness in my mind, I must seek Your grace for the most desirable and blissful liberation.", "My relationship with You must be strengthened.", "You protect the seven worlds steadily by Your equitable dispensation of justice!", "Oh Consort of VaLLi, You relish being seated at the ancient mount in Thiruvallam* and at Mount ThiruththaNigai, famous for its blue lilies!", "Shall I be able to pluck the tender leaves of fresh Vilwa trees and place them", "in obeisance at Your lotus feet?", "He (Lord SivA) is the Leader wearing a hooded serpent; She (PArvathi) is seated on the left side of His body;", "River Ganga (BhAgeerathi) is held by Him in His immaculate tresses; and You are the son of all the three!", "Love blossomed gradually (in VaLLi's mind) in Mount VaLLimalai, and You fell in intense love with that Mount!", "You became the leader of all the hunters who surrounded You!", "To pierce the mystical mount Krouncha, You wielded the red-hot spear with a spinning force from Your hand!", "You are the nephew of Lakshmi held dearly by Vishnu in His heart!", "You are the younger brother of the Divine Elephant, VinAyagA; You are the master of the white elephant, AirAavatham;", "and You are the beloved consort of DEvayAnai, Oh Great One!"]
246.english_pathavurai: I always want to pursue the route to True Knowledge that will make me prosper. I want to chant the contemporary scriptures to enlighten my intellect. To dispel the delusory darkness in my mind, I must seek Your grace for the most desirable and blissful liberation. My relationship with You must be strengthened. You protect the seven worlds steadily by Your equitable dispensation of justice! Oh Consort of VaLLi, You relish being seated at the ancient mount in Thiruvallam* and at Mount ThiruththaNigai, famous for its blue lilies! Shall I be able to pluck the tender leaves of fresh Vilwa trees and place them in obeisance at Your lotus feet? He (Lord SivA) is the Leader wearing a hooded serpent; She (PArvathi) is seated on the left side of His body; River Ganga (BhAgeerathi) is held by Him in His immaculate tresses; and You are the son of all the three! Love blossomed gradually (in VaLLi's mind) in Mount VaLLimalai, and You fell in intense love with that Mount! You became the leader of all the hunters who surrounded You! To pierce the mystical mount Krouncha, You wielded the red-hot spear with a spinning force from Your hand! You are the nephew of Lakshmi held dearly by Vishnu in His heart! You are the younger brother of the Divine Elephant, VinAyagA; You are the master of the white elephant, AirAavatham; and You are the beloved consort of DEvayAnai, Oh Great One!

247.english_pathavurai: How many riotous fights! How many tricks and juggleries! How many diseases and how much madness! How many births, both animate and inanimate! How many scary acts! Among them, how many bold and manly deeds! How many types of desires! How many pieces of meat to satiate my hunger everyday! I do not want to keep on filling my stomach like a crazy man. I want to be liberated from birth. For that liberation, I must know the nature of actions of the multitudes of Your devotees; (the goal) which stands alone and is inconceivable; (the goal) which is an expansive bright luminous principle, OM, the PraNava ManthrA, (the goal) cannot be comprehended by attachments and desires; and that goal is Your two feet, which kindly grant me. (The sound of the same meter) Hundreds of drums were sounding to the above meter while many sages (siddhas), hunters, kings and devotees coming from all eight directions were marching around the holy mountain in homage. 248.english_pathavurai: The bones, the veins, water, blood, filthy substances, brains and worthless worms are contained in this house, that is called the body. In this house, how many flouters of ethical principles live?! Immoral and scheming ones, treacherous people, those who deceive the entire town with their tall talks, those who never progress even a bit since their birth, people who fuss around building several houses proclaiming their success boastfully, those wicked ones caught in the web of lust, those sinners totally oblivious of the value of penance, those who corrupt everyone and are capable of ditching even their own friends, those thieves who roam about in the company of murderers, arrogant ones and tale bearers, and those hot-headed ones occupy this house; how many diseases ail this body?! Why should I willingly enter such a house that strives to conquer (all those people and diseases) and roam around miserably in this world? To the loud beating of several drums in the background of the fierce battlefield, many demons advanced menacingly, and they were all destroyed; the dark delusive mount Krouncha was shattered; and the celestials and sidhdhAs (achievers through penance) venerated You when You wielded the Spear! He knocked down the heads of lustful RAvaNA and killed him; He sent Mahabali to the prison in the nether world (by placing His foot on his head); He scraped the steel pestle into powder and mixed it in mid-sea*; He is Lord Vishnu, and You are His nephew! The heads of BrahmA, the authority on VEdAs, were smacked with Your knuckles! She is the dancing Goddess; She delivered the entire universe; She has a green complexion; that PArvathi is wedded to our Father, Lord SivA, the Supreme Lord; and You preached to that SivA, Oh Great Master! She bears resemblance to the peacock family, living in the forest of VaLLimalai; She is the damsel of the KuravAs; You hugged that VaLLi after enticing her; and with immense happiness, You sought ThiruththaNigai as Your abode, Oh Great One!

249.english_pathavurai: In pursuit of gathering everything for myself toiled everyday for years on end restlessly, being born into several bodies and dying later, the shameless cycle of mine has to end, I should reach the abode of those who praise You for several days by singing Thiruppugazh (Your Glory). I should never deviate from their teachings. Will I be able to have the honour of prostrating at Your bright holy feet? Once Manmatha, who knew his archery, shot an arrow on SivA, who burnt Manmatha and brought him down; (That SivA) asked You to explain (the meaning of OM) then, You explained the meaning of Veda which even BrahmA listened to with great pleasure. With a rage You let go Your strong Spear on SUran, the Demon, and beheaded him, Oh MurugA! With VaLLi, of KuRavas, who was guarding the millet fields, You are seated at ThiruththaNigai, Oh Great One!

250.english_pathavurai: Leprosy that has afflicted me, biliousness that has attacked me due to my bad deeds, fever that makes me feel as if my body is on fire, convulsion (known as muyalakan) that shakes my body with unspeakable pain, constant twitching and coughing bouts - with all these diseases, I still keep thinking of my houses, women and children! I do not want to die in utter delusion with my mind in total stupor. Please grant me today Your vision, mounted on the emerald-green peacock, and bestow blissful liberation on me. 251.english_pathavurai: Do I have any intellect, my Lord? Whom will I seek with desire from now on? Am I destined to die in vain? With You as my Father and Mother, how can I suffer like this? Should I become the object of ridicule in this world? Right before the eyes of all those laughing at me, You must agree to place me at Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord!* Knowing my condition, should You refuse to place me at Your feet, the entire world will laugh at us, Oh Lord! When the child runs to his father and screams aloud, with the aroma of milk still fresh in his mouth, will the father despisingly question as to who would pick him up, leaving the crying child on the floor? Why does this thought never strike me? The milky ocean simmered like the boiling milk; and the wicked and foolish demons were driven away in all the eight directions and slaughtered by the powerful Spear (SakthivEl), bright like the Sun, held in Your hand, Oh our Lord! The tresses, in which River Ganga is held tightly, swayed; His hands in which the deer and the pick-axe are sitting snugly, also swayed; and the anklets on His holy feet made lilting sounds while He danced; that Cosmic Dancer, Lord SivA, delivered You to us! She lives in the big millet field; She is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, with dark and sparkling eyes; and You hugged that VaLLi with Your broad chest, Oh rider on the Peacock! Lord KandhA! The women who adorn their hair with lovely flowers for the success of the mission of Manmathan (God of Love) are amazed at the greatness of the sages who have performed long and true penance; those sages live in this distinguished hill station at ThiruththaNigai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

257.english_meanings_list: ["A few devious sidhdhas (people capable of performing miracles),", "and some religious zealots claiming to have mastered the six religions*", "contemplate installation of several famous gods;", "they choose names for the gods and cast them in many moulds (like statuettes, copper plates etc.).", "Why do they roam about sowing divisive seeds of distrust leading to miserable births in several wombs?", "For the sake of golden chains, rings, bangles for both the hands", "and classy diamond necklaces to be showered upon women, people go about in search of money;", "can they not perceive in the least the greatness of Your hallowed feet which are all-pervasive and, at the same time, stand apart uniquely?", "After destroying Mount Krouncha and the seven fortress-hills (of SUran),", "after noisily stirring up the group of several wide seas,", "and after wearing as garland on Your shoulders the intestines of the brave demon, SUran,", "with Your spear, still fuming with rage, You split his body into two and bathed in the gushing blood, Oh Lord!", "In the wonderful millet field, there are marks of the gentle footsteps of VaLLi;", "She collects all the loose flowers, makes a garland and wears it shyly;", "and You worship her with praise, Oh realized one!", "You are seated at ThiruththaNigai, surrounded by impressive walls.", "You are the one, who (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) rendered the Scriptures in Tamil (as ThEvArams), Oh Great One!"]
257.english_pathavurai: A few devious sidhdhas (people capable of performing miracles), and some religious zealots claiming to have mastered the six religions* contemplate installation of several famous gods; they choose names for the gods and cast them in many moulds (like statuettes, copper plates etc.). Why do they roam about sowing divisive seeds of distrust leading to miserable births in several wombs? For the sake of golden chains, rings, bangles for both the hands and classy diamond necklaces to be showered upon women, people go about in search of money; can they not perceive in the least the greatness of Your hallowed feet which are all-pervasive and, at the same time, stand apart uniquely? After destroying Mount Krouncha and the seven fortress-hills (of SUran), after noisily stirring up the group of several wide seas, and after wearing as garland on Your shoulders the intestines of the brave demon, SUran, with Your spear, still fuming with rage, You split his body into two and bathed in the gushing blood, Oh Lord! In the wonderful millet field, there are marks of the gentle footsteps of VaLLi; She collects all the loose flowers, makes a garland and wears it shyly; and You worship her with praise, Oh realized one! You are seated at ThiruththaNigai, surrounded by impressive walls. You are the one, who (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) rendered the Scriptures in Tamil (as ThEvArams), Oh Great One!

258.english_meanings_list: ["On their solid and robust shoulders that are soft like the bamboo, on their mountain-like bosom,", "on their cloud-like dense and black hair and on the kayal-fish-like dark painted eyes of these whores, I have let my thoughts dwell", "without knowing the ways of attaining Your matchless and hallowed feet that wear the anklets;", "this body is the seat of a whole host of diseases and is blown like the bellows in the furnace (by repeated sighs);", "and bound by the sensory organs, flesh and skin, all of which are wrapped within this unreal pot;", "kindly sever this birth in which I am forced to bear the burden of that pot and grant me the immortal state of bliss!", "He has as a vehicle the angry, white elephant, AirAvadham, whose trunk is huge like a palm tree; that IndrA was chased by the demon SUran who was scared off by You into the sea when You fought him with Your spear, Oh Lord!", "The Rooster on Your staff has sharp nails in its paws that could trample the mountains wiping out their arrogance, Oh Lord KumarA!", "You proudly embrace, with Your hallowed shoulders, VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, residing in the millet-field of VaLLimalai!", "In the outer fields of this beautiful town, pure pearls abound, signifying the presence of the Goddess of Wealth, Lakshmi;", "this holy place, located in the auspicious northern side (of Tamil NAdu), is ThiruththaNigai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
258.english_pathavurai: On their solid and robust shoulders that are soft like the bamboo, on their mountain-like bosom, on their cloud-like dense and black hair and on the kayal-fish-like dark painted eyes of these whores, I have let my thoughts dwell without knowing the ways of attaining Your matchless and hallowed feet that wear the anklets; this body is the seat of a whole host of diseases and is blown like the bellows in the furnace (by repeated sighs); and bound by the sensory organs, flesh and skin, all of which are wrapped within this unreal pot; kindly sever this birth in which I am forced to bear the burden of that pot and grant me the immortal state of bliss! He has as a vehicle the angry, white elephant, AirAvadham, whose trunk is huge like a palm tree; that IndrA was chased by the demon SUran who was scared off by You into the sea when You fought him with Your spear, Oh Lord! The Rooster on Your staff has sharp nails in its paws that could trample the mountains wiping out their arrogance, Oh Lord KumarA! You proudly embrace, with Your hallowed shoulders, VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, residing in the millet-field of VaLLimalai! In the outer fields of this beautiful town, pure pearls abound, signifying the presence of the Goddess of Wealth, Lakshmi; this holy place, located in the auspicious northern side (of Tamil NAdu), is ThiruththaNigai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

261.english_meanings_list: ["Those arrogant people who are compulsive liars, those who heed to their five sensory organs,", "those evil ones with gazing eyes that destroy their ruined life altogether, without any hope of redemption; those blind fools bereft of any intellect, those thieves,", "and those religious zealots were the ones I have been approaching; without learning anything to enhance my knowledge, becoming exhausted, and without my rigid heart melting through devotion,", "I have become blemished, totally drowning in the sea of birth that destroys me; lest I end up in such a manner,", "will I be able to rise, coming up in life, leading myself in the righteous path with a good feeling and attain Your hallowed feet?", "To cure the high fever of the intelligent king PANdiyan (with a hunch-back) and to destroy the entire foolish clan of ChamaNas, who had the custom of plucking the hair of one another,", "You distributed the fragrant holy ash of SivA (in Madhurai) coming as Poet ThirugnAna Sambandhar in the lineage of kavuNiyars of Pukali (SeegAzhi*)!", "He raised fiery sparks merely from His smile that destroyed Thiripuram completely; and You are the good son of that Lord SivA!", "In its famous fountain, a fragrant blue lily blossoms every day", "in this place SeruththaNi** (ThiruththaNigai), which is Your abode, Oh SaravaNA, the Great One!"]
261.english_pathavurai: Those arrogant people who are compulsive liars, those who heed to their five sensory organs, those evil ones with gazing eyes that destroy their ruined life altogether, without any hope of redemption; those blind fools bereft of any intellect, those thieves, and those religious zealots were the ones I have been approaching; without learning anything to enhance my knowledge, becoming exhausted, and without my rigid heart melting through devotion, I have become blemished, totally drowning in the sea of birth that destroys me; lest I end up in such a manner, will I be able to rise, coming up in life, leading myself in the righteous path with a good feeling and attain Your hallowed feet? To cure the high fever of the intelligent king PANdiyan (with a hunch-back) and to destroy the entire foolish clan of ChamaNas, who had the custom of plucking the hair of one another, You distributed the fragrant holy ash of SivA (in Madhurai) coming as Poet ThirugnAna Sambandhar in the lineage of kavuNiyars of Pukali (SeegAzhi*)! He raised fiery sparks merely from His smile that destroyed Thiripuram completely; and You are the good son of that Lord SivA! In its famous fountain, a fragrant blue lily blossoms every day in this place SeruththaNi** (ThiruththaNigai), which is Your abode, Oh SaravaNA, the Great One!

262.english_pathavurai: She has cuckoo's sweet voice but she is roaming about in agony in the wayside listening to the heartrending cooing of the cuckoo; because of the menacing (fifth) arrow of flower (blue lily) shot by Manmathan (God of Love) an arrow that could kill, because of the fiery rays of the cool, pale and beautiful moon that scorch the pearl beads of the chain on the bosom of this bright creeper-like girl, because of the stormy wind constantly tossing the waves in the sea making a loud noise, and because of stinging gossip by all the women surrounding her, she feels very weak and lonely, longing to hug Your shoulders; is she to be denied the pleasure of embracing You? Oh valorous One, You fought so fiercely that the mount Krouncha was destroyed, the seven hills were shattered and Yaman (God of Death) ran about hither and thither! DEvayAnai, the damsel of the celestials who grew under the shade of the (wish-yielding) kaRpaga trees, and VaLLi, the damsel of the kuRavAs who lived in the forest of VaLLimalai - both of them hugged Your hallowed chest with their bosom! As He prostrated at Your feet, You graciously preached to Lord SivA the significance of the PraNava ManthrA; and You are the Lord of ThiruththaNigai where red lily blossoms everyday, Oh Great One!

263.english_pathavurai: It is forbidden to have friendship with people who wander like bunches of sparrows and eagles, like herds of jackals and wild animals roaming about in the rare jungles, are like worms and kuravai fish, and like elephants and like trees. "This fellow has indulged in several miserable actions provoked by young women and is tormented by mental distress, agony and diseases; he is an unstable wanderer, dishonourable and poverty-stricken" - without being thus ridiculed by many people; kindly save me from such humiliation; I do not seek the glamour of riding in a golden palanquin, displaying densely-packed jewellery on my shoulders, surrounded by many elephants and horses, wearing silk clothes and being admired by suitors comparing me to the sales merchandise of the God of Love, Manmathan; my ultimate refuge is bound to be Your hallowed lotus feet, being the fountain wherefrom words for my musical poems spring; (therefore, in order for me) to attain those feet, kindly bless me with the ability to sing songs of Your Glory, Oh Lord! Loudly proclaiming Your victory, many beats reverberated in a scary way to the meter of "thanaththana thanana thanaththana vithami thimiththimi thimitha thimiththimi vikirtha daduttudu ririri" and "gugu"; the crown-hoods of the famous serpent AdhisEshan were smashed with a crushing noise; the cardinal directions were jolted and holed in a crowded barricade; the demons who fought till the very end were knocked down by the spear You wielded, Oh Lord! He frowned on them with His fiery third eye burning down the rare Thiripurams; He holds the weapon mazhu (pick-axe) in His hand which severed one of the heads of BrahmA; He is the One who protects all the worlds and all lives; You are the child of that Lord SivA! (Coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) You ensured that the ChamaNas were destroyed by sending them to the gallows; along with DEvayAnai, the pretty lass reared with affection by the celestials and VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, You settled down in the beautiful mountain of ThiruththaNigai, where You dance, Oh Great One!

266.english_pathavurai: They deliberately loosen their hair and retie it into a knot in the manner of showing-off. They apply black pigment to their rolling eyes and intimidate people with their looks. The speech of these whores betrays anger. They press the shoulders of their suitors with the sharp bud-like breasts appearing to be made of solid-wood. They embrace their suitors willingly and later raise a racket, causing misery. They make nail-marks of the shape of a curved crescent moon. They openly express their desire to be paid more than the usual amount offered to them for many days. When they see that their desire is not fulfilled, they resort to whining. They are useless, bent upon causing misery by their misdeeds. Once the suitors run out of money, they banish them out of the house making them feel wretched. To enable me to get rid of the liaison with such whores, You are yet to grant me Your hallowed and gracious feet. Kindly tell me how I could ever reach the righteous path. Making Sugreeva wear the garland of the daffodils (KAnthaL), He sent him to a duel with the matchless monkey-king, VAli; He then killed that VAli with His bow GANdeepam; He is Lord RAmA, possessing all virtues, and You are His nephew, Oh Lord! He succeeded in scaring the hunter-girl, VaLLi, who was deeply in love with You; He then accepted three kinds of fruits namely, the mango, the jack fruit and the plantains and devoured them all, along with sugar; He appeared before the maiden, VaLLi, who stood alone in the forest; He is like the wish-yielding KaRpaga Tree who grants the seekers what they seek; He has a black face of the elephant; and You are the younger brother of that Lord VinAyagar! As soon as You learnt about the coming of the hunters, who had planted the sweet millet seeds in the field, You stood in the disguise of a beautiful and lone neem tree, Oh Lord! In order to unite with VaLLi, who is bestowed with a speech sweet as honey, You went to the field of millet (where she lived) and remained there, Oh Lord! The bamboo shoots are so tall as if they are touching the sky; near the bamboos, there are many ponds filled with lily flowers everywhere that radiate like gold; this is the shrine at ThiruththaNigai, and You are seated here, Oh Great One!

268.english_pathavurai: Under the KurA tree* (in Thiruvidaikkazhi) full of bunches of flowers, in the middle of the lotus hearts of Your devotees, and at the apex of the multi-disciplined VEdAs (scriptures), You prevail, Oh Great Master! In Pazhani of Kongunadu, You appear as the six-faced Shanmukha; in ThiruchchendhUr, You appear as the Protector; and in ThiruththaNigai, You are simply peerless! Those, gathering in a noisy crowd, opposing religion and being argumentative, can never realize You! Those who are outside Your Domain can never meet You! Your path is of a unique tradition; and that path must be shown to me by You! Adorned by fragrant kadampa flowers, with beetles humming around, and with anklets fitted with golden beads, are Your two soothing lotus feet; and Your great gracious gift of these feet to me can never be forgotten by me even in my dreams! With the river (Ganga), Aththi (mountain ebony) flower, kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower, young and fresh crescent moon and a snake adorning the reddish tresses of SivA, He gave You unto us as His lovely child, Oh MurugA! In the forest of SheNpaka trees, on the raised platform in millet fields, and in the thick jungle of tall sandalwood trees lives the damsel of KuRavas, namely VaLLi. Her lotus feet wearing the reddish-golden anklets; Her bangled hands which are soft as fresh bamboo; Her moon-like bright lotus-face; Her chest, fragrant with kasthUri (musk) and vermillion; Her sweet voice like veena and smile like nectar; Her enchanting lips, red like the insect IndragOpam; Her complexion like green emerald; Her brows like the rainbow; and the blue pupils of Her wide eyes running upto her ears as if to fight with the studs - all these, You portrayed in madal* (canvas in palm leaf), Oh Great One!

269.english_pathavurai: To the hotheads who are angry with Your devotees, to the families of those who oppose Your devotees, to the lives of those who destroy Your devotees, to those who with rage jeer at Your devotees, and to those who abuse Your devotees, songs of "the Glory of the Lord" feel like Fire and destroy them; we know it is true. These songs grant Your devotees all their wishes; they melt the minds of the singers and the listeners; they terminate any future births and confinement in dark wombs; they are capable of burning even the fire itself; and they can even demolish mountains into bits and pieces! You have to grant us the ability to sing such songs which are full of Your praise and glory. (same sound) in that meter, the war-drums were beating; (to this sound) beat the thudi (another hand-drum); to those beats marched the armies of the demons (asuras). Their anger was destroyed and the heaps of the beheaded corpses were totally burnt down by Your smile alone, Oh bright and mighty Speared Lord! You revel on the bosom of Your consort VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavas, who guarded the millet fields in VaLLimalai. You chose as Your abode, ThiruththaNigai, worshipped by Your devotees, Oh Great One!

270.english_pathavurai: How many lives have I been born in bodies of the size of little tilseed (gingely), thinai seed and minuscule sand? In how many times did I get life beneath the roaring ocean full of waves in several forms, from the giant shark to little fish? Not content with that, how many births have I taken in hills and ponds? In how many physical forms did I exist, which fancied and lusted for the trashy bosoms of women? Is there a count for the number of lives that were snatched away in several births by Yaman (God of Death)? How many treacherous thoughts did I nurture in my heart? How many families did I ruin? How many living beings did I torture in a brutal way? It is simply countless! How many incidents have occurred which did not deviate from their destined course? This person, me, is like a mere mosquito, a bully, one in the clan of dullards and who is full of lust and devoid of wisdom. For my heart to melt at Your lotus feet, will You kindly bless me at least henceforth? To the aforesaid meter, the voice of victory sounded characteristically from maththaLam and dhamarukam (percussion instruments), resounding like the roaring sea. Blood was shed profusely at the battle field where the war was waged with fury. Elephants, demons, horses and bows were torn into shreds while vultures and wolves fed on the corpses, when You stood on a mountain of human flesh and fought with SUran, Oh VElA!
