272.english_pathavurai: I am like a rattle snake daring to fight a fierce battle ("coward"); I am a loner eating without offering to anyone ("selfish miser"); I am far away from the ritual of wearing SivA's holy ash ("anti-saivite"); I am a sinner, roaming around denying myself the benefit of any deep-rooted meditation which sustains life like the root sustaining the tree ("atheist"); I pose like an eloquent person, and, without thinking about You, argue with others barking abusive language ("dog"); Until today, I have faltered wastefully, without knowing where my solace can be found ("scum"); I am a treacherous person without any respect for the enlightened people ("traitor"); Due to acute ignorance, I am possessed by the three evil characteristics (haughtiness, karmA and illusion); and I am baser than the basest. Should You decide to get rid of such a hopeless person? Am I not eligible to get salvation if I go to heaven along with Your devotees? You have the golden spear, sharp and sparkling like a diamond, and the peacock! Will You shower Your grace on me? She got her nose cut off; she was stupid and yet had a lot of muscle-power; she was the root cause (for the downfall of RavaNA's dynasty); her name was SUrpanagai and she was cruel; she deserves to be disrespected; she belonged to an obstinate breed; although she was the sister of good VibheeshanA, she was a consummate temptress; and that SUrpanagai went to her elder brother and Rakshasa King, RAvaNA, and described Sita's beauty in such a tempting way that Sita, who is none other than Lakshmi in the temple of lotus, was kidnapped in a cunning manner by that Rakshasa; and he took her in his chariot which flew off towards the clouds to LankA, which has tall and picturesque buildings, armies and towers. There, in Ashokavanam, he imprisoned her. On that day, it was resolved that his dynasty would be rooted out; that resolution was carried out by expert archers, whose leader was Rama, and You are his nephew! Sounding like many percussion instruments as drums (maththaLam) and trumpet (pErikai), is the chanting of VEdAs (scriptures) at Your shrine. There is a perennial fountain yielding kazhuneer flowers (red water lilies), daily at ThiruththaNigai; and You reside on its hill, Oh Great One!

274.english_pathavurai: The fertile Earth, Water, flickering Fire, breezy Wind and the famous wide Sky (the five Elements, in all); the three characteristics (sathvam, rAjasam and thAmasam) and the three desires (for the land, woman and gold) have all been inextricably combined (to form this body). This sinful body is something not to be enamoured of and I do not wish to be born again and again in this world. The Grace that can never be secured by the vast intellect of people who fail to worship You and that Grace which is beyond their reach is the One You should shower on me. For those who worship You without fail or interruption, You remove all their bondages due to their karma. You destroyed the arrogance and the sovereign rule of SUran, the demon. You are the true scholar of Saivism and, holding Your unique spear, You have chosen ThiruththaNigai as Your abode! VaLLi, the damsel having a voice so sweet as sugar and milk, was guarding the millet field, and You went to embrace her! Oh Supreme One, Oh Eternal One, Oh the one beyond all bonds, and Oh Mystical One! Oh universal Father, KumarA, Oh, Great One!

It is a pot filled with compressed air and the three slags namely, arrogance, karma and delusion. It is a mishmash made up of woeful flesh, muscles and blood. Even though I roam around hankering after such a despicable body, will there be a day when my speech totally ceases (and silence prevails)? He is our Father wearing bones, serpents and holy ash on His body; You are the wise sage-like master worshipped by that SivA with flowers. You have twelve shoulders like the mountains, always ready for war! Your abode is Mount ThiruththaNigai where blue lilies blossom! You are the son of PArvathi and River Ganga! If there is a singular vision in this world, that is the vision of Your dancing posture; that vision is possible only to those who have performed penance, and You are for ever helpful to them, Oh Youthful One! 276.english_pathavurai: These women feign ticklishness when touched. They always harbour treacherous thoughts. They are stupid, lacking the eye of knowledge. They are young damsels, full of blemishes. They ditch others knocking them down into the clefts on the ground. They administer sensual pleasure in small doses. They are too cunning. They readily display their grumpiness. These useless women are full of utter treachery. They are foolish and are bereft of any virtue whatsoever. They reverse their talk completely in about turn. They are too slippery to be caught. They elude so cleverly that their misdeeds never show up. They grab their suitors' money after flirting with them in a friendly manner. They sell their bosom for a price. I do not wish to be ensnared in the net spread by these whores; comparable to these whores, there are others who also block my path towards righteousness; these are both elators and depressors as they indulge in sorcery; deeming them bright as coral, I used to take them home and wasted so much of my time in this world surrounded by the great Mountain ChakravaLAka. In order that my five mental states (avasthAs*) are done away with and the various mischiefs played on me by the several tenets are removed, and to dispel the darkness of my ignorance so as to spread the bright and True Knowledge throughout my mind, kindly bless me graciously; will there be a day when I shall attain Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord? After creating the entire universe, setting everything in motion and protecting them all, She, along with Lord NadarAjar (SivA), destroyed the whole lot; She is chaste and of a complexion of emerald green; She dances on top of the unique cosmos; and You are the younger child of that Goddess UmAdEvi, Oh Lord! He fought against the aggressive demons sending them all to the land of Yaman (God of Death); He is the handsome Lord holding the conch and the disc in His hallowed hands; the huge earthen pot constituting this world was concealed by Him inside His belly; and You are the nephew of that tall Lord VishNu! The sea was in a shell-shock, the demons ran away helter skelter and the mountains in all the eight directions were shattered to pieces when You wielded the bright Spear perfectly and went around the world in a fraction of a second mounted on the peacock, Oh Valorous One! She belongs to the field of millet; She is the young lass bestowed with two mountain-like breasts; She comes from a good lineage of the KuRavAs; along with that pearl-like VaLLi and DEvayAnai, the daughter of IndirANi, You are seated permanently in this famous mountain in ThiruththaNigai, Oh Great One!

277.english_pathavurai: I was drowned in the ocean of family life; an ocean whose vastness and depth can never be measured. I used to make a lot of false statements which sounded like truth. In the meantime, I put in long hours of physical labour for many days. I used to hide myself from the company of respectable elders. I never used to think of serving You or seeking Your feet. Many major diseases attacked my body. (As I said about the ocean of family life), several waves of illnesses called the disease of birth swayed me! I became an angry mad man and lost my balance. I do not want to suffer like that any more. I want to contemplate on the origin of birth and to destroy its root cause, namely, desire. I want to sing Your glory and survive in this world by Your grace. You are always the great bridegroom to VaLLi, the damsel of the KuravAs, in whose company You revel! You embrace her lovely shoulders and play with her romantically! I seek the Your closeness as You rejoice in the company of VaLLi! You have to make me experience happiness. It is not only Your duty but would also add to Your dignity, Oh MurugA! Those devotees of Yours, who sing Your glory without fail several times a day, are blessed by You to live in Your company forever worshipping You! People love to deem this place, ThiruththaNigai, to be the land of SivA in this world; and You have Your abode here, standing as the Curer of the disease of birth, Oh Great One!

280.english_pathavurai: Having a head with prominent teeth, strong arms and sturdy legs to support (the torso), this pot-like body, full of lies, has been made with tender care; this body is the base of all blemishes and sins. This body contains the intestines, the seat of hunger, and it is a huge mass of biliousness and fear. It is a big blower made of skin to blow air, fitted with three sources of trouble (namely, lust, anger and delusion) and five senses (taste, light, feeling, hearing and smell). Bearing this constricted leather bag (during life) and dropping it (upon death) has been the activity of each birth. To get rid of birth should be my aim and goal; will You kindly grant me that thought? You protect those devotees who always meditate upon You in their heart and discard treacherous people from Your hallowed feet (which are meant only for Your devotees), Oh valorous One! The virtuous damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi, lived in the millet-field with fully grown crop of millet; You hugged her with Your broad shoulders. The mighty demons of Thiripuram advanced in the battle and confronted Lord SivA; they were all burnt down by the mere smile of SivA who is indestructible. You are the son of that SivA, Oh KumarEsa! This place stands uniquely on the northern border of Tamil NAdu where righteousness is loftily upheld; that famous place, ThiruththaNigai, is Your abode, Oh Great One!

288.english_pathavurai: Many devotees worshipped Your hallowed feet and attained exalted status. I am incapable of praising their greatness with a melting heart; nor am I able to give up the bookish blabberings and praise Your glory with true knowledge. I am not able to think of You with clarity. I came in a hurry to be born in this world, and my later sinful deeds were aplenty. I roamed around every day from door to door desperately. I was totally plunged in this rut of despicable birth. Saving me from this ordeal, will there be a day when You will grant me some liberation? He willingly gave the left half of His body to the Supreme Mother, the daughter of Mount Himavan. He is Pure Consciousness Himself; and You are that SivA's Son, the victorious stalwart mounting the Peacock! Tamil language has words of wisdom and truth, in all the three phases of literature, music and drama, whose meaning and sound last eternally (and can be heard) in the hills of ThiruththaNigai, which is Your abode! There is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, at the millet-field (in VaLLimalai) with plenty of trees like the wish-yielding KaRpaga; and You hug her lovely bosoms with the fragrance of camphor, and fitted with tight blouses. The hostile bunch of demons was driven away by Your rage, and You broke the shackles into pieces, that were laid (by SUran) on the hands of IndrA, holding the weapon VajrA, Oh Great One!

292.english_pathavurai: (Thinking that) he is comparable to the cloud in charity, to the sun in fame, to the brilliant pearl in the glow of his face, to Manmathan (God of Love) who wields flowers as arrows from his bow of sugarcane in terms of handsomeness, and to the great son who grants a thing to the heart's content in giving alms, I approched him eagerly; declaring that he is the old Karnan and the wish-yielding divine tree KaRpagam; that he is none other than the Lord VishNu, with the complexion of black cloud, who killed the crocodile in the pond; and that he is like the six faced Lord Murugan; describing poverty-stricken people as those who are endowed with all the wealth, comparing them with Arjunan who is skilled in archery, and equating them to the Mount MEru circumambulated by the sun, I sang musical poems on them; in order to terminate my profession of begging, wandering to the places of such misers whose heart is rigid like solid rock, and to attain Your hallowed feet, kindly bless me so that I reach the level of penance realised by Your multifarious devotees! She delivered the entire world in an orderly manner; she is UmA, the peacock-like daughter of Mount HimavAn; She bent the great Mount MEru like a bow and, in a second, burnt down Thiripuram in this place called Thiruvathikai; that Abhirami (the most beautiful) is concorporate on the left side of His body; He has the matchless form of fiery effulgence; He is beyond the reach of words; He belongs to the old Tamil literature; He could not be comprehended by Lord VishNu, BrahmA and the entire world; He is the dancing Lord SivA, and You are His Treasure, Oh Lord! the demons, with discs as their weapons, were all shattered to pieces; the wavy seas dried up; even on the elevated areas of the battlefield, gushing blood flowed like a river; and the mount Krouncha, with its high peaks, was smashed to smithereens when You fought with the spear; You are the gracious sun who removes the darkness (of ignorance), Oh Great Master! You fly around mounting the youthful peacock and are seated permanently in this matchless place, ThiruththaNigai, Oh Great One!

294.english_pathavurai: Manmathan, the Love God, is holding the bow of sugarcane, the pearl within which is about to split open; and the flowery arrows expertly flung from that bow are haunting her. From the surface of the beautiful sea that contains many pearls, the moon rises and burns (her) like fire with its light. She wears the misery of slander-mongering by parrot-like women who revel in gossipping repeatedly about her. Lest this lovely creeper-like damsel suffer any further, You must appear before her right this day in this place, ThiruththaNigai, famously known in all directions for its victorious glory. With extreme anger (You shattered) the Mount Krouncha in the North, famous for its high peaks, by piercing them with Your dazzling Spear, Oh Lord! Heaping praises on VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, You hugged her bosom ardently and passionately with Your highly decorated chest, Oh Lord! He is said to be extremely eccentric; he adorns His tresses with the lovely flower Umaththai; He is Lord SivA; that SivA cherishes Your holy feet in His heart! In the seas throwing waves in circles, the hostile demons who came to fight with You were all destroyed and cut into pieces by You, Oh Great One!

297.english_pathavurai: In the high seas where ships sail, the waves keep ebbing and flowing everywhere, lashing with a deafening noise; He is a deceitful but determined one, hurling all the five fiery flower arrows; He is the God of Love (Manmathan); My shameless body gave birth to her, my girl, who is virtuous, having a creeper-like waist, beautiful like a peacock, now looking like a withered piece of cotton because of the burning agony in her heart; Can You not consider her state of dying in loneliness due to the anguish of her separation from You? In this grove, amidst a multitude of coconut trees, there are plantain trees everywhere; the beetles gather together closely and sing steadily to the tune of "thenthen thenathena"; the peacocks dance elegantly to that tune; and in the ponds, brimful with water, blue lilies blossom everywhere making the ponds famous for yielding this flower at all times. Such a beautiful place in the South is ThiruththaNigai, which is Your abode, from where You are capable of creating the seven worlds at all times, Oh Great One!

298.english_pathavurai: My wife who is gifted with round and bright bosoms, the prattling kids I sired through her, my elderly mother, my town, my house, the garden I set up therein, my wealth, all the assets that I have earned, a host of my relatives and my knowledge - are all about to leave me; briskly driving their vehicle, a large buffalo that is fast approaching me, these foolish messengers of Yaman (God of Death) are about to throttle my neck with the rope (of attachment) to take my life; before that moment, enabling me to get liberated and making me one of the emancipated souls, kindly bless me with Your two hallowed feet which permeate the sacred VEdAs and the bunch of kurA flowers! It has a decorated veil over its forehead, four* large tusks of ivory and a hanging trunk; it is the celestial elephant (AirAvadham), under whose care grew this bright and beautiful belle, DEvayAnai, with the gait of a female elephant; You are her consort! She stands (to guard the millet field) on a raised platform made of raw bamboo; she comes from a town of hunters of a simple unpretentious lineage; You embraced the shoulders of that VaLLi, Oh Lord of ThiruththaNigai! The elephants with hanging trunks and the eight large mountains (Mount Krouncha and the seven protective mountains of the demons' clan) shuddered when You wielded the spear, Oh Lord! You are beyond the reach of those who do not worship. You naturally disengage from any kind of attachment! You are easily accessible to those who sing Your glory in Tamil songs, Oh Great One!

299.english_meanings_list: ["From the corner of their eyes that resemble deer's eyes,", "these girls captivate the youth;", "and losing my sense of balance, I gave away all my belongings to those girls and became poor.", "That poverty lit a fire in my stomach which burned wild.", "Due to that fire, I became friendly with someone;", "I became an enemy of someone else;", "and yet again, I got over-attached to another.", "With all these attachments I became debilitated.", "Bless this worst sinner, namely myself, to sing about Your feet", "by leading a lofty life with good character.", "If The Glory of God described in Tamil (this Thiruppugazh) by ArunagirinAthan (namely myself)", "is sung with full force, You are pleased.", "The camaNas (anti-saivites) were killed in the gallows (kazhumaram) and", "The Pandya King, husband of the unique Mangaiyarkkarasi, was redeemed from the base camaNa religion", "miraculously by the Divine Hymns (DEvAram) sung in Tamil by ThirugnAna Sambandhar; and You came as that great poet!", "The haughty clan of SUran came to fight a war with You, and their entire dynasty was uprooted by the impact", "of the sharp spear in Your lovely hand!", "In this hallowed place is a beautiful fountain which delivers every day a unique violet flower (Neelothpala flower);", "this beautiful place is known as ThiruththaNigai, and You reside on its mount, Oh, Great One!"]
299.english_pathavurai: From the corner of their eyes that resemble deer's eyes, these girls captivate the youth; and losing my sense of balance, I gave away all my belongings to those girls and became poor. That poverty lit a fire in my stomach which burned wild. Due to that fire, I became friendly with someone; I became an enemy of someone else; and yet again, I got over-attached to another. With all these attachments I became debilitated. Bless this worst sinner, namely myself, to sing about Your feet by leading a lofty life with good character. If The Glory of God described in Tamil (this Thiruppugazh) by ArunagirinAthan (namely myself) is sung with full force, You are pleased. The camaNas (anti-saivites) were killed in the gallows (kazhumaram) and The Pandya King, husband of the unique Mangaiyarkkarasi, was redeemed from the base camaNa religion miraculously by the Divine Hymns (DEvAram) sung in Tamil by ThirugnAna Sambandhar; and You came as that great poet! The haughty clan of SUran came to fight a war with You, and their entire dynasty was uprooted by the impact of the sharp spear in Your lovely hand! In this hallowed place is a beautiful fountain which delivers every day a unique violet flower (Neelothpala flower); this beautiful place is known as ThiruththaNigai, and You reside on its mount, Oh, Great One!

The heads of the war-mongering demons were severed valiantly and felled on the earth as the herds of devils and crows that assembled in the battlefield were fed with the blood of the demons when You wielded the spear, Oh Lord! In this place, as the soft-bodied kayal fish leap up knocking the bunches of betel-nuts from the trees, the sheer weight of the betel-nuts topples the plantains from below, and grains from the fully grown and dense crop of red paddy are scattered throughout the field; there are millions of such paddy fields, along with many groves that abound in every mountainous valley, and several tall golden temple towers with large halls, the mere sight of which even from a distance is able to remove the bad deeds of the worshippers, surrounding this city; many garlands and festoons decorate the quiet streets which the temple cars go around in this town; this is ThiruththaNigai, Your beautiful abode, praised by all the celestials, Oh Great One!

302.english_pathavurai: The force of flowery arrows sent out by Manmathan (Love God) with a stretched bow of sugarcane, which ensures victory; the moon looking like a round disc that emits fire, spreading light in the milky way and in the streets; the scandals that are heaped on me by the women of the town who have resolutely learnt scandal-mongering as an art; and the music that emanates from the flute - all these haunt me, and I do not want to suffer any more. You have to kindly grant me devotion and my liberation by arriving in front of me, mounted on Your great green-hued Peacock! He burnt down Manmathan by the fiery eye in His forehead; He is the great Lord who performs the cosmic dance; and that SivA contemplates You in His heart where You reside with Your anklets, oh brave one! She, the chaste damsel of the KuRavAs, with bosoms like honeyed lotus flowers, loves You; and everyday You embrace that VaLLi with Your chest very tightly! 305.english_pathavurai: In this world, these whores are capable of provoking so much passion in men that, out of lust, they even resort to doodling on palm leaves*; these women are treacherous in their teasing love-play; they display their beautiful hair adorned with pretty flowers and their bosom; their slender waists like the flashes of lightning; their delicate clothings; their gaits with a lilt; their sweet talk and beautiful eyes; - all these have left me, the lowly dog, dazed like a little baby; should I be so inebriated? Those nomadic sages who move around from place to place like birds and those who have realised through silence are incapable of approaching this mystery that is conspicuously detached and that which manifests in the sound of Siva-Sakthi union achievable by holding the inhaled air (pUragam)** through breath-control methods (PrANAyAmam); that which is undescribable, unattainable and unimaginable; that which is full of compassion, primordial and capable of holding my mind in a state of samAdhi (which is at the peak of the kundalini zones, namely sahasrAra)***; kindly come and deliver that bliss to me! You mounted the blue peacock and fought with the demons who were holding the celestials in prison and killed their entire armies, Oh Wonderful, Powerful and Compassionate One! This cool river KAvEri coming from the Coorg (Kudagu) region has large waves thumping like the sea waves; You are the valorous One residing in ThirisirAmalai lashed by those waves! You are the leader of all hunters living in mountainous regions (kuRinji); You are the younger brother of the primordial Lord GaNapathi; and You are the Lord of River KAvEri! You are the Leader par excellence in handsomeness; You are the Consort of DEvayAnai; You are also the Consort of, and reveller in, our dear VaLLi, the deer-like damsel; You are the Master of all the celestials! You are the Master of Lord SivA, the Consort of Mother Gowri; You relish in setting up Your abode in all beautiful mountains, Oh Great One!

306.english_pathavurai: Going after the money of rich misers who are foolish and deceitful, people sing a variety of Tamil literary compositions such as Manjari, Kovai and ThUthu, in a flattering way, comparing them with renowned kings, PAri and KAri (who are great givers) as if they are to be worshipped! Not wasting my time in this vain sycophancy, (I would like to sing about) Your reddish lotus feet, the sweetly jingling anklets, Your garland of kadappa flowers, strong and powerful spear, Peacock and six holy faces, in chaste Tamil language, every day, leading to my well-being. To accomplish this, kindly bless me with a gracious word from Your reddish fruit-like mouth an oracle, that is the source of Wisdom! PANdiya King's hunchback and his high fever were simultaneously cured; the dumb SamaNa priests, who were known to be argumentative and repetitive, echoing like a parrot, went to the gallows, in disgrace, with their peacock feathers intact (after losing their debate); You came as the wise man, ThirugnAna Sambandhar singing the hymns, and distributed the holy ash of True Knowledge to all! In this greenish millet field, where many elephants and yALis (lion-elephants) roam about, the hunter tribes assemble and dance in frenzied ecstasy; and then they worship You seeking a blissful life. You grant their boons, standing tall in their esteem! You play around in all mountains with relish, Oh Great One!

309.english_pathavurai: "He is the Great One whose hallowed shoulders are adorned by the vetchi garland that gets crumpled as soon as DEvayAnai hugs Him tightly; Her embrace is so full of happiness that Her exhilarated bosom presses His chest deeply; He grew weaker with a melting heart for VaLLi, the beautiful parrot-like damsel who lived in the forest of the KuRavAs and whom He sought, prostrating at Her feet with immense love and exhausting passion; He holds in His hallowed hand the great weapon, the Spear; He is the eternal Lord KumarEsan; He removes the sorrow of His devotees who worship Him with pure devotion; He is my companion, mounting His vehicle, the green peacock" - praising You so on and so forth, offering flowers to You, fulfilling my desire and singing Your glory, I want to stand on a pedestal above the whole series of VEdAs, beyond the stateless state (thuriya - the pure and supreme principle) and the spot where the entire tenets vanish; kindly bless me thus with a gracious glance. He entered the sacrifice ground (Of Dhakshan) where all arrangements were made to perform the sacrificial in the fire-pits in accordance with rituals; He attacked the terrified Lord VishNu, who holds a disc in His hand, and Lord BrahmA, who is seated on the lotus and engaged in the act of creation; the teeth of the Sun were knocked down; the thick wings of IndrA, who took the form of a cuckoo, were severed; the armies that lined up, belonging to the protecting deities in charge of the eight cardinal directions (namely, IndrA, Agni, Yaman, Nruthi, VaruNan, VAyu, KubEran and EesAnan), were all shattered and killed; the exquisitely beautiful goddess (DhakshAyaNi) who steadfastly guarded the dignity of Her consort by Her chastity was relieved of Her anguish (that She and Her consort SivA were deliberately humiliated by Her father, Dhakshan); the disgraced King Dhakshan was finished, being consumed by fire; that Brahmani Saraswathi lost her shine and felt ashamed having suffered mutilation (of her nose); such was His raging anger; He was Lord SivA, who ultimately triumphed on that day; and that SivA worships You in KAnchipuram where You are seated, Oh Great One!

310.english_pathavurai: "You have gorgeous mountainous shoulders that look like golden pillars, decorated with vetchi garland and by a bunch of weapons like Your celebrated and triumphant sword; You have the lotus-like hand that held the reddish and powerful spear which annihilated with rage the demon SUran hiding in the sea, lurking with a treacherous motive, in the disguise of a unique mango tree; Oh KumarA!" - so saying, people worship You, singing poems about Your glory, and immerse themselves in those songs with full understanding of their meaning; Yet, the same people of this earth, out of sheer ignorance, approach (rich) persons, speaking to them in a flattering manner, comparing their hand to the (wish-yielding) kaRpaga tree and declaring that they are unblemished and that they are like the great philanthropist-king KumaNan* who fulfilled the desires of alm-seekers; going through such miseries in their blind pursuit of begging, they steal words and meters from poems (of old texts) and compose songs to match their words; and then they scream in raptures (of self-importance); will such muddled intellect never become clear? As the reign of matchless chastity of SeethA, the beautiful and dear daughter of King Janakan, ruled in the famous kingdom of LankA, the kins of all demons were scorched in fire; as the mighty and angry demon RAvaNan, capable of fierce warfare, was killed with his ten dazzling and crowned heads severed in a bunch by the unique arrow of Lord Rama who removed the miseries of the celestials; that Lord VishNu, along with the Sun, IndrA, the Lord of the celestial land, Sukran, EesAnyan who wears a crescent moon on His hair, the protectors of the (eight) cardinal directions, Sage Agasthiyar, Lord BrahmA, the famous sage Vasishtar, the whole lot of VEdAs, the people of this world, the devotees who have purity of mind and body, the realisors of the eternal bliss who have conquered their mind and actions and Lord SivA as well are all assembled to worship You in Kanchipuram which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

311.english_pathavurai: This body is the receptacle of all sins, made up of bones. This is an edifice built with blood and a closely-knit nervous system. It is an alloy of several conflicting attachments, an admixture of several past deeds that have combined together to imprison this body. In the dark and miserable sea of birth with tall waves lashing out, this body rolls about floating like a tender coconut plucked from somewhere and thrown into a whirl-pool in the mid-sea; it is a vessel full of myths drifting away on the water (of the sea of birth) whose occupants are the four basic tenets, namely, mind, intellect, arrogance and will. If life departs the (treacherous) body, it is rendered into a thatched hut that is burnt away. It is a coffer for the three basic slags, namely, haughtiness, karma and delusion. (Carrying the burden of this body,) roaming around in all the eight directions and faltering at all places, I have been learning the various texts of this world; although I have attained the (virtuous) state of mind that keeps me away from associating with religious zealots who weaken themselves with their shrieking fanaticism, kindly bless me to remain peacefully in a state of blissful tranquility, Oh Lord! She possesses immaculate chastity and is compassionate like the (wish-yielding) KaRpaga tree. She is slender like a creeper and is endowed with three eyes (namely, the sun, the moon and fire). She wears a string of greenish pearls that is worthy of adornment. She has a genital that resembles the hood of the snake. She is Mother, UmA DEvi, and is elated by You, Oh Lord KumarA! Lord SivA grants blissful liberation to those devotees who worship praising Him every day, with utmost concentration, chanting the manthrA of eight sacred letters (Om Aam Aum SivAyanama); You are the great Master of that SivA who prostrates at Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord! Your heart melts for the lotus-like hand of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, that wears the bangles, her waist, the neat deck of her curly hair, her lips that have been adorned with churned coral and her dazzling bosom that wears a tight blouse, Oh Lord! You are seated in Kancheepuram, a shrine that is worshipped by the pure Rigg scripture and the celestials, Oh Great One!

312.english_meanings_list: ["Upon the huge Mount Krouncha He wielded the powerful spear and on that very day, He destroyed the armies of the demons;", "earlier, He knocked with His knuckles the head of BrahmA, seated on the many-petalled lotus, and chained shackles in His hands; He is the Lord who protected the celestials;", "Lord KaRpaga VinAyagar, with a long trunk, whom learned and wise elders circumambulate with love, led Him by holding His hand, and He (Murugan) learnt to walk; He is the father of the Universe;", "He is the protector of VaLLi, the young parrot-like damsel in the millet-field to whom He spoke words of love;", "He always stands fresh by the side of His devotees;", "on His solid shoulders He wears many garlands of fragrant vetchi flowers; - in this vein,", "I would like to go on, learning to speak only about Him (Murugan) and wish to destroy the desire of talking about others;", "will I be able to acquire the matchless gift of implanting, in every song of mine, such sweet meaning that will taste like the sugarcane?", "The eight Cardinal Elephants (that guarded the eight directions), having fiery red eyes,", "wrestled with him and their tusks were broken; the end-pieces of those tusks remained embedded inside his broad matchless chest;", "when he set about resolutely using his might to uproot the golden mount of KailAsh,", "his twenty mountain-like shoulders were crushed;", "he was no match even to a speck of the crushing big toe (of Lord SivA);", "he was the valiant and fierce demon, with ten faces; to that RAvaNan, the Lord handed a gift of a sword; that great Lord SivA,", "and DEvi PArvathi, are together seated (in half-SivA and half-PArvathi form) in Mount ThiruchchengkOdu;", "that mount, along with the southern mount of SwAmimalai and ThiruththaNigai are some of Your favourite abodes; in addition, You are seated in KAnchipuram, Oh Great One!"]
312.english_pathavurai: Upon the huge Mount Krouncha He wielded the powerful spear and on that very day, He destroyed the armies of the demons; earlier, He knocked with His knuckles the head of BrahmA, seated on the many-petalled lotus, and chained shackles in His hands; He is the Lord who protected the celestials; Lord KaRpaga VinAyagar, with a long trunk, whom learned and wise elders circumambulate with love, led Him by holding His hand, and He (Murugan) learnt to walk; He is the father of the Universe; He is the protector of VaLLi, the young parrot-like damsel in the millet-field to whom He spoke words of love; He always stands fresh by the side of His devotees; on His solid shoulders He wears many garlands of fragrant vetchi flowers; - in this vein, I would like to go on, learning to speak only about Him (Murugan) and wish to destroy the desire of talking about others; will I be able to acquire the matchless gift of implanting, in every song of mine, such sweet meaning that will taste like the sugarcane? The eight Cardinal Elephants (that guarded the eight directions), having fiery red eyes, wrestled with him and their tusks were broken; the end-pieces of those tusks remained embedded inside his broad matchless chest; when he set about resolutely using his might to uproot the golden mount of KailAsh, his twenty mountain-like shoulders were crushed; he was no match even to a speck of the crushing big toe (of Lord SivA); he was the valiant and fierce demon, with ten faces; to that RAvaNan, the Lord handed a gift of a sword; that great Lord SivA, and DEvi PArvathi, are together seated (in half-SivA and half-PArvathi form) in Mount ThiruchchengkOdu; that mount, along with the southern mount of SwAmimalai and ThiruththaNigai are some of Your favourite abodes; in addition, You are seated in KAnchipuram, Oh Great One!

You liberate Your devotees granting them eternal bliss, Oh Great One!

316.english_pathavurai: ThiruththaNigai, the mountain with a pond in which the reddish dense kazhuneer flower blossoms every day; other similar abodes that are chosen by You; Your unique, bright and sparkling spear which learnt to chop off hills like Mount Krouncha; and the bunch of Your twelve strong shoulders - all these clearly form a vision in my mind! I must seek the true knowledge which teaches that this delusory world is like a mere bubble in the water; that You are the God who preached to Lord SivA the significance of detachment; that You destroy Your devotees' fear and shower love on them graciously; and that You stand majestically in this beautiful place Kachchi (kAnjeepuram). My love should pour from a serene heart, after I learn the ways of worshipping; all other activities of my mind should cease; at that stage, whatever is within my mind's reach should be attainable; and when will You grant me that kind of maturity? He was of a short stature (VAmanan) but He was taller than all those people of fame; The little boy (PrahlAdhan) stated, in his childish babble, only the truth to the utter dismay of his teacher Sukran who became very scared; all the words from his child were refuted by HiraNyan; He (Vishnu) pierced all the limbs of HiraNyan's body and plucked out his reddish intestines, with the hair around His face reaching all the eight directions; He came with a lion's face and a human body (Narasimhan); He destroyed the demon Muran and therefore was known as MurAri; AdhisEshan, the serpent with sparkling hoods, serves as His bed on which He slumbers; He holds a wheel (Sudharsanam) in His hand; He has the complexion of the pure rainy cloud; He is the father of the entire world; He holds in His other hand the sacred conch-shell (PAnchajanyam); He is the famously known dancer (who danced on the hood of the giant-snake, KALingan). He came as a young damsel (Mohini) in a traditional old-fashioned style; and He is famously known for His hue of blue cloud. To such Vishnu, You granted heavenly bliss (at KAnchipuram*), Oh Great One!

317.english_pathavurai: VishNu and BrahmA opened their flower-like mouth and stated their grievance; all those celestials who had assembled there prostrated at Your feet; piercing the bodies of the demons, Your spear stabbed and chopped them down; at that time, millions of devils stood there clapping with their hands to the meter of "thAm thiththi"; they also tuned up many musical instruments giggling jeeringly among themselves; they joined in chorus with DurgA DEvi singing the Raga Gurjari in the most astonishing way; they opened their reddish eyes wide and sparks of fire were emitted like the vadavA muka agni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole on the doom's day); they danced the spiral dance (called pavuri) causing tremor in the eight directions; they landed en masse on the battlefield, all of them dancing together, and began to beat up the demons; they meditated upon Your hallowed lotus-hands which held the powerful spear capable of conquering any weapon; they worshipped You praising Your name in many ways as SaravaNan and the handsome Lord of KAnchipuram! In order that I too could acquire that kind of devotion, will I be fortunate to serve You, Oh Lord? On Her large mountain-like bosom She wears tight blouse and applies cold paste of vermilion; Her slender waist is like the vanji (rattan reed) creeper; Her divine and vibrant voice never differentiates between many musical patterns, subdivided into shadjam, rishabam etc., (kaikkiLai, thuththam in Tamil Music*) nor does it show any preference to one kind of music; Her mastery in permutating the musical notes; Her display of moving fine arts that is described in texts on the art of sculpture; Her petite and thin belly that has graciously delivered every planet in this universe; She has dark hair looking like dense black cloud; vermilion mark on Her forehead; reddish golden hair-band and pearl necklace adorning Her lovely neck; Divine compassion; and pure green complexion; for all the devotees who meditate on Her, She offers liberation; and She is Mother Gowri (PArvathi), and You are Her son! You are the Lord of all, Oh Great One!

318.english_pathavurai: The mountain at ThiruchchengkOde (known as NAgamalai) where mango trees with plenty of fruits abound, Pazhani hills, SwAmimalai in the south, KadhirgAmam, the famous place ThiruchchendhUr and the great weapon, Spear, are not mentioned by me even in my dreams; for the pleasure of this troublesome body, I go about acquiring everything by hook or crook, constantly contemplating all devious means, and roam about in my imagination. "He is the precious ruby adorning the finger of Mother PArvathi, the consort of impeccable Lord SivA; He is the new pearl delivered by old Mother Ganga; He is the safe deposit earned by those great people who never save anything in the world but spend it all every day for the sake of the Lord" - so I should have praised You with melting heart and worshipped at all times, but I did not. Even then, You have condoned my shortcomings; showing great forbearance, You have placed me as one among Your devotees. How can I describe Your compassion, and is there anything that can match Your mercy? They have reached a state of non-duality (where I am not different from You) with all attachments severed, and they have clear mind; they are the visionaries who have precisely understood the impeccable Mother, with garlands adorning Her, having established Her abode in beautiful KAnchipuram, decorated by jasmine flowers in Her hair; She is Mother ParA Sakthi (Supreme Power); She is righteousness personified; She is like the tender creeper of a deep green complexion; The words of this creeper-like Mother are sweeter than sugar candy and nectar; She is the Pearl that created the entire universe; She is the Mount MEru made of solid gold; Her two bosoms are like mounts having the beauty of matchless pearl necklaces; their sheer weight has made Her waist slender; She is the youthful damsel, UmAdEvi. On the banks of River Kambai, whose waves lash out delivering conch shells in plenty, She did Her penance; with two measures of paddy, She carried out thirty-two religious duties*; She is the Great Goddess KamAkshi; to Her consort, Lord SivA, You preached the Eternal Truth of PraNava ManthrA, Oh Great One!

319.english_pathavurai: This body, made up of measured quantities of flesh and skin, loses its firmness; the hair turns white like the crane; the fine head and the robust body weaken; the bone structure crumbles; all the five sensory organs undergo changes in their activities; I have become weak turning into a totally crazy old man leaning on my walking stick, staggering haphazardly with no sense of direction; the neat rows of my teeth have fallen off; while my neighbours are pooh-poohing me, I am also ridiculed by my children; the womenfolk in my house spit at me in contempt; all others mock at me dirisively; I have had enough of this life on this earth; when will You bless me to attain and hold on to Your hallowed lotus feet, wearing the vetchi flowers and adorned by precious rubies and gems? He mounted a great chariot whose wheels were the Sun and the Moon to which were attached tightly harnessed and well decorated horses (namely, the four VEdAs); those horses, seeking true knowledge, leapt and sped in the eight directions; He is the great leader who wielded a single arrow (namely, Lord VishNu) and burnt down the celebrated Thiripuram; His victory was proclaimed everywhere; that Lord SivA worships You, Oh Lord with the bright spear, seated in Kancheepuram! Lord Brahma was stunned and standing perplexed; the mighty mountain Krouncha was pierced by the spear and destroyed; You marched ahead across the seas with clear waves and over all the fortress walls and fought with the enemies conquering them and crushing the heads of the demons; the wide eyes of the demons froze in shock when You thrust the spear into their hearts; You severed their arms so powerfully that the blood-stained swords in their hands were smashed to pieces and scattered all over, falling far away in the battlefield, Oh Great One!

320.english_pathavurai: My mind is stained with several blemishes like uncontrollable anger; I have never done any penance; I utter unadulterated lies at all times; I have no other refuge; I am like the dirt in the garbage swirling around in the wind; I have no patience; even though I comprehend all the nuances of the diverse truths, I draw a blank and become useless when it comes to attaching myself to that totally detached substance (namely God); I am a wicked person; I do not have an iota of aesthetic sense to learn about Your boundless glory; My intellect is far too shallow; I am debased; and I am not destined to attain salvation. Your mountain-like shoulders adorned with garlands of vetchi flowers, Your dazzling spear, Your seats in KadhirgAmam, Vattamalai*, other abodes and beautiful KAnchipuram must fill up my mind, in their entirety, even in my dreams, so that by comtemplating them, I shall be able to attain You. The seven roaring oceans surrounding the earth cried out, boiled and dried up; the wicked demon SUran, who ruled the great city (of Veeramahendrapuri), was annihilated with his entire clan; the unique mount ChakravALam was displaced from its original position; the miseries of the celestials were removed; the group of renowned mountains in all the eight directions trembled; IndrA, holding the weapon vajrAyutham in His holy hand, was able to resettle in His home at AmarApuri; BrahmA, the four-faced God who is an expert in Rig VedA and who has created the earth and the sky, fled after being punished (by knocks on His heads); the enemies of Your devotees who always worship You ran away; and the pretty anklet, thaNdai, and the bunches of golden sathangai (a unique anklet with intricate designs) make lilting sounds in a synchronised meter, adorning Your lotus feet, where You are tying the victory anklets, Oh Great One!

321.english_pathavurai: This is a large cottage wherefrom water and faeces are excreted, in which all past deeds settle in a collaborative effort; this is formed out of love between a father and a mother whose blissful union manifested through beautiful limbs brought together; this body has been lying like a rag cloth on a mat of lies, awaiting extinction; before my mind faces the quandary of the life in this body being uniquely pulled out and driven away by the God of Death (Yaman), It is multicoloured; the other day, (in the battlefield) the great battleground twisted and turned under its feet; it is strong and has feathers with a pattern of wide eyes; You mounted that Peacock* and drove it to win the war, Oh Lord with the Spear! I wish to praise, with full knowledge of, and love towards, Your hallowed, fragrant and reddish feet with the choicest words of purity without any blemish; will You not come happily to grant me that boon, even to a little extent? On that day, when Lord SivA took the Mount MEru as a bow and burnt down Thiripuram and its demons who after forsaking worship of SivA, were thoroughly demoralised, She held that bow in Her strong hand; She is the beautiful Goddess wearing a fitting blouse on Her bosom; She is compassion personified; She has fully learnt the entire works of art contained in the texts of knowledge prevalent in all directions; on the banks of KambA river where fresh flowers had blossomed, (while She was worshipping Lord SivA), She was scared (by the flash-flood in the river) and hugged the left side of Lord EgAmbara NAthar (SivA) so strongly that His reddish body turned black; to the devotees worshipping Her lotus feet with love and devoted heart, She kindly grants blissful status; She is Mother Gowri; You are seated in Her KumarakkOttam (of Kanchipuram), Oh Lord; You are the Lord of IndrA, Oh Great One!

322.english_pathavurai: Your Peacock that is praised by many poets who are of the highest calibre; Your Spear that shattered Mount Krouncha; Your shoulders that are adorned with the garland of vetchai flowers; Your two consorts, namely DEvayAnai and VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs; and Your reddish lotus feet adorned with golden chains, anklets with pearls, and kiNkiNi (another lilting anklet) - with these as subjects, he is capable of composing great songs; he is indeed a great poet like the dark clouds (in showering poems); he is a leader who has attained true knowledge; and he is a paragon of virtues giving charity to worthy causes - with these words, the world should praise me. May I not be granted a birth in which I can attain Your golden feet? Oh Lord, You are the Great One worshipped by all the Heads of the Celestials!

323.english_pathavurai: I wish to get away from imbibing the pleasurable lips and to get over the dizziness that occurs due to the treacherous and miserable thoughts that I have been nurturing; having obtained this vessel of a body comprising bones, sensory organs, the filth of faeces, muscles and skin, I do not wish to be chasing sinful activities arising from attachment; I do not wish to be involved with those researchers of philology, who delve into the inner meaning of even any kind of sound, explaining to them the true meaning of those (gutteral) sounds nor do I wish to be exhausted from (such dictional) research; (aviding all of the above,) will I not be able to praise the glory of, and prostrate at, Your hallowed feet adorned with bunches of reddish flowers, bedecked with garlands of blue lily and vetchi flower and wearing the kadappa flower? He became enraged and stood in the disguise of a devious mango tree; You destroyed that demon SUran and took charge of him (by adopting the two portions of his split-body, one, the peacock, as Your vehicle and the other, the rooster, on Your staff); and the golden Krouncha, the mountain of the dynasty of the demons, along with its treachery, was annihilated by Your piercing spear, Oh Lord! The stem of Your valorous staff of Rooster is made of bamboo, belonging to the sugar-cane species, whose softness can be compared to the beautiful shoulders, adorned by pearl ornaments, of VaLLi, the parrot-like damsel of the KuRavAs, and DEvayAnai, who stands firm in the righteous path! AirAvadham, the fierce and spotlessly white majestic elephant, belongs to IndrA; the prestigious sovereignty of His celestial land, with (the wish-yielding) kaRpaga trees, was restored to him by Your graciousness, Oh Lord! He wears on His thick matted hair the kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower and the serpent; on the left side of that Lord SivA, DEvi PArvathi, the creeper-like Goddess, is concorporate; She is the ocean of chastity and is seated in KAnchipuram, which is also Your abode, Oh Handsome and Great One!

324.english_pathavurai: The harlots who loudly scream bargaining "Give me some; shall give you some" have the objects of their desires presented to them on a golden plate; this body is subject to that peril! When life goes off this body in a whiff, it is placed in between logs that burn it down; before that event, before another birth, and before a reentry into this world and eventual destruction, (...* continues later) In the millet-field there is VaLLi, a parrot-like damsel of the KuRavAs, who babbles sweetly; her bosoms are hugged graciously with Your broad chest, adorned with the garland of vetchai flowers! (...* continuation from before) I would like to avoid haughty, short-tempered and immoral miscreants and flee from their company in order to praise the glory of Your holy feet. Kindly bless me with that quality! The demon, TharakAsuran, had a huge trunk like the palm tree and was biding his time to attack like the scheming crane; he was stopped by Your piercing Spear which knocked him dead; the thousand-hooded serpent, Adhiseshan, was terrified and the seas trembled when You fought with Your Spear. Absence of greed, miserliness, nervousness and delusion is assured for Your devotees on whom You bestow all these boons; and You are their great treasure! To win a fruit (from Lord SivA), You flew around the world spread out in all directions, enthusiastically mounting the green and famous peacock! In this Kaliyuga, there is no God that matches You in tirelessly granting Liberation to Your devotees. This place, Kachchi (kAnjeepuram), where lovely Mother Kamakshi is present and where the sound of PraNava (OM) is echoing everywhere like the waves of the sea, is also Your abode, Oh Handsome and Great One!

325.english_meanings_list: ["The flesh and adjoining blood are mingled and spread evenly throughout the body;", "around the frame of bones, the wall of skin is structured;", "a new vessel is thus created, and in that newly decorated house, one enters (in other words, life is born in the form of a human body);", "one willingly enters the prison of desire where the principle is \"I want something; You too may have something\"; after attaining this birth,", "one is subject to the states of sleep and dream, rambling in a daze and feeling miserable; I do not wish to go through such gyration;", "instead, I wish to roam about singing the glory of Your eternal valour with words depicting Your beauty in order to attain salvation by holding on to Your hallowed lotus feet.", "Like He gave place in His matted hair to the famous and reddish crescent-moon, He let the creeper-like DEvi PArvathi, with a green complexion and well-braided hair, remain concorporate on the left side of His body, which is the source of all desires; He is Lord SivA;", "to River Gangai, gushing from His matted hair, and to the group of SivagaNAs (devils) who have a large trunk and a huge pot-belly like VinAyagA, You are very well known, Oh Lord!", "You hold a tall staff of Rooster, Oh Lord!", "To feed the hungry, red-eyed, bunch of dwarf-devils who have become exhausted after beating the drums, You dole out evenly the pierced body-parts of the demons, Oh Lord with the spear!", "He slumbers on the bed, AdhisEshan, a serpent with rows of hoods and densely formed spots on his body; He is Lord VishNu, who incarnated as a tortoise and later came willingly to this place Kachchi (KAncheepuram)* which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
325.english_pathavurai: The flesh and adjoining blood are mingled and spread evenly throughout the body; around the frame of bones, the wall of skin is structured; a new vessel is thus created, and in that newly decorated house, one enters (in other words, life is born in the form of a human body); one willingly enters the prison of desire where the principle is "I want something; You too may have something"; after attaining this birth, one is subject to the states of sleep and dream, rambling in a daze and feeling miserable; I do not wish to go through such gyration; instead, I wish to roam about singing the glory of Your eternal valour with words depicting Your beauty in order to attain salvation by holding on to Your hallowed lotus feet. Like He gave place in His matted hair to the famous and reddish crescent-moon, He let the creeper-like DEvi PArvathi, with a green complexion and well-braided hair, remain concorporate on the left side of His body, which is the source of all desires; He is Lord SivA; to River Gangai, gushing from His matted hair, and to the group of SivagaNAs (devils) who have a large trunk and a huge pot-belly like VinAyagA, You are very well known, Oh Lord! You hold a tall staff of Rooster, Oh Lord! To feed the hungry, red-eyed, bunch of dwarf-devils who have become exhausted after beating the drums, You dole out evenly the pierced body-parts of the demons, Oh Lord with the spear! He slumbers on the bed, AdhisEshan, a serpent with rows of hoods and densely formed spots on his body; He is Lord VishNu, who incarnated as a tortoise and later came willingly to this place Kachchi (KAncheepuram)* which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

326.english_pathavurai: Deeply contemplating the act of grabbing the pot-like bosom, one happily muses on such thought; these whores have fish-like eyes and a pair of perfect bosom; enchanted by their amorous art and loudly babbling the erotic texts, one becomes tired and gets victimised by their highly imaginative speeches and hides behind clandestine curtains; when he ultimately dies, (to burn his body in the cremation ground) it is laid up among logs of wood and is ignited with a powerful flame; then the relatives depart from the cremation ground with no attachment whatsoever; before such a thing happens to me, will I be able to set my heart with devotion and hold on, for my liberation, to Your hallowed feet adorned with vetchai flowers? Will I ever be fortunate to roam about praising Your triumphant glory in the choicest words of Tamil language? He thrashed the celestials and threw them into prison; he surrounded their beautiful heavenly land; and he left after condemning the DEvAs to suffer the torture in the prison; You battered that demon SUran with anger and knocked him down; You also destroyed the seven hills (that stood guard for him) by smashing them to pieces; You devastated him and wreaked havoc on the sea with circular waves by shrinking it; after ranting and raving on the ground with an intent to kill, the demon SUran hid (in the sea) in the disguise of a mango tree, bearing the weight of his anger and shame in his heart; You fought with him and wielded Your spear to destroy him, Oh Lord! In order to unite with VaLLi, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs, in the millet field, you praised her with enticing words and then married her! You are seated in the town of KAnchipuram, Oh Handsome and Great One!

327.english_pathavurai: Entering a mother's womb as an embryo, growing bigger, arriving on the earth at the appropriate time (after ten months), developing into various shapes (according to the age and the stage), entrenching in mind the only thought of earning wealth, squandering away life like this, counting the remaining days of the life-span, and getting agitated as the end seems near, I shall then witness the separation of life from my body by Yaman (God of Death) who will come rushing to me angrily, throwing the rope (of attachment around my neck); once they realise that the life has departed, the grieving relatives around me will accompany the dead body (to the cremation ground), cremate it, return home and send for everyone related to me, who will wail to the point of exhaustion; to eradicate my desire for such a birth, kindly bless me with Your hallowed feet wearing the fragrant garland of vetchi flowers! You are the beloved consort of VaLLi, the parrot-like damsel of the kuRavAs, with her mountain-like bosom covered by camphorous paste and blouse, who lived in a fertile millet-field and whose speech was full of sweet - nothing! He burnt down Thirisiram but gave exalted position in SivA's land to three* of His devotees who remained detached from Thiripuram; He is the eccentric Lord SivA to whom You graciously preached the significance of PraNava ManthrA as His Master! In the battlefield, You stabbed the vile, arrogant and dog-like demons, smashed their bodies angrily and destroyed them, Oh valorous One! In this place, the Tamil language is flawlessly chanted in its purest form in all its three branches (literature, music and drama); this is the famous and beautiful town called Kachchi (kAnjeepuram) which is Your abode, Oh Handsome and Great One!

336.english_pathavurai: Comparing their eyes to the spear, the arrow, the fish, the sea being the source of water, the wonderful blue lily and the poison, and likening the bosom on their chest to the huge mountain and the bunch of their hair to the dark cloud, I have been lying and compiling several words of exaggeration; (in that process) my heart has melted losing its strength and composure; I have become unsteady; I have lost my sleep and forsaken all my duties; I am filled with sorrow and feeling very fragile; I do not wish to weaken any further roaming after bangled women; will I be able to offer kurA flowers and prostrate at the reddish and hallowed feet of Yours, the feet that belong to One who interpreted the inner meaning of the VEdAs? will I not be able to hold firmly and surrender at those feet covered by vetchi flowers offered in worship by Your dear devotees? She is DEvayAnai having the stormy cloud* as her vehicle; the other one is VaLLi whose speech is like that of cuckoo and whose complexion is like that of a parrot; She is the pearl of the millet-field (which she guarded) where parrots swarm in and eat the millet, tweaking with their beaks; both those consorts hug Your handsome shoulders, Oh valorous One! When the chariot of the sun, revolving along with its horses, gets into darkness gripping the world that staggers and loses its strength, this pretty Rooster crows aloud to dispel that darkness; You hold that Rooster on Your triumphant staff, Oh Lord! When the fulcrum that held the earth became scaringly imbalanced, the great Sidhdha Sage, Agasththiyar**, restored the earth's horizontal position by raising the dangerously low level of the northern direction at Mount HimAlayAs; he meditated and worshipped in Your abode, KAnchipuram! The mango tree (in which the demon SUran had disguised himself) lost its strength and began trembling and SUran shed his prestige and started to shake in fear when You held the powerful spear in Your hand and fought the war, Oh Handsome and Great One!

(Therefore, Oh MurugA,) You must kindly give her Your garland of vetchi flowers, intertwined with nice and fresh flowers of jasmine! You have Your abode in the City of KAnchipuram which place is blessed by UmAdEvi, of an emerald-green complexion, and where She worshipped (Lord SivA) with love! For the sake of devotees who worship You with love, You fight with and destroy their harmful enemies, Oh Lord with the bright spear! She is beautiful and full of love for You; she is VaLLi, the prattling damsel of the KuRavas; and she hugs You with admiration, Oh Lord with a hallowed chest! You fight so fiercely that the seven famous mountains of the demons along with Mount Krouncha (totalling eight) are shattered to pieces and the demons are completely sheared away, Oh Great One!

338.english_pathavurai: (The first of the five flowery arrows of Manmathan - God of Love being) the lotus, the unique (middle arrow being the) asOka flower, (the fifth one being) the blue lily and the two in-between ones being the mango flower and jasmine, all of them constitute the flowery arrows* of provocation; indulging in the resultant uprising, I become exhausted and recline on the bed; to quench my passionate thirst, I am attacked by the plumpy and bloused bosom, loooking like tender coconuts, which I hug; my life is being snatched by the dark, painted and lush eyes of this girl; to get rid of the ever-increasing deluge of passion for, and pleasure-seeking from, this girl, kindly grant me Your blissful and lotus feet that are the end of the VEdAs, offering the supreme delight and are the final destination of liberation, Oh Lord! He is constituted by the letters a, ma, kara, (joining as OmkAra) representing the PraNava ManthrA; He wears the sky as His loin-cloth; He could be referred to even in the neutral gender, praising Him as "It"; He sits alone under a unique mango tree; He is matchless; when Lord Brahma took the form of a swan and flew all over the blue sky seeking His head, He was unable to sight it; He is the remover of all sins; He has a scar on His chest made by the sharp nipple of the hallowed bosom of Goddess PArvathi; seeking that Lord SivA through a penance performed in Kanchipuram, UmAdEvi ultimately united with Him; it is that holy place where She carried out the thirty-two religious duties**, and You chose it as Your abode, Oh Lord! You are unblemished! Oh Son of the River Gangai, You hugged the mountain-like bosom of VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters! In order that the DEvAs could flourish in the fragrant celestial world, You set fire to the wide sea, annihilating the demons, and removed the effects of all evil deeds, by wielding Your Spear, Oh Great One!

343.english_pathavurai: Down, down with the three slags (namely, arrogance, karma and delusion) which are the three evil mountains, Thiripuram; these are like wild forests that must be burnt down to ashes; sleepiness and the five shrouds* that cover the soul will have to be annihilated; the soul must be liberated, attaining eternal bliss; it should experience rapturous enlightenment; it should create a wonderful vision of climbing up to the land of the sun and dancing in ecstasy; For all that, I have to follow the righteous path and realise Your grace, steadily remaining in tranquility. Not knowing how to accomplish that I am being hounded by attachments which seem to go away for some time but return to me with a vengence. I have had it, and enough is enough. I do not want to be subjected to this misery. Henceforth, please do not thrust me into this disgusting track and kindly take charge of me; please be compassionate and bless me with Your vision that is the only salvation for me in this world; and grant me an eternal jewel to wear that is nothing but Your hallowed lotus feet! He was an ignorant, wicked and evil one; he was full of blemishes; that SUran was destroyed by You; and the celestials and ascetic sages in all the eight directions of the seven worlds were relieved of their miseries by Your grace! He (Lord SivA) holds in His hands the eminent fire, a trident, a deer and a pick-axe; His feet are red like coral; on the side of His body, the celebrated Goddess PArvathi DEvi is seated elegantly; and She delivered You, oh handsome Master! KAsi (Varanasi), Madhurai (famous for the three branches of Tamil), the seven hills (ThiruvEnkatam), ThirukkOvalUr, ThiruvAnaikkA, VedAraNyam (the forest of the four vEdAs), Kanagamalai, SeegAzhi, ThiruvArUr, beautiful Chidhambaram, KALahasthi and ThirisirApalli are a few abodes of Yours, besides several places throughout the country, where You are worshipped all the three times of the day. You are seated with relish at the holy place, KAmakOttam in Kacchi (kAnjeepuram), Oh Handsome and Great One!

344.english_pathavurai: Kethu, the serpent, devoured it with a penchant and spattered the moon (during eclipse) to make it another poisonous cobra, and that moon, full of blemishes, is spluttering all that venom upon me. The din of noise made by the seashells and the thunderous sound from the clouds are drowned by the uproarious waves in the sea. Lacking any devotion or clarity of thought, I have come to You with nothing but desire; and in order not to depress and weaken me, this little girl, coming to You with so many thoughts nurtured in the heart and making all attempts to worship, You should bless me right now granting refuge. You mount the green Peacock and woo the green belle, VaLLi. Your favourite resting place is the green and fertile hillside. Your devotees, who remain steadfast in their devoutness, offer You green leaves and flowers, adorning Your hallowed feet! The ascetics, who have shunned the seductive women wearing fancy blouses covering their bosoms, seek to worship You at Kachchi (kAnjeepuram) where You are seated, holding the bright spear! The Celestials, who live in the land of wish-yielding trees and who uphold justice and righteousness in their hearts, were freed from their imprisonment by You, Oh Great One!

345.english_pathavurai: Deceitful behaviour was already well entrenched in their stupid mind; and every other second, they spoke words of insincerity. To such vain harlots, I gave my body and many a valuable thing, just to please them; my life became very miserable; indigence burnt me like the big fire of vadavai*; and I was tormented by extreme distress. To end that anguish, to get me out of that singular hell, and to do away with deeds (both good and bad), kindly bless me with Your hallowed feet! Oh KumarA, You unite with VaLLi, with a waist slim like a creeper, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs! You reside in Kachchi (kAnjeepuram). Plenty of flowers like kurA, vetchi, white lotus and fresh blue lilies adorn Your broad chest! Holding the Mount MEru as the large bow, He burnt down Thiripuram (by His mere smile), turning it into powder; and You are the master of that SivA! The seas with unevenly rising waves, the strong demons and their armies were all churned and shaken by You in the war, Oh Great One!

347.english_pathavurai: It cannot be explained to other people; It cannot be attained by any amount of education; It is incomparable with anything else; It cannot be measured by the mind nor conceptualised. It cannot be confined within any series of research or logic; He who adorns His tresses with the Umaththai flower, the golden flower of kondRai (Indian laburnum), the river GangA and the crescent moon; He who has three eyes and is known as handsome SivA asked You to interpret It; and It constituted the inner meaning of Your explanation! It is the cause of blissful liberation! It is inaccessible to stupid fools. The four scriptures are trying hard to attain It, but It is still elusive. It is far earlier than the earliest substance; kindly preach It to me! Your maternal uncle, Vishnu, with reddish eyes and the wheel in hand, is full of praise for Your deeds. You made the grass and flowers grow abundantly; In every direction, You created, right from the golden mount of Meru, all shapes and forms. The devils and the ghosts danced, clapping their hands; the vast ocean evaporated; the fierce demon, SUran, was hurt in his chest, with blood gushing; when You wielded the spear from Your lotus-like hand, Oh mighty one with mountain-like shoulders, soaked in thick paste of sandalwood and camphor! She is the heavy bosomed one, filled with the milk of Grace, and She once delivered the seven worlds simultaneously, by the sheer power of Her chastity; and She, Mother Kamakshi, performed so many mystical deeds at this place, KAnchipuram, in the heart of which is KachchApeswaram, where you reside, Oh Great One!

I want to get away from the crowd of such rude artists. My mind should become totally detached. Those who experience You by Your grace after conquering their egoism; those who melt in their devotion and prostrate at Your lovely lotus feet; it is in their company, from now on, I should kindly be placed; will You not show me even the slightest consideration for that? With Your spear, possessing extraordinary strength and sparkling like lightning, the matchless Mount Krouncha was crushed into powder; and the demon, SUran, who took the disguise of a mango tree, was conquered by You, Oh Lord! You have twelve strong shoulders! Your hallowed chest is adorned with the garland of vetchi flowers! In order to embrace the shoulders of EgAmbarEswar (SivA), adorned with serpents, She, the Divine Mother (KAmakshi) of great chastity, performed penance on the banks of the River Kampai* in this place, Kachchi (kAnjeepuram), where You reside enchantingly, Oh Great One!

I went on heaping plaudits on them to make money. After collecting some amount, I started wandering in the streets in search of harlots on whom to shower all that money. I wasted my life. You appeared in the disguise of an old man among the tribe of hunters (at VaLLimalai); there, You met the deer-like damsel, VaLLi, who was busy guarding the millet-field and driving away the birds; and You enticed her completely, revealed to her Your Divine form and eventually married her. 355.english_pathavurai: Under the delusion that this mortal body is going to last for ever, people hold their noses and practise controlling their breath! In vain, do they eat only leaves and herbs? In that process, they suffer and wear themselves out easily. I do not want to be like those pseudo-yogis. I want to destroy all the effects and sufferings arising from my three slags (namely arrogance, desire and karma) and delusion; I want to be full of knowledge, discipline and flair; I want to realise that I am a separate entity, from my body and that the rest of the universe is separate too; I want to attain that state which is beyond the comprehension of my mind, and which causes the incidents to happen. Kindly bless me to become the great Yogi of SivA's manifestation! He blows sweet music into His flute; He is the son of Nandagopan; and He has a thousand names. You are the dearest nephew of that Gopalan (Vishnu)! You are the captain who protected the great ship called DEvA's land! You are the protector of the entire world! You wear the garland made of fresh kadappa flowers! You hold the Spear valorously, and belong to VayalUr! River KAveri flows in the ChOzha kingdom benefitting mankind and every living being; and that river's forceful flow brings water and waves to the banks of ThiruvAnaikkA, surrounded by fragrant flower gardens! All the rulers of the world praise and worship You, Oh Lord! You are the Lord of DEvAs, Oh Great One!

358.english_meanings_list: ["\"In the field of the famous grammatical text called kArikai, I am considered the foremost expert;", "to sing in praise of you a song of the type 'madal kOvai' (one of the ninety-six kinds of mini-literature),", "without wasting time, I shall look for a special scriber with a handle carved of ivory;", "I have not seen anyone in the world matching your greatness;", "you are the refuge for all stalwart-poets who have the great skill of composing songs;", "go ahead and bring a knotted bundle of golden coins; bring a lot of fine jewellery, precious gems and nice clothes\" -", "so saying, should I be ensnared in the misery of praising others, suffering humiliation?", "There were many ChamaNas who did not wrap any clothes around their waist (but wore grassy reeds); they were in Madhurai where the language, Tamil, prospered; You went there (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar);", "(to defeat the ChamaNas in debates) You placed palm-leaves (on which holy poems were scribed) in fire and water and earned fame as the Treasure of Justice!", "You are seated in the eastern side of the paddy fields where the sEl fish swim in water in abundance, Oh reddish Lord!", "There was a spider, in deep contemplation on Lord SivA, living in a forest on the bank of the wavy river KAvEri; it had spun a web", "which served as a grand canopy (in the town of ThiruvAnaikkA) under which He is seated graciously;", "sitting in the form of an effulgence under the beautiful web woven by the spider is Lord SivA, and You are His Master, Oh Great One!"]
358.english_pathavurai: "In the field of the famous grammatical text called kArikai, I am considered the foremost expert; to sing in praise of you a song of the type 'madal kOvai' (one of the ninety-six kinds of mini-literature), without wasting time, I shall look for a special scriber with a handle carved of ivory; I have not seen anyone in the world matching your greatness; you are the refuge for all stalwart-poets who have the great skill of composing songs; go ahead and bring a knotted bundle of golden coins; bring a lot of fine jewellery, precious gems and nice clothes" - so saying, should I be ensnared in the misery of praising others, suffering humiliation? There were many ChamaNas who did not wrap any clothes around their waist (but wore grassy reeds); they were in Madhurai where the language, Tamil, prospered; You went there (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar); (to defeat the ChamaNas in debates) You placed palm-leaves (on which holy poems were scribed) in fire and water and earned fame as the Treasure of Justice! You are seated in the eastern side of the paddy fields where the sEl fish swim in water in abundance, Oh reddish Lord! There was a spider, in deep contemplation on Lord SivA, living in a forest on the bank of the wavy river KAvEri; it had spun a web which served as a grand canopy (in the town of ThiruvAnaikkA) under which He is seated graciously; sitting in the form of an effulgence under the beautiful web woven by the spider is Lord SivA, and You are His Master, Oh Great One!

359.english_pathavurai: It is the matchless one proclaimed by the VEdAs that loudly chant the ManthrA "OM". It transcends the milky way and shines in the cosmos as the pre-eminent light. Those who have mastered the three methods of worship*, namely sariyai, kiriyai and yOgam, cannot even describe as It surpasses all those disciplines. Within the confines of perception, through both formless and idol worship, It blends fully with the universe, the body and the soul. It is perceived only by those saints blessed with the Supreme Knowledge of SivA. It stands alone as the primal fullness and one without any deficiency. It does not have any caste or creed whatsoever. Furthermore, It is the cosmic knowledge mentioned by beloved devotees, that is felt by experienced souls in tranquility, leading to the true joy of liberation, submerging in the sea of bliss. (All these describe the greatness of Your lotus feet, Oh Lord!) When will I conquer the lusts, desires and vacillations caused by my sensory organs and have the honour of attaining Your feet? "Oh Youthful Kumara! GuhA! Kandha! Your Spear split the Mount Krouncha! Oh Rider of the Peacock!" So prayed IndrA, the leader of the Celestials, whose sufferings were eradicated by You. Fragrant sandal paste, auspicious and pure turmeric layer, and valiant ornamental shields adorn Your shoulders, Oh majestic lion! You wear the garland of victory at the battlefield, Oh great warrior! You belong to the famous place, VayalUr! She is the pristine one in the Universe; She is Mount Himavan's daughter, bright as a stroke of lightning; She is blue-hued and is also of a golden complexion; She is the Primal woman; She is verily of the Kundalini Power; She is like the ever-tasty fruit; She is our gracious Mother; She has delivered the three worlds; She is in the form of music; She is omniscient; Her belly is like the banyan leaf; She is as sweet as fresh sugarcane; She is the consort of Lord JambunAthan, who sits under a white jambu tree (naval) in ThiruvAnaikkA; She is slim as a vanji (rattan reed) creeper; and She is UmAdEvi who brought forth You to this world, Oh Great One!
