361.english_meanings_list: ["Although they look like the black lily and the arrows, they subtly differ from them;", "their hue is like dark blue poison, AlakAlam;", "they are capable of dispensing simultaneously bliss that could kill and a delusion of passion;", "and they swing moving back and forth attacking the ears with the two ear-studs as if to sever them; possessing such eyes,", "are the enchanting whores to touch whose bodies I have unabated desire; I also have anger, miserliness and arrogance; to redeem such a sinner like me,", "kindly show me the path of wisdom, that can be revealed by people who are interested in my long life and strong source of oxygen and who could offer me ways and means of practical activities that leads to enlightenment;", "from now on, kindly love me so that I keep that path as my goal and I become interested in meditation and penance;", "can You not think of taking charge of me unto Your hallowed feet adorned at the lilting anklets?", "The rooster crowed aloud saying \"Hail to You\" while the peacock danced excitedly soaring high like the rising poison, AlakAlam;", "the armies of devils who serve Lord SivA gathered in the sky playing;", "and the efforts of the frightening and valorous demon, SUran, were wasted and destroyed;", "when AdhivarAgan* who came to the war screaming and charging with rage, was overpowered by Your sharp spear, Oh Lord!", "The sEl fish in the pond of this town, West VayalUr, surrounded by groves of sugarcanes, jump about soaring so high as to strike the young bunches of betelnuts in the kamuga trees; You have Your abode in this place;", "Girls filled with love willingly come singing Your praise to worship You at", "ThiruvAnaikkA where You are seated with relish, Oh Great One!"]
361.english_pathavurai: Although they look like the black lily and the arrows, they subtly differ from them; their hue is like dark blue poison, AlakAlam; they are capable of dispensing simultaneously bliss that could kill and a delusion of passion; and they swing moving back and forth attacking the ears with the two ear-studs as if to sever them; possessing such eyes, are the enchanting whores to touch whose bodies I have unabated desire; I also have anger, miserliness and arrogance; to redeem such a sinner like me, kindly show me the path of wisdom, that can be revealed by people who are interested in my long life and strong source of oxygen and who could offer me ways and means of practical activities that leads to enlightenment; from now on, kindly love me so that I keep that path as my goal and I become interested in meditation and penance; can You not think of taking charge of me unto Your hallowed feet adorned at the lilting anklets? The rooster crowed aloud saying "Hail to You" while the peacock danced excitedly soaring high like the rising poison, AlakAlam; the armies of devils who serve Lord SivA gathered in the sky playing; and the efforts of the frightening and valorous demon, SUran, were wasted and destroyed; when AdhivarAgan* who came to the war screaming and charging with rage, was overpowered by Your sharp spear, Oh Lord! The sEl fish in the pond of this town, West VayalUr, surrounded by groves of sugarcanes, jump about soaring so high as to strike the young bunches of betelnuts in the kamuga trees; You have Your abode in this place; Girls filled with love willingly come singing Your praise to worship You at ThiruvAnaikkA where You are seated with relish, Oh Great One!

362.english_pathavurai: Blood, flesh, bones, skin, nerves, germs, air, water, meat, dense intestines, fat, hair, and brain - all these fill up this body. In this cottage, there are five hunters constituting the sensory organs who run around this jungle of five senses and who are the worst cheats with lustful desires. There are evil people who carry on with the five* worst offences and because of that, they ignore the ways of worship mentioned in VEdAs and PurAnAs, such as sariyai, kiriyai, worship of DEvAs, prostrations, chanting and meditation. Not even one such method** was ever attempted by me; instead, I was roaming as a stupid and useless fellow, amidst provocative, lascivious and arrogant ones, suffering due to my attachment to them. Ending such blemish, please bestow on me Your grace so that I can attain the blissful heaven! With a unique spear, You pierced the large mount of Krouncha; and also the demons and, SUran in the disguise of a mango tree, along with the seas roaring with waves, were all shattered to pieces when You fought with them with Your lotus-like hand, Oh warrior! Great sages, the Celestials living in heaven and Your devotees who prostrate at Your feet with devotion are all privileged to be blessed by Your happy presence in their hearts at all times! The vedic purohits who are all well-versed in the six aspects*** of the scriptures and who perform sacrificial rites keep chanting "Hari, Hari, Govinda and Kesava" in praise of the two lotus feet of Sriranga RAjan (Vishnu) whose beloved nephew You are! BrahmA, seated on the lotus, IndrA (Aakandan) and other DEvAs proudly acclaim SivA as their Lord when worshipping His feet at this place, ThiruvAnaikkA, whose Lord JambunAthar (SivA) has blessed us with You, Oh Great One!

365.english_pathavurai: Aromatic paste of sandalwood powder, musk, and bunches of fragrant flowers had all combined in their hair; beetles with fine stripes slumbered restfully on the hair which looked like the dense rainy cloud in the sky; the hair of these women was black like the surrounding darkness; seeking their lotus-like feet wearing the anklets, I gladly carried out the chores tossed by them at me, and I was indeed swollen with pride to do so; I was such a pathetic waste! I did not care to follow the righteous path; I was such a fool; my speech was full of vanity and emptiness; I never bothered to research and understand classic texts because I hated them; I was a cheat and had taken leave of my senses; I was full of blemishes and misdeeds; I was an unscrupulous person and went back on my words; and I had already fallen in hell which was supposed to be a destination after death. (Despite all the above), will there be a day when You will carefully enquire about what ailed me and graciously bring me under Your reign? To shatter the enemy's stronghold, Thiripuram, to pieces, She, NArAyani (VishNu's sister), picked up Mount MEru in one hand as a bow; She wears anklets and is the daughter of Mount HimavAn; She is KAmakshi, the presiding deity in KAnchipuram, She is like the blissfully dancing peacock; She is the beautiful Consort of Lord SivA; She is the Mother who created all the worlds which wear the sea as a dress; She is Goddess UmA; She is AkilANda NAyaki having Her shrine in ThiruvAnaikkA; and You are the child kindly delivered by Her! In the war that was waged, RAvaNA charged aggressively and later screamed (in pain) like a thunder; before that, he wept at the top of his voice, thoroughly shaken as his many heads were severed by Rama; He is also VishNu, who took the Supreme Colossal shape (ViswarUpam); You are His nephew! Once, You went seeking VaLLi, the matchless damsel of the KuRavAs, with a twine-like slender waist, and buried Your face amidst her mountainous bosom, Oh Great Lover! You are the Lord of the celestials who have done extensive research on the old scriptures, Oh Great One!

374.english_pathavurai: "Their two eyes appearing as an amalgam of poison and nectar are not lotus; instead, they are two arrows soaked in fire; their fragrant hair exuding an aroma of musk is not black cloud; instead, it is the unique darkness of ignorance that blocks the path to the matchless search for the eye of Knowledge; their speech is not nectar; instead, it is the net that ensnares life; their teeth are not a row of jasmine that provoke passionate exhilaration; instead, they are hiding stealth in themselves; the awesome valley of their navel is not a deep pool in the river; instead, it is a trench (that is dug to entrap elephants); their waist is not a hand-drum; instead, it is the shape of Manmathan (God of Love) (because it is shapeless like Manmathan); their beautiful bosom is not a mountain; instead, it is the deadly God of Death (Yaman), himself; the string of beads heaving on their chest is not made of pearls; instead, it is the rope of bondage cast by Yaman; these whores are not women at all; instead, they are an embodiment of many deeds combined together" - will there be a day when I shall acquire the knowledge of the above feeling (and see the whores as they really are)? The fairy queens of the forest worship by offering flowers at Your two hallowed lotus feet wearing anklets, that are worthy of surrender; VaLLi, the deer-like damsel with matchless beauty, residing in the field of millet grown near Mount VaLLimalai, and DEvayAnai, reared by the celestials, walk by Your side; and You mount the bleating white elephant* that is adorned with an ornamental cloth covering its face, that devours huge balls of food, that has an enormous trunk and that looks like a mountain, Oh Novel Lord! The exhilarated range of Your mountain-like shoulders revels in the bliss of union (with VaLLi and DEvayAnai), Oh Lord with an exquisite heart! You terrify the armies of demons comprising the elephants, chariots, horses and soldiers! The red lilies and burning fire are withered and darkened by the radiant reddish rays emanating from Your body, Oh Lord! The esteemed and pure sage Gauthamar prostates at Your feet and worships! You are the child delivered by the compassionate Goddess UmA DEvi, who carried out many virtuous acts in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh SaravaNabavA! You are the Lord of Indra, the leader of the celestials, Oh Great One!

The drums in the battlefield were beaten to the meter "kumara gurupara kumara gurupara kumara gurupara kumara gurupara kumara gurupara kumara gurupara"; rare sounds of triumph were heard with a roaring noise "damada damadama damada dama"; the drum called thimilai, the cymbals called challari and other string instruments like lute (kinnari) were all played aloud; all the celestials, sages and BrahmA together offered their worship with honey-dripping flowers and redeemed their respective positions; and the armies of the demons consisting of horses, elephants and chariots were all shattered to pieces when You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! All the worlds were lit brightly everywhere when You mounted the peacock displaying Your hallowed feet and united with VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and took Your seat in this matchless mountain, ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!

376.english_pathavurai: "I kept a vigil day and night looking after you, but you abandoned me leaving me totally inactive; Oh my dear husband, having lost you, I am destroyed" so wailed the wife. The old mother lamented "Oh my son, you always remain in my thoughts". The sons wept loudly "Oh father!" At the head of the corpse, all relatives and old friends assembled and cried. The funeral came with drum-beating. The God of Death (Yaman) threw the thick rope (PAsak kayiRu) around my neck and tightened it. At this juncture, kindly save me and spare my life. With the Spear and the Staff of Rooster symbolising justice held in Your hands, You mount the peacock and reside in the temple tower of ThiruvaNNAmalai. You are the Lord of the Celestials! You kiss the little girl, DEvayAnai, reared by the DEvAs. You are easily accessible to those poets who sing the glory of SivA in unique words! In the dense hillside of beautiful VaLLimalai, where dark clouds linger and rest, You wooed VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, who was minding the millet field, and united with her! You smashed the Mount of Krouncha into powder and fought with SUran who hid as a mango tree in the sea; and You are the consummate warrior, Oh Great One!

377.english_pathavurai: They are like the fiery God of Death (Yaman) who shakes up the life; they roll their elegant sEl-fish-like eyes staring ardently and negotiate for their bodies the price predetermined after careful thought; with deceit hidden in their heart, they dole out carnal pleasure in proportion to the money received; on the neat floral bed, they tease and cause misery, feigning quarrels; these whores submit to those who offer abundant money; I am one who has lost the acumen of mind to the misery of their taunting. Will I worship Your hallowed feet that serve my life as the raft to cross the sea of birth? As BrahmA, who preaches the VEdAs, IndrA who holds the weapon vajrA in his hand and Lord VishNu who is endowed with a beautiful form and complexion of the dark cloud searched for shelter (being scared by SUran) and sought Your refuge, You fought with that strong demon SUran with Your spear, drying out the wide sea filled with large mountains, Oh Lord! As learned and wise men join me in singing my songs praising You in rhymes, You are seated with relish on the temple tower of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord! In the forest of VaLLimalai, she roams about like a peacock; You went craving for the broad and large bosom of that VaLLi and became weary, Oh valorous and Great One!

378.english_pathavurai: Yama, the God of Death, wields a thick rope from his hand (to snatch my life); and I willingly fell prey to that Yama and lodged my useful life with him. The so-called relatives of mine on this earth caught hold of my body firmly; and laid it on a funeral pyre burning intensely. Later they all departed after taking a dip in the wavy water. I took such a sinful birth! I, the lowly dog, was debilitated with many diseases and roamed about aimlessly. Saying "Please forgive my sins and protect by severing me from all defects!" will I have the fortune of chanting Your glory with love? "Vishnu, who has the complexion of dark cloud, offered His lotus eye* which was desired by Lord SivA wearing the anklets; to that SivA, You preached the essence of all arts, namely, the PraNava ManthrA; You pierced (with Your spear) Mount Krouncha; and You are the real Almighty holding the staff with the reddish Rooster!" - with these words, Your devotees sing Your glory in rare poems; for them and for the sake of their entire families, You shower Your blessings seated at the temple towers of ThiruvaNNAmalai! You lovingly embrace the bosoms of VaLLi, the peacock-like damsel of the jungle, to the point of fatigue! You are the most valorous, Oh Great One!

380.english_meanings_list: ["To the rays of the hot full moon that has taken a dip in the inferno at VadavAmuka (the destructive fire that erupts from the North Pole at the end of the aeon),", "to the foolish women who are scandal-mongering, to the sweet music from the matchless flute and to the mischief played upon me by the good old God of Love, Manmathan, I am not prepared to succumb;", "instead, I am contemplating the ways and means of hugging Your twelve hallowed shoulders that wear a new look, smeared with civet paste and adorned with garlands of fragrant kadappa and pretty kurA flowers, bedecked in rows; the truth of my contemplation should be revealed to the entire world by Your visiting me everyday, mounting the beautiful and blue peacock, capable of fighting a war, Oh Lord!", "This place ThiruvaNNAmalai has many groves surrounded by ponds in which the makara fish keep leaping; You are seated in its temple tower whose grandeur is beyond description in writing, Oh Lord!", "The damsel of the hunters stands there with her waist caving in and her attire swaying; You never stop hugging the bulging and youthful bosom of that VaLLi with Your hallowed chest, Oh Lord!", "He holds on His matted hair a serpent with a gorgeous hood and the river Gangai which gushes with water; to that Lord SivA You once preached the PraNava ManthrA, Oh Great Master!", "Brahma, VishNu and other rare celestials were all imprisoned (by the demon SUran); You freed them from that prison and brought them out, Oh Great One!"]
380.english_pathavurai: To the rays of the hot full moon that has taken a dip in the inferno at VadavAmuka (the destructive fire that erupts from the North Pole at the end of the aeon), to the foolish women who are scandal-mongering, to the sweet music from the matchless flute and to the mischief played upon me by the good old God of Love, Manmathan, I am not prepared to succumb; instead, I am contemplating the ways and means of hugging Your twelve hallowed shoulders that wear a new look, smeared with civet paste and adorned with garlands of fragrant kadappa and pretty kurA flowers, bedecked in rows; the truth of my contemplation should be revealed to the entire world by Your visiting me everyday, mounting the beautiful and blue peacock, capable of fighting a war, Oh Lord! This place ThiruvaNNAmalai has many groves surrounded by ponds in which the makara fish keep leaping; You are seated in its temple tower whose grandeur is beyond description in writing, Oh Lord! The damsel of the hunters stands there with her waist caving in and her attire swaying; You never stop hugging the bulging and youthful bosom of that VaLLi with Your hallowed chest, Oh Lord! He holds on His matted hair a serpent with a gorgeous hood and the river Gangai which gushes with water; to that Lord SivA You once preached the PraNava ManthrA, Oh Great Master! Brahma, VishNu and other rare celestials were all imprisoned (by the demon SUran); You freed them from that prison and brought them out, Oh Great One!

381.english_meanings_list: ["Because of the great moon which comes out (in the sky) after dipping into the fire in vadavA mukAgni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole on the doom's day at the end of the aeon), because of the sweet music from the yAzh (a string instrument) that sounds like the pleasant voice of women,", "because of the roaring sea which completely surrounds the eight mountains in all the eight directions,", "and because of the (flowery) arrows shot by the God of Love (Manmathan) who is formless after his death, she has been battered;", "to dispel the daze of an extraordinary passion that possesses this damsel who has an exhilarated bosom looking like the golden mount MEru,", "kindly remember her plight and come to her mounted on Your triumphant and beautiful peacock that has green feathers, with bright eyes on the plume!", "He shot an arrow that knocked off the twenty shoulders, wearing garlands made of fresh blossoming flowers, and the ten heads of RAvaNan; He is Lord VishNu who came as RAmA, and You are His nephew!", "He stands beyond the comprehension of many celestials; to enable that Lord SivA to learn the silent, secret and inner meaning of the VEdAs, You preached to Him, Oh Great Master!", "On the pathways of this scary town ThiruvaNNAmalai, many serpents freely creep about, and You have chosen Your seat in the nice eastern temple tower of this place, Oh Lord!", "You once became very angry and fought with Mount MEru* which is immensely vast like the seven worlds; the big eight mountains (Krouncha and the seven hills that guarded the demons) were pierced by the spear that You wielded, Oh Great One!"]
381.english_pathavurai: Because of the great moon which comes out (in the sky) after dipping into the fire in vadavA mukAgni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole on the doom's day at the end of the aeon), because of the sweet music from the yAzh (a string instrument) that sounds like the pleasant voice of women, because of the roaring sea which completely surrounds the eight mountains in all the eight directions, and because of the (flowery) arrows shot by the God of Love (Manmathan) who is formless after his death, she has been battered; to dispel the daze of an extraordinary passion that possesses this damsel who has an exhilarated bosom looking like the golden mount MEru, kindly remember her plight and come to her mounted on Your triumphant and beautiful peacock that has green feathers, with bright eyes on the plume! He shot an arrow that knocked off the twenty shoulders, wearing garlands made of fresh blossoming flowers, and the ten heads of RAvaNan; He is Lord VishNu who came as RAmA, and You are His nephew! He stands beyond the comprehension of many celestials; to enable that Lord SivA to learn the silent, secret and inner meaning of the VEdAs, You preached to Him, Oh Great Master! On the pathways of this scary town ThiruvaNNAmalai, many serpents freely creep about, and You have chosen Your seat in the nice eastern temple tower of this place, Oh Lord! You once became very angry and fought with Mount MEru* which is immensely vast like the seven worlds; the big eight mountains (Krouncha and the seven hills that guarded the demons) were pierced by the spear that You wielded, Oh Great One!

383.english_meanings_list: ["These strange women with conflicting, hostile and deceitful attitudes", "flirt with me, and I am enamoured of them.", "I am oblivious of this weakness of mine, and none of my blemishes and sins takes leave of me;", "I hide the various changes occurring in my body which I dotingly nourish.", "To put an end to this metamorphosis, such as birth, ageing (from child to youth to old man) and eventual death and", "in order that my life is without any imperfection, my mind has to envision You, with", "Your glorious and sharp Spear, Your staff with Rooster on it,", "and VaLLi, the deer-like damsel of the hunters who lived in the valley of the millet field; will I ever be able to meditate on these?", "Seated on a central flowery seat, mounted on an elephant* or Your peacock, You come out in procession", "in the streets of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord Kandha!", "The good old celestials, in whose land lives peacock-like DEvayAnai, reared by the white elephant (AirAvadham),", "were all released from the prisons of SUran by Your going to war with him, Oh Lord with the Spear!", "The biggest sinner, SUran, and other demons, with a large battalion of soldiers, were all destroyed in the battle;", "To save this earth and the celestial world, You showed Your mercy, Oh Lord!", "Thinking about Your hallowed lotus feet and worshipping them by flowers represented by True Knowledge", "are Your singing devotees, and You are their bosom friend, Oh Great One!"]
383.english_pathavurai: These strange women with conflicting, hostile and deceitful attitudes flirt with me, and I am enamoured of them. I am oblivious of this weakness of mine, and none of my blemishes and sins takes leave of me; I hide the various changes occurring in my body which I dotingly nourish. To put an end to this metamorphosis, such as birth, ageing (from child to youth to old man) and eventual death and in order that my life is without any imperfection, my mind has to envision You, with Your glorious and sharp Spear, Your staff with Rooster on it, and VaLLi, the deer-like damsel of the hunters who lived in the valley of the millet field; will I ever be able to meditate on these? Seated on a central flowery seat, mounted on an elephant* or Your peacock, You come out in procession in the streets of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord Kandha! The good old celestials, in whose land lives peacock-like DEvayAnai, reared by the white elephant (AirAvadham), were all released from the prisons of SUran by Your going to war with him, Oh Lord with the Spear! The biggest sinner, SUran, and other demons, with a large battalion of soldiers, were all destroyed in the battle; To save this earth and the celestial world, You showed Your mercy, Oh Lord! Thinking about Your hallowed lotus feet and worshipping them by flowers represented by True Knowledge are Your singing devotees, and You are their bosom friend, Oh Great One!

388.english_pathavurai: In this world, where the sun and moon shine visibly. the close relatives like the wife and lovely children stand by my side, and cry uttering heart-rendering words full of grief and sometimes speak harshly too! He has dark scary body and eyes spitting fire; before that Yaman (God of Death) nears me on a mission to snatch my life I want all the arts I have learned and all my miseries to be erased altogether; and for that You have to cast Your glance of grace at me so that I could contemplate only Your Lotus Feet! Broad-shouldered Vishnu (who holds Lakshmi in His heart), BrahmA, and people in the wide world from all eight directions were trembling when SUran came to the battlefield; and that SUran's strong shoulders were cut and scattered into pieces and the wavy seas were scared away when You with Your Spear and valour showed Your rage! Great scholars who have mastered the rare scriptures, all the DEvAs in Heaven, and all Your beloved devotees prosper hailing You! In those days, DEvi PArvathi performed thirty-two kinds of religious duties*; and She was given the left side of His body by Lord SivA. They both reside at ThiruvaNNAmalai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

389.english_meanings_list: ["He cleverly wields the evil and troublesome rope (of attachment) around my neck", "and stands at my door angrily with fiery sparks in his eyes; He is Yaman (God of Death);", "he has arrived to take my life at the appointed hour as destined by my fate; at this time,", "women and relatives, with a treacherous mind, are about to shed tears; before this confusion arises,", "kindly bless me with the discipline of prostrating at Your hallowed feet that are capable of destroying all my past deeds!", "He always resides in the hearts of His devotees;", "He is VishNu, slumbering on a serpent-bed (AdhisEshan), which has several hoods that spew poison;", "He chants the wonderul and old vEdAs; He is BrahmA, seated on the lotus;", "He swallowed the evil AlakAla poison to allay the fears of all the celestials assembled; He mounts His vehicle, Bull (Nandi);", "He wears the serpent and the crescent moon on His matted hair on which He has also placed River Ganga; He holds fire in one hand;", "He is concorporate with His Consort, PArvathi Devi, in the left half of His body; He is Lord SivA; thus the entire Trinity reside in", "ThiruvaNNAmalai which is also Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
389.english_pathavurai: He cleverly wields the evil and troublesome rope (of attachment) around my neck and stands at my door angrily with fiery sparks in his eyes; He is Yaman (God of Death); he has arrived to take my life at the appointed hour as destined by my fate; at this time, women and relatives, with a treacherous mind, are about to shed tears; before this confusion arises, kindly bless me with the discipline of prostrating at Your hallowed feet that are capable of destroying all my past deeds! He always resides in the hearts of His devotees; He is VishNu, slumbering on a serpent-bed (AdhisEshan), which has several hoods that spew poison; He chants the wonderul and old vEdAs; He is BrahmA, seated on the lotus; He swallowed the evil AlakAla poison to allay the fears of all the celestials assembled; He mounts His vehicle, Bull (Nandi); He wears the serpent and the crescent moon on His matted hair on which He has also placed River Ganga; He holds fire in one hand; He is concorporate with His Consort, PArvathi Devi, in the left half of His body; He is Lord SivA; thus the entire Trinity reside in ThiruvaNNAmalai which is also Your abode, Oh Great One!

390.english_meanings_list: ["These makara fish stay put in one place and forcefully repel the aggressive sharks in the wavy sea; because of the moon rising from the sea,", "because of the so-called gentle, but fiery, southerly breeze that gushes through the street inhabited by women who are responsible for both good and bad deeds,", "and because of the merciless Manmathan (God of Love) shooting arrows of the fragrant, but cruel, lotus and blue lily, picked from the centre of the pond,", "is it fair that this belle, who is swept by passion, to the extent of her bangle slipping off her hand involuntarily, should toss about all alone on her flowery bed?", "Those demons possessed a huge body comparable to the great mount Meru in the north; You wielded the spear, knocking down their jeweled crowns, Oh Lord!", "She is the damsel of the hunters; she possesses youthful bosom smeared with sandal paste mixed with nectar and thrills; You hugged that VaLLi with Your chest, Oh Lord!", "This peacock is strong, highly decorated, enchanting and of a pleasant green hue; You mounted the peacock and took Your seat in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord!", "The Trinity, VishNu, SivA and BrahmA, whom the host of VEdAs praise in an orderly way, themselves worship You, Oh Great One!"]
390.english_pathavurai: These makara fish stay put in one place and forcefully repel the aggressive sharks in the wavy sea; because of the moon rising from the sea, because of the so-called gentle, but fiery, southerly breeze that gushes through the street inhabited by women who are responsible for both good and bad deeds, and because of the merciless Manmathan (God of Love) shooting arrows of the fragrant, but cruel, lotus and blue lily, picked from the centre of the pond, is it fair that this belle, who is swept by passion, to the extent of her bangle slipping off her hand involuntarily, should toss about all alone on her flowery bed? Those demons possessed a huge body comparable to the great mount Meru in the north; You wielded the spear, knocking down their jeweled crowns, Oh Lord! She is the damsel of the hunters; she possesses youthful bosom smeared with sandal paste mixed with nectar and thrills; You hugged that VaLLi with Your chest, Oh Lord! This peacock is strong, highly decorated, enchanting and of a pleasant green hue; You mounted the peacock and took Your seat in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord! The Trinity, VishNu, SivA and BrahmA, whom the host of VEdAs praise in an orderly way, themselves worship You, Oh Great One!

391.english_pathavurai: Being captivated by the whores who walk with the gait of a (female) elephant, being prompted by the wretched fate that leads to misery, being totally thoughtless about attaining liberation and not knowing how to pray to You, would I let my mind delve into thoughts of carnal pleasure that are destructive, and am I to roam about in this world for long carrying this burden of my body, a mass of flesh, that is subject to scornful ridicule? Kindly bless me to enter the shade of Your hallowed feet, which resemble the hundred-petalled lotus, being the only raft by which I could cross the ocean of birth! You are the renowned child of Thiripurai (PArvathi), who is happily concorporate on the left side of the body of SivA who burnt down Thiripuram! You wielded the spear so forcefully that the Mount Krouncha, where the demons resided, was split into two! This place is very famous in this world, and in this town of ThiruvaNNAmalai, You have taken a seat in the northern side of the large wall, Oh Great One!

392.english_meanings_list: ["These whores spoil my good health;", "I do not want to lose my heart to them and suffer from lust.", "I cannot deny the right of the powerful Yaman (God of Death) to take my life,", "nor do I wish to unduly suffer with a distressed mind.", "I do not want to befriend those who are responsible for my repeated births", "and I wish to avoid falling into the sea of misery.", "Kindly have mercy on me by granting Your hallowed feet", "and the wisdom of realising the True Knowledge.", "You dwell in the heart of those who meditate on You even only once and praise Your two holy feet!", "On Your strong shoulders You placed VaLLi, the honey-like sweet damsel of the KuRavAs, and", "eloped with her successfully, Oh Kumara!", "He was arrogant and proud; He strangled the divine celestials;", "That SUran came to challenge You on the battlefield only to be killed by You, Oh Warrior with the Spear!", "In this stable world is this huge Mount ChoNAchalam (thiruvaNNAmalai)", "whose elegant temple tower is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
392.english_pathavurai: These whores spoil my good health; I do not want to lose my heart to them and suffer from lust. I cannot deny the right of the powerful Yaman (God of Death) to take my life, nor do I wish to unduly suffer with a distressed mind. I do not want to befriend those who are responsible for my repeated births and I wish to avoid falling into the sea of misery. Kindly have mercy on me by granting Your hallowed feet and the wisdom of realising the True Knowledge. You dwell in the heart of those who meditate on You even only once and praise Your two holy feet! On Your strong shoulders You placed VaLLi, the honey-like sweet damsel of the KuRavAs, and eloped with her successfully, Oh Kumara! He was arrogant and proud; He strangled the divine celestials; That SUran came to challenge You on the battlefield only to be killed by You, Oh Warrior with the Spear! In this stable world is this huge Mount ChoNAchalam (thiruvaNNAmalai) whose elegant temple tower is Your abode, Oh Great One!

393.english_meanings_list: ["Like the arrows that never leave the hands of the unique and handsome Manmathan (God of Love) and", "like the kayal fish are the lovely eyes of the taunting whores.", "I hugged their beautiful, tantalising, sweet-scented, mountain-like bosom;", "I lost all my vigour, and my health was shattered.", "I fell into a coughing spell and lost my speech and sensation.", "I became very thin, my mind was down in the dumps and my life was sinking.", "To save me from falling into the worst hell, namely, the burning inferno (called kumbipAkam*),", "kindly grant me Your hallowed feet!", "The matchless great Mount Krouncha was shattered to pieces", "by Your powerful throwing of the elegant and dazzling spear, Oh Lord!", "In the forest, where deers roam about, lived the famous damsel of the KuRavAs, namely, VaLLi,", "and Your twelve strong shoulders melted in love for her, Oh valorous One!", "You are extremely dear to Lord SivA whose vision could never be fully seen by Vishnu and BrahmA, seated on the lotus.", "In ThiruvaNNAmalai, surrounded by fertile and lush paddy-fields,", "You have Your abode, relishing Your procession in its wide streets, Oh Great One!"]
393.english_pathavurai: Like the arrows that never leave the hands of the unique and handsome Manmathan (God of Love) and like the kayal fish are the lovely eyes of the taunting whores. I hugged their beautiful, tantalising, sweet-scented, mountain-like bosom; I lost all my vigour, and my health was shattered. I fell into a coughing spell and lost my speech and sensation. I became very thin, my mind was down in the dumps and my life was sinking. To save me from falling into the worst hell, namely, the burning inferno (called kumbipAkam*), kindly grant me Your hallowed feet! The matchless great Mount Krouncha was shattered to pieces by Your powerful throwing of the elegant and dazzling spear, Oh Lord! In the forest, where deers roam about, lived the famous damsel of the KuRavAs, namely, VaLLi, and Your twelve strong shoulders melted in love for her, Oh valorous One! You are extremely dear to Lord SivA whose vision could never be fully seen by Vishnu and BrahmA, seated on the lotus. In ThiruvaNNAmalai, surrounded by fertile and lush paddy-fields, You have Your abode, relishing Your procession in its wide streets, Oh Great One!

394.english_meanings_list: ["I cried a lot; I offered worship amidst intense sobbing; from time to time, I melted and choked from devotion;", "I lost control and drowned in the sea of love which was my supportive foundation;", "I went in pursuit of the symbol of silence which could never be discerned by restless and vain religious fanatics;", "still, I could not attain the flawless True Knowledge;", "like a large bubble capable of assuming various sizes, depending on the extent of past deeds, birth is like a whirlwind in the sea;", "am I now destined to fall into that? Kindly tell me.", "Materialising as prosperous sons on the banks of the old Ganga river in the SaravaNa Pond,", "You imbibed the nectar-like milk from the bosoms of six KArthigai girls with Your six holy faces, Oh Little One!", "You are the Supreme Deity of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord, mounting the Peacock; You are the Embodiment of Knowledge!", "At dusk, mount Krouncha was crushed to pieces and all the planets, including Earth, were smashed to smithereens;", "the seas, throwing pearls on the shores and protecting the fish, wailed and howled uncontrollably; and the vedic scriptures began to moan loudly;", "when You fought the war with Your Spear, Oh Great One!"]
394.english_pathavurai: I cried a lot; I offered worship amidst intense sobbing; from time to time, I melted and choked from devotion; I lost control and drowned in the sea of love which was my supportive foundation; I went in pursuit of the symbol of silence which could never be discerned by restless and vain religious fanatics; still, I could not attain the flawless True Knowledge; like a large bubble capable of assuming various sizes, depending on the extent of past deeds, birth is like a whirlwind in the sea; am I now destined to fall into that? Even when the loud appeal made by sages, BrahmA, Vishnu, DEvAs and all Your devotees, who can never reach You, is not audible, how can the lonely voice of this poor soul reach Your ears? Is there anyone else to speak with compassion on my behalf? (I do not know). Every speck of dust on Your feet is equal to a mountain on this earth! Is there any measure for Your infinite compassion and grace? You shine as the Great Master and You cause even the movement within the atom! You have as Your weapons the Five great Elements, starting with the Air (including Fire, Water, Earth and the Sky). You take the oldest form and all the other forms, Oh VElA! When Vishnu and BrahmA surrendered to You seeking Your help (to fight asuras), You threw Your Spear piercing SUran who disguised himself as darkness! When Your servant, namely myself, suffered from the incurable disease*, You reduced the disease into dust particles! You have Your abode at aruNagiri (thiruvaNNAmalai), Oh Great One!

401.english_pathavurai: Scaring away both my karmas (good deeds and bad deeds), driving all my faults and defects out of sight, and making my ignorance and diseases disappear, You must come riding on Your peacock, speaking all graceful and kind words to me; beetles will hum around Your kadappa flowers seeking the life-sustaining nectar; Elephant-faced Ganapathi will call You fondly "Oh my younger brother, Muruga"; DEvAs in heaven will happily shower flowers happily; and You must appear before me pouring Your Grace over me and with a bright smile, as fast as You can in Your dancing pose! Thiripuram (Asuras' abode) was burnt down and so also was Manmathan's (Love God) body by a smile from Sivan, the One who mounts the Bull, and who appears as a Cosmic Light, dancing gracefully; He also takes Mother Goddess on the left side of His body; in one arm, He carries mazhu (pick-axe); and Our Father Sivan, the spotless one, is thrilled about You, His Master! At the mount of ThiruvaNNAmalai, VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavAs, is happy because she shares her flowery bed with You, Oh Great One!

402.english_pathavurai: It is just a green bag of skin in which the good and bad deeds are ingested; It is but a vessel in which birth takes place; It is a cavern, to be doomed soon, filled up with miseries; It is a rudderless ship tottering in the mid-sea of distress and evil; It is a septic tank filled with faeces and urine; It is but a sleeping corpse in the night and a receptacle for all diseases; It is a cage in which all the five elements are filled; It is this body, a small cottage, from which my mind and life will depart simultaneously. Thinking that this body is indestructible, I develop attachment with people of this world, due to delusion, being the result of my past deeds; getting rid of that delusion, will I ever be able to attain Your two hallowed lotus feet? In front of the imposing and impeccable Temple Tower of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Your devotees are being paid obeisance to by the celestials with their lotus hands folded; You are the friend of those devotees! Once, the entire world was swallowed by Lord Vishnu, who holds in His hand the unique bow, SArangam; You are His nephew! Along with the compassionate sage, VyAkrapAdhar, the tiger-footed one, the Great Serpent King, Sage Pathanjali, witnessed the Cosmic Dance of Lord NadarAjar*; You are the son of that NadarAjar. The thick feathers of Your Peacock are capable of smashing the mountains to pieces! You are well-versed in literature, Oh King! You are the greatest preserver of Truth, Oh Kantha! You are the Lord worshipped by all IndrAs who wield the weapon Vajra, Oh Great One!

403.english_pathavurai: Their dark hair falling loose, pearl-like beads of perspiration appearing on their moon-like face, their rolling eyes looking like bright kayal fish, their twin breasts, heavy and beautiful, thawing, their waist caving in, the bangles on their arms colliding with one another, their elegant attire whose beauty in indescribable by any one loosening and getting dishevelled, and passion growing unabatedly, I endeared myself to them, drowning myself in the sweet whirlpool of their navel, imbibing the nectar-like saliva oozing from their lips and uniting the lives and bodies as one; with anger and hatred subsiding, I lay on the fragrant and flowery bed; as their lotus-like face withered, I was destroyed by my own passionate desire; with my speech becoming incoherent and my balance becoming shaky, I totally sank drowning in the sea of lust; even at that time, I would never forget Your lotus feet that are worshipped ardently by the sages and the celestials who laud You as One closely associated with the VEdAs, acknowledged by all as the highest pinnacle of mature and great penance, and regarded as unblemished, Oh Lord! During the marriage ceremony of a unique young man NambiyUrAn (Sundhara MUrthy), He entered the main door of the wedding hall coming in the disguise of a tired old man and declared openly to the hearing of all assembled people that the young groom was His slave (showing a palm leaf as the evidence); the crumpled old palm leaf that was produced was forcibly snatched from the old man's hand and deliberately torn to pieces by the young groom; at that time, (throwing up His arms and legs into the air), the old man shouted creating an uproar and questioning the injustice meted out to Him; that Primeval old man, who was well-versed in the VEdAs, was none other than Lord SivA who delivered You as His child! The unique Moon was erected as the central pillar and the golden mount MEru was set up as the churner; the Serpent VAsuki, with its hoods embedded with precious gems, was tied as the churning rope, and the celestials and others swiftly began to churn the milky ocean; when (ultimately) nectar emerged from the sea, it was equally distributed (among the celestials) by Lord VishNu, and You are His nephew! With deep foresight, You once established the Rooster on Your staff*, and took Your seat at the main gate of the Temple Tower in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!

You destroyed all the demons and freed up the DEvAs, reestablishing their celestial kingdom, Oh Great One!

411.english_pathavurai: The sea is stretching beyond the reach of the eyes, and the waves are making never-ending noise; and the din is killing her. Following suit is Manmathan (Love God) with the southerly breeze as his chariot. Then there is the moon which was trampled under His feet by SivA* who consumed the poison coming out of the milky ocean. All these angrily conspire against her; on this earth, this poor girl, looking like a shy peahen, is standing alone in her tattered cotton saree. The scandal-mongering of the women of the world is destroying her. She herself is the centre of verbal abuses from all over. Why should she suffer physically everyday (due to Your separation from her)? Oh, Lord of SONAchalam (thiruvaNNAmalai)! You have adorned Your twelve broad shoulders with kadamba garlands, Oh Leader! You are the warrior who has never known defeat! Oh mighty King, with Your spear You angrily destroyed the powerful but immoral asura, SUran! DEvayAnai, the damsel who is worshipped by all DEvAs in heaven, embraced Your glorious chest with unending love! The Trinity of BrahmA, Vishnu and SivA, who are cherished by all DEvAs, and all IndrAs who are their Leaders combine to worship You, Oh Great One!

412.english_pathavurai: Their hair looks like the dark cloud. Rolling their eyes that look like arrows soaked in evil poison, they smear a paste of several herbs with turmeric on their face. The swinging studs move back and forth on their ears close to the hair while the other ornaments sway on the top. The breasts of these whores have the lustre of marble and look like pots filled with nectar. Impelled by their avarice for money, they resort to subjugation methods by spraying magic potions in powder form. They are capable of flirting with charming lisps. They move about hither and thither on the streets like cuckoos, deliberately dropping their upper garment, with their waist caving in and moving their feet in rhythm as though they are dancing dolls. With intense liaison with these whores, I spent a few days very well until my skin suffered wrinkles and the pain inflicted by many diseases became so debilitating that I felt I was dying; I started walking like a monkey leaning on the stick in my hand. Amidst ridiculing words against me being spoken all around, being bed-ridden, with an emaciated and shrunken body, deteriorating day by day, with distressing pain affecting my life, the brightness in my eyes fading, unable to think cogently, being short of hearing and forgetting both bliss and agony simultaneously, I became a laughing stock among the people of my town, including my own kith and kin who surrounded me in a crowd declaring that it was not yet time for this life to depart and condemned me with all kinds of deriding remarks leaving me alone to die; am I destined to witness the decay of my body as all my folks depart? He spewed fire (from His fiery eye) burning the Thiripuram and Manmathan (God of Love) to ashes; He wears the hides of the elephant, the tiger and the lion as the loin-cloth; on His matted hair, He wears the River Gangai, crescent moon and a garland of Aththi flowers (mountain ebony); He mounts the bull (Rishabam); he imbibed the evil (AlakAla) poison that emerged from the sea; he is my father Lord SivA on whose left side She, my Mother, is concorporate; She is the younger sister of Lord VishNu; She is the chaste Consort of the Lord; She is Mother Sankari; She is the most beautiful Goddess enjoying the love of one and all; She has a figure comprising the texts of the VEdic Scriptures; She has three eyes (namely, the Sun, the Moon, and Agni, the Fire-God); She is bestowed with huge bosom; and You are the son of eminent Knowledge of that Goddess Parvathi! The celestials in submission to you sing Your glory hailing You as the Lord who mounts with Your feet the horse-like vehicle, namely the peacock with plumes, and as the Great master with a fund of knowledge. Destroying the demons, weakening the large Mount MEru, dehydrating the beautiful sea, the eight mountains*, the eight great elephants** that guard the cardinal directions and the seven islands***, inflicting injury to the thousand hoods of the great poisonous serpent AdhisEshan in the netherland, and shattering to pieces the surrounding Mount ChakravaLAkam, You danced about merrily as the dust particles filled up the entire sky, Oh Lord with the Spear! You dazzle on top of the VEdAs that have been weakened due to many branches emanating from them! She not only obtained bliss by winning Your reddish lotus-like hand but She also stole Your heart; She is VaLLi, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs; along with her, You also revel in the company of the wonderful celestial maid, DEvayAnai, and have taken Your seat in the eminent place ThiruvaNNAmalai, known for the effulgence of SivA standing upright as a pillar of fire, Oh Great One!

You have six lovely faces, kurA flowers, peacock as Your vehicle, a broad chest ruled by the hugging damsel of the KuRavAs (VaLLi), abundant wealth (of Knowledge) and love, Oh Lord! You wield Your spear scaring off Mount MEru, the huge demon SUran, Mount Krouncha, the black wavy seas and all the enemies, Oh Lord! You have Your abode in the holy street of ThiruvaNNAmalai which place is worshipped by the entire world, Oh Great One!

415.english_pathavurai: Deliberately untangling the tress of their hair that has the aroma of kurA flowers, staring with their two kayal-fish-like eyes as if in attack, displaying their lily-like lips that are red and bright like coral, provocatively speaking so as to ripen the budding passion, recalling past incidents of sweetness and closeness, and letting the upper garment slide and purposely casting it sideways, these whores engage in so many acts to entice young men; having been ensnared by them, I, the wicked one, am being abused by this world being branded as the loser of all my money, youth, education and mind; to save my mind from destruction by yielding to the command of my five sensory organs and to curb the naughty activities of my body caused by the five elements, kindly grant me Your two hallowed feet, adorned by freshly blossomed flowers, that will soothe my mind; I am praising Your glory so that everyone concurs with me when I declare that You alone are the Greatest Leader in ThiruvaNNAmalai; will You not kindly think of protecting this humble slave with Your gracious glance? He wears on His unique and matted hair the serpent, aRugam (cynodon) grass, the moon, Aththi (mountain ebony) and Umaththai flowers, rudraksha beads and gems; in a manner accepted with relish by that Lord SivA, You taught Him the meaning of the supreme PraNava ManthrA, which is the rarest one, beyond anyone's comprehension. In the SaravaNa pond, You imbibed plenty of nectar-like milk, breast-fed by six celestial KArththigai girls who were endowed with beautiful hair; six little babies then merged together as a single bodied child, Oh Young One! Making the celestials walk freely and happily in their land and destroying the demons by shattering their brains to pieces, You wielded Your angry spear, Oh Mighty Lord! You are the most righteous one! You were so enraged that the dried up seven seas appealed to You loudly, Oh Lord! You approached on Your lotus feet the forest which was guarded by the hunters who held hand-drums and big drums; and waited for a proper opportunity to meet with Mother VaLLi guarding the millet field, who was the damsel, with curly hair, of the KuRavAs; then You embraced her, Oh Great One!

416.english_meanings_list: ["I was born as a little baby, grew into a young man, affected by delusion and passion,", "and became a well-settled family man of good lineage, possessing a house and a wife. I roamed about in the countryside and forests until I became dizzy.", "Eventually, my body was bent out of shape, developing a hunch-back, and I became an old man.", "Knowing that after the life departs, my body would burn along with logs and get reduced to ashes, I wish to get away from this trend of thought", "and attain the state at which my body is discarded once I have surpassed the (KuNdalini ChakrA's) old centres numbering six*;", "(the state at which) I am able to return four inches of unused air** into the unfettered and blissful ether daily;", "I wish to develop my body by putting it through a variety of Yogic exercises;", "(after completion of the above) will I be able to ultimately reach the immortal heavenly abode where there is no death and there is only an effulgence of Knowledge?", "The seven seas caught fire; Mount Meru was shattered to pieces;", "BrahmA, the four VEdAs and the sun ran helter skelter in wrong directions;", "the bright nether world (PAthala LokA) ruled by the old serpent king AdhisEshan and the Himalayas were smashed to smithereens;", "Mount SakravALa was split into two and fell down; the mountains in all the eight directions collapsed;", "handsome IndrA, the Great, and other DEvAs were resettled in their own golden celestial land;", "the vast armies of the demons were driven to the dust as if it were a sport;", "You fought with the demons headed by SUran because of their disinclination for peace, Oh Lord with the Spear,", "You are seated with relish in Your famous abode in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!"]
416.english_pathavurai: I was born as a little baby, grew into a young man, affected by delusion and passion, and became a well-settled family man of good lineage, possessing a house and a wife. I roamed about in the countryside and forests until I became dizzy. Eventually, my body was bent out of shape, developing a hunch-back, and I became an old man. Knowing that after the life departs, my body would burn along with logs and get reduced to ashes, I wish to get away from this trend of thought and attain the state at which my body is discarded once I have surpassed the (KuNdalini ChakrA's) old centres numbering six*; (the state at which) I am able to return four inches of unused air** into the unfettered and blissful ether daily; I wish to develop my body by putting it through a variety of Yogic exercises; (after completion of the above) will I be able to ultimately reach the immortal heavenly abode where there is no death and there is only an effulgence of Knowledge? The seven seas caught fire; Mount Meru was shattered to pieces; BrahmA, the four VEdAs and the sun ran helter skelter in wrong directions; the bright nether world (PAthala LokA) ruled by the old serpent king AdhisEshan and the Himalayas were smashed to smithereens; Mount SakravALa was split into two and fell down; the mountains in all the eight directions collapsed; handsome IndrA, the Great, and other DEvAs were resettled in their own golden celestial land; the vast armies of the demons were driven to the dust as if it were a sport; You fought with the demons headed by SUran because of their disinclination for peace, Oh Lord with the Spear, You are seated with relish in Your famous abode in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!

420.english_meanings_list: ["Placing a beautiful decorative mark of vermillion on the bow-like curvy forehead, wearing an elegant gem of rich ruby on the nose that looks like a soft flower on a pretty face resembling the cool lotus,", "and gazing fiercely with their reddish eyes, acting treacherously appropriate to the poison that fills them, and seethingly attacking the ears that wear the hanging ear-studs,", "these whores are behaving in an excessively hostile manner with feigned resentment; falling at their flower-like feet against the background sound of the jingling bangles worn in their hands ornamentally,", "I have been indulging in many a famous act of sensual romance, embracing their bosom with fusing intensity and making love to them fiercely; even then, I shall never forget Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord!", "He has reddish and matted hair adorned by the crescent moon; PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn, is concorporate on His left side;", "He is the compassionate Lord who dances to the tune of \"kaNa kaNa kat kat kaNin kaN\"; He has three fitting eyes (the Sun, the Moon and Fire, Agni); and He is Lord SivA, and You are His Son, Oh MurugA!", "She roamed about in the fields of millet; She is the soft creeper-like damsel, VaLLi; and You hugged her huge mountain-like bosom with Your shoulders, Oh Valorous One!", "When the vast armies of the demons entered the wavy sea and fought a fierce battle, You strewed about their severed bodies and emerged triumphant, making jingling sound with Your anklets while the great celestials worshipped You, Oh Lord!", "Removing the fearful grief of Your devotees, You bestow upon them Divine Grace, seated in this lovable place, ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!"]
420.english_pathavurai: Placing a beautiful decorative mark of vermillion on the bow-like curvy forehead, wearing an elegant gem of rich ruby on the nose that looks like a soft flower on a pretty face resembling the cool lotus, and gazing fiercely with their reddish eyes, acting treacherously appropriate to the poison that fills them, and seethingly attacking the ears that wear the hanging ear-studs, these whores are behaving in an excessively hostile manner with feigned resentment; falling at their flower-like feet against the background sound of the jingling bangles worn in their hands ornamentally, I have been indulging in many a famous act of sensual romance, embracing their bosom with fusing intensity and making love to them fiercely; even then, I shall never forget Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord! He has reddish and matted hair adorned by the crescent moon; PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn, is concorporate on His left side; He is the compassionate Lord who dances to the tune of "kaNa kaNa kat kat kaNin kaN"; He has three fitting eyes (the Sun, the Moon and Fire, Agni); and He is Lord SivA, and You are His Son, Oh MurugA! She roamed about in the fields of millet; She is the soft creeper-like damsel, VaLLi; and You hugged her huge mountain-like bosom with Your shoulders, Oh Valorous One! When the vast armies of the demons entered the wavy sea and fought a fierce battle, You strewed about their severed bodies and emerged triumphant, making jingling sound with Your anklets while the great celestials worshipped You, Oh Lord! 422.english_pathavurai: This body is meant to provide visual pleasure to, and serve as the meal for, angry dogs, jackals, eagles, flock of vultures, crows, devils and worms. This is a vessel, fitted with bones, serving as a container for muddy feaces and urine. The wretched webs of birth and death pursue and haunt this body, back and forth. After taking many shapes and forms in this world, whose number exceeds that of tiny sands on the sea-shore, I, baser than the dog, took birth here only to decay; in order that You come and bless me graciously so that I could approach and join the company of Your kind devotees who enjoy eternal bliss under the shade of the divine land, I hereby surrender to You my body and soul which are bonded to You eternally. Kindly accept my devoted service, ensuring that my union with Your devotees is consummated, thereby enhancing my splendour; as my mind and intellect reach Your hallowed feet, with the celestials happily standing beside Your peacock showering golden flowers, will Your loving bliss not be bestowed upon me today giving me priority? To the beat of "thananathana thananathana thanthanan thanthanan thakukukuku kukukukuku dangkudang kunthu" the crooked drums, snares, paRais and thimilais (kinds of percussion instruments) were beaten making the big sound of "dingku dingkunthu"; the large drums of the celestials made the sound of "thadudududu dududududu duNduduN duNduduN dimidimida dakura thikuku"; the conch-shell and the white trumpet made such a powerful sound as though it was the end of the aeon; the sea was terrified; and the entire clan of the treacherous demon SUran was shattered and destroyed, as You wielded the spear fiercely; the celestials, that ocean, all the cardinal directions, people in the NAgA world and on the Mount Manthara in the terrestrial world, Lord BrahmA on the lotus and all others were exhilarated; Lord VishNu and BrahmA sang heartrending songs seeking refuge; with a beaming and divine smile on Her lips, Goddess UmA, concorporate on the left side of our father Lord SivA, had her heart melting; the matchless River Gangai was looking admiringly at (the dance of) Lord SivA seated in ThiruvaNNAmalai; and He worships You, Oh Great One!

426.english_pathavurai: "(This buffalo has) hooves making loud noise; a black body, as if a mound of darkness has been splashed on it; eyes, like fireballs, emitting blazing sparks; and horns resembling the trumpets - mounted on such an angry buffalo the loner, Yaman (God of Death), is coming towards me, ready to throw the rope (of attachment) to take my life" - this kind of anxiety is distressing me. On the day death approaches me, when a lot of wailing by my relatives takes place and my sons are extremely saddened, (You must come to me) with Your lotus-like faces gorgeously grinning, long eyes, golden ear-rings dangling graciously from the earlobes, studs, shoulder-braces set with diamonds and gems, Your triumphant and dazzling spear, the peacock that has just returned from a swift flight around the world, the elegant and ornamented feet wearing golden anklets, studded with stones, making lilting sounds of victory; with all these together, kindly come and bless me with the boon! Upon the humble request by Lord SivA, You stood before Him and preached the fundamentals of the scriptural texts, Oh valorous One! When the evil demon SUran confronted You in the battlefield commanding all his forces, You wielded the sparkling spear and split his body into two, Oh Lord! When all the ChamaNas assembled in multitude in Madhurai (and lost their debate), You witnessed their mass self-immolation, each one taking turn in kicking off the pedal at the gallows, Oh Unique Leader! You are the son of the crystal-clear and pure river, Ganga! You are easily accessible to Your devotees! Oh Lord KandhA, You are worshipped by the celestials! Wearing the garland of kadappa flowers, You drown Yourself in the bosom of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs! This town ThiruvaNNAmalai is famous for its glory, and on its tall tower, You, the six-faced one, are seated with relish, Oh Great One!

439.english_pathavurai: Their hair is dark like the black cloud. Their eye-brows are curved like the bows. Their eyes are sharp like the arrow. On their lotus-like face, the decorative mark sits beautifully. With the chain hanging from their neck heaving, they display their prominent bosom that looks like Mount MEru. With the bangles and bracelets neatly arranged in a stack on their arms, these women show their thread-like slender waist that caves in. Their gait is like that of the peacock with a plume of feathers. With their anklets making a jingling sound and the attire on their body loosening, they come dancing along the nice streets to negotiate a price for their breasts and resort to treacherous and provocative tricks ensnaring the men. Showing flirtatious affection to their suitors, these women entice them with their eyes and administer potions of seductive passion. The hand-drums, bells and drums made a continuous noise sounding "sEkaNac chekaNa thOthimith thikuda dAdu duttamada deeku thaththokurthi theetha kaththimitha thO"; the entire world was terrified; the thousand hoods of the Serpent AdhisEshan got blunted; the huge mount MEru was shattered; all the islands where the demons had settled were destroyed, and everyone over there screamed in distress as You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! She belongs to the VEdAs and their scriptures; She is the Primeval Principle for many causes; She is the powerful Shakthi who gave birth to me; She is endowed with the throne of the lion; She is SivagAmi, concorporate on the left side of Lord SivA; and You are the child delivered by this Virtuous Goddess, Oh MurugA! He restored the stolen VEdAs* to Lord Brahma; She is the daughter of that Lord VishNu, who was in deep love with You; desiring to join that beautiful damsel, VaLLi, You came to be seated with relish in ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!

440.english_meanings_list: ["Because of the sea that has become notoriously black and stirred up by multitude of makara fish, makes a roaring noise, surrounding all available space,", "and because of the moon in its waxing phase spreading poison everywhere through its rays, that dips deep into the vadavA mukAgni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole on the doom's day at the end of the aeon) and comes out after immersing in fire,", "this girl of mine, with hair like the dark cloud and a waistline like the creeper vanji (rattan reed), is suffering due to pangs of separation from You; kindly consider alleviating her suffering", "by granting her liberation on coming to her, mounted on the graceful peacock having greenish hue, purity and victory and which dances beautifully!", "She is the beautiful and soft KuRavA girl; You hug, with Your hallowed chest, the exhilarated bosom of that VaLLi, which is smeared with sandal paste and nectar!", "You are the Deity of amarAvathi, the capital of the celestial land, beautiful ThiruchchendhUr and the prosperous town of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord!", "To protect the seven worlds, You wielded the bright spear that shattered the heads of the demons and pierced through the seven mountains, Oh Lord!", "The AdhityAs (sons of adhithi), the celestials, Lord VishNu, Rudran and BrahmA, seated on the lotus, were all relieved when You allayed their fear, Oh Great One!"]
440.english_pathavurai: Because of the sea that has become notoriously black and stirred up by multitude of makara fish, makes a roaring noise, surrounding all available space, and because of the moon in its waxing phase spreading poison everywhere through its rays, that dips deep into the vadavA mukAgni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole on the doom's day at the end of the aeon) and comes out after immersing in fire, this girl of mine, with hair like the dark cloud and a waistline like the creeper vanji (rattan reed), is suffering due to pangs of separation from You; kindly consider alleviating her suffering by granting her liberation on coming to her, mounted on the graceful peacock having greenish hue, purity and victory and which dances beautifully! She is the beautiful and soft KuRavA girl; You hug, with Your hallowed chest, the exhilarated bosom of that VaLLi, which is smeared with sandal paste and nectar! You are the Deity of amarAvathi, the capital of the celestial land, beautiful ThiruchchendhUr and the prosperous town of ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Lord! To protect the seven worlds, You wielded the bright spear that shattered the heads of the demons and pierced through the seven mountains, Oh Lord! The AdhityAs (sons of adhithi), the celestials, Lord VishNu, Rudran and BrahmA, seated on the lotus, were all relieved when You allayed their fear, Oh Great One!

445.english_pathavurai: Lavishly smearing fragrant musk and rose water on their body that is filled with faeces, wearing dazzling jewellery on their mountain-like bosom, the source of all evil, smiling in many a way, letting loose their hair that is dark like the cloud, the forest and the sea, bedecked with fragrant flowers, and slackening off their slender thread-like waist, they behave shamelessly; I have maintained intimate relationship with these whores, roaming about hankering after them as if they are my only refuge; I have been an utter fool, nevertheless, kindly grant me Your hallowed feet, representing the Knowledge of Lord SivA! Shattering the past deeds of the devotees who speak of Your glory, You grant them graciously the blissful status of Your unique and beautiful peacock! She is the unique Goddess KALi who dances along with Lord SivA; She is SivagAmi, full of graciousness; and You are the son of that UmAdEvi! You are the child of the six-faced river, Gangai! You played with VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, to her heart's content and took her as Your consort! You are the nephew of the primordial and victorious Lord VishNu, who came as RagurAman! You are seated in the great town, ThiruvaNNAmalai, Oh Great One!

446.english_pathavurai: This body enjoys its association with rich life in this resourceful world. Feigning great friendship, five treacherous people (namely five senses) have entered this body. They have resorted to this destructive path of making me miserable; making me enjoy the worldly life with family, wealth and relatives who please me by heaping their praises. With tender love I cherish this little cottage of my body; (ultimately), this body is laid in a ditch to be preyed upon by eagles with sharp and split beaks and dogs. This body decays into a corpse; this cottage of a body, always doted on by me, is destroyed without any use. Will You make me Your target and direct me towards an undeviating path of bliss, making the worldly delusions, deceptions, caste and creed disappear, and granting me Your hallowed feet, namely, the True Knowledge of SivA? The forests of Thiripuram were shattered to pieces; Manmathan who held the bow of sugarcane and had a handsome body was reduced to ashes; when the powerful Lord SivA burnt them (with His third eye) creating fire and smoke; that SivA delivered You to us graciously! He terrified and thrashed everyone in all the eight directions and took many unique disguises; that demon SUran was destroyed and fell prey to Your famous spear in the battle making You happy, Oh Lord! When You entered the millet field, full of love, and the damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi, pretty as Lakshmi, was scared (at the sight of the elephant), You reassured her saying "Do not be scared by this famous elephant; do not cry, and come to me" and then, You embraced her. In order that I, the basest person, be eligible to enter the domain of SivA kindly accept me granting the requisite greatness! You have Your abode at ThirukkALathi*, famous for its wisdom and beauty, Oh Lord KanthA, Oh Great One!

448.english_pathavurai: BrahmA, seated on the lotus, has created all moving and stationary things on this planet called the earth; thereon, the five elements gathered together to create this human body; driven by attachment leading to desire, this body roamed about merrily; being unable to cross over the deceitful and immoral trickeries of the whores, I became a lying vagrant; I was distressed and weakened; many diseases and my bad deeds swathed my body. Kindly, therefore, grant me an unwavering mind and protect me by bestowing Your blessings. You are the beloved son delivered by the Primordial and beautiful Goddess PArvathi, wearing the pretty anklets, and who occupies the left side of Lord Sankara! You adorn Your feet with anklets and hold the staff with the emblem of a Rooster! He allowed the crescent moon to stroll about on His tresses; He wore on His chest the serpent with a raised hood; He holds in His hand the powerful bow (pinAkam) and in another hand, the trident; from the very deep and wide milky ocean, emerged the dark and evil poison, AlakAlam, which was swallowed and held on the neck by Him, of great Effulgence (known as Neelakantar); on the strong shoulders of that great Lord SivA, You crawled as a baby gorgeously, Oh Master! When Lord Vishnu roamed about uncontrollably as a wild lion (Narasimham), His arrogance was shattered* by Veerabhadrar (an incarnation of Lord SivA) who, as a saraba bird, flew angrily and with a loud noise; (that Lord Veerabhadrar) had earlier offended the Sun (during Dhakshayagnam); for the atonement of that offence,** He performed a holy penance in the Southern KailAsh (known as KAlahasthi), which is Your abode from where You bless all Your devotees, Oh Great One!

449.english_meanings_list: ["You are my Master dancing at the Golden Shrine of Chidhambaram", "in the form of merciful Murugesa, the Great One!", "When BrahmA, with a golden complexion, beseeched You for mercy,", "You knocked his head with Your lotus-like hand; You are that bright flame of knowledge and the Great One!", "You play joyfully with those devotees who seek You out to worship", "and show zeal, pleasure and love for them, You Great One!", "You are BrahmA, You are all the sages, You are the DEvAs, You are SivA ruling AruNagiri and also", "You are the Light that emanates from my pure exhaled breath, You Great One!", "You are the nephew of Sri Rama, the Consort of JAnaki;", "so speak a hundred scriptures with pleasure - You are that Kumaraswamy, the Great One!", "SivagAmi (PArvathi), who protects all those who surrender to her and destroys dynasties of all demons in the battlefield,", "delivered You, with the name of MurugA, the Great One!", "Well settled in the millet-field at VaLLimalai, is the sweet damsel of KuRavas, VaLLi,", "and You are her affectionate lover and consort, Oh Great One!", "You are also the consort of DEvayAnai, the peacock-like maiden reared by the unique elephant (AirAvatham), and", "You reside with her at the befitting town of PuliyUr (Chidhambaram), Oh Great One!"]
449.english_pathavurai: You are my Master dancing at the Golden Shrine of Chidhambaram in the form of merciful Murugesa, the Great One! When BrahmA, with a golden complexion, beseeched You for mercy, You knocked his head with Your lotus-like hand; You are that bright flame of knowledge and the Great One! You play joyfully with those devotees who seek You out to worship and show zeal, pleasure and love for them, You Great One! You are BrahmA, You are all the sages, You are the DEvAs, You are SivA ruling AruNagiri and also You are the Light that emanates from my pure exhaled breath, You Great One! You are the nephew of Sri Rama, the Consort of JAnaki; so speak a hundred scriptures with pleasure - You are that Kumaraswamy, the Great One! SivagAmi (PArvathi), who protects all those who surrender to her and destroys dynasties of all demons in the battlefield, delivered You, with the name of MurugA, the Great One! Well settled in the millet-field at VaLLimalai, is the sweet damsel of KuRavas, VaLLi, and You are her affectionate lover and consort, Oh Great One! You are also the consort of DEvayAnai, the peacock-like maiden reared by the unique elephant (AirAvatham), and You reside with her at the befitting town of PuliyUr (Chidhambaram), Oh Great One!

450.english_pathavurai: He has a trunk; He is youthful; He is luminous; He has an elephant's face; He is the substance of all VEdAs (scriptures); His name is KaRpaga VinAyagar*; and You are His younger brother, Oh Great One! She is SivagAmi, the queen of chastity, and Nithya KalyaNi (Harbinger of good for ever); and You are the Master of Her consort, Lord SivA, Oh Great One! You are the nephew of Rama, whose complexion is like the dark rainy clouds! You hold in Your hand the victorious Spear, Oh Great One! Making the mountainous planets tremble with fear, as it sweeps its feathers furiously; is Your victorious Peacock, Oh Great One! Those lovely six faces and the vast bejewelled chest of Yours can never be seen in any other part of this Universe, Oh Great One! 452.english_pathavurai: When I praise You heartily, saying "Oh GuhA! Oh Great Master!" blissfully sweet honey wells up profusely in my inner tongue due to Your grace. As the nectar of SivA sprouts within me, the hunger in my stomach is satiated. The root of my wicked deeds, both good and bad, evil vices and diseases are totally destroyed. I happily chant the ManthrA "Om NamasivAya". I reach a blissful zone in the ether where day and night cease to exist. I realise that this is the ultimate destination where the matchless and heavenly cosmic dance by the Lord takes place, and in that beautiful thought process I have the vision of the Lord with coral-like body and hallowed feet, accompanied by His devotees who have already attained those feet. Mounting Your beautiful, gold-like and young peacock, that can give refuge to all, kindly grant me Your golden feet! To the meter of "thakuda thakuthaku thAthaka than-thath thikuda thikuthiku theethaka thon-thath thadudu dudududu dAdaka dingku", the two small drums (tabElA), the large drums (thimilai), flutes, and other percussion instruments of the variety, pampai and karadi (making animal sounds) hand-drums (udukkai) and veeNAs - all these created a loud noise; the slain corpses were scattered all over; with the speed of a cyclone, You went to the battlefield; the dancing red eagles flocked together as if a space was enclosed blocking the skyview; those eagles' hunger was satiated, and the demons were killed; the seas were agitated due to boisterous waves and the eight great serpents were terror-stricken when You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! Your father, Lord SivA, who danced in Mount KailAsh, was delighted with a molten heart when You played with Him teasingly. You have Your abode at the golden stage in Chidhambaram, Oh Kantha, the Great One!

455.english_pathavurai: Daubing the perfume of civet and fragrant rose-water on their hair profusely, these pretty whores display their robust bosom looking like the Mount Manthara and like the white ivory tusks of the elephant; they have bedecked bunches of flowers on their beautiful hair and smeared the soothing paste of turmeric on their face; also adorning with shaNpaka (champak) flowers, these women look like the young creeper vanji (rattan reed), resembling the green parrot, the endearing cuckoo and the peacock; they come to their bed made of cotton mattress and gleefully suffer the scars (of nail-marks), dishevelling their nice garments and enhancing my harm and passion simultaneously; I blabber a lot of words of vows; my eyes and ears, that enjoyed the bliss of passion (earlier), are now in a reverse gear (leaving me blind and deaf), and I am now laid up on the bed along with all my vows; am I destined to die away like this? To the beats sounding like "thanthananthana thanthananthana thinthiminthimi thinthiminthimi", conches, large drums along with similar percussion instruments, the beads in the anklets making the noise "sanjalanj chala" and many large and round tom-toms that look like the moon made a loud noise as the treacherous demons perished on the battlefield; white eagles, the reddish garudans (bald-eagles) that soar high on the sky and the vultures closed in flocking from all directions over the top of the battlefield which turned red (due to the gushing blood) as You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! This golden stage in Chidhambaram that belongs to Lord SivA and that is praised and ardently worshipped by the moon, Indra, the celestials and other denizens of the sky is also Your lovely abode, Oh Lord! You are the Lord of Your devotees, Oh Great One!
