456.english_pathavurai: The golden chain worn around their neck pressed hard on their chest with bosom of the size of Mount Manthara; these women smear a paste of fragrant sandalwood powder and red vermillion, sprinkled with rose water. They have moon-like face. Their hair is like the cloud. Their eyes are comparable to the arrow, the kayal fish and the sword. Their hair is adorned with a bunch of red lilies. Their curly ears prominently display the studs. They dance until their caving-in waistline is sore. They cast magic spell on their suitors by administering potions of subjugating medicines. They prattle flirtingly. They are like the creeper (rattan reed) capable of provoking passionate delusion. When their suitors enter their home, they enquire as to where they are from adding that they appear to be very familiar. They keep on rattling sweet words to arouse passion and come beautifully into close quarters of their suitors with affection, welcoming them inside their home and singing amorous songs to induce fervent foreplay. To imbibe the rich honey, in other words, to grab the suitors' belongings, they show a lot of enthusism in love-making as soon as they see gold placed on their own palm. Because of such whores, I felt miserable, contracting paralysis and similar debilitating diseases; with puss-forming scabies, worms, oozing wounds all over my body, along with poisonous and infectious bites, delirium caught at a young age, venereal disease and a host of other afflictions, I scampered hither and thither with a deteriorating body and entered the wretched sea of Yaman (God of Death); to enable me to cross that sea, kindly preach the manthra by which I could attain Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord! Against the background sound of the drums in the sky, the leaders of Lord's SivA's group (gaNAs) praised, along with vEdic scholars, IndrA, the Moon, the Sun, many poets, sages, VyAkrapAdhar, Pathanjali, Brahma, the handsome Lord VishNu, Goddesses Lakshmi and Saraswathi, the consorts of sages who have performed rare sacrifices, many celestial maids such as Rambai and others, the distinguished maids of the nAgA land, several terrestrial damsels and Arundhathi also joining in the extolment, as He danced raising His reddish lotus-feet; concorporate on the side of that Lord SivA as well as dwelling in His heart, is the beautiful Goddess SivagAmi (UmAdEvi), who delivered You, Oh Lord KandhA! drums, distinguished percussion instruments of the mELam family and conches made a roaring sound to the meter "thinthimi thinthimi thOthiminthimi theethathi thinthitha theethithinthimi thanthana thanthana nAthananthana thAnathananthananA" as You smashed the heads of the demons to pieces by wielding Your spear, Oh Lord! She lives in the beautiful mountainous region of VaLLimalai where fields of reddish millet abound; She is the youthful, creeper-like damsel, VaLLi; You fell at her feet in prostration and had the glorious vision of her hallowed face, Oh Lord with sacred feet! Holding the spear in Your holy hand, You came to the earth to be seated at the golden-red stage in Chidhambaram, with corridors surrounding the inner shrine, Oh Great One!

457.english_pathavurai: Having taken manifold births in this world, after soaking in the semen again and again, and my body having been burnt repeatedly, I am exhausted of this humdrum activity. As if it has vowed to take several births, my life has entered innumerable forms and shapes; and in that process, I have suffered degeneration time and again. In order that You take hold of me heartily, You must come mounted on Your elephant*, surrounded by the Celestials and Your devotees. Bless me so that my birth, which is nothing but a jungle of delusions, is burnt down. The Celestial girls, who are accomplished singers, must approach me liltingly, dancing in devotional ecstasy and playing ball; With beetles crowding around the kadappa garlands adorning Your shoulders, Your pretty golden lock of hair and Your lovable beautiful lotus feet, You must appear before me and bless me with a mind that thinks only of You! The celestials ran away awestruck; The Vidhyadharas (the learned in the Heaven) ran away worried; The Divine Musicians and BrahmA Himself fled demoralised; Vishnu, the ultimate mystic credited with devouring the earth spread out in all eight directions, was so scared that He fell at Your feet seeking refuge; when the opposing wild demons, spread out like a forest, were burnt down by the fiery Spear that was shot off by You from Your reddish hand, Oh VElA! VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, with prominent breasts looking like the ivory tusks of the elephant was exhilarated when You hugged her shoulders passionately! You had a grand wedding with DEvayAnai, the daughter brought up by an elephant (AirAvatham), Oh Lord KanthA! Once, the forest called Thiripuram was destroyed by His mere smile that ignited a huge fire (emanating from His fiery eye); He is of reddish hue like fire; and He dances the Cosmic dance on the golden stage (in Chidhambaram) praised by the Celestials. He is SivA, the great Deity of the Stage, and You are His Master, Oh Great One!

460.english_pathavurai: With their looks comparable to a parrot, these women dance like the peacock. With arrow-like eyes and hair resembling rain-bearing cloud, these statuette-like women have lilting anklets that give out sound in measured beats. Their milk-bearing bosom looks like the blue krouncha bird and like a golden pot with which they hug (their suitors) tightly. These pretty women appearing as if they came off a painting deceive and grab money. They establish a blatant lie as truth through their insistence. These beautiful whores are capable of murder causing misery. These treacherous women make the men reel under their influence by pumping delusory passion into them. They show their liking to whoever is able to advance money in their hand. They speak very haughty words that entice the suitors and cast a magic spell by showing affection until the desired amount of money is tendered. Afflicted by bouts of vomitting, venereal disease, virulent carbuncle on the sides of the chest, miserable hiccups, dysentery, biliousness and a host of other ailments, this wicked thief (namely, myself) is so much debilitated. When will be the day when the various status of heavenly bliss* will be granted to me? As the seven debased and treacherous mountains were smashed to pieces and the protectors of the eight cardinal directions sang hymns extolling Your valour, You resorted to several victory dances, Oh Lord with the spear! She is like the wish-yielding Divine Gem (ChinthAmaNi) concorporate on the left side of the triumphant Lord SivA; She is the most virtuous damsel; She is our Mother enjoying the love of Her devotees; She is like a beautiful parrot; She possesses the fiery eyes that burnt down the revolving and flying Thiripuram; and You are the son of that Goddess PArvathi! To stay very close to the wonderful and beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs, You assumed the disguise of a bangle-merchant and played a number of deceptive games with her and danced about; when that VaLLi, known for her sharp intelligence, hugged Your shoulders, You took her over and united with her completely, Oh Lord! He is the Supreme Knowledge, the greatest principle and the Lord Rudra presiding at the beautiful and prosperous shrine Chidhambaram; He is the leader holding the trident with three distinct leaves; He is Lord NadarAjar dancing on the golden stage to the beat of "thiththi"; and You are the Master of that Lord SivA, Oh Great One!

471.english_pathavurai: (Not letting the pranic air -oxygen- to be dissipated and) holding it in its place * 1 , arousing the auspicious flame of SivA located in the lotus of MUlAdhara ChakrA * 2 making it leap right up to the cosmic zone (Brahamaranthiram), creating the union of SivA and Sakthi with a deafening sound, mounting the white horse * 3 that remains numinously standing in the hall specially built, driving that horse along the street of SivA that yields all wishes like the KaRpaga tree, arriving at the plank called lalAtam * 4 where all tenets converge, practicing there many yOgA methods * 5 (such as DhyAnam, PrathyAkaraNam, DharaNai), carefully binding the breath so as to hold the nectar from the moon from spilling and the energy from slipping, wearing the holy ash and standing still, burning into ashes the three slags (thiripuram - represented by arrogance, karma and delusion), acquiring the eight siddhis * 6 , knocking down the mischief created by the ninety-six tenets, attaining the heavenly pinnacle of SivA, the Lord of eight characteristics * 7 , remaining entrenched in that bliss of my Lord, burning away the misery of birth, imbibing the nectar of true knowledge, turning my body into a solid diamond rock, changing my complexion into a golden hue, and attaining pure liberation, will I be able to sing Your glory in an amazing VEdic meter? Into my ears, a stupid fool who does not even know that eight and two make ten, You preached that those numbers are the symbols of SivA * 8 and further elucidated that they represent the PraNava ManthrA OM * 9 , Oh MurugA, my Master! In all the ten directions (the usual eight directions, along with zenith and nadir, the top and the bottom of the celestial sphere), You let the red blood flow; You assumed sixteen postures * 10 and wielded the spear upon the treacherous demons in the battlefield and also those demons in many worlds situated in the ten directions, Oh Lord! He assumed the appearance of a bangle-vendor and went around the streets of Madhurai ruled by AngayaRkaNNi (an incarnation of PArvathi); He placed the bangles on the wrists of the Queen squeezing until they turned red and bargained for a price of the bangles; He is my Lord SivA; to the cool content of His heart, You preached to Him the powerful principle of PraNava ManthrA, which is without a beginning, Oh Master! You also assumed the appearance of a bangle-vendor and reached the forest in VaLLimalai; You fell deeply in love with VaLLi, representing the Divine Energy of desire; and then You abducted her, Oh Lord, and came to be seated in the golden shrine of Chidhambaram, Oh Great One!

472.english_pathavurai: Those people who are devious and with a poisonous mind are shunned by me as untrustworthy and dangerous. I am seeking Your friendly hallowed feet with abundant love, screaming "Oh Our Lord, I am surrendering to You" Has my scream not reached Your ears? Or is it because You are so constantly looking at Your consorts that You failed to hear me? Can anyone dare to underestimate Your word and transgress You? My protection is entirely Your responsibility! Who else is there by my side to help me? Just like You took care of the need of DEvAs, You must come before me to my aid. Once, You jumped to reach for the Head of BrahmA and banged it with Your reddish knuckles, Your eyes brimming with fun! You embrace the beautiful shoulders of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, with eyes like fish; and Your shoulders pressed hers just like the perfectly fitting shirt! The seven hills trembled, and water in the seas receded and dried up when You drove the entire families of the demons (asuras) up the sky to their death, Oh Lord KanthA! The entire Universe praises our Lord SivA whose abode is Pulisai (Chidhambaram), where NadarAjA dances at the Golden Shrine; and You are His Great Master!

483.english_pathavurai: They are extremely avaricious; they are capable of committing sorcerous and sinful acts; they are raiders like the whirlwind; they are utterly useless; they fool around with their flippant and killing eyes; their passionate advances can lure anyone; with their red lips like the kovvai fruit, these wicked women utter deceitful words; they feign love outwardly, falling all over, but carry on relationship in a hurting manner; the blemish in their heart is like darkness; they have inbuilt antagonism; and I have been roaming around, like a dog, in the delusory circle of such whores! You have chosen Your seat in the Western Tower of the Temple in Chidhambaram, Oh Great One!

485.english_pathavurai: Bones, skin, hair, clusters of veins and arteries, the dormant puss, worms and germs, various parts of the brain, sea of blood, water, faeces - these are all filled in this body, a slimy pond; general weakness, anaemia, rheumatism, paralysis, stomach ache, chUlai (another kind of stomach pain), extreme breathlessness, the worst kind of piles, swelling of the testicles, nervous debility, high fever, diabetes, bronchitis causing accumulation of phlegm, deafness, hunched back, cholera, blindness, lameness, itchy ring worm around the neck that eats the flesh from inside,- such diseases have settled inside this miserable body; thinking that this body is everlasting, I, the lowly dog, roam about aimlessly afflicted by my bad deeds. In this famous town called PuliyUr (Chidhambaram), You remain the highest principle by the side of the northern temple tower, Oh Unique Lord!

487.english_pathavurai: Diseases caused by excessive rheumatism and biliousness, eczema, stone-like abcess of carboncle, bronchitis, whooping cough, ringworm around the neck, cancer, dizziness and vertigo, acute fever, night-blindness, blindness caused by gingivitis, deafness due to blockage of ear, speech-impairedness, spasmic fits and seizures, and bleeding piles - these are some of the diseases grown and ripened in the tree of this body! This body is the seat where the ninety-six tenets* seek orderly occupation; This body is the arena many games of Lord Almighty, the essence of all scriptures, who takes many forms and tosses it like a little boat on the high seas; this body also puts on various costumes and roams about greedily to make money, and in that process, poisons itself slowly; it builds a house and, therin, crumbles due to passionate lust. I do not want to miss the inner musical tone and die in vain; for that, You will have to grant me liberation and a place in the heaven. May I not meditate on You and have the blissful vision of Your cosmic dance, mounted on the Peacock? The seas with roaring waves, the clouds and thousands of hoods of the serpent-king (AdhisEshan) were all shattered to pieces; the demon SUran, his protective (seven) hills and the demons living thereon were all destroyed; when You wielded the fiery and famous Spear of Yours into the seas, Oh Lord! He is the primordial substance of the five lettered ManthrA coupled with "OM", namely, "OM NAMASIVAYA"; He is benevolent to all His pure devotees; He is concorporate with UmAdEvi, the emerald-green Goddess, as a part of His side; He is the gracious jewel on the crown, Lord SivA; and You are His Son! You emerged after the Primeval VinAyagA, who is like the wish-yielding KaRpaga tree, Oh Handsome Saravanabava! Oh Lord, You knew the meaning and the method of interpretation of the Primordial PraNava ManthrA! You went to the millet-field everyday to meet Your beloved VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and eventually married her in the pure traditional manner! In the great town of PuliyUr (Chidhambaram), You are seated with relish at the beautiful tower, shining like gold and marble, Oh Great One!

488.english_pathavurai: Because of the cooing of the cuckoos that love to gather in the groves where beetles swarm, because of the gusty and chilly northerly wind, because of the impact on her body of the rapid, fragrant and flowery arrows wielded by Manmathan (the God of Love), because of the scandal-mongering abuse of the women who pursue her, because of the just-blossomed flowers sprinkled all over her bed which is the playground of Manmathan, powerfully showing off his valour, and because of the sound of the little bells tied around the necks of the bulls returning home (after the day's grazing) this deer-like damsel suffers from the agony of separation; understanding her plight and looking for the opportune moment, will You not kindly grant her the nectar-dripping fresh garland swaying on Your chest? When GaNapathi appeared menacingly as the dark, triumphant and raging elephant, the young deer-like belle, VaLLi, sought Your refuge and hid behind You; and You made her Your consort! You are the treasure of a child of Lord SivA who chose the golden stage for His cosmic dance in PerumpatRa PuliyUr (Chidhambaram) which is surrounded by paddy fields filled with sugarcanes! To remove the miseries of those devotees who worship You ardently by offering flowers in an orderly manner, You appear before them mounted on Your comfortable peacock, Oh Lord! When the demon SUran surged forward aggressively, accompanied by his clan, You wielded the Spear and knocked him down, like a child's play, making him roll over the ground, Oh Great One!

The ten heads of RAvaNan who had no inclination to prostrate (at the feet of RAmA) were severed with a single arrow wielded by Him; He blew up the minds of the untruthful demons and destroyed their valour; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Surrounding the demon SUran and his entire foolish clan who fought with arrogance bragging about the greatness of their lineage, You wielded the spear that killed them all in the battlefield, Oh Lord! Being separated from You, the wise men with their heart filled with love, are yearning to worship Your hallowed feet, adorned with anklets and golden kazhal (another kind of anklet) signifying Your valour, in Perum patRap puliyUr (Chidhambaram) where You are seated, Oh Great One!

490.english_pathavurai: He mounts the wild buffalo aptly suited for his driving need; to that God of Death (Yaman), I would become totally subservient; all the wealth and many possessions in my hand have already been gobbled up completely by the eyes of those whores with hair dark as the black sand; all the luxuries and desires worth fulfilling and all the knowledge and fame worth mentioning would become mere myth and depart from me; on that day, when life is about to leave from this body, and when my body is about to be consumed by burning logs heaped up at the cremation ground, when all the relatives assembled there burst into lamentation looking at my body laid on the funeral pyre, and before I am bound by ropes to the wooden coffin on my final march to the cremation ground, either let me merge with You, reaching a state of intense contemplation leading to my sublime goal or give me enough intellect to obtain True Knowledge while I am still living in this world; kindly agree to grant me the boon, choosing any one of the above two alternatives as You deem appropriate for me! He wielded His arrow upon the seven trembling marAmara trees with long branches; He killed VAli, the monkey who wrestled with Sugreevan; the big ocean was devastated, raising a dust storm; all the demons belonging to the clan of their leader, RAvaNan, were shrieking in terror; the whole country of LankA was engulfed by fire as Lord Agni came down hard; the treacherous demon, RAvaNan, haughty due to his huge wealth, was attacked so that his ten heads were totally knocked down when He wielded His arrow; that great hero, Rama, is extremely fond of You, His renowned nephew! Hailing You as the unique poet of this world, triumphant trumpets are blown in Your praise; You came as ThirugnAna Sambandhar, a great Saivite and VEdic jewel on the crown, having composed several ThEvAram hymns choosing noble words. In various scholastic texts, You are the matchless hero; You are for ever auspicious! You reside with relish in Perum PatRap Puliyur (Chidhambaram), Oh Great One!

493.english_pathavurai: If one counts the sands on the shores of the seven seas, even that number is exceeded by the number of my miserable births! I surrender my life and body unto You. I am tired of leaving my body and taking new birth again and again. Eagles, foxes, fire, earth, Yaman (Death-God) and the Creator (BrahmA) are all exhausted in consuming and recreating my bodies. My duty is to surrender to You totally. To this servant, Your service is the only service. You must grant me Your Holy feet immediately. She, who is extremely beautiful, with an emerald green complexion, and who is Purity personified, that PArvathi delivered You unto us, Oh MurugA! Burning the expansive earth and powdering the mighty Krouncha Mount, You came traveling on the swift Peacock! While the seven seas burst out, the demons' (asuras) lives were devoured by Your mighty Spear! At Puliyur (Chidhambaram), DEvAs and Sages* worshipped You when You danced the Cosmic Dance, Oh Great One!

494.english_pathavurai: Merciless Yaman (Death-God) will pick a thick rope and throw it holding its tip to take my life away; to avoid that misery, I must chant all scriptures and VEdAs which have been very well compiled. The six subsects* of the religion are fighting among themselves to the extent of causing headache and utter disgust; to get rid of that frustration, You have to show to Your devotees the embodiment of supreme bliss and tranquility in order that peace prevails. You are the nephew of Hari and Lakshmi, who sits on a fragrant lotus. You are the Treasure of PArvathi, daughter of Mount HimavAn. Lord SivA, who adorns His tresses with a river (Ganga), a crescent moon, kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower, and a serpent, dances in PuliyUr (Chidhambaram), and You belong there, KumarEsA. When angry demons (asuras) came to fight You, they were decimated and scattered around the wavy seas by Your might. Anger towards Your devotees who worship Your two feet adorned by anklets of bravery is unknown even in Your dreams, Oh Great One!

497.english_pathavurai: Wearing saffron coloured robes, growing long unkempt wild tresses, roaming aimlessly around jungles, living on fruits and vegetables, torturing the body with fasting and other rituals, and wandering all over the world are futile. The shrinking of the self into the soul and the control of the five elements and senses will give rise to supreme knowledge and a great illumination. To enable me to see that Light, You must grant me Your cool lotus feet. TharukAsuran and his clan, who were nothing but embodiment of sin, were decimated by Your anger, Oh valorous One! Overjoyed by Your victory, the ghosts in the battlefield clap their hands and sing cacaphonously, and those songs are hailed by You, Oh Lord with the bright Spear! Swans abound in the paddy fields, and plenty of groves surround the town, PuliyUr (Chidhambaram); and You are there! Your peacock dances to the joy of all warriors, and You move about mounted on that peacock, Oh Great One!

So I speak of Your Glory in several ways repeatedly seeking Your ever-fresh lotus feet! I stand before You with a torn mouth due to screaming Your name; and You must come to me graciously to dispel my worries. She has the bright form of the precious Divine gem; She is seated upon the hide of a great lion; and Her name is UmA - You are Her son! You are of the purest form! 506.english_pathavurai: Directing the fire in the lotus at the MUlAdhAra Centre towards the four-square seat of BrahmA, the fifth house, called SwAdhishtAnam* through the susumna** nerve by way of regulated breathing (PrANAyAmam) and meditation, creating a great effulgence in the lunar zone centred at MaNipUragam, the centre which is VishNu's abode, conducting the fire in a coordinated way along the three zones (Agni, the Sun and the Moon) and the six centres (anAgatham and others), witnessing several divine images in all those places, conserving (in a process known as "kumbakam")** the four inches of PrANic air (oxygen), which is vital for preserving the body, by not letting it seep out gradually, hearing the melodious and high-pitch tone of the conch shell, halting at the junction of the Siva-Sakthi union where divine music is heard and imbibing the celestial nectar that is IndrA's bliss, when shall I reach the great golden stage of Lord NadarAja, with His raised left foot, dancing a myriad dances? To rescue all IndrAs, VishNu and BrahmA, You took hold of Your spear and wielded it to burn down the houses of the treacherous demons and to dry up the water in the important seas, Oh Lord! 508.english_pathavurai: A sperm of the size of a drop of dew sets about its journey along the urinary track causing pregnancy; after ten months, the baby arrives on this earth upside down; a few days pass by seeing the baby crawl, its steps stumbling while learning to walk and speech prattling; then they fall into the pit called women with voluptuous bosom and fritter away their precious time; on the appointed day for the visit of the evil God of Death (Yaman), they are unable to hold themselves steady and shed the cottage of their bodies; will I never be spared such a debilitating and delusory grief at all? Mount Krouncha, notorious for its trickery, was shattered to pieces and the arrogant demon SUran was destroyed in the sea when You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! BrahmA's four heads were pulverized and knocked down when You hit them forcefully with Your knuckles! You are the consort of VaLLi who illuminates brightly the hearts of the devotees meditating on her. You are the rich treasure seated in PuliyUr (Chidhambaram) which in itself is the repository of wealth of the world, Oh Great One!

510.english_pathavurai: This body is a decorated bed; a remarkably engineered machine; a receptacle into which bilious juice and urine have been pumped; a nest that loses its strength and deteriorates; the life in this body is a rotten one; it is an artefact manufactured from earthen clay; it is a rock about to slide and crash; it is eventually meant to be a prey for the lean and hungry devil or the hungry and lean dog or the lean and hungry flea; will you kindly eradicate this miserable body and transfer me into that pure and immortal body so that I may obtain the bliss of liberation? You remove the false signs and marks from the bodies of Your devotees and imprint on them Your genuine symbols as identification; then You offer them refuge at Your golden feet, Oh Lord of PuliyUr (Chidhambaram)! The unique brahmin (SivakOchariyAr) who was conspicuous for his display of holy ash (on his forehead) taken from his bag of ash was lucidly taught what true knowledge was by the hunter (KaNNappan) belonging to the jungle in the mountainside; his offering of green leaves in worship, the shower of saliva from his mouth, that was equivalent to holy anointment, and the bow tied to his shoulders, the Lord was enamoured of all these; that SivA happily took hold of him (KaNNappan); and You are the treasure of that SivA! You methodically taught Your father the significance of blissful liberation and captivated Lord SivA's heart! You are the rare treasure found by Your devotees, Oh Great One!

511.english_pathavurai: The earth, that is benefited by the moon, has five* 1 characteristics. That earth is of the shape of a quadrilateral. It assumes the first letter "na" in the five sacred letters (NamasivAya) and takes after the nivarththikalai of the five* 2 kalais. The zone of water has four* 3 characteristics. It denotes the letter "ma" in the PanchAkshara ManthrA (NamasivAya). The zone ahead of that of water is fire which refers to the letter "si" in NamasivAya. This fire zone has three* 4 characteristics and is of the shape of a triangle. The huge zone of air with the inherent quality of destruction has two* 5 characteristics. It is the effulgent avenue where five elements are joined by the sixth unique one making the air zone a hexagon, symbolising the letter "vA" in NamasivAya. The wide open sky (cosmos) is the zone with a unique characteristic (namely sound) and is of an elliptic shape where the bright sun and the moon are contained. This zone is denoted by the letter "ya" in NamasivAya. In a two way path (consisting of REsakam and PUrakam) on the brilliant skull, the horses with two unique gaits called idakalai and pingalai* 6 gallop. (In order to rein those horses and) to spread the gracious rays all over my limbs, I need to acquire the mystical power to be bestowed on me by all the deities that manifest in the zones of the Sun, the Moon and Fire; when will I join the great SivA in the form of Lingam (Nadham - Sound)? The reverbrating drums made noise at a high decibel level to the beats "dangu dAdika"; the five types of percussion instruments of this world (namely, leather instruments, reeds with holes, string instruments, blowers - from the throat, and cymbals) were beaten loudly to the meter "dakuda daNdada thonthathOthaka"; VidhyAdharAs, one of the eighteen classes of sivagaNAs, along with Thumpuru and NAradhar blissfully sang the music of the variety of Sindhu; the celestials played the heavenly drum, blew the conch and the long trumpets, with the resultant noise soaring high; the deluge of blood flowing like a flood everywhere and fire burning incessantly all around, the demons leapt to fight on the battlefield, and the huge bunches of their veins and bones were scattered along with their big heads when You confronted them with rage, Oh Mighty One! The people on this world, rendered fertile and prosperous by the downpours of rain, prospered as Lord NatarAjar danced in this shrine at Chidhambaram, which dance was witnessed by Sage Pathanjali, of the form of a serpent, and VyAkrapAthar, of the form of a tiger; and You are seated here with relish, Oh Great One!

513.english_pathavurai: Hark, Oh my mind, I shall tell you something which will bolster your confidence. Come closer to me and follow my advice implicitly. The Deity mounting the peacock as His vehicle is the king for all His devotees. He is the child-God who can give you bliss, free from mind and delusion. What else do you need to think of? He will give You the celestial world and eternal bliss and He is the great effulgence that can uproot your three slags, namely, arrogance, karma and delusion. He is to us like the celebrated Treasures called the conch-shell treasure, lotus treasure and the celestial tree, KaRpagam*; He is our firm refuge; He is the primordial God; He dispenses justice; You must continue to worship Him. She is the only one whom we can claim as our true relative; She is exquisitely beautiful; She is beyond the comprehension of the great and valuable vEdAs; She is ever youthful; She is absolutely matchless; She is in an unclothed nirvana state; She is the Divine Mother who gave birth to me; She is the famous KalyaNi, known as UmAdEvi; She is held on one side of Lord SivA, our Father, who dons His tresses with kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower; You are the Master of that SivA! The Trinity (consisting of BrahmA, Vishnu and SivA) came along by Your side, praising You and showering flowers like rain all the way; You beheaded the entire clan of the old demon SUran, Oh MurugA! Her words are sweet like the molten jaggery and her teeth are like pearls; She looks like the peacock; for that VaLLi, Your heart melts out of love! Oh MurugA! You elate me everyday; and You are the first and foremost in this world! You are the Lord ruling over all kings of this world. This world, the Ether, and the five elements that engulf both are all Your manifestation as the ManthrA, SIVAYANAMA*, Oh my Lord! 517.english_meanings_list: ["Concentrating on the illuminated zone, guiding the inhaled breath along the route of the pranic air -oxygen- (namely, through idakala and pingala closing them)*,", "holding steadily on to the path of SivA and then rising high to the unique zenith", "for merging with the flame of SivA like in the wedlock of two puppets,", "burning down the three prominent slags (namely, desire, anger and delusion) in the fire caused by Your mere smile,", "also my deeds (both good and bad) being charred to ashes, I wish to focus on Your beautiful and gracious form;", "in this wonderful earth where there is neither darkness nor light, as a result of my penance in my previous births,", "I wish for the union between You and I to happen; because of that union, this body is to be deemed indestructible", "to the envy of even the celestials who must wonder who this youth is; kindly bless me with that strange and singular honour!", "The sounds from His anklets of triumph making deafening noise in all the eight directions;", "the Trinity (BrahmA, VishNu and Rudran) and the ancient VEdAs paid obeisance to Him;", "the trident, the pick-axe and the deer in His hands revolved nimbly;", "the Serpent-King AdhisEshan's hoods cracked with a loud noise;", "as He stepped aside by moving His lotus-like feet from His vehicle, Bull (namely, Nandi) and began to dance;", "His devotees extolled Him with a melting heart saying \"Hara Hara, Jaya Jaya\";", "such a great cosmic dance was graciously presented by Lord SivA, the consort of PArvathi; and You are His son, Oh Lord!", "You relish the blissful duel on the bed with beautiful VaLLi, whose hair is adorned with flowers and who is the daughter of Goddess Lakshmi;", "You are also equally fond of Mount KailAsh where Your devotees live, Oh Great One!"]
517.english_pathavurai: Concentrating on the illuminated zone, guiding the inhaled breath along the route of the pranic air -oxygen- (namely, through idakala and pingala closing them)*, holding steadily on to the path of SivA and then rising high to the unique zenith for merging with the flame of SivA like in the wedlock of two puppets, burning down the three prominent slags (namely, desire, anger and delusion) in the fire caused by Your mere smile, also my deeds (both good and bad) being charred to ashes, I wish to focus on Your beautiful and gracious form; in this wonderful earth where there is neither darkness nor light, as a result of my penance in my previous births, I wish for the union between You and I to happen; because of that union, this body is to be deemed indestructible to the envy of even the celestials who must wonder who this youth is; kindly bless me with that strange and singular honour! The sounds from His anklets of triumph making deafening noise in all the eight directions; the Trinity (BrahmA, VishNu and Rudran) and the ancient VEdAs paid obeisance to Him; the trident, the pick-axe and the deer in His hands revolved nimbly; the Serpent-King AdhisEshan's hoods cracked with a loud noise; as He stepped aside by moving His lotus-like feet from His vehicle, Bull (namely, Nandi) and began to dance; His devotees extolled Him with a melting heart saying "Hara Hara, Jaya Jaya"; such a great cosmic dance was graciously presented by Lord SivA, the consort of PArvathi; and You are His son, Oh Lord! You relish the blissful duel on the bed with beautiful VaLLi, whose hair is adorned with flowers and who is the daughter of Goddess Lakshmi; You are also equally fond of Mount KailAsh where Your devotees live, Oh Great One!

518.english_pathavurai: Honey, three great fruits (mango, plantain and jack fruit), milk, reddish sugarcane and coconut water - the sweetness of these things is surpassed by Sivam; that Sivam's Grace has to sprout copiously inside me. All karmas due to bad deeds and good deeds will be shattered into pieces. I shall realize that this Soul is nothing but SivA's form. My ego will be completely destroyed and my attachment to life and body will be gone; in the milky way of my mind, I shall hear the tune of Brahmam (Omniscience) and in that bright light, Knowledge of Sivam will fill within me like a fountain. In that happy sense of attainment, I should spend every day in eternal bliss; for that, You must grant me Your Holy Feet! To save the DEvAs in the Skies, to let this poor soul flourish, and to let BrahmA and Vishnu survive (the ferocious attack of Suran), (SivA decided) to lessen the effect of the poison that came from the milky sea; His hands picked up all that poison.* He is the protecting Father of all of us. He holds Fire and a deer in His hands.** That Sivan gracefully gave You to us, Oh MurugA! In the tune of "dhAnan thanaththathana nA" beetles go around humming and suck the honey in the rich kadappa flower (in the garland) adorning Your chest! (To this meter), the drums, conch shells, trumpets, percussion instruments, inferior banging equipment like muzhavu and ekkALam, and others made so much noise that it sounded like the roaring seven seas; the anger of the demons, who bombastically boasted about their valour at the various corners of the battlefield, was destroyed; the chariots fell; the blood gushing from elephants and strong horses covered all the eight directions; and the devils, jackals and birds (like vultures) rejoiced when You wielded the spear with a gracious laugh, Oh Lord! 524.english_pathavurai: My black hair grew increasingly grey. Both my healthy eyes became hollow. My fleshy cheeks shrank and my ears became skinny. My neckline was totally bent out of shape. My broad and firm back became hunched. All my teeth had fallen from the jaws. There was uncontrollable oozing from my lips. Just when I was about to fall asleep, coughing started so intensely as to shake my bones. My strong and resonant voice became feeble and scratchy. The cane became one of my legs. My firm steps began to slow down. Before my body becomes ripe due to old age, will I ever be able to serve Your devotees who have willingly surrendered to You? He incarnated in the form of a little fish; and when the VEdAs were hidden deep under the huge wavy ocean, He (as Vishnu in Mathsya avathAram) successfully rescued them. He shot the arrows at the bay, and built a new bridge across the sea; with the help of His younger brother Lakshmanan, and in the happy company of Hanuman, who gauged RavanA's strength correctly (and set fire to LankA), along with His army of monkeys, He invaded LankA, with its strong fortress walls, and knocked RavanA's ten heads down by the strength of His bow (KOthaNdam); and He is Rama, an incarnation of Mukundhan (Vishnu). 525.english_pathavurai: Oh SaravanNabhava*, Our Treasure, Six-faced Kumara, Great Master, Oh SaravanNabhava, Our Treasure, Six-faced Kumara, Great Master, Oh SaravanNabhava, Our Treasure, Six-faced Kumara, Great Master, With these names we, Your devotees, are praying in Tamil eloquently. Our cycles of birth and death should be ended, and we should reach SivA's Land. Our diseases arising from karma should flee. We pray for this boon, and You should grant it to make our lives happy! Your eyes are full of compassion and grace! You are the younger brother of the unique primary God, elephant-faced VinAyagA, who is always at Your side! The souls of the devotees dedicating their sweet poems to You are assured of salvation by Your grace and love! Lives in this world surrounded by seas go through so many sufferings; they are subject to much confusion and such agonies; and to remove all these and for them to attain eternal bliss, the only solution is the shadow of Your two feet. Will You grant me that shadow one of these days? Oh KumarA, You were delivered to us by Lord SivA who burnt down Thiripuram! At the sanctums of ThiruppOrUr, ThiruththaNigai, very famous Sivagiri and ThiruvEngkadam, You have Your abode, Oh Lord with a sharp spear! You reside in the hearts of Your devotees who sing Your praise daily! You also dwell in their two wealths, material and spiritual! You come as the Sun of Wisdom to dispell the darkness of our arrogance! The tall one, who sleeps on the bed of AdhisEshan, who is also Narasimhan, that Vishnu - You have come as His nephew, and You are full of wonders! One who removes all slags of the mind, One who is the purest and One who is supreme, that UmAdEvi, PArvathi, has delivered You to us, Oh MurugA! The seven lower worlds, starting from Athala and Vithala, trembled severely when Your Peacock flew over, with You mounted on it, full of light! You prevail in the middle of the ShaNmugA Hexagonal Wheel (ShadkONam)**, seated beautifully, Oh Harahara Siva Siva, Oh Great One!

526.english_pathavurai: Their hair is cool like the jasmine flowers containing honey-drops; it is tied up exquisitely and looks like black sand; it is curly and filled with aroma; its black shade puts darkness to shame; it is adorned with fragrant flowers neatly arranged in a row; happy beetles, thriving in the sweet scent of flowers, swarm around it; it scares away the night (with its darkness); it is snarl-free, sitting pretty in matchless style on a high pedestal; its curls are wavy; it is highly provocative and very inviting; its colour is like the black pigment painted on the eyes; the hair of these women is filled with the pleasant smell of musk, intermingled with the rich scented smoke from ignited akil (incence); their forehead shines with the green decorative mark that sticks like glue; that dot contains a red, curvy and rich arc looking like the crescent of the moon; that arc on the forehead looks like the bow of Manmathan (God of Love) and the rain-bow commanded by Lord IndrA; by that hair, the forehead, and by all the birth-marks over the body, as well as by the reddish and wonderful sides of their figure, I became enthralled; although I am negligent of the true worship upheld by the scriptures declaring that there is no permanent solace other than Your lotus feet and that those hallowed feet alone can grasp and deliver all the wishes of the mind, kindly bless me! When poison was consumed (by Bheeman), his glow was unaffected by the poison; when sharp swords were kept hidden in a pond to snare him, the tips of the swords were revealed (by KrishnA to Bheeman)*; shattering the poison on its head, He danced gracefully on the hood of the serpent (KALingan); He is Lord VishNu, of the hue of dark cloud, who (as RAmA) wielded the deadly arrow on the seas; on His hallowed chest, the ever-smiling Goddess Lakshmi is concorporate; He holds the conch-shell and the disc in His lotus-hands while fighting; He is the mystic Lord VishNu; He threw the rotten intestines of the demons to the hungry jackals, swords and fire to devour; He is the enemy of the demon NarakA, and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu and His matchless consort, Lakshmi, Oh Lord! Her bosom is daintily covered by the knotted blouse made of silk; its movement is like that of the nectar-filled pot; it looks as though it is moulded from the juice of sugar-cane; You simply drown in that fragrant and huge bosom of VaLLi, hugging her with Your twelve shoulders! Your chest is adorned with precious gems made of gold, Oh Lord! Feeding the roaring spear that is prominently held in Your hand, You fiercely destroyed SUran, the leader of the demons, who came with his clan of black-complexioned demons amidst the loud beating of drums, Oh Young Lord! On both sides of the path-way leading to this mountain, forests abound; You are seated in that Mount ThiruvEngkadam, Oh Great One!

528.english_pathavurai: Without peace of mind, I was possessed by lust, scorching me like fire. Desire, like a cyclone, was playing havoc in my mind. Never-ending disputes in the name of religion making it a doomed one, but big as an ocean, could never be crossed by me. I believed that in this world wife, children, family and friends are the only support! Indulging in the pleasures of women, thinking about embracing their pretty young lotus-like bosoms, splashed with vermillion and sandal paste, I lost my balance of judgement and became very desperate. In the end, my precious life was being snatched away by Yaman (Death-God), and I was left all alone without anyone by my side. Is this a fitting end to me? She has soft arms like the daffodils (kAnthaL); She was delivered by Lakshmi in the disguise of a deer; She looks like a peahen; She is VaLLi, and You are Her consort! You manifested as a Luminous Light on a VishAkA day, Oh SaravaNabhava, You redeemed the beautiful City, AmarAvathi, DEvAs' Capital, and ruled! All the scriptures praise You as the most valorous one! You are the consort of DEvayAnai, who is bright as a creeper of lightning, and who was reared by AirAvatham, the White Elephant of IndrA! Oh King! Oh youthful KumArA! Oh GuhA, who always dwells in the cave of my heart! Oh Virtuous One, with Peacock as Your vehicle! You reside in the holy mountain of ThiruvEngkadam, in the Northern Frontier! 534.english_pathavurai: This is a bag filled with a bundle of treachery and lies; it is a bag of flesh with a lot of holes; it is a leather bag containing lethargy, anger and stealth, caused by the mischievous and frenzied God of Love (Manmathan) holding a bow of sugarcane; it is a bag filled with many kinds of gases in rapid circulation; it is a bag of rubbish meant to be snatched away and emptied by Yaman (God of Death); it is a muddy bag containing the soul and other shackles (of attachment); it is a bag of illusions, filled with sins; it is a bag in which puss and mucus accumulate; it is a bag in which utter fatigue prevails; this bag of my body contains flesh, liver and other parts all of which would be devoured by barking dogs, eagerly biting into, and pulling them apart, with their teeth. Why can I not get rid of such a body? You are the consort of the highly intelligent damsel, DEvayAnai; and You are the son-in-law of IndrA, master of the white elephant (AirAvadham), and of Lord VishNu who slumbers on the milky ocean! You walked for the sake of VaLLi on a rugged path in a dense forest (of VaLLimalai*) filled with humming beetles and birds which fall prey to the hunters. When Your father Lord SivA beseeched You to explain "the righteous way of meditation as practised by VaLLi", in the twinkling of an eye**, You preached its significance into His ears, Oh Young One! You are the beloved consort of the Divine damsel VaLLi who guarded the millet-field in VaLLimalai*** where the creepers called VaLLi are abundant, Oh Great One!

535.english_meanings_list: ["Because of tricks deliberately played by Manmathan (God of Love) who could conquer the entire world knocking down all to a heap, who is armed with the arrow of jasmine flower and who holds a sugarcane as his bow,", "I lost my sheen, being consumed by passion, faltering for words, losing my mind, visiting whorehouses with a life of falsehood and became excessively worried;", "there I encountered far too many miseries, and my body simply drowned in a sea of wretchedness.", "Is it fair that I should be tossed about in a battlefield of controversial and academic debates of diehard zealots belonging to the six religions who pursue materialistic objectives rather than a righteous path?", "Due to the agony of separation, the heroine, suffering from one-sided love, keeps saying \"when will this night end?\" As if to soothe her and grant her wish, the rooster announces the dawn by crowing loudly; You have placed that rooster on Your staff, Oh Lord!", "You are seated at a supreme place that transcends both dark night and somewhat visible daylight, Oh Infinitely Compassionate Lord!", "You are the son of Lord SivA who mounts the strong and majestic bull (Nandi), belongs to the great place Thillai (Chidhambaram) and is the beloved consort of SivagAmavalli (PArvathi)!", "She guarded the millet-field in the mount VaLLimalai*, where creepers called VaLLi proliferate; You became the beloved consort of that VaLLi, Oh Great One!"]
535.english_pathavurai: Because of tricks deliberately played by Manmathan (God of Love) who could conquer the entire world knocking down all to a heap, who is armed with the arrow of jasmine flower and who holds a sugarcane as his bow, I lost my sheen, being consumed by passion, faltering for words, losing my mind, visiting whorehouses with a life of falsehood and became excessively worried; there I encountered far too many miseries, and my body simply drowned in a sea of wretchedness. Is it fair that I should be tossed about in a battlefield of controversial and academic debates of diehard zealots belonging to the six religions who pursue materialistic objectives rather than a righteous path? Due to the agony of separation, the heroine, suffering from one-sided love, keeps saying "when will this night end?" As if to soothe her and grant her wish, the rooster announces the dawn by crowing loudly; You have placed that rooster on Your staff, Oh Lord! You are seated at a supreme place that transcends both dark night and somewhat visible daylight, Oh Infinitely Compassionate Lord! You are the son of Lord SivA who mounts the strong and majestic bull (Nandi), belongs to the great place Thillai (Chidhambaram) and is the beloved consort of SivagAmavalli (PArvathi)! She guarded the millet-field in the mount VaLLimalai*, where creepers called VaLLi proliferate; You became the beloved consort of that VaLLi, Oh Great One!

Her Consort, BrahmA, was unable to see (the head or feet of) Lord SivA.", "He contained the fierce poison in His throat; on His bent tresses, He carried the thousand-faced river Ganga; and You are the treasure of that SivA!", "There are plenty of magizha trees and budding surapunnai trees in this millet-field at", "the famous mountain, VaLLimalai* where she lives;", "She hails from the hunter tribe and is of emerald complexion;", "for that VaLLi, You are the most befitting consort, Oh Great One!"]
536.english_pathavurai: The five elements, namely the cosmos, air, fire, water and earth, constitute this body. It smells like rotten meat and is nothing but a house, full of germs. Anger flares up during speech as if fiery sparks are set off; that leads to maddening rage, and the body becomes a leather bag filled up with the toxic liquor of delusion. Lest I carry this burden of my body, (I need) the unique substance that is immortal even at the end of the universe; in order that the knowledge of SivagnAnam, gushing within myself like a fountain is perceived by mind's eye that luminous substance, which has neither shape nor form, according to the scriptures, and that which is seated at the pinnacle of those very scriptures; I want to behold that, namely You, with Your blessing! With the pleasant aroma of musk, on a fully-blossomed white lotus is seated Goddess Saraswathi, wearing white dress. Her Consort, BrahmA, was unable to see (the head or feet of) Lord SivA. He contained the fierce poison in His throat; on His bent tresses, He carried the thousand-faced river Ganga; and You are the treasure of that SivA! There are plenty of magizha trees and budding surapunnai trees in this millet-field at the famous mountain, VaLLimalai* where she lives; She hails from the hunter tribe and is of emerald complexion; for that VaLLi, You are the most befitting consort, Oh Great One!

537.english_meanings_list: ["Because of the arrow of lily flower shot by Manmathan (God of Love) who arrived at dusk with his triumphant bow,", "because of the fiery rays emitted by the crescent moon, because of the doubt raised by the southerly breeze whether the Lord would arrive (due to the fiery rays),", "and because of the scandal (spread by the folks in the town), this girl, looking like Lakshmi on the lotus, feeling lonely on the bed,", "should not hate herself attributing her misery to her past deeds;", "for that, You must give her Your garland of kadappa flowers around which beetles, with pure rays on their body, jump about after imbibing the reddish honey!", "You are the poet adjudged by PArvathi, Daughter of Mount HimavAn, to be the best* in a boundless competition among erudite poets, Oh Lord!", "He is the great charitable Lord SivA, with honey-dripping kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower in His matted hair; when He prostrated at Your feet the other day, You preached to Him most clearly the matchless PraNava ManthrA!", "The powerful demons ran away scared and the virtuous celestials were elated when You showed Your prowess, Oh valorous Lord on the Peacock!", "You went up to Mount VaLLimalai** where the vaLLi creepers abound and wedded the damsel VaLLi over there, Oh Great One!"]
537.english_pathavurai: Because of the arrow of lily flower shot by Manmathan (God of Love) who arrived at dusk with his triumphant bow, because of the fiery rays emitted by the crescent moon, because of the doubt raised by the southerly breeze whether the Lord would arrive (due to the fiery rays), and because of the scandal (spread by the folks in the town), this girl, looking like Lakshmi on the lotus, feeling lonely on the bed, should not hate herself attributing her misery to her past deeds; for that, You must give her Your garland of kadappa flowers around which beetles, with pure rays on their body, jump about after imbibing the reddish honey! You are the poet adjudged by PArvathi, Daughter of Mount HimavAn, to be the best* in a boundless competition among erudite poets, Oh Lord! He is the great charitable Lord SivA, with honey-dripping kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower in His matted hair; when He prostrated at Your feet the other day, You preached to Him most clearly the matchless PraNava ManthrA! The powerful demons ran away scared and the virtuous celestials were elated when You showed Your prowess, Oh valorous Lord on the Peacock! You went up to Mount VaLLimalai** where the vaLLi creepers abound and wedded the damsel VaLLi over there, Oh Great One!

538.english_pathavurai: A happy family life with my mother, wife, children and a lot of bright young girls with lark's voice, a heritage and plenty of wealth - I felt lucky and proud to have attained these. I never realized the value of my Guru's teachings and spent my days wastefully. (On the day of reckoning) before the evil Death-God, (Yaman), closes in on me and tortures me inflicting a lot of pain; amidst grief, my body is taken to the crematorium (cremation ground) to be consumed by fire; prior to that event, will the greatness of Your two Holy Feet be realized by me? The Silvery Mount (Thirukkayilai) in the North is protected by You, sitting majestically on the spotted Peacock, Oh Kumaresa! You worship the feet of beautiful VaLLi and wait for her at VaLLimalai*, as a good husband! All my past sins are to be forgiven by You, and an ability to extol Your Grace has been given only by You, my Treasure! For those who are capable of worshipping Your lotus feet You are always good to such devotees, Oh, Great One!

539.english_pathavurai: This mysterious body consists of a head, beautiful hands, eyes, ears, a mind which is the seat of treacherous thoughts, blood and bones, all of which are well fitted together; this body goes through some unhappy and happy experiences, and at the time of death, when the body is about to be consigned to burning red flames of fire as the life is spilled and before being gripped by great grief that Yaman (God of Death) has come too soon to wage his war with me and feeling shaken and dying. I wish to get rid of all my bad deeds and welcome only good deeds; for this, kindly bless me with the love to contemplate Your hallowed feet! Lord VishNu, of the hue of black cloud, who once feigned slumber on the serpent (AdhisEshan) while protecting all lives, and the celestials, were scared to face the battle as the demon SUran confronted them menacingly; tearing his wide chest, and making his shrieking scream, as he fell, reach all parts of the world, You killed him that day with utmost rage, Oh Lord with the spear! (In this place,) the lotus flowers blossom beautifully in ponds while swarms of beetles join together and hum in unison; monkeys playfully jump on the sandalwood trees here (in VaLLimalai*); You went to this mountain to see VaLLi, the pretty damsel of the KuRavAs, stood until she set her lotus feet there and fell at them, Oh Great One!

541.english_meanings_list: ["Adopting family life, some people fritter away a few days without knowing any other righteous way;", "after some time, they are afflicted by the futile (and destructive) arrows wielded by Manmathan (God of Love) and sink in the sea of lies spoken by giggling girls with dirty eyes painted with black pigment;", "after spending a few days of misery with no sense of balance, they are ensnared in a delusion about this earth, their children and their wealth which they firmly believe to be real;", "while holding on to their attachment, they are overcome by bodily diseases like exhaustion, shortness of breath and biliousness making them grow old with greying hair; (like them) before I stand in front of Yaman (God of Death) with His long rope of bondage clasping me around,", "kindly bless me graciously making me a peer of Your good devotees who have a steadfast devotion to Your hallowed lotus feet, Oh Lord!", "His laugh was enough to burn down Manmathan holding a bow of sugarcane praised by all; He reduced the Thiripuram which closed in on Him to ash with His smoke-spewing fiery eye on His forehead; He is Lord SivA, and You are the dear son graciously delivered by His loving Consort PArvathi!", "He initiated the great (MahAbhArathA) epic war in which (King DridharAshtrA's) sons and their children, along with many other kings, became absolute enemies; He is Lord VishNu who holds the disc as a weapon in His hand!", "Concealing Your broad shoulders wearing the elegant garland made of kadappa flowers, You assumed several disguises and hugged VaLLi, the damsel living happily in the fields of millet in the wonderful mountain VaLLimalai, Oh Virtuous One!", "This town is famous in this world, comparable to AmarAvathi, the capital city of IndrA; You are seated in this beautiful place, Thiruk kazhukkundRam*, Oh Great One!"]
541.english_pathavurai: Adopting family life, some people fritter away a few days without knowing any other righteous way; after some time, they are afflicted by the futile (and destructive) arrows wielded by Manmathan (God of Love) and sink in the sea of lies spoken by giggling girls with dirty eyes painted with black pigment; after spending a few days of misery with no sense of balance, they are ensnared in a delusion about this earth, their children and their wealth which they firmly believe to be real; while holding on to their attachment, they are overcome by bodily diseases like exhaustion, shortness of breath and biliousness making them grow old with greying hair; (like them) before I stand in front of Yaman (God of Death) with His long rope of bondage clasping me around, kindly bless me graciously making me a peer of Your good devotees who have a steadfast devotion to Your hallowed lotus feet, Oh Lord! His laugh was enough to burn down Manmathan holding a bow of sugarcane praised by all; He reduced the Thiripuram which closed in on Him to ash with His smoke-spewing fiery eye on His forehead; He is Lord SivA, and You are the dear son graciously delivered by His loving Consort PArvathi! He initiated the great (MahAbhArathA) epic war in which (King DridharAshtrA's) sons and their children, along with many other kings, became absolute enemies; He is Lord VishNu who holds the disc as a weapon in His hand! Concealing Your broad shoulders wearing the elegant garland made of kadappa flowers, You assumed several disguises and hugged VaLLi, the damsel living happily in the fields of millet in the wonderful mountain VaLLimalai, Oh Virtuous One! This town is famous in this world, comparable to AmarAvathi, the capital city of IndrA; You are seated in this beautiful place, Thiruk kazhukkundRam*, Oh Great One!

542.english_meanings_list: ["Vishnu, who once held all the seven worlds in His stomach,", "BrahmA, and bright Rudra, being the Trinity,", "and other DEvAs", "have all worshipped the Goddess, the Prime Parasakthi;", "She fed the Divine Milk of Knowledge from Her breast to You (as Gnanacampanthan); Your mouth has that Divine sweet Smell!", "In SeegAzhi, which is fragrant with aromatic scent, You were born in the KavuNiya lineage as Pure Knowledge incarnate.", "When You floated a palm leaf, with Tamil hymn inscribed on it, the leaf went upstream against the current in Vaigai River;", "and when ChamaNas confronted You, they were all sent to the gallows by Your war through Tamil hymns, Oh Great Master!", "You are the son of the unique SivA, who holds on His hands a pick-axe, a deer, BrahmA's skull, a hand drum (udukkai) and three-pronged weapon (TrisUlam).", "You imprisoned BrahmA, who sits on a lotus,", "took over his job of Creation and performed very well, Oh Muruga.", "At the pinnacle of the great Mount of Veda, eagles* prostrate daily;", "and at its bright gates, all DEvAs assemble and", "chant VEdAs and Tamil hymns, sounding like sea waves.", "This place is Kathalivanam** (ThirukkazhukkundRam), Oh Great One!"]
542.english_pathavurai: Vishnu, who once held all the seven worlds in His stomach, BrahmA, and bright Rudra, being the Trinity, and other DEvAs have all worshipped the Goddess, the Prime Parasakthi; She fed the Divine Milk of Knowledge from Her breast to You (as Gnanacampanthan); Your mouth has that Divine sweet Smell! In SeegAzhi, which is fragrant with aromatic scent, You were born in the KavuNiya lineage as Pure Knowledge incarnate. When You floated a palm leaf, with Tamil hymn inscribed on it, the leaf went upstream against the current in Vaigai River; and when ChamaNas confronted You, they were all sent to the gallows by Your war through Tamil hymns, Oh Great Master! You are the son of the unique SivA, who holds on His hands a pick-axe, a deer, BrahmA's skull, a hand drum (udukkai) and three-pronged weapon (TrisUlam). You imprisoned BrahmA, who sits on a lotus, took over his job of Creation and performed very well, Oh Muruga. At the pinnacle of the great Mount of Veda, eagles* prostrate daily; and at its bright gates, all DEvAs assemble and chant VEdAs and Tamil hymns, sounding like sea waves. This place is Kathalivanam** (ThirukkazhukkundRam), Oh Great One!

543.english_pathavurai: The humming beetles made the sound "thanA thanA"; the sound produced by their impinging upon the flowers on the hair was like "paLeer paLeer"; the rattling anklets on the legs made a clinking noise; during their love-play, the crooning calls of birds emanating from their matchless throat sounded "kukU kukU"; they profusely perspired in a sticky and sultry manner; their exhilaration was accompanied by goose-bumps chilling the entire body; Manmathan (God of Love) got out of his seat and jumped all over in a spurt; the body became tingled due to excessive passion; these whores, adorned with strand of pearls, unite only after their demand of limitless amount of money is met; I do not have the desire to copulate with them and sink into the sea of birth only to refloat again; instead, my mind wishes to think of the fundamental principle of the six hallowed letters (SaravaNabava) and to keep on chanting "Oh GuhA, Oh GuhA"; will I ever get that good fortune, Oh Lord? With reddish hair on the head (due to bleeding) adorned with garlands, showing his white teeth sharp like the spear and black-complexioned shoulders that once displayed garlands of triumph, the demon SUran advanced confrontingly; his chest was charred altogether; pieces of flesh gathered on the floor in heaps after heaps to the rejoicing of the jumping fiends; the dumbfounded demons fell down screaming uncontrollably; blood gushed in the battlefield like a river; the seas became dried up and shrank suddenly; the magical and treacherous mount Krouncha was shattered, falling down with a thud; the exalted celestials and others sang songs of praise hailing You "Oh my Lord, Oh my Lord as You came with the spear, Oh, Sun of Knowledge!" In this mountain ThirukkazhukkundRam* (also known as VEthagiri) where Tamil reverberates, You are seated full of grace and compassion! You are the Leader, Oh Son of Lord SivA!

In their mind they have countless millions of schemes of treachery. Deviously, these vain women fall all over many men. They read only the erotic texts dealing with carnal knowledge. These whores do not have any compassion whatsoever; and could there be any good outcome from my liaison with such great sinners? You are the Lord that can remove all my blemishes! The mighty and evil hunters in the forest, holding bows, screamed uncontrollably and died when You wielded the sharp spear on them, Oh Lord! You proudly possess twelve broad and handsome shoulders, Oh Lord KandhA! You represent the six hallowed letters (SaravaNabava) that appear prominently in front of the special temple towers that have lofty peaks, Oh Lord! You are seated in ThirisirAppaLLi whose fame is as high as the celestial land! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

561.english_pathavurai: That cannot be perceived after any amount of studies. That cannot be attained through any number of Pujas (modes of worship). That cannot be described in words. That cannot be conceived in impure hearts. That cannot be uprooted from His devotees' hearts. That cannot be surrounded by illusion. That is beyond the reach of the Sound (nAtham) created by the churning of Energy (vindhu). That is at the boundary of the skies. That is the origin of the entire Universe. Having understood and seen that, the lowly myself want to attain the Union (yOgA) with SivA; for that, You have to teach me the True Knowledge. Now I should rescind my mortal body without any illusions about it. with great desire You went to the millet-field guarded by the hunter-girl (VaLLi) and fell madly in love with her; and knelt down at her golden feet, Oh Kandaswamy! You reside in VayalUr where the fish swim about roaring in the fertile fields. Your peacock wears the poisonous serpent as garland; You ride that peacock as if it were a horse, Oh Warrior! Even by inhaling life giving air (oxygen-praNavAyu) through one nostril, and exhaling it through the other nostril (PrANAyAmam)*, the great sages are still unable to attain You. Despite keenly desiring You, they are unable to see You as You stand beyond their reach. The peak of the Mount ThirichirAmalai rises so high as to touch the lofty clouds, and that Mount's Lord, SivA, worships You as Guru. You are the Great Leader of all the DEvAs!

565.english_pathavurai: Because of their black-shaded eyes vying with kayal fish, looking like a female deer's eyes and beautiful lotus, their bright, rising and dark hair that taunts the dense and dark cloud, and their lovely and large bosom that surpass the dainty and beautiful pot and the mount, I have lost all values like happiness and grace, my intelligence is gone and even my basic sense has vanished; how will I ever be able to attain salvation? When once the demon SUran, in the disguise of a mango tree, hid inside the dark seas over which clouds hang, You annihilated him by wielding Your spear; with that kind of commanding prowess, You fought the war and eradicated the grief of the celestials, Oh Famous One! You successfully composed (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) many hymns (ThEvAram) in the three branches of Tamil and interpreted their great significance for the entire world to experience, Oh Lord! You are seated in the form of Absolute Truth in this great place SivAyam*, known as Rathnagiri, Oh KumarA, the Great One!

566.english_pathavurai: I acquired all the malice around me and practised many treacherous activities. Mastering the skill of thievery, I mingled with disreputable people and murderers until I got tired of them. I roamed around, gloating about vainly and drowned in the sea of life, suffering all its harassment. I was like the fish caught in the net strewn over the miserable ocean of life and the rubbish found in the soup. My body felt like the wax thrown into the burning fire; in this unclean and obese body, the five sensory organs play so much havoc that the God of Death (Yaman), the strong and arrogant one, comes without even the slightest compassion. At that time, not realising the imminent danger (of death), the five gamblers (called the sensory organs) make merry and run around carefree, indulging in the myth of sensory pleasures of sound, touch, smell, sight and taste; seeking physically suitable women, pursuing them to their houses, and messing around with them in carnal pleasure, this body becomes the stinking subject of ridicule of one and all. Will my body ultimately degenerate to such a dismal position leading to death? Kindly bless me before that with Your immortal hallowed feet! (To this meter), beats were sounding like thunder all over; VishNu and BrahmA were dancing around; Lord SivA danced; so also did Mother ParAsakthi and the learned sages; the demons in all the directions faded and became depressed; the celestials began to sing and the VEdAs were chanted; in the battlefield of confrontation, the messengers of Yaman wandered everywhere in search of the carnage and walked all over the corpses; the strong foxes danced with joy having found plenty of food; the fiends and crows danced; the devils, hit in the conflict on the battleground, danced; when You wielded the powerfully bright and sharp spear, Oh Lord! Assuming several disguises (like hunter, neem tree, bangle merchant and old man), You tricked the deer-like belle VaLLi, an expert guard of the millet field, looking like a pretty pUvai bird, and simply stirred her heart with passion, Oh GuhA! Along with Lord SivA, You are seated in the town of Rathnagiri* (also known as VAtpOkki), Oh MurugA! You are for ever youthful; and You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

568.english_pathavurai: The six hallowed faces in an orderly row, adorned by lofty crowns in which brilliant gemstones of nine kinds are embedded, and which faces are worshipped by all celestials and their lords; the twelve shoulders embraced by the illustrious Veera Lakshmi (Goddess of Valour); the two sacred feet, fragrant with kadappa flowers around which beetles with long stripes hum the melody of Sri Ragam; VaLLi, the young daughter of the hunters, whose love for You is ceaseless, and DEvayAnai, the pretty daughter of IndrA who mounts the cloud as His vehicle, standing by You on the right and left side as anchors for Your devotees symbolising Your Divine order; Your Spear that dispenses justice after careful deliberation; Your Peacock; and Your exquisitely handsome and illustrious stature depicting True Knowledge; - even though I am base and dishonourable, kindly bless me with the privilege of meditating upon (all of the above) each and every day! Lord NadarAja, who danced on the silver stage in Madhurai, famous for its imposing terraces and halls, and who (once acceding to the request of Pandya King Rajeswaran) danced with His right foot up*, had composed a treatise on the aspects of mind (iraiyanAr akap poruL) which was interpreted by forty-nine poet-stalwarts of the Madhurai Tamil Sangam; in order to explain the real meaning of the chapter on "resources", You hailed from the apt lineage of Chettis** as a mute and dumb boy and grew up playfully in ThiruvAlavAy (Madhurai) where You established the truth by way of a Divine sport, Oh Courageous One! You are the grantor of boons, Oh Great Master! Once, (in the battle of the Maha BhArathA) when Arjunan prepared to shed his life (by jumping into fire), He saved him by concealing the sun with His sharp disc; He is the Lord of the cowherds, Krishnan, and You are His dear nephew! This river KAvEri tosses its noisy waves unswervingly in a rhythm; on its banks is the town VayalUr which is Your abode. You are also seated in VirAlimalai which is in the region of KOnAdu***, Oh Great One!

569.english_pathavurai: They negotiate a price for their bosom, smeared with the paste of sandalwood, which looks like Mount MEru that is the pivotal mountain for all worlds including the nether-world; their speech is sweet like the milk, sugar and honey with which words these whores provoke extreme passion; describing poetically their organs right from the foot to their head, I am possessed by the devil; I lack true knowledge; I am a sinner whose tongue has no sense of discrimination; I am totally untruthful; I do not possess either the intelligence or penance to use my living days without wasting them; I am a fool who whiles away time by merely talking about life and other earthly matters without the consciousness of the Divine; despite all these shortcomings, will I too be blessed with the privilege of becoming a speck on Your two hallowed feet, Oh Lord, thereby being graciously saved from falling into hell? Terrified Yaman (God of Death) fled along with his messengers; Brahma and Lord VishNu also ran away in fear; the otherwise powerful and deadly army of IndrA became weary, and was shattered to pieces; the venerable sages, who perform penances and the SOma Yagna (sacrifice to the Moon) defined in the scriptures, stood there chanting the five-lettered ManthrA (NamasivAya) as the demon SUran, who fought the war in many mystic ways demonstrating his valour and ferocity, was killed by the Spear wielded by You, Oh Young Lord seated in VayalUr! The groves in this place are full of many flowers like kUthALam, kadappa and gamboge (surapunnai) around which the beetles hum musically in various majestic melodies like sAdhAri (PanthuvarALi), thEsi (Desh) and nAmakriyai (NAthanAmakriyai); the storks around the wild river flowing here peck plenty of lamprey (Aral) fish; many lakes and paddy-fields abound in a cluster in this country called kOnAdu* in which is situated the mountain, VirAlimalai, and You are seated here, Oh Great One!

"He does not have desires, does not indulge in pranks, has no miserliness and lust; he is indeed a great man". In order that I qualify for these words, Oh upright one, who wears the spotless crescent moon* 1 , and the most compassionate, Oh SadhAsivA, Oh MahEswarA (Lord of all Gods), You pervade everything in the world, both moving and stationary, Oh the Supreme Being, please think in terms of blessing me with the sublime experience of NirvAna, where the thought process ceases and the mind shrinks. The crescent moon that spreads moonlight everywhere, the serpent (AdhisEshan) who feeds on the wind that stops nowhere and who is known to uphold justice* 2 , and the river Ganga are worn in SivA's tresses; RAvanA, who is the Leader of the asura dynasty, once suffered immense pain in his shoulders, which was inflicted by SivA* 3 ; He is free from any disease; He is seated on the lotus; that SivA delivered You as His child! These hunters are experts in fighting with their bows and arrows and delight in doing so; their wonderful girl, VaLLi has You as her consort! 571.english_pathavurai: That which is free from disease, which is ancient, and supreme; which grants a boon, is immortal and without worries; which is foremost, luminous and without any desire; which is worshipped by Saivite holy men; which is SivA, who burnt down Thirisirapuram without any weapon; which is Vishnu and BrahmA; which is Heaven and Earth; which is in all animals and plants, movable and immovable; and That ancient form in all these is MurugA - I did not meditate concentrating on that form. Instead, I became a slave to useless people who have a mind of a crocodile and are indifferent to me; and why should I go after these treacherous people with materialistic desires? Once, Rama, who hails from Raghu's dynasty, won over RAvaNan, who had a crying voice out of fear for Rama and with a dark complexion like the night; (that Rama is none other than) the loving Vishnu; His daily worship with flowers to SivA (including His lotus eye as a flower)* is a known true story; and You are the Son of that SivA! You are the King of all arts! You are the younger brother of famous elephant-faced VinAyagA! You are without any attachment! You are the leader of all DEvAs! Without fighting any wars, You are always able to win, and You never fail in Your victorious pursuits! You reside in the town of ChruvUr (ThiruppOrUr). There is a variety of kurA trees and agil trees, with huge and thick trunks, surrounding VirAlimalai** where You rule right royally, Oh Great One!

574.english_pathavurai: Whenever they run into men coming from the opposite direction, they assess their situation stealthily and begin to flirt with them. They provoke a lot of passion in them and lead to the cave-like place in their body where one falters. The genitals revealed by these young women are nothing but an irrigational basket to fetch water from the well within. It is an outlet through which old sludges are discharged. If one does some research into the subject, it would be seen as a whirlpool that causes terrible misery in the so-called evil river of love in the early stages of youth. It is a tear in the body that is set to rot very badly. It is the spot where all dirt accumulates. It is a clothed part of the body covering the gateway to the conception of a foetus. It is a hole from which liquids gush out like a waterfall. It is the worthless bottom-part of the body consisting of mushy mud, and I do not wish to be mired in that ruinous muck; and for that, You have to take me over and bless me, Oh Lord! When Vidhuran took up the big bow and entered the battlefield, armed with weapons like arrows to fight with the enemy (PANdavAs), He cleverly achieved victory by deluding him into giving up the fight, ensuring that the hundred kauravAs headed by DhuriyOdhanan were killed; He is the messenger of Dharman who lived in the forest of idumbai where Goddess Durga was present; He is the charioteer driving the large chariot of Arjunan who performed penance wearing the holy ash on his forehead; He is the unblemished Lord KrishNA (Lord VishNu); and You are His nephew, Oh Lord! In this place, the groves have tall trees on which the moon hovers; among those trees is the most fertile tree called santhAnam which is a wish-yielding one; like that tree, You also yield the wishes of the devotees who worship You, and You are seated in this mount VirAlimalai*, Oh Lord! Without making Your devotees come all the way to the top, You let them climb half the distance up to the spot, called SanthAna kOdu, where a divine fragrance prevails, and at that very spot You are seated showering Your blessings on the devotees and granting them their wishes, Oh Great One!
