575.english_pathavurai: All the five Elements (Earth, Water, Fire, Air and Cosmos), the six religious sects (Saivam, Vaishnavam, SAktham, GANApathyam, Kaumaram and Sauram), the ManthrAs, the scriptures, the purANAs*, the arts, the fifty-one different alphabets (of the Sanskrit language), the DEvAs in different forms, the movable and immovable animate forms, the Great BrahmA, Vishnu with the complexion of dark cloud, SivA with the reddish complexion of the setting sun, the moon and the sun radiating cool moonlight and hot rays, the Hamsa ManthrA**, (see footnote)***, are all in combination, nothing but one and only one form. Knowing the oneness of that form, and not differentiating it, and being rooted in it, one has to realize the Universal aspect of Siva-yOgA. For the destruction of egoes, delusions and karmas of individuals, one has to follow the conventional Master-Student tradition; and will I be fortunate to fall in that traditional line and obtain Your preaching? The confronting armies of asuras (demons) were scared away; the land of IndrA was redeemed, and the DEvAs resettled in their homeland; the devils and ghosts were able to quench their hunger in the battlefield; the destroyer of the demon Mahisha, the fierce and valorous Durga, rejoiced and chanted "Hara Hara, SankarA"; and the peaks of Mount MEru were swept by enormous dust; when You threw Your mighty Spear, Oh Lord of VayalUr! The sages with matted lock who wear the holy ash roasted in fire on their foreheads, and who have won over the bondages of attachment, desire and other vascillations, ultimately attain their blissful tranquility at the stony caves of this mountain (VirAlimalai); On that mountain, the peacocks dance; the dark beetles, intoxicated from the sweet honey sucked by them, sing hummingly; and the kondRai (Indian laburnum) trees abundantly shed gold instead of flowers. That VirAlimalai**** is Your abode, Oh Great One!

BrahmA, who is the authority on all scriptures, ran away from the scene out of extreme fear; the woman of ill-omen (MUdhEvi) fled the spot in a hurry; the Mount MEru (KailAsh) in the North was so enraged that it began to spin on its axis; the sea caught fire; SUran was so frightened that he cried loudly until his jaws tore open, and he was eventually killed; all the seven worlds and SUran's abode, ChakravALagiri, which was a huge sphere obscuring all the directions, fell; devils along with vultures and eagles danced in the battlefield; and You marched into that battlefield willingly! You wear the garland made of pure kadamba flowers! For compassion You are comparable to Mount MEru (KailAsh)! You have chosen for Your abode the famous and beautiful place, VirAlimalai**, Oh Great One!

578.english_pathavurai: They serve as the weapon of Manmathan (God of Love); snatching the lives of young men, they swing right up to the beautiful ears from which heavy ear-studs dangle; they fill up the shade under the hair that hovers like dark cloud; they are sharp and prominent like the edge of the sword; they have the characteristic of whirlwind; the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) feel ashamed before the horror of the spear-like pointed eyes which provoke passion; the movement of the eyes of the whores and the awe they inspire are like that of the pure blue lily; in order to get rid of my delusion for them, which blemish could not be eradicated, You appeared before me and salvaged this old slave; for that reason, I would never forget the power of Your grace! She is Thiripurai, the great Goddess; She is Bhairavi whose rage is comparable to the vadavA mukA agni, the inferno that appears during the deluge of the aeon; She is virtues-incorporated; She has blue complexion; She is the deity in charge of the three worlds including the sky; as that PArvathi DEvi along with the six divine KArthikai Mothers, cuddled You, their pet son, calling You "Oh KumArA", You graciously preached the righteous way that is interpreted in the upanishads and VEdAs to Lord SivA, the leader of Mount KailAsh in the North, and became His great Master who removed the blemish called ignorance, Oh Young One! In this place, the worship of SivA is conducted in the traditional style; manliness and consistent charity prevail here everyday; this is Mount VirAlimalai, being part of KOnAdu*, where You are seated, Oh Great One!

579.english_pathavurai: I used to praise a miser who had never given charity, calling him the greatest giver like KubEran; and I kept on flattering him, wandering with him in vain! In this world, I undertook the heavy burden of my family. I suffered unimaginable miseries and was run down in health. At that time, I never sought Your grace to rid myself of all my poverty. My mind simply reeled under delusion thinking about the golden bosoms of women. I never had character nor healthy habits. Unspoiled effects of meditation disappeared completely. Only misery kept on multiplying. Before my feeble body and miserable soul die in this world, will You kindly instruct Yaman, Death-God, not to touch me and to leave me alone? Will that command ever come from Your mouth? Please tell me. You are the Son of PArvathi, Divine Mother, who created the seven worlds! You are the embodiment of Knowledge in Whom Life thrives amidst NAdham (Sivam), Bindhu (Sakthi) and six KuNdalini chakrAs* starting from MUlAdhAram, none of which was implanted by anyone other than You!) Your pure Spear sparkles like the Sun! The shady and cool groves have sky-high trees; and the trees are fertile and fully grown as it rains continuously everyday resulting in overflowing ponds full of flowers in VirAlimali**, which is Your favourite abode, Oh Great One!

580.english_pathavurai: These women are personification of illusion and are full of astuteness. They deceive with sweet words with a heart that is filled with endless treachery. The corner of their eyes is capable of severing the living days and frittering them away. Even the sages are haunted by their passionate laughter with which they could melt them off. They reveal their bosom through the attire covering their chest. While saying "Please come on in and be seated", they are out to deceive their suitors thoroughly. Their cunningness does not give room to doubt their ability to provoke extremely sensual thoughts. If they are not paid, they could be extremely indifferent. They rejoice in the consumption of alcohol. They are full of thievery and vanity with no compunction whatsoever about slander or sin. Their neck shows funny nail-marks. They are ever ready to sell their blemished bosom for a price. How can a liaison with such whores do me any good? When KrishNa set his heart on stealing raw milk, refined butter and curd behind the back of the shepherd-women and imbibed them without giving it a second thought, His black-cloud-like body was tied to the stone-barrel by His mother YasOdhai who literally went to war to tie Him down; as she slapped Him, He began to cry holding both His ears; when He played on the flute sweetly, many species of cows in herds followed Him home without tiring; that famous Lord VishNu is Your Uncle, Oh Lord of VayalUr! The demon SUran was extremely proud that his weapons never remained idle even for a single day without partaking in a war; when he stood in the disguise of a mango tree in the sea, You wielded the wonderful spear held in Your hand on the sea to destroy him, Oh Lord! You have Your abode in VirAlimalai*, Oh Great One!

581.english_pathavurai: Daze, desire and anger - these were pursued by me constantly everyday. I went about in myriad ways of undesirable mystic pursuit. Although I am a big sinner and treacherous, my Lord, You are my Mother and Father from now on. The Four Great Vedas or the Great Scriptures were never learnt by me. Lest my remaining days are wasted, You have to bless me with the True Knowledge (which surpasses 36 fundamental tenets*). Oh, Eternal Youth, and the lover of red kalAra (hibiscus) flower, You wear fragrant sandal paste on Your jewels, You are the supporter of both the PAthAla (Nadir) and the Earth, You chose West VayalUr as Your abode, rich in water and fish. Oh VElA, with the Spear, and the Treasure of Virali Mount**, You are the son of SivA, the Leader of multitudes of bhUthas and ghosts. 584.english_meanings_list: ["You were born in a pond surrounded by reeds,", "Your compassion is limitless,", "Your feet are like lotus with a hundred petals,", "You are extremely handsome!", "You are youthful and valorous,", "You are the commander-in-chief of the army,", "You belong to ThiruppOrUr, where the troops are always combat-ready,", "You are the Lord of the entire universe.", "Your form is one of Supreme Knowledge,", "You are the King of IndrA, the Leader of DEvAs,", "You wear the fragrant kadamba garlands,", "You are the son of PArvathi, known as UmA, KALi and Bhagawathi,", "You are the fundamental cause of this life and the life after death,", "You are manly and full of virtues,", "You must now show Your grace to me!", "The solar system, the cosmos and the earth were all covered with a variety of dust particles;", "all the DEvAs were relieved and uplifted;", "the seven seas screamed asking if it was fair for them to suffer;", "the great mountain MEru (KailAsh) was battered and powdered;", "and the demons (asuras), roaming about at night, were debilitated when You threw Your long spear at great speed!", "Vishnu, with emerald green complexion, BrahmA, with golden colour,", "and SivA, with the complexion of fire, together worship Your feet", "when You mount Your peacock!", "Oh VElA, You reside at VinAyagamalai (PillaiyArpatti*)!", "You are the supporter of all the hunters of the forests living on the mountains, Oh Great One!"]
584.english_pathavurai: You were born in a pond surrounded by reeds, Your compassion is limitless, Your feet are like lotus with a hundred petals, You are extremely handsome! You are youthful and valorous, You are the commander-in-chief of the army, You belong to ThiruppOrUr, where the troops are always combat-ready, You are the Lord of the entire universe. Your form is one of Supreme Knowledge, You are the King of IndrA, the Leader of DEvAs, You wear the fragrant kadamba garlands, You are the son of PArvathi, known as UmA, KALi and Bhagawathi, You are the fundamental cause of this life and the life after death, You are manly and full of virtues, You must now show Your grace to me! The solar system, the cosmos and the earth were all covered with a variety of dust particles; all the DEvAs were relieved and uplifted; the seven seas screamed asking if it was fair for them to suffer; the great mountain MEru (KailAsh) was battered and powdered; and the demons (asuras), roaming about at night, were debilitated when You threw Your long spear at great speed! Vishnu, with emerald green complexion, BrahmA, with golden colour, and SivA, with the complexion of fire, together worship Your feet when You mount Your peacock! Oh VElA, You reside at VinAyagamalai (PillaiyArpatti*)! You are the supporter of all the hunters of the forests living on the mountains, Oh Great One!

589.english_pathavurai: Seeking an opportune party (who would give money) and an appropriate place, uttering words of flattery to them, resorting to the profession of begging, engaging in that vocation whole-heartedly, plunging into the leaping fire of hunger, (I have been addressing) people who till their very end are incapable of achieving the integrity of mind, who have a heart of hard steel without any compassion whatsoever, sincerely composing fine songs in the worthy and cool language of Tamil; with a lot of hesitation and anxiety, I sang those hollow songs albeit composed with fortitude; I used to shrink with fear, feel morose and hide myself in a corner; how could I have developed an aptitude for singing such worthless songs? When the raging elephant appeared menacingly in the forest, she realised the danger and embraced Your hallowed feet; You granted Your mighty shoulders to that VaLLi! He showed the fiery eye on His forehead when waging a unique war with Manmathan (God of Love) who holds a sugarcane as bow; that Lord SivA worships You in ThiruchchengkOdu* which is Your abode, Oh Lord with the dazzling spear! To those who have surrendered to You, who melt at Your thought rendering them debilitated, who are composed and tranquil, whose heart is moved by devotion for You, who roam about in vain in search of food, who are desolate, who are saddled with worries, who lead a miserable life, and saints who have realised You, You are the benefactor, Oh Great One!

591.english_pathavurai: Blinking their eyes as though they are exhausted, exposing their bosom openly to the view of many people and taking their suitors for a ride, these whores roam about showing off their eminence; making (their suitors) imbibe the saliva, sweet like the sugarcane, oozing from their pretty and reddish lips looking like the kovvai fruit, they hug tightly and provoke so much of dizzy passion that misery ensues; I do not wish to be caught in, and reel from, their professional old games; Oh Lord, You are beyond the comprehension of Lord Brahma, seated on the lotus, Lord VishNu, who as KrishNa gathered all the calves and led them to graze, and Lord SivA who debilitated Yaman (God of Death) and destroyed him; will You kindly look at me, develop a liking for me and preach the celebrated, meaningful and blissful Word of Wisdom so that I too am able to realise its significance and preserve that knowledge? For that, will I ever be fortunate to come within the field of Your gracious vision, Oh Lord? He hid (inside the sea) treacherously and held a trident in his hand; when he came forward in confrontation, You went in search of that demon SUran to his place of hiding, drove him away and thrust Your sword into his chest in delight, Oh Lord with a bunch of twelve shoulders! In the garden where beetles' hum rises to a musical crescendo, wearing the cool kurA flowers on Your broad chest, You remain amidst the devotees who praise Your glory and bless them with Your vision, Oh Young Lord! She is like a parrot with endearing speech; she lives in the cool mountain, hailing from the lineage of hunters; You signalled to that VaLLi, whose eyes were like the sEl fish, gesturing with Your eyes and wooed her away; doting on her, You hugged VaLLi in the green grove of the millet field! The groves are fertile, spreading fragrance everywhere, and beautiful clouds abound hovering over the mountains in this country called Kongu NAdu where You are seated in ThiruchchengkOdu*, Oh Great One!

592.english_meanings_list: ["Around the garland on their black cloud-like hair, beetles swarm about; they have long eyes that roll sideways like a ball shunting from here and there; they have marble-like white teeth and black eye-brows that are beautiful like a bow; (from all the arrows of flowers wielded by Manmathan, God of Love,) the arrow of blue water lily has been chosen to strike their genital, the proud throne of Manmathan, the seat that is the source of love and cause for procreation; You are the Lord at NAgagiri (also known as ThiruchchengkOdu**)! You love to delight in the three branches of Tamil.* You are the nephew of Vishnu holding ChakrA (Wheel) and GadhA in His hands! The SamaNA (Jain) sages were dumbfounded when they lost their debate with You, and You sent them to the gallows, Oh ThirugnAna SambandhA, the Brahmin Poet from SeegAzhi!*** She is resolutely chaste; she is VaLLi, the darling daughter of the hunters who throng the foothills of VaLLimali; and You are her consort! You were the Death-God for the closeknit dynasties of demons (asuras) who hated You! You are cherished by DEvAs in whose land is the KaRpaga Tree, Oh Great One!

604.english_pathavurai: Imagining that the bosom, tightly compressed by a fitting blouse made of beautiful and unique silk, is comparable to the lotus, these young men fall prey, like birds, into the net spread by the whores and even get bitten by their neat row of teeth; those women, with bosom like round and evil wheels, are capable of smooth and matured speech in order to fleece out gold; their heart is hard like stone, and trying to passionately enter that maddening delusion which is nothing but a total myth, sometimes one ends up in bouts of wrestling (vying with other suitors who also visit there); I do not wish to roam about like that; I wish to speak Your glory alone; kindly bless me with realisation and the ability to conceive the choicest words to praise You; and grant me Your triumphant and hallowed feet giving me the ability to recite such words! It is so frustrated due to the lack of nourishment that it stays awake with hunger, agony and fear; it continually crows like "kukkuk kukkukkuk kukkuk kukkuk" yearning for food, beating the two sides of its stomach with its feathers; that Rooster makes a significant and shrill noise; and You have placed it on Your staff, Oh Lord! He is immortal, omniscient, primordial and full of knowledge; He is Your beloved Father, Lord SivA; and You preached to Him, Oh Lord! You came as ThirugnAna Sambandhar in the powerful place SeegAzhi and sang the ThEvaram hymns, giving divine sound to letters! This desire, capable of catching like wild-fire, could enter the body right from the womb; such a desire (for women, earth, and gold) is eradicated in the lofty mountain of the Serpent (NAgamalai, also known as ThiruchchengkOdu*) which is Your abode, Oh Handsome and Great One!

605.english_pathavurai: The evil Death-God (Yaman) and his deadly army should all perish; and me, the little babbling child, worshipping Your two feet, with Your grace should fight that Yaman. To witness my fight, You must come with Your twelve mountain-like shoulders that are embraced by VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs; with Your six lovely faces; with several (eighteen*) eyes; and with the Rooster in Your staff that announces the arrival of the sun everyday. You should manifest Yourself in such entirety. From west to east and in all eight directions, around the world, around the seven long oceans, and upon Your command to fly around the ancient mountain of ChakravALagiri, it could do so in a minute; that is Your dancing Peacock, more like an emerald horse; and You must come mounted on that Peacock flanked by Your old devotees and the DEvAs in multitude singing a lot of Tamil hymns, chanting VEdAs, and praising Your Glory. Your coming to me should be similar to the vision You gave me in ThiruvaNNAmalai previously! He adorns His head with tresses; He holds the venomous poison in His neck; He wears the serpent as His jewellery; He holds the great mazhu (pickaxe) in His hand; He wears the crescent moon; He is an embodiment of purity; He holds the hand-drum that sounds soothingly; He holds the deer in His holy hand; He holds PArvathi on the left side of His body; He holds one of BrahmA's heads in the hand; He holds the heavy world in one hand; He holds Mount MEru as one of His bows; and He holds on His tresses the great River GangA, with a thousand faces. He is Lord SivA, and You are His Son! You are the most virtuous! Your abode is NAgamalai** also known as ThiruchchengkOdu! You are the most compassionate One! You are the consort of DEvayAnai, whose beauty is like a peahen and who is the daughter of IndrANi, of DEvAs' Land, with plenty of KaRpaga trees. Darkness from the bodies of the asuras (demons) spread everywhere; their white teeth sparkled like moonlight; from their fiery eyes, sparks of fire emerged; the seven hills of the asuras were shattered into pieces; from the dying asuras and burning bodies, thunderous noise and smoke arose; and the armies of the asuras invading fiercely, scaring the sky and the earth, were thoroughly uprooted and killed, when You threw Your unique weapon, the Spear Oh Lord! Oh Supreme Master, You are worshipped by IndrA, Oh Great One!

You came as Rudra Sanman* into the chetti family to reveal the whole truth and to establish peace among the quarelling poets, Oh Lord! You are the consort of DEvayAnai who is like a creeper of the hue of pearl, with picturesome beauty and who belongs to the celestial world with an ability to offer liberation! You belong to the dense forest of Kollimalai** where an enchantress*** greets one on the road, who is so beautiful as to inebriate the seer! You adorn Your head with the green flowers of vanni, alli and vetchai, and You are the Lord capable of mounting and driving the green peacock, Oh Great One!

608.english_pathavurai: With their hair that trounced the dark cloud floating in the sky, with their forehead that defeated the rainbow of IndrA that offers consummate enjoyment of pleasures, with their eyes that conquered the flowery arrows of Manmathan (God of Love), around which classy beetles swarm, with their lips that surpassed the kovvai fruit (in redness), which are hailed by amorous men as sweet as the sugar candy, with their pleasant music that traverses to the grove and challenges the music of the cuckoo, with their tight-bloused, heavy bosom that excels the mountain, with their waist that beats the hand-drum held with relish in His hallowed hand by Lord NadarAjar who dances on the golden stage, with their genital, the receptacle of passionate love-making, that rivals the hood of the serpent, and with their soft thigh that defeats the stem of plantain tree, oozing honey, they come out in the open; I have been whiling away my time with such whores hankering after money; I roam about with my body as a wicked person seeking liaison with them; removing all my slags, kindly come over and grant me the interpretation of the union of the illuminated soul with the supreme principle, Oh Lord! When UmAdEvi incited with fiery words, He was determined to suspend the mammoth sacrifcial rite of Dhakshan and destroy it by entering the hall in the dazzling form of Veerabhadran, a powerful and matchless one; that day, the Moon's body lost its lustre; the teeth of the Sun were knocked down; Agni whose job was to singe the sacrificial cow lost his arms which were severed; the foremost PrajAthipathi (Dhakshan) fell down with his head chopped off; the virtuous Goddess, Saraswathi, had her dismembered nose slip down; Lord VishNu who came on the scene fled from that place while He (Veerabhadran) steadfastly stood in the sacrificial hall and waged a war, scolding all those who had assembled there; when Lord SivA made a thundering noise of rage, the devils that danced together celebrating the victory left the sacrificial hall; the sages assembled there and pleaded to you saying "Oh our child, Oh our Lord!" and implored You to interpret for them the four dear purushArthAs (namely, virtue, wealth, pleasure and liberation, which are the four pursuits humans may legitimately engage in); the seeking of the sages took place in the famous mountain of Rajagembeera vaLanAdu* which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

609.english_meanings_list: ["These whores are schemers, murderers, greedy after money, and meat-eaters, having malicious, pale and anaemic faces;", "they are afflicted with several diseases like stomach ache, epilepsy and rheumatism; they are sinners, highly infected and unclean people, and tale bearers;", "they hang around in the street, speaking firmly for self-gratifying purpose, inviting someone and haggling with him about the rate for the use of the vessel (their body) per ghati (24 minutes);", "pulling them over, they sprinkle magic powder on them, patting their bodies; will this kind of relationship with them ever befit me?", "Determining in advance that sages well-versed in vEdAs, children, women and priests should be far removed from the battleground, You evacuated them all;", "then You knocked down all the confronting demons and rendered the seven wavy seas into dried-up slush by wielding Your spear, Oh Lord!", "You are the child of beautiful PArvathi, concorporate as SivagAmi in the left side of the Leader, Lord SivA!", "Along with Your consort, VaLLi, the daughter of Lord NArAyaNan (VishNu), You are seated in this place called GnAnamalai*, Oh Great One!"]
609.english_pathavurai: These whores are schemers, murderers, greedy after money, and meat-eaters, having malicious, pale and anaemic faces; they are afflicted with several diseases like stomach ache, epilepsy and rheumatism; they are sinners, highly infected and unclean people, and tale bearers; they hang around in the street, speaking firmly for self-gratifying purpose, inviting someone and haggling with him about the rate for the use of the vessel (their body) per ghati (24 minutes); pulling them over, they sprinkle magic powder on them, patting their bodies; will this kind of relationship with them ever befit me? Determining in advance that sages well-versed in vEdAs, children, women and priests should be far removed from the battleground, You evacuated them all; then You knocked down all the confronting demons and rendered the seven wavy seas into dried-up slush by wielding Your spear, Oh Lord! You are the child of beautiful PArvathi, concorporate as SivagAmi in the left side of the Leader, Lord SivA! Along with Your consort, VaLLi, the daughter of Lord NArAyaNan (VishNu), You are seated in this place called GnAnamalai*, Oh Great One!

610.english_meanings_list: ["My wife laughed at me, and the entire town also laughed at me;", "all the women of this world laughed at me;", "my father and all relatives were disgusted with me;", "I felt like a dog with a mind completely frustrated;", "everyday, I was called awful names by each and everyone;", "and I became the target of all the people's jeering.", "My mind could not think and became totally dark.", "If I could think at all, the only thought that came to my mind everyday was \"What is the purpose of my life in this body?\".", "When my body prepared itself to shed its life, You came towards me*", "and gracefully showed me Your two feet; will You show them again?", "The drums beat to the meter \"thanathana thanaththa thAna\";", "and the instrument VeenNai, hand-drums (udukkai) and the chanting of VEdAs by multitude of people were all sounding like sea waves, when", "You took Your spear, shining like a lightning, and forcefully threw it against the demons (asuras)", "in the battlefield, Oh MurugA, the Luminous One!", "My heart simply melted when You preached me the yOgA Experience by showing Your lotus feet!*", "You are the son of UmAdEvi whose emerald-green colour is undescribable!", "All the DEvAs praise You at GnAnamalai** which is the abode of Yourself and Your consort VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs!", "You are also the consort of beautiful DEvayAnai, the daughter of IndrANi, Oh Great One!"]
610.english_pathavurai: My wife laughed at me, and the entire town also laughed at me; all the women of this world laughed at me; my father and all relatives were disgusted with me; I felt like a dog with a mind completely frustrated; everyday, I was called awful names by each and everyone; and I became the target of all the people's jeering. My mind could not think and became totally dark. If I could think at all, the only thought that came to my mind everyday was "What is the purpose of my life in this body?". When my body prepared itself to shed its life, You came towards me* and gracefully showed me Your two feet; will You show them again? The drums beat to the meter "thanathana thanaththa thAna"; and the instrument VeenNai, hand-drums (udukkai) and the chanting of VEdAs by multitude of people were all sounding like sea waves, when You took Your spear, shining like a lightning, and forcefully threw it against the demons (asuras) in the battlefield, Oh MurugA, the Luminous One! My heart simply melted when You preached me the yOgA Experience by showing Your lotus feet!* You are the son of UmAdEvi whose emerald-green colour is undescribable! All the DEvAs praise You at GnAnamalai** which is the abode of Yourself and Your consort VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs! You are also the consort of beautiful DEvayAnai, the daughter of IndrANi, Oh Great One!

611.english_pathavurai: First and foremost Mother, the Great, and the consort of Lord SivA, with the name Aavudaiya Nayaki* in whose company the Lord delights, She delivered You, Oh Kumaresa! When I call Your name with love and melting heart as the Prime Lord with Golden Red complexion, You must bless me to worship You, my Protector! With this body of mine, which was formed by the permutations of the five elements, I was wandering all over, without knowing the fulsome scriptures or Vedas; thinking constantly about the bejewelled chests of women and the varieties of passionate desires; and my longing was only for such lustful acts. Then, You took pity on me, and with Your gracious love, showing the Saivite Way and the righteous path, taught me in a manner similar to Your preaching of OM, the VEda ManthrA, into the ears of Lord SivA. You came to me mounted on Your blue peacock, Oh VElA! For those who practise, and realize the Truth from, yOgAs in accordance with the directions of the scriptures, their bondage is broken by You; and You integrate fully with their bodies and souls and add lasting divine bliss to their lives at Udhimalai** which is Your favourite abode, Oh Great One!

612.english_pathavurai: Their large coiffure is bound after untangling the hair and combing; they are the whores who craftily facilitate illicit relationship; ridding my mind of the trivial pleasure derived from such whores, clearing my unsteady mind and granting me the virtues of a steady and sharp intellect and true knowledge, kindly bless me to remain blissfully at all places where Your valorous acts are praised! Bless me graciously so that my mind remains unswervingly in the musical sublimity (of SivA Principle), Oh Great Master! You are the nephew of Lord VishNu, worshipped as the Father of BrahmA, the four-faced Lord who creates all the worlds! Kindly grant me, Your ardent devotee, Your hallowed feet to destroy all my miseries that have arisen, Oh Lord! Lord SivA addresses You graciously as "Oh My Son, You are the Master of Your Father"; Oh Lord with a sharp spear! To the meter of "thOthimi thiththith thimiththa dingkuku deekuku dikkud dikukku diNdimi thOthi mithiththith thanaththa thantha", You dance encircled by the devils in SivA's kingdom! At the time of shedding my life from this body, You bless me with compassion and great munificence sending me to an auspicious state of prosperity, Oh Lord! You are the underlying principle of all chantings offered; You are kindhearted towards all Saivite devotees; You are the effulgent one being the pulse of the great PraNava ManthrA, OM! Just like a blooming odhiya tree in a cave, showers golden jewels in lieu of flowers, You bestow Your blessings in the rare form of liberation! You are seated with relish in Udhimalai*, Oh Great One!

614.english_meanings_list: ["When a man comes from anywhere, they set their enticing eyes on him;", "saying that no one could resist the passion for him,", "with a melting heart and craving words, they offer their sweet lips provoking him to hug them tightly;", "rolling their eyes playfully, they grab all his belongings and life in an unhesitating way without a shadow of doubt; thinking that their music and the union with these deer-like whores would be blissful for ever, I have been immersed in a sea of passion; to get me out of that sea,", "kindly bestow upon me Your grace that is filled with cool comfort!", "He holds in His hands the conch-shell and the disc; walking behind the herds of cows that He (coming as KrishNa) tends, He plays the bamboo flute which is filled with holes;", "to conquer their love for Him, He stole the robes of young women emotionally involved with Him and climbed to the top of the (kuruntha) tree; He has a handsome body; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "Lord BrahmA seated on the lotus was terrified when You set free all those celestials who sought refuge by shattering the demons;", "as all Your devotees gather together in Your worship, You are seated in ThensEri Giri*, Oh Great One!"]

He holds in His hands the conch-shell and the disc; walking behind the herds of cows that He (coming as KrishNa) tends, He plays the bamboo flute which is filled with holes; to conquer their love for Him, He stole the robes of young women emotionally involved with Him and climbed to the top of the (kuruntha) tree; He has a handsome body; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Lord BrahmA seated on the lotus was terrified when You set free all those celestials who sought refuge by shattering the demons; as all Your devotees gather together in Your worship, You are seated in ThensEri Giri*, Oh Great One!

615.english_meanings_list: ["With a flattering speech, they flirt with teasing and tantalising words;", "whoever they see, they tear their heart apart with their eyes;", "their hair is bedecked with a bunch of flowers; their bosom is comparable to the mount MEru in the north;", "with their majestic appearance as if they are seated in a stately court and with their slender waist like a creeper,", "and dancing like a peacock that shrieks aloud, these whores flirt amorously with everyone;", "lest my desire is channelled towards them in a delusory way,", "kindly teach me the same PraNava ManthrA that You preached, using primordial VEdic words in a manner beyond arguments, to Lord SivA on whose left side UmAdEvi is concorporate!", "Swarming merrily without leaving the lotus pond where the southerly breeze blows gently, the beetles imbibe honey from freshly blossomed lotus that never droop; such a pond is in VayalUr where You are seated, Oh Lord!", "He has the complexion of dense and dark cloud; He attacked and kicked the confrontational Kamsan with whom He fought until his death; He is Lord KrishNa who is the beloved of Goddess Lakshmi; and You are Her nephew, Oh Lord!", "The stranded demons were all taken as slaves after the red spear in Your reddish hand blew them apart, Oh Lord ShanmukhA!", "Beautiful golden-red wall surrounds this town like an ornament, and the moon's rays embrace it in", "ThensEri giri* where You are seated with relish on the hill, Oh Great One!"]
615.english_pathavurai: With a flattering speech, they flirt with teasing and tantalising words; whoever they see, they tear their heart apart with their eyes; their hair is bedecked with a bunch of flowers; their bosom is comparable to the mount MEru in the north; with their majestic appearance as if they are seated in a stately court and with their slender waist like a creeper, and dancing like a peacock that shrieks aloud, these whores flirt amorously with everyone; lest my desire is channelled towards them in a delusory way, kindly teach me the same PraNava ManthrA that You preached, using primordial VEdic words in a manner beyond arguments, to Lord SivA on whose left side UmAdEvi is concorporate! Swarming merrily without leaving the lotus pond where the southerly breeze blows gently, the beetles imbibe honey from freshly blossomed lotus that never droop; such a pond is in VayalUr where You are seated, Oh Lord! He has the complexion of dense and dark cloud; He attacked and kicked the confrontational Kamsan with whom He fought until his death; He is Lord KrishNa who is the beloved of Goddess Lakshmi; and You are Her nephew, Oh Lord! The stranded demons were all taken as slaves after the red spear in Your reddish hand blew them apart, Oh Lord ShanmukhA! Beautiful golden-red wall surrounds this town like an ornament, and the moon's rays embrace it in ThensEri giri* where You are seated with relish on the hill, Oh Great One!

616.english_meanings_list: ["A mind that is as fast as GanEshA, God with five hands (GanEshA went around the Universe in the fastest way),", "mastery over the five perceptory senses,", "and a thought process beyond the endless cycle of day and night", "bless me with these!", "In beautiful Tamil, which greatly flourishes in this world,", "(I should sing) Your praise with love.", "You should bless me with the requisite meditating mind", "so that this humble slave of Yours may attain salvation", "and transcend the cosmos of the moon (through yOgA).", "(I request You to give me) a palanquin, dignity and respect", "from people in all eight directions, with increasing awe and admiration.", "My mind, which has immersed itself in the sensual gratifications offered by women,", "should be made to concentrate only on You and to remain there in peace.", "Day and night, state leaders come to me seeking", "ways and means of protecting the people and ensuring their welfare;", "You have to give me the necessary wisdom to guide them.", "In Kongunadu, a miracle happened when a dead boy regained his life* (after he was devoured by a crocodile)", "through the compassion of SivA (AvinAsi), when the body also grew; teach me the secret of this miracle*", "You, the younger brother of the elephant-headed GanEshA, famous as the victorious Kanda", "You prosper in Kongkanagiri, Oh Great One!"]
616.english_pathavurai: A mind that is as fast as GanEshA, God with five hands (GanEshA went around the Universe in the fastest way), mastery over the five perceptory senses, and a thought process beyond the endless cycle of day and night bless me with these! In beautiful Tamil, which greatly flourishes in this world, (I should sing) Your praise with love. You should bless me with the requisite meditating mind so that this humble slave of Yours may attain salvation and transcend the cosmos of the moon (through yOgA). (I request You to give me) a palanquin, dignity and respect from people in all eight directions, with increasing awe and admiration. My mind, which has immersed itself in the sensual gratifications offered by women, should be made to concentrate only on You and to remain there in peace. Day and night, state leaders come to me seeking ways and means of protecting the people and ensuring their welfare; You have to give me the necessary wisdom to guide them. In Kongunadu, a miracle happened when a dead boy regained his life* (after he was devoured by a crocodile) through the compassion of SivA (AvinAsi), when the body also grew; teach me the secret of this miracle* You, the younger brother of the elephant-headed GanEshA, famous as the victorious Kanda You prosper in Kongkanagiri, Oh Great One!

617.english_pathavurai: Oh my mind, You do not melt down on realising the meanings of the songs. Even if the meaning is explained, You fail to melt. Even on seeing the path through which Yaman (God of Death) is coming, You do not thaw in devotion for the Lord. Despite facing all the miseries everyday, You do not realise the truth. Day in and day out, you never seek the blissful liberation granted by Lord SivA who is wearing the snakes on His tresses. You do not know to utter words of praise to the Lord even from the tip of your tongue. Having taken many wretched births in this world, oh my mind, you are not willing to seek the righteous way nor are you prepared to relinquish the shell of your body. You do not also know the path through which destiny, inscribed in the leaf of your fate, is driving you. I cannot be a mere spectator to your plight. I shall give you a piece of advice, please listen to me. He is the one who will grant you graciously the appropriate words to praise His glory and the ability to see His vision. He is easily accessible to His devotees. He removes both the good and bad deeds of those who worship Him. He is Lord Murugan, and you must meditate on Him. He makes the entire universe dance. He bent Meru, the mountain in the north, like a bow and tied the serpent VAsuki as the bow's string. He set fire to Thiripuram. He subdued the arrogance of Yaman (God of Death) by kicking him with His extended foot. He burnt down the body of Manmathan (God of Love) into ashes. He devastated the sacrificial rite of Dhakshan*. He attached the head of a goat on the body of Dhakshan. He punished Saraswathi, the Goddess of Scriptures, by inflicting injuries on Her face. He is the consort of UmAdEvi, and You are the son of that Lord SivA! He wrote the sacred ManthrA on a palm-leaf and set it out against the current in River Vaihai; He held against fire the palm-leaf which remained fresh and green without burning; with rage, He sent the ChamaNas (who lost in the debate) to the gallows; and He (ThirugnAna SambandhAr) was none other than You, Oh Great Master! Oh Immaculate One! In order that my mind eagerly pays obeisance to You, kindly bless me with compassion! You are the protector of this place known as Theerththa Malai**! You are the Lord of DEvayAnai, the daughter of IndrANi, Oh Great One!

626.english_pathavurai: These useless women display their love, techniques and vanity openly; even while keeping mum, these wicked and wasteful women abuse others; even if their suitors are from a low lineage, these treacherous whores swear saying "I promise upon my honour; I promise upon your honour" without any compunction whatsoever in order to grab their money; they stand right in front (of their suitors) and show off their pomp; showing feigned affection, they disturb anyone and when their suitors jump on them, they become standoffish; they adorn their beautiful body, their skin glittering with perfumed powder; saying on the one hand "Do not be too passionate; You are now making me dizzy with love; Oh, come on, come on", they, on the other hand, betray; These are vain people offering unworthy passion; how can any relationship be nurtured with such whores? Unknown to anyone, He quietly stood there and gobbled up the curd in the vessel hanging from the roof, making the sound "aha, aha"; when the huge king Kamsan, not having an iota of compassion, sent, as an emissary, a giant-sized woman (PUthanai) who was a large-jawed devil with her dreadful mouth wide open, He easily won over the battle waged by that fiendish woman; He is Krishna, and You are His nephew! You challenged the enemies, who were delving and dancing in sins, and the hostile demons to the war and destroyed them all, Oh Great Warrior! You protect the entire world with Your compassion and grace, Oh Lord MurugA! The river ThEnARu is famous in all the seven worlds including the celestial land; that river flows around the pure hill called MayUramalai, that is Your abode; This town KundRakkudi is a flourishing place where You are seated, Oh Great One!

638.english_pathavurai: I need clothes to wear; I need sumptuous drinks to quench my thirst and hunger; For a bright appearance, I need water to bathe and colourful clothes to wear; To heal my bodily diseases, I need medicines and remedies; I need a young wife to take care of my home; I need a private house for my sleeping pleasure; and if I get all these I need, I become a "Family Man"! Then I drown in the deep sea of illusion! I become the guardian of an extended family, and lo, there goes my life into utter waste! You must call me unto Yourself specially to provide me with a compassionate heart and Knowledge of SivA. I am caught reeling in the whirlwind of fate in this mountain-valley of birth; and will You please take me over one of these days? (Hereafter SwAmigaL describes HanumAn's role in RAmAyaNA, with particular reference to KadhirgAmam) "Some messengers should proceed Westward to look for (SitA); some should proceed Northward to search; and some should go Eastward" said Sugreeva sending his messengers. As for HanumAn, who is so sharp as to read between the lines, he was chosen as the head-messenger heading south; and his brief was not to return without any positive information (about SitA Devi). The great warrior HanumAn, who is never intimidated into losing to the cunning and vicious RAkshasAs, jumped across the wavy sea to the other side reached AsOkavanam, where SitA DEvi was imprisoned, and handed to her SriRAmA's divine and lovely golden ring. Back from his successful mission, HanumAn was blessed by You blissfully* at KadhirgAmam, Your favourite abode, Oh Great One!

640.english_pathavurai: The striped tigers in Your abode KadhirgAmam roar louder than, and drown, the rattling noise of the drums. Your valour displayed by the Spear shakes the waves of the sea! With a kind heart, You married DEvayAnai, reared by AirAvatham, the elephant of IndrA, noted for its fame and rage. You dwell inside the cave of my heart, Oh GuhA! Vishnu, father of Manmathan, was scared; BrahmA fled from the place; and the northern mount MEru saw its peak reduced to powder when Your peacock (more like a horse) danced; and You mounted on it, KanthA! I do not worship You in a traditional way as Your devotees do. Nevertheless, will my desires and miseries ever be extinguished? You desired to be the slave of VaLLi, the wonderful daughter of a sage meditating in the forest*, and faced a lot of trouble going to her millet field! Once there was a poet (PoyyAmozhi) who was roaming in the forest in a trance; You challenged him and took him on in the disguise of a hunter with a spear!** He gave the left side of His body to this emerald-green peahen, called PArvathi; and He is SivA. You are His treasure! Whether I praise You with kind words or I speak to You arrogantly, You are always extremely gracious to this poor soul, Oh Great One!

641.english_meanings_list: ["Their rolling eyes are sharp like the spear specially honed for the battlefield; shaking their breasts covered by tight blouses, they walk along the street like peacocks;", "even those great men, full of grace and purity, who abide by the four methods* of worship, namely, sariyai, kiriyai, yOgam (and gnAnam), are made to fall for them passionately by their seductive gestures;", "they belong to men who do not contemplate Your hallowed feet and who are under the delusory spell that causes death; these whores are like great parrots capable of casting a magical charm;", "even though I have been entangled in their bright bed, kindly offer me Your gracious blessing!", "She is the daughter of King HimavAn of the HimAlayAs; She makes one feel happy all the time; She is the Supreme Mother Sakthi; She has the form of GAyathri ManthrA that can never be grasped through description; and You are the son of that UmAdEvi!", "Oh MurugA, You resorted to scribing the madal** for VaLLi, the deer-like damsel of the hunters, and with extreme passion, You approached the raised platform where she stood and prostrated at her feet, Oh VisAkA!", "You became famous by fighting the war to liberate the celestials from their prison; You are the emperor among many famous and proficient crown-poets!", "You cried (coming as a child, ThirugnAna Sambandhar, and imbibing the nectar-like milk, breast-fed by DEvi PArvathi) and uplifted the world (with ThEvAram hymns), Oh the sun of Knowledge, born in the lineage of kavuNiyars!", "You belong to the rare town, KadhirgAmam, Oh Handsome One!"]
641.english_pathavurai: Their rolling eyes are sharp like the spear specially honed for the battlefield; shaking their breasts covered by tight blouses, they walk along the street like peacocks; even those great men, full of grace and purity, who abide by the four methods* of worship, namely, sariyai, kiriyai, yOgam (and gnAnam), are made to fall for them passionately by their seductive gestures; they belong to men who do not contemplate Your hallowed feet and who are under the delusory spell that causes death; these whores are like great parrots capable of casting a magical charm; even though I have been entangled in their bright bed, kindly offer me Your gracious blessing! She is the daughter of King HimavAn of the HimAlayAs; She makes one feel happy all the time; She is the Supreme Mother Sakthi; She has the form of GAyathri ManthrA that can never be grasped through description; and You are the son of that UmAdEvi! Oh MurugA, You resorted to scribing the madal** for VaLLi, the deer-like damsel of the hunters, and with extreme passion, You approached the raised platform where she stood and prostrated at her feet, Oh VisAkA! You became famous by fighting the war to liberate the celestials from their prison; You are the emperor among many famous and proficient crown-poets! You cried (coming as a child, ThirugnAna Sambandhar, and imbibing the nectar-like milk, breast-fed by DEvi PArvathi) and uplifted the world (with ThEvAram hymns), Oh the sun of Knowledge, born in the lineage of kavuNiyars! You belong to the rare town, KadhirgAmam, Oh Handsome One!

642.english_pathavurai: You are born between the reeds (saravaNabava); When SUran jumped into the battlefield strongly and smartly, You spared him until he behaved himself; (when he did not) You approached him and closed in on him; then You split his body into two; his head and chest were cut and piled into a heap; finally, You killed him. Many garlands of appreciation were showered on You, along with a staff carrying a rooster. Victory greeted You! Kindly grant me Your lotus feet! The asuras at Thiripuram were well armed with boons and arrows; when they came forward to wage a war (with SivA), SivA was patient at first and later, attired Himself in a war-outfit; (without any weapons) he smiled and burnt Thiripuram down with the sparkling fiery eye on His forehead! Then, He peeled off the hide of (GajamukAsuran who came as) an elephant; He spread out the hide and wore it as His robe! When Manmathan (Love God) sent by DEvAs, came on the chariot of southerly breeze with an intention to shoot arrows at Him, He reduced Manmathan into ashes; and that Great SivA adores You as the pearl of His eye! You are happily settled in KadhirgAmam, Oh MurugA!

643.english_pathavurai: It is beyond the reach of people who worship through the sariyai* method, or the kiriyai method or the great yOgA process; It is above the Supreme Power (ParAsakthi) that is capable of granting the true knowledge which cannot even be approached by diverse religious pursuits; It is where the ascetics (yOgis) remain in a transcendental stage; It extends even beyond that stage where supreme knowledge pervades as a unique effulgence; It is an eminent place; It is impeccable; It is the non-dual amalgamation of the Lord with my soul (SAyujyam); It is endless; It is the celebrated blissful form; will I ever attain It duly? You are the mighty Lord of VayalUr surrounded by walls, Oh Virtuous One! You wielded the spear from Your hand to knock down that strong and valorous demon SUran who rolled over on the ground, Lord KumarA! You graciously blessed me so that I could compose great songs (Thiruppugazh) spreading Your glory! Herds of black monkeys climb the jack-fruit trees, tear the fruits, pick out the slices and eat, fighting among themselves, and jumping between the plantain and mango trees in the fertile country called eezham (Sri LankA), where You chose Mount KadhirgAmam as Your abode, Oh Great One!

644.english_pathavurai: Their beautiful and exhilarating breasts are heavy, wearing a string of pearls and smeared with sandalwood paste; their tight waistline is slender; their musical speech is sweet like the molten jaggery; their eyes impinge like the flowery arrows of Manmathan (God of Love); with all these, the whores provoke passion and trap their suitors; by their tuft of hair looking like the dark cloud, their ears wearing the swinging studs looking like the makara fish and their round faces, I have been exceedingly enchanted; the locked-in obsessive passion of mine has been totally eradicated by Your hallowed feet, and how could I ever forget those feet? In the old country of LankA, the Sun was scared to enter and drive his chariot* (being terrified of RAvaNan); He bewildered that RAvaNan of ten heads and chopped him to pieces; and You are the famous nephew of that mystic Lord VishNu, Oh Lord! You dwell at thousands of abodes and prevail over millions of mountains! Your lotus feet are sought by Your devotees at KadhirgAmam! 651.english_pathavurai: I am the worst sinner in this world. I am a very deceitful fool. I am a deliberate and determined thief. I waste my life indulging in extreme lust. Bless me to wear that ash so that I could attain the real goal of beholding Your holy feet. Bless me to become worthy of realising the Pure Knowledge that is the True Wisdom, filled with Your holy grace. When, once, the elephant GajEndran was dragged and attacked by a crocodile, mystic Vishnu rushed to his rescue; and You are His delightful nephew! Thiripuram, which once flourished grandly, lost its lustre as it went up in smoke and was reduced to ashes by Lord SivA, who has adorned His matted locks with the great crescent moon; and You are His son! One who is the cause for everything and the target, Lord of Justice is Lord SivA; and in His shrines, You, as ThirugnAna Sambandhar, sang the Great hymns of Saivite DharmA (called ThEvAram), Oh holder of the bright spear! You sought VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, in the forest. Oh Kumara, You always speak the language of True Knowledge and You are Supreme! You reside in KAsi* eminently, Oh Great One!

652.english_pathavurai: A woman and her husband lived together happily. The force of passion hit them, and (as a result) a stream of bursting snow-like sperms spread inside; by the grace of Lord Brahma, the foetus became swollen like a beetle. As days passed by, it grew to the size of a ball, palm fruit and tender coconut and developed into the size of a pot. With further growth in many respects, the foetus came upside down through the same route in which the intercourse took place, after the lapse of ten months, and landed on the earth. Being named as the son, the child became the favourite of both the mother and the father who doted on him with love. Imbibing milk from reddish and huge breasts over many days, the child crawled elegantly and walked for many days. Growing like this, am I destined to while away my time in a wasteful manner indulging with whores having wide and poisonous eyes, thereby ruining myself? When this boy PrakalAthan declared that Lord VishNu would appear clearly like the nelli fruit on the palm, He appeared, with tremendous love and affection for the boy, out of a pillar taking the form of Man-Lion (Narasingam) with prominent teeth and tore open the body of the demon king HiraNyan; He graciously blessed the celestials; He holds in His hallowed hands as jewels that never part His company, the conch (PAncha janyam) and the disc (Sudharsanam); He slumbers on a huge serpent-bed (AdhisEshan) in the shrine at Sreerangam on the banks of the twin rivers (KAvEri and KoLLidam); and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu, Oh Lord! She is concorporate on the left side of the body of Lord SivA, who holds River Gangai on His matted hair; Her complexion is a combination of gold and bright coral; Her face is milky-white like the moon; Her hair is dark; and You are the child of that Goddess ParamEswari (PArvathi), Oh Lord! Mounting the peacock that leaps like a horse, You seek the delightful company of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, blessed with two lovely breasts! You are seated in KAsi* (VAranAsi) on the banks of the River Gangai, Oh Great One!

655.english_meanings_list: ["He pressed His toes so hard that RAvana, the great warrior, who tried to lift the rare mount KailAsh, was crushed underneath!", "He is SivA who holds UmAdEvi on the left side of His body; and You are Her beloved son!", "You are the most favourite (nephew) of Vishnu who as RAmA built a bridge across the ocean!", "You move around in all the eight directions, mounted on Your vehicle that is the lovely Peacock!", "Your six faces shine like the Sun, and You have broad shoulders and twelve arms!", "Oh MurugA of great fame!", "Your devotees contemplate Your lotus feet in their hearts everyday;", "please grant me the wisdom to prostrate at the feet of such devotees.", "Your father SivA asked You to explain the significance of OM, the foremost ManthrA of the scriptures, first uttered by BrahmA,", "and You readily spoke to Him of its significance, Oh Wise Master!", "For the prosperity of IndrA, the Leader of the DEvAs,", "for the release of all DEvAs from the prisons of SUran,", "and for the mutilation of all asuras (demons),", "You threw Your Spear, Oh Lord!", "Fragrant flowers blossom plentifully in trees in the surrounding fields,", "along with the adjacent lily ponds full of blue lillies (neelOthpala flowers) and", "on the fertile banks of the river Saraswathi which flows along", "Your abode at Vayiravivanam*, Oh Great One!"]
655.english_pathavurai: He pressed His toes so hard that RAvana, the great warrior, who tried to lift the rare mount KailAsh, was crushed underneath! He is SivA who holds UmAdEvi on the left side of His body; and You are Her beloved son! You are the most favourite (nephew) of Vishnu who as RAmA built a bridge across the ocean! You move around in all the eight directions, mounted on Your vehicle that is the lovely Peacock! Your six faces shine like the Sun, and You have broad shoulders and twelve arms! Oh MurugA of great fame! Your devotees contemplate Your lotus feet in their hearts everyday; please grant me the wisdom to prostrate at the feet of such devotees. Your father SivA asked You to explain the significance of OM, the foremost ManthrA of the scriptures, first uttered by BrahmA, and You readily spoke to Him of its significance, Oh Wise Master! For the prosperity of IndrA, the Leader of the DEvAs, for the release of all DEvAs from the prisons of SUran, and for the mutilation of all asuras (demons), You threw Your Spear, Oh Lord! Fragrant flowers blossom plentifully in trees in the surrounding fields, along with the adjacent lily ponds full of blue lillies (neelOthpala flowers) and on the fertile banks of the river Saraswathi which flows along Your abode at Vayiravivanam*, Oh Great One!

656.english_meanings_list: ["BrahmA, the son of powerful Vishnu, has already decreed the path of fate; according to that fate,", "the five senses (taste, sight, feeling, sound and smell) work in collusion in the cottage of my body. Every day,", "the five sensory organs (mouth, eyes, body, ears and nose) create trouble in this world that is surrounded by wavy oceans, thereby causing heart-break and dizziness.", "In order for this miserable lowly person to be relieved of indulgence through mind, speech and action", "in worldly affairs, to put an end to this delusion,", "to sever the attachment arising from my egoism and to attain Your hallowed feet,", "kindly teach me a lesson indicating the frontier of tranquility.", "VaLLi's bejewelled bosoms, her pretty face,", "her creeper-like delicate ears,", "and her emerald green complexion were all sketched by You on a lotus leaf,", "and You stood there at the millet field, Oh valorous One mounting the peacock!", "He holds poison in His neck; He is extremely virtuous; He has placed the crescent moon on His tresses; He is unblemished;", "His abode is the silvery mount KailAsh where He materialised as a 'lingA'*; You are the Master of that Lord SivA!", "Your feet are like the freshly blossomed lotus wearing the anklets;", "You have chosen Your abode at VeLLigaram*, Oh Great One!"]
656.english_pathavurai: BrahmA, the son of powerful Vishnu, has already decreed the path of fate; according to that fate, the five senses (taste, sight, feeling, sound and smell) work in collusion in the cottage of my body. Every day, the five sensory organs (mouth, eyes, body, ears and nose) create trouble in this world that is surrounded by wavy oceans, thereby causing heart-break and dizziness. In order for this miserable lowly person to be relieved of indulgence through mind, speech and action in worldly affairs, to put an end to this delusion, to sever the attachment arising from my egoism and to attain Your hallowed feet, kindly teach me a lesson indicating the frontier of tranquility. VaLLi's bejewelled bosoms, her pretty face, her creeper-like delicate ears, and her emerald green complexion were all sketched by You on a lotus leaf, and You stood there at the millet field, Oh valorous One mounting the peacock! He holds poison in His neck; He is extremely virtuous; He has placed the crescent moon on His tresses; He is unblemished; His abode is the silvery mount KailAsh where He materialised as a 'lingA'*; You are the Master of that Lord SivA! Your feet are like the freshly blossomed lotus wearing the anklets; You have chosen Your abode at VeLLigaram*, Oh Great One!

658.english_meanings_list: ["The whores all over the world, full of blemishes, have teeth like cool jasmine, sweet speech like seasoned jaggery,", "ears like tender vaLLi (creeper), waist like slender vine and youthful and developed bosom;", "so saying, I hankered after them, and even though I sought carnal pleasure with such tarnished whores, capable of making me feel miserable,", "kindly grant me Your blessings, little by little, to adorn Your hallowed feet with refined garlands of poems and fragrant flowers!", "Once, a Saivite sage was in deep penance which was distracted by a spotted deer jumping about; his union with that deer resulted in the birth of this girl who grew up in a millet field;", "that VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters belonging to Mount VaLLimalai, gave you the millet-flour which You ate in a relaxed way with relish, Oh Lord!", "Those ChamaNas preached a religious way of little value, and their entire clan was sent to the gallows by You (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar); and You took VeLLigaram* as Your abode, Oh Our Treasure!", "You are capable of fighting so fiercely that the entire wealth of the hostile demons is drowned in the sea, Oh Great One!"]

Once, a Saivite sage was in deep penance which was distracted by a spotted deer jumping about; his union with that deer resulted in the birth of this girl who grew up in a millet field; that VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters belonging to Mount VaLLimalai, gave you the millet-flour which You ate in a relaxed way with relish, Oh Lord! You are capable of fighting so fiercely that the entire wealth of the hostile demons is drowned in the sea, Oh Great One!

To Lord SivA, who resides in the most desirable abode of Mount KailAsh, You explained the significance of PraNava ManthrA successfully, Oh Great One!

662.english_pathavurai: Being embarrassed to say no, and without holding back any possession, one should be able to share with others whatever little bit one has. People who do not share with others should be discerned by me as those to be condemned. I do not know the means to survive. I do not know how to compose Your venerable names in beautiful poems about Yourself. I do not realise that You are endless, pristine and the primordial principle. I am a liar cherishing this decaying mortal body of mine. Nonetheless, without forsaking, You always protect me with Your holy feet; and I wonder at Your magnanimity! The mighty asuras were left to perish; the virtuous DEvAs were protected; and the sinful mount Krouncha was smashed to smidgen by You. Dense groves and cool mountains abound in VaLLimalai where lives the petite damsel, VaLLi, a veritable creeper; and You are her consort! You mount the triumphant Peacock, Oh Lord Kumara! You adorn Yourself with fresh viLa leaves and Kadappa flowers. In the prosperous-looking streets of this town, there are many beautiful silvery-white balconies in VeLLigaram* (meaning Silver Town), which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

664.english_pathavurai: VaLLi has a lotus face and eyes like arrows; You went to her millet-field and said "Come over to me. Your town (VaLLimalai) is just 25 miles away from my town (ThiruththaNigai). Both of our hometowns are so close to each other that there is only a millet-field in between them" Thus You spoke to her in that grove where You surrendered all Your strength. You were so enchanted with VaLLi that You were ready to climb the "madal"*, Oh my Lord! The hunter (Kannappan) offered food saying that it was very sweet; and after taking a bite by himself, he then offered the food that was gladly accepted by Him (Lord SivA) who cast a magic spell on the hunter (with bleeding eye). You are the Son of that pure SivA! You remain forever youthful; (at the same time) the ancient work in Tamil (ThirumurugAtRuppadai) calls You the old man of the mountains! When You are worshipped ardently in a big way, millions of births** are destroyed. This is indeed a miracle! He holds in His hands five different weapons; GowthamOthaki as the mace, the great SArangam as the bow, Sudharsanam as the wheel, PAnchajanyam as the Conch and NAndhakam as the sword; Yasodhai, the consort of King NandagOpan, was delighted when the grinding stone to which she tied Him was dragged by the famous butter thief; He grew terrifyingly upto the sky piercing it with His head; (before that) He stood innocently in front of the benevolent Emperor MahAbali as pious little VAmanan seeking alms; and He is Your Uncle NarAyaNan! You lost Your temper with His son, BrahmA, Oh Lord! Amid the fertile paddy field, there are plenty of conch shells in this place, called VeLLinagar (VeLLigaram***), which is Your abode, Oh Lord of the Spear! You are the Master of all the DEvAs worshipping You!

665.english_pathavurai: The skin and flesh are soaked in water that is filled inside, with bones interlinked through joints here and there, for everything to function well in coordination; both legs are so properly fitted that this hut of a body could be mobile on its feet; in this body, life moves at a very fast pace when the five fiery sensory organs romp around like mad elephants ravaging the five senses; to avoid this ruin, kindly grant me the energy to recite Your name flawlessly, saying "KanthA, my Lord!" in front of all Your devotees prostrating at Your hallowed feet! Once, the charming flautist, Krishna, who was capable of playing the flute enchantingly making the melodious music tranquil, came (as VishNu) to the aid of the elephant GajEndran who screamed in pain, calling out His name "Oh Primordial One, I seek refuge in You!" He dashed to that place in the twinkling of an eye (to save the elephant); He is the mystical Lord, VishNu; (along with Him) there were BrahmA, others from many directions, and people of the earth and the celestial world, who went around Lord SivA with reverence in this old city of His; women come here and perform superb dances in Thiruva(l)lam*, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

666.english_pathavurai: These women offer pleasure to those who pay them a lot of money. If their suitors are accompanied by some who do not pay, they mercilessly drive them away. They are an embodiment of delusion. They feign friendship and make utter fools of their suitors. They openly display their bosom on their chest. These worst sinners do not have an iota of compassion. They deliberately ignore their suitors and indulge in many a sinful activity. They put forth arguments using the choicest words that cannot be relied upon and provoke passion. They are the impish goddesses of adversity (mUthEvi) holding on to their suitors without letting them go. Will there be a day for me to get out of the company of such women and attain Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord? In the Kingdom of PANdiyAs which had Madhurai as its capital, the King was following the principles of the samaNAs; smearing the holy ash upon that King, You straightened his hunch-back; in the nearby river Vaigai, the palm leaves that were placed on the flood water went against the current, and the beautiful queen Mangaiyarkkarasi of PANdiya kingdom extolled You with deep devotion; because of that and the great miracles performed by You, the samaNAs were all annihilated, and You triumphed coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar, Oh Leader! The honey-like juices oozing out of the fresh mangoes in this place flow through the sugarcane factories that are engaged in manufacture of sugar day and night, and then overflow further into the neighbouring towns; because of this unique honour, this town was praised by many experts, who had excelled in all walks of life, comparing it to ALagApuri*; this is Your abode, VElUr, Oh Great One!

667.english_meanings_list: ["They have one eye looking like the sEl fish and the other like poisonous venom; with their spear-like beautiful reddish eyes, they conquer men;", "they preplan to ruin their wealth, lives and hearts;", "their speech is sweet like honey, and with well-chosen words, they come forward to hug;", "I have been enamoured of the posh display of these whores who are capable of offering endless misery and delusory bliss;", "I do not show my love to You, and in order to arrest the loss of my gleam and the deterioration and destruction of my body,", "to face up to, and conquer, millions of obstacles that confront me,", "and in order that I follow everyday the righteous path of true devotion, kindly bless me to worship You.", "The great Manmathan (God of Love) was totally perplexed, and roaming about aimlessly;", "as also the beauty of his sugarcane bow, he perished when Lord SivA went after him and burnt him down; You are that SivA's Treasure, Oh KanthA!", "Once, when the hostile and mighty demons accosted You within a close range, You mounted the peacock and subdued them all!", "Acceding to the moving entreaty of the celestials who always contemplate upon the Supreme and Primordial Substance, You wielded the spear and destroyed the Mount Krouncha, Oh Lord!", "Many women with bamboo-like robust shoulders assemble here to offer worship, and You have chosen Your abode in this worthy place, VElUr, Oh Great One!"]
667.english_pathavurai: They have one eye looking like the sEl fish and the other like poisonous venom; with their spear-like beautiful reddish eyes, they conquer men; they preplan to ruin their wealth, lives and hearts; their speech is sweet like honey, and with well-chosen words, they come forward to hug; I have been enamoured of the posh display of these whores who are capable of offering endless misery and delusory bliss; I do not show my love to You, and in order to arrest the loss of my gleam and the deterioration and destruction of my body, to face up to, and conquer, millions of obstacles that confront me, and in order that I follow everyday the righteous path of true devotion, kindly bless me to worship You. The great Manmathan (God of Love) was totally perplexed, and roaming about aimlessly; as also the beauty of his sugarcane bow, he perished when Lord SivA went after him and burnt him down; You are that SivA's Treasure, Oh KanthA! Once, when the hostile and mighty demons accosted You within a close range, You mounted the peacock and subdued them all! Acceding to the moving entreaty of the celestials who always contemplate upon the Supreme and Primordial Substance, You wielded the spear and destroyed the Mount Krouncha, Oh Lord! Many women with bamboo-like robust shoulders assemble here to offer worship, and You have chosen Your abode in this worthy place, VElUr, Oh Great One!

668.english_pathavurai: They will let one suitor recline on the mattress in the bed in their little house while another suitor will be left stranded at the gate of their house in a state of dilemma. Yet another suitor will be on the street roaming here and there with a lot of anxiety. Because of these acts, they play one suitor against the other creating jealousy and rancour, sometimes drawing the sword from the sheath and sometimes wrestling in their room. Some suitors, on a second thought, are grateful to have been spared their lives; such thoughts are caused by these whores. Because of the passionate desires aroused by them, I trangressed the righteous path of penance, lacking the discipline to perform the sariyai and kiriyai* functions and forsaking good conduct; and I squandered away all my savings in wasteful expenses and became the laughing stock of the town, jeered at by one and all. To remove all kinds of miseries that afflict me and to enable me to acquire all the virtues along with fame in this world, I have to earn my respect by contemplating with love, Your hallowed feet at all times; for that, kindly bless me graciously, Oh Lord! The demons imprisoned and tortured the celestials who used to implicitly follow the word of their Master Brahaspathi and remained in the right path. Those demons were a total waste possessing utterly vicious attributes, and they were punished for their earlier crimes by being severed by Your spear, Oh Lord! She has a speech sweet like that of the cuckoo; eyes like the kayal fish; lips like the coral; forehead like a bow; and face like the moon. She wears a broad smile; Her hair is like the dark cloud; Her breasts are mountain-like; Her waist is slender like the creeper; Her gait is like that of the she-elephant; and She is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and You hug her tightly, Oh Lord! Those chamaNAS possessed the treachery that could knock down research scholars of the six religions; they were notorious in plucking the hair off their head; their entire lineage was smashed and decimated when You conquered them in debates and sent their bodies alive to the sharp gallows (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar), Oh Lord! Bunches of betelnuts fall from the trees on plantain trees knocking down clusters of plantain fruits which in turn shake the sugarcanes felling pearls on the waterfront in the fields where kayal fish jump about playing in this town, Thirukkarapuram (Virinjipuram); and You are seated here, Oh Six-faced Lord, the Great One!

670.english_pathavurai: "The five elements which are peerless, the mind with thinking ability and the soul will all be melting and merging in a state of non-enmity by Your Grace, Oh the Radiant Sun of Knowledge! You are immortal and supreme, Oh beautiful Lord KumArA!" - so chant the VEdAs (scriptures) praising It. There are radical religious fanatics who make loud noise like the roaring ocean (founded by SakarAs) which is full of conch shells; but those religious debauchees can never know Its value! It stands all alone uniquely even when the Universe is about to end. It is adorned by victorious anklet, with lilting beads inside. It is nothing else but Your Lotus Feet; and will You grant It to me? The seas which are full of sharks and fish, bright, with noisy waves, and with a number of ships passing through, simply boiled over and evaporated due to excess heat; the armies of asuras (demons) who came along the wide sky* and SUran who opposed You fighting in the battlefield, - all died; the DEvAs, led by IndrA, were able to settle in their redeemed heavenly land; and the peaks of the magical mountain Krouncha were shattered; all these happened when You let go Your victorious Spear, Oh Young One! You are the treasure of Lord SivA, who wears the crescent moon on His tresses! From all directions, the famous kings, DEvAs and BrahmA worship this famous place called Thiruvirinjai**, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

Destroying the arrogance and conceit of the dark and cruel demons, You wielded the spear swiftly shattering their bodies into pieces of food for the eagles satiating their hunger, Oh valorous One! Lord BrahmA on the lotus, Lord VishNu, VaruNan, Agni, Yaman, Lord IndrA who mounts the white elephant, AirAvadham, and who has eyes all over his body, and all other celestials were able to reestablish their position by Your grace, Oh Lord! He held in His neck the AlakAla poison that arose from the roaring milky ocean; He wrapped around His body the skin of the tiger; He wore the snake on His tress as an ornament; He performed grandly the cosmic dance; You are the virtuous son, born to that Lord SivA! These sages do daily research into the rare VEdAs and interpret their meaning; they carry out their duties neatly on this earth; the favourite place of those sages is Virinjipuram*, which is also Your abode, Oh Six-faced Lord, You are the Great One!

674.english_pathavurai: Even the sons who uplift the fame in a congregation in an indelible manner cannot be deemed indestructible assets. In this earthly life of tumultous commotion, where material wealth is considered today as the best succour for all, when the angry and evil God of Death (Yaman) is lurking to snatch the life away, "this chap is staying put here, fully donned, holding his life inside the so-called lofty body which is nothing but a base shell; today, he does not even remember to worship You, singing Your glory" - so speak others in a disreputable and scandal-mongering tone; before such scandal spreads, to dispel the proliferating deeds that stem from the mind and the five sensory organs, kindly consider granting Your hallowed feet and taking charge of me! Once, He lifted the Mount (Govardhan) like an umbrella and protected the calves and the cows; He gulped down the earth; and You are the greatly admired nephew of that Lord VishNu! You were charmed by the unswerving mind of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, who donned her firm bosom with fresh garland of flower bunches; and You went beseeching her to graciously take charge of You! Once, the great cosmic dancer, Lord SivA, danced at ThiruvAlangkAdu* for uplifting even the celestials; You came (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) to sanctify that place with Divine Grace by explaining the good effects of those hymns (thEvAram), Oh our Treasure! You eradicate the sins of all those devotees who worship Your feet with love; and You are able to bless them with fearless heart and prosperity on this earth, Oh Great One!

675.english_pathavurai: Earth, water and air were combined; fire and sky were blended with the mixture; a brand new mind was fitted; in between, senses and sensory organs, numbering ten, were fastened; four powerful gears, namely, mind, intellect, egotism and willpower, were added; nine so-called portals* were created; and thus the body was created! (The causes for birth in this body are) the bad deeds (karma) which must be pulverised. I must possess a good mind that will pursue only the righteous way. You must explain to me the significance of Pasu, Pathi and PAsam (the soul in this body, God and attachment). My five senses must be extinguished. Having driven me to this earth, You must come now to take charge of this slave of Yours, blessing me and showing me the right path to the supreme liberation! To disseminate, for the benefit of the world, the True Knowledge of SivA, and to bestow His holy vision on the ascetic sages**, Lord SivA danced His Cosmic Dance; You are His child, oh MurugA! Vishnu, holding Goddess Lakshmi in His heart, praised; and BrahmA, whose four faces point to the four directions, worshipped You daily; when You mounted the Peacock to protect this world and the world of the celestials; You conquered Mount Krouncha and defeated SUran; You attacked the seven seas and the mango tree (in which SUran had disguised himself) by drawing Your sharp Spear and throwing it in the battlefield, Oh Lord Kumara!
