679.english_meanings_list: ["I have been willingly carrying this burden of my body to be eventually devoured by a bunch of vultures that would belch after their stomach is filled;", "I have been visiting many towns, roaming about and getting exhausted in search of ways to amass wealth; I do not wish to stand here and there, weakened and depressed;", "instead, I wish to get rid of my five sensory organs that remain constantly hostile, praise You (with a resolute mind) and repeatedly sing the songs of Your glory; this humble slave, namely myself, ardently seeks Your hallowed feet", "and wishes to unite with You and to enter the blissful heaven that is beyond all sorrows; will I have the pleasure of remaining in that state of bliss?", "He is Lord VishNu holding the sword (NAnthakam) made in unblemished and refined gold, the disc (Sudharsanam), the aptly fitting conch-shell (PAnchajanyam), the mace (KoumOthaki) and the bow (SArangam) and wearing the indestructible and beautiful golden ornaments;", "the waves that lash the shore of the ocean, filled with milk, look like the prostrating long arms that worship that Lord; in that milky ocean, He chose for His bed the Serpent AdhisEshan, with spear like sharp and fiery eyes; He is the slumbering Lord VishNu, and You are His nephew, Oh Lord!", "The kendai fish in this place leap to attack the tall betelnut trees and the sugarcanes and then settle into the pond; this is PAkkam*, Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
679.english_pathavurai: I have been willingly carrying this burden of my body to be eventually devoured by a bunch of vultures that would belch after their stomach is filled; I have been visiting many towns, roaming about and getting exhausted in search of ways to amass wealth; I do not wish to stand here and there, weakened and depressed; instead, I wish to get rid of my five sensory organs that remain constantly hostile, praise You (with a resolute mind) and repeatedly sing the songs of Your glory; this humble slave, namely myself, ardently seeks Your hallowed feet and wishes to unite with You and to enter the blissful heaven that is beyond all sorrows; will I have the pleasure of remaining in that state of bliss? He is Lord VishNu holding the sword (NAnthakam) made in unblemished and refined gold, the disc (Sudharsanam), the aptly fitting conch-shell (PAnchajanyam), the mace (KoumOthaki) and the bow (SArangam) and wearing the indestructible and beautiful golden ornaments; the waves that lash the shore of the ocean, filled with milk, look like the prostrating long arms that worship that Lord; in that milky ocean, He chose for His bed the Serpent AdhisEshan, with spear like sharp and fiery eyes; He is the slumbering Lord VishNu, and You are His nephew, Oh Lord! 681.english_pathavurai: Their hair is black and thick like the dark cloud; their eyes are like the sharp spear; their speech is sweet as milk; their waist line is slender like the thread; their bosoms are like the tender coconut; crazy about such harlots, oh my mind, you are going fanatical with infatuation! I am born with such an obsessive passion; I am the worst sinner; would You not look at me with Your gracious eyes? Would You not consider me as one among Your devotees? Would You not bestow upon me Your total compassion? Oh, Lord Kumara, the son of UmAdEvi! He is endowed with words of praise from the poets of the world; he is Nakkeerar*, an oustanding poet in this old world, surrounded by oceans; You accepted Him gladly; would You not show me similar grace and preach a matchless word of ManthrA? You are the primordial source showering grace on the entire world! The samaNa priests, who were the root cause of confrontation, were annihilated by Your angry words (of thEvAram, when You came as ThirugnAna Sambandhar). You are the enthusiastic leader whose efforts enhanced the cause of the great Saivism! You are always in the state of yOgA, Oh Wise One, You are the Son of SivA. Oh GuhA, You are the treasure of Your devotees! You are the beloved and great consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters who dwell in the forest holding spears in their hands. You are the child of VEdapureesar (Lord SivA) who resides in ThiruvERkAdu**. You are the handsome consort of DEvayAnai, the daughter of IndrA, famous for his many sacrificial oblations. You are the treasure of DEvAs of the golden celestial world, Oh Great One!

682.english_pathavurai: Beautiful women, the world surrounded by the seas, and wealth are the oceans of lust which I can hardly cross. To assuage the sufferings of this stupid me, will You ever deign to grant me Your grace? Or are You determined to let me rot in these dark prisons of births for a long long time? Am I going to be denied even a little of Your grace? I am unable to recognise the multitude of Your devotees. The Great Mount Meru was lifted by Her* as a bow by pretty Goddess PArvathi whose consort is AruNachAlar, and You are His Master! In a virtuous birth, with deep meditation, You have to give me this home of my body; and please tell me when You will do so. You are praised by great saints, Oh Virtuous One! You are SivA and also the Master of SivA! She wears snakes for jewels; She steals our hearts and revels in the company of great devils; She rejoices in dancing with SivA in the jungles; She is soft as soft can be; and She is the Supreme Goddess, PArvathi. You are the Great King She has bestowed with us. He is an archer with arrows of waterborne flowers such as lotus, lily, neelOthpalam (a blue flower) etc; and He is Great Manmathan (Love God). His mother, the renowned Goddess of Wealth, is Lakshmi. You are Her Nephew! You are the God of all DEvAs, Oh MurugA! Goddess PArvathi, who married young, and who is the creeper-like damsel of Mount Himalayas, loves to sit captivatingly at Chidhambaram, where Lord NadarAjA performs the Great Cosmic dance; and You are that SivA's dear son! A lush growth of fragrant jasmine plants and soft flowers abound in elegant gardens with ponds all around at VadamullaivAyil**, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

683.english_meanings_list: ["With their face looking like the bright moon and their big bosom like Mount MEru,", "they accost men coming at a distance and conclude their terms of negotiation as though they have been very old and close friends;", "they fall all over them and hug both their shoulders; talking deviously, they coax them to visit their home and remain united with them;", "they forcibly embrace their suitors and offer their lips that are like reddish kovvai fruit; on those days, once these women grab all their belongings, they either remain tight-lipped or resort to unnecessary squabbles and rebuke them;", "I fell passionately for these wicked whores who were out to deceive me; I have been a foolish sinner having lost my peace of mind; will I ever reach the righteous path?", "When the celestials praised You in worship, addressing You as \"Oh the Primordial Lord!\", You attacked their enemy, namely the demon SUran, and totally smashed him to pieces by angrily mounting the peacock and wielding Your long spear, Oh Lord!", "He happily went to every town where the shepherds resided, climbed on top of the stone-barrel and reached for the butter kept in the 'uRi' (hanging holder of containers); stealthily picking up that butter, He ate it to His heart's content; and You are the nephew of that KrishNa (Lord VishNu), Oh Lord!", "He is the Primordial Lord who conquered KALi who challenged Him in a debate; He has the hallowed feet that were worshipped by VaruNan, Lord of the Oceans, with a lot of prostrating waves serving as his arms; He is Lord SivA;", "He is known as Lord MAsilAmaNi* (in the town of Vada ThirumullaivAyil) worshipped by Lord BrahmA, seated on a great fragrant lotus, along with Lord VishNu in whose heart Lakshmi resides; You are the son delivered happily by that Lord, Oh Great One!"]
683.english_pathavurai: With their face looking like the bright moon and their big bosom like Mount MEru, they accost men coming at a distance and conclude their terms of negotiation as though they have been very old and close friends; they fall all over them and hug both their shoulders; talking deviously, they coax them to visit their home and remain united with them; they forcibly embrace their suitors and offer their lips that are like reddish kovvai fruit; on those days, once these women grab all their belongings, they either remain tight-lipped or resort to unnecessary squabbles and rebuke them; I fell passionately for these wicked whores who were out to deceive me; I have been a foolish sinner having lost my peace of mind; will I ever reach the righteous path? When the celestials praised You in worship, addressing You as "Oh the Primordial Lord!", You attacked their enemy, namely the demon SUran, and totally smashed him to pieces by angrily mounting the peacock and wielding Your long spear, Oh Lord! He happily went to every town where the shepherds resided, climbed on top of the stone-barrel and reached for the butter kept in the 'uRi' (hanging holder of containers); stealthily picking up that butter, He ate it to His heart's content; and You are the nephew of that KrishNa (Lord VishNu), Oh Lord! He is the Primordial Lord who conquered KALi who challenged Him in a debate; He has the hallowed feet that were worshipped by VaruNan, Lord of the Oceans, with a lot of prostrating waves serving as his arms; He is Lord SivA; He is known as Lord MAsilAmaNi* (in the town of Vada ThirumullaivAyil) worshipped by Lord BrahmA, seated on a great fragrant lotus, along with Lord VishNu in whose heart Lakshmi resides; You are the son delivered happily by that Lord, Oh Great One!

687.english_pathavurai: Oh Luminous One, the entire universe is contained within Your great form! You are beheld as the Brahman offering real happiness to all. You are radiant with Brahmic glow, and You are sweet and the most auspicious. Your pure incandescence never gets extinguished. You are beyond the reach of religions and are rapturous. Your valour is multi-faceted! Bless me so that I am not to enter the womb of any woman! Bless me so that I worship Your feet, the most desirable part of Your great form and Bless me to excel in all aspects of music. Oh compassionate and dazzling one, with Your grace, may I attain the unblemished liberation of my soul and get rid of all sufferings? You hold in Your hand the staff with the colourful rooster! In the battle field, the fierce and dazzling spear is held in Your hand, Oh Lord! You are the nephew of Vishnu, Oh KumarA! You are famous, Oh GuhA! You are spotlessly pure and effulgent! You are the God of Death for all ravenous demons lacking in character! In ThiruvotRiyur, where Lakshmi, Goddess of Wealth, happily resides, Lord SivA is seated near the seashore. You are His son! Devout sages who are notable for their deep yOgAs and intense penance hold You dearly in their hearts, Oh Great One!

688.english_pathavurai: IndrA, the Chief of the Celestials, BrahmA, Vishnu and others were scared when the deadly poison came (out of the milky ocean). (To escape the poison, they prayed) - "Oh Destroyer of our mental agony, You reside in the serene hearts of people who possess complete tranquility, Oh Lord of this Universe; To help us to rise on our feet, You must grant us Your holy feet; and the poison is closing in on us" (- so all DEvAs prayed to Lord SivA). When their pleas reached Him, with the speed of whirlwind, and vowing to protect those who surrendered, in just a moment, SivA swallowed that poison! You are that SivA's great son! You must come to take us into Your fold in Your Great Kingdom! At the asuras who were enemies of the pious DEvAs You threw the powerful Spear which is a symbol of truth! (To the sound of the same meter) Your Peacock dances to please us, Your devotees, in many ways, and You go about mounted on the Peacock. You are our Lord Kumaresa, son of PArvathi, who Herself is the daughter of King HimavAn. Your cosy residence is in the most fitting place, Thirumayilai* and You are our Supreme Master, Oh Great One!

691.english_pathavurai: The seas, full of waves rising to different heights, surround the world in which this birth has taken place. To experience happiness and to get rid of the good and bad deeds along with sufferings, one has to contemplate Your two lotus feet in deep meditation; but I never do that. I never completely melt, seeking Your grace; I am never devoted to You to the point of exhaustion; nor do I worship You; I never praise Your name addressing You as the child cuddled by SivA whose left side is occupied by UmAdEvi; I am never content; my ignorance is unlimited; I am not wise nor do I have clarity of thought; I have never practised silence which is the culmination of speechlessness; I am the miserable chap haunted by the lasciviousness caused by young women's seductive beauty; (Despite all my shortcomings), Will it be possible for me to attain the blissful nearness of Your devotees? Will there be a day when I shall mingle with them (Your devotees), due to Your grace? To enthrall VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavas, with robust bosoms, You befriended her and chose several soothing words sprinkled in nectar, to address her lovingly, Oh Lord with six faces! You are the embodiment of abundant grace and justice! You are majestic, consummate and compassionate! You are extremely knowledgeable! You are the ultimate refuge for all! You emerged from the great pond of reeds (Saravanam), Oh GuhA! You are the essence of effulgent SivA and You are supreme! You are the greatest; You are the ultimate substance of justice in the scriptures! You represent the first letter "a" by being the foremost; You represent "U" for UmAdEvi, the symbol of Sivasakthi; You burn down the evils of arrogance and possessiveness; You are the Pure Wisdom representing SivA. You reside inside the soul of JeevAthma; Your compassion is abundant; You are omniscient! You wielded the spear to destroy all the demons who were hostile and well entrenched in their mighty fortresses! There is plenty of natural beauty, a lot of knowledge, fame and prosperity in Mylapore* where You reside every day! You are the son of SivA around whom there is always the vibrant chanting of Hara Hara! You belong to Your devotees, Oh Great One!

693.english_meanings_list: ["Because of the arrows shot by mighty and provocatively troublesome Manmathan, God of Love, upon the bud-like bosom, wearing sandal paste and a chain of gems,", "because of the scandal deliberately spread by all women who are sweet-tongued, and looking like dazzling lightning,", "and because of the full moon roaming like a mass of fire,", "this girl is melting on the sturdy bed sprinkled with well-blossomed flowers; lest she become weaker day by day and begin to publicise her passion through the palm-leaf doodles*,", "You must come to her flowery bed and give her a winning hug with Your shoulders adorned by the garland around which beetles, with beautiful stripes, swarm!", "He wears the garland of ThuLasi on His chest; He holds a disc in His hand; He is known as VishNu and MurAri (destroyer of the demon Muran); He slumbers on the serpent-bed called Adhiseshan; and You are His favourite nephew!", "In this place Thirumayilai**, which is Your abode, vEdAs, upanishads and sacrifices are prolific; You mount the green peacock with beautiful plumes, looking like a fierce horse!", "When the girl (PUmbAvai), belonging to the Chettiar lineage of AlakApuri, died, You (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) brought her back to life by singing the hymn full of divine grace, Oh Lord KumarA!", "The rare mount Krouncha was shattered to pieces and the demons were uprooted so that You could redeem the celestial land for the DEvAs, Oh Great One!"]
693.english_pathavurai: Because of the arrows shot by mighty and provocatively troublesome Manmathan, God of Love, upon the bud-like bosom, wearing sandal paste and a chain of gems, because of the scandal deliberately spread by all women who are sweet-tongued, and looking like dazzling lightning, and because of the full moon roaming like a mass of fire, this girl is melting on the sturdy bed sprinkled with well-blossomed flowers; lest she become weaker day by day and begin to publicise her passion through the palm-leaf doodles*, You must come to her flowery bed and give her a winning hug with Your shoulders adorned by the garland around which beetles, with beautiful stripes, swarm! He wears the garland of ThuLasi on His chest; He holds a disc in His hand; He is known as VishNu and MurAri (destroyer of the demon Muran); He slumbers on the serpent-bed called Adhiseshan; and You are His favourite nephew! In this place Thirumayilai**, which is Your abode, vEdAs, upanishads and sacrifices are prolific; You mount the green peacock with beautiful plumes, looking like a fierce horse! When the girl (PUmbAvai), belonging to the Chettiar lineage of AlakApuri, died, You (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) brought her back to life by singing the hymn full of divine grace, Oh Lord KumarA! The rare mount Krouncha was shattered to pieces and the demons were uprooted so that You could redeem the celestial land for the DEvAs, Oh Great One!

694.english_pathavurai: Deceitful ones who have vowed to lose temper at all times; people with lowly instincts; utterly foolish people who always create trouble; people who love to do only bad deeds; cunning scoundrels; and these are the people whose company I sought! I used to speak of very ugly things in their presence. I was such a wicked fellow who shunned the righteous path. I never paused to think. I was preserving this cottage of my body covered by a flimsy roof of lust and desires! To prevent me from decaying like this everyday, (You must come before me) on Your lovely Peacock with Your six great faces, the Spear, and twelve shoulders adorned with garlands of KuvaLai flowers! You must come so that I can have Your vision right in front of me! The earth and the great mount MEru trembled; the thousand hoods of AdhisEshan were shaken; large mountains were shattered; the water in the wide seas boiled over; all the demons (asuras) died; and prosperity was restored in the Celestial Land; when You threw Your Spear valorously, mounted on Your Peacock! There is a large grove of jackfruit trees which have grown beautifully, tall right up to the sky; there are several lotus ponds; lakes with plenty of water-flowers; a number of fields producing crops; there are majestic terraces and beautiful balconies on tall towers in the lovely place called Mylapore*, which is Your abode; and You are worshipped by all DEvAs, Oh Great One!

695.english_pathavurai: I roam around with people in this world, surrounded by wavy seas, but without saying any prayers to You. Every day, I must first have my heart filled with words of praise for You, and then I must pray "Oh, SivA's Son, You are the Lord of the Trinity, You are the jewel delivered by Mother UmA, the daughter of the great Mount HimavAn, Oh GuhA!" Extolling You like this, the humble me should become one among Your devotees who worship You; and I must mingle with them and acquire devotion. Will such a great day occur to me? Kindly bless me to chant Your names! IndrA, who is the master of the royal elephant, AirAvadham, and all the celestials were once humiliated and lost their status; their hearts were filled with darkness and delusion as the demon kings harassed them immensely. To end their sufferings, You took the mighty spear in Your hand and threw it at SUran and split his body into two. The arrogant demon, SUran, who had disguised himself as a mango tree, was destroyed and killed by You, Oh strong and powerful one! You reside in the beautiful town, Mylapore*, Oh Great One!

702.english_pathavurai: These whores are capable of negotiating and finalising a price (for their services); they conceal their bosom (with a cloth); they loosen their fragrant and rich hair, black like the cloud and adorned with garlands of flowers; with their eyes that look like poison, lotus and arrow, they chase (the men); their speech is contradictory; with their body filled with flesh, water and blood, they come out and stand at the front door; they deliberately confront and cross the path of foolish men; following them, they offer betel leaves mixed with lime and betelnut urging them to come to their house right then; by praising their virtues, they cajole them with sweet words and make them visit their house; they kindly take them along inside their house right up to the bed on which they sleep and slacken their clothes to provoke a passionate desire in them; remaining on the bed they speak flirtingly (saying many words of welcome) and grab all their belongings; when the money dries up, they become irritated with their suitors; at that time, they invent some lame excuse and create so much of ruckus that they beat the brain out of their suitors and drive them away; then when their share of the loot (from the suitors driven off) shrinks, they are capable of befriending a stranger and cleverly telling him false stories; having witnessed such characteristics in these whores, my attachment to them has not abated; in order that I contemplate on You, at least for some time, with rapt attention like some realised and stoical people, that I hail Your vision with glee and that I approach and attain Your fragrant and hallowed lotus-feet, I do not have the necessary knowledge; despite my ignorance and the fact that I am a big sinner, kindly take me over and bless me, Oh Lord! In the battlefield, as the devils screamed "thenaththena thenanthenthen thenanthA" and as the drums that are beaten by the left hand (idakkai), bells and other drums that make a bass noise produced sounds to the meter "dikuNdingkuN dikuNdA dikukudikkuku dikukudikkuku dikuNdingkuN dikuNdee", the demon RAvaNan's huge mountain-like heads numbering ten and his twenty big shoulders were knocked down simultaneously by an angry and matchless arrow wielded by RAmA; that Lord VishNu's son Manmathan (God of Love) is related to You as a cousin*, Oh Lord! You split the bodies of the demons hauling out their intestines and mounted the peacock, Oh Lord! 708.english_pathavurai: Scaring away all those relatives who have gathered (in a house around a death-bed) sitting in a circle, crying and holding hands and shoulders among themselves, comes the God of Death, Yaman, with His hideous-looking, heavy trident and the rope (of attachment); at that time, the dead body is carried to the funeral pyre to be consumed by fire; I do not want to decay and die in this miserable way; kindly relieve me from the bondage of attachment to the worldly desires and entrust me at the holy feet of the enlightened people! 709.english_meanings_list: ["The principle of SivA is of the form of true effulgence that could never be interpreted by texts that one learns nor by religions one observes; in order that the flame remains eternal,", "one has to change the course of the direction of oxygen that flows into the cosmos of the skull, spread like a cloud, and that runs through the nostrils,", "merging it with the vein of Susumna* and then contemplate on the tiring body with love; rather than remaining in such a posture of Siva-yOgA steadily,", "sensing the flow of life through each and every pore of the body,", "and attaining the state of sublimation in Karma yOgA, one perishes on this earth which is filled up with the devil of passion; will there be no end to such a death?", "The wavy seas lost their force and Lord BrahmA, the Creator, was terrified when You destroyed the aggressive demon, SUran, with Your bright spear, Oh Lord!", "Consumed by passion due to the five flowery arrows, famous for their valour, shot by Manmathan (God of Love), You fell in a fit of passion the other day at the feet of VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, Oh Lord!", "He put him to shame, casting him into a corner; He severed the head of that Dhakshan, His father-in-law, without any qualms; He became enraged with the inept place, Thiripuram, and burnt it down; He is Lord SivA, and You are His younger child!", "You have the staff of a rooster, Oh Handsome KumarA, the valorous one!", "You have Your abode in KOdainagar**, Oh Great One!"]
709.english_pathavurai: The principle of SivA is of the form of true effulgence that could never be interpreted by texts that one learns nor by religions one observes; in order that the flame remains eternal, one has to change the course of the direction of oxygen that flows into the cosmos of the skull, spread like a cloud, and that runs through the nostrils, merging it with the vein of Susumna* and then contemplate on the tiring body with love; rather than remaining in such a posture of Siva-yOgA steadily, sensing the flow of life through each and every pore of the body, and attaining the state of sublimation in Karma yOgA, one perishes on this earth which is filled up with the devil of passion; will there be no end to such a death? The wavy seas lost their force and Lord BrahmA, the Creator, was terrified when You destroyed the aggressive demon, SUran, with Your bright spear, Oh Lord! Consumed by passion due to the five flowery arrows, famous for their valour, shot by Manmathan (God of Love), You fell in a fit of passion the other day at the feet of VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, Oh Lord! He put him to shame, casting him into a corner; He severed the head of that Dhakshan, His father-in-law, without any qualms; He became enraged with the inept place, Thiripuram, and burnt it down; He is Lord SivA, and You are His younger child! 712.english_meanings_list: ["Their beautiful gait is like that of the famous swan; their grand look is like that of the great peacock;", "these whores have a face like that of the full moon;", "their speech is sweet like honey; their youthful and large bosom is like the mount MEru;", "their sharp eyes are shaped like the sEl fish; their nose is well-formed;", "their long hair is adorned with garlands; their shoulders are smooth like bamboo;", "I am roaming about in the company of such whores; kindly show mercy to me;", "kindly bless me to have the astuteness to fall at and worship Your hallowed feet at which the brahmins who have mastered the SAma VEdA and the celestials offer fresh flowers everyday!", "These hunters lived in the vast forests of VaLLimalai where clouds move over the hills; she was guarding the millet-field in that forest; You fell in love with that VaLLi and hugged her!", "You are the Primordial One who came as ThirugnAna Sambandhar and sang many hymns (ThEvAram) describing the scriptures and mythologies for the benefit of all! You are full of compassion, Oh MurugA!", "You wielded the spear upon the warring demon SUran, causing mud to rise in the sea, Oh mighty King!", "Oh valorous One, You mount the beautiful peacock!", "BrahmA, who is seated on the lotus, Lord VishNu and Lord SivA, in the half of whose body UmAdEvi is concorporate, worship", "this place called ThiruppOrUr,* which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
712.english_pathavurai: Their beautiful gait is like that of the famous swan; their grand look is like that of the great peacock; these whores have a face like that of the full moon; their speech is sweet like honey; their youthful and large bosom is like the mount MEru; their sharp eyes are shaped like the sEl fish; their nose is well-formed; their long hair is adorned with garlands; their shoulders are smooth like bamboo; I am roaming about in the company of such whores; kindly show mercy to me; kindly bless me to have the astuteness to fall at and worship Your hallowed feet at which the brahmins who have mastered the SAma VEdA and the celestials offer fresh flowers everyday! These hunters lived in the vast forests of VaLLimalai where clouds move over the hills; she was guarding the millet-field in that forest; You fell in love with that VaLLi and hugged her! You are the Primordial One who came as ThirugnAna Sambandhar and sang many hymns (ThEvAram) describing the scriptures and mythologies for the benefit of all! You are full of compassion, Oh MurugA! You wielded the spear upon the warring demon SUran, causing mud to rise in the sea, Oh mighty King! Oh valorous One, You mount the beautiful peacock! BrahmA, who is seated on the lotus, Lord VishNu and Lord SivA, in the half of whose body UmAdEvi is concorporate, worship this place called ThiruppOrUr,* which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

713.english_pathavurai: I have the darkest mind and the greatest ignorance, but You are the Sun of Knowledge that removes my miseries and arrogance. You are also the Sun giving light to the three worlds (Earth, Heaven and Thrisangu Lokam)! You are SivA! You are the fundamental cause for everything! You are the Son of SivA wearing snakes as ornaments and who is also the Head of all VEdAs! You are the Nephew of Hari NarAyaNan! She is a young virgin; She has a blackish green complexion; She is the Mother Divine; She is UmA; She is without any blemish; Her colour is emerald green; She is complete in all respects; She is the Treasure of all virtues and arts; and She is NArAyaNi. You are Her son, Oh Lord! Oh Master, Oh GuhA, Oh Lord KumarA, Oh SaravaNA, You are the Lord who manifests in a form for us to worship! You are the Gem that loves VaLLi, the great daughter of the KuRavAs! You wear the reddish Vetchi garlands around which the beetles hum! You are the substance of PraNava ManthrA! You are the object of eternal bliss! You composed the hymns (ThEvAram) and taught their morals to the world! You wear garments made of red silk! You are the presiding deity of all mountains! You feel fulfilled by adorning Yourself with the holy ash (VibUthi)! You hold the Rooster in Your staff! You hold in Your hand the great and powerful Spear! You are the great poet! You are the Supreme Master of yOgAs! You are responsible for the decline of other warring religions You are the underlying deity of all the twelve religions You are the Leader who protects Your devotees at the opportune time! You mount Your great Peacock, and You are the most knowledgeable warrior! All the worlds and the unblemished VEdAs worship Your abode, SamaramApuri (ThiruppOrUr),** Oh Great One!

714.english_meanings_list: ["The Scriptures (VEdAs), the theosophic treatises (Upanishads),", "the protectors of the eight cardinal directions (AshtadhikpAlakAs)* 1 , the ascetics,", "the unblemished sages (rishis)* 2 numbering seven, and the three great flames [namely, the sun, the moon and fire (agni)]", "the prakrithi purushas (who are in charge of the five elements) who are beyond any description, the nine prime siddhas known as NavanAthar* 3 ,", "those residing in galaxies afar, the experts in scriptures,", "the millions of unique religions, the Celestials, the millions of devotees,", "Vishnu, BrahmA and million others - all of them got together", "to perceive and know Your hallowed feet but failed;", "kindly bless me so that the knowledge to discern Your two feet springs like a fountain within my intellect!", "All the mountains (including Mount Krouncha) were smashed into powder; all the places of the demons were destroyed;", "the seas full of makara fish dried up and became slimy; the old SUran was killed;", "the devils began to dance; the Goddess of Victory (Vijaya Lakshmi) was delighted;", "the hunger of dogs, foxes and crows, coming in search of food, was satiated when the heads of the demons were scattered;", "rivers of blood gushed with rippling waves;", "and Yaman, the God of Death, was terrified and fell at Your feet;", "when You, mounting the peacock, hurled swiftly the spear from Your lovely hand, Oh MurugA!", "Your abode is the town of UththaramErUr* 4 , and You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!"]
714.english_pathavurai: The Scriptures (VEdAs), the theosophic treatises (Upanishads), the protectors of the eight cardinal directions (AshtadhikpAlakAs)* 1 , the ascetics, the unblemished sages (rishis)* 2 numbering seven, and the three great flames [namely, the sun, the moon and fire (agni)] the prakrithi purushas (who are in charge of the five elements) who are beyond any description, the nine prime siddhas known as NavanAthar* 3 , those residing in galaxies afar, the experts in scriptures, the millions of unique religions, the Celestials, the millions of devotees, Vishnu, BrahmA and million others - all of them got together to perceive and know Your hallowed feet but failed; kindly bless me so that the knowledge to discern Your two feet springs like a fountain within my intellect! All the mountains (including Mount Krouncha) were smashed into powder; all the places of the demons were destroyed; the seas full of makara fish dried up and became slimy; the old SUran was killed; the devils began to dance; the Goddess of Victory (Vijaya Lakshmi) was delighted; the hunger of dogs, foxes and crows, coming in search of food, was satiated when the heads of the demons were scattered; rivers of blood gushed with rippling waves; and Yaman, the God of Death, was terrified and fell at Your feet; when You, mounting the peacock, hurled swiftly the spear from Your lovely hand, Oh MurugA! Your abode is the town of UththaramErUr* 4 , and You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!

715.english_pathavurai: The skin, the bones, the pus, the nerves, the mucus in the eyes, the congested phlegm, and the gushing blood have all rolled into some kind of mould to form this shape of the body; I am bearing in vain this obese body, the source of all sins, and deteriorating in health. In order that this disease of birth is terminated and for an end to my misery, (I need the following): Lord SivA who consumed poison, Vishnu who devoured the entire universe, BrahmA, all the scriptures and the books of VEdic rules praise Your two feet; (I need those feet); Your hallowed faces numbering six; Your twelve shoulders; and the swinging spear held triumphantly in Your exquisite hand; when will I think of these? He (SivA) wears the young crescent moon on His tress; She is the embodiment of all elegant VEdic ManthrAs; She is the Universal Mother; She holds Goddess Saraswathi as a part of Herself; She holds the five flowery arrows as Her weapons; (She is PArvathi). You were delivered to this world by those SivA and PArvathi, Oh MurugA, The five delusions* 1 , the five forces* 2 , the five elements* 3 and the five sounds* 4 are all present in the moving and stationary objects of this world; You dwell in them all! At the opportune time, He (VinAyagA) came to Your aid with love; He came running in the form of an elephant with a single tusk; and looking at the elephant, VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, was so scared that she ran towards You to be hugged! Veera Lakshmi, the Goddess of valour, Lakshmi, the daughter of the milky ocean, and the Goddess of Earth do all reside auspiciously in this place, Uttara MerUr* 5 ; and You came to rule this place, Oh Great One!

716.english_meanings_list: ["Loving the whores with long hair, dark as the cloud,", "I became passionately involved with them, drifting from the righteous path;", "searching for wealth in this world, I roamed all over, became exhausted and was disheartened;", "without any thought of leading a virtuous and moral life,", "I became a victim destined to be doomed and used other peoples' names (as heroes) in my poems;", "millions of songs were composed like this by me, a deceitful sinner; how could I ever survive in this world?", "Will You not kindly bestow the same gracious glance even slightly on me, which You reserve for Your devotees?", "Lord VishNu, who slumbers on the milky ocean, BrahmA, who is ensconced on the lotus,", "Lord SivA, who is the essence of all the scriptural texts, and all others,", "along with Lord GaNapathi, who has the elephant's face and rage, those enlightened ones who freely stroll about,", "and the vEdic experts numbering a thousand and two hundred* have all assembled in UththaramErUr,**", "which is also Your abode; You skillfully mounted the beautiful peacock with colourful feathers", "and fought with the demon SUran who came to the war with hostility and shattered him to pieces with Your spear, Oh Lord!", "You stand loftily as the consort of VaLLi, the daughter born to a deer, Oh Great One!"]
716.english_pathavurai: Loving the whores with long hair, dark as the cloud, I became passionately involved with them, drifting from the righteous path; searching for wealth in this world, I roamed all over, became exhausted and was disheartened; without any thought of leading a virtuous and moral life, I became a victim destined to be doomed and used other peoples' names (as heroes) in my poems; millions of songs were composed like this by me, a deceitful sinner; how could I ever survive in this world? Will You not kindly bestow the same gracious glance even slightly on me, which You reserve for Your devotees? Lord VishNu, who slumbers on the milky ocean, BrahmA, who is ensconced on the lotus, Lord SivA, who is the essence of all the scriptural texts, and all others, along with Lord GaNapathi, who has the elephant's face and rage, those enlightened ones who freely stroll about, and the vEdic experts numbering a thousand and two hundred* have all assembled in UththaramErUr,** which is also Your abode; You skillfully mounted the beautiful peacock with colourful feathers and fought with the demon SUran who came to the war with hostility and shattered him to pieces with Your spear, Oh Lord! You stand loftily as the consort of VaLLi, the daughter born to a deer, Oh Great One!

The whole range of Krouncha mountains were powdered and the seas dried up, when You fought with the demon SUran, Oh Great Warrior with the spear! You are full of virtues! 723.english_pathavurai: They smear herbal leaf powder on their faces to make them sparkle. They are experts in treacherous acts. They are useless dancers. Their thought is always focussed on grabbing the belongings (of their suitors). They entice with rows of their white pearl-like teeth and their eyes. Provocatively, they pass on from their mouth the saliva that is sweet as the mixture of three fruits (namely, mango, jack fruit and plantain) and sugar. These pretty and treacherous whores speak many flattering words on their bed made of tightly woven ropes and cleverly enchant with their solicitation. Because of my lust for those whores, I have been feeling miserable roaming about daily like a laughing stock before the people of the world who ridicule me with disdain; in order that I get rid of this act and get over this lustful attitude, kindly grant me Your hallowed feet! He is the Ocean of Compassion with the complexion of green cloud slumbering on a poisonous serpent; He is united with Goddess Lakshmi who is seated on the lotus; He holds in His hand the conch-shell; He wears a garland of ThuLasi leaves on His chest; He anchored the huge Mount Manthara in the middle of the (milky) ocean, tied the serpent VAsuki as the rope around the mountain, churned the ocean and brought forth the coveted nectar to distribute among the celestials; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu, Oh Lord! Her speech is full of lisp and her eyes are black; Her waist is slender and her bosom is large; she is the damsel of the KuRavAs; and You are in love with that VaLLi, Oh Lord KumarA! This great town Thiruvakkarai* is surrounded by fields with ponds full of blossoming lotus flowers and the forceful water of the river kadikai; and You are seated here with relish, Oh Great One!

731.english_pathavurai: These (eyes) are like the arrows shot by the formless God of Love, Manmathan, who elates one like the seasonal rain that showers at the appropriate time; these are like the wrinkles on a baby mango and like the kayal fish, attracting the attention of youngsters who enthusiastically call one another to behold their beauty; these whores with forest-like hair create a furore and cacophony showing one-sided love commensurate with the money they have received; being smitten by excessive passion for such devious whores showing false love who glibly speak of erotic texts, under the exciting weight of their heavy breasts and in their flowery beds exuding an agreeable fragrance, I drowned myself in a debilitating sleep of carnal pleasure; having taken a miserable birth on this earth full of castes and creeds, I wish to be liberated from the total humiliation I have imposed upon myself; for that, kindly show me the goal of attaining Your hallowed feet in the Cosmos that serve as the guiding beacon, making me think a lot about the ascetic way of life! He slumbers on a serpent-bed (AdhisEshan) on the milky ocean; He graciously protects the cattle by playing the flute; He is Lord KrishNA coming as the charioteer to drive brave horses; He is the Master of Arjunan; He took several disguises to steal butter and curd stored in an elevated vessel on the roof (uRi), and when He distributed the stolen nectar-like food among friends satiating the hunger of all, that little boy KrishNA got a beating at the hands of women who whipped him with pieces of ropes; knocking VAli who was enraged, felling the seven mighty marAmara trees, and destroying the ten great heads and twenty arms of the demon, RAvaNan, by wielding a unique arrow was the matchless RAmA (Lord VishNu); and You are His nephew! In this town ThiruvAmAththUr* filled with the aroma of many fragrant flowers, You are seated, Oh Lord with six faces! You graciously eradicated the sufferings of the devoted celestials in the sky, Oh Great One!

732.english_pathavurai: They exhibit their solid mountain-like bosom that looks like a deeply-embedded steel nail and like a pot churned out of molten copper; staring deeply with their arrow-like eyes, they flirt openly, feigning as though their heart is melting; "Oh my beloved, you made me passionate and then left me alone pining for you" - so saying they fondle the (suitor's) nose; "Once you used to be seeking us passionately; now you do not seem be in love any more. You have given room to the scandal-mongers; come to think of it, there is no one equal to you; not even Lord MurugA and the like are comparable to you" - so saying, they turn to all sorts of violent acts while simultaneously talking sweetly like the lump of jaggery; then they lead (their suitors) to their home and make them recline on the mat made of dry grass; at the opportune moment, they make love to them exclusively; because of my passionate obsession for such whores, am I to roam about like a mad man? You preached to the eccentric Lord SivA who remains as the Principle at the very end (of everything) and beyond any delusion, Oh Lord! Latching on brightly to the fort that is the mind of intense meditators, are You not the One ensnared by their devotion, lasting there forever, Oh Lord? The significance of the letter 'a' in Tamil language (denoting Lord SivA) was explained to this poor soul when You preached to me, Oh, Hallowed Seed for Liberation! Getting involved in the aggressive war, Your angry spear severed the indestructible demon SUran and his family, Oh Lord with that mighty weapon! Oh Celestial Carpenter!* You carved out by splitting the mango tree (in which disguise SUran hid himself) the Peacock and the Rooster, Oh Mystical Lord! You prostrated at the feet of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, befriended her as though You were the pupil of her eye and went to her place to unite with her in wedlock! In this world with four unvarying cardinal directions, namely, the East, the West, the North and the South, You have taken Your seat in a famous place (now known as ANdArkuppam) located in the northern direction of ThacchUr**, Oh Great One!

735.english_pathavurai: The demon ThArakAsuran was knocked down and destroyed. The celebrated Mount Meru trembled on being uprooted. The awesome and noisy ocean, containing large fish, became turbulent and broke out with a big fire. On that day, You wielded the sharp spear, Oh Lord, wearing the garland of kadappa flowers! Juices indicating wildness profusely flow from the mouth of the clamouring, large-headed and mountain-like elephant (AirAvadham) belonging to the celestials; and mounting that elephant is the deer-like damsel, DEvayAnai; VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, looking like a deer is residing in VaLLimalai; and You are the beloved friend of both consorts, Oh Lord! You mount the great peacock, Oh KandhA! When shall I praise You as above to my heart's content and with single-minded devotion? His chest has scars from the hugging large bosoms (of Mother PArvathi); His complexion is reddish-golden; the river Ganga, a garland of white skulls, flowers of kondRai (Indian laburnum), thumbai (leucas) and siruthALi, large snakes, garlands of nochchi flowers, bones, adambu flowers, black lily, leaves of vilwa, karanthai and aRugam (cynodon) grass - all these blended, adorn His fragrant body; He is our Lord SivA; and on the left part of His body, vanji (rattan reed) creeper-like Mother PArvathi is seated on a grand and cool lotus. 736.english_pathavurai: That which cannot be seen; That which has a form and is formless; That which cannot be described in words; That which lends itself to several interpretations; That which resides at the peak of all the four visible VEdAs (scriptures); That which is entrenched in attachment to this body composed of the five elements; That which is mystic and cannot be perceived by the body; That which comes in a human form and talks like a human being but is still beyond any human comprehension; That which is the bright flame in the cosmos; That which is beyond the grasp of Vishnu and BrahmA; That which conforms to all worldly aspects of unity and diversity; That which is known as the Cosmic Union of Shakthi (bindhu) and SivA (nAdham)*; That which is the essence of all scriptures and arts; That which transcends the most sublime level of Yogis; That which is the beneficial culmination of my good deeds and my completed penance; That which blossoms as the fullness of Divine Grace; All "That" I have described above is You and You alone! You played with BrahmA, who knows four VEdAs and has four faces, and punished him by hitting him hard on his head with Your knuckles (when he failed to interpret OM), Oh Great Warrior! You are Kanda Swamy, Giver of Divine Grace! Those Yogis, who are never accessible to anyone or any evil force, and who are spiritually emancipated, find You residing in their hearts. You appear in the town of DhEvanUr**, Oh KumarA, You are the Lord of all DEvAs!

738.english_meanings_list: ["Because of their flower-like poisonous eyes looking like the spear, their nectar-like sweet and delicious speech and", "their pleasurable bosom that swell with great enthusiasm,", "these haughty whores go about looking very beautiful; in the large net cast by them, my past deeds and life are together ensnared explicitly; to retrieve me from the miserable company of such mischievous net-casters,", "to let me join the company of the devotees who meditate upon You, to escape from drowning in the seas of seven births that superficially look blissful and to save me henceforth from the debilitating effects of the two deeds (good and bad),", "Oh Lord who graciously removed the miseries of the celestials, the sages and IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs,", "kindly bless me too to praise the glory of Your twelve hallowed shoulders everyday with music!", "His (RAvaNan's) twenty shoulders adjoining his broad chest and his matchless ten heads wearing crowns embedded with the rarest gems were knocked down to the earth by the peerless arrow wielded by Him;", "biding His time, He carefully chose an opportune moment to shoot a fiery arrow upon the sea;", "He showers His gracious blessing on the devotees who praise His glory and destroys their past deeds; He slumbers on the serpent, AdhisEshan, on the wide milky ocean; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "The blood gushing from the bodies of the confronting demons was devoured by the devils who hailed it as their food amidst their shrieks of \"Hara, HarA!\";", "and the wavy seas roared in rapture when You fought the war, mounted on the peacock, Oh Brave One!", "You have Your abode in this big town, Thiruvathikai**, that witnessed the burning of Thiripuram where the evil demons once lived and ganged up aggressively to torture the celestials and others!", "You are the Lord of DEvayAnai, the daughter of Sasi (whose consort is IndrA), Oh Great One!"]
738.english_pathavurai: Because of their flower-like poisonous eyes looking like the spear, their nectar-like sweet and delicious speech and their pleasurable bosom that swell with great enthusiasm, these haughty whores go about looking very beautiful; in the large net cast by them, my past deeds and life are together ensnared explicitly; to retrieve me from the miserable company of such mischievous net-casters, to let me join the company of the devotees who meditate upon You, to escape from drowning in the seas of seven births that superficially look blissful and to save me henceforth from the debilitating effects of the two deeds (good and bad), Oh Lord who graciously removed the miseries of the celestials, the sages and IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs, kindly bless me too to praise the glory of Your twelve hallowed shoulders everyday with music! His (RAvaNan's) twenty shoulders adjoining his broad chest and his matchless ten heads wearing crowns embedded with the rarest gems were knocked down to the earth by the peerless arrow wielded by Him; biding His time, He carefully chose an opportune moment to shoot a fiery arrow upon the sea; He showers His gracious blessing on the devotees who praise His glory and destroys their past deeds; He slumbers on the serpent, AdhisEshan, on the wide milky ocean; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! The blood gushing from the bodies of the confronting demons was devoured by the devils who hailed it as their food amidst their shrieks of "Hara, HarA!"; and the wavy seas roared in rapture when You fought the war, mounted on the peacock, Oh Brave One! You have Your abode in this big town, Thiruvathikai**, that witnessed the burning of Thiripuram where the evil demons once lived and ganged up aggressively to torture the celestials and others! You are the Lord of DEvayAnai, the daughter of Sasi (whose consort is IndrA), Oh Great One!

742.english_meanings_list: ["The varieties of birth that take the shape of a body in innumerable mystic patterns are larger than the seven seas.", "Although the signal that I am bound to fall into the pit of a womb in the whirlpool of birth, as per my deeds, has been etched in my heart,", "it has to be reckoned that fate can never be eluded, as declared by the elders.", "That (fate) holds me tight, binding me firmly with a thick rope", "and sends me down the gutter in a large body giving the shape (of a child);", "with the havoc played on me by the treacherous sensory organs, I twist like a worm in the flesh wriggling about", "and suffer miserably with my body melting like wax on fire; will I ever be able to get rid of this distress?", "These people display their anger (on those seeking alms) like the smoke emitted during the vadavAmukA fire (the ultimate inferno from the North pole) that flows at the end of the aeon;", "the hearts of these several persons, falling prey to eternal hell, fume in wrath like the bellows in a furnace;", "to put an end, from now on, to my seeking alms at their doors standing before them shamefully with a melting heart and to desist from soliciting their company", "and to uplift me, kindly grant me, as my refuge, Your hallowed lotus feet for me to worship, Oh Lord with the peacock and the spear!", "Upon all those great sages who praise Your glory, the achievers (sidhdhAs) and Lords SivA, VishNu and BrahmA, You bestow Your grace,", "taking Your seat in this place, ThiruththuRaiyUr*, Oh Great One!"]
742.english_pathavurai: The varieties of birth that take the shape of a body in innumerable mystic patterns are larger than the seven seas. Although the signal that I am bound to fall into the pit of a womb in the whirlpool of birth, as per my deeds, has been etched in my heart, it has to be reckoned that fate can never be eluded, as declared by the elders. That (fate) holds me tight, binding me firmly with a thick rope and sends me down the gutter in a large body giving the shape (of a child); with the havoc played on me by the treacherous sensory organs, I twist like a worm in the flesh wriggling about and suffer miserably with my body melting like wax on fire; will I ever be able to get rid of this distress? These people display their anger (on those seeking alms) like the smoke emitted during the vadavAmukA fire (the ultimate inferno from the North pole) that flows at the end of the aeon; the hearts of these several persons, falling prey to eternal hell, fume in wrath like the bellows in a furnace; to put an end, from now on, to my seeking alms at their doors standing before them shamefully with a melting heart and to desist from soliciting their company and to uplift me, kindly grant me, as my refuge, Your hallowed lotus feet for me to worship, Oh Lord with the peacock and the spear! Upon all those great sages who praise Your glory, the achievers (sidhdhAs) and Lords SivA, VishNu and BrahmA, You bestow Your grace, taking Your seat in this place, ThiruththuRaiyUr*, Oh Great One!

744.english_pathavurai: Under the protection of Siva Shakti, burning off the multifarious mischiefs arising from tenets and the darkness of ignorance, and consigning all miseries into the flames of the Northerly Fire (VadavA mukAgni), beholding the eternal dancing Flame in the wide milky way at the union of the Divine 'nAdha-bindhu'* or 'Siva-Sakthi', controlling the breath, blocking alternately the passage of idakalai** (the nerve that passes from the big toe on the right foot up to the left nostril) and pingalai (the nerve that passes from the big toe of the left foot up to the right nostril), assuming the matchless and bright incandescence of the sunshine, taking up the dancing posture of Lord SivA and spreading throughout in the supreme cosmos, the lilting sound emanating from the beautiful anklets on the hallowed feet filling everywhere, melting in the golden stage where He danced the Cosmic Dance, and myself drowning in the blissful sea of Divine Delight, You should appear before me everyday as the unblemished Earthly Tenet, along with DEvi PArvathi and Lord SivA with matted hair dazzling like the lightning; to enable me to pass through such blissul experience, kindly grant me a body that will be known as the seat of famous light! Oh Young Lord, You came as (ThirugnAna Sambandhar) a bearer of a few victorious laurels and as One who sent to rows of gallows the bodies of mean and debased SamaNAs who had discarded the holy ash and as One who had the erudition and ability to compose great ornamental poems! You approached the damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi, in the valley of Mount VaLLimalai that has a nice field of millet; You went in the disguise of an old man and ecstatically hugged her beautiful shoulders in the pond while an elephant confronted her; You united with her by embracing with Your broad chest, Oh Lord! She has the right to be concorporate on the left side of Lord SivA who held Mount MEru as a bow; She is the most rightful damsel who showers nothing but bliss; Coming as DhAkshAyani, this unblemished DEvi UmA felled the head of her father Dhakshan with an axe in Her hand; and You are Her Son, Oh Lord! This town ThiruveNNeynallUr*** on the banks of this joyful river PeNNai is surrounded by groves and clouds; in this nice place, You are seated with relish and fame, mounted on the wonderful peacock, dancing happily, Oh Great One!

745.english_pathavurai: The muscles, combined with flesh, blood and nerves, the intestines, closely-packed bones and the skin are all arranged closely within this body. This old body is susceptible to be infected with diseases. At various stages of life, this body takes different shapes and is inflicted with contaminations. While in this little cottage of the body with nine portals* life is still sustained, I do not have the inclination to attempt great penance for my salvation. I do not have the virtues like meditation. I do not have any virility, righteousness or the capability even to love. I do not have any greatness. However, before my mind ceases to think, (You must graciously come to me) mounted on the unique, emerald-green, immaculate horse-like peacock, with all Your six hallowed faces glowing with grace, to enlighten me on the significance of the four scriptures and Upanishads. The Sun who dips into and rises from the ocean was scared to perform his routine in LankA, with its tall fortress walls. The King of LankA, Ravana, lost all his ten heads, with golden crowns embedded with gems; his heads were felled down on the earth by an angry and sharp arrow from Rama who sought to go after RAvaNA with a fully-bent bow and determination. Rama is of the hue of dark clouds. He is Hari, the bravest, with names like Vishnu and ThirumAl. You are His great nephew! The beautiful mount KailAsh began to tremble; all the seven celebrated mountains** were shattered, raising a dust storm; and the fierce wavy ocean was in tumult when You threw Your Spear, Oh MurugA! Once DEvi PArvathi, the Purest form of Mother, performed a unique penance in the great PAdalanagar (ThiruppAthirippuliyUr***) where You reside with relish, Oh Master! Oh Lord with six hallowed faces and the beloved of VaLLi, the damsel of KuRavas, You are worshipped by distinguished sages, Oh Great One!

747.english_pathavurai: This lotus in the MUlAdhAra Centre has four petals and faces the four corners of the floor; beginning from that centre, the six (Kundalini) zones*, made up of the three major effulgences [namely, the Sun, the Moon and the Fire (Agni)], were cooled and flexed; then, the vision of the great cosmic dance that proffers the ultimate bliss of SivA was witnessed by me from Your lotus feet of refuge; my two slags, namely, arrogance and possessiveness, were totally wiped out by Your twelve mountain-like solid shoulders, six holy faces, and the feet around which there was a glow of halo protecting all lives, mounting the peacock, looking around everywhere as the saviour, Your majestic stature like the sea of compassion, Your glance more endearing and precious than gold, making me sing Your glory in chaste Tamil like Your devotees, and Your choicest gaze that guided me towards my salvation can never be forgotten! There was tremor in the earth and the mountains in the four directions shuddered and were smashed to pieces; the large heads of the evil demons who came to the war beating the drums were shattered; and the seas were stirred up into a roar when You wielded the Spear! She is the Consort of Lord SivA; She is the powerful Shakthi who has the foot that kicked away Yaman, the God of Death; She is Primordial; She removes the obstacles (of Her devotees); She created the universe just like that in a flash; She is PArvathi, and You are Her Son! He is MAdhavan (Krishna) who created a serious wedge between Vidhuran and DuryOdhanan who held the staff of a serpent; He is also the charioteer of Arjunan, driving his large horses (in the role of PArthasArathy); You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! The demon (SUran), who fought ferociously in the open and in all the eight directions, was ultimately conquered, and You made him (partly) into a Rooster installed on Your staff carried in Your hand and strolled about in triumph, Oh Lord! You have Your abode in ThiruvEtkaLam** where victory and truth prevail, Oh Great One!

750.english_pathavurai: Their two breasts are comparble to the pot and the lotus bud; their forehead is bright as the crescent moon; their forest-like dense hair, black as the dark cloud, flutters like waves on their back; their delight is comparable to that of a peacock at the sight of the rich rainy cloud; their eyes are like kayal fish; in their garlanded arm, they carry a pot comparable to their beautiful bosom; their lilting voice is like the cooing of the cuckoo and sounds like the yAzh (a string instrument) and the parrot; their meandering gait is like that of a peacock; their knowledge of eroticism challenges that of many experts on that subject; these whores wear passion as an ornament; when they smile, their bright teeth flash like the ligtning in a dark cloud; they imbibe saliva from many a mouth; these treacherous women grab wealth from others; is it worth my while to have relationship with such whores? He built a dam across the sea; He possesses the unique arrow that severed RAvaNan, the matchless valiant king, along with his entire kin; He similarly sheared off the rage of all the demons; He has the complexion of the dark cloud; and You are the nephew of that Lord RAmA! He chopped off the head of BrahmA; He burnt down Thiripuram; He, however, saved the lives of the (three) enlightened demons who lived in Thiripuram*; She is concorporate upon half of the body of that Lord SivA; and You are the child of that Goddess UmAdEvi! You annihilated the towns of the evil and venomous demons; You performed many valorous miracles with Your dazzling spear! Oh Handsome One with lotus-like eyes, You freed the DEvAs from their prison, eradicated their poverty and enabled them to resettle in their celestial land; You are the fine-looking lover of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, Oh Lord! You are seated along with Your vehicle, the peacock, in ViruththAchalam, the abode of my Mother, Goddess ViruththAmbikai, Oh Great One!

751.english_meanings_list: ["For the sake of discerning the significance of the great PraNava ManthrA, Lord SivA prostrated before You!", "You preached it to Him, Oh SaravanabhavA!", "In the bright city of Madhurai, the ChamaNas were sent by You* to the gallows", "and their bodies were shattered to pieces!", "Just like the people who do not love You and fall outside Your irresistible grace,", "I do not want to suffer as one of them. Will You not kindly cast Your gracious glance at me?", "To the amazement and praise of the entire world,", "in ThiruvaNNAmalai, once You came to help me** driving Your peacock in a fraction of a second!", "She has dark eyes resembling the penetrating arrows; she is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs;", "and right before her eyes, You once became a neem tree!", "You are the handsome nephew of Vishnu who has the complexion of dark clouds!", "Out of compassion, You preached to me the sacred ManthrA!", "The DEvAs who lived in the shade of KaRpaga trees with fragrant flowers were released from prison by You!", "For their sake, You showed Your rage on the hostile demon, SUran!", "Those who breathe their last in this place are never born again; and such sanctity is preserved in this holy place called", "ViruththAchalam (known as Mudhugiri in Tamil), where You reside victoriously, Oh Great One!"]
751.english_pathavurai: For the sake of discerning the significance of the great PraNava ManthrA, Lord SivA prostrated before You! You preached it to Him, Oh SaravanabhavA! In the bright city of Madhurai, the ChamaNas were sent by You* to the gallows and their bodies were shattered to pieces! Just like the people who do not love You and fall outside Your irresistible grace, I do not want to suffer as one of them. Will You not kindly cast Your gracious glance at me? To the amazement and praise of the entire world, in ThiruvaNNAmalai, once You came to help me** driving Your peacock in a fraction of a second! She has dark eyes resembling the penetrating arrows; she is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs; and right before her eyes, You once became a neem tree! You are the handsome nephew of Vishnu who has the complexion of dark clouds! Out of compassion, You preached to me the sacred ManthrA! The DEvAs who lived in the shade of KaRpaga trees with fragrant flowers were released from prison by You! For their sake, You showed Your rage on the hostile demon, SUran! Those who breathe their last in this place are never born again; and such sanctity is preserved in this holy place called ViruththAchalam (known as Mudhugiri in Tamil), where You reside victoriously, Oh Great One!

752.english_pathavurai: The dry skin of my body shrank further due to my maturing bad deeds; my steps began to totter; I lost my balance; my hand's only work was to scratch all over; my teeth protruded outward (as the gum receded); because of the growing cataract, my vision became impaired; my body withered like a dry fruit; my hair became white like the crane; the attack of biliousness and gastritis was so severe that I became dizzy and blind; I became very feeble and had to support myself with a cane which my fingers held; I have been virtually thrown out in the open in this miserable birth; is it possible for me to be liberated and to obtain Your blessings one of these days? When the unshakable demons were destroyed, the ecstatic celestials, including IndrA, who holds the weapon vajra, showered abundant flowers covering the earth; You are a matchless warrior and victor in the battlefield! Because of an unblemished and limitless love He had for the PANdavAs, He assumed countless forms*; He is KrishNan, of the hue of dark cloud! You are His nephew! This place is full of Saivite devotees who attained Your blessing merely by chanting Your sweet and glorious name; this is known as "ancient mount" (ViruththAchalam), which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

753.english_pathavurai: In this world surrounded by noisy oceans, a life takes birth. Immense interest is shown to build up the body to play a lot of games! People fall into the pit of the womb resembling the interior of mountainous caves! In order that I am spared that kind of misery, develop a non-hostile and friendly attitude, and the effects of both good and bad deeds do not ensue every birth, (I need You). The blissful experience that can be discerned only by those who are immersed in deep meditation on the true knowledge will have to be preached to me by You in the most auspicious and beautiful words of wisdom! The huge mountain, Krouncha, was split into two; BrahmA, (Son Of Vishnu, who came as Krishna to be the charioteer of Arjun, King of the Kuru Dynasty,) was shaken and so were the VEdAs (scriptures) learnt by Him; all the wives of the asuras plunged en masse into fire and died; AmarAvathi, the Capital of DEvEndrA, rejoiced on being redeemed; and the wide ocean full of waves caught fire, when KanthA, You took Your prime weapon, Spear, and let it go! The lush fields produce enough foodcrop to feed the seven worlds and remove their poverty; and such fertile fields surround VEppUr*, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

754.english_pathavurai: The five elements, namely, earth, water, fire, air and sky, and the four entities, namely, mind, intellect, perception and egoism, are unable to discern anything about It in day or night; It does not have an end, or middle or origin; and It is that blissful liberation which I want to attain. To do that, (the feet that went to the forest looking for) the damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi, who was brought up by the hunters at the hill with its peak covered by clouds - those lotus feet of Yours will have to be eulogised by me in songs of Glory in beautiful Tamil language; kindly bless me with that miraculous power! DEvayAnai, the damsel looking like a peahen, reared by AirAvatham, the elephant of DEvAs, and who has a rich fragrant coating of vermilion and sandal paste on her bosom, is embraced by Your loving chest! Your rage scared the mount of the enemies, Krouncha, and left it trembling! Oh Brave One, who split the heart of the fierce warrior SUran You released Your victorious and sharp Spear! Nimbapuram*, Your abode, is surrounded by bright fortress walls. You are praised by all the leaders of the land of DEvAs, Oh Great One!

756.english_pathavurai: My past deeds have surrounded and are persecuting me, and the three lusts, namely lust for earth, woman and gold, have emerged as the red-hot molten iron ingots that come out of the burning furnace are holding me under their grip; because of the magical spell of delusion that has attacked me and stubbornly subjected me to dance to its tune in the path of this life, I have been enjoying the luxury of flowers, sandalwood paste, civet and rose water under gentle breeze and wearing strings of pearls on my chest that is bearing them as though they are a godsend; I have been engaged in flirting with whores who have bright and painted eyes displaying beauty, joy and love, and in that process, I am locked in their net of passion, totally ensnared; afflicted by many a disease and pain, including rheumatism, I have been gobbled up by my past deeds which have affected my fortunes; without any love for You, I was easy in mind thinking that I was immortal because of the huge material wealth that I have amassed; with that thought in my mind, I am spending my days of life until the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) would be driven to me, debilitating me; they would bring with them the memorandum on palm leaf bearing the writing and seal of Lord BrahmA, and I would be persecuted by Yaman to peruse it; lest that Yaman confronts me, kindly grant me Your grace and love, Oh Lord! You were enraged with the hunters but were very friendly with VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters; You fought with the demons who were possessed by ignorance by wielding Your reddish and bright spear; You freed up the celestials from their prison and made their leader, Indra, settle prosperously, Oh Great Artist! He went to Madhurai in a disguise and performed several sportive miracles;on the banks of the river Vaigai, He carried loads of sand on His head; He holds the axe in His hand as a weapon; He is my Father; He burnt down the glory of Thiripuram; He reigns in the land of SivA and mounts the Bull Nandi as His vehicle; and She is the Mother who is concorporate on the left side of the body of that Lord SivA; Her slender thread-like waist bears the huge mountain-like bosom; Her figure is bright like millions of moons; She is the exquisitely beautiful Goddess, SivagAmi; She destroyed with rage the God of Death (Yaman); She is the stunning beauty, PArvathi DEvi; and You are the dear son heartily delivered by Her, Oh Lord KanthA! The two rivers VeLLARu and MaNimuththARu merge in this place (KUdalaiyAtRUr*) and flow grandly as one river; and You are seated here, Oh ChEnthA (reddish Lord)! You mount the peacock as Your vehicle! You make my body Your abode where You reside along with both Your spouses, VaLLi and DEvayAnai, so that Yaman leaves me alone and falls apart, Oh Great One!

757.english_pathavurai: "Come over here, my house is close by; I consider money as poison; please go home after fulfilling your desire by making love to me; oh girls, come on, spread the mat" - they speak such words of respect, and before leading their suitors to the bed, they grab money and clothes to their heart's content; even then these disgruntled whores complain that it is not enough and chase away their suitors; please do not let me go to the places of such whores, and save me from the resultant blemishes that proliferate; for that, kindly bless me by granting Your cool and hallowed lotus feet! He is NArAyaNan, SreerAman, KEsavan, the bearer of the sharp disc as a weapon and Lord KrishNA who came to this world in the cowherd's lineage; and You are His nephew, Oh Lord! He danced the (Cosmic) Dance with His hallowed feet as Sages NArathar and Thumpuru provided the background music; and You are the child of that Lord SivA! The demon SUran and all his torturous acts went inside the sea and hid (as a mango tree); destroying them and letting the Sun's chariot run its usual course, You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! The bright tributary, chitRARu, that merges with the pure and fragrant water of River KAvEri, runs around this place, KadambUr* which is Your abode; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

759.english_pathavurai: These women wear garlands made of flowers. Their hair is adorned with bunches of flowers. Their shooting looks are like the spear, the sword, the well-blossomed flowery arrows, full of nectar, deliberately wielded by Manmathan (God of Love) for combat purposes, and the messengers sent on the command of Yaman (God of Death); every day, with their eyes painted with black pigment, these whores play several tricks upon and enchant their suitors, particularly those loaded with money, provoking them with intense passion. Their mouth is full of nectar-like saliva, oozing all the time. They are so manipulative that they lie openly to convert the thinking (of their suitors). Their slender waist, thinner than the thread, feels painfully the burden of their big and dazzling bosom, smeared with the paste of camphor, musk and incence, and wearing garlands, nice jewellery, strands of pearls and a tight blouse. Doting on such whores I have gone down in my health; will You not kindly preach to me True Knowledge so that I attain realisation and begin to worship You from now on? She is the Mother; She is the sister of Lord VishNu; She is the virgin, UmAdEvi; She is ShivAmbigai dancing blissfully; She burnt down Thiripuram; She is Bhairavi surrounded by the devils and fiends ruled by Her; She is the Goddess of all worlds; She is the Creator of everything, the Protector and Destroyer without any discrimination whatsoever; She is concorporate sportingly on the left side of Lord SivA; and You are the child of that Goddess PArvathi! Those liberated ones, who perform libations of sacred water and meditation and have renounced everything, have attained You in their sublime pursuit of Knowledge, Oh Great Master! Comprising poetic and grammatical nuances and the choicest words, You have composed many Tamil songs (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar), Oh Lord MurugA! In this town, there are many benevolent alms-givers who, with a large heart, offer money profusely to those deserving people seeking alms; this town is also surrounded by long and bright fortress walls; this place is YAzhppANAyan Pattinam* where You are seated, Oh Great One!

760.english_pathavurai: The garland of pearls given by sugar canes, the garland of pearls made up of rain drops from the clouds, the garland of pearls yielded by the elephants, the garland of famous pearls found in the mountains, the garland of pearls from conch shells, the garland of pearls gotten from the seas, the garland of hot pearls spat out by the snakes, and so on; wearing all these garlands swaying on Your chest befittingly, You must come before me, mounting the dark green horse-like peacock, along with Your gracious consort VaLLi (representing the Power of Desire) and the assembly of Your devotees, and to bless me. She has the complexion of dark clouds; She is the bright effulgence, DEvi UmA; She speaks sweet prattling words like the cuckoo and the parrot; She is the Mother who gave birth to all of us; She is Shakthi, the happy consort of our father, Lord SivA, who wears the golden Umaththai flower (on His tresses), who has blue-tinged neck and who is eternal; and You are the child of that PArvathi, Oh MurugA! She wears on her chest a garland of rich pearls; She is DEvayAnai, full of sweet nectar; She is capable of granting blissful liberation; and You are her consort! You severed the shackles of the celestials who were imprisoned by the demons. Oh Wise One! You have Your abode in Thirumuttam*, Oh Great One!

762.english_pathavurai: The ManthrA that resides in the Fundamental ChakrA (MUlAthAram) and that carries the blissful experience of remaining in that ChakrA, the three great effulgences, (namely the sun, the moon and the fire), the three zones in the milky way, the six fundamental and causal chakrAs* and the wish-yielding kaRpagA tree (symbolising the Supreme Path of Siva) are surpassed by the mind which transcends all that; it travels up to the old stage (lalAta maNdapam where all tenets surrender) in which there is an endless and dense effulgence in the shape of the crescent moon of the third phase emitting a thousand rays, seated in the AgnyA ChakrA; mingling with the moonlight on the upper stratum shining like marble, the mind sees the Union of Siva and Sakthi against the background music, sounding like a fervent appeal seeking refuge, interspersed with a variety of resonant beats and has the vision of the Cosmic Dance, imbibing the sea of nectar; seeing all the fourteen worlds in the minutest detail over there and experiencing them, witnessing the trident-like passage of inhaled air (oxygen) through three veins (namely, cuzhumunai, idaikalai and pingalai) representing respectively the sun, the moon and the fire, and subsequent by holding that air in the spinal-cord that looks like the stem of the veeNA; eventually, that air embraces, and winds up through, the rope of cuzhumunai, rich in knowledge and encounters a luminosity equivalent to a hundred million moons (the great effulgence of Siva); will I ever be able to attain that blissful state? She holds in Her hand the trident; She has the shape of the cosmic sky; She is the spouse of Sankara who holds the skull in His hand; She is the one who burnt down Thiripuram; while burning Thiripuram, She served as the arrow in the form of VaishNavi; She is for ever youthful; She is concorporate on the left side of Lord SivA, who is endowed with eight Divine Characteristics**; She is SivagAma Sundhari (PArvathi) and You elate Her as Her child, Oh Lord! You dance merrily as the VEdAs fervently appeal to You praying "Oh Lord KumarA, You destroyed the demon SUran! You helped Indra, the leader of the celestials! You come to the aid of Your devotees! Oh Handsome GuhA!", Oh Lord with the spear! Those evil samaNAs who refused to wear the holy white ash were sent to die on the dreadful gallows when You performed a miracle (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar); and You distributed the holy ash (to King PANdiyan with a hunch-back and other devotees) with Your lotus hand, Oh Lord KandhA with (six) moon-like faces! She is like the Celestial beauty, Rambai; She was born in the milky ocean along with nectar; that Goddess Lakshmi gave birth to a deer-like damsel, VaLLi (Amuthvalli), who embraced Your hallowed shoulders, Oh Valorous One! You are seated in this town ThirunallUr*** where Lord SivA has assumed the name of Sankara ThyAgar, Oh Great One!

On His flower-decked matted hair, He wears a serpent, river Gangai, crescent moon and bone; He has a reddish body on which He smears the holy ash; He is Lord SivA and You are His child with red complexion, Oh Lord MurugA with the spear!
