764.english_pathavurai: The wavy sea, Manmathan (God of Love) with his bow, the squall of the rainy season, and the gossip spread by women are all burning me like fire; I am scared of the sound of bells tied to the swaying cattle returning home and the noise of the birds, anRil (kind of swan) and cuckoo; I am sweating profusely, melting like the wax on fire; the smoke from the incence and the fragrance of musk are attacking me like poison; the jewels and chains of gems that I wear are burning into ash, and my whole body is undergoing transformation; with my blazing bosom, all the thoughts of my past are fading, and I have completely lost control of myself and have become weak; the agony of separation is hitting me like fire with full impact, and lest I wither away, (I need) the spear forcefully wielded by Your strong fragrant shoulders and Your wonderful lotus feet, along with the beautifully swinging garland; all of which, will You not grant them to me with grace, and without any indifference or anger, so that my delusory passion is chided away? She is Goddess VAnavi with a bow-like forehead, eyes like kayal fish and with well-chosen kind words; She is superior to the Trinity; She is Bhairavi, the Consort of Bhairavar (Lord SivA); She is the tall Goddess wearing the crescent moon on Her bright matted hair; Her complexion is reddish gold, and Her vehicle is the Lion; She has a battalion of fiends; the high-sounding horns, trumpets, thimilais (kind of a drum) and the resonant drums made a loud noise while She danced along with Lord SivA; She is Mother UmA; that PArvathi delivered You, Oh Lord MurugA! Every day, You used to caress the feet of the damsel VaLLi, who was born to a sage doing penance in the foothill of Mount VaLLimalai; and You assisted her in (guarding the millet-field by) chasing away the birds like peacocks, cuckoos and parrots, by using new slings with stones! In this town, rainy clouds hover over the closely-built temple towers; paddy fields and fortress walls surround this famous place, SeegAzhi*; You were born here (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) in the lineage of KavuNiyars; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

771.english_pathavurai: All the religions, bickering among themselves, caught in delusions and throwing temper tantrums; those non-religious ones who deny even the existence of God; and those ChamaNas, whose members pluck the hair (of the Master-to-be among them)*; were all in a state of shell-shock when You (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) narrated the endearing songs (ThEvAram) in Tamil. That command**; Your compassion; Your triumphs; Your auspicious glories; Your loftiness; Your great virtues; the famous pond of Saravana where You grew up; Your forbearance; Your fame; Your matchless and bright Spear; Your holy feet, victoriously displayed on the peacock, worshipped by the Celestials ardently; Your manifold charitable acts; Your skills; Your nobleness; Your submission to the deer-like damsel (VaLLi) in the millet field, cuddling in her bosom, fragrant with the paste of musk and vermilion, caressing her feet, leading to Your marriage and union with her; and Your several victories** - all these, I want to keep on praising again and again with love. I can never forget Your greatness! Considering the wrong acts (of Ravana), Rama decided to destroy LankA; He also was determined to annihilate all the asuras (demons); and He wanted to restore the old glories of the Sun and the Moon - so He, the mystical one, made sure that those events occurred; When the wild elephant, GajEndran, was scared, trembling in distress in the pond, He (Vishnu), with the complexion of the dark cloud, rushed to his rescue; He is the consort of Lakshmi; He is Ranganathan of Srirangam; He is also Mukundhan; (As Krishna) He smashed to pieces the speeding wheel (SakadAsuran) which came rolling to kill him; He also showed His rage on the Marutha trees which were shaken and felled down; He is Varadhan (bestower of boons); He came as a dwarf (Vamanan) wearing a garland; He (as Rama) was the strong archer who threw a powerful arrow from His hand to tame the vast sea, sending it into turmoil; and You are that Great Vishnu's nephew! In this holy place, Brahmapuram (SeegAzhi***), where even IndrA settled once to do a penance, and in the hearts of those who praise You calling "Oh GuhA!", You reside with relish and compassion, Oh Great One!

773.english_pathavurai: Not only because of the crescent moon in the reddish sky and the God of Love (Manmathan) holding the sugarcane bow, but also because of the chilling southerly breeze and the melodious sound of Chitra VeeNa, burning (the ears) unremittingly, and because of the scandal-mongering womenfolk, I became depressed unnecessarily; (to enable me to pay the whores, I sought rich people and on them) I sang many lengthy songs; (in those songs) I described them as great mountains with a trunk and a huge jaw like the white elephant AirAvadham; as fortunate ones who would amass gold; as the wish-yielding KaRpaga Tree in giving alms; as the prominent sun, shining in the three worlds; and as the safe repository for the learned poets; knowing that these were false tributes, I shamelessly fell into the hands of these men fortunate to be possessing the rubbish called wealth; kindly look at my humiliating plight with compassion. To Lord VishNu, holding a disc in His hand, to BrahmA who emerged on the lotus sprouting from the abdomen of VishNu and to Lord SivA who is famously known as the immortal God, It was beyond comprehension; It was the origin of all scriptures, and You, as the Entity of True Knowledge, preached It! Vanquishing the arrogance of Mount Krouncha, You also pierced with Your spear, the body of the demon SUran who assumed the disguise of a mango tree, Oh valorous One, mounted on the horse-like peacock! Oh handsome KumarA! Oh Lord, Your shoulders are adorned with garlands of flowers like blue lily and vetchi! You are seated in Your abode at Kochchai (SeegAzhi*) as the Master of the three branches of Tamil, Oh Great One!

774.english_pathavurai: People say that his brightness was comparable to that of the Sun and Vishnu holding the bow, SArangam. He lived in a very sunny palace around which stood a lengthy fortress wall. He reclined on a seat adorned with pearls and precious gems. The courtesan singers sang in unison praising him. On both sides, damsels, wearing similar pairs of bangles, stood ministering to him with fans, gently. He was wearing garlands on his chest smeared with fragrant punugu, sandal paste and incense. He was leading a Royal life! He was happy and extremely proud! But, his body was bound by the karma of both good and bad deeds. Ultimately, his body was destroyed into a handful of ash. What an end? As the hunters stood awestruck, You grew up hitting the roof of the sky; their darling daughter, VaLLi, like a peahen, and her girlfriends danced; in the forest, among the peacocks and deer, You stood as a tall and robust neem tree at VaLLimalai. You took the magic form of neem tree (for VaLLi)! Thousands of dumbfounded samaNa priests defeated by You in argument, were led to hang in the gallows, while the holy ash was distributed by You throughout the Kingdom of PANdiyan, the recipient of Your compassion; and You, our beloved, gave to the world the Scripture in Poems (ThEvAram)! Oh Young Lord! You came as ThirugnAna SambandhAr to SeegAzhi*, also known as Kazhumalam and PUndharAy. You are the King of KavuNiyas, Oh Lord, of the Celestials!

775.english_pathavurai: Vishnu, Who wears Sri Lakshmi, seated on the lotus, on His chest, BrahmA, the four-mouthed, Who recites the VEdAs (Scripture), IndrA, the Leader of the Celestials, sages and all others went into hiding frightened by the battling demons. Those mighty demons did not explore the holy Texts that seek to explain the essence of the spoken VEdAs. All those assembled, terror-stricken, entreated Lord SivA, to bless them with an adversary to destroy the inimical demons, by worshipping SivA with garlands of poems and prayed "Oh Lord! Lustrous is Your body sprinkled with the sacred ash! With honey-filled kondRai (Indian laburnum) flowers Jhanvi* (River Ganga) beautified by water, the great crescent moon, the cobra, the pomegranate flower, leaves of vilwa, nAval and viLA, Your tresses are elegant, Oh our Lord! You alone are our solace. Do we have any other refuge but you?" Out of boundless compassion, SivA gave You, Oh VElavA, (to the tormented world!) MurugA, You mounted on the blue-feathered Peacock, flew around the earth and six other worlds and returned in just a moment! You became the Commander-in-Chief of the Celestials! I do not say with love "Oh Lord, You are handsome as Manmathan (Love God), Your six faces match six full moons, You wear the fragrant kadappa garlands, and possess dazzling brilliance", and I, the spiteful me, simply roam about not caring to worship thus. Still, You must protect me, Oh Lord! Once You killed the demon king SUran with Your sharp spear, Oh VelavA! You reside in the cloud-filled prosperous town of SeegAzhi**, Oh Great One!

783.english_pathavurai: Igniting fire in the MUlAdhAra centre (of the Kundalini ChakrA*), letting it run through the six centres of the Kundalini, driving the vital PrANa VAyu (oxygen) through the Susumna** nerve which runs along the gears of the six centres; concentrating between the eye brows, in the foremost centre called AjnA upon the cusp of the crescent moon in the cosmos; at the supreme Brahmaranthara Centre against the background of divine music, the inner soul is hiding; without letting it escape from there, carefully intertwining it, for a blissful experience, with this body, which is subject to the vagaries of desire; and hoisting it to the exalted state of true knowledge (DwAdhasAntham) which is glorified in various VEdAs and many renowned scriptural texts; over there, upon the mystic throne of PanchAksharA (the five sacred letters of NamasivAya) are seated Mother PArvathi and Lord SivA graciously presiding over the Divine Congregation where the vision of three great effulgences (the Sun, the Moon and the Fire) is seen; at that very place, the divine nectar from the moon oozes which kindly pour into my mouth and protect me by being at my side! She is the Goddess holding the trident; She is Mother UmA; She is SAmbavi, the Consort of the compassionate Lord SAmba Sivan; She is the Mother who protects Her children day and night; those bad deeds which drag us to the point of burning are destroyed by Her; She is such an unblemished angel who takes care of us tenderly as if we are little babies; He is the One who delegated the duties of creation, protection and destruction to the Trinity namely, BrahmA, VishNu and Rudran; He is Our Father seated in Vaiththeeswaran KOyil (VELUr) known as VaidyanAthan; He removes our many deeds; and He is Lord SivA; She is concorporate in that SivA's effulgent body; She is Mother PArvathi, and You are Her child, Oh Lord with the Spear! The seven seas shrank and dried up and the treacherous and foolish demons were destroyed and sent to the land of Yaman (God of Death) by the ferocity of Your horse-like vehicle, namely, the peacock, Oh Lord! You knocked with Your knuckles the four heads of BrahmA so strongly that they were sore with the wound; and You got a kick out of His imprisonment, Oh Lord with the magical spear! You were compassionate to VaLLi, the daughter of VishNu, Oh Great One!

They invite the men walking along the streets with cajoling words, and putting on an act of melting away for them with desire, they take them to their home and hug them. She is the peacock-like damsel of the KuRavAs; She is a great companion of DEvayAnai, previously known by the name Amuthavalli; She is the lightning-like goddess VaLLi; You blissfully hugged her showing pangs of prior separation and held her bosom closely entwined with Your chest, Oh Lord! 785.english_pathavurai: This life has been filled in this good body as assigned by BrahmA in the leaf of destiny. Three whip-like veins (namely, cuzhumunai, idaikalai and pingalai)* have been rivetted to this body; like a little boat being tossed about in the sea, I have passed time hovering around; I hankered after gold and women thinking that such a pursuit was advisable; many people mocked at me while I was roaming about in misery; not knowing where I could seek solace through penance, I carried on nurturing this body of mine, displaying pompously the diamond pendant around my neck so that others could look upon me as the God of Love (Manmathan). In those days, when I was showing off, shaking and moving my body hither and thither, vultures and crows considered this body to be a potential prey as if it were a cavern full of faeces or a bundle of cooked rice. On this earth, at the final hour when all my vital signs would have ebbed, kindly bless me graciously; You are the One mounting the great peacock that has a serpent tied to its feet tightly! Duryodhanan, the treacherous one, set fire to the palace of lacquer in which the five PANdavAs were confined; he eventually banished them from the country by defeating them in many gambling games; led by their fate, the PANdavAs, the princes of Kuru Dynasty, went to the forest; they were leading a life in disguise, and when the stipulated time of banishment ended, a major battle of the BhAratha was initiated by the great warrior, Krishna; and You are His nephew! You destroyed SUran's fort of Mahendrapuri; the head of the demons shrieked in fear; and his town was burnt down by You, the Supreme and Handsome One! Your sharp spear dazzles like the bright red rubies studded together, Oh Lord! She kicked him with Her left leg to knock Yaman (God of Death) dead; to that Goddess PArvathi this girl is very dear, having been delivered by a deer; You are the Lord of that VaLLi's mountain-like bosom! You have Your abode in ThirukkadavUr,** Oh Great One!

786.english_pathavurai: The serpent-like pranic air (oxygen) running in three branches like the prongs of a trident* is to be held and restrained in order to have a vision of the pure and brilliant light and to attain the liberated state of bliss. The form of arrogance, like the surrounding darkness, is to be destroyed by burning it in the fire of yOgA. Then, one must enter the unblemished abode where the dazzling shrine studded with gems is situated. In that supreme cosmos, one must unite with the 1008-petalled lotus of the Master (SahasrAram**) and immerse in the holy water reflecting the reddish glow of SivA - the True Knowledge. At that stage, the bright vision of the Spear and Your vehicle, Peacock, will be seen. Kindly bless me to realise that vision and grand liberation! The wailing demons, the seas in the eight directions and the Mount ChakravALam - all perished and the Mount Krouncha was pierced by the spear wielded by You, Oh valorous Lord, mounting the Peacock! You went to the millet-field in the forest where VaLLi, the deer-like damsel of the hunters, lived; then, You caressed her feet; and later, You embraced her after preaching to her the PraNava ManthrA, ensuring that she fully understood its significance! 808.english_pathavurai: She has two bosoms like green and bright mountains; Around Her hair, beetles swarm in absolute bliss; Her kayal-fish-like eyes sparkle like the spear and the lotus; Her teeth are like white pearls arranged neatly in a row of radiant wisdom; Her forehead is like a bow; Her lips are comparable to coral, lotus and sheNbaga (champak) flowers; Her blissful beauty is realisable only through experience. She is the enchanting Goddess PArvathi in the form of the Supreme Cosmos, granting all wishes. She is like a parrot. Her belly is like the golden banyan leaf. She is the green parrot that carries out all chores of the family life. Her waistline is slender like the lightning and a thread. She is exceedingly beautiful. For the benefit of the entire world, irrespective of any lineage or any physical body, She evenly distributes to everyone at all times, (thirty-two) religious duties* with two measures of paddy, without moving away from Her abode. You are the son of that PArvathi - why do I not simply melt praising You with such words? You are known for Your waistband, bright sword, twelve broad shoulders, the spear, twelve eyes and six hallowed lotus faces, Oh MurugA! The holy land of the celestials, which has the wish-yielding KaRpaga Tree, regained its prosperity; the SidhdhAs (achievers through penance), vinjayars (performing artists) and the DEvAs hailed You by cheering with the word "SabAsh"**; when You threw Your spear to annihilate the vexatious and evil demons and their clan, Oh Lord! He slumbers on the bed of the serpent, Adhiseshan, with a poisonous white hood; His broad shoulders bear the complexion of dark cloud and emerald green; He mounts the eagle, Garuda; He holds in His hallowed hands a bow (SArangam), arrows, a conch shell (Panchajanyam) and a wheel (Sudharsanam); He is Lord Vishnu, and You are His nephew! The damsel VaLLi lived in a nice millet field; You won her love, and then, along with DEvayAnai, the maiden reared by AirAvadham, You sought to be seated with relish in ThirunaLLARu. You are the Lord of the DEvAs, Oh Great One!

You are seated in VazhuvUr*, blessing Your devotees with good life, Oh Great One!

she is beautiful like the parrot; her body and bosom are sweet like nectar;", "she wears the garland of kadappa flowers elegantly on her hair; she is the Divine damsel VaLLi, and You are her consort, Oh Lord!", "You danced holding up Your tall staff of Rooster, Oh Lord!", "There are many cool groves cherished by the celestials in this good town, VazhuvUr***, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
810.english_pathavurai: Right in the beginning of my life, You placed Your hallowed feet upon my head and kindly instilled in me the meaning of the fundamental principle; with the manthrAs of SivA, You immersed me in the sea of penance and knowledge; by Your grace, You placed me in the company of Your gifted devotees and taught me the knowledge of three branches of Tamil which even the celestials did not know; You preached to me the principles of Upanishads, including Mundaka upanishad, and other VEdic methods; You gave me the vision of the effulgence that lights up along the nerves of idakalai and pingalai* on the paramount region where the three zones of Fire (Agni), the Sun and the Moon converge; You united my soul with the great light and sound of the Supreme SivA; as a first step, You led me through the gateway of Susumna (cuzhimunai) for meditation and took me past the centre of SwAdhishtAnam**; You showed me first the lotus centre of ThiruvArUr (MUlAdhAram) and from there You lit up the light of yOgA along my path through several other centres; and then You gave Your vision lovingly for me, mounted on the peacock with bright plumes, to shower Your blessings; that magnanimity of Yours will never be forgotten by me! The Mount Krouncha fell; the army of soldiers spread like the sea was destroyed; the demons were beheaded and garlands of their slain heads were hoisted in the sky when You wielded Your dazzling spear, Oh Lord! He is the matchless consort of SivagAma Sundhari; He is my Father; he wears a garland of serpents with stripes; to that Lord SivA, You taught with relish the unique meaning of Knowledge of SivA, Oh handsome Lord with lotus face! She guarded the millet-field in the valley of VaLLimalai; she is beautiful like the parrot; her body and bosom are sweet like nectar; she wears the garland of kadappa flowers elegantly on her hair; she is the Divine damsel VaLLi, and You are her consort, Oh Lord! You danced holding up Your tall staff of Rooster, Oh Lord! There are many cool groves cherished by the celestials in this good town, VazhuvUr***, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

811.english_meanings_list: ["According to the time limit predetermined in my fate by the creator, BrahmA, who is seated on a swan and who emerged on a red lotus (from the navel of Lord Vishnu),", "I was fondly hoping that this body made of flesh, which totally depends on food, would never perish;", "my thoughts were full of delusion with my five senses wandering all over others through my sensory organs;", "then, slowly and steadily I practised control of my breath after learning from many texts the illusory, irritating and flawed subject called yOgA and then discarded all that I learnt;", "realising that all these debilitating and improper methods would never make me happy,", "destroying the ignoble conviction that my particular dogma is the only suitable course for me and eradicating all my miseries,", "will You not kindly bless me with the blissful life that is beyond description?", "Her speech was sweet like sugar-candy; Her hair was neatly braided; Her gait was like that of the swan; Her dress consisted of plantain leaves;", "Her eyes resembled kendai fish and were sharp enough to tame even a shark; She was VaLLi;", "and to abduct her, You chose the pre-dawn hour and an appropriate spot in a stony cave", "and stood inside that cave like a motionless statue, sweating right through and waiting for her, my Treasure!", "This place Kannapuram* is in the ChOzhA kingdom, famous for its immovable strength, is next in rank only to the golden mount MEru;", "You are seated here on the banks of the River KAvEri where crocodiles breed; and You are the master of Lord SivA who wears a serpent on His matted hair!", "To all the blessed souls in Mount KailAsh and Sri Vaikuntam where Lakshmi dwells,", "and to all the IndrAs of the celestial land wearing beautiful golden crowns, You are the Great Master, Oh Lord!"]
811.english_pathavurai: According to the time limit predetermined in my fate by the creator, BrahmA, who is seated on a swan and who emerged on a red lotus (from the navel of Lord Vishnu), I was fondly hoping that this body made of flesh, which totally depends on food, would never perish; my thoughts were full of delusion with my five senses wandering all over others through my sensory organs; then, slowly and steadily I practised control of my breath after learning from many texts the illusory, irritating and flawed subject called yOgA and then discarded all that I learnt; realising that all these debilitating and improper methods would never make me happy, destroying the ignoble conviction that my particular dogma is the only suitable course for me and eradicating all my miseries, will You not kindly bless me with the blissful life that is beyond description? Her speech was sweet like sugar-candy; Her hair was neatly braided; Her gait was like that of the swan; Her dress consisted of plantain leaves; Her eyes resembled kendai fish and were sharp enough to tame even a shark; She was VaLLi; and to abduct her, You chose the pre-dawn hour and an appropriate spot in a stony cave and stood inside that cave like a motionless statue, sweating right through and waiting for her, my Treasure! This place Kannapuram* is in the ChOzhA kingdom, famous for its immovable strength, is next in rank only to the golden mount MEru; You are seated here on the banks of the River KAvEri where crocodiles breed; and You are the master of Lord SivA who wears a serpent on His matted hair! To all the blessed souls in Mount KailAsh and Sri Vaikuntam where Lakshmi dwells, and to all the IndrAs of the celestial land wearing beautiful golden crowns, You are the Great Master, Oh Lord!

812.english_pathavurai: He was an emperoror with armies of elephants and soldiers; the whole regimen at his command; his wheel of power held sway in all directions; he reigned proudly reclining on a round cushion; adorned with garlands of victory. He was clad in dazzling royal attires and with fragrant perfumes; and his jewels with precious gems glistened like the bright sun. It is these that made this emperor who had stemmed from but a human seed! Near and dear ones thronged his bedside as he was about to breathe his last. His body was later consumed by fire, An emperor reduced to a handful of ash with no one realizing this (the ephemeral nature of life)! People who hanker after riches never care to worship Your feet! These people of Kuru clan had composure; The five PAndavAs to whom He granted boons; He was dark complexioned; He was the tallest one (Thrivikraman) of great fame; He was Hrishikesan, having conquered his sensory organs; He was the elder brother of UmAdEvi of green hue, who created the entire universe; His favourite abode is the Northern Mount VEnkatam (Thirumalai); He holds the famous weapons of SArangam (bow) and Sudharsanam (Chakram); and He is the great Vishnu, and You are His nephew! You are also the famous son of SivA, who destroyed Thiripuram! You are the cousin* of Manmathan, consort of Rathi, Oh MurugA! You are the supreme power, Subramaniya, six-faced and with a Spear in hand! You are the King of VayalUr which has ponds full of waves and blooming lotuses! Your abode is ThiruvAnjiyam*** which confers eternal bliss (MOkshasthalam)**! You are the Lord of all DEvAs, Oh Great One!

813.english_pathavurai: The golden chains on the chest heaving along with their large bosoms; garlands made of flower bunches on their hair rolling over their shoulders; the studs on their fleshy ears glinting like the sun's rays; their reddish lips like the kumudam flowers; their foreheads shining like the rainbow against the clouds; their eyes sharp like the sword and the spear; their lisping romantic words sounding like the parrot, they speak with gleeful grin; drawing the men closer to them by saying "Come on in; please be seated; you are closely related to me" - these are the whores who provoke them into lustful delusion; these are cut-throats; gamblers; murderers; destroyers of families; women loitering around with sensuous shoulders; covetous after money, indulging indiscriminately in carnal pleasure; and they come from the basest lineage. Oh no, I do not want to suffer being snared in their tricky nets. I want to listen to and merge with the dasanAthams* (ten sounds) that could be discerned only by Yogis; burning and driving away the delusory darkness, the primordial flame will spread everywhere when You preach into my cool ears, blessing me to attain Your two hallowed flowery feet! Saying "Oh handsome one, You mount the Peacock, saying "Oh KandhA, KumarA, Oh Master of Lord SivA, saying "Oh Son of PArvathi, who wears the reddish vermilion on Her forehead, saying "Oh Lord with the sparkling Spear, whose triumphs are hailed with such a noise as the waves of the seas, and saying "You are the Master of SivA who wears in His tresses a garland of skulls, Oh MurugA, You hurled the Spear from Your hand to destroy the strong demon, SUran, the seas and Mount Krouncha, shattering them to pieces! BrahmA, who had nicely mastered the VEdAs, was knocked down by You. Falling in love with the matchless girl, VaLLi, You went to the forest and never took Your hands off her sweet bosom, Oh Lord, with a hallowed chest! The eight-shouldered Lord (SivA) once came with a desire to devour child's flesh with relish** in this place, called, ThiruchchengkAdu, where You are seated magnificently, on the bright peacock; Oh Six-faced, kindly wear the poetic garland of my love on Your tresses! You are the Lord of the Celestials, Oh Great One!

815.english_pathavurai: The intestines, the fat, the bones, flesh, fully-spread blood and nerves are all enclosed under the cover of the skin in a cool and temperate manner; faeces and other dirts fill up this little cottage of a body, containing nine portals*; it is destroyed faster than the bubble formed on the surface of water. Being attached to this mystical and miserable body, I have been always pursuing some useless medicines and attempting to practise many yogic exercises; and my mind has been tossing about in distress; enough is enough! I do not know when I shall attain Your lotus feet, adorned with anklets. The demons, stampeding and advancing in the war, were all killed together; the seven famous mountains (headed by Mount Krouncha) were all shattered to pieces; the large ocean, which is always pleasant to view, became dry and parched; and the celestials were freed from SUran's prisons and were restored safely in their hometown (AmarAvathi). You made it all possible, Oh Compassionate One! It has a thousand faces with beautiful hoods; it is the poisonous serpent, (AdhisEshan); once, it was supposed to be the string on the bow of Mount MEru (during the war of SivA with Thiripura asuras); before the bow was even bent, Thiripuram was completely burnt down to ashes merely by the bright smile of Lord SivA, the enemy of Thiripuram. He also angrily burnt down Manmathan by His fiery eye in His forehead. You came from the flames from His eyes and were reared by the River Ganga, Oh young one, You are seated at this place, North Vijayapuram**, Oh Great One!

816.english_pathavurai: Without any embarrassment, and not being subjected to the ridicule of the world, I have been learning shallow treatises that do not mention Your greatness. My mind digressed and left the righteous path. I did not sing about the prowess of Your Spear. I never lovingly threw the garland of kUthaLa flowers around Your shoulders. I did not speak of Your glory at all. I did not bow down prostrating at Your feet which are beyond the reach of even the celebrated VEdAs. I went astray; is it fair that the life of mine, worse than a dog's life, is wasted in this way? Oh my friend, the Leader of all the celestials, and Handsome One! You wear the garland of kadappa flowers; You went to the millet-field in the forest and met with the deer-like damsel VaLLi; and You are full of contentment. You went to SUran's place (Mahendrapuri) and fought with him over there. You are the proprietor of the land of the celestials with abundant KaRpaga trees (wish-yielding trees) around which large clouds hover. You are the protecting Lord of the destitutes! You are the Treasure of Your famous abode, ThiruvArUr.* Oh red complexioned one, Lord MurugA, You are stunningly handsome, Oh Leader! Oh my God, You are the lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

817.english_pathavurai: Come here, oh stork with a long and sharp beak, tell me whether or not He, who left me, will return to hug me again. To say the least, my life has become a total waste; my mother too has become hostile bearing animosity towards me. my relatives are bent upon spreading gossip about me; moreover, the so-called northerly gentle breeze blows on me like a scything sword and burns my body like a searing flames of fire. Is it fair that I also suffer like those miserable poets praising in vain the names of those who lead a life totally bereft of charity? Oh Lord with the spear who has never faced defeat, You graciously redeemed for them the happy life of the celestials by destroying the life of the demon SUran! In this famous place ThiruvArUr,* You are seated (as SomAskanthan) with SivA, a vision of effulgence, and DEvi UmA who is concorporate with SivA! You are the Lord dispensing justice to all! You are the valorous leader of the celestials! You are the child of Lord SivA who burnt down Thiripuram belonging to the hostile demons! You are the reddish God of Love! You are the handsome king! Oh Lord, You are the God of all the celestials, Oh Great One!

818.english_pathavurai: "Are you sweet like milk or honey or solid jaggery? or are you the nectar drawn out by the celestials from the milky ocean? Are you the treasure owned by the people of the world? Or are you blessed with a life like that of the God of Love (Manmathan)? Are you the sun or the most precious pearl?" - with such greetings, lullabies were no longer sung to me; no mother thought of me with love and breast-fed me; I was not given any worthy name nor was I ever spoken to with love; I was only ridiculed. Is it fair? The other day, upon hearing the shouts of VaLLi driving away the birds (while guarding the millet), You became so uncontrollably passionate that You proceeded right up to her millet field and fell at the feet of Mother VaLLi declaring that Your life then became worth living; thus You entered her life at an opportune moment as an attendant and servant and enjoyed her company fully! Along with sEl fish, there are plenty of Aaral fish in this prosperous place, ThiruvArUr*; and You are the treasure of this town! You are God's Son! You are Lord KandhA! You are fresh like the flower! Oh King! Oh Lord of all the celestials! Oh Great One!

821.english_pathavurai: "Their hands are like the lotus; their face is like the moon; their hair is like the cloud; their dignified speech is sweet like the fruit; their bright teeth are like the jasmine; and their eyes that could cause a war are like the sea and the poison" - so considering in my mind, I have been roaming about with an obsessive passion for these whores with a gait like that of the swan, creeper-like waist, demeanor of the peacock, fragrant paste of incence and musk smeared on their body and an elating bosom that is like the mountain. Day in, day out, without any discrimination, in order to wipe away all thoughts of hostility, to destroy the three sludges (namely, arrogance, karma and delusion) and to sever the desires that attach themselves to me, with my eyes shedding tears and my mind being thawed like the molten jaggery and remaining in that molten state, I wish to feel the ecstatic pleasure of calling Your name as the Young One who dips deep into the twin mountain-like breasts of Goddess VaLLi, whose beauty cannot be described in words, and to attain Your twin hallowed feet; will there be a day for me to realise this wish, Oh Lord? When a cow was unable to bring her dead calf to life, she carefully considered all alternatives and finally shook the Bell of Investigation installed by the then king Manu Needhi ChOzhan. The ringing of that bell caused deep anguish to the king who surmised that some terrible injustice had happened and summoned his subordinates to inquire into the matter. The king came out of his palace with a heavy heart concluding that a major blunder must have been committed. Looking at the cow in tears that evoked the words "Hara Hara Siva Siva" from the king's mouth, he stood steadfast in the path of impartiality and prayed to the Lord. Having realised that his son, the Prince, had caused a grievous hurt to the cow by driving his chariot over the calf killing it, he decided that his son must be punished in similar way by being run over by a chariot splitting the prince's body into two; that Manu Neethi ChOzhan ruled this town called ThiruvArUr* where You are seated, Oh Six-faced Lord! Oh Son of Lord SivA! Oh the Younger brother of Lord GaNapathi! Oh KumarA! Oh the Leader of the Kings! Oh Lord SaravaNA! You wielded the spear on the sea making it appeal to You fervently, Oh Great One!

822.english_pathavurai: "Is it milk, honey or a slice of the sweet jack fruit? Is it the nectar of the celestials or jaggery made from sugarcane juice? Or is it the Divine milk breastfed by UmAdEvi to Her child ThirugnAna Sambandhar who sang the heartrending Divine Hymns (ThEvAram)? What else could be compared with the sweet speech (of these women)? Are their eyes the spears or the arrows that kill? Is the brightness of their face that of the sun or the moon that traverses the sky?" so on and so forth, I went crazy over women. Oh Lord with countless shapes and forms! Oh Luminous One with six lotus-like faces, or whatever else You are, Your radiance grows in my heart which is besmirched with the biggest stain! Is it not a spot of bright effulgence where you and I glow as marble? Is it a particular country or is it heaven, the final place of liberation? You have established the impartial Truth; Your shoulders are strong and sturdy like the Central Pillar! You preside over the august assembly of the celestials, Oh Lord! You bless those beseeching You repeatedly with melting heart! Your manifestation in this world was accompanied by floral shower by the devoted celestials! "Oh Valiant One!" is how the sages praise You, the Lord who could take myriads of mystic forms! Not praising You as Hara Hara and Siva Siva, the confrontational demons stood arguing; those demons, along with the people living in SUran's land and the wavy seas were left screaming vociferously; (Mount Krouncha and the seven ancestral) mountains were shattered to pieces; when You wielded Your sword and spear to kill them all, Oh Gracious MurugA! Durga who holds the trident, Lakshmi, who belongs to VishNu and is ensconced on the lotus, and Saraswathi, the Goddess of Learning, all stand worshipping this magnificent Goddess; She wears the sparkling studs which radiate the moon's rays; She has two mountain-like bosoms; She is UmAdEvi who once delivered You as Her child! This is the most blissful SivA's place for all the pure devotees of Yours; they wisely decide to stay and live here permanently and so they gather at this famous town of ThiruvArUr, Your abode; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

827.english_pathavurai: "Oh You are the (wish-yielding) KaRpaga Tree looking after the poets! Your shoulders embrace the mountain-like bosoms of virtuous women! Your fame has spread in all the eight directions! For matchless and true friendship, could there be anyone in this world equal to you?" - with these choicest words, so well arranged, I composed exquisite poems; I sang with profuse plaudits saying "For protecting the priceless words of Tamil, could there be a more generous person than you?" To end the penury which pushed me into crying my heart out to those stingy people who are obsessed only with their lives, I take immense pains to attain Your lotus feet and hold on to them as my sole refuge; on this poor me, kindly cast Your gracious eyes and bless me with an unalloyed blissful life! You wear the elegant garland of vetchi flowers on Your chest and shoulders! She has bow-like brows, darkened eyelashes and sparkling vermilion - affixed forehead; and She is the daughter of Mount HimavAn; You are Her Son, Oh MurugA! You are the immaculate consort of both VaLLi, the young mountain-girl, and DEvayAnai, the unique daughter of IndrA (BAga SAdhanan)! You are the nephew of the mystic one, Vishnu, whose body is of the complexion of beautiful dark cloud. The fragrance from the fully blossomed flowers from this place, extend up to 38 kAdhams (380 miles) in all the directions; beetles roam about with a musical drone in the lush groves; this is exquisite Sikkal* where You are seated with the name "SingAra VElavan". The aggressive and angry demons who advanced in the battlefield were all killed and destroyed by You, Oh Great One!

828.english_pathavurai: This town is surrounded by sea having rising waves whining all the time. I roam here in search of wealthy lords who can give alms like the cloud (without expecting anything in return) or like the KaRpaga tree (granting whatever I desire). Calling dumb ones as famous lords, calling utter fools intelligent, and calling people with defective limbs as handsome lords, I was carrying on stupidly; and I was saying such things to these aggrandized fools, wasting on them beautiful poems from the three branches of Tamil. I was feeling like a lowly dog as I narrated millions of my desires to these people and roaming about as a wastrel; I want to give up anger; and further, I want to steer clear of my desires. When are You going to grant me Liberation so that I could prostrate before You and attain Your lotus feet? She is ever youthful; She is Durga; She is Sakthi; She is the Mother of the Universe; She forms the left half of the body of SivA, who is the crazy Lord of the worlds; and that PArvathi delivered You happily, Oh Young One! The seas dried up while Mount Krouncha was shattered when You threw Your long spear! You were victorious! Your shoulders are strong and ask out for wrestling! Your valour is world famous! You mount Your brave Peacock! He devoured the entire world and other planets; He slumbers on the thick bed of AdhisEshan (Serpent); and He is NArAyanan (Vishnu). You are His kind nephew who bestowed grace on Him! SUra Pathman, who had conquered all worlds in all the four directions, succumbed to You in the battlefield! You have Your abode at NAgappattinam, Oh Great One!

854.english_pathavurai: The whores with eyes looking like keNdai fish stand there shaking their hair-bunch bedecked with flowers; staying close (to the suitors), in a hushed and seductive voice, showing all their teeth, they bring their suitors home to the bed; sprinkling aromatic powders on them, they hug tightly and indulge in pleasant talk and provocative action; saving me from falling into that pit of delusory passion, (kindly come) with the dazzling thaNdais on Your ankles making the sound "kalin kalin kalin", the kiNkiNis (another type of anklet) jingling "kiNkiNi kiNin kiNin", and the gracious kolusu and silambu (yet another type of beaded anklet) reverberating, with Your hallowed and fragrant lotus feet which always appear before me reflecting Your compassion, so that my past evil deeds, my anguish and the three slags (arrogance, karma and delusion) that haunt me are all annihilated! As Your devotees prostrate at Your feet repeatedly saying "We surrender to You", the trumpets made the sound "gugum gugum gugum" and the drums approached with the sound "Dhimin Dhimin Dhimin", You wedded the beautiful damsel, DEvayAnai, Oh mighty KandhA! You protected the impeccable Mount VaLLimalai which had the unique millet field, the abode of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and severed the shoulders of the mischievous demons who harassed the celestials, Oh Lord! You also protected the celestial land having the beautiful forest of fertile kaRpaga trees where the great damsel, DEvayAnai, grew up; Around this town, there are water barricades, with near-by walls, and groves in which monkeys line up and where trees of the species of shaNbagam, akil, sandal and dense kondRai (Indian laburnum) abound; this town is ThiruppanthaNainallUr*, which is Your abode, Oh SarvaNA, the Great One!

855.english_pathavurai: The saliva gushing from their lips is sweet like honey. Their teeth are white like marble. Their speech is cool. They have arrow-like eyes and a beautiful face. Their eye-brows are comparable to the young and crescent moon. Around their hair, beetles are buzzing about. Their neck is like the betelnut tree. Their shoulders are like the bamboo. Their reddish bosom is like the mountain. Their waist caves in, and their genitals are like the lotus. They possess an enticing magic spell. Their thighs are like the stem of the plantain tree. Their feet are like the lotus. They look like the young peacock. Although I indulge in a blissful play of love-making with these women who smear sandalwood paste until I am tired, I shall for ever meditate in my love-filled mind upon Your hallowed lotus feet, twelve shoulders and Your broad chest decorated with garlands made of kadappa and other flowers, Oh Lord! She has the figure that has merged with the Great Lord SivA, represented by the manthra "Om NamasivAya"; She is the bluish Goddess, DurgA, having five hallowed faces; She is the Deity who does good to all (KaliyANi), wearing a string of precious gems; She is the powerful Shakti representing the Knowledge of SivA; She is the causal force for the energies of light and sound; She is our Mother with exquisite beauty; and You are the reddish Lord delivered by that UmA DEvi! As the multitude of armies of demons and their women died screaming uncontrollably and as their bodies went floating on a muddy river of blood, the celestial musicians sang from all the eight directions and You danced on the battlefield, Oh Lord with the spear! She stood guard to the crop of millet in the field; She is beautiful like Rambai, the celestial maid, and is endowed with pure and true knowledge; She is my mother with a hallowed face like the moon; She is VaLLi, the deer-like damsel of the KuRavAs, with her waist like the rattan reed (vanji); along with that VaLLi, You also hug DEvayAnai, the divine deer-like maid, reared by the celestials, with Your broad chest, Oh Lord! He wears the beautiful and fragrant basil plant (karanthai), the cynodon grass (aRuku), the skull, the Indian laburnum (konrai), the crescent moon and the River Gangai on His matted hair; that Lord SivA is seated in this beautiful and immortal place, Thirup panthaNainallUr*, which is also Your abode, Oh Great One!

856.english_pathavurai: Their face is so beautiful that the moon is put to shame; even the peacock is intimidated (because it suffers in comparison to the elegance of these women); they look like a bunch of parrots; like the celestial damsels MEnakai and Rathi who have a sweet speech, these women walk with a lovely gait, with a waistline like the creeper vanji (rattan-reed), showing prominently their beautiful bosom looking like golden pot; their elegance is like that of Lakshmi who arose from the pure milky ocean; these women walk through the streets everyday and ensure that the belongings of the men are usurped and then they make love to them; I do not wish to roam about being a victim of these whores who can beckon and reject men at their whim; instead, I wish that my spiritual wealth accumulates to the point that I gain the knowledge of praising You by virtue of many good deeds and penance done in the past and that I am enabled to sing great songs of Your glory profusely with apt rhymes; for that, kindly bless me, Oh Lord! On His matted hair He wears the gushing River Gangai; when UmA DEvi offered worship to Him with devotion, He accepted it very gracefully and with delight; He is Lord SivA, who is the most supreme Lord; and You are His dear child, Oh Lord! This great river maNNi is comparable to the fresh river Gangai; on its bank is the town called KanthukApuri which is now known as ThiruppanthaNainallUr*; and You are seated here to glorify this place, Oh MurugA! In order that they are eternally blessed with salvation, an assembly of SivA's host of herds, the celestials, Indra, Brahma who is seated on the lotus, Lord VishNu, and a multitude of poets - all prayed, and You blessed them graciously to be prosperous, Oh Lord! When the arrogant demon SUran accosted You with enmity, You scared him and his entire army by wielding the spear that rose like a wild-fire and split the mount Krouncha, Oh Great One!

858.english_pathavurai: A small droplet of the size of dew at the tip of the arugam grass entered inside a large body, assumed the shape of a baby and came out of that body; melting their heart at the sweet babbles of that child, its parents poured profound love, caught in the delusion of this world, and reared it very very dearly; his robust and shining body deteriorated completely and he developed a hunch-back; he became a sinner mingling only with, and serving, wastrels who waste their time; if someone advised him about the misery that would ensue him in the next birth, he bluntly asked them to stop that nonsense and would argue with them stating how anyone so transient like the weed could ever know about the next birth; She lived in the forest (of VaLLimalai) where elephants go and slumber; You embraced with Your hallowed chest the sandal-smeared bosom of that VaLLi! You have Your abode in this beautiful town, KumbakONam, Oh MurugA! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

872.english_pathavurai: With a thing called the Mind, are combined the five Elements, namely, Cosmos, blowing Air, Fire, Water and Earth to form this Body. This Body is subjected to (13 X 7) 91 tenets (ThathvAs)* 1 , which combine to cause happiness, misery and desires tormenting the Mind and the Intellect; and I must conquer them. In order that I obtain the Supreme Knowledge and follow the Right way of Life, You must grace this dog, namely myself. Universal Mother, Sankari, The VEdic Supreme, NarAyaNi, The Purest, One who has all eight Divine Characteristics* 2 , The Cause for Everything, Sivai, and The One who is Superior to the Supreme that PArvathi graciously delivered You as Her Son! To liberate the DEvAs and the Sages from their bondage and to restore their Kingdom, and to annihilate the asura (demons) dynasty, You threw the sharp spear gifted happily to You by SivA, Oh Muruga. When HiraNyA hit the pillar with his forehand, out came Narasimha (half Human-half-Lion form); and He fought with HiraNyA while the mountains, the earth and the seas shook. He used His sharp nails to pierce his body and to win over screaming HiraNyA and without spilling even a drop of blood, He drank all of HiraNyA's blood and life as though it was Divine Nectar! You are the great nephew of that Vishnu (who came as Narasimha) with a lotus-like belly! The Sun, Manmathan (Love God), the graceful Sages, the DEvAs, IndrAs, the leaders of NagalOkA (Sepent Kingdom) BrahmA, and the Great VEdic Scholars have all assembled to praise Your Glory, Oh Handsome One! All homes here are replete with Ashta Lakshmis (Eight Goddesses of Wealth* 3 ), and the beautiful temple is made of pure gold at this place which is Sivapuram* 4 , and You are the Supreme Master residing here, Oh Great One!

895.english_pathavurai: The body looked as though it had been scorched; the senses were all gone; when the life departed, relatives cried their hearts out; all the drums that had arrived (at the site of death) began to make a loud noise; the body was seated on a palanquin shining with gold and gems; then it was laid up between the logs; with their flower-like palms, the relatives offered the last morsel of rice at the mouth of the corpse; then the nice cloth, covering the body, was removed; the body was burnt all over, including the private parts, when fire was ignited and the flames rose virulently; the near and dear ones returned along the route they came by, took bath thoroughly in water, reached their homes and got over their sorrow. I refer to other human beings by way of relationship and because of that reference, I either feel happiness or sadness; provoked by the wicked God of Love (Manmathan) who shoots his flowery arrows, I am filled with passion and become a victim in the hands of women, feeling weak, extremely depressed and lost; keeping this slave in Your mind, kindly instruct me that the path to the land of eternal bliss is none other than attaining Your hallowed feet, and grant me those feet! She looks like a beautiful green peacock, born as the daughter of the matchless king (HimavAn), ruling the Mount HimAlayAs; She is the one who held the golden bow in Her hand to destroy Thiripuram; with ceaseless devotion and amazing vigour She undertook a rare penance in KAnchipuram where She is happily seated; and You are the son of that famous DEvi PArvathi! The ten bunched heads and twenty shoulders of RAvaNan were severed when He wielded His arrow; He is the Lord holding a disc in His hand; He slumbers on the spotted serpent, AdhisEshan; He has a complexion of pure green and the dark cloud; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Mounting the unique peacock of emerald-green hue, You dried up the roaring sea, annihilated the entire clan of demons and enabled IndrA, the Lord of the celestials, to regain, and happily settle in, his kingdom, Oh mighty Youngster! Your jewel crowns, filled with bright gemstones that radiate in all the ten directions, look gorgeous and rich, Oh Lord! In the fields of this town, flourishing kayal fish in rows keep on jumping up and up; You are seated here, in Aththippattu*, Oh Great One!

896.english_pathavurai: After cleansing the skin of their bodies, they put on beautiful attire; then they wear jewels, and smear the fragrant and enticing sandal paste (called puli*); praising such whores, one derives certain pleasure leading to an impure state of mind; paying no heed to the advice of elders, one simply treads the path laid by the sinful sensory organs which are his only relatives; I do not want to roam about in this world like that; Eradicating the three sins, namely, lust, anger and delusion, I wish to learn many artistic texts; getting rid of wrongful methods, I wish to surrender to the pure and enlightened ones who have realised themselves; with that newly acquired knowledge, I wish to attain the pinnacle of penance and see the vision of the True Substance which alone can grant me liberation; kindly bestow upon me the boon that will let me plunge into the boundless ocean of bliss! They controlled the eight cardinal directions after conquering them and heaped their commands on the celestials for running errands; they confronted with a rigid heart devoid of any semblance of compassion and fought in the battlefield along with their armies; the bleeding shoulders of those demons were severed and felled by Your matchless weapon, SakthivEl (Powerful Spear); IndrA, the leader of the celestials, regained the composure of his mind and his kingdom; and You graciously made it all possible, Oh Lord! You are the dear son of Lord SivA who holds River Gangai and the crescent moon on his matted hair! In this distinctly bright place Aththikkarai**, You are seated with relish, Oh Great One!

897.english_pathavurai: The sperm spreads in all the directions and takes different shapes, in multitudes of bright moving bodies and stationary objects in this world; after their time is over, the bodies break apart, and the lives depart. Believing that everything is under my firm control, I live merrily in the hope that this life would last for ever. A few people wonder if I am content with this luxurious life. Abundant wealth has led me to unique thoughts and words of conceit. Wearing cool and fragrant garlands elegantly, with girls dancing around me, while large white fans (chAmaram) drive a current of cool air and trumpets and flutes blow nearby, I imagine myself seated smartly in a palanquin; hankering after that great luxurious life, I roam around. That desire must be burnt. Instead, love towards You must intensify, and I must have Your blissful vision! Please bestow me with Your love so that I am known as the servant of Your hallowed feet! The dark mount Krouncha, with its peaks and valleys notorious for several plotting schemes, and the demons were all destroyed, being crushed to their death; the Sun's chariot, fastened with horses, drove along its orbit in the mid-sky (unlike during the rule of SUran)*; the bright Lord BrahmA, IndrA, and all the celestials from the first DEvA to the last encircled in worship; our Father, the Primordial Lord SivA, who dances in the golden stage, stood there delighted with love; and the hostile demons who came to the war died; when You wielded the Spear from Your reddish hand! You approached VaLLi, the deer-like damsel with fragrant pot-like bosoms, and took over from her the duty of guarding the millet field, Oh MurugA! You are seated auspiciously in VAlikoNdapuram**, which is considered to be a great place, Oh Great One!

908.english_pathavurai: Blood, germs, urine, faeces, hair and flesh make up the shape of this body; I have assumed enough of these bodies. Many exquisitely dainty jewels, fragrant perfumes, several delicious cuisines, beds and cosy house with temperate rooms - I have had enough of these. Wife, children, mother, siblings, and many people claiming some kind of relationship - I have had enough of these. Save the four VEdic scriptures and the Saiva treatises that deal with them, I do not want to study any of the worldly works. Rather than seeking the company of those who think of You alone, the Illuminated and Immortal One, I have been roaming around others, totally enticed by them and worshipping them; I have had enough of that kind of friendship. I wish to tread the path towards blissful culmination in the Ocean where Your waves of grace are blowing; kindly grant me that Knowledge delighting my mind! Symbolising victory, the drums were beaten making a loud noise; Garudan, the King Eagle, stretched his two large wings and encircled the cloudy sky; the devils commenced their dance of joy; the celestials prayed loudly "Hara Hara, SivA SivA, We seek Your refuge;" The Sun and the Moon, with cool rays, went around You; and the evil-minded demons were all destroyed when You waged the war with Your sharp Spear, Oh Lord! Once, two Marutha trees were broken to pieces when Krishna rolled over crawling with His waist tied to the stone-barrel (ural); You are the nephew of that Vishnu! There are a lotus pond and a cave where tigers frequent in VirAli Malai which is Your abode, Oh Six-faced One! You are the Great Master! There are plenty of fish of the type kayal, mayilai and makara jumping about in the paddy-fields of VayalUr*, where You are seated; You are always showering grace, Oh Great One!

918.english_pathavurai: They gather their cloud-like hair in a bunch and on it they display the lotus-like golden clasp, which they attach to the hair painstakingly, making sure that it is noticed by others; with an arduous knack, they let their kayal-fish-like eyes swing right up to the ears; their four inner tenets (anthak karaNam) namely, mind, intellect, will and egoism are increasingly filled with treacherous thoughts only; their relationship is merely a result of the money heaped on them by the amorous suitors who fall at their feet in utter delusion of passion; to embellish their beautiful bosom swelling like a full pot, that is smeared with cool and red vermilion, they wear an ornament made of pearls, shaped like the crescent moon, which they provocatively loosen a little and melt their suitors' bodies; these whores have the ability to buy the heart of anyone at a favourable price for themselves; kindly bless me so that my delusory fascination for them is destroyed! You have valorous mountain-like shoulders, Oh Strong One! As the numerous herds of devils danced, as the drums and percussion instruments were beaten loudly at a quick tempo and as the flock of eagles danced about, He danced rapturously like a spun-off top; He is the Lord holding the unique staff of bull; that Lord SivA and DEvi PArvathi, who comes foremost in the dynasty of the VEdAs, are exhilarated when You appear before them, Oh valorous One! On the edge of KAvEri, synchronised waves toss pearls and fill the banks of the river in this beautiful town ThiruththavaththuRai*, where You are seated, Oh Treasure! You stifled the angry demons who came in a confronting manner and graciously freed the kind and devoted celestials from their prisons, Oh Great One!

919.english_pathavurai: These whores display the cloth that covers their mountain-like bosom bedecked with strings of pearls and long chains embedded with rubies, their curly and greasy hair, sword-like eyes and beautiful face like the moon; they wear a sari around their quivering and slender waist, clasped with golden band (mEkalai); they fill moneyed people with enchantment by stimulating them passionately; every day, on the street, they coax people to their place and speak to them nicely in a cooing voice of the cuckoo; saving me from the fall into their web and reeling under it, I must set my mind to lead a life dedicated to the worship of Your hallowed feet; I have been the worst sinner ridiculing the assembly of Your devotees who are filled up with natural and spontaneous devotion; will You not kindly preach to me so that I could attain prosperous and blissful state? He held in His arm Mount MEru bending it as a bow; He dwells in the heart of those who undertake righteous penance; into the famous and beautiful ears of that Lord SivA You preached the principle of True Knowledge, Oh Lord with the sharp spear! This place is extolled by devotees wholeheartedly cherishing the words of wisdom spoken by great people who have researched into the three illustrious branches of Tamil language; it has many tall and famous buildings with balconies embedded with beautiful gems; it also flourishes with rich and abundant flood water gushing in the wide river KAvEri which looks like the wavy sea; this is VayalUr, Your abode, where harvested paddy and red rice crops are strewn everywhere in heaps after heaps, Oh Lord MurugA! She is the eternal Benefactor (Nithya KalyANi) who carried out (thirty-two) religious duties* (in Kancheepuram); She is the gracious Goddess UmAdEvi who is seated in ThiruththavaththuRai** (LAlgudi), which is also Your abode, Oh Great One!

You are a famous and strong warrior, Oh Lord! Making the demon SUran tremble with fear and destroying his mountain-like body that he obtained through boons bestowed upon him, You fought the war wielding Your eminent and dazzling spear, Oh Lord! 922.english_pathavurai: The sea, the arrows of Manmathan (God of Love), the beetle, the dark kayal fish, the keNdai fish, Yaman (God of Death), the lotus, the bird sakOram that gobbles up the fresh moonlight, the venom and Your spear that smashed Mount Krouncha to pieces are all comparable to them; those eyes are combative, wide, rolling in several directions, having reddish tinge in their middle and the corners, hiding treacherous thoughts and are highly demonstrative with all sweetness before the young men of the world; they impinge upon the beautiful golden ear-studs that swing; they wage a war acting so sensationally and with so much ado that the five sensory organs of the beholders are driven to agony; they have hoisted the flag of harassment that causes extreme pain at all times; the eyes always contain venom when these whores cast sidelong glances; I have been showering several valuable gifts repeatedly on these whores feeling exhilaration in my three inner faculties (namely, mind, speech and body); Oh Lord KanthA, in order to approach Your hallowed feet, filled with greatness, will I not be able to meditate upon You whole-heartedly day and night so that I could sever worldly attachments? Along with soft garlands made of fully blossomed kadappa flowers, effusive cream of civet, fresh paste of sandalwood grown in the mountains, vermillion and a blend of pigments are cohesively smeared on Your twelve shoulders that are always benevolent; those shoulders, Your six eternal and hallowed faces, the treatises that describe the ways to worship You, Your manthrAs, Mount Pazhani, Thirupparang KundRam and ThiruchchendhUr are always praised by Your true devotees in whose mind You are seated; You have an abode also in VayalUr, Oh Lord! He has fragrant and matted hair on which He wears a serpent having a bunch of hoods, the river Gangai, the crescent moon, the kurA flower, the aRugam (cynodon) grass, the little thumbai (leucas) flower and kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower; and You have the privilege of being worshipped by that Lord SivA, Oh Great Master! The river KavEri began its flow from the famous mountain in Coorg; that river came out of the water jug with a spout (kamaNdalam) used by ascetic Agasthya*, the dwarf-sage, who worships Lord SivA; that river KAvEri comes and joins the banks in ThenkadambanthuRai** where You are seated, Oh Great One!

925.english_pathavurai: My body is nothing but a mere bundle of flesh fully adorned from head to toe. This body is bound to vascillate in this world every day. I, the lowly dog, possess such a troublesome body! I want to give up my egoism and possessiveness; my intellect must contemplate the Complete Entity, which is shapeless and formless; my meditation should be only on the Supreme One; and my subconscious mind should experience it. All these can be granted as wished by me by Your Grace. You are the son of AsalEsurar* (Lord of Mount KailAsh that cannot be stirred)! You have the complexion of the rising sun in the East! You revel in all three branches of Tamil, namely literature, music and drama! You are the expert in all the vedic scriptures! You reside at VayalUr where blemishless devotees of Yours live! You are the Divine nectar flowing in the hearts of all compassionate people! You are the cousin** of BrahmA seated on the Lotus sought by beetles! You are filled with kindness, Oh Great Master! Your Western abode is KaruvUr***, Oh, Beautiful and Great One!

926.english_pathavurai: This body is afflicted by diseases everyday. Its formation and endurance are as a combination of the five elements, namely, water, earth, air, fire and the bright shining sky. It has a desire to rule the entire world and, in addition, to occupy the land of the celestials, for fulfillment of which desire, it roams about everywhere. It proudly puts on jewels and clothes and wanders with a foolish ego deceitfully. Thinking confidently that this body will last for ever without failure, I have been rambling amidst delusory worldly myths without realising True Knowledge. Taking me over by even by hoodwink, kindly make me reach to Your devotees and bless me nicely so that I obtain, through Your grace, the divine nectar of Knowledge and lead a great life at Your hallowed feet! The loud noise of the beating of the drums (pErikai) echoed everywhere (sounding to this meter); all the cardinal directions of the celestials were shaken and thrown astray; the confronting demons were shattered to pieces; and the hundred hoods of the great serpent (AdhisEshan) were terrified when You wielded the spear, Oh Lord! He smears all over His hallowed body the holy ash that confers victory; He offered the left side of His body for the concorporation of Lord VishNu (Sankara NArAyaNar) who grew up as Krishna in the cowherds' hamlet, GOkulam; He wears the garland of Aththi (mountain ebony) on His matted hair; and You are the child graciously delivered by that Lord SivA! You reside in the heart of Goddess VaLLi who is bestowed with mountain-like bosom, Oh KumarA! In order to take over devotees like us, You are seated in this gloriously triumphant place, KaruvUr*, Oh Great One!

934.english_meanings_list: ["As the moon is radiating fire without any compassion or kindness;", "as the southerly breeze from Mount Pothigai blows hot;", "as the sole cuckoo in the cool grove sings sadly;", "as the flute blows a note of melancholy;", "the lonely damsel separated from You has her fish-like eyes filled with fatigue.", "Without letting her debilitate further in her loneliness,", "and to help her sinking heart settle in peace,", "Oh MurugA with a gracious and hallowed chest, kindly come to her and hug her tightly!", "Oh Kumara, You wielded the Spear at Mount Krouncha and split it into two!", "You are the Lord of Tamil language, with its three branches, namely, literature, music and drama.", "You are the unique son of Lord SivA, in the form of the great effulgence,", "and You reside in this prosperous place, SElam.", "The hostile mounts of SUran and he himself, with his entire clan, perished in the war,", "and mounting Your matchless peacock, You flew around the world!", "You are the younger brother of Lord Ganapathi, with the spotted face of an elephant.", "You are full of wonders, Oh Great One!"]
934.english_pathavurai: As the moon is radiating fire without any compassion or kindness; as the southerly breeze from Mount Pothigai blows hot; as the sole cuckoo in the cool grove sings sadly; as the flute blows a note of melancholy; the lonely damsel separated from You has her fish-like eyes filled with fatigue. Without letting her debilitate further in her loneliness, and to help her sinking heart settle in peace, Oh MurugA with a gracious and hallowed chest, kindly come to her and hug her tightly! Oh Kumara, You wielded the Spear at Mount Krouncha and split it into two! You are the Lord of Tamil language, with its three branches, namely, literature, music and drama. You are the unique son of Lord SivA, in the form of the great effulgence, and You reside in this prosperous place, SElam. The hostile mounts of SUran and he himself, with his entire clan, perished in the war, and mounting Your matchless peacock, You flew around the world! You are the younger brother of Lord Ganapathi, with the spotted face of an elephant. You are full of wonders, Oh Great One!

935.english_meanings_list: ["\"What a paraphernalia like the blowing conch shell, a long crown, golden anklets, prominently displayed royal fans, flagstaff, palanquin, horse and elephant! - all these belong to me;", "I have learnt several million beautiful words; I am an expert magician; I am very proficient in the four varieties* 1 of Tamil poetry;", "my speech is fierce like the typhoon; I have earned the title of Poet-King and many other accolades; I was awarded the title of \"Bala Saraswathi\" (Young God of Learning);", "I am a poet capable of exposition of literary works described in the Sangam texts;", "and you are seated before me like the great alms-giver, comparable to the twenty-one celebrated philanthropists\" - with such hyperbole, how could I be flattering people who indulge in the five heinous sins?* 2 ?", "When GajEndran, the elephant with an attractive trunk, was terrified by a huge crocodile in a pond in the middle of the forest,", "and screamed His name as \"Oh Primordial One!\", He mounted the eagle, Garudan, and rushed to the aid of the elephant as the celestial world hailed His kindness and the fourteen worlds in a row rejoiced; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "You are seated with relish in KongunAdu which was awarded a lot of gold by sages like KongaNa Munivar* 3 , Oh valorous Lord with fragrant garlands, Oh KumarA, You are liked by the eighteen kinds of gaNas (semi-deities who are attendants of Lord SivA)!", "You hug the fragrant and beautiful bosom of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, Oh Lord!", "You have Your abode in Rasipuram* 4 which is located in the fertile land of KongunAdu, Oh Great One!"]
935.english_pathavurai: "What a paraphernalia like the blowing conch shell, a long crown, golden anklets, prominently displayed royal fans, flagstaff, palanquin, horse and elephant! - all these belong to me; I have learnt several million beautiful words; I am an expert magician; I am very proficient in the four varieties* 1 of Tamil poetry; my speech is fierce like the typhoon; I have earned the title of Poet-King and many other accolades; I was awarded the title of "Bala Saraswathi" (Young God of Learning); I am a poet capable of exposition of literary works described in the Sangam texts; and you are seated before me like the great alms-giver, comparable to the twenty-one celebrated philanthropists" - with such hyperbole, how could I be flattering people who indulge in the five heinous sins?* 2 ? When GajEndran, the elephant with an attractive trunk, was terrified by a huge crocodile in a pond in the middle of the forest, and screamed His name as "Oh Primordial One!", He mounted the eagle, Garudan, and rushed to the aid of the elephant as the celestial world hailed His kindness and the fourteen worlds in a row rejoiced; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! You are seated with relish in KongunAdu which was awarded a lot of gold by sages like KongaNa Munivar* 3 , Oh valorous Lord with fragrant garlands, Oh KumarA, You are liked by the eighteen kinds of gaNas (semi-deities who are attendants of Lord SivA)! You hug the fragrant and beautiful bosom of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, Oh Lord! You have Your abode in Rasipuram* 4 which is located in the fertile land of KongunAdu, Oh Great One!

946.english_pathavurai: They conform to a mature and disciplined way of life; their food consists of the choicest herbs and leaves; they perform penance in silence, and they practise yOgA in SivA's way. The aim of their devotion is to attain blissful liberation that is beyond the comprehension of the thirty-six tenets*. That is devoid of any attachments, and I would like to attain that very state. As soon as I reach that goal, the baneful qualities possessed by me, caused by delusion, should leave me completely. Your teaching me the True Knowledge will be my only weapon. That weapon, capable of destroying all my attachments, will have to be in the form of preaching from Your holy mouth, Oh Revered Master! I shall never forget Your wonderful and hallowed feet. You possess twelve powerful shoulders that symbolise truth. Fragrant bunches of blue lilies blossom in this place; there is soothing moonlight, and water in the ponds here are crystal-clear like pearl; this is VayalUr, Your favourite abode, where kuvaLai and lotus flowers abound. Your prowess is without any falsehood and is truly great! Your superb body is of a dazzling gold complexion. In AvinAsi, the myth of the Kaliyuga (the present aeon) was destroyed and the truth of God was established**, adding fame to ThiruppukkoLiyUr***, where You are seated, Oh Great One!

947.english_pathavurai: It has a wide jaw that serves as the source for generation of bilious juice; in the front, it has the decorative cover for its face and the ornamental cover for its forehead; fragrant paste of camphor is smeared on the forehead of that elephant on which is fitted a decorative covered pavilion (ampAri) as the seat; it has a very elegant trunk with which it feeds itself; it has exceedingly reddish eyes and a very speedy gait; around its neck a rope is tied with hanging bells that jingle with a loud noise; mounting, in style, that white elephant, AirAvatham, You go about in a procession and later relax peacefully under the shade of the rich and fertile KaRpaga tree; in the golden land of the celestials that has palaces with mountain-like fortress walls and courtyards filled with moonlight, You are reigning with nobility, surrounded by the worshipping DEvAs, Oh Lord with a youthful mien! Appearing in person in VayalUr to grant me Your vision, You took charge of me graciously, Oh Lord! To elate his matchless lover, Paravai NAcchiyAr of ThiruvArUr, by showering on her a thousand sovereigns of gold, he went to many Saivite shrines* to earn that gold; when that devotee, Sundarar went to those places, singing ThEvAram hymns maintaining rhythmic beats, with a determined perseverance and an effusive mind, he became exhausted due to excessive heat of the summer; to alleviate his exhaustion, He came in the disguise of an upright brahmin to the forest travelled through by Sundarar and appeared before him; He then opened the bundle of food (brought along with Him) and offered food to Sundarar; when Sundarar reached AvinAsi, he became befuddled and lost direction; at that time, He showed him the proper direction and vanished; once, when a child was gobbled up by a crocodile in a lake, moved by the hymn sung by Sundarar, He retrieved that child from the crocodile's jaws**; He is primordial and the most compassionate One; He is Lord SivA with His abode in ThiruppukkoLiyUr***, and You are praised by Him, Oh Great One!

948.english_pathavurai: It soars up in the sky beautifully; it is the cuckoo that creates meloncholy while cooing aloud; Manmathan, God of Love, has come to wage a war wielding His flowery arrows; He mounts the chariot of the southerly breeze under the shade of the moon that serves as the white, royal umbrella; in the background, the waves of the sea repeatedly lash the shore making the sound of the drum; His army of maids plays the flute to provide the music with its tempo building up; He marches with His fleet and arrives in the early evening determined to kill; the beating of the drums intensifies and the sound reverberates everywhere; His tall, pretty and famous bow of sugarcane wields, with relish, the arrows on me ceaselessly as if to wage a war; (because of that war,) I am left to die buried inside the attire of the whores whose hair is long and fragrant; is this what You wish, Oh Lord? Your horoscope is such that Your desire is fulfilled, namely, hugging the beautiful and mountain-like bosom of VaLLi, the damsel who guarded the millet-field! You are the great son of Lord SivA who wears the crooked and crescent moon on His matted hair! Those eminent sages known for their penance were like the earth for their forebearance; they were able to prosper, remaining steadfast in the righteous path, because You took the precious life of the sinful demon SUran who adorned his shoulders with closely-strung garlands of flowers plucked from the fresh groves, Oh Lord with the Spear! He blocked the vast and angry sea that lashed the shore with rapid waves by building a bridge across it; the renowned and crowned heads of RAvaNan, the leader of the demons who devour flesh, were all severed by the arrows wielded by Him; He is Lord VishNu, Your valorous uncle; He, along with Lord Brahma, who emerged from His belly, and who is famous for His dexterity in chanting the four VEdAs, hold Your valour in the highest esteem and praise You, Oh Lord! You are seated in this town, ThiruppukoLiyUr* which is famous for many temple-festivals; and You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

952.english_meanings_list: ["With a benign smile on their kind face, they beckon people to come to them; with melodious music and dances, they could melt the hearts;", "whoever their suitors may be, they are able to invite them treacherously; with their rolling eyes, like the arrows wielded by Manmathan (God of Love), they are capable of attacking (their suitors) and enchanting them;", "in front of the gate of their home, they stand on the street, with perverted and ulterior motives in their mind; they conclude the negotiation of the price and provocatively shake their big bosom wearing a string of pearls;", "they loosen their hair bedecked with garlands of flowers and re-tie the hair into a tuft; they deliberately slacken their attire and wrap it around their waist;", "feigning excessive passion, they speak out the desire in their mind and fall all over (their suitors); they have learnt many tricks of deception causing a lot of misery; how can a liaison with such whores do any good?", "The heavy Mount MEru was chosen as the churning rod; it was immediately installed (in the milky ocean); the hooded serpent VAsuki, which is worn as garland by Lord SivA on whose left side is Goddess UmAdEvi concorporate, was tied around the churner as the rope;", "one end of the rope was held by VAli and the other end was held by the celestials; several miraculous things emanated (from the milky ocean) that included Lakshmi, PArijAtham and others;", "He presided over the whole operation of churning the milky ocean; He was the compassionate Lord who distributed the nectar to the celestials; He has a green complexion; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "Like the indestructible town ALakApuri, the capital of KubErA (the Celestial Treasurer), this town KeeranUr* is also rich with many terraces, assembly halls and flowery groves; You are seated in this place, holding a spear in Your hand and blessing all graciously, Oh Great One!"]

The heavy Mount MEru was chosen as the churning rod; it was immediately installed (in the milky ocean); the hooded serpent VAsuki, which is worn as garland by Lord SivA on whose left side is Goddess UmAdEvi concorporate, was tied around the churner as the rope; one end of the rope was held by VAli and the other end was held by the celestials; several miraculous things emanated (from the milky ocean) that included Lakshmi, PArijAtham and others; He presided over the whole operation of churning the milky ocean; He was the compassionate Lord who distributed the nectar to the celestials; He has a green complexion; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!
