955.english_meanings_list: ["My robust body, the envy of all, has shrunk;", "my black hair has become grey and looks like cotton;", "my ears that could clearly hear all sounds have become deaf; my hitherto bright eyes have become blind;", "my strong white teeth have fallen;", "my arrogant ego has been shaken;", "I am out of breath, and chronic cough with unremitting metallic sound has resulted;", "accompanied by a painful headache, I am also feeling dizzy due to rising biliousness;", "due to anaemia, my skin is paler than that of a bloodless worm;", "my mind, speech and action have all strayed from their regular course and are in disarray;", "the women folk by my side ridicule and taunt me;", "all the people have declared me as an unclean guy, and I have become thick-skinned and insensitive;", "I have now reached a critical stage where my pulse rate is hardly perceptible;", "on that day when my life will be thus lingering painfully, kindly bestow Your grace upon me!", "(To this meter)", "drums that are beaten with the left hand, trumpets and similar percussion instruments making a loud noise;", "in the battlefield, the demons became very nervous;", "some devils began drinking blood using the empty skulls as ladles;", "a multitude of hawks began to pluck the intestines from the corpses;", "and some excited foxes scattered pieces of flesh all over, when You battled with Your spear, Oh Lord!", "Mounted on Your peacock, Your vision is seen in VayalUr, in the hearts of Your beloved devotees", "and in Thanichchayam*, situated in the prosperous region of Kongku nAdu where You are seated with relish, Oh KandhA, the Great One!"]
955.english_pathavurai: My robust body, the envy of all, has shrunk; my black hair has become grey and looks like cotton; my ears that could clearly hear all sounds have become deaf; my hitherto bright eyes have become blind; my strong white teeth have fallen; my arrogant ego has been shaken; I am out of breath, and chronic cough with unremitting metallic sound has resulted; accompanied by a painful headache, I am also feeling dizzy due to rising biliousness; due to anaemia, my skin is paler than that of a bloodless worm; my mind, speech and action have all strayed from their regular course and are in disarray; the women folk by my side ridicule and taunt me; all the people have declared me as an unclean guy, and I have become thick-skinned and insensitive; I have now reached a critical stage where my pulse rate is hardly perceptible; on that day when my life will be thus lingering painfully, kindly bestow Your grace upon me! (To this meter) drums that are beaten with the left hand, trumpets and similar percussion instruments making a loud noise; in the battlefield, the demons became very nervous; some devils began drinking blood using the empty skulls as ladles; a multitude of hawks began to pluck the intestines from the corpses; and some excited foxes scattered pieces of flesh all over, when You battled with Your spear, Oh Lord! Mounted on Your peacock, Your vision is seen in VayalUr, in the hearts of Your beloved devotees and in Thanichchayam*, situated in the prosperous region of Kongku nAdu where You are seated with relish, Oh KandhA, the Great One!

956.english_meanings_list: ["Praising the valour of Your shoulders that have destroyed countless demons,", "adoring Your spear that pierced through the Mount Krouncha,", "extolling Your lotus feet around which golden anklets embellish their beauty,", "revering Your lush hair wearing the cool koothaLa flowers,", "admiring Your chest that hugged VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters,", "and hailing Your six holy faces, may I not be blessed with such love that could touch my heart and melt all my bones?", "Those fanatics who quarrel with one and all indiscriminately, making loud noise and finding fault with other religions,", "raise their decibel level high, and shout blistering words full of inaccuracies;", "destroying their so-called religious text, a travesty; ending the havoc played on me by the five elements; and", "if I may say so, restraining my restless mind and making it perish,", "You taught me graciously the true spiritual knowledge; how can I describe the greatness of that wonderful knowledge?", "Peanut, sugar candy and honey of top quality are mixed with tasty millet-flour and molten jaggery", "making the favourite food for our Lord VinAyagar which He devours with relish;", "He was once requested by Sage VyAsA to write the great epic MahAbhAratham using one of His tusks;", "He obliged and wrote the epic sitting on top of the golden-red Mount MEru, which is in the north, having lofty and tall peaks; He was Himself looking like a coral hill!", "One day, before He could circumambulate His Father, Lord SivA,", "(You set about Your journey) faster than a hurricane going around the entire world in the eight directions,", "mounted on Your vehicle, the strong peacock, with green feathers, which roams around preying on the snakes, Oh MurugA!", "\"You are like the eight-legged huge bird (Saraba)* that is capable of conquering the Lion!\" - so the celestials praise You in Mathurai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
956.english_pathavurai: Praising the valour of Your shoulders that have destroyed countless demons, adoring Your spear that pierced through the Mount Krouncha, extolling Your lotus feet around which golden anklets embellish their beauty, revering Your lush hair wearing the cool koothaLa flowers, admiring Your chest that hugged VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, and hailing Your six holy faces, may I not be blessed with such love that could touch my heart and melt all my bones? Those fanatics who quarrel with one and all indiscriminately, making loud noise and finding fault with other religions, raise their decibel level high, and shout blistering words full of inaccuracies; destroying their so-called religious text, a travesty; ending the havoc played on me by the five elements; and if I may say so, restraining my restless mind and making it perish, You taught me graciously the true spiritual knowledge; how can I describe the greatness of that wonderful knowledge? Peanut, sugar candy and honey of top quality are mixed with tasty millet-flour and molten jaggery making the favourite food for our Lord VinAyagar which He devours with relish; He was once requested by Sage VyAsA to write the great epic MahAbhAratham using one of His tusks; He obliged and wrote the epic sitting on top of the golden-red Mount MEru, which is in the north, having lofty and tall peaks; He was Himself looking like a coral hill! One day, before He could circumambulate His Father, Lord SivA, (You set about Your journey) faster than a hurricane going around the entire world in the eight directions, mounted on Your vehicle, the strong peacock, with green feathers, which roams around preying on the snakes, Oh MurugA! "You are like the eight-legged huge bird (Saraba)* that is capable of conquering the Lion!" - so the celestials praise You in Mathurai, which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

957.english_pathavurai: My dear, You are the immediate younger brother of elephant-faced VinAyagA. You are also the six-faced scholar and the Lord of all DEvAs. To the primordial Lord SivA and to BrahmA, presiding over the VEdAs, You are the Great Master who taught the scriptures! Dynasties of the demons were beheaded with the sword of Yours, the shrewdest war-strategist and valorous one! I must surrender at Your two lotus feet and attain the status so that my life prospers with Your Grace. The seven worlds* of the upper strata, Vishnu and BrahmA, or any one, for that matter, could not perceive the greatness of SivA who resides in Madhurai as Chokkar; He and PArvathi were thrilled when You flew around on the peacock, Oh Muruga. The deer-eyed damsel of KuravAs, namely VaLLi, who resides in the millet-field at VaLLimalai, where honey is abundant, was embraced by You with Your strong shoulders! Any fear about SUran that was lurking in the minds of DEvAs was removed by Your Spear, Oh Great One!

959.english_pathavurai: If they are not paid, they curse some people; at times (on being paid), they extol some. They pass on the betel-leaves chewed by them to someone else. Their focus is only on money. If they are paid, they are willing to hug even a corpse. While being engaged in chatting, they slip into the bedroom to prepare some concoction to serve. Then they embrace tightly. Saying that they need money for the festive season in the month KArththigai (December), they extort money from their suitors; they address everyone naming some kind of relationship, inviting them to visit at least once a month. Their intention is to grab the entire wealth of the visitors.They chase away the non-paying customers. Because of the harassment by these whores who are bent upon destroying my family life, do I have to be tied down as a bullock paired off (in a cart) with another bull and suffer in a daze in the hell of passion? Protecting me from the evil of falling into this bottomless pit and becoming a total waste, and admitting me to the company of Your devotees so as to take me over, kindly consider blessing me to walk the righteous path! As a Great Master rich in true knowledge, You chose the vast and prolific scriptures, along with the tenets of Saivism, and preached them properly into the hallowed ears of Your Father, Lord SivA, Oh Wise MurugA, the handsome Lord with a reddish complexion! She is clever and famous because of her chastity; the demon (RAvaNan) harassed that JAnaki and kidnapped her stealthily; He shattered that RAvaNan's body to pieces and returned to AyOdhdhi victoriously; You are the beloved and handsome nephew of that RAmA (Lord VishNu), Oh Lord! Wielding the powerful weapon, the spear, You split the bodies of many demons and thereafter, You redeemed the celestial world for the DEvAs; then, You entered into holy matrimony with the damsel, who stood close to You, namely DEvayAnai, the daughter of IndrA, the Leader of the Celestials, Oh Lord! This wonderful and large city is famous for great poets who were well-versed in the three branches of Tamil literature; here, in NAnmAdaRkUdal (Madhurai), You have Your abode, Oh Great One!

966.english_meanings_list: ["They think only the worst treacherous thoughts in their mind;", "they have the grotesque form like the overbearing devils;", "these whores deliberately show off their bravado everyday and while away precious time exhibiting nice bangles on their arms, swinging studs on their ears and pearl chains on their bosom;", "they are utterly useless; earnestly seeking others' admiration, they sing and dance;", "they pretend to run away as though they are too shy to appear before men; on the streets, however, they speak (with men) flirtatiously; they talk as though they are filled with love;", "they are capable of enticing people; they express their desire openly and then feign shyness; they are highly tricky; they are fiendish; they are swindlers;", "and they are avaricious; in order that my delusory passion for such whores is shattered and blown apart,", "kindly guide me to that path which leads me to the nectar, namely, Your grace, so that I could attain Your hallowed feet!", "(To this meter), the drums were beaten loudly and", "the percussion instruments, the battle-drums, long horns, curved trumpets, conch-shells, hand-drums, and the elegant bugles were all sounded vociferously;", "when You wielded Your spear crushing all the demons and scattering their bodies all over, Oh Lord!", "She stood guard to the millet-field everyday; this statuette-like beautiful girl has rows of teeth looking like pearls; she is VaLLi, the fine-looking damsel born to a deer;", "and making that VaLLi exult in exhilaration, You played with her daily, Oh MurugA!", "He burnt down the Thiripuram by His mere smile; He has DEvi PArvathi concorporate on the left side of His body; He is the handsome Lord ChokkanAthan (SivA); into His ears You graciously preached the meaning of the matchless PraNava ManthrA!", "You then took Your seat in the southern city of Madhurai, Oh Great One!"]
966.english_pathavurai: They think only the worst treacherous thoughts in their mind; they have the grotesque form like the overbearing devils; these whores deliberately show off their bravado everyday and while away precious time exhibiting nice bangles on their arms, swinging studs on their ears and pearl chains on their bosom; they are utterly useless; earnestly seeking others' admiration, they sing and dance; they pretend to run away as though they are too shy to appear before men; on the streets, however, they speak (with men) flirtatiously; they talk as though they are filled with love; they are capable of enticing people; they express their desire openly and then feign shyness; they are highly tricky; they are fiendish; they are swindlers; and they are avaricious; in order that my delusory passion for such whores is shattered and blown apart, kindly guide me to that path which leads me to the nectar, namely, Your grace, so that I could attain Your hallowed feet! (To this meter), the drums were beaten loudly and the percussion instruments, the battle-drums, long horns, curved trumpets, conch-shells, hand-drums, and the elegant bugles were all sounded vociferously; when You wielded Your spear crushing all the demons and scattering their bodies all over, Oh Lord! She stood guard to the millet-field everyday; this statuette-like beautiful girl has rows of teeth looking like pearls; she is VaLLi, the fine-looking damsel born to a deer; and making that VaLLi exult in exhilaration, You played with her daily, Oh MurugA! He burnt down the Thiripuram by His mere smile; He has DEvi PArvathi concorporate on the left side of His body; He is the handsome Lord ChokkanAthan (SivA); into His ears You graciously preached the meaning of the matchless PraNava ManthrA! You then took Your seat in the southern city of Madhurai, Oh Great One!

967.english_meanings_list: ["\"He is like a mountain on whose left side DEvi PArvathi is concorporate, adorned with rows of pearls and nine precious gems;", "He is the sacred tree that grants the fruit of Liberation; He is the three-eyed Lord SivA\" - so on and so forth that Lord is praised; to that SivA, Lord Murugan kindly preached!", "When all the celestials of thirty-three* kinds prostrated at His feet,", "Lord VishNu (as RAmA) shot His arrow knocking down the ten heads (of RAvaNA);", "the same Lord VishNu (as KrishNA) drove the chariot for ArjunA making him the victor in the (MahAbhArathA) war;", "He is of the hue of greenish dark cloud; that VishNu was terrified of the demons (SUrapathman, Singamukan and ThArakan); and You are the Lord who removed His fear, Oh MurugA!", "Kindly grant me the bliss that prevails in the hearts of all Your devotees!", "(To this meter) the drums, idakkai (a percussion instrument made of leather beaten only by the left hand) and udukkai (hand-drums) were beaten;", "He danced to the meter of \"thaththathaku seccharikai seccharikai\"", "synchronising with that dance of Father SivA, She too dances; She is the primordial Goddess of the three worlds; She is PArvathi who bestows fresh boons on Her devotees; You are Her child, Oh Lord!", "This town is full of multi-storied mansions where women with slender waists live; it is also surrounded by tall fortress walls;", "this is Madhurai, famous for its Golden Lotus Tank; and it is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
967.english_pathavurai: "He is like a mountain on whose left side DEvi PArvathi is concorporate, adorned with rows of pearls and nine precious gems; He is the sacred tree that grants the fruit of Liberation; He is the three-eyed Lord SivA" - so on and so forth that Lord is praised; to that SivA, Lord Murugan kindly preached! When all the celestials of thirty-three* kinds prostrated at His feet, Lord VishNu (as RAmA) shot His arrow knocking down the ten heads (of RAvaNA); the same Lord VishNu (as KrishNA) drove the chariot for ArjunA making him the victor in the (MahAbhArathA) war; He is of the hue of greenish dark cloud; that VishNu was terrified of the demons (SUrapathman, Singamukan and ThArakan); and You are the Lord who removed His fear, Oh MurugA! Kindly grant me the bliss that prevails in the hearts of all Your devotees! (To this meter) the drums, idakkai (a percussion instrument made of leather beaten only by the left hand) and udukkai (hand-drums) were beaten; He danced to the meter of "thaththathaku seccharikai seccharikai" synchronising with that dance of Father SivA, She too dances; She is the primordial Goddess of the three worlds; She is PArvathi who bestows fresh boons on Her devotees; You are Her child, Oh Lord! This town is full of multi-storied mansions where women with slender waists live; it is also surrounded by tall fortress walls; this is Madhurai, famous for its Golden Lotus Tank; and it is Your abode, Oh Great One!

968.english_meanings_list: ["By the arrows of flowers shot by the combative God of Love (Manmathan) and by the venomous eyes of the whores,", "I was smitten by lust for their dazzling bosom decorated with swinging pearl necklaces;", "rather than prostrating with love and respect at Your hallowed feet, which feet are those of the Master of the primordial Lord SivA,", "I was suffering with a drooping and painful heart and a decaying body;", "my five faculties of sense, namely, taste, light, feeling, sound and smell, standing steadily as hunters;", "and the action of my four mental powers, namely mind, intellect, will and arrogance,", "should be prevented from attacking me, and I should be insulated from them in order to realise You and be blessed by You;", "my desires should be destroyed by Your merging with my thoughts so that I could conquer all the evil and delusory powers;", "then, You must kindly preach to me the crux of the supreme entity that presides upon the sacred VEdAs!", "He destroyed the power of the wild demoness ThAdakai; He helped conduct grandly the holy sacrifice by the famous sage ViswAmitrar;", "His graceful stride was such that the specks from His heels removed the curse (of the unique woman, Ahalya); He bent the strong Bow of SivA and broke it (in front of King Janaka);", "He then wedded the naturally beautiful damsel, JAnaki, and embraced her; thereafter,", "He renounced the throne of AyOdhyA and undertook to carry out the command of His (step -) mother, KaikEyi; Rama was of such fame, and You are the nephew of that Rama!", "All the hoods of the serpent, AdhisEshan, were shaken and stormy winds blew everywhere", "while the celestials jumped up with excitement when You mounted Your vehicle, the dancing peacock!", "In this town, clouds hover over the top of the trees in the groves and wealth is abundant;", "this is Sripurushamangai (NAngunEri) which is Your abode, Oh Great One!"]
968.english_pathavurai: By the arrows of flowers shot by the combative God of Love (Manmathan) and by the venomous eyes of the whores, I was smitten by lust for their dazzling bosom decorated with swinging pearl necklaces; rather than prostrating with love and respect at Your hallowed feet, which feet are those of the Master of the primordial Lord SivA, I was suffering with a drooping and painful heart and a decaying body; my five faculties of sense, namely, taste, light, feeling, sound and smell, standing steadily as hunters; and the action of my four mental powers, namely mind, intellect, will and arrogance, should be prevented from attacking me, and I should be insulated from them in order to realise You and be blessed by You; my desires should be destroyed by Your merging with my thoughts so that I could conquer all the evil and delusory powers; then, You must kindly preach to me the crux of the supreme entity that presides upon the sacred VEdAs! He destroyed the power of the wild demoness ThAdakai; He helped conduct grandly the holy sacrifice by the famous sage ViswAmitrar; His graceful stride was such that the specks from His heels removed the curse (of the unique woman, Ahalya); He bent the strong Bow of SivA and broke it (in front of King Janaka); He then wedded the naturally beautiful damsel, JAnaki, and embraced her; thereafter, He renounced the throne of AyOdhyA and undertook to carry out the command of His (step -) mother, KaikEyi; Rama was of such fame, and You are the nephew of that Rama! All the hoods of the serpent, AdhisEshan, were shaken and stormy winds blew everywhere while the celestials jumped up with excitement when You mounted Your vehicle, the dancing peacock! In this town, clouds hover over the top of the trees in the groves and wealth is abundant; this is Sripurushamangai (NAngunEri) which is Your abode, Oh Great One!

969.english_pathavurai: Because of the quivering of the dishevelled and cloud-like hair and because of the long swinging ear-studs swaying in accordance with the movement of the hair, the young girls provoke sensuous thoughts disturbing the minds of passionate young men; thrusting forward in a confrontational manner, their breasts are solid and rugged like diamond, looking like pots, the tusks of an elephant and two mountains; if one begins to name these whores, they are like monkeys (because of impetuous pranks), like serpents (because of poisonous nature) and like elephants (because of their arrogance); they serve as the limb of Manmathan (God of Love) spreading the net of their eyes; (falling victim to their spell), my hitherto great intelligence was shattered, and I felt disheartened being tossed about by passionate thoughts; to eradicate my mental agony, kindly come and grant me Your blessings! Oh KanthA, when You come walking, the dainty anklets on Your hallowed feet sway elegantly; as Your symbol, You display the matchless Peacock (* an aspect of SUran) and You hold in Your hand the sharp spear, Oh Lord! You are the son of UmAdEvi, the Goddess of great eminence; You acclaimed as Your staff, the Rooster (which was another aspect of SUran that came* towards You) and were seated in ThiruchchendhUr as its Treasure for the upliftment of the celestials, Oh Lord! Aware of this uncertainty, Your devotees get off the ocean of family life; and I want to be like them. That mighty SivA bowed down before You (to listen to Your preaching of VEdAs). IndrA, who holds the weapon Vajra, and all DEvAs were subdued by You. Gold-complexioned BrahmA was imprisoned by You (due to His inability to interpret the VEdAs). You are the ruler and protector of this place, Aaykkudi*. The asura armies were making boisterous noise on the seas; and You were able to destroy them and the mount, Krounchagiri, with a thunderous sound by throwing the Spear in Your hand, Oh Great One!

980.english_pathavurai: Staring with their eyes that beat the sharpness of the spear, smiling and showing off the stud in the ear, pointing out the direction to their house, deliberately dropping their upper garment, they expose their body to entice their suitors' mind, revealing the elephant-like breasts as if ready to wage a war and they conceal them instantly; they are treacherous to the fullest extent in fiercely fighting the suitors by speaking opportunistic words in a cajoling manner; they demand the money previously stipulated by them, and once they grab that money, they display indifference in mid-course and chase their suitors away; (if they are offered additional money,) they feign remorse and extend a warm welcome; their bed strewn with flowers demonstrates love, but on that very bed these whores resort to deception; why do I passionately pine for these stupid whores, and when will I ever be freed from the shackle of the bad deed caused by that mental disease? He is an Effulgence of light with a scar of AlakAla poison on His gullet; He holds the skull of Brahma on His hand; He dances to the enthrallment of PArvathi; He holds in His strong hand a bow which he took out to wage a war (on Thiripuram) when He used as the arrow none other than Lord VishNu (coming as KrishNa) who swallowed the earth and spat it out sportingly when asked to give it back; on His thick and matted hair, He holds River Gangai on whose waterfront there are plenty of flowers oozing honey; He is the great Lord of pristine quality; armies of SivagaNAs surround Him worshipping with relish; to that Father of Yours, Lord SivA, You preached the meaning of True Knowledge (PraNava ManthrA); and that prestigious fame is Yours, Oh Lord MurugA! Around this town, VayalUr, ponds abound in which sEl fish and kayal fish jump about, and You are seated here, Oh Lord! You hold the spear as a weapon in Your hand! You are the refuge of all brahmins, Oh Valorous and Pure One; You are seated in ThiruppuththUr*, Oh Great One!

981.english_pathavurai: This body is covered by flesh which camouflages diseases inside. When the body degenerates and the life departs, all kith and kin come home and cry their hearts out; and their wailing seems unabated, and eventually it subsides. They place the corpse on decorated palanquins. Before the body rots and stinks, they take it to the cremation ground and set fire to it. They do it without any qualms, and the body is turned into ash. This is the ritual in this birth, and lest I desire this destiny, You must shower Your grace on me! Vishnu, the great enchanter who danced on the spotted hood of the large cobra, KALingan; BrahmA with His abode atop the honey-dripping Lotus flower; the DEvAs who guard the eight directions; the eight celebrated mountains; the shaken asuras (demons) and DEvAs were all rescued when the incoming evil poison was consumed by the Great Lord SivAs if it were Divine nectar! When that SivA once prostrated before You in the traditional and orthodox way, You preached to Him the quintessence of scriptural knowledge readily! Your abode forever has been Thiru vAdAnai*, Oh Great One!

982.english_pathavurai: "You are the Deity of Knowledge like the (wish-yielding) KaRpaga Tree; You are the Lord of DEvayAnai, who grew up previously in the celestial land; You are the strong younger brother of the Elephant-God GaNapathi who graciously accepts and devours, in His beautiful and prominent stomach, sugar cane with a sweet honey-taste, jaggery, cooked rice, white sugar, milk, honey, raw coconut filled to the brim, the three kinds of fruits, namely, plantain, mango and jack fruit and lentils; You have the beautiful peacock as Your vehicle which prostrated at Your hallowed feet (in its previous birth) to become Your vehicle (in this birth); and You wear anklets that have solid and rotary types of gems embedded in them, making a pleasing sound" - with such words, I wish to offer prayers to You, meditating on You with a melting heart, attaining the hallowed feet of SivA by singing the beautiful songs of Your glory, soaring to the cosmos of true knowledge and reaching the highest point of the intellect; will I be able to imbibe the nectar of realisation that is said to be spouting like a fountain from within the body? Herds of horses and elephants with overwrought bodies of combative zeal, along with heaps of corpses, strewn like garbage, of the demons covered the battlefield, reddening all the eight directions with blood; the elephants guarding the eight cardinal directions (ashta-dhik-gajas*) began to dance; a few varieties of trumpets blared to the meter of "thaththana thAnath thadududu"; the cymbals sounded to the rhythm of "thaku thoku"; some drums gave the appearance of flashing lightning and blasting thunder; and the DEvAs of the wonderful celestial land, who regained their homeland and reclaimed all its wealth, showered golden flowers as You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! VaLLi, the daughter of the KuRavAs, who is the wise one having realised the true knowledge, the beautiful damsel DEvayAnai, reared by the elephant (AyrAvadham) and the exalted vehicle of Yours, namely the peacock are all prominently seen with You in uththara kOsa mangai**, Your chosen abode, Oh Great One!

983.english_pathavurai: Growing up into a robust youth, looking handsome like Manmathan, the God of Love; undertaking profitable business assignments; becoming deluded and playing quite a few love games; thinking that this wasteful life would last; seeking wealth to be a rich man owning palatial houses with balconies and halls; setting my heart on fragrant musk and flowers with petals; happily applying lavish perfumes over my body and rambling about fanatically; running after whores chasing them around with passion; after several days of such wasteful life, noticing wavy wrinkles on my skin; my hair turning grey; losing my eyesight; both my legs tottering; my ears losing their hearing power; my abilty to discern distinctly the diverse principles of life, God and bondage gone; my happiness lost; old age creeping in, and moving around leaning on a stick; stomach ache, rashes, phlegm, wheezing, diseases caused by gastritis, diabetes, anaemia, ring worm around my neck, high fever, whooping cough - all these closing in on me; and the basic container of these diseases, namely, my filthy body emitting a foul odour; should I have to die like this? He has four faces; He was unable to interpret the meaning of the PraNava ManthrA which is the fundamental principle for everything; He is BrahmA; You knocked Him down demanding to know the correct meaning of that ManthrA and forcefully hit His four heads with Your knuckles, blowing apart His faces and tufts, like beating the drums, Oh Young One! You are the friendly brother of GaNapathi, the first-born of DEvi PArvathi, concorporate with the body of Lord SivA who wears the fragrant kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower on His matted hair! She was happily residing in the forest of Mount VaLLimalai; She was the wise damsel of the kuRavAs; and You have the honour of marrying that VaLLi in the grove surrounded by the millet fields, Oh valorous One mounting the peacock! The shrieking She-demon ThAdakai, SubAgu, tall trees of maRamaram numbering seven, VAli, Neeli, Bagan, unique demon VirAthan, the seas with rising waves and, in addition, the entire clan of mighty RAvaNA were all destroyed by Him in the war and shattered to pieces; He merrily holds in His hands the bow that shoots fiery arrows, the disc and the conch-shell; He holds Goddess Lakshmi on His hallowed chest; He is Lord VishNU known as Hari and KEsavan; You are His nephew; You are thus praised by the VEdAs! 985.english_pathavurai: In the impeccable SahasrAra* lotus centre (with 1008 petals, which is above all the six KuNdalini Centres), the reverberation of the conch shell is heard (when oxygen gushes through); even though one perceives secretly the firm phenomenon of expanding brightness in the entire range of the wonderful cosmos, no one can discern its true nature over there. Above all the fifty-one alphabets, vowels and consonants (of the Sanskrit language), all the worlds, rivers and planets, is this reddish and pure effulgence which pervades all over; on the lofty and blissful lotus (of Brahmaranthiram) which Yogis, who have transcended the stages of the beginning and the middle, meditate upon, in the cosmic expanse of golden glow, where moonlight is widely spread, and which has a beautiful crystal cloured door, at the apex of susumnA** vein where all the five sensory organs (skin, mouth, eyes, nose and ears) obtain the nectar-like bliss of Siva-yOgA, I wish to experience the same with Your blessing; for that, I must repeatedly chant Your name as "Oh Son of PArvathi, KumarA, Oh Master!" For my acquiring matured devotion, You have to grant me the requisite youthful vigour and take charge of me at Your hallowed feet! The drums and other percussion instruments were beaten (to this meter). the hoods of the serpent, AdhisEshan, and all the planets were about to be ripped open by the loud noise from the conch shells proclaiming victory; on the battlefield where the demons fought and died, all the celestials gathered together and showered flowers; the rare staff of Rooster was displayed prominently everywhere; VishNu, BrahmA, the sages and all the worlds were rescued when You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! You wrapped Your body over the bosom of VaLLi, the daughter of VishNu and happily hugged her with Your hallowed shoulders and radiant face; and with Your rare peacock and the spear, You are seated with relish in this place called Inthambalam***, Oh Great One!

986.english_pathavurai: I would like to look right into Your eyes without any trickery; my mind should melt; I should be singing Your glory with my eyes filled with tears; my love for You should keep on swelling; and day and night, I should concentrate only on You and nothing else. "Oh KumarA, You love to wear garlands of kurA flowers; Oh MurugA, ShatAksharA (six-lettered Lord), SaravaNabavA, Oh King, who as a child suckled the breasts of Karthigai women" I would like to sing as above! With my words fumbling, I should worship You crying repeatedly. I should belong to You completely; and thereupon, would You not give me the Eternal Knowledge that is beyond anything else in this world? You showed* me the path to Eternal Bliss, Oh the Cleverest One! You are the King of all mountains! You are the greatest warrior! You redeemed DEvAs' land and setlled them there safely! You are praised by the people of EzhukarainAdu**, Oh Great One!

995.english_pathavurai: As safeguarding the soul in this life is the most worthwhile thing to do, I ought to have known the fundamental tenets (namely, righteousness, material things, pleasure and liberation); without knowing them or the most important principle in life, I enjoyed my dominant rides on elephants, and horses much to the admiration of many soldiers, and roamed around aimlessly away from my home in many countries and forests; I indulged lavishly in women coming up with new songs and dances, immersing myself in their mountain-like bosoms where flowery scent lingered. In carnal pleasure with women and in playful dissonance with them, I spent days and nights. Wasting time like this, should I just give up my body in vain? He is the consort of DEvi PArvathi; He is the supreme form of purity; to that SivA You exhaustively preached the significance of PraNava and the truth that is beyond the reach of all tenets of the soul, Oh Lord! You are the Sun of Wisdom! Oh Handsome One, You came (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) to sing four different varieties* of poetry! You are the deliverer of Eternal Bliss! You are the supreme sacrificer! You are the great treasure brought forth by the six Karththigai Women who appear as stars in the night! Upon those devotees who prostrate at Your feet, Your twelve eyes bestow abundant grace! You are the Lord represented by the six holy letters (SaravaNabava)! You hold the sharp spear that shattered Mount Krouncha! Oh valorous One! Making the demons scream in fear, rendering the Master of VEdAs, BrahmA, speechless (due to His inability to interpret the PraNava ManthrA), and stirring the oceans into a roaring screech, You wielded the spear swiftly, Oh Great One!

Mounting the peacock that thrashed bunches of fierce and swift snakes, and wielding the spear from Your hand, You destroyed the valiant demon SUran, disguised as a mango tree, and shattered the famous Mount Krouncha as the celestials worshipped You showering flowers and praying "Oh Lord with the Spear, Hail to You!" 998.english_pathavurai: On the lotus of six petals, attached to the flower, is the chakrA centre (called SwadhishtAnam); upon that centre, is Lord BrahmA, merrily ensconced, with a reddish-gold hue, resembling the rising sun; right above that chakrA, in the centre (called MaNipUraka) is seated Lord VishNu who once swallowed the earth and who is the protector of all lives; In the lotus of the heart (in AnAhatham ChakrA), which is the base of all yOgAs and ManthrAs, is seated Lord Rudran; the Lord (SadAsivan) sought after by the Trinity, who is of the form of light and glory, is seated in the middle (of the two eyebrows); above that chakrA is the seat meant for Your mystic frolics and the elegant gem-studded shrine that is identified by the scriptures as the Lord's seat; It is that abode of Yours where millions of dazzling rays shine; in that wide hall of Your shrine many fragrant incenses and lamps are displayed; and You are ensconced snugly in that centre, Oh valorous Pundit! Oh Gallant Master, kindly destroy all my deeds and save me! You are the Lord of all celestials, Oh Great One!

999.english_meanings_list: ["Lord Brahma, seated on the lotus which He would never part from, and who is well-versed in the four VEdAs, and Lord VishNu who mounts with relish the big eagle (Garudan) were never able to discern Him;", "when those two went into an argument (as to who was greater among them), He rose and stood at the appropriate time as a tall and red effulgence of fire and pervaded the whole wide sky; He is the unique Lord SivA, of everlasting fame;", "when that Lord SivA sought to have an insight into the True Path, You preached to Him as the Great Master, and He worshipped Your hallowed feet stating that You had showered love and bliss on Him;", "in order that I too worship those feet praising with my tongue and to enable me to compose songs with my loving thoughts fixed on You, will there be a day for this slave when I too am able to attain the bliss of veneration after knowing You thoroughly?", "With her kayal-fish-like eyes that keep running up to the ears as if to accost them with many challenges, her sweet lips looking like the kovvai fruit and her exquisite beauty, VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs,", "who was bestowed with dark and dense hair, mountain-like bosom and slender waist wrapped around by her attire,", "made You declare that her closely set earstud would serve as the pledge deed (evidencing that You were her bonded slave); You then reached a highly pitiable stage, with Your speech faltering, and began to roam about alone aimlessly with a depressed mind, Oh Lord!", "The ocean caught fire and boiled over, and the evil demons were killed, with their bodies scattered around, when You wielded the powerful spear on their chest, Oh Great One!"]
999.english_pathavurai: Lord Brahma, seated on the lotus which He would never part from, and who is well-versed in the four VEdAs, and Lord VishNu who mounts with relish the big eagle (Garudan) were never able to discern Him; when those two went into an argument (as to who was greater among them), He rose and stood at the appropriate time as a tall and red effulgence of fire and pervaded the whole wide sky; He is the unique Lord SivA, of everlasting fame; when that Lord SivA sought to have an insight into the True Path, You preached to Him as the Great Master, and He worshipped Your hallowed feet stating that You had showered love and bliss on Him; in order that I too worship those feet praising with my tongue and to enable me to compose songs with my loving thoughts fixed on You, will there be a day for this slave when I too am able to attain the bliss of veneration after knowing You thoroughly? With her kayal-fish-like eyes that keep running up to the ears as if to accost them with many challenges, her sweet lips looking like the kovvai fruit and her exquisite beauty, VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, who was bestowed with dark and dense hair, mountain-like bosom and slender waist wrapped around by her attire, made You declare that her closely set earstud would serve as the pledge deed (evidencing that You were her bonded slave); You then reached a highly pitiable stage, with Your speech faltering, and began to roam about alone aimlessly with a depressed mind, Oh Lord! The ocean caught fire and boiled over, and the evil demons were killed, with their bodies scattered around, when You wielded the powerful spear on their chest, Oh Great One!

1000.english_pathavurai: Standing on the high bamboo platform in the hunters' millet field, She guarded the full-grown millet; when You were struck by that VaLLi's arrow-like eyes, You reeled over and pretended to totter; as if Your body had lost its vigour, with a melting heart, You pathetically assumed the disguise of an old man and waited for the most opportune moment to enter the millet field; that calculative skill is the subject of many a poem composed by poets of this world who proclaim Your glory loudly. They are enchanted by Your hallowed feet, which are praised by all the fourteen worlds. With those holy feet, wearing the fragrant kadappa garlands, Your devotees are kindly protected; Will there be a day when I can do a rare penance to seek and attain that greatness? The golden mount, Manthara, was firmly fixed as the churning rod in the middle of the milky ocean; the great serpent VAsuki, having thousands of hot poisonous split tongues and fangs, was wound like a rope around that mount; when the ocean was churned, nectar was produced which was served (by Mohini) to satiate the large hunger of the celestials; He also came as the cowherd, Krishna - that Vishnu; Once, to burn away the Thiripuram Kingdoms, He arched the heavy Mount Meru in the north into a bow; that valiant Lord SivA; - both of them praised You saying, "You have reduced our burden*, Oh Lord"; the clan of the treacherous demons was destroyed; IndrA was rescued from his rigorous prison, and his entire kingdom and wealth were restored; and in his celestial land, You resettled the DEvAs, Oh Great One!

1002.english_pathavurai: Along with peanuts, lentils, split beans, sesame-seed, puffed rice, sukiyan (roasted ball of coconut and jaggery), vadai (fried lentil dough), sugarcane and plantain, all of which taste like nectar, ripe and mature fruits of many kinds are assembled; for the prosperity of all people living on this earth surrounded by the seas, He happily takes that food with His trunk in one sweep and graciously devours it; He stuffs that food in His large pot-belly; He is Lord GaNapathi looking like a wild elephant; I have failed to worship You as His younger brother, the matchless six-faced Lord, Murugan; nor have I prostrated at Your feet by folding my two arms and shedding tears from my wide-open eyes; instead, my mind has been blown away due to the humiliation brought about by poverty and misery caused by my past evil and enormous deeds; will I never be able to kick away the habit of falling into the treacherous pits laid by the whores and roaming about towards utter decay? The gifted God of Death (Yaman) who rises swiftly like a swelling sea (to take lives away) became very scared; the sun and the moon were also terrified; and the earth began to shake precariously as the evil demons marched into the battlefield; their heads were felled with a thundering noise; the peaks of the famous eight mountains began to shake and rumble; when You mounted the horse-like, dancing and bright peacock, holding Your matchless spear in the hand! You fiercely went around the earth at mighty speed, Oh Lord with hallowed lotus feet, as the perennial river Gangai gushed with a bubbling sound and the sages worshipped You with fragrant flowers chanting "Hara, Hara, Hara"; and the celestials were liberated from their prison. You took Your seat upon the fragrant lotus in the pond at SaravaNam where You grew up, Oh Great One!

1004.english_pathavurai: This body is closely knit with muscles, blood and flesh; it is filled up with active germs yet it is an inert and dull body; this little cottage is ultimately consigned to the cremation ground. Cherishing and nourishing such a body, there are many ritualists, religious fanatics, and a few people hanging on to methods of worship* through offerings and meditation; and confused and unwise ones. I wish to give up the methods of all these people. Henceforth, I should be clearly revealed the True Spiritual Knowledge; for that, a valuable lesson has to be taught to me; both my good and bad deeds must be severed; my three major blemishes (namely, arrogance, karma and delusion) must be removed; the two states of uniqueness and commonness of the soul must be gone; my possessiveness must perish; and the duality (the distinction between You and me) must go. It is Truth based on experience; It is a matchless and prominent state that gives eternal bliss; It is such a rarity that even the pinnacles of the VEdAs cannot describe It with certainty; Its two manifestations of Sakthi and SivA are none other than an eternal immutable existence, and to enlighten me of Its greatness, kindly preach to me! Lord HimavAn, the King of the mountains, delivered this matchless and beautiful daughter, PArvathi; She is unblemished; She is worshipped by all the seven** immaculate Divine Mothers; She is graciously seated in ThiruvaNNAmalai; She is extremely charming; She is Pure without any sin; She is experienced in the Spiritual Knowledge; She is full of compassion; She is for ever new and the leading light; She is the Old Traditional One who blesses, one and all, in the most complete and orderly manner, in the seven worlds, starting with the athala world; You are the child of such a great Mother, UmAdEvi! Lord SivA, who is in the form of fire, was elated when You taught Him the method of mastering the art of silence; DEvayAnai, the damsel belonging to the Celestials; VaLLi, the belle of the hunter-tribe; Your sharp Spear; Your Peacock; Your proficiency in literary Tamil; Your composition of ThEvAram songs consisting of all the concepts of the scriptures; Your magnanimous, compassionate and charitable disposition; Your Divine shape, youthfulness and magnificence are all radiating everywhere, Oh Handsome and Great One!

1005.english_pathavurai: The long northern range of mountain (Mount MEru) was shattered; the seven hills (surrounding SUran's country) were smashed to smithreen; the very old leader of the snakes (AdhisEshan) had his closely formed hoods torn to pieces; and the earth shuddered; when Your matchless peacock played around! That peacock, along with Your staff on which is engraved the rooster that crows and spits out the sun* every morning, Your compassion, Your eternal greatness, Your red complexion, Your youth, Your strength, Your two hallowed feet, Your hair adorned with kadappa flowers, Your majestic shoulders hugging the mountain-like and fragrant chest of VaLLi, the damsel of the fashionable hunters, and whose tender creeper-like waist which is pressed by the sheer weight of the budding bosoms, Your garland made of kurA flowers around which beetles make a humming noise and Your names such as Murugan, ARumugan etc.,- all these I want to sing about in chaste, literary and flawless Tamil. Will there be a day when I may be able to do so? From the chests of the evil demons who commit heinous murders, abundant blood began to gush with a gurgling noise as if it was a river flowing with ripples at a regular beat; Lord BrahmA was so scared that He ran away; the rough sea swayed roaring as if its bowels were split open; the mango tree (SUran in disguise) with plenty of baby mangoes was felled with a great noise as it was uprooted; and the mountain with the name of the large, tall bird (Krouncham) was pierced and destroyed when You wielded the bright spear, Oh Lord! The River Ganga gushing with a thousand faces from the skies and the six damsels of KArthigai equally claim You as their child because You were delivered to them by Goddess PArvathi. 1006.english_pathavurai: I do not have an iota of thought to share food with others; I do not have any compassion; Your shrines like ThiruvaNNAmalai, ThiruththaNigai, Pazhanimalai, SwAmimalai, ThiruchchengkOdu and several other mountains are not even in my songs nor do I have the capacity to sing about them; I am used to saying evil and contradictory things all the time; I do not possess any charm; nor do I have a decent lineage; I have no virtue whatsoever; I have no devotion, magnanimity nor any greatness; Within the time it takes for the potter's wheel to make one full circle, my mind rotates seventy times, and I feel miserable, for I am such a crooked-minded person; I am an arrogant one whose mind never thinks about melting, crying or prostrating before You; I do not have decent manners, grace or any asset whatsoever; I am a stealthy, stupid, and hopeless person without any good karma; and I have no feeling of doing noble deeds. Do You think such a man like me I can attain the eternal bliss of SivA's world one of these days? (Hereafter, SwAmigaL describes Vishnu in detail) The ocean full of sharks screamed of pain when the asura (demon) RavaNA's ten crowns and twenty mighty mountain-like shoulders were knocked down by a single peerless and choicest arrow from Rama of dark complexion like the cloud; On behalf of PANdavAs, Kings of the country Kuru, Krishna went as messenger; As GajEndran, the elephant screamed for help crying "Oh, AadhimUlA!", when attacked by a crocodile in the tank, He, as VaradharAjan, came to his rescue; When two gandharvas came as strong marutha trees, Krishna attacked and brought them down; When little child PrahalAdhan lisped that the VEdAs speak of "Om NamO NarayaNAya", his father HiraNyan jeered at him; and HiraNyan's body was torn down by the sharp edges of His nails by Narasimham (man-lion form); He holds the weapon of ChakrA in His hand; He is like the green emerald mount; He danced as Krishna on the head of KAlingan, a fire-spewing snake; You are the nephew of Vishnu (described as Rama, Krishna, VaradharAjan and Narasimham)! You remove the darkness of two karmas (good and bad deeds) of Your ardent devotees, as the rising Sun! The moon, with its cool rays, goes around this world (once a month) - and You circle the entire world within a fraction of a second, Oh Great One!

1007.english_pathavurai: Their fragrant hair became loosened and dishevelled; the moon-like face showed beads of perspiration; their speech that is usually sweet as nectar obtained from the good old sea (milky ocean) became a babble; the bangles (on their arms) made a clinking noise; the garlands worn on their chest that serves as the bridge to the bliss of physical union were severed at the knots and fell loose; the two anklets on their feet rattled so much as though they were complaining that their waist was about to give way; their teeth radiated a cool moonlight amidst the blossoming flowers; my mind melted after imbibing the saliva oozing from their lips, red like the ilavam (silk-cotton) flower; the two bodies united fittingly; and these women make me feel that their life and mine are one and the same; so was their helpful relationship; even though I have fallen into the sea of passion along with those beautiful girls on their bed, drowned in that sea, refloated again and whirled in it, I will never forget meditating on and praising Your two hallowed feet that are the only refuge for my life, Oh Lord! Eagles and crows, accompanied by the white-necked kites (garudan), crowded as if there was no empty space left in the sky; bunches of fiends and little imps, that had assembled in the battlefield to devour the flesh from the corpses, began to sing songs in literary and musical Tamil; in the battlefield of full-scale war, where enmity was fully complete, they came with their fellow-devils to add to the music while the two feet of the Goddess RaNa Bhairavi (KALi) danced in a frenzy; at that time, He stood face to face (against RAvaNan); holding on to the two ends of the matchless bow (KOthaNdam), He bent the bow and wielded a unique and powerful arrow severing and felling the ten heads and twenty arms of RAvaNan; those strong hands belonged to the Primordial Lord VishNu (RAmA), the tall and mystical Lord, and You are His nephew, Oh Great Master! You are the most famous Lord having been born in the Pond of SaravaNa! Indra, the leader of the celestials, was able to redeem his golden land, and the demons were destroyed because of You, capable of mounting the worthy peacock, Oh Great One!

1009.english_meanings_list: ["In their fragrant hair, in its brightness,", "in their slender waist that is hardly noticeable, in their gait,", "in their lotus-like eyes, in their speech,", "in the net of the smile of these young women showing no sign of anger, in its enchanting nature,", "and in their mountain-like bosom with tight-fitting blouse,", "I became obsessed with endless passion that could be compared to a unique lethal poison;", "I am a total waste, destined to go to hell; I am a fool;", "I am an incorrigible thief; I remain in a state of delusion;", "I have a venomous mind without any good thinking; I am an arrogant one and a victim of my past bad deeds;", "I am a wicked person, ever treacherous, without a sense of justice and indulging in negative talk; I am born to decay and die;", "(despite all my shortcomings,) kindly teach me a lesson that would enable me to attain Your lotus feet!", "Upon the head of the striped serpent (KALingan) this Mystic One danced showing His expertise in Bharatha NAttiyam;", "He measured the seven worlds with His foot; He is the grantor of boons; He has performed great penances;", "He is Lord VishNu who severed the body of HiraNyan into two pieces using His nails; He is Hari; He holds the disc in His hand;", "As the wavy and roaring seas appealed, He, with a dark complexion, severed and knocked down the ten crowned heads of the demon, RAvaNan, with His matchless arrow;", "He felled the marutha trees; He is the Deity who listened to the great poet (Thirumazhisai AzhvAr) and followed him in implicit obedience to his word*;", "with the music from His flute, this most handsome One protected the herds of cows;", "He is the compassionate Lord NArAyaNan, Master of Arjunan and the leader of all celestials; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "Your mind melted for VaLLi, the daughter of the dark hunters who lived in the forest, Oh Great One!"]
1009.english_pathavurai: In their fragrant hair, in its brightness, in their slender waist that is hardly noticeable, in their gait, in their lotus-like eyes, in their speech, in the net of the smile of these young women showing no sign of anger, in its enchanting nature, and in their mountain-like bosom with tight-fitting blouse, I became obsessed with endless passion that could be compared to a unique lethal poison; I am a total waste, destined to go to hell; I am a fool; I am an incorrigible thief; I remain in a state of delusion; I have a venomous mind without any good thinking; I am an arrogant one and a victim of my past bad deeds; I am a wicked person, ever treacherous, without a sense of justice and indulging in negative talk; I am born to decay and die; (despite all my shortcomings,) kindly teach me a lesson that would enable me to attain Your lotus feet! Upon the head of the striped serpent (KALingan) this Mystic One danced showing His expertise in Bharatha NAttiyam; He measured the seven worlds with His foot; He is the grantor of boons; He has performed great penances; He is Lord VishNu who severed the body of HiraNyan into two pieces using His nails; He is Hari; He holds the disc in His hand; As the wavy and roaring seas appealed, He, with a dark complexion, severed and knocked down the ten crowned heads of the demon, RAvaNan, with His matchless arrow; He felled the marutha trees; He is the Deity who listened to the great poet (Thirumazhisai AzhvAr) and followed him in implicit obedience to his word*; with the music from His flute, this most handsome One protected the herds of cows; He is the compassionate Lord NArAyaNan, Master of Arjunan and the leader of all celestials; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Your mind melted for VaLLi, the daughter of the dark hunters who lived in the forest, Oh Great One!

1010.english_pathavurai: Smeared with turmeric, they looked like decorated jugs of nectar, comparable to the great golden crown of Manmathan (God of Love); those two pot-like heavy, cool and novel breasts, wearing the paste of musk, appeared to be the repository of millions of hearts and lives of young men; making love to the whores bestowed with such bosom, I have been indulging in the sludge of passionate sea, night and day, without a break, imbibing their proffered saliva deemed to be sweet, making love and enjoying that bliss; will there be a day in my life when I completely forget the act of ruining myself by uniting both bodies in embrace which is the source of my bad deed and begin to think about Your bright and hallowed feet? Indra, the leader of the celestials, Brahma, Lord VishNu, many sages wearing the deer-hide to cover themselves and several celestials joined together in saying prayers to You when the confronting demons who came to fight with You were annihilated; the tireless gang of devils danced around their prize, namely, the mountain of flesh; many fiends analysed the mound of flesh declaring which part is astringent, which is sour, which has become hardened as a solid, which portion got spoiled, which is not edible and which portion is worth devouring; they were all relieved of their tremendous hunger when You singularly fought and triumphed uniquely, Oh Mighty and Valorous One, mounting the peacock! Oh Child of BhAgeerathi (Gangai)! You are the Consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs residing in the mountain! The broad, tall and huge mountain KrounchA, was pierced by Your spear, and You have the ability to hold that powerful Spear in Your hand, Oh Great One!

1011.english_pathavurai: The well-known and famous religions speak about It; It has no shape nor is It shapeless; It is referred to as the Effulgence and is also denoted by the cosmos; It is said to be up in the Heavens and is also stated to be on the earth; It is supposed to be the pillar of strength which stabilises the worlds; understanding that Supreme Principle, that the True Knowledge in a state of silence, remaining in that realised state and not letting those days lapse in waste, and attaining the liberation would be the greatest boon; instead, frittering away that opportunity, I have been subject to the havoc played on me by the five sensory organs (responsible for touch, sight, smell, sound and taste) arousing desire in me, and I am experiencing many a trivial and delusory pleasure that cause misery which I want to avoid; in the sea of suffering, there are a variety of treacherous whores wearing anklets in their feet; into that bottomless pit I am falling, having committed five heinous crimes*; when will I realise this, get out and reach the shore? When the celestials screamed for help saying "Oh Hara, Hara, Son of SivA, Oh Lord KandhA, We surrender to You; kindly grant us refuge", You graciously assured them saying "Let your fear end; you do not have to be scared anymore"; the strong demons and their endless armies were dispatched to the land of Yaman (God of Death); the chest of the confronting demon SUran was split open; and in that impact, the wide sea dried up spewing out a lot of dust as You wielded Your triumphant spear, Oh Lord! You mount the peacock having an emerald-green plume, Oh SarvaNA; You are the smartest One! He is capable of reciting the four ancient VEdAs till the very end and He is seated on the fragrant lotus; that Lord BrahmA, the mystic Lord VishNu, who slumbers on the poisonous serpent-bed, AdhisEshan, and Lord SivA, who holds the pure river Gangai on His matted hair, have all gathered to worship You, Oh Great One!

1012.english_pathavurai: Placing the HimAlayan mountain (MantharA) as the churning rod and tying around it the fierce serpent VAsuki as the rope, the celestials churned the bright and wavy milky ocean; on that day, the terrible poison AlakAlam (which may be compared to their eyes) emerged; those eyes roam around and collide with the studs on both their ears and attack the nose that looks like a blossoming flower; they surpass the speed and action of the five triumphant and flowery arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love), the consort of Rathi, who holds in his arm the bow of sugarcane; on such wide and combative reddish eyes, looking like kayal fish, and on their enlarged bosom, looking like golden mount, with a fitting tight blouse, I do not wish to set my lonely heart and get depressed; nor do I wish to be agitated by the false love of those whores with beautiful hair which the beetles swarm around; for that, will You not kindly grant me Your reddish and hallowed feet so that I could worship them by offering lotus with a hundred petals? As the celestials praised and IndrA worshipped, He commanded the army of monkeys of seventy species; He built a bridge across the wavy sea, crossed over into LankA and in the war that confronted Him, He knocked down the twenty mighty shoulders of RAvaNan, the king of the demons, and severed the neat bunch of his ten heads by wielding arrows from His lotus hand; You are the nephew of that RAmA! He wears on His matted hair the kondRai (Indian laburnum) garland with oozing honey, unblemished and matchless garland of thumbai (leucas), the crescent moon and River Gangai; He is Lord SivA on whose left side DEvi PArvathi is concorporate; You are the son delivered by Her! You roamed about in pursuit of VaLLi, the beautiful parrot-like damsel of the KuRavAs, and embraced her robust bosom, Oh Great One!

the fiery and white moon exudes fire like the vadamukAgni (the inferno from the North during the end of the aeon); the beetles swarm together humming many a tune;", "the southerly breeze coming from mount Pothigai blows on me shattering my mental resolve and inflicting many wounds on my body by arousing obsessive passion; as the demons advanced towards You in a close encounter, You fought them in the battlefield, piercing their bodies with Your spear and conquered their evil armies, Oh Reddish Lord!", "PArvathi, who wears the swinging studs on Her ears, the matchless consort of Lord SankarA and who is also Goddess Gowri, took You on Her lap with love and fed You with the Holy Milk of Knowledge from Her hallowed breasts, and You imbibed it with a clear mind and bestowed grace on all, Oh Great One!"]
1013.english_pathavurai: After applying make-up on their face, they loosen the long hair that looks like the black cloud; inserting plenty of flowers like the serunthi and the ShaNbaga into the hair, they tie it into a tuft and come out (of their house) happily, pacing (the street) back and forth; they shake their bosom and deliberately let the upper garment slide, immediately covering their chest as if they are setting it right; their smile is loaded with treachery; they have the nerve to come up flirtingly right up to the front of their street; Manmathan, God of Love, stands firmly entrenched within the special circle of these women (and keeps wielding his arrows); the fiery and white moon exudes fire like the vadamukAgni (the inferno from the North during the end of the aeon); the beetles swarm together humming many a tune; the southerly breeze coming from mount Pothigai blows on me shattering my mental resolve and inflicting many wounds on my body by arousing obsessive passion; my heart simply melts; should my mind be thus about? With its lustre very much diminished, the sun moved about in a shrunken state; the peak of the sky, covered by clouds, was torn and pierced through; mountains of the stature of Manthara went into orbit simultaneously; those shattered mountain-pieces flew behind (the peacock) as You drove the peacock, that pecks the gems on the hoods of the serpent, at the matchless speed of a horse, making the seas roar in rapture with water sprinkling all over and causing the awestruck world, made of the five elements, stand still; (witnessing this scene) the self-existing Lord SivA, with three eyes, became enchanted with You; as the demons advanced towards You in a close encounter, You fought them in the battlefield, piercing their bodies with Your spear and conquered their evil armies, Oh Reddish Lord! PArvathi, who wears the swinging studs on Her ears, the matchless consort of Lord SankarA and who is also Goddess Gowri, took You on Her lap with love and fed You with the Holy Milk of Knowledge from Her hallowed breasts, and You imbibed it with a clear mind and bestowed grace on all, Oh Great One!

1014.english_pathavurai: All the relatives on this earth stand nearby surrounding the body, with outpouring love and shrieks of crying; the body is then laid on huge logs of wood that are ignited amidst the background beats of the drums; after consigning the body to fire, the various relatives take a dip in the wavy water and depart for their respective homes; Yaman, the God of Death, whose mission is destruction, attacks the life subduing it with his two fiery eyes that spew flames and angrily prepares to take it away; before that event, will You not grant me the wisdom to join the righteous path of Your devotees who firmly believe that Murugan alone is the one to confer salvation so that I too become more sensible and chant Your name? Mount Krouncha in the north was pierced and destroyed; the wavy seas dried up; victory was achieved in all the eight cardinal directions; the demons who confronted You and fought with vigour were shattered to pieces; and, after defeating them, You challenged the demon SUran, who took the disguise of a tall mango tree, by attacking him with Your spear, Oh Great Warrior! He wears on His dense and matted hair the crescent moon and wavy water of the river Gangai; He is Lord SivA, Your father; You preached to Him the meaning of the PraNava ManthrA and earned name and fame as the Father's Teacher, Oh Precious Treasure! Even at the end of the Yugam (aeon) their form and figure remain intact without any deterioration; they are firm believers in practicing solemn silence and are called the Eternal Dazzlers; these pure souls always worship You, Oh Great One!

1016.english_pathavurai: The nine prime sidhdhAs* doing penance in the caves; BrahmA, whose origin was from the great lotus blooming from Vishnu's belly; the three distinguished characteristics {namely, Sathvam (tranquility), rajO (aggressiveness) and thamas (sluggishness)}; the leaders of the demons; Lord SivA, who destroyed Thiripuram using the four VEdAs as His chariot's horses roaring like the wavy seas; valiant Vishnu of emerald-green complexion who was known as MurAri, having killed the demon Muran; triumphant IndrA, holding a mace (kulijam) in his hand with which he conquered the demon, Valan; all the text books of SAstrAs laying down strict rules; detailed legendary stories of yore of various Gods; the entire works of art in this world; and the very many extensive scriptures of exceptional value; all of these convened in an attempt to comprehend You but failed. Realising that You are the embodiment of that wisdom which transcends all knowledge and ignorance, when shall I attain Your rosy lotus feet? DuriyOdhanan, a symbol of enmity, was born to wage the war of MahAbhArathA with his armies; Knowing that story (of MahAbhArathA), He scribed it on top of the great Mount MEru with His lone tusk as Sage VyAsar once narrated the epic flawlessly; that transcriber was VinAyagA; His complexion was coral-red and His form was of a raging elephant; You are His younger brother, Oh MurugA! The seas, making a loud noise, were stirred up; the seven crests of (SUran's) hills were shaken; and the perverted demon, SUran, was bewildered when You fought in the battlefield. She belonged to the lineage of the celestials; She was reared by the elephant (AirAvadham); garnishing pure sandal paste, her large and bright bosoms have the fragrance of musk; and You embrace that DEvayAnai's chest, Oh Great One!

1022.english_pathavurai: With their mountain-like bosom, bedecked with a cluster of chains embedded with pearls and rubies, these whores are capable of steering the lives of well-educated young men into a track of passion; their face like the full moon, their dark hair like the black cloud in the sky, their eyes and their soft and beautiful shoulders looking like bamboo are considered by me to be eternal bliss; with that conviction I have been drowning in their beds while treacherous thoughts crop up in my mind; I have been selecting really stupid people, composing poems on them, describing their hand as golden and stating that they are indeed great and famous persons; I do not wish to roam about in this world in such a mythical path, feeling exhausted; instead, I wish to attain Your lotus feet, adorned by flowers; for that, kindly bestow upon me the choicest words with which I could sing Your glory in a trendy and spirited manner! He knocked down the ten heads and the twenty shoulders (of RAvaNan) by wielding a matchless arrow; that green complexioned Lord VishNu and Lord BrahmA, who is renowned for the four VEdAs, could not discern nor have the vision of the hallowed feet of Lord SivA who performed the Cosmic Dance; praising those feet in hymns resplendent with deep devotion, You sang (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) and roamed about to many places of worship like people do customarily on this earth, Oh Lord! 1023.english_pathavurai: They negotiate a bargain price to sell their bosom, smeared with a rich paste of sandalwood powder, mixed with the balm of civet, rose water and musk; in proportion to the money handed to them, they measure the quantity of coital bliss to be dispensed on the well-spread bed, sprinkled with flowers and having the fragrance of camphor; their eyes impinge on the coiled and swinging ear-studs; they (the eyes) get past their prominent nose that looks like the kumizham flower and collide with, and deflect, the flowery arrows wielded by Manmathan (God of Love); they look down condescendingly upon the swarming beetles, the spear and the sEl and kayal fish (as they fall far too short in comparison) and arrogantly frown upon Yaman (God of Death) who sulks in comparison (against their deadliness); being caught in the web of looks from those black-painted eyes, I bang my head against bad deeds treading the unrighteous path; am I destined to rot like this in a state of delusion? You have a beautiful name called Chetti, Oh Lord! You have a lasting fame of wielding the triumphant spear! It went around the world in all the (eight) cardinal directions, instantly returning to the starting point; It has a lustrous cluster of plumes; and You mount that peacock as if it were a horse! You threw a temper tantrum on the wavy sea that contains makara fish, Oh Lord! You are wearing the garland of vetchi flowers (scarlet ixora) on Your broad chest in the attire of a bridegroom, Oh Lord! You annihilated the wicked SUran, the leader of the demons; You stood guard for IndrA, the leader of the celestials who praised You! The elephant (AirAvadham) has a beautiful face covered by jewellery and an ornamental clothing and jaws oozing with bilious juice; Indra mounts that elephant and goes in a procession in the celestial land whose armies are awestruck by Your leadership, Oh Commander! You have the munificence of granting blissful liberation, Oh Lord! She is the pure daughter of the hunters, and You engaged in keeping a watch over that VaLLi at the opportune time, Oh Great One!

1035.english_pathavurai: The body consisting of flesh and muscles comes along with nine portals* and takes millions of births through the womb. (To end the miserable birth cycle,) whatever holy writings that I read, the music I practise and all other learnings I acquire, kindly make me realise their significance; for that, I have to sing Your glory; I have to willingly pay obeisance to Your hallowed feet keeping Your grace in my mind in the morning and in the evening; and kindly bless me to seek henceforth Your devotess who praise Your holy name and prostrate at their feet. 1036.english_meanings_list: ["This body is filled with the five elements, namely, fire, air, water, earth and sky;", "it is also filled with the soul and three kinds of shackles, namely, arrogance, karma and delusion; not knowing how to keep this body intact,", "and without a clue to an effective means to end both types of deeds (good and bad),", "in order to terminate birth in which six hundred (600) plus ten times a hundred (10 X 100 = 1,000) plus ten times twenty hundred (10 X 20 X 100 = 20,000) totalling (600+1,000+20,000) 21,600 breaths*", "occur each and every day in this little life and to liberate the soul (in other words, to put an end to the birth cycle), will I ever be fortunate to learn the Siva-yOgA?", "You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel living in the millet-field of VaLLimalai forest where bamboos, neem and viLa trees abound!", "The seven seas where many fish roam about were burnt down and became dried up;", "BrahmA, who chants VEdAs aloud with His four unique mouths, was imprisoned (in Kandagiri) by the mystic mountain Krouncham;", "and SUran who fought clandestinely from behind the huge cloud was felled, with his chest and two shoulders severed;", "when You fought with the sword, Oh Great One!"]
1036.english_pathavurai: This body is filled with the five elements, namely, fire, air, water, earth and sky; it is also filled with the soul and three kinds of shackles, namely, arrogance, karma and delusion; not knowing how to keep this body intact, and without a clue to an effective means to end both types of deeds (good and bad), in order to terminate birth in which six hundred (600) plus ten times a hundred (10 X 100 = 1,000) plus ten times twenty hundred (10 X 20 X 100 = 20,000) totalling (600+1,000+20,000) 21,600 breaths* occur each and every day in this little life and to liberate the soul (in other words, to put an end to the birth cycle), will I ever be fortunate to learn the Siva-yOgA? You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel living in the millet-field of VaLLimalai forest where bamboos, neem and viLa trees abound! The seven seas where many fish roam about were burnt down and became dried up; BrahmA, who chants VEdAs aloud with His four unique mouths, was imprisoned (in Kandagiri) by the mystic mountain Krouncham; and SUran who fought clandestinely from behind the huge cloud was felled, with his chest and two shoulders severed; when You fought with the sword, Oh Great One!

1037.english_pathavurai: Diseases caused by rheumatism, head ache, stomach ache, edema in the stomach (known as mahOdharam) and such ailments should not afflict me; I do not want to be sent again to another womb by which I assume a different body filled up with delusion; like the waves lashing again and again in the vast expanse of the sea, I do not want to be ravaged by repeated births; in order that the devotees who praise Your glory are liberated, will You bless me with Your two hallowed feet? With melodious music at a divine pitch and with complete devotion, Your devotees chant vedic hymns with absolute clarity; they are spared the impact of the afflicting destiny because You are always by their side protecting them with utmost compassion, Oh Lord! Lord Vishnu and BrahmA who are praised by the holy scriptures prostrate at Your feet, Oh Victorious Warrior! The aggressive and confronting demon SUran was smashed to pieces when You engaged in battle wielding Your Spear, Oh Great One!

1038.english_pathavurai: I always thought that this body of flesh is myself; endlessly ailing without any remission, I still cherished this mortal body of mine that swayed like a swing; without learning the texts, without being involved in religious debates and without conforming to ritualistic stipulations of this world, I wish my mind to be distinctly aloof; my inner soul should merge with the Supreme Soul, namely, You; I must seek You willingly by chanting several scriptures and then experience self-realisation; am I, the lowly dog, destined to die without such insight? 1040.english_pathavurai: This body is like a cottage composed of veins, skin, water and several doorways (nine portals*). While living in this body as an intelligent person, the day of reckoning will come, and I have to depart after death. Before the body is subjected to preying by dogs and devils, - Oh Lord wearing on Your twelve shoulders the fulsome garlands of Aththi (mountain ebony) flowers, Oh the bestower of prosperous life on Your devotees, - kindly grant me, the lowly dog, without delay, the vigour and strength to sing the glory of Your feet with my tongue! Lord Vishnu who protects the seven worlds with His perseverance and BrahmA, who preaches the VEdAs full of songs, searched in the wastelands, in the skies and in the earth for the hallowed feet of Lord SivA which they could never attain; He is of such a unique glory; He lives with His consort, PArvathi; he mounts the huge bull (Nandi); He has golden tresses; You are the son of that Lord SivA! You are the reddish God of Love! You are the handsome king! Oh Lord, You are the God of all the Celestials, Oh Great One!

1044.english_meanings_list: ["If the air that is freely exhaled nonstop every day could be contained without total waste by reining it in and retaining it inside the body (kumbakam*),", "one could attain spiritual liberation (Jeevan mukthi); without carefully researching this fact, and obtaining Your blessing, I do not wish to be an indisciplined yogi of karma (practitioner of actions) and waste my life;", "I do not wish to wander in this world recklessly all the time;", "I wish to clearly distinguish between my body, myself and my inner faculties (such as mind, intellect, will and arrogance) and then renounce all of them;", "I wish to prostrate with melting heart at Your feet which are beyond the description by words;", "in order that I follow the sacred and righteous path and become a supreme practitioner of Siva-yOgA,", "kindly bestow on me the royal bliss of Your hallowed feet!", "The huge mountain MEru in the north with a large base was fixed (as the churning axle);", "to extract nectar from the seven seas with lashing waves,", "resulting in extreme pain to VAsuki, the serpent with bright gem-studded hoods, (that was used as the churning rope) and to the moon (used as a fulcrum),", "He churned the seas with His thousand** aching shoulders - which shoulders are the favourite of Goddess Lakshmi seated on the lotus; He is the primordial Lord Gopalan (VishNu); and You are His nephew!", "You are the son of Lord SivA who holds in His hands the trident and the skull of Lord BrahmA; You are the Lord of VaLLi, the creeper-like damsel of the spear-wielding hunters;", "You are the King who protected the golden celestial land and You are the source and origin of all the worlds!", "Your compassion is huge like the Mount MEru, and You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
