1048.english_pathavurai: This cottage of a body is made up of blood and skin; when life degenerates and is about to depart from the body, and before the messenger KAlan, sent by Yaman, the God of Death, comes with the evil rope of bondage and his unique weapon, the trident, and shamelessly harasses with unbearable diseases, besieging me oppressively, Oh Young Lord, who wielded the spear to remove the fear of the sun, the moon, the celestials, the terrestrials and Lord VishNu who slumbers in the milky ocean, and whose valorous shoulders are so handsome that their beauty cannot be described in poetry even by expert poets who are capable of singing impeccable songs, kindly grant me the blessing to praise Your hallowed feet with love! He is the mystic one who displayed His valour that uprooted the marutha tree; He plays the flute; when the elephant (GajEndran) in the pond screamed "Oh Primordial Lord" and sought refuge, He came flying to its rescue; He is MurAri, the enemy of the demon Muran; He is the consort of the GopikA girls of the clan of cowherds; He is KEsavan who as Rama obeyed the command of His mother (KaikEyi) and willingly went to the forest; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! He is in the form of inconceivable Knowledge; He mounts the bull, Rishabam; He holds in His hand the skull (of BrahmA); He dances along with evil devils; those (in Thiripuram) who ignored Him (by not offering worship) were all drowned in wild fire by His will; You are the son of that Lord SivA! You are beyond all causes; Your compassion is like the huge mountain MEru! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1049.english_meanings_list: ["It is not heard anywhere in the scriptures; It is not seen by anyone practicing the traditional worship method (sariyai)* offering services to temples;", "It is not accessible to the YOgis* who have reached the transcendantal state (thuriya); It cannot be pursued nor attained by anyone;", "It cannot be penetrated even by powerful delusory powers; It is the inexhaustible sea of bliss that is immortal;", "It cannot be burnt away even by the scorching sun; It cannot be singed (scorched) even by vadamukAgni, the fiery northerly inferno coming on the dooms day;", "It can neither be pushed down even by the most turbulent storm nor can it be made inert and motionless; It cannot be drowned even if surrounded by the water of the sea;", "and It cannot be destroyed even when attacked by countless armies; - Will You kindly enlighten me as to what It is that has all these qualities and which is the paramount seat of true knowledge?", "The abodes of the demons were all destroyed; the seas inhabited by the sharks and other fish caught fire;", "the celestials were resettled in their golden land where clusters of kaRpaga tree abound;", "as You wielded the spear on the snow-clad Mount Krouncha, which has numerous hefty peaks, Oh Lord!", "He is the grand master who delivered the manuals for the scriptures that are meditated upon by BrahmA, who has a mastery over VEdAs, and by VishNu, who is the primordial Lord worshipped by the vEdAs;", "He is the Lord who arched the golden Mount MEru into a bow;", "He strolls along the sky of Knowledge; He resides in all the worlds; He has several unique gaits;", "He is the Dance Master capable of performing myriad dances in Mount KailAsh; He is the Omnipresent Lord SivA; and You are His Treasure!", "Your compassion is huge like the Mount MEru! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
1049.english_pathavurai: It is not heard anywhere in the scriptures; It is not seen by anyone practicing the traditional worship method (sariyai)* offering services to temples; It is not accessible to the YOgis* who have reached the transcendantal state (thuriya); It cannot be pursued nor attained by anyone; It cannot be penetrated even by powerful delusory powers; It is the inexhaustible sea of bliss that is immortal; It cannot be burnt away even by the scorching sun; It cannot be singed (scorched) even by vadamukAgni, the fiery northerly inferno coming on the dooms day; It can neither be pushed down even by the most turbulent storm nor can it be made inert and motionless; It cannot be drowned even if surrounded by the water of the sea; and It cannot be destroyed even when attacked by countless armies; - Will You kindly enlighten me as to what It is that has all these qualities and which is the paramount seat of true knowledge? The abodes of the demons were all destroyed; the seas inhabited by the sharks and other fish caught fire; the celestials were resettled in their golden land where clusters of kaRpaga tree abound; as You wielded the spear on the snow-clad Mount Krouncha, which has numerous hefty peaks, Oh Lord! He is the grand master who delivered the manuals for the scriptures that are meditated upon by BrahmA, who has a mastery over VEdAs, and by VishNu, who is the primordial Lord worshipped by the vEdAs; He is the Lord who arched the golden Mount MEru into a bow; He strolls along the sky of Knowledge; He resides in all the worlds; He has several unique gaits; He is the Dance Master capable of performing myriad dances in Mount KailAsh; He is the Omnipresent Lord SivA; and You are His Treasure! Your compassion is huge like the Mount MEru! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1050.english_meanings_list: ["It cannot be touched; Its form cannot be directly seen;", "even those capable of interpreting the VEdAs cannot find words to describe It;", "It is our favourite God; It is the matchless Supreme substance; It is beyond the three stages, namely, wakefulness, sleep and dream; It is different from all these; and It is Pure Knowledge.", "Occupying this body which moves around with long legs and arms,", "It renders itself to interpretation as duality by texts distinguishing between \"You\" and \"me\"; this gives rise to a delusory feeling;", "upon the command of the unique God of Death (Yaman), His messengers arrive without fail clamorously (to take the life away); will You kindly explain to me this precise routine?", "You wielded the triumphant spear on millions of mighty demons and killed them in the battle, Oh valorous One!", "You are the great leader with twelve shoulders, Oh Lord!", "You are the consort of VaLLi, the daughter of a beautiful deer!", "You ruled the celestial land with such eminence that BrahmA and VishNu could survive (without fear of the demon SUran)!", "His neck bears the mark of poison; He is the greatest dancer performing wonderful dances;", "He is the primal God who went after the hostile Thiripuras and burnt them down;", "and He is the Lord mounting the bull (Nandi); You are the son of that Lord SivA!", "You are the Causal One; You are the substance of all the VEdAs; Your compassion is great as Mount MEru; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
1050.english_pathavurai: It cannot be touched; Its form cannot be directly seen; even those capable of interpreting the VEdAs cannot find words to describe It; It is our favourite God; It is the matchless Supreme substance; It is beyond the three stages, namely, wakefulness, sleep and dream; It is different from all these; and It is Pure Knowledge. Occupying this body which moves around with long legs and arms, It renders itself to interpretation as duality by texts distinguishing between "You" and "me"; this gives rise to a delusory feeling; upon the command of the unique God of Death (Yaman), His messengers arrive without fail clamorously (to take the life away); will You kindly explain to me this precise routine? You wielded the triumphant spear on millions of mighty demons and killed them in the battle, Oh valorous One! You are the great leader with twelve shoulders, Oh Lord! You are the consort of VaLLi, the daughter of a beautiful deer! You ruled the celestial land with such eminence that BrahmA and VishNu could survive (without fear of the demon SUran)! His neck bears the mark of poison; He is the greatest dancer performing wonderful dances; He is the primal God who went after the hostile Thiripuras and burnt them down; and He is the Lord mounting the bull (Nandi); You are the son of that Lord SivA! You are the Causal One; You are the substance of all the VEdAs; Your compassion is great as Mount MEru; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1052.english_pathavurai: They have a clandestine heart like a closed door; they have buxom bosoms like hills, coated with sandal paste; being aroused by the angry flowery arrows flung by the God of Love (Manmathan), they indiscriminatingly cohabit with men of any lineage; they proudly display their youthful bodies; and these are the whores with whom I indulge in carnal pleasure, showing off my richness and pride, and flirt shamelessly! My blemish is in wasting time like this; I am the lowly dog, doing my bad deeds, and am very wicked. Without praising Your glory, I roam around speaking gibberish. I am totally blind, having failed to seek You. Yet, will You take me over one of these days? He took the form of an innocent and dimunitive sage (VAmana); He is Vishnu; He went to find the feet of Your Father SivA who stood beyond His reach. That SivA, as Lord ChokkanAthan of Madhurai, presented (to King PANdiyan) a unique plank, the Seat of Sharada,* on which You mounted and protected all lives in this world, covering the four directions, by Your deep insight, Oh Young One! You have the purest body shining like gold and Your complexion is like the beautiful red coral! You are the Lord mounting the pretty-feathered and green Peacock! Oh Compassionate One, You reside in the lotus of my heart in the form of Wisdom! You are the Mount MEru of Grace and the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1053.english_meanings_list: ["As AdhisEshan (the 1000-headed Serpent) danced in the netherworld,", "Mount Meru (Sri KailAsh) on the earth also danced,", "in unison with SivA's Dance, Kali also danced,", "along with Her, making Her shiver,", "raising His leg up in competition,", "SivA, who mounts on the Bull (Nandi), also danced,", "and nearby, the BUthaganas and ghosts also danced,", "Saraswathi of sweet voice also danced,", "BrahmA on the Lotus also joined in the dance,", "all the Celestials and Moon also danced,", "Lakshmi on Lotus, Your mother-in-law, danced,", "Vishnu, the tall one (who assumed ViswarUpam) Your father-in-law,", "Your peacock should also dance and You too, dancing,", "should appear before me dancing!*", "Bhima, who never parted with his mace (gadha), from his shoulder,", "shot a series of arrows (in MahAbhArathA War)", "at the large army of his mighty opponents and", "decimated them (with the help of Krishna);", "herds of sobbing cows came rushing to (Brindhavanam) (hearing the magical flute of Krishna);", "as the charioteer on Vijayan (Arjuna)'s chariot,", "the golden and vedic victory-conch shell was blown (by Krishna);", "on the milky ocean with waves tossing about, He (Krishna) reclined on a serpent-bed;", "(in Vamana Avatharam) he measured the entire world with one foot (that foot-bearer, Krishna)", "He, the Great Mystic, with Garuda for vehicle.", "You are His favourite nephew!", "Fresh garland adorning His chest,", "is the great King Praputa DEvA (of ThiruvaNNAmalai);", "Your presence made the King's heart dance with joy", "Oh the Greatest One of all Gods!"]
1053.english_pathavurai: As AdhisEshan (the 1000-headed Serpent) danced in the netherworld, Mount Meru (Sri KailAsh) on the earth also danced, in unison with SivA's Dance, Kali also danced, along with Her, making Her shiver, raising His leg up in competition, SivA, who mounts on the Bull (Nandi), also danced, and nearby, the BUthaganas and ghosts also danced, Saraswathi of sweet voice also danced, BrahmA on the Lotus also joined in the dance, all the Celestials and Moon also danced, Lakshmi on Lotus, Your mother-in-law, danced, Vishnu, the tall one (who assumed ViswarUpam) Your father-in-law, Your peacock should also dance and You too, dancing, should appear before me dancing!* Bhima, who never parted with his mace (gadha), from his shoulder, shot a series of arrows (in MahAbhArathA War) at the large army of his mighty opponents and decimated them (with the help of Krishna); herds of sobbing cows came rushing to (Brindhavanam) (hearing the magical flute of Krishna); as the charioteer on Vijayan (Arjuna)'s chariot, the golden and vedic victory-conch shell was blown (by Krishna); on the milky ocean with waves tossing about, He (Krishna) reclined on a serpent-bed; (in Vamana Avatharam) he measured the entire world with one foot (that foot-bearer, Krishna) He, the Great Mystic, with Garuda for vehicle. You are His favourite nephew! Fresh garland adorning His chest, is the great King Praputa DEvA (of ThiruvaNNAmalai); Your presence made the King's heart dance with joy Oh the Greatest One of all Gods!

1054.english_meanings_list: ["Blood, brain, flesh and the stenchy faeces never leave this cottage of a body, covered by the skin, this body serves as the breeding ground for phlegm and other dirty germs; it is flimsy like an air bubble which perishes no sooner than it is formed, giving a delusory impression that the body is a safe haven;", "upon demise, this body is going to be devoured by vultures, dogs, devils and many crows who will peck into the flesh keeping the pieces upon a chunk of wood; nurturing such a body with affection, I have been stupidly drowning myself in worldly matters in vain;", "those traditional worshippers, who offer flowers and tender leaves like vilvam (bael) to You and those who have taken up their mission of worship zealously as though it is a thespian service, have not been able to discern the great bliss of liberation; kindly preach to me what that liberation is, Oh Lord!", "She is concorporate on the left side of the Supreme Lord SivA whose body glows like fire and is smeared with the holy ash; She is the daughter of Mount HimavAn; She holds the famous trident in Her hand; and You are the child of that Goddess PArvathi!", "These great sages (like Agasthiyar) who have researched into, and realised the finishing stages of, the seven species of life, along with the Celestials in the skies, praise You to Your delight, Oh Lord!", "The serpent, AdhisEshan, the huge Mount MEru, the seas filled with makara fish and the entire world were shaken; the seven mountains (of the demon SUran) were shattered to pieces; the devils, the fiends and the great Goddess KALi danced about on the battlefield; and the demons perished as You wielded the spear, Oh Great One!"]
1054.english_pathavurai: Blood, brain, flesh and the stenchy faeces never leave this cottage of a body, covered by the skin, this body serves as the breeding ground for phlegm and other dirty germs; it is flimsy like an air bubble which perishes no sooner than it is formed, giving a delusory impression that the body is a safe haven; upon demise, this body is going to be devoured by vultures, dogs, devils and many crows who will peck into the flesh keeping the pieces upon a chunk of wood; nurturing such a body with affection, I have been stupidly drowning myself in worldly matters in vain; those traditional worshippers, who offer flowers and tender leaves like vilvam (bael) to You and those who have taken up their mission of worship zealously as though it is a thespian service, have not been able to discern the great bliss of liberation; kindly preach to me what that liberation is, Oh Lord! She is concorporate on the left side of the Supreme Lord SivA whose body glows like fire and is smeared with the holy ash; She is the daughter of Mount HimavAn; She holds the famous trident in Her hand; and You are the child of that Goddess PArvathi! These great sages (like Agasthiyar) who have researched into, and realised the finishing stages of, the seven species of life, along with the Celestials in the skies, praise You to Your delight, Oh Lord! The serpent, AdhisEshan, the huge Mount MEru, the seas filled with makara fish and the entire world were shaken; the seven mountains (of the demon SUran) were shattered to pieces; the devils, the fiends and the great Goddess KALi danced about on the battlefield; and the demons perished as You wielded the spear, Oh Great One!

1055.english_meanings_list: ["The body, the source of all miseries, caves in and loses shape when the woe of starvation strikes, establishing its right to burn like fire; to satiate that hunger, people struggle, day and night,", "debating among themselves animatedly about all kinds of religious issues; getting away from their bickering,", "those who undertake the worship of Your lotus feet, extolling Your glory with their tongue,", "feeling ecstatic upon attaining a blissful plane beyond the rare thuriya state (remaining in the state of SivA), a state of true knowledge that surpasses the sensory organs and all attachments,", "shedding their outer shell of delusion, regulating their breath and holding it in a subdued manner, there are some of Your unblemished devotees who reign in absolute control; can the few flowery arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love), the consort of Rathi, have any impact whatsoever on them?", "Innumerable chariots and men of armies charged (into the battlefield) making a loud noise and raising so much dust that the bright rays of the rising sun became invisible;", "the kings with their sprawling crowns and the hundred KauravAs (headed by DuriyOdhanan) were all destroyed solely by Arjunan;", "(on behalf of the PANdavAs,) He went as a messenger amidst great peril; He is the matchless powerful one, KrishNan; and You are His nephew!", "You are the child of DEvi PArvathi! You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the fierce hunters!", "Making the dark seas roar noisily, killing the demons and shattering Mount Krouncha to pieces, You wielded Your spear swiftly, Oh Great One!"]
1055.english_pathavurai: The body, the source of all miseries, caves in and loses shape when the woe of starvation strikes, establishing its right to burn like fire; to satiate that hunger, people struggle, day and night, debating among themselves animatedly about all kinds of religious issues; getting away from their bickering, those who undertake the worship of Your lotus feet, extolling Your glory with their tongue, feeling ecstatic upon attaining a blissful plane beyond the rare thuriya state (remaining in the state of SivA), a state of true knowledge that surpasses the sensory organs and all attachments, shedding their outer shell of delusion, regulating their breath and holding it in a subdued manner, there are some of Your unblemished devotees who reign in absolute control; can the few flowery arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love), the consort of Rathi, have any impact whatsoever on them? Innumerable chariots and men of armies charged (into the battlefield) making a loud noise and raising so much dust that the bright rays of the rising sun became invisible; the kings with their sprawling crowns and the hundred KauravAs (headed by DuriyOdhanan) were all destroyed solely by Arjunan; (on behalf of the PANdavAs,) He went as a messenger amidst great peril; He is the matchless powerful one, KrishNan; and You are His nephew! You are the child of DEvi PArvathi! You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the fierce hunters! Making the dark seas roar noisily, killing the demons and shattering Mount Krouncha to pieces, You wielded Your spear swiftly, Oh Great One!

1056.english_meanings_list: ["The speech of the daughter, the wife, the mother, the relatives and all those gathered there becoming mournful, even the grief-stricken people from out-of-town who have assembled in large numbers beginning to scream,", "Yaman (God of Death), with eyes spewing fire, and accompanied by his boisterous messengers, approaching, for the sole purpose of taking the life from my body, and before he ensnares me,", "while life on this earth is nearing the end, the breath exhaled from the left nostril being assessed by the relatives standing nearby, establishing their relationship and declaring \"there is mobility of the breath\" and some disputing, saying, \"no; the breath is gone; it has ended\",", "(at that moment,) kindly bless me so that I could say \"Oh MurugA\" with my tongue praising Your hallowed feet!", "Arjunan, an extremely capable warrior, possessed a matchless and great bow (called GANdeepam); He made that Arjunan destroy the entire armies consisting of horses, elephants, chariots and soldiers belonging to the sons of the famous king DhirutharAshtiran;", "He terminated the rule of the kingdom (by DhuriyOthanan) and removed the misery of this great world; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "He came in the form of a huge mountain and the vast sea; to kill all those who opposed him, he took several concealing forms and fought the war with a spear in his hand; he was the demon SUran;", "destroying the strength of his fragrant and huge shoulders, You swiftly wielded Your spear and claimed victory, Oh Great One!"]
1056.english_pathavurai: The speech of the daughter, the wife, the mother, the relatives and all those gathered there becoming mournful, even the grief-stricken people from out-of-town who have assembled in large numbers beginning to scream, Yaman (God of Death), with eyes spewing fire, and accompanied by his boisterous messengers, approaching, for the sole purpose of taking the life from my body, and before he ensnares me, while life on this earth is nearing the end, the breath exhaled from the left nostril being assessed by the relatives standing nearby, establishing their relationship and declaring "there is mobility of the breath" and some disputing, saying, "no; the breath is gone; it has ended", (at that moment,) kindly bless me so that I could say "Oh MurugA" with my tongue praising Your hallowed feet! Arjunan, an extremely capable warrior, possessed a matchless and great bow (called GANdeepam); He made that Arjunan destroy the entire armies consisting of horses, elephants, chariots and soldiers belonging to the sons of the famous king DhirutharAshtiran; He terminated the rule of the kingdom (by DhuriyOthanan) and removed the misery of this great world; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! He came in the form of a huge mountain and the vast sea; to kill all those who opposed him, he took several concealing forms and fought the war with a spear in his hand; he was the demon SUran; destroying the strength of his fragrant and huge shoulders, You swiftly wielded Your spear and claimed victory, Oh Great One!

1057.english_meanings_list: ["Assembling the intestines, water, fat, and faeces along with many impeccable bones,", "this cottage of body is built to be a seat of terrible diseases; upon it is laden what is called \"life\",", "which is a shapeless minute thing sought after by the messengers of Yaman (the God of Death); before they come fighting to grab that life,", "will my mind mature for me to prostrate at Your hallowed feet and will You not kindly grant me the blemishless true knowledge?", "The hunters who lived in the dreadful jungle could not make out how the neem tree came there as You came in the disguise of that tree;", "You loved VaLLi, with soft bamboo-like shoulders, who was the peacock-like damsel of the KuRavAs and embraced her through a surreptitious pursuit, Oh Lord KandhA!", "The demons came swiftly and confronted You aggressively in the war, making a loud noise, and You conquered them all by wielding Your spear, Oh valorous One!", "You gave the vision of Your universal and gigantic form to the old trinity of BrahmA, VishNu and SivA, and You are the Lord of all the three, Oh Great One!"]
1057.english_pathavurai: Assembling the intestines, water, fat, and faeces along with many impeccable bones, this cottage of body is built to be a seat of terrible diseases; upon it is laden what is called "life", which is a shapeless minute thing sought after by the messengers of Yaman (the God of Death); before they come fighting to grab that life, will my mind mature for me to prostrate at Your hallowed feet and will You not kindly grant me the blemishless true knowledge? The hunters who lived in the dreadful jungle could not make out how the neem tree came there as You came in the disguise of that tree; You loved VaLLi, with soft bamboo-like shoulders, who was the peacock-like damsel of the KuRavAs and embraced her through a surreptitious pursuit, Oh Lord KandhA! The demons came swiftly and confronted You aggressively in the war, making a loud noise, and You conquered them all by wielding Your spear, Oh valorous One! You gave the vision of Your universal and gigantic form to the old trinity of BrahmA, VishNu and SivA, and You are the Lord of all the three, Oh Great One!

1058.english_pathavurai: You are the common factor of all lives. You are the unique primordial substance. You are the meaning of all vedic scriptures being recited, surpassing days and nights. You are the ultimate culmination of that meaning. You are the widest cosmos. You are very transparent. You are endless. You are the refuge of all. You are beyond comprehension. You are sweet like the divine nectar being imbibed. Destroying the five perceptory senses (namely, taste, light, feeling, sound and smell), and annihilating the five sensory organs (namely, mouth, eyes, skin, ears and nostrils), You have removed my fear of death; how wonderful is Your gracious teaching! The seas bellowed; the demons made a loud noise; and the entire world praised You in awe when You mounted the attractive peacock with pretty feathers, driving it like a matchless brave horse, Oh valorous One! You are an adoring friend of all mountains in this world! You are the leader of the celestials. You are the beloved child of Mother PArvathi! You are the dear child of all the KArththigai damsels who nursed You with abundant milk from their bosoms! They have their seats on the lotus, the milky ocean and the mount KailAsh; They are respectively the elder Gods, namely BrahmA, Vishnu and SivA. You are the Leader above all of them, Oh Great One!

1059.english_pathavurai: This tree had a cluster of branches; it was a mango tree that grew up suddenly in the middle of the sea; (that tree was the disguise of the demon SUran) whose bravery was burnt down by Your Spear; I never sing the glory of that Spear nor do I dance in ecstasy celebrating its triumph. I do not seek blissful liberation by prostrating at Your compassionate feet that are adorned by lilting anklets; nor do I fall at the feet of those who worship Your hallowed feet. I do not offer unhesitatingly even a morsel of food to those who are in need of food. Instead of such a deplorable life, death would be far better. In order that my body is permanently relieved from the vicious cycle of birth and death, You only, oh Lord, can grant me liberation! The crocodile pursued the footprints of the elephant (GajEndran) and came to the pond with a view to grabbing and killing him. To shatter the crocodile's head to pieces, the elephant screamed and prayed "Ha! NArAyaNA! My good friend! You are the consort of Lakshmi who emerged from the milky ocean! You wear on Your holy chest the garland of ThuLasi, Oh GopAlA! Kindly come to my rescue!" - on hearing this appeal from the mountain-like elephant with his lifted trunk, He mounted his vehicle, the Eagle Garuda, blowing His golden conch (PAnchajanyam), and rushed to GajEndran's rescue by flying through the sky! He is Lord Vishnu, and You are His nephew! Oh Lord, You are the protector of the Celestial Land ruled by IndrA, who holds in his hand the weapon Vajra! Oh God Almighty, with reddish feet! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1060.english_pathavurai: It is the sun; It is the cool moon; It is the wide earth; It is the sky, the water, the fire, the air, the wonderful stars and many other things; It takes the form of all the days of the week (beginning with Sunday); It comes as the distinguished stars, numbering 27 (14+6+7); It pervades as the seven worlds; It is the VedA (scripture); It is the light that shines on top of the VEdAs; It is BrahmA; It is Vishnu; It is the auspicious substance above all of them; It is an immortal object, unaffected by the darkness of ignorance; It is Your holy feet; why should I wander about without wearing Your feet on my head and seeking them feet and lead an unfulfilled life? The hundred sons (starting from Duryodhana) sired by DhirutharAshtran fell down dead and were sent to rule the heaven in a war that lasted eighteen days; the famous PaNdava, Arjunan, was given the honour of ruling the world and protecting it by Krishna, the King, who drove his chariot; and You are that Krishna's nephew! You hold in Your hand the Spear that has bathed in the blood of the enemies! You showed Your rage against the demons and rAkshasAs! You wear the garlands made of kadappa and kUthALa flowers! You mount the peacock, Oh valorous One! You protect the world ruled by IndrA who holds the weapon, Vajra! Oh Lord, You are God MurugavEL and the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1061.english_pathavurai: As the body that serves as the primary support for life and its youthfulness decay when ripe old age is reached, people of this world cry out (one day) saying "Oh anchor-like man, You were our rescuer!" The funeral drums are beaten with a loud noise; the face of the corpse is covered with a piece of cloth, and the relatives assembled in the house cry their hearts out; the children scream aloud, the wife weeps and the mother bangs her head, falling all over, crying "Oh my treasure!" at that time, You must assure me that the journey of death to the town of the mystical Yaman, God of Death, would never happen to me and take me along with You stating "Come with me to rule the heaven!" The hunters living in the valley of the mountain, where bushes of reeds had not become extinct and where the noise of the screaming tribals had not died out, fled in scare, along with the demons who came confronting in a large number like a sea, when You aggressively battled with them, Oh Victorious and valorous One! Oh Protector of the earth, You are the child that wears the garland of kadappa flowers! From Your hallowed mouth emanated the prattling words that taught Your Father, Lord SivA, Oh Great Master! Your name has six sacred letters (SaravaNabava); You possess an upright form that never deviates from the virtuous path; You are also formless; and You delivered this Earth, Oh Lord! You are the protector of the celestial land belonging to IndrA, who has performed a hundred penances involving the horse (aswamEthayAgam) and who holds the vajra (mace) as a weapon in his hand, Oh Leader! Oh Lord MurugA! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1062.english_pathavurai: "Are the eyes of those scheming whores who invite people to their houses comparable to the sword, the spear, the sEl fish or the deer? Is their dense hair, as black as their heart, comparable to the dark cloud, the forest or the immortal dark form of Lord VishNu Himself? 1070.english_meanings_list: ["She came to win us over in order to protect us; She is our dear VaLLi, the sugarcane-like damsel of the KuRavAs; You went one day to the serene millet-field to see her and spoke to her in a friendly manner;", "You fell for her bulging and bejewelled bosom that are strong and exquisitely beautiful, looking like tender coconuts, and for her smooth shoulders;", "and in a passionate trance, You happily hugged her, without releasing her and with overwhelming love; not praising Your great quality,", "I have been carrying the burden of this body consisting of five sensory organs, filled with perplexity and misery; when will I be able to get rid of that?", "He brought along with him an army of monkeys and, in a rage, smashed the weapons of the demons and their mountainous country, Lanka, to pieces; He is Lord VishNu with the hue of black cloud; along with Him, Lord SivA, endowed with three eyes (the Sun, the Moon and Agni, the Fire),", "and IndrA, the leader of the elephant AirAvadham that is bright and valorous, well-decorated with ornaments, and that gets wildly enraged and chases away evil enemies, with its saliva oozing;", "and Your devotees in eternal bliss having been granted the boon of immortality and the dear ones in the three worlds have all assembled to praise and worship You; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
1070.english_pathavurai: She came to win us over in order to protect us; She is our dear VaLLi, the sugarcane-like damsel of the KuRavAs; You went one day to the serene millet-field to see her and spoke to her in a friendly manner; You fell for her bulging and bejewelled bosom that are strong and exquisitely beautiful, looking like tender coconuts, and for her smooth shoulders; and in a passionate trance, You happily hugged her, without releasing her and with overwhelming love; not praising Your great quality, I have been carrying the burden of this body consisting of five sensory organs, filled with perplexity and misery; when will I be able to get rid of that? He brought along with him an army of monkeys and, in a rage, smashed the weapons of the demons and their mountainous country, Lanka, to pieces; He is Lord VishNu with the hue of black cloud; along with Him, Lord SivA, endowed with three eyes (the Sun, the Moon and Agni, the Fire), and IndrA, the leader of the elephant AirAvadham that is bright and valorous, well-decorated with ornaments, and that gets wildly enraged and chases away evil enemies, with its saliva oozing; and Your devotees in eternal bliss having been granted the boon of immortality and the dear ones in the three worlds have all assembled to praise and worship You; You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1071.english_meanings_list: ["I am incapable of filling my heart with happiness and making it melt with love;", "nor do I have any of the following qualities, namely, a broad mind, virtues and respectable humility.", "She grew up in Mount VaLLimalai where hunters with spears in hand roam about; to tightly hug the bosom of that VaLLi with Your hallowed arms, You went to that mount;", "not realising with love Your greatness in that action,", "having been a person filled with anger, making scathing remarks with arrogance and vanity;", "when will I straighten my crooked mind and behave in the righteous way?", "He is the Valiant One who severed the heads of RAvaNan who arrogantly went the other day to stand at the foothill of Mount KailAsh, the abode of the compasionate Lord SivA, and began to uproot the mountain with his large hands; He is Lord VishNu;", "along with Him, all people from the eight directions, the Sun who spreads its wide wrinkle-free rays, IndrA, the devotees who yearn for Your hallowed feet as their refuge and who are immersed in love for You, and the denizen of the three worlds", "are worshipping You as the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
1071.english_pathavurai: I am incapable of filling my heart with happiness and making it melt with love; nor do I have any of the following qualities, namely, a broad mind, virtues and respectable humility. She grew up in Mount VaLLimalai where hunters with spears in hand roam about; to tightly hug the bosom of that VaLLi with Your hallowed arms, You went to that mount; not realising with love Your greatness in that action, having been a person filled with anger, making scathing remarks with arrogance and vanity; when will I straighten my crooked mind and behave in the righteous way? He is the Valiant One who severed the heads of RAvaNan who arrogantly went the other day to stand at the foothill of Mount KailAsh, the abode of the compasionate Lord SivA, and began to uproot the mountain with his large hands; He is Lord VishNu; along with Him, all people from the eight directions, the Sun who spreads its wide wrinkle-free rays, IndrA, the devotees who yearn for Your hallowed feet as their refuge and who are immersed in love for You, and the denizen of the three worlds are worshipping You as the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

He prevails upon You with love as Master! The mighty and proud demon, SUran, and his dynasty were annihilated by Your rage! When Yama's (Death-God) messengers approach me with relish with their favourite weapon, PAsakkayiRu (Rope of Bondage), I should not be disheartened; and at that weak moment when they take my life away, You must come to me on Your great peacock to end my misery. You display the beautiful spear on Your shoulder, Oh Great One!

1075.english_meanings_list: ["In one moment, the asuras' abode, Thiripuram, was", "burnt down graciously by SivA; You are His Son!", "To scare the wits out of the angry demons,", "You drove Your Peacock fiercely amidst them!", "The large mountain, Krounchamalai, was pierced by", "Your sharp spear, Oh Arumuga (Six-faced God),", "This daughter of mine, afflicted by separation from You and suffering from decoloration of her young chest,", "does not deserve to be pierced by the flower-arrows shot by Manmathan (Love God).", "You are the younger brother of VinAyagA, with a holy elephant-face and a large belly.", "VaLLi, the damsel of rich and famous KuRavas,", "was embraced by You with love and compassion!", "You are the nephew of Hari, who sleeps on the snake-bed!", "You are the proud possessor of the entire world!", "Your devotees' karma and the asuras' tormentation", "are both destroyed by Your Grace, Oh Great One!"]
1075.english_pathavurai: In one moment, the asuras' abode, Thiripuram, was burnt down graciously by SivA; You are His Son! To scare the wits out of the angry demons, You drove Your Peacock fiercely amidst them! The large mountain, Krounchamalai, was pierced by Your sharp spear, Oh Arumuga (Six-faced God), This daughter of mine, afflicted by separation from You and suffering from decoloration of her young chest, does not deserve to be pierced by the flower-arrows shot by Manmathan (Love God). You are the younger brother of VinAyagA, with a holy elephant-face and a large belly. VaLLi, the damsel of rich and famous KuRavas, was embraced by You with love and compassion! You are the nephew of Hari, who sleeps on the snake-bed! You are the proud possessor of the entire world! Your devotees' karma and the asuras' tormentation are both destroyed by Your Grace, Oh Great One!

1076.english_meanings_list: ["Languishing in their pot-like breasts that look like the Mount MEru in the North, smeared with a paste of civet, incence and mixed sandalwood, wearing compactly-set chains of dazzling pearls and gems,", "and pining for the eyes that look like black lily belonging to the young whores beautified by the servant women and their sweet speech like nectar,", "I lost my self-control and, with great passion, was ensnared by those whores on their bed; my mind simply melted, destroying me altogether; kindly take charge of this slave and bless me with Your grace!", "When He played on the flute, the little herd of cows (of the milk-yielding variety) were mesmerised and became scared; Lord KrishNa helped those cows graciously;", "The sea full of waves making a loud noise tossed mountain-high waves and swelled up very fast; the earth and the full moon went on a dizzy spell; Mount Manthira began to rotate around its own axis with a breaking sound as Lord VishNu, of the complexion of the black cloud, began to churn the milky ocean speedily; and You are the nephew of that Lord!", "The beetles swarming around the lotus of Brahma on which He is seated began to hum musically; and You are the Lord of that Brahma, Oh Great One!"]
1076.english_pathavurai: Languishing in their pot-like breasts that look like the Mount MEru in the North, smeared with a paste of civet, incence and mixed sandalwood, wearing compactly-set chains of dazzling pearls and gems, and pining for the eyes that look like black lily belonging to the young whores beautified by the servant women and their sweet speech like nectar, I lost my self-control and, with great passion, was ensnared by those whores on their bed; my mind simply melted, destroying me altogether; kindly take charge of this slave and bless me with Your grace! When He played on the flute, the little herd of cows (of the milk-yielding variety) were mesmerised and became scared; Lord KrishNa helped those cows graciously; The sea full of waves making a loud noise tossed mountain-high waves and swelled up very fast; the earth and the full moon went on a dizzy spell; Mount Manthira began to rotate around its own axis with a breaking sound as Lord VishNu, of the complexion of the black cloud, began to churn the milky ocean speedily; and You are the nephew of that Lord! The beetles swarming around the lotus of Brahma on which He is seated began to hum musically; and You are the Lord of that Brahma, Oh Great One!

You are the son of Lord SivA who was deemed by many as a mad one! You are the deity adored by all! You mount the green peacock as Your vehicle! You are omnipresent throughout the world! You are the primordial Lord who can grant liberation! You are dexterous in many mystical sports (sidhdhis)! You are the nephew of Lord VishNu! You are matchless! You have a handsome figure of a red hue! You are the Supreme Lord above all, Oh Great One!

1086.english_pathavurai: Because of the weight of the heavy mountain-like bosom smeared fully with the mixture of fragrant substances and kastUri (an aromatic essence derived from the deer), her waist is likely to cave in; as if the methodical rhythm and musical sound of appeal made by the anklets on her feet is not enough, You went up to Mount VaLLimalai and engaged in the sport of flirtatious conversation with the dear damsel of the hunters; she is VaLLi, the innocent girl who was merely cultivating the crop of millet; You embraced the bright and elegant bosom of that VaLLi, bedecked with decorative ornaments, Oh Lord with a reddish complexion! Kindly bless me to prostrate at Your feet saying "I am worshipping You, Oh Lord!" The Sun, the Moon, Lord BrahmA seated on the lotus around which the beetles hum, Lord VishNu, Lord IndrA who mounts the elephant (AirAvatham) that has a crystal-white hue, has a huge and majestic body, has oozing saliva of rage and has garlands made of gems and decorative garment on the reddish forehead of its big and spotted face, and all others were facing extinction (at the end of the aeon) when Lord SivA and Goddess ParAsakthi danced together; when all the seven seas merge together and rise, submerging the entire world resulting in the ultimate war between the good and the evil, You shall stand steadily without fear, Oh Great One!

1087.english_meanings_list: ["Because of the arrows of heavy flowers shot, with an aim to kill, by the confrontational God of Love (Manmathan),", "because of the humming sound made by the beetles after imbibing the exhilarating honey,", "because of the deafening noise made by the waves in the sea over there,", "and because of the rays of the moon with many phases burning like fire,", "this sweet-natured dear girl of mine, wearing prominent bangles made of conch shells, who knows only to love and who is bright like the lightning, has today become very thin, thinking about You; (saving her from further weakening, and)", "to remove her misery, You must appear before her and embrace her with Your twelve shoulders, clasping her bosom adorned by a reddish chain with similar kind of beads!", "The sun who revolves around this earth once requested You from the sky saying \"Oh Lord, I seek refuge in You; kindly protect me\"; because of that prayer,", "You wielded Your dazzling spear that pierced through the head and shoulders of the powerful and evil demon, SUran, and instantly came out of his body, Oh Lord!", "He is the great Lord SivA who dances to the beatings, and the tune, of the several songs sung by the fiends and devils together;", "He once beseeched You to vividly preach to Him the significance of DharmA (righteousness) and true knowledge on which DharmA rests;", "then and there, You exquisitely taught Him everything, Oh Great One!"]
1087.english_pathavurai: Because of the arrows of heavy flowers shot, with an aim to kill, by the confrontational God of Love (Manmathan), because of the humming sound made by the beetles after imbibing the exhilarating honey, because of the deafening noise made by the waves in the sea over there, and because of the rays of the moon with many phases burning like fire, this sweet-natured dear girl of mine, wearing prominent bangles made of conch shells, who knows only to love and who is bright like the lightning, has today become very thin, thinking about You; (saving her from further weakening, and) to remove her misery, You must appear before her and embrace her with Your twelve shoulders, clasping her bosom adorned by a reddish chain with similar kind of beads! The sun who revolves around this earth once requested You from the sky saying "Oh Lord, I seek refuge in You; kindly protect me"; because of that prayer, You wielded Your dazzling spear that pierced through the head and shoulders of the powerful and evil demon, SUran, and instantly came out of his body, Oh Lord! He is the great Lord SivA who dances to the beatings, and the tune, of the several songs sung by the fiends and devils together; He once beseeched You to vividly preach to Him the significance of DharmA (righteousness) and true knowledge on which DharmA rests; then and there, You exquisitely taught Him everything, Oh Great One!

1088.english_meanings_list: ["In this body that is shown off prominently and consisting of blood, water, skin, intestines and bones,", "remains the life, having the characteristics of delusory evil, anger and intense passion; to take that life away,", "Yaman, the God of Death, comes deliberately bringing along with him the long rope (of attachment);", "standing by the side, is my mother crying uncontrollably; I am about to depart after abandoning everything as if I forgot them all; now, before that event,", "kindly let the lotus of my mind blossom in blissful devotion so that You emerge from it as the Lord GuhA and bless me with the knowledge of the art of happily praising Your Divine Grace!", "Making the huge and tall demon, SUran, surrounded by armies of demons, flee the battlefield in a daze,", "You killed him with Your spear witnessed by the celestials who cherished in their heart the bravery shown by You once in the battlefield;", "As the Sun, the Moon and Vishnu, who once went digging into this earth (as a boar), prostrated at His feet,", "He imbibed the evil poison (AlakAlam) Himself, dispelling the fear of the seven worlds; that steadily dancing Great Lord SivA was delighted", "when You preached to Him the ancient VEdAs the other day, Oh Great One!"]
1088.english_pathavurai: In this body that is shown off prominently and consisting of blood, water, skin, intestines and bones, remains the life, having the characteristics of delusory evil, anger and intense passion; to take that life away, Yaman, the God of Death, comes deliberately bringing along with him the long rope (of attachment); standing by the side, is my mother crying uncontrollably; I am about to depart after abandoning everything as if I forgot them all; now, before that event, kindly let the lotus of my mind blossom in blissful devotion so that You emerge from it as the Lord GuhA and bless me with the knowledge of the art of happily praising Your Divine Grace! Making the huge and tall demon, SUran, surrounded by armies of demons, flee the battlefield in a daze, You killed him with Your spear witnessed by the celestials who cherished in their heart the bravery shown by You once in the battlefield; As the Sun, the Moon and Vishnu, who once went digging into this earth (as a boar), prostrated at His feet, He imbibed the evil poison (AlakAlam) Himself, dispelling the fear of the seven worlds; that steadily dancing Great Lord SivA was delighted when You preached to Him the ancient VEdAs the other day, Oh Great One!

1089.english_meanings_list: ["The body is afflicted by both good and bad deeds of the past; after death, the body becomes just a shell;", "all the people in the household hasten to take the body away to the cremation ground where they ultimately cry;", "there, just beneath the head, fire is lit (for the cremation);", "before I am beckoned by Yaman, the cruel God of Death who mounts his black vehicle, the strong buffalo with two horns, and who tightens the rope of bondage around my neck,", "kindly let me have the vision of Your hallowed feet, adorned with anklets whose glow makes even gold and gems look pale!", "She was engaged in guarding the millet-field from the birds like parrot in the high mountain of VaLLimalai; (as in her previous birth She did penance, pining for You, as Sundaravalli) VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, had an old relationship with You, and You became Her Consort!", "In the army barracks of the enemies, You ignited blazing fire from Your fiery middle eye in the forehead*, Oh Lord KumarA!", "The famous work (of Sangham age) in Tamil (ThirumurugAtRuppadai), which included rare quotations from the scriptures, was listened to by You in its entirety, Oh MurugA!", "The demons who thronged in multitude in the wavy seas were driven away by You, and the celestials were freed from the prison, Oh Great One!"]
1089.english_pathavurai: The body is afflicted by both good and bad deeds of the past; after death, the body becomes just a shell; all the people in the household hasten to take the body away to the cremation ground where they ultimately cry; there, just beneath the head, fire is lit (for the cremation); before I am beckoned by Yaman, the cruel God of Death who mounts his black vehicle, the strong buffalo with two horns, and who tightens the rope of bondage around my neck, kindly let me have the vision of Your hallowed feet, adorned with anklets whose glow makes even gold and gems look pale! She was engaged in guarding the millet-field from the birds like parrot in the high mountain of VaLLimalai; (as in her previous birth She did penance, pining for You, as Sundaravalli) VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, had an old relationship with You, and You became Her Consort! In the army barracks of the enemies, You ignited blazing fire from Your fiery middle eye in the forehead*, Oh Lord KumarA! The famous work (of Sangham age) in Tamil (ThirumurugAtRuppadai), which included rare quotations from the scriptures, was listened to by You in its entirety, Oh MurugA! The demons who thronged in multitude in the wavy seas were driven away by You, and the celestials were freed from the prison, Oh Great One!

1090.english_meanings_list: ["Causing a lot of grief to all the kith and kin;", "and later, when they compose themselves by getting over their anguish, the body will be taken to the cremation ground, led by destiny that governed it since birth; there it will be consigned into leaping fire;", "before Yaman (God of Death) ties my life with his powerful rope of bondage and tows it along with a strong twist and jerk,", "kindly let my mind contemplate upon You with abundant love and grant me the intellect to gladly praise Your hallowed feet with devotion!", "She has a forehead like the crescent moon and eyes like the sEl fish; She happily grew up in Mount VaLLimalai as the daughter of the hunters;", "She was not born to a human being but was conceived and delivered by a deer; She guarded the fully grown crop in the millet field; that VaLLi is like a she-elephant, and You are her consort adoring her feet, Oh Lord!", "You preached the meaning of the PraNava ManthrA to Lord SivA who has adorned His dense and matted hair with aRugam (cynodon) grass, crescent moon, Aththi (mountain ebony) leaf, and River Gangai with wavy water!", "You destroyed the demons along with their clan who confronted You in the battlefield and liberated the celestials from their prison, Oh Great One!"]
1090.english_pathavurai: Causing a lot of grief to all the kith and kin; and later, when they compose themselves by getting over their anguish, the body will be taken to the cremation ground, led by destiny that governed it since birth; there it will be consigned into leaping fire; before Yaman (God of Death) ties my life with his powerful rope of bondage and tows it along with a strong twist and jerk, kindly let my mind contemplate upon You with abundant love and grant me the intellect to gladly praise Your hallowed feet with devotion! She has a forehead like the crescent moon and eyes like the sEl fish; She happily grew up in Mount VaLLimalai as the daughter of the hunters; She was not born to a human being but was conceived and delivered by a deer; She guarded the fully grown crop in the millet field; that VaLLi is like a she-elephant, and You are her consort adoring her feet, Oh Lord! You preached the meaning of the PraNava ManthrA to Lord SivA who has adorned His dense and matted hair with aRugam (cynodon) grass, crescent moon, Aththi (mountain ebony) leaf, and River Gangai with wavy water! You destroyed the demons along with their clan who confronted You in the battlefield and liberated the celestials from their prison, Oh Great One!

1091.english_meanings_list: ["The neatly combed hair became dishevelled; the eyes shut up snoozing; the bangles made a jingling noise;", "nectar-like sweet words poured out with a quiver; the pearl-necklace worn on the beautiful and bulging bosom shook in vibration; the slender waist became loose;", "pleasure was overflowing as the whores exhibited extreme passion, melting the heart, and indulged in carnal relationship; I do not wish to sink my intellect in their evil and manipulative acts of treachery;", "kindly grant me Your twin fragrant and lotus feet that mounted Your peacock and went around the entire world in a fraction of a second!", "He is the one who wielded His arrow dehydrating the curved and wavy sea*; He is Lord VishNU who bestows boons upon His devotees; He is the handsome One (coming as KrishNa) who knocked down the twin marutha trees and blessed them;", "He is Varadhan who slumbers on the striped serpent (AdhisEshan); He is the consort of Vijaya Lakshmi; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "When the armies of the Leader of the demons rushed to the battlefield to wage a war, You chased them away and shattered the mountain Krouncha; the head of SUran, the king of the demons, was knocked down, and a leaping fire broke out as You swiftly wielded Your spear, Oh Lord!", "You are the consort of VaLLi, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs, who adorns herself with necklaces made of pearls and precious gems, Oh Lord!", "You are well-versed in all the arts, Oh Great One!"]
1091.english_pathavurai: The neatly combed hair became dishevelled; the eyes shut up snoozing; the bangles made a jingling noise; nectar-like sweet words poured out with a quiver; the pearl-necklace worn on the beautiful and bulging bosom shook in vibration; the slender waist became loose; pleasure was overflowing as the whores exhibited extreme passion, melting the heart, and indulged in carnal relationship; I do not wish to sink my intellect in their evil and manipulative acts of treachery; kindly grant me Your twin fragrant and lotus feet that mounted Your peacock and went around the entire world in a fraction of a second! He is the one who wielded His arrow dehydrating the curved and wavy sea*; He is Lord VishNU who bestows boons upon His devotees; He is the handsome One (coming as KrishNa) who knocked down the twin marutha trees and blessed them; He is Varadhan who slumbers on the striped serpent (AdhisEshan); He is the consort of Vijaya Lakshmi; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! When the armies of the Leader of the demons rushed to the battlefield to wage a war, You chased them away and shattered the mountain Krouncha; the head of SUran, the king of the demons, was knocked down, and a leaping fire broke out as You swiftly wielded Your spear, Oh Lord! 1093.english_meanings_list: ["The intestines, faeces and water are packed together, interspersed with flesh, along with proportionate amount of fat, with the blood decolorising into slimy mud;", "everything becoming loose and greasy, breeding countless worms squirming about, the resultant blood-flow gushes out with an unbearable stench on its passage-way;", "applying on such a body all kinds of perfumes like civet and adorning it with various ornaments, these whores come out tantalising the men-folk of this world;", "removing my lust for these women, destroying all the deeds of my karma, tranquilising my wavering mind, dispelling the darkness of my ignorance and annihilating my egoism, egotism and possessiveness, kindly bless me so that True Knowledge springs within me, Oh Lord!", "Those strong enemies were of immense size comparable to the holy golden mount MEru and other mountains in the north;", "the bodies of those enemies were split by Lord VishNu's unique weapon, the disc (Sudharsanam); in His other hand is the famous conch (PAnchajanyam) whose colour is like the utterly white moon; He dived deep into the sea full of makara fish (in His AvatAr as Fish - MachchAvathAram) and played under the sea;", "in order to measure the world surrounded by the seas, He grew immensely tall (as Thirivikraman); He is Lord VishNu of the hue of the black cloud; like Him Your peacock, with a deep blue plume, also grew up covering the entire earth and rising fully up to the zenith in the sky; and mounting that bird and driving it powerfully,", "You fought with the four kinds of armies comprising the elephants, the chariots, the horses and the soldiers, Oh Great One!"]
1093.english_pathavurai: The intestines, faeces and water are packed together, interspersed with flesh, along with proportionate amount of fat, with the blood decolorising into slimy mud; everything becoming loose and greasy, breeding countless worms squirming about, the resultant blood-flow gushes out with an unbearable stench on its passage-way; applying on such a body all kinds of perfumes like civet and adorning it with various ornaments, these whores come out tantalising the men-folk of this world; removing my lust for these women, destroying all the deeds of my karma, tranquilising my wavering mind, dispelling the darkness of my ignorance and annihilating my egoism, egotism and possessiveness, kindly bless me so that True Knowledge springs within me, Oh Lord! Those strong enemies were of immense size comparable to the holy golden mount MEru and other mountains in the north; the bodies of those enemies were split by Lord VishNu's unique weapon, the disc (Sudharsanam); in His other hand is the famous conch (PAnchajanyam) whose colour is like the utterly white moon; He dived deep into the sea full of makara fish (in His AvatAr as Fish - MachchAvathAram) and played under the sea; in order to measure the world surrounded by the seas, He grew immensely tall (as Thirivikraman); He is Lord VishNu of the hue of the black cloud; like Him Your peacock, with a deep blue plume, also grew up covering the entire earth and rising fully up to the zenith in the sky; and mounting that bird and driving it powerfully, You fought with the four kinds of armies comprising the elephants, the chariots, the horses and the soldiers, Oh Great One!

1094.english_meanings_list: ["Those belonging to other religions heatedly discuss, using their shallow brain, in a dissipated and improper manner and argue animatedly raising their voice to a high decibel level;", "millions of such blind people will never be able to perceive the rare and matchless principle; but my mind keeps on chasing It at all times;", "to wash off the slush called the two deeds (both good and bad),", "the four inner tenets (anthak karaNam), namely, mind, intellect, will and egoism, pulsate vigorously; to get rid of those tenets and to put an end to death and the enemy within myself,", "my mind (referred to above) has to melt, and I have to sing Your glory everyday with inner feeling and acquire eyes of wisdom;", "for that, kindly bless me with the knowledge to henceforth realise Your hallowed lotus feet, fragrant with the aroma of musk!", "With their expanding rays, the multitude of stars glitter all over the sky like melting sparks of fire;", "the seven worlds beneath the earth, including the serpents' world (nAga lOkam) and the lowest nether world (pAthALam), along with many bright mountains, the eight good elephants* guarding the cardinal directions and the serpents of the world - all of them appear to be melting down together;", "on that last doom's day of this aeon, the vadavA muka agni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole) swallows all the roaring seas and emits a dark cloud-like smoke; comparable to that dense smoke", "is the peacock with plumes, which is driven by You at the end (of the war) on the top of the sky;", "(this is how) You fought with the four kinds of armies of elephants, chariots, horses and soldiers of the demons, Oh Great One!"]
1094.english_pathavurai: Those belonging to other religions heatedly discuss, using their shallow brain, in a dissipated and improper manner and argue animatedly raising their voice to a high decibel level; millions of such blind people will never be able to perceive the rare and matchless principle; but my mind keeps on chasing It at all times; to wash off the slush called the two deeds (both good and bad), the four inner tenets (anthak karaNam), namely, mind, intellect, will and egoism, pulsate vigorously; to get rid of those tenets and to put an end to death and the enemy within myself, my mind (referred to above) has to melt, and I have to sing Your glory everyday with inner feeling and acquire eyes of wisdom; for that, kindly bless me with the knowledge to henceforth realise Your hallowed lotus feet, fragrant with the aroma of musk! With their expanding rays, the multitude of stars glitter all over the sky like melting sparks of fire; the seven worlds beneath the earth, including the serpents' world (nAga lOkam) and the lowest nether world (pAthALam), along with many bright mountains, the eight good elephants* guarding the cardinal directions and the serpents of the world - all of them appear to be melting down together; on that last doom's day of this aeon, the vadavA muka agni (the inferno that spreads from the north pole) swallows all the roaring seas and emits a dark cloud-like smoke; comparable to that dense smoke is the peacock with plumes, which is driven by You at the end (of the war) on the top of the sky; (this is how) You fought with the four kinds of armies of elephants, chariots, horses and soldiers of the demons, Oh Great One!

1095.english_meanings_list: ["These eyes are so cruel that the God of Death, Yaman, and the triumphant God of Love, Manmathan, both of whom are well-experienced in torture, desired to learn the art of persecution by worshipping at these eyes;", "these eyes extend right up to the ears where the ear-studs, in the shape of makara fish, made in diamond and emerald, are swinging; they have tiny blood vessels within them and appear to have grown with in-built poison; with the two eyes that are ever ready to wage a war of passion,", "these sorceresses take away the lives of young men;", "the depth of these women's heart could never be fathomed by others; following the path of such whores,", "I gave up the righteous course meant for this birth and suffered miserably without knowing the way out; kindly take charge of this blind slave of Yours", "and bless me happily, granting a little grace of Your eyes, Oh Lord!", "Worshipping His hallowed feet with flowers and offering plenty of pure rice crispies, puffed rice, lentils and other grains to fill His big pot-belly,", "and pleasantly providing three kinds of fruits (namely, plantain mango, and jack fruits), the great sage VyAsar narrated (the story of MahAbhAratham) on the mount MEru in the North; as the sage was saying, He wrote with His huge single tusk", "the entire story of the PANdavAs, belonging to the kingdom of Kuru; He is the matchless elephant-faced God, Ganapathi; making that elephant holler* in awe,", "You drove Your vehicle, the plumed peacock which went around in a second, at a high speed, the entire world surrounded by large oceans!", "You battled with the (four kinds of) armies of the demons, namely, chariots, elephants, horses and soldiers, Oh Great One!"]
1095.english_pathavurai: These eyes are so cruel that the God of Death, Yaman, and the triumphant God of Love, Manmathan, both of whom are well-experienced in torture, desired to learn the art of persecution by worshipping at these eyes; these eyes extend right up to the ears where the ear-studs, in the shape of makara fish, made in diamond and emerald, are swinging; they have tiny blood vessels within them and appear to have grown with in-built poison; with the two eyes that are ever ready to wage a war of passion, these sorceresses take away the lives of young men; the depth of these women's heart could never be fathomed by others; following the path of such whores, I gave up the righteous course meant for this birth and suffered miserably without knowing the way out; kindly take charge of this blind slave of Yours and bless me happily, granting a little grace of Your eyes, Oh Lord! Worshipping His hallowed feet with flowers and offering plenty of pure rice crispies, puffed rice, lentils and other grains to fill His big pot-belly, and pleasantly providing three kinds of fruits (namely, plantain mango, and jack fruits), the great sage VyAsar narrated (the story of MahAbhAratham) on the mount MEru in the North; as the sage was saying, He wrote with His huge single tusk the entire story of the PANdavAs, belonging to the kingdom of Kuru; He is the matchless elephant-faced God, Ganapathi; making that elephant holler* in awe, You drove Your vehicle, the plumed peacock which went around in a second, at a high speed, the entire world surrounded by large oceans! You battled with the (four kinds of) armies of the demons, namely, chariots, elephants, horses and soldiers, Oh Great One!

1108.english_meanings_list: ["Competing with the sharpness of the bright spear, their eyes, looking like the sword, battle with rage by besieging the young men;", "with treacherous thoughts filling their mind, they pretend to be dearly loving; they accost the men with glib talk and grab their big wealth;", "their slender waist looking like a hand-drum caves in due to the weighty bosom; I do not wish to be carried away by the carnal pleasure offered by these whores on the bed meant for sleeping;", "instead, I wish to learn the righteous method that never succumbs and to realise which way is wasteful; for that, kindly grant the wisdom to worship Your hallowed feet!", "For the prosperity of Brahma, the son of Lord VishNu who pervades throughout the world blessing all, and for the benefit of the fourVEdAs and the celestials,", "He imbibed the evil poison (AlakAlam) that surged from the milky ocean; He danced the great cosmic dance with all the devils; He carried the burning fire in His hand; He mounts His vehicle, Nandi, the Bull;", "on His matted hair, He holds the sparkling and evil serpent, young crescent moon, the wavy water of River Gangai and black lily; He is Lord SivA;", "His hallowed body becomes ecstatic when hugged fondly by Goddess PArvathi, and You are Her dear Son and the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
1108.english_pathavurai: Competing with the sharpness of the bright spear, their eyes, looking like the sword, battle with rage by besieging the young men; with treacherous thoughts filling their mind, they pretend to be dearly loving; they accost the men with glib talk and grab their big wealth; their slender waist looking like a hand-drum caves in due to the weighty bosom; I do not wish to be carried away by the carnal pleasure offered by these whores on the bed meant for sleeping; instead, I wish to learn the righteous method that never succumbs and to realise which way is wasteful; for that, kindly grant the wisdom to worship Your hallowed feet! For the prosperity of Brahma, the son of Lord VishNu who pervades throughout the world blessing all, and for the benefit of the fourVEdAs and the celestials, He imbibed the evil poison (AlakAlam) that surged from the milky ocean; He danced the great cosmic dance with all the devils; He carried the burning fire in His hand; He mounts His vehicle, Nandi, the Bull; on His matted hair, He holds the sparkling and evil serpent, young crescent moon, the wavy water of River Gangai and black lily; He is Lord SivA; His hallowed body becomes ecstatic when hugged fondly by Goddess PArvathi, and You are Her dear Son and the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1109.english_meanings_list: ["This body is just a cottage full of miserable diseases and other adversities; knowing the exact moment of severance of the body from attachments arising from worldly delusion, namely, the time of life's departure,", "the relatives and children break into crying; the long life filled with perils and the righteous disciplined path hitherto followed are about to be extinguished;", "the unique messengers sent by the great God of Death (Yaman) have begun to attack;", "life, submerged under the past deeds, and propelled by fate, is about to expire; before that happens,", "please consider whole-heartedly to bless me, willingly and happily, so that I could praise Your glory everyday in the three aspects, namely literature, music and drama, of the great Tamil language!", "The people in the seven worlds painfully declared that these demons, resorting to treacherous acts, were evil;", "penetrating the skin under the broad chests of those demons, You wielded the sharp spear, Oh valorous Lord!", "You are the son of Lord SivA performing the Cosmic Dance! Your knowledge based on flawless Tamil language is impeccable, Oh MurugA!", "On a lotus-like seat, similar to the fragrant lotus on which BrahmA, chanting the four VEdAs, is seated with relish,", "You are mounted on the proud peacock; while You are so seated,", "Your devotees come to You daily as if they seek to visit their cherished treasure that is saved; protecting those devotees,", "You show Your unwavering compassion to them, Oh Great One!"]
1109.english_pathavurai: This body is just a cottage full of miserable diseases and other adversities; knowing the exact moment of severance of the body from attachments arising from worldly delusion, namely, the time of life's departure, the relatives and children break into crying; the long life filled with perils and the righteous disciplined path hitherto followed are about to be extinguished; the unique messengers sent by the great God of Death (Yaman) have begun to attack; life, submerged under the past deeds, and propelled by fate, is about to expire; before that happens, please consider whole-heartedly to bless me, willingly and happily, so that I could praise Your glory everyday in the three aspects, namely literature, music and drama, of the great Tamil language! The people in the seven worlds painfully declared that these demons, resorting to treacherous acts, were evil; penetrating the skin under the broad chests of those demons, You wielded the sharp spear, Oh valorous Lord! You are the son of Lord SivA performing the Cosmic Dance! Your knowledge based on flawless Tamil language is impeccable, Oh MurugA! On a lotus-like seat, similar to the fragrant lotus on which BrahmA, chanting the four VEdAs, is seated with relish, You are mounted on the proud peacock; while You are so seated, Your devotees come to You daily as if they seek to visit their cherished treasure that is saved; protecting those devotees, You show Your unwavering compassion to them, Oh Great One!

1110.english_meanings_list: ["The obedient sons and women standing around the body reverently covering it with a precious silk cloth;", "then garlanding the body, hugging the long pAdai (bier) and breaking into crying;", "once they take a dip in the wavy water, their remaining grief leaves them;", "before my people behaving like strangers begin to set fire of a golden hue upon my body, and prior to the expiry of my life,", "kindly grant me a life with an ever-growing intellect to praise Your hallowed feet everyday with love in my heart!", "He made up His mind to destroy Manmathan (God of Love) bearing the bow of sugarcane; He is the Lord MahAdEvar, with three eyes (Sun, Moon and Fire); He is Lord SivA who is every thing and omnipresent; You are His great Treasure!", "The unfathomable and vast sea dried up and the old demon SUran was killed when Your mighty spear ascended and attacked, Oh Lord!", "The people of the world, the celestials and the sages who came from many directions surrounded You as You came around, mounted on the exultant peacock!", "Your devotees come to You daily as if they seek to visit their cherished treasure that is saved; protecting those devotees,", "You show Your unwavering compassion to them, Oh Great One!"]
1110.english_pathavurai: The obedient sons and women standing around the body reverently covering it with a precious silk cloth; then garlanding the body, hugging the long pAdai (bier) and breaking into crying; once they take a dip in the wavy water, their remaining grief leaves them; before my people behaving like strangers begin to set fire of a golden hue upon my body, and prior to the expiry of my life, kindly grant me a life with an ever-growing intellect to praise Your hallowed feet everyday with love in my heart! He made up His mind to destroy Manmathan (God of Love) bearing the bow of sugarcane; He is the Lord MahAdEvar, with three eyes (Sun, Moon and Fire); He is Lord SivA who is every thing and omnipresent; You are His great Treasure! The unfathomable and vast sea dried up and the old demon SUran was killed when Your mighty spear ascended and attacked, Oh Lord! The people of the world, the celestials and the sages who came from many directions surrounded You as You came around, mounted on the exultant peacock! Your devotees come to You daily as if they seek to visit their cherished treasure that is saved; protecting those devotees, You show Your unwavering compassion to them, Oh Great One!

1111.english_meanings_list: ["These lotus flowers have blossomed without any involvement of water or earth; (these are the four-petaled lotus MUlAthAram*, the six-petaled one SwAdhishtAnam, the ten-petaled one maNipUragam, the twelve-petaled one anAgatham, the 16-petaled one visuththi, and the 2 or 3-petaled one Agnai); climbing up through these centres (in the path of Siva-yOgA),", "mingling directly with the effulgence of SivA, with an immeasurable length and breadth, which flame is the result of the loving union of SivA and His Consort, Shakthi,", "remaining there with unswerving devotion,", "and entering the bright and spectacular zone that could never be reached by the rays of the sun or the moon,", "I wish to dance with joy, exclaiming \"He is the Lord MurugA who mounts the feathered peacock\";", "for that, kindly grant me Your sparkling spear and the kadappa garland!", "All parts of the sea shuddered and shrank; the thousand-hooded serpent, AdhisEshan, scrammed away with his mouth ajar;", "(while it ran amuk), its precious gems scattered all over in the eight directions like falling stars;", "as You flew on the gracefully dancing peacock, Oh Lord with the unique rooster on Your staff!", "BrahmA and His father, VishNu, who are even now seeking (in vain to locate His head and feet), sing His glory;", "He is the Cosmic dancer; He is the reddish effulgence, Lord of ThiruvaNNAmalai; You are the child of that Lord SivA!", "The elephant-faced GaNapathi came running in search of VaLLi's place because of", "Your exquisite love for her; Your form is one of brilliant radiance, Oh Great One!"]
1111.english_pathavurai: These lotus flowers have blossomed without any involvement of water or earth; (these are the four-petaled lotus MUlAthAram*, the six-petaled one SwAdhishtAnam, the ten-petaled one maNipUragam, the twelve-petaled one anAgatham, the 16-petaled one visuththi, and the 2 or 3-petaled one Agnai); climbing up through these centres (in the path of Siva-yOgA), mingling directly with the effulgence of SivA, with an immeasurable length and breadth, which flame is the result of the loving union of SivA and His Consort, Shakthi, remaining there with unswerving devotion, and entering the bright and spectacular zone that could never be reached by the rays of the sun or the moon, I wish to dance with joy, exclaiming "He is the Lord MurugA who mounts the feathered peacock"; for that, kindly grant me Your sparkling spear and the kadappa garland! All parts of the sea shuddered and shrank; the thousand-hooded serpent, AdhisEshan, scrammed away with his mouth ajar; (while it ran amuk), its precious gems scattered all over in the eight directions like falling stars; as You flew on the gracefully dancing peacock, Oh Lord with the unique rooster on Your staff! BrahmA and His father, VishNu, who are even now seeking (in vain to locate His head and feet), sing His glory; He is the Cosmic dancer; He is the reddish effulgence, Lord of ThiruvaNNAmalai; You are the child of that Lord SivA! The elephant-faced GaNapathi came running in search of VaLLi's place because of Your exquisite love for her; Your form is one of brilliant radiance, Oh Great One!

1112.english_meanings_list: ["I want to drop off desires like the hand flings a burning hot stuff.", "I want to reach the state of blissful wisdom, devoid of worldly miseries.", "I want to have the vision of the spotless and unfettered cosmos that is beyond words and perception and is featureless.", "That which pervades the blossoming lotus chakrAs*, the six fundamental kundalini centres, and transcends them, and is superior to the moon showering nectar;", "that which is different from the ninety-six** tenets (30+36+30 = 96); and that which is the manifested symbol of sublime silence; will I ever attain that?", "BrahmA ran away screaming in unbearable pain; Mount Krouncha collapsed;", "the seven seas with rising waves became dry;", "millions of hostile demons and their leaders were destroyed;", "and the matchless demon, SUran, died when You hurled Your victorious spear with all the might of Your twelve shoulders, Oh Valiant One!", "She guarded the millet field; she is VaLLi, the virtuous woman; and You hugged her shoulders, Oh Upright One!", "The celestials worship You steadfastly, Oh Great One!"]
1112.english_pathavurai: I want to drop off desires like the hand flings a burning hot stuff. I want to reach the state of blissful wisdom, devoid of worldly miseries. I want to have the vision of the spotless and unfettered cosmos that is beyond words and perception and is featureless. That which pervades the blossoming lotus chakrAs*, the six fundamental kundalini centres, and transcends them, and is superior to the moon showering nectar; that which is different from the ninety-six** tenets (30+36+30 = 96); and that which is the manifested symbol of sublime silence; will I ever attain that? BrahmA ran away screaming in unbearable pain; Mount Krouncha collapsed; the seven seas with rising waves became dry; millions of hostile demons and their leaders were destroyed; and the matchless demon, SUran, died when You hurled Your victorious spear with all the might of Your twelve shoulders, Oh Valiant One! She guarded the millet field; she is VaLLi, the virtuous woman; and You hugged her shoulders, Oh Upright One! The celestials worship You steadfastly, Oh Great One!
