Your hallowed feet have gone round the entire world, Oh Lord! You are the Lord of the celestials who worship You ardently, Oh Great One!

1114.english_meanings_list: ["Like the bird falling into the trap losing all its energy, I too was ensnared in the actions of tenets and became weak;", "turning into a useless muck on this earth, I began to speak falteringly;", "whenever I deviate from the righteous path,", "kindly bring me a little closer to Your devotees who have realised pure liberation; to enable me to get rid of the (spiritual) poverty of this lowly self;", "please come to me fast, mounting, and flying at breakneck speed, Your vehicle, the green, horse-like and triumphant peacock, whose feet are of the hue of coral and pearl!", "You are the younger brother of the wise elephant-faced God, Ganapathi, with a huge coral-coloured pot-belly!", "You hold in Your hand the victorious and powerful spear, Oh MurugA!", "Your peacock with green plumes made the mount Krouncha and the eight directions rotate around their axis, Oh valorous One!", "He is the Leader with a long matted hair and three eyes (namely, the sun, the moon and fire); His clothing is nothing but the cosmos; this Lord is seated in KAnchipuram, and to that SivA You preached, Oh Great Master!", "Your heart melted for DEvayAnai, the parrot-like damsel of the celestial world of KaRpaga trees; and You got hold of VaLLi, the chaste belle reared by the hunters who were devoted to Your hallowed feet; and You hugged her, Oh Great One!"]
1114.english_pathavurai: Like the bird falling into the trap losing all its energy, I too was ensnared in the actions of tenets and became weak; turning into a useless muck on this earth, I began to speak falteringly; whenever I deviate from the righteous path, kindly bring me a little closer to Your devotees who have realised pure liberation; to enable me to get rid of the (spiritual) poverty of this lowly self; please come to me fast, mounting, and flying at breakneck speed, Your vehicle, the green, horse-like and triumphant peacock, whose feet are of the hue of coral and pearl! You are the younger brother of the wise elephant-faced God, Ganapathi, with a huge coral-coloured pot-belly! You hold in Your hand the victorious and powerful spear, Oh MurugA! Your peacock with green plumes made the mount Krouncha and the eight directions rotate around their axis, Oh valorous One! He is the Leader with a long matted hair and three eyes (namely, the sun, the moon and fire); His clothing is nothing but the cosmos; this Lord is seated in KAnchipuram, and to that SivA You preached, Oh Great Master! Your heart melted for DEvayAnai, the parrot-like damsel of the celestial world of KaRpaga trees; and You got hold of VaLLi, the chaste belle reared by the hunters who were devoted to Your hallowed feet; and You hugged her, Oh Great One!

1115.english_meanings_list: ["The children, the relatives, the wife, the brothers standing by and other elders like the master,", "along with my collection of copper coins and the jewels embedded with gems and pearls, in addition to (whatever that would never accompany me) a large group of my servants", "have all assembled together, beginning to grieve; as they place my body on the crematory pyre consigning it to leaping flames,", "I do not wish to melt down from attachment to this myth of a body;", "will there be a day when You will kindly fill me with an abundance of intellect so that I could worship You, offering flowers and praising Your hallowed and compassionate feet?", "On His reddish and dense matted hair, He wears plenty of feathers of the crane, River Gangai that flows down to the earth and the crescent moon; to that Lord SivA,", "imparting into His mind lucidly, You preached, with grace, the most benevolent principle of ultimate liberation, that stands very firm, Oh Lord!", "When he assumed the disguise of a mango tree, with all its limbs intact, and hid inside the dark sea, You surrounded the demon SUran and his clan annihilating them in one bunch with Your sharp spear, Oh Lord!", "With Your valorous and triumphant shield, You entered the battlefield to fight, at times approaching the enemies very closely and some times remaining at a distance, so that a few were pierced with the spear and some were beheaded with the sword, Oh Great One!"]
1115.english_pathavurai: The children, the relatives, the wife, the brothers standing by and other elders like the master, along with my collection of copper coins and the jewels embedded with gems and pearls, in addition to (whatever that would never accompany me) a large group of my servants have all assembled together, beginning to grieve; as they place my body on the crematory pyre consigning it to leaping flames, I do not wish to melt down from attachment to this myth of a body; will there be a day when You will kindly fill me with an abundance of intellect so that I could worship You, offering flowers and praising Your hallowed and compassionate feet? On His reddish and dense matted hair, He wears plenty of feathers of the crane, River Gangai that flows down to the earth and the crescent moon; to that Lord SivA, imparting into His mind lucidly, You preached, with grace, the most benevolent principle of ultimate liberation, that stands very firm, Oh Lord! When he assumed the disguise of a mango tree, with all its limbs intact, and hid inside the dark sea, You surrounded the demon SUran and his clan annihilating them in one bunch with Your sharp spear, Oh Lord! With Your valorous and triumphant shield, You entered the battlefield to fight, at times approaching the enemies very closely and some times remaining at a distance, so that a few were pierced with the spear and some were beheaded with the sword, Oh Great One!

1116.english_meanings_list: ["This body is constituted by the five elements that could cause ill-omens;", "to nurture that body, I managed to run along with it; whenever I faced perils, my heart filled up with worries and I used to bemoan little by little until my sobbing became loud;", "I pretended to act like people fully involved in family life and totally devoted to God;", "kindly teach me the true knowledge that stands alone, way beyond the reach of all those worldly attachments!", "To help the DEvAs who used to live in the beautiful and golden celestial land, You went to the battlefield; You confronted the demons and knocked down the mount Krouncha;", "You entered the sea approaching the demon in disguise (as a mango tree) and wielded the spear piercing that SUran and smashing him to pieces, Oh Lord!", "When the Poet (PoyyAmozhi) first sang a song, there was a flaw in the meaning; You pointed out the flaw and offered him a revised song with correct meaning, Oh Lord!*", "You are like a rare pearl! You are the deity in charge of three kinds of holy sacrificial fires**! You are impeccably pure!", "You are totally detached! You are the only one that can grant us liberation, Oh Great One!"]
1116.english_pathavurai: This body is constituted by the five elements that could cause ill-omens; to nurture that body, I managed to run along with it; whenever I faced perils, my heart filled up with worries and I used to bemoan little by little until my sobbing became loud; I pretended to act like people fully involved in family life and totally devoted to God; kindly teach me the true knowledge that stands alone, way beyond the reach of all those worldly attachments! To help the DEvAs who used to live in the beautiful and golden celestial land, You went to the battlefield; You confronted the demons and knocked down the mount Krouncha; You entered the sea approaching the demon in disguise (as a mango tree) and wielded the spear piercing that SUran and smashing him to pieces, Oh Lord! When the Poet (PoyyAmozhi) first sang a song, there was a flaw in the meaning; You pointed out the flaw and offered him a revised song with correct meaning, Oh Lord!* You are like a rare pearl! You are the deity in charge of three kinds of holy sacrificial fires**! You are impeccably pure! You are totally detached! You are the only one that can grant us liberation, Oh Great One!

1117.english_pathavurai: They kick and lambast; their reddish eyes are so fiery that fire and light pale in comparison; their teeth are crooked like the crescent moon and sharp like the sword; they are the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) who tie with their rope (of attachment) shaking my body, tossing it about with rage and are ready to take me away; before that, my relatives, friends, parents and all other surrounding me say "We shall not let you go; do not leave us yet" so saying repeatedly, they stand close by, showering their love; Who else (other than God) could stand guard at the time of death? Hitting at the strong jaws of the enemies, You knocked off their teeth with Your arrow, Oh Lord! She stands guard to the fertile crop of millet in the field; You prostrate at the beautiful feet of that VaLLi! They have realised true knowledge which is ripe and never shallow; in the hearts of those devotees, You are happily seated! You are like a rare pearl! You are the deity in charge of three kinds of holy fires*! You are impeccably pure! You are totally detached! You are the only one that can grant us liberation, Oh Great One!

1118.english_pathavurai: With carefully chosen select words that are sweet as honey and potent with meaning, I fluently sang a few songs like glib poets praising some rich people in flattering and untrue language; I roamed about in vain falsely portraying myself as an intellectual scholar; You take care of me like my comforting parents, showering Your love on me; will I be privileged to prostrate at Your hallowed feet and praise them at least to a little extent? The celestials pleaded to You loudly saying "Please mount the illustrious peacock swiftly and protect us; we seek Your refuge!" While they encircled You in the sky and on the earth, You confronted the demon, SUran, and fought, maiming him with Your spear, Oh Lord! You eradicate the past deeds of, and bless, the devotees who worship Your feet unswervingly! You are like a rare pearl! You are the deity in charge of three kinds of holy fires*! You are impeccably pure! You are totally detached! You are the only one that can grant us liberation, Oh Great One!

1120.english_pathavurai: Ten, seven times eight (56), two times eight (16) and seven times two (14), totalling ninety-six (10+56+16+14 = 96) tenets* have been assembled in an orderly way to make this bag of skin, a little cottage subject to wear and tear, namely this body; it is propelled by attachments to seek ways and means of nourishing (that very body); it runs to many countries and adapts very well to the conditions in those countries; it even travels up to the farthest seven islands, becomes weak, hangs on to those places with relish and desire and eventually loses the strength in the vital blood cells; am I destined to go through this motion of miseries? You are the true principle and an ever youthful One! By destroying the demon SUran, along with his entire army, and the Mount Krouncha, You established justice, Oh Bright One! You have six hallowed foreheads wearing the shining holy ash (VibUthi)! On Your broad chest You wear those garlands of kAnthaL and vetchi flowers! You are the cherished treasure that is beyond the reach of people with the three kinds of desires (namely, property, women and gold)! Oh Wizard of Knowledge! You are the leader of all those who have attained realisation in this birth! You are like a rare pearl! You are the deity in charge of three kinds of holy fires**! You are impeccably pure! You are totally detached! You are the only one that can grant us liberation, Oh Great One!

1121.english_pathavurai: For the collection of gold coins and several other material things, these whores bargain against their offer of short-lived carnal pleasure. Craving for their false words and beautiful bodies, and to pay for experiencing that pleasure, I went about in search of money, running to many towns in the south, to many other towns like KAsi (VAraNAsi) in the north, dashing to all places in the east and scurrying to many centres in the west, sailing by ships going overseas, and running to many far-off islands in several oceans. Why am I ruining myself in this way? Meditating upon You, many devotees hold You in their mind, enabling them to seek safer haven, because You are the Supreme One worshipped by them. While people at large seek steadfastly every day, the three purushArthas of DharmA, Artha and KAmA (meaning, righteousness, material wealth and enjoyment) and stop short of seeking Mukthi (liberation, the fourth purushArtha),* You once proceeded voluntarily to reach the forest to graciously meet VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, and stood right in front of her in the disguise of a neem tree in the valley of Mount VaLLimalai . You are like a rare pearl! You are the deity in charge of three kinds of holy fires!** You are impeccably pure! You are totally detached! You are the only one that can grant us liberation, Oh Great One!

1124.english_pathavurai: All the fifty-one letters of the alphabets starting with "a" (51 letters being in Sanskrit); all the arts of this world; the varieties of Thathvas (tenets - in all 96)*; and VEdAs (scriptures) of immeasurable vastness This unique Entity containing them all in itself! This Entity, an eternal Bliss of Knowledge, that can be perceived by those who can feel its omnipresence. The ultimate vision experienced by Yogis (sages) in trance. That purest substance without a beginning, a middle or an end, tinier than the minutest particle of an atom, which manifests in the heart of those who have gotten rid of the three slags (namely, arrogance, karma and delusion), the four aspects of mind (namely intellect, free-will, egoism and desire) and the three qualities (namely sattvam, rajas and thamas). which ultimately remains as the One and only One, that has no fullness nor deficiency nor degeneration and is omniscient and which is matchless. Such a unique Entity was addressed by even Lord SivA, who burnt down Thirisiram that was constantly orbiting the sky, as follows ... "Oh Lord, Great Master, KumarA" - like this Lord SivA worshipped MurugA with devotion. You blessed Him with the "ManthrA of Silence"**. Kindly initiate me, Your old traditional slave, also into it in a sweet, vivid and graceful manner. Repeatedly sounding like the meters given the drums made of leather beaten by the left hand (idakkai), hand-drums (udukkai) and other drum instruments were making a rattling noise; in that din, the earth split apart; the erect ghosts jumped about dancing; the entire world was awestruck; Bhairava MUrthis (SivA's disciples) were ecstatic and danced non-stop; in the battlefield where the demons (asuras) were dying, millions of old eagles, crows, vultures and other birds were eating away the flesh from the dead bodies; blood was gushing in the field like a river; several beheaded torsos were dancing about everywhere; and the drums were beaten loudly to proclaim victory, when You conquered the asuras and redeemed the Kingdom of IndrA and gave it to him gracefully, Oh Great One!

1125.english_pathavurai: These people have mastered treachery and are extremely vicious. These idlers are merciless, having a knack of sweet talk, and are wicked. They are foolish, devoid of any love, roaming about in a destructive path. They are swayed by waves of extreme passion, adopting despicable means. They are full of sins giving rise to bad deeds. These dim-witted people feel at home in the places of those without any compassion. These arrogant ones have a confused mind that leads them only to hell. I have been roaming about in search of places where such people reside; I composed songs permanently casting their bodies and limbs in poetry, comparing them to Lord VishNu who swallowed the earth, Manmathan, the God of Love and the wish-yielding kaRpaga tree in the celestial world; accepting whatever they had to offer, I have ben whiling away my life; will this base profession never leave me at all? Oh Great Master, You imbibed the nectar of milk from the breasts of the dark-haired Goddess PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn, the Mountain-King! You are the nephew of VishNu, who as Rama wielded the arrow drying up the wavy sea! She is matchless and full of grace and comes from the lineage of the KuRavAs; You were united with that VaLLi in wed-lock, Oh KumarA! Mounting the peacock, You flew swiftly around in all the eight directions in a fraction of a second, Oh Young Lord! He burnt down the Thiripuram by His fiery smile; He dances on the cosmic stage; on the left side of the body of that Lord SivA, She is concorporate; She is Mother Sivai, the beautiful Goddess PArvathi; and You are Her child! IndrA, who mounts the mountain-like white elephant, AyrAvadham, and the DevAs who lived in the celestial world were all freed from their prison when You wielded the sharp spear, Oh Great One!

1126.english_pathavurai: I had an uncontrollable passion for women; my eyes were roving over all the limbs of women from foot to toe and my mind was spoilt; and having lost my morals, I was consumed by the devil of lust. I became a totally indisciplined character. I felt so unclean, running hither and thither daily. To save me from further degeneration, (You have to appear before me with) Your twelve shoulders and six holy faces, adorned by the ever fragrant garland of kadappa flowers, with the majestic peacock looking like a blue horse. Even those who are not Your devotees will praise You out of love, and all evil things will be gone! 1127.english_pathavurai: In the ostentatious ways people make their offerings during worship, in their continuous and obsessive meditations, in the various yantras (metal sheets) upon which the deities are invoked, in the grand display of the prayer hall with sixteen stone pillars, in then loud chanting of the VEdAs and AgamAs in the heaps of pyres (samiththu) offered to burn in the sacrifices - in none of these You are awestruck or carried away. You are delighted to bathe in the abundant tears of ecstasy (from Your devotees)! You are elated at the chanting of the primordial PraNava ManthrA, OM! In order that the concept of You and Me (as duality-dwaitham) is gone and Oneness (adhwaitham) is achieved, You should call me here towards You without any differentiation, offer me the blissful heaven as wide as the ocean and immediately bestow on me the Supreme joy of Liberation! You are the seat of valour! Mother Durga and the multitude of Her armies (bUthaganAs), strategically assembled, were delighted; and the herd of (corpse-eating) fiends had a hey-day when You fought in the battlefield! BrahmA screamed in awe and sought Your refuge; the skies hovering the worlds were shattered; the mango tree, in which SUran disguised himself, was uprooted; the vadavAgni* and the seven seas were completely swallowed; in the battle with mighty SUran, all his arrows were chopped; and, in addition, his bow, the source of the arrows, was lanced by Your dazzling Spear! To rule their Celestial land, You beckoned the DEvAs again and again and redressed their misery, Oh Great One!

1128.english_pathavurai: Those eyes look like a spear that contains the poison AalakAlam; they extend right up to the beautiful dangling ear-studs as if to wage war with them; they follow indifferent people right through in order to catch their attention; by such eyes of the whores when people are ensnared, and while the victims are surrounding them, they make sure that the trapped ones are unable to get out; they play their tricks of trade for a price so cleverly that the victims lose their sense of judgment; they exhibit all their glamour in a moment leaving them with a broken heart and a melting mind; if they receive only a portion of what they solicited, they would just disappear from the scene, let alone having a conversation with them; they are vain people who show only superficial friendship rather than true amity; they simply leave their patrons to fall into their destruction; these whores are such sinners; is it fair that I suffer the miserable fear that results from all their mirth? All the celestials headed by VishNu, who slumbers on the milky ocean, marched towards Mount KailAsh; they let their eyes wander over that mountain (wondering what happened to the mission they all entrusted to Manmathan to shoot arrows on Lord SivA); when they were doubting the outcome, Manmathan's charred body, along with his bow of sugarcane, fell on the earth in sparks and flames; he was thus burnt down by the wisest Lord SivA; and You are the child of that SivA! You move with Your devotees with spontaneous love, Oh Lord! Once, when enemies in the form of demons filled up all the four directions, You annihilated them all, along with Mount Krouncha where they lived and their seven hills, by fighting with Your dazzling spear, Oh Lord! You graciously liberated the celestials from their prison; with inexhaustible valour, You first imprisoned Lord BrahmA with undiminished valour and later bestowed Your grace upon Him, Oh Great One!

1129.english_pathavurai: You gifted me the imperishable Spiritual Knowledge and an interest in the scriptural texts worth researching into. You gave me the ability to cross the sea of desire without losing myself in this turbulent and delusory life and deteriorating to the point of death. You elevated me to a height that is beyond the reach of words. You made the lowly me into a very famous person with the pleasant realisation that all people and things in the seven worlds are none other than myself; attaining that state of non-duality was the basis of my fame! You made me compose excellent poems of Your glory and sing them with nectar-like sweetness. You granted me the greatness so that any of my writings or letters sent in any direction were revered with royal respect. The three major slags (namely, arrogance, karma and delusion) that could never cross the sea of misery, the three gunAs (qualities, namely, sathwam, rAjasam and thAmasam - meaning, tranquility, aggressiveness and lethargy) this birth, transient like an air-bubble in water, and afflicted by several sins (such as lust, anger, covetousness, ignorance, pride, envy, stubbornness and prejudice) - all these were obliterated by You in the nicest manner by way of a blessing gesture that could never be forgotten by me! The giant serpent VAsuki was tied firmly as the string; and the matchless huge Mount MEru was held as the bow; the great Lord, VishNu, was used as the arrow to be wielded; of the demons actively involved in sinful deeds in Thiripuram, except three individuals,* were shattered to pieces when He once grinned from the eye in His forehead; You are the Treasure of that Supremely Erudite Lord SivA! "Oh Lord, You are the Consort of DEvayAnai, who lived in the grove of KaRpaga trees in the celestial land and who was gifted as the daughter of, and raised by, IndrA" - so praised the virtuous DEvAs who were protected; You slayed and subdued the demon SUran who never contemplated Your mighty hallowed feet; the Mount Krouncha was smashed, and because of the demons' blood gushing like mud, the sea itself rose like a solid mass of mountain; and the host of recalcitrant demons were slaughtered to pieces hither and thither by Your mighty sword, Oh Great One!

1130.english_meanings_list: ["Picking up a furious spear and filling it completely with poison,", "(using that spear as) the eyesthat run up to, and impinge on, both ears and come back to position, these whores spread their eyes, which are like the kayal fish, as the net, beckoning (men) sweetly and enticing them into their homes;", "hiding their face with a piece of cloth, they provocatively expose their two mountain-like breasts that press the blouse; then, they conclude negotiation of the price due to them;", "they loosen their curly hair filled with flowers with petals fully blossomed, shake the hair and then refasten it into a tuft;", "they stand in the street giggling uncontrollably; when they spot people from whom steady income is assured without any change, they readily grab their money in advance;", "why am I losing my heart utterly to these whores' speech and weakening due to excessive passion?", "She is the most beautiful Goddess pervading the entire world; She is praised by the VEdAs; She has a very slender waist;", "Her matted hair, adorned with the crescent moon, falls down gracefully; with two measures of paddy, this Supreme Deity performed (in Kanchipuram) the thirty-two religious duties*;", "Her shoulder-bands are studded with precious gems and diamonds; She goes with relish in several directions looking prominent; She has the complexion of a famous blue tinge; She wears the sari made of the skin of the murderous tiger;", "She mounts the huge bull (Nandhi) which has a raging face ready to go to war; She is the younger sister of Lord VishNu, who gobbled up the entire world; and You are the great Treasure of that Goddess PArvathi, Oh Lord!", "You brandished the sword upon the fervent prayer of Lord VishNu and Lord Brahma and liberated the vast multitude of the celestials;", "and You wielded Your spear to annihilate the entire clan of demons, Oh Great One!"]
1130.english_pathavurai: Picking up a furious spear and filling it completely with poison, (using that spear as) the eyesthat run up to, and impinge on, both ears and come back to position, these whores spread their eyes, which are like the kayal fish, as the net, beckoning (men) sweetly and enticing them into their homes; hiding their face with a piece of cloth, they provocatively expose their two mountain-like breasts that press the blouse; then, they conclude negotiation of the price due to them; they loosen their curly hair filled with flowers with petals fully blossomed, shake the hair and then refasten it into a tuft; they stand in the street giggling uncontrollably; when they spot people from whom steady income is assured without any change, they readily grab their money in advance; why am I losing my heart utterly to these whores' speech and weakening due to excessive passion? She is the most beautiful Goddess pervading the entire world; She is praised by the VEdAs; She has a very slender waist; Her matted hair, adorned with the crescent moon, falls down gracefully; with two measures of paddy, this Supreme Deity performed (in Kanchipuram) the thirty-two religious duties*; Her shoulder-bands are studded with precious gems and diamonds; She goes with relish in several directions looking prominent; She has the complexion of a famous blue tinge; She wears the sari made of the skin of the murderous tiger; She mounts the huge bull (Nandhi) which has a raging face ready to go to war; She is the younger sister of Lord VishNu, who gobbled up the entire world; and You are the great Treasure of that Goddess PArvathi, Oh Lord! You brandished the sword upon the fervent prayer of Lord VishNu and Lord Brahma and liberated the vast multitude of the celestials; and You wielded Your spear to annihilate the entire clan of demons, Oh Great One!

1131.english_meanings_list: ["This body is the place where all miseries gang up and stay for good relentlessly; this myth of a body will be eventually placed amidst burning fire;", "dear relatives and sons will cry their hearts out, stating their relationship appropriately in many a word;", "later, the disheartened relatives will depart, leaving behind their grief;", "Yaman, the God of Death, with reddish eyes that emit excessive poison, with a determination to destroy,", "will pluck away the seed of my life; before that event, in order that my past deeds and attachments perish,", "will I be blessed with the privilege of singing everyday, using fresh words, the greatness of Your triumphant and hallowed shoulders*, adorned with vetchi garland?", "He is Your Father, Lord SivA, who wears the beautiful crescent moon and River Gangai on His thick, hallowed and matted hair;", "You taught Him the meaning of PraNava ManthrA which is full of Knowledge!", "The hunger of herds of devils was satisfied when many of them, vying with one another, laid their hands and began plucking the corpses; in that scuffle, the devils screamed in pain and resorted to a brawl; such was the mighty war You waged against the demons, with Your spear, Oh Lord!", "He is in the form of a green mountain, slumbering consciously on the serpent-bed of AdhisEshan over the milky ocean, adored by His devotees; He is Lord VishNu holding a disc in His hand;", "He is the tall creator, Lord BrahmA, seated on a lotus; to these two and for all those in the eight directions, You are the Emperor-Lord, Oh Great One!"]
1131.english_pathavurai: This body is the place where all miseries gang up and stay for good relentlessly; this myth of a body will be eventually placed amidst burning fire; dear relatives and sons will cry their hearts out, stating their relationship appropriately in many a word; later, the disheartened relatives will depart, leaving behind their grief; Yaman, the God of Death, with reddish eyes that emit excessive poison, with a determination to destroy, will pluck away the seed of my life; before that event, in order that my past deeds and attachments perish, will I be blessed with the privilege of singing everyday, using fresh words, the greatness of Your triumphant and hallowed shoulders*, adorned with vetchi garland? He is Your Father, Lord SivA, who wears the beautiful crescent moon and River Gangai on His thick, hallowed and matted hair; You taught Him the meaning of PraNava ManthrA which is full of Knowledge! The hunger of herds of devils was satisfied when many of them, vying with one another, laid their hands and began plucking the corpses; in that scuffle, the devils screamed in pain and resorted to a brawl; such was the mighty war You waged against the demons, with Your spear, Oh Lord! He is in the form of a green mountain, slumbering consciously on the serpent-bed of AdhisEshan over the milky ocean, adored by His devotees; He is Lord VishNu holding a disc in His hand; He is the tall creator, Lord BrahmA, seated on a lotus; to these two and for all those in the eight directions, You are the Emperor-Lord, Oh Great One!

1132.english_meanings_list: ["In contrast to the flowery arrows wielded angrily and with intensity by Manmathan (God of Love) from his hand (acting as rival arrows),", "attacking the two swinging ear-studs, differing from the sea with abundant water (feeling wider and deeper), driving all the deer away (shying into the forest being belittled by their eyes' eminent beauty),", "looking like the spear that tore the sea (drying it out), their eyes contain the nectar and AlakAla poison together within them; with such a net of their eyes,", "they persecute the lives of young and strong men, by hooking them (with those eyes) and bring them under their control; making love to such whores,", "imbibing the sugarcane-like sweet saliva oozing from the reddish, kovvai-fruit-like lips of their (babbling) mouth, hugging their nectar-filled bosom adorned with a string of bud-like pearls,", "and sinking in the blissful pond of their navel, I do not wish to be destroyed by drowning; for that, kindly grant me Your benevolent and hallowed feet, Oh Lord!", "He lived in LankA surrounded by wavy seas; the ten heads and twenty well-formed shoulders of that RAvaNan were knocked down by the unique arrow wielded by RAmA; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "Oh Lord MurugA, You prevail in the fundamental principle of clear and lucid Knowledge!", "In Thiripuram surrounded by protective fortress walls, there lived three* saivite devotees who worshipped Him, constantly meditating upon Him; (even though He burnt down Thiripuram,) He took pity on the three devotees and graciously saved their lives; He is the unique Lord SivA who prostrated at Your feet as His Master, Oh Lord!", "Realising the wide principle that is older than the oldest and is the end of all ends, these devotees sing hymns day and night, with a melting heart; You are delighted to listen to those songs, Oh Great One!"]
1132.english_pathavurai: In contrast to the flowery arrows wielded angrily and with intensity by Manmathan (God of Love) from his hand (acting as rival arrows), attacking the two swinging ear-studs, differing from the sea with abundant water (feeling wider and deeper), driving all the deer away (shying into the forest being belittled by their eyes' eminent beauty), looking like the spear that tore the sea (drying it out), their eyes contain the nectar and AlakAla poison together within them; with such a net of their eyes, they persecute the lives of young and strong men, by hooking them (with those eyes) and bring them under their control; making love to such whores, imbibing the sugarcane-like sweet saliva oozing from the reddish, kovvai-fruit-like lips of their (babbling) mouth, hugging their nectar-filled bosom adorned with a string of bud-like pearls, and sinking in the blissful pond of their navel, I do not wish to be destroyed by drowning; for that, kindly grant me Your benevolent and hallowed feet, Oh Lord! He lived in LankA surrounded by wavy seas; the ten heads and twenty well-formed shoulders of that RAvaNan were knocked down by the unique arrow wielded by RAmA; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Oh Lord MurugA, You prevail in the fundamental principle of clear and lucid Knowledge! In Thiripuram surrounded by protective fortress walls, there lived three* saivite devotees who worshipped Him, constantly meditating upon Him; (even though He burnt down Thiripuram,) He took pity on the three devotees and graciously saved their lives; He is the unique Lord SivA who prostrated at Your feet as His Master, Oh Lord! Realising the wide principle that is older than the oldest and is the end of all ends, these devotees sing hymns day and night, with a melting heart; You are delighted to listen to those songs, Oh Great One!

1133.english_pathavurai: Day and night, without slackening, misery afflicts me continuously everyday; The hunger in the stomach is like a fire giving rise to desires in a big way. Life is nothing but excessive labour in search of food, with constant bickering and arguments. In between, several days elapse, and I grow old. My hair becomes increasingly grey, and I am branded as "the old man". My steps begin to falter, and I start stumbling. My eyes begin to lose their vision. When shall I, the poor me, see the dawn? (in other words, when will my miseries end?) Will I perish without attaining the blissful heaven where Lord NadarAjA dances with a bent and raised leg? She has feet that execute the holy dance; She dons the holy ash; She wears eardrops shaped like the makara fish; She is Durga known as MAri; She is MahA KALi; She ignited the fire in Thiripuram; She is the ultimate refuge; She is the most beautiful; She occupies the left side of Lord SivA's body; She has a blue complexion; She holds a lance in her hand; She is known as Gowri; She offers protection as the fifth Sakthi; She is Our Mother; She is the Greatest Mystic (MahA MAyee); She is the Consort of SivA; She is the Goddess in the form of a little girl; She is the purest Celestial named PArvathi; and You are Her Child! The anklets in Your feet make lilting sound, Oh valorous and Courageous One! You are the luminous Lord protecting all mountains! You place Your holy feet on the heads of Your devotees! You are the honey-like sweet Consort of VaLLi, the beautiful and young damsel of the KuRavAs! The Trinity of Vishnu, SivA and BrahmA, King IndrA, the DEvAs in the large Celestial Land, GandharvAs and all others worship You, Oh Great One!

1139.english_pathavurai: In this world, many women including the wife, sons, close relatives and other well-to-do family members assemble, with profound grief, as next of kin (at the death bed); so ordains Yaman, the God of Death. In order to brighten all the fourteen worlds and to dispel darkness, the moon rises in the sky; that moon rests on His beautiful tresses; He mounts the great bull, Nandi; He is Lord SivA, who has kind words for His devotees; He holds in His two hands a deer and a pick-axe; to the delight of that SivA, You preached to Him graciously! Mount Krouncha was pierced and split into two parts; the vast sea was totally shaken; people in this beautiful world were terrified and sought Your refuge; and kings of the demons, bereft of power, lost their lustre; when You astounded all by wielding Your sharp spear, Oh Wise One! The celestials, IndrAs and sages worshipped You with flowers in their hands when You elegantly mounted Your unique and beautiful peacock and came to bless all, Oh Great One!

You hold the spear in Your hand, Oh wonderful Lord! You mount the peacock valiantly! You conquered the valorous armies of the demons and killed them triumphantly! 1158.english_pathavurai: The relatives, children and the wife with soothing words are all dismayed (looking at the wetness near the patient) wondering whether it is his urine or plain water; (talking among themselves) they conclude that the disease is about to make the patient bedridden; weeping with grief and feeling miserable, they approach the body; in preparation for consigning the body to fire, they walk with a pot of fire against the background noise of drums sounding like "thokku thoku thoku thokku"; discussion ensues as to which is the appropriate time to cover the corpse with a cloth; as the body has totally deteriorated, talk prevails as follows - "Any moment, the bondage between the body and the soul is to break and when the rhythm stops, life will escape; and the pulse has now reached the lowest level"; amidst a lot of commotion, people, with their hands held on their heads in sorrow, spread around the word that with the pulse failing, there is no way the life can be saved; at that very moment when my life departs from the body, kindly grant me Your two hallowed feet! As several drums and percussion instruments are beaten in the battlefield, raising sound in an appropriate manner, and in order that IndrA, the King of the Celestials, leads a steady life truthfully, You fought the war shattering the bodies of the demons and their clan to pieces, Oh Great One!

1159.english_meanings_list: ["Even the sOmayAjees*, who have performed sacrifices by setting up (hOmA) pits where smoke rises amid flames of fire,", "fall flat at their two lotus feet in surrender; so powerful are their cantankerous eyes;", "even those warriors who are immune to temptations of the sensory organs and the eight kinds of vices, namely, lust, frenzy, avarice, stubbornness, jealosy, passion, anger and miserliness and who have certain strong characteristics radiating their prowess of sacrifice are conquered by these whores;", "these women have sharp eyes capable of severing the bodies (of their victims); I became absolutely obsessed with passion, yearning for such whores;", "in order that my mind is not destroyed, being shrouded by the darkness called ignorance, and to enable me to research into the beautiful bright light of non-hostility that is the dawning knowledge,", "will You not kindly grant me pure love and present me with Your matchless hallowed feet, the seat of grace?", "He wears on His matted hair fragrant kurA garland, cool kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower, thuLasi and Aththi (mountain ebony) leaves, venerable river Gangai, the moon with beautiful phases and flowers from the creeper eekai and the plant erukkai;", "He wears the serpent as the dangling ear-stud and holds in His hand the bow, PinAkam, as His weapon; when that Lord SivA, along with", "Lord VishNu, who holds in His hands the conch-shell, the disc and the mace, fervently appealed to beseeching \"Oh Our Treasure! kindly set free the celestials from their prison\",", "You rendered the leader of the demons, SUran, miserable without any support; Lord BrahmA seated on the VEdAs was terrified; and the Mount Krouncha was shattered to pieces;", "when You wielded Your speedy and strong weapon, the Spear, which is the symbol of valour, Oh Great One!"]
1159.english_pathavurai: Even the sOmayAjees*, who have performed sacrifices by setting up (hOmA) pits where smoke rises amid flames of fire, fall flat at their two lotus feet in surrender; so powerful are their cantankerous eyes; even those warriors who are immune to temptations of the sensory organs and the eight kinds of vices, namely, lust, frenzy, avarice, stubbornness, jealosy, passion, anger and miserliness and who have certain strong characteristics radiating their prowess of sacrifice are conquered by these whores; these women have sharp eyes capable of severing the bodies (of their victims); I became absolutely obsessed with passion, yearning for such whores; in order that my mind is not destroyed, being shrouded by the darkness called ignorance, and to enable me to research into the beautiful bright light of non-hostility that is the dawning knowledge, will You not kindly grant me pure love and present me with Your matchless hallowed feet, the seat of grace? He wears on His matted hair fragrant kurA garland, cool kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower, thuLasi and Aththi (mountain ebony) leaves, venerable river Gangai, the moon with beautiful phases and flowers from the creeper eekai and the plant erukkai; He wears the serpent as the dangling ear-stud and holds in His hand the bow, PinAkam, as His weapon; when that Lord SivA, along with Lord VishNu, who holds in His hands the conch-shell, the disc and the mace, fervently appealed to beseeching "Oh Our Treasure! kindly set free the celestials from their prison", You rendered the leader of the demons, SUran, miserable without any support; Lord BrahmA seated on the VEdAs was terrified; and the Mount Krouncha was shattered to pieces; when You wielded Your speedy and strong weapon, the Spear, which is the symbol of valour, Oh Great One!

1162.english_pathavurai: She wears a unique ornament called the Knowledge; She is of the hue of dark cloud, She remains the Causal One for everything; She is the enchantress who instils desire in all lives; She is the Goddess who did penance under the shade of a pAthiri tree (in ThiruppAthirip puliyUr); She has an emerald-green complexion; She is the great illusionist; She is PArvathi, the possessor of all virtues; and She is UmAdEvi whose consort and a compassionate master is Lord SivA; and You are the Master of that SivA! You graciously taught Him the VEdAs and the scriptural texts, Oh Lord of Lords! You are the most virtuous Lord! You are the child of the great Lord SivA, with matted hair, and the Supreme Goddess, PArvathi! You are the consort of VaLLi whose speech is sweet like honey! You mount the great peacock that is worshipped by all the DEvAs in the celestial land! You are also the beloved consort of DEvayAnai, who is the deer-like damsel ruling the celestial kingdom! In order that the thirst for lust suffered by me, worse than a wretched dog, is destroyed and driven away from me, holding Your hallowed feet upon my head, bless me kindly with the ability to sing Your glory in artistic language! Those camaNAs never respected You nor did they wear the holy ash; You thrashed them (in debate) leaving them stranded and dazed, eventually sending them to the gallows; and You came to Madhurai (as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) and uplifted (by straightening his back) the hunch-backed king, PANdiyan, whose staff has the emblem of fish! He was a very valorous one, leading the clan of the demons; that RAvaNan's body was split into two by the arrow wielded by RaghurAman whose mouth resembles a flower; He is Lord NArAyaNan, the great mystic one who came as RAghavan; and You are His nephew! The demons came to the battlefield to perish; the celestials living in the golden land prospered and flourished; as You came as the leader of the army, Oh Lord! Oh Great Master, Lord KumarA! Your words are beyond the reach of any word, Oh Lord! The people in all the countries prostate at Your hallowed feet; and You prominently prevail as the Lord removing all their attachments, Oh Great One!

1163.english_pathavurai: A little droplet of the size of a lentil falls into the womb of a mother in this world; it takes the shape of a delightful egg in which muscles, blood and flesh develop, with the formation of limbs; with nine outlets, arms and nice legs, the nine portals* (consisting of eyes-2, ears-2, nostrils 2, mouth-1, excretory organs-2) become distinctly visible; in about ten months, the child arrives in this world to be greeted with pleasure by the parents who cherish the child as theirs; the child learns to walk; (on becoming a youth) he is ensnared as a victim to the lustful acts of women; he eventually gets exhausted; his condition undergoes a reversal; his erect upper body bends down and he has to rely on a walking stick; thereafter, he is confined to bed at all times; the God of Death (Yaman) knocks the front door and spills his life away from the body; he is declared as a corpse saddening his sons and relatives; people keep on repeating "take this corpse away"; the body is carried to the cremation ground and is laid ardently on the fire logs; it is burnt and converted into ashes to be immersed in water. I do not wish this birth any more; to avoid that, kindly bless me by offering Your hallowed feet, adorned by anklets! The multitude of hostile demons who came to the war was destroyed; everywhere, eagles and vultures, with a keen eye for corpses, hovered around in the sky; and the devils teamed up with an eager appetite for the corpses of the angry demons and devoured their bodies, leaping in joy, making this noise 'dumu dumuda dumu dumuda duNduduN duNduduN' and beating fiercely on many drums and percussion instruments such as thimilai, paRai, muzhavu, thudi, pambai and sangam; when You kept on shooting arrows, row after row, Oh Kumara! "Oh MurugA! You came to liberate the celestials from the prisons where they were shackled previously!" - with these words, IndrA and the four-faced Lord BrahmA prostrated at Your feet as You cornered the enemies and fought a fierce war wielding Your dazzling spear, Oh Lord! Even Lord VishNu, of the hue of dark cloud, who gobbled up the entire world as if it were nectar, was not able to find those tresses on which are held snakes, the crescent moon, River Ganga and kondRai (Indian laburnum) flower; those tresses belong to that unique Lord SivA, and You are His Son, Oh Great One!

1164.english_meanings_list: ["Shaking their bosom slightly, displaying golden ornaments, silky attire and beautiful gem-studded anklets, holding the veeNa (a string instrument) elegantly in their hand,", "speaking words like baby's prattle, wearing golden chains around their neck in a loving and soothing manner,", "and simultaneously wielding from both eyes, that are like arrow and spear, a maddening dose of passionate dizziness everyday, these whores appear congenial as though they heed to the command with folded hands; then they engage in carnal act and begin their daily routine of treachery by grabbing the money due to them (from their suitors);", "putting an end to my debased instinct of falling victim to their tricky ploys and roaming about by treading the useless and unrighteous path, kindly bless me graciously so that I attain glorious exaltation and a level of sacrament.", "The terrified and exhausted demons were scattered listening to the drum-beats \"thananthaththath thananthaththath thaduNduttut tidiNdittit tadaNdattat timiNduttut\" and to the loud noise from the huge hand-drums to the meter \"thakunthoththith thiminthiththith\";", "acceding with compassion to the prayer of the worthy celestials, You became enraged against the demons who came to the war and burnt them all; when You wielded the arrows from Your hand, the peaks of hundreds of mountains shook;", "the terrified Mount Krouncha was split and shattered to pieces; and people in all the directions in this world became prosperous", "when You entered the battlefield and became victorious, Oh Handsome and Great One!"]
1164.english_pathavurai: Shaking their bosom slightly, displaying golden ornaments, silky attire and beautiful gem-studded anklets, holding the veeNa (a string instrument) elegantly in their hand, speaking words like baby's prattle, wearing golden chains around their neck in a loving and soothing manner, and simultaneously wielding from both eyes, that are like arrow and spear, a maddening dose of passionate dizziness everyday, these whores appear congenial as though they heed to the command with folded hands; then they engage in carnal act and begin their daily routine of treachery by grabbing the money due to them (from their suitors); putting an end to my debased instinct of falling victim to their tricky ploys and roaming about by treading the useless and unrighteous path, kindly bless me graciously so that I attain glorious exaltation and a level of sacrament. The terrified and exhausted demons were scattered listening to the drum-beats "thananthaththath thananthaththath thaduNduttut tidiNdittit tadaNdattat timiNduttut" and to the loud noise from the huge hand-drums to the meter "thakunthoththith thiminthiththith"; acceding with compassion to the prayer of the worthy celestials, You became enraged against the demons who came to the war and burnt them all; when You wielded the arrows from Your hand, the peaks of hundreds of mountains shook; the terrified Mount Krouncha was split and shattered to pieces; and people in all the directions in this world became prosperous when You entered the battlefield and became victorious, Oh Handsome and Great One!

1165.english_meanings_list: ["[In the five-lettered ManthrA \"Namasivaya\"* 1 ] 'Na' represents the two hallowed feet (of Lord NadarAjar); 'ma' represents His abdomen;", "His chest is denoted by the middle letter 'si'; His mouth is represented by the letter 'va';", "and the essence of the letter 'ya' is to be found in His matted hair with the River Ganga;", "thus all the sacred and exquisite letters of the five-lettered ManthrA \"NAMASIVAYA\" represent the hallowed body of the Lord Almighty;", "the letters 'a' and 'u' constitute the initial letters of OM (AUM) whose causal One is that Lord, and the significance of OM was known to the demon SUran* 2 whose Knowledge was one of total enlightenment!", "as I too would like to realise the significance of that ManthrA, kindly bless me with that Knowledge to be experienced inside the lotus temple of my heart!", "(Unable to bear the curse heaped on His mother PArvathi), Lord Murugan* 3 came to this world to reveal His grace and valour and also to eradicate the curse imposed on (SivA's vehicle) Nandi, who was born as a shark;", "(Devi PArvathi) appeared as a lonely baby-girl on the sea-shore", "and was reared by our fishermen-folk, to whose family the Goddess came as a boon and grew up on the wavy sea-shore as a fisher-woman; wooing her,", "as the entire world watched, He came assuming a wonderful disguise of a fisherman (with a fishing net)", "and wedded the fisherwoman nicely and left with her; that pursuer with the fishing net was none other than Lord SivA", "who appears to me as the six-faced Murugan, (having an abode in this place, ThiruvArUr) with the name of VanmeekanAthar;", "You stand as an effulgence in the form of ajapA ManthrA* 4 that is capable of doing away with birth and Lord Yaman (death), Oh Great One!"]
1165.english_pathavurai: [In the five-lettered ManthrA "Namasivaya"* 1 ] 'Na' represents the two hallowed feet (of Lord NadarAjar); 'ma' represents His abdomen; His chest is denoted by the middle letter 'si'; His mouth is represented by the letter 'va'; and the essence of the letter 'ya' is to be found in His matted hair with the River Ganga; thus all the sacred and exquisite letters of the five-lettered ManthrA "NAMASIVAYA" represent the hallowed body of the Lord Almighty; the letters 'a' and 'u' constitute the initial letters of OM (AUM) whose causal One is that Lord, and the significance of OM was known to the demon SUran* 2 whose Knowledge was one of total enlightenment! as I too would like to realise the significance of that ManthrA, kindly bless me with that Knowledge to be experienced inside the lotus temple of my heart! (Unable to bear the curse heaped on His mother PArvathi), Lord Murugan* 3 came to this world to reveal His grace and valour and also to eradicate the curse imposed on (SivA's vehicle) Nandi, who was born as a shark; (Devi PArvathi) appeared as a lonely baby-girl on the sea-shore and was reared by our fishermen-folk, to whose family the Goddess came as a boon and grew up on the wavy sea-shore as a fisher-woman; wooing her, as the entire world watched, He came assuming a wonderful disguise of a fisherman (with a fishing net) and wedded the fisherwoman nicely and left with her; that pursuer with the fishing net was none other than Lord SivA who appears to me as the six-faced Murugan, (having an abode in this place, ThiruvArUr) with the name of VanmeekanAthar; You stand as an effulgence in the form of ajapA ManthrA* 4 that is capable of doing away with birth and Lord Yaman (death), Oh Great One!

1166.english_pathavurai: My black hair has turned gray; all my teeth have fallen; the skin of my body is full of wrinkles; being unable to walk, my legs have become painfully weak; my eyes see only darkness having lost their vision; and I rely on a walking stick, tottering about. Wishfully thinking that my slippery and degenerating body of flesh is going to last for ever, and that all my possessions will be mine for ever, I enjoyed the so-called comfortable life. Ultimately, I have been subject to this misery and delusion. Rather than laughing off this plight, (I indulged in) the fragrant hair of women soaked in musk, strong enough to attract humming beetles, their spear-like showy eyes with a rich coat of mascara, and deceitful harlots who stood showing off their overly made up face and figure; tossed between these, my mind was torn apart by excessive lust. Will I not ever pause to contemplate and begin to sing the glory of Your hallowed feet lovingly? The three great Saivite Poet-Patrons (namely, Appar, Sundarar and Sambandhar) knew not only the apppropriate words but also their meanings (the interpretation of Sivam and Shakti); He illuminated them all by preaching the ManthrA, NamasivAya; He holds on one side of His body the emerald-green consort, PArvathi; He roams around the entire world gladly accepting the alms offered to Him; the terrible poison, AlakAlam, that emerged from the milky ocean was imbibed by Him to demonstrate His Omnipotence and indestructibility to the world; He burnt down the three evil empires, Thiripuram, which were capable of flying in the sky; as an elegant belt around His waist, He wears the poisonous snake; to match the River Ganga adorning His tresses, He has decorated His matted hair with the crescent moon sitting pretty, along with a snake, and placed the aRugam (cynodon) grass and flowers like nochchai and thumbai; He is worshipped daily by Lords Vishnu and BrahmA; He is that immaculate Lord SivA to whom You preached the most important ManthrA effectively, Oh Great One!

IndrA, the ruler of the land of DEvAs known for its KaRpaga trees was doing penance (at SikAzhi) taking the form of a bamboo tree*. Then You released the DEvAs from prison before returning to Lord SivA. You are such a superb warrior and the Lord of all the DEvAs, Oh Great One!

1169.english_pathavurai: Having lived a pompous life, I shall face the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) who will come running to me. They will roar like the waves of the ocean and advance towards me. With anger, they will thrust needles into my body. They will squeeze my body as if it were sugarcane being crushed in the mill. They will take a powerful sword and bisect my body and throw away the pieces. (When I am going through this torture) there will be so much of crying and wailing going on; the womenfolk from my household and all those women who loved me will assemble and fall upon my body. Seeing this pathetic scene, kindly come to bless me. She is Devi; She is valorous; She is frightening; She is the Mother; She is the Primordial Mother who is seated on the left side of the Leader (SivA) who is adulated by all the VEdAs; She is lauded extensively by the devotees running to Her seeking Her vision and is worshipped everyday; She is the daughter of Mount HimavAn; She has the blue complexion of Vishnu who slumbers on the milky ocean (She is in the form of Vishnu-Shakthi); and She holds the trident in Her hand. She is Mother UmA, and You are Her Treasure and Her Son! You wear the garland made of kadappa flowers, Oh Lord Kumara! SUran, who came running to You (in disguise) assuming a blue complexion, was shattered to pieces by You, the Dispenser of justice. You are unique as Balasubramaniyam, Oh Great One!

1170.english_pathavurai: My arms and legs are made of water, bones and skin; along with them, long limbs are attached, and like a magic, life is infused into them. My beloved father and mother once fell in so much love that I was conceived. I was raised as a very disciplined boy but later followed a very destructive path. I enjoyed every pleasure that was to be enjoyed in life and had nothing to complain about. To my heart's content, I revelled in the company of women amorously. At the designated final moment predetermined by fate, Yaman (God of Death), mounting his vehicle, buffalo, would come promptly to throw the rope (of attachment) around me, and this body of flesh is bound to perish; will that magic cycle ever end? To prevent the demon SUran from running away abducting the honour of the entire world, You mounted the pretty peacock and wielded Your spear, Oh valorous One! He adorns His shoulders with a garland of bones and His tress with the river Ganga; He dances the cosmic dance; He is the Cosort of PArvathi, the pretty peacock-like Goddess; to that Lord SivA You preached the most secret ManthrA (PraNava)! He is the Lord who swallowed the entire world; He plays on the bamboo flute; once, He was so enamoured of the songs of His devoted poets (such as Thirumazhisai AzhwAr*) that He went with them upon their beckoning; You are the nephew of that Lord Vishnu! They destroy all unrighteous things, rendering them to pieces, and sing songs composed only with the righteous words upholding the truth of the VEdAs; You are the Treasure of such devotees, Oh Great One!

1171.english_pathavurai: The string of a neat row of nine precious gems, radiating reddish rays of light that blind even the sunlight, gets severed by the tip of their nails, and the gems are scattered around; the sweet words from their mouth that has imbibed the saliva emanate with a flutter; the bright bangles adorning their lotus-like arms make a clinking sound; their exhilarated bosom heavily impinge on the chest; caught on their fragrant bed and feeling a sense of disgrace, I hug them tightly with my arms and fall into a delusion of passion; why can I not give up being a victim of these whores, and instead, carefully nurture my inner intellect so as to worship You offering flowers and realise You at least once, Oh Lord? 1173.english_pathavurai: These women dance with their lotus-like feet which are aptly formed to perform classic Bharatha NAtyam dances. With their lily-like beautiful mouths that shower nectar, they sing many melodious songs. They grab many people's belongings, subsequently quarrel with them after taking possession and chase away their suitors. Lest they are blamed for a major wrong-doing, they feign a little weeping and rub their eyes, babbling words of love. The look from their eyes is like the piercing arrow. They wear tightly on their hair red lilies that rouse one-sided passion, along with a rich balsam made of akil (incence), musk and plenty of rose-water. They wave the fan gently to spread the southerly breeze bearing the erotic aroma discussed in Tamil compositions that keenly describe the female organ whose marks* are spread out all over the body of IndrA, the Lord of the Celestials. These are the whores who hook and bend the minds of men. I have been drowning myself in their bosom, suffering miserably by melting away till the dawn. Will there be a day when You will come and graciously rescue me from such misery? She is the great PArvathi DEvi who delivered all the worlds supported upon the famous hood of the Serpent AdhisEshan; He has her concorporate on one side of His body; and He is Lord SivA wearing a serpent as an ornament; He is KrishnA, referred to as the butter-thief, who crawled while being tied to the barrel with a tiny rope by the milk-maids who were angry at His act of stealth committed by jumping over to the vessel hanging from the ceiling; He is Lord IndrA who rides the white and fierce elephant AirAvatham that has a dribbling jaw with wild rage and is like a mountain ever ready for war; having realised that worshipping You is their duty, they (the three of them) are prostrating at Your feet; You lost Your temper with Lord Brahma who could not interpret the inner meaning of PraNava ManthrA; You protected AmarAvathi, the capital city of the celestials; You defeated and destroyed the tall and treacherous Mount Krouncha; the seven seas were scattered and spilled all over as if an avalanche had struck them; and all the demons fled running away from the battlefield when You confronted and attacked them, Oh Great One!

1174.english_pathavurai: My learning was blemishless; I passed beyond all the worldly desires; I fought and conquered my inner enemies, namely my good and bad deeds which I completely shook off; I practised very many Yogic exercises; (despite all that) I was knocked down by the fragrant flowery arrows of Manmathan (God of Love) which caused me anguish and mental depression; I was even prepared to publicise my passion through the palm-leaf doodles*; feeling miserable and disheartened, I saw my obsession increase day by day; I was carried away by pity for the whores who feigned love towards me with their sobbing and play-acting; the arrows of their eyes knocked me down, making me feel battered, with a depressed heart; Is this all the act of fate because of my past deeds? Or is this a practical joke You are graciously playing on me? I am unable to understand the reason for this malady! He declared that Lord Almighty not only prevailed in the VEdAs whose greatness one could not even write about but that He was also omnipresent; He was the matchless and extremely wise child-devotee, PrahlAdhan; the Lord was seated in that child's heart; taking a dual form of half man and half lion, He emerged as Narasimha MUrthy and materialised from a solid pillar; the unique valour displayed by the Lord in splitting the chest of HiraNyan was spontaneously revealed upon the request of PrahlAdhan; You are the nephew of such a valiant Lord VishNu! You are the son of Lord SivA who burnt down the Thiripuram! She is the proud possessor of enthralled bosoms like baby coconut, having a nice coating of sandalwood paste; She is the deer-like VaLLi, living among the hunters of Mount VaLLimalai where clouds hover and elephants stroll about; You fell madly in love with her and dashed to the millet-field guarded by her, Oh Great One!

1175.english_pathavurai: It cannot be touched and held in hands; It cannot be seen even a little by those practitioners of yOgAs; It cannot be determined by squabblers debating in vain; It cannot be trapped by the delusory bonds of attachment, caused by the five elements which are treacherous; It cannot be snared by any other method; It cannot be contemplated upon by any type of meditation; It cannot be reached by climbing the ladder of the mind, a receptacle of all worries; It cannot be attained through the research of rich texts containing lofty ideas that are high as the sky; Its root cause cannot be interpreted in any way by Its seekers; It is such a unique and Supreme matter. To enable me to attain It, and to get out of the big sea of misery and reach the shore, will I be able to worship Your hallowed feet, fragrant with vetchi flowers adorning them? The famous Mount Meru was made of absolutely pure and solid gold; You wielded Your spear on that mountain*; You destroyed the danger that had befallen IndrA; dispelling even the shadow of the dazzling discs and other weapons of the demons, my Lord, You ruled the universe bounded by Mount ChakravALam that is bright as the sun! She wears a pendant embedded with rubies, corals and blue sapphires; that beautiful lass belonging to the hunter tribe is VaLLi; and the fragrance of Her ankle-bearing lotus feet is distinctly discernible in Your head (meaning Murugan's head fell at VaLLi's feet)! The inner meaning of the PraNava ManthrA which could not be interpreted by Lord BrahmA was once preached to Lord SivA by You as His mentor, Oh Great Master, You are the unique Lord of all the celestials!

1177.english_pathavurai: You hold the blemishless staff of the Rooster! You show Your rage at the war-mongering asuras (demons) with prominent teeth! You smashed the long range of Mount Krouncha! You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs! Praising Your mountainous shoulders, Holy Brahmins and DEvAs prostrate at Your feet with my two eyes shedding tears of ecstacy, with ever-growing love filled to the brim of my heart, with my body made of all elements and containing the precious life, all my intellect, mind and other entities getting released, and with my ego being demolished, at that very moment, I should realise You! Different schools* of thought and religions will have to recede as You stand alone as the "being" and the "naught"! You have to grant the grace for enabling this ignorant one to realise You today! He has the staff with the flag of Fish; He rides through the gentle breeze from the South emanating from the Pothigai Hill belonging to the beautiful Tamil Land; His flowery arrows arouse several aromatic scents; His string in the bow is formed by rows of beetles that roam around many flowers; He comes to war holding in His hand a bow of sugarcane; and He is King Manmathan (Love God) who was burnt down by SivA with a focused fiery eye in His forehead! In His tresses, He wears the little crescent moon and the ancient river BhAgeerathi (Ganga); (along with SivA) She stands as the enchanting Goddess, worshipped by all VEdAs (scriptures) She wears in Her lotus feet anklets made of shells; She is Sankari; She is the daughter of Mount HimavAn; She has three eyes; and She, PArvathi, delivered You, Oh MurugA, You are the consort of DEvayAnai, Oh Great One!

1179.english_pathavurai: In this world, those contemplating upon Your two feet are capable of seeing the past, the present and the future! Without knowing this significance, some devious people are led into improper religious paths by certain fanatics; and they will all go, without fail, to the worst hell full of worms! I do not have the capability of singing Your glory in poetry. I am caught in a whirlpool of sins which has tired me out. In this troublesome world, I must be given certain duties of which there should be an account; and how can You not know that? You are the Lord of SivA; You are the Lord dancing on the Peacock; You are the Lord grandly etched inside our hearts; You are the luminous Lord whose form is visible only to Your devotees; You are the Lord that destroys birth; You are the Lord that shatters all sins; You are the Lord that manifests in the penance of the sages; You are the Lord that forgives all our mistakes; You are the Lord who redeemed the land of the DEvAs and re-established them; You are the Lord who destroyed and reduced the asuras (demons) into powder; You are the Lord determining what services we must do in this world; You are Saravanabhava (the Lord who emerged from a pond of reeds); and You are the Lord who preached to His own father, Oh Great One!

1183.english_pathavurai: They roll their eyes that look like the combative kayal fish. They deliberately shake the string of gems upon their exhilarated bosom. They spread out and show off their cloud-like hair. Such whores proffer, along with a seductive smile, their pure saliva that oozes like honey. They deliberately ruffle their costume wrapped around their glittering waist. They exhibit their newly acquired anklets by performing a dance number. Leading the languishing young men to their bed, they demonstrate their hugging skills. Grabbing their entire assets, they render them impoverished and humiliated. They choose sweet words comparable to the nectar derived from the milky ocean and demand to be paid. Administering a fascinating magic powder, they cleverly mix it with their suitor's food creating unbearable stomach-burn and then manipulate them. With their harsh words they discriminate human values by splitting, and uniting with, them at their whim. Enabling me to give up carnal relation with such whores, will You not think in terms of taking me over graciously, Oh Lord? He kicked to pieces the rolling wheel (chakatAsuran) made of marutha (arjunA) tree; in the village of the shepherds, He knocked down all the suspended network of ropes for hanging milk-pots; He was stirred up to the point of crying when He was bound by a rope, beaten up and tied to a stone-barrel; He grew tall enormously (coming as Thirivikraman) and assumed a gigantic form; His complexion is that of the black cloud; when the foolish demon HiraNyan challenged PrahlAthan to show the Lord in front of him, He appeared and split his chest; when it poured heavily, He lifted Mount GOvardhan to protect the herds of cows from the rain; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! Against the background sound of many percussion instruments proclaiming victory, You severed and strewed away the evil heads of many demons belonging to the clan of SUran and knocked down their shoulders by wielding Your spear, Oh Valorous One! Those demons carried out many misdeeds like burning the big sea with wild fire and destroying it to pieces; You diverted the water of that sea to flow into their capital city MahEndranagar and ravaged it, Oh Lord! You are the Lord of the devotees who worship You by showering flowers in plenty at Your hallowed feet, Oh Great One!

1184.english_pathavurai: I happen to have helpful children who would never let the family's prestige down and a wife who provides support to me throughout the life and I can afford to enjoy immense wealth, feasting in the company of new relatives; however, when the misery of poverty strikes, I have to brood over ways and means of amassing gold, and in that process, I roam about extensively in this life; according to the destiny pre-scripted for me by Lord Brahma, seated on a lush lotus, I am scared of Yaman (God of Death) who is all set to wage a war with me to take my life till I am taken to the crematorium; until the doubt (whether this life will be spared or not) is cleared, he is going to be armed with weapons like the bow; before he actually approaches me, I wish to praise You with these words "Oh Lord with broad and handsome shoulders smeared with sandalwood paste and wearing the kadappa garland, Oh Lord KandhA who is well-versed in all the three branches of Tamil"; and for that, when will You remove my mental desolation by granting Your hallowed feet? He wears a garland of bones; He was beaten by the bow by Arjunan* and subjected to suffering; He holds in His hallowed hand (leaning on His shoulder) Mount MEru as the bow; He mounts the bull (Nandi) as His vehicle; He looked with His fiery eye (on His forehead) at Manmathan (God of Love), who was carrying, as his support, a quiver for arrows where he kept fresh and cool flowers, and sent him down screaming and burning; He dances on the cremation ground holding a pot of fire in His hand; On the milky ocean, He scooped the AlakAla poison in its entirety and imbibed it all by Himself in order that all the people in the eight directions of this earth could be spared their life; to that Lord SivA, You came as the apt preacher and removed His holy thirst (for understanding the significance of PraNava ManthrA) by graciously teaching Him the amazing meaning of that ManthrA! Removing the sins of all Your devotees who worship Your hallowed feet with love, You are also able to grant them on this beautiful earth a mind that does not fear anything and all the wealth, Oh Great One!

1185.english_pathavurai: On the barely visible waistline that is like the imperceptible body of Manmathan (God of Love), on the heart-melting gait like that of the she-elephant, on the lotus-like pair of feet wearing the anklets, on the dark cloud-like long hair wearing makizham flower and musk, around which beetles swarm, on the gem-embedded swinging ear-studs that look like the makara fish, on the bud-like rounded bosom of the young women, on the gushing saliva that fills their mouth that is sweet like the nectar in the milky ocean, on their sweet speech, on their eyes that leap right up to the swinging ear-studs, on their matchless smile that looks like the jasmine, on their beautiful forehead that looks like the cool crescent moon and on every organ and limb of these women, I have been, at all times, charmed with obsessive passion; will there be a day when You will remove that madness of mine and take me over, Oh Lord? The sea was arrested and buried under and the unique chariot of the sun was banned from entering the city of LankA; in that town, making the rays of the bright sunshine re-enter in a second and putting an end to the suffering of JAnaki, He (RAmA) wielded His unique arrow knocking down the twenty mountain-like shoulders and severing the ten necks of RAvaNan, the leader of the demons; He is Lord VishNu; Thiripuram*, the dwelling place of the demons who lacked serenity, knowledge and stability, was burnt down and destroyed when He bent as a bow the great Mount MEru, which is the primal mountain of all mountains and the most distinct one like the mark on the forehead; that Lord SivA (along with Lord VishNu) became exhilarated; the celestials were resettled in their golden land; the seas filled with waves and the makara fish roared in appeal; and the demon SUran and his seven mountains with all their peaks were smashed to pieces when You attacked with Your spear, Oh Great One!

1186.english_pathavurai: Because of the flowery arrows wielded by Manmathan (God of Love), because of the influence of my good and bad deeds, and because of the interaction of the five elements such as the earth and water, this body of mine took shape. With this body I am unable to move about in this world. For the destruction of delusions in my mind and to do away with the effects of the deeds, both good and bad, and to uproot the slag of arrogance, I must obtain the grace of experiencing True Knowledge to be cherished and perceived in my heart; to enable me to mingle and play with the group of Your devotees who have already obtained the blessings of Your feet, You must appear before me with total compassion, elegantly mounting Your Peacock, which symbolises true knowledge and serves You as a horse, with the celestials showering flowers on Your hallowed feet, to bless me with Your vision, radiating the glow of a million moons! A billion young women, with dazzling white complexion, were waving the sAmarams (hand fans) like sea waves; the full moon and the sun were providing brilliant illumination; about ten million great sages with tresses were worshipping in complete surrender; many priests were chanting the sacred VEdAs; as Lord SivA with tresses (as NadarAjar) danced His cosmic dance in accordance with the meter; You are the child of that SivA! She is the younger sister* of BrahmA whose duty is to determine the fate of all lives; She is gloriously seated in my heart; She is Goddess VaLLi; With immense love You embrace the bosom of that VaLLi, Oh MurugA! He pervades the entire sky and the universe; He has the complexion of the blue lily; He is Lord Vishnu, and You are His nephew! 1187.english_meanings_list: ["A house encompassed by uniformly-built compound walls is filled up with riches by one who guards the assets zealously (in the fear of burglary);", "enjoying a status of power and drunk with pride like an elephant in rage, one is surrounded by an overwhelming crowd of women and a group of ardent supporters who would never utter a word in opposition;", "while enjoying such a life, the day of reckoning arrives in the form of death; on that final day, the body is tied to the bier and the friends accompany (the funeral procession) beating about their chests and crying uncontrollably; the corpse with all its limbs intact is left to be consumed by fire;", "I have been yearning for Your gracious blessing that would get rid of that misery; in order to protect me, will You not kindly grant me the privilege of holding on to Your two hallowed feet, Oh Lord?", "Fixing the golden mount MEru as the large churner and tying the serpent (VAsuki) as the churning rope, the celestials began to churn (the milky ocean) forcefully;", "when the boiling sea spewed smoke and fire making everyone scream in terror, the celestials fled from the scene and the evil AlakAla poison erupted with a burst; that poison was held arrested (in His throat) by the amazing Lord SivA, and You are His son, Oh Lord KumarA!", "You shamelessly befriended VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, while people of the seven worlds laughed at You with derision; deeming it to be the most opportune moment, You went and stood near her, Oh Youngster with profound Knowledge!", "Beheading the heads of the mighty demons, possessed with raging anger, You established that real valour consisted in overpowering those demons, and You grandly practised that doctrine, Oh Great One!"]
1187.english_pathavurai: A house encompassed by uniformly-built compound walls is filled up with riches by one who guards the assets zealously (in the fear of burglary); enjoying a status of power and drunk with pride like an elephant in rage, one is surrounded by an overwhelming crowd of women and a group of ardent supporters who would never utter a word in opposition; while enjoying such a life, the day of reckoning arrives in the form of death; on that final day, the body is tied to the bier and the friends accompany (the funeral procession) beating about their chests and crying uncontrollably; the corpse with all its limbs intact is left to be consumed by fire; I have been yearning for Your gracious blessing that would get rid of that misery; in order to protect me, will You not kindly grant me the privilege of holding on to Your two hallowed feet, Oh Lord? Fixing the golden mount MEru as the large churner and tying the serpent (VAsuki) as the churning rope, the celestials began to churn (the milky ocean) forcefully; when the boiling sea spewed smoke and fire making everyone scream in terror, the celestials fled from the scene and the evil AlakAla poison erupted with a burst; that poison was held arrested (in His throat) by the amazing Lord SivA, and You are His son, Oh Lord KumarA! You shamelessly befriended VaLLi, the damsel of the hunters, while people of the seven worlds laughed at You with derision; deeming it to be the most opportune moment, You went and stood near her, Oh Youngster with profound Knowledge! Beheading the heads of the mighty demons, possessed with raging anger, You established that real valour consisted in overpowering those demons, and You grandly practised that doctrine, Oh Great One!
