1188.english_pathavurai: He wore the bones of the dead Gods such as Vishnu and BrahmA (after Dhaksha's Sacrifice); He is the Leader with a unique tress; that Lord SivA pleaded with You; then You preached to Him the PraNava ManthrA; (If the) five elements, namely, ether, earth, air, fire and water, the four karaNas (internal sense organs), namely, manas (mind), ahankAram (egoism), budhdhi (intellect) and chitta (will), and the arrogance and possessiveness in me are all gone, - in other words, if all the aforesaid things are destroyed, the PraNava ManthrA will become discernible. If You choose not to teach me that ManthrA, (as an alternative) kindly grant me "detachment" with which my mind gives up all desires and unwaveringly falls at Your hallowed feet; I seek only those feet, with a melting heart full of love. My prayer to You, saying "Oh Lord, You are the primordial One, wearing the garland of kadappa flowers; Your holy feet are my only refuge" is not something that would go waste; don't I know this truth? He rules the entire universe; He assumed a huge form (ViswarUpam) to measure the three worlds with His two footsteps; He is Mukundan (Lord Vishnu); In the pond, once, caught in the mouth of a crocodile, a mountain-like elephant (GajEndran) thought it was going to die and screamed for help from Lord Vishnu; at that moment, Lord Vishnu blew hard on His pure conchshell (Panchajanyam) and even before its sound subsided, with profuse love, He reached the forest where the pond was situated, holding the disc (Sudharsanam) readily in His hand; He came alone, all by Himself, and rescued the elephant and gave refuge; You are the nephew of that Vishnu with the hue of the dark cloud! In this nice grove, the blossoming coconut petals were giving off a pleasant aroma; there, among the unique hunters of the hill (VaLLimalai), stood the peacock-like damsel, VaLLi whose pretty bosom was desired by You, Oh Great One!

Those demons, filled up with the six major vices* and armed with swords, were all shattered to pieces when You wielded Your spear, Oh Lord with Six Faces! You are the Consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs! Your peacock, capable of controlling the seven worlds surrounded by the seas, screamed after successfully binding the mouth of the Serpent VAsuki; You mounted the peacock elegantly, Oh Young One! Because of the excessive strength of their power, the triumphant demons had imprisoned the celestials, and You freed the DEvAs, Oh Great One!

1190.english_pathavurai: In their slender waist that quivers like lightning, in their white pearl-like teeth, in their round-shaped, beautiful, fulsome, soft and bulging breasts, in the vermillion dot worn on their curved bow-like forehead, in the speech of the whores which is sweet like the sugarcane, in their gait like that of the famous swan, in their two black eyes and in their reddish kovvai-fruit-like mouth, I had remained awestruck, with mind immersing in each of them individually; changing my mind set, the fruit of my past deeds made me meditate on Your six hallowed faces; how can I ever forget this reward for any reason? 1191.english_pathavurai: These women display pearl necklaces upon their bosom; they carry out the errands of Manmathan (God of Love); they melt their suitors' hearts merely by kissing; they mingle very well with young men and keep them in a trance; their eyes look like long leaves and spears; they are capable of having millions of thoughts in their mind; they are like parrots with the ability to arouse passion; they entice in many ways; they show of their shoulders smeared with camphorous paste; these are the whores who lead one to the sinful path with a treacherous mind; I do not wish to lose my balance because of these whores; instead, kindly bless me with the true principle of knowledge based on the three aspects of Tamil (namely, literature, music and drama) so that I could learn about Your glory and chant it all the time! You are the son of Lord SivA, who peeled of the hide from the elephant-demon (KayAsuran) with a huge pot-like forehead; You are the nephew of Lord VishNu (who came as hunter Upendran) related to Goddess Lakshmi as a brother-in-law*! Making the seas dry up, and scaring the demons who bragged about their earlier victories, You wielded the powerful spear graciously, Oh Young Lord! You went up to VaLLi, the beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs, and once, in the millet field, You hugged her tightly as her Consort! Your hallowed feet are wrapped with vetchi flowers, Oh Lord! You are the Lord that blesses true saints with immortal and blissful life, Oh VishAkA; You are the Lord of the worthy celestials, Oh Great One!

1192.english_pathavurai: On their long and fragrant hair, where they have applied black pigment, on their lotus-like mouth, on their eye that looks like the broad and moving spear, on their mountain-like bosom that is the root-cause of disturbing the mind of people passing by in a hurry, letting their morals go astray, people run about losing breath like those hastening to travel on the dark and wide sea; their body and speech go through so much of transformation that they are called crazy; some insignificant souls make such endeavours and in that process melt their heart; again, there are some other people who control their mind and pursue a path where their body and soul merge together; they choose such loving words of devotion in praise of You that their heart appears to have melted like the wax in the fire; these people have given up the three worldly lusts namely, earth, woman and gold; in their True realisation arising from the control of mind, You grant them the vision of Your hallowed feet, Oh Lord! Kindly keep me in mind and bless me as well. Many water-birds roam about in the beautiful beach of ThiruchchendhUr, and You reside there, Oh KumarA! She was born in Mount HimAlayAs, the world's leading mountain; and You are the child of that Supreme Mother PArvathi! You belong to those chaste people who chant the VEdAs and realise the truth! You went in search of, pined away and melted for the beautiful damsel of the hunters; You went there running, with an ulterior motive of making a big steal, and took away peacock-like VaLLi who resided in the hunters' place, Oh Embodiment of Effulgence! Near the great city of Madhurai, famous for its plantain and mango trees, in a round-shaped cave of the renowned town ThirupparangkundRam, there was this great poet Nakkeerar*; to listen to his rich tamil poetry (ThirumurugAtRuppadai), You waited for a long time in hiding, Oh Lord! He wears the moon on His wide-spread and matted hair; that Lord SivA was elated when You went around the whole world within a fraction of a second mounting and driving Your vehicle, namely the peacock, Oh Great One!

1194.english_pathavurai: My courage was destroyed and my ego shattered; my age was advanced and all my teeth had fallen; my back was like a bow showing a big hunch; my bright face was crestfallen and vision blurred; I coughed uncontrollably and lost my sleep altogether; my speech slurred and tongue became inactive; my grasping power was gone and so was my memory; I was simply stretching my legs and bending my knees; dizziness and worries took control of me; I took leave of my discipline and old age took over; many diseases plagued me and I was bedridden; my own faeces and urine emitted an unbearable stench; and before people say that my time will be over in a minute, You have got to do good to me in that very last minute! IndrA was humiliated and the DEvAs lost their land when they were persecuted and imprisoned by asuras with vengence. From the oppressing multitude, millions of asuras advanced with large armies to fight a war with You; and the enemies' heads and flesh pieces were scattered all around when You threw Your spear with a thundering noise! There was this beautiful girl, VaLLi, who was guarding the millet fields from the parrots; You went towards her, prostrated at her feet and later married her; and Your married life with her was an open book before the whole world, Oh Young One! You are the son of Sankara who burnt down Thripuram and reduced it to ashes. Oh KandhA, Oh valorous One! You taught beautiful Tamil with all clarity to Your devotees, Oh Great One!

1196.english_pathavurai: The aggressive God of Death (Yaman) came rushing in, armed with his unique and sharp spear, to snatch my life, the entire women folk who loved me, coming along with my neighbours, and overcome by grief, swiftly falling on my body; standing there saddened, with tears welling up in their eyes. Due to delusory attachment, some elders and also a few youngsters enquiring as to what had caused my death; some suggesting to others to walk up to the cremation ground; some saying that he must be rushed to the seven hells as he was a big sinner who abused his sensory organs immorally; (lest I am subjected to these kinds of treatment), with glorious tributes from all those living in the seven worlds and the celestial land and the host of sages and saints, You must come to me, Oh Son of Lord SivA, with the loud chanting of the VEdAs in the background! After Dharman lost his country in a gambling war, the PANdavAs accepted banishment for twelve years in the forest; with their chaste spouse, Draupathi, they lived in VirAta kingdom (in disguise for a year); at that time, DuryOdhanan and his clan abducted herds of cows from VirAta kingdom; the PANdaVAs intercepted the abductors and successfully redeemed the cows; in order to claim their right to the kingdom, they sent a unique messenger, Krishna; however, DuryOdhanan said that he would rather confront them with all his might in the battlefield (than cede the kingdom); and Krishna returned without success. The sons of DhirudharAshtiran who came to the war after animated discussions and the others who joined the war for the sake of DhuryOdhanan - all of them died; the other kings and all their armies were destroyed; He swiftly drove the strong horses tied to the chariot of Arjunan who held the triumphant bow, GANdeepam, with elegant stripes on it; He is Lord VishNu, the gallant and mystic one; You are His nephew! You are the emperor of the land of the celestials, Oh Great One!

Their mountain-like breasts, daubed with aromatic substances, appeared prominent.", "On those breasts, a variety of precious gems shone driving the sun's rays into defeat, and many chains made of pearls glittered, along with nail-marks etched with the tips of the nails.", "Their eyes became slanted, speech stuttered and their hands, having soaked in plenty of nectar, quivered causing the bangles to rattle with a jingling noise. 1201.english_pathavurai: Their spread-out hair, smeared with fragrant musk and bedecked with flowers, was let loose. Their mountain-like breasts, daubed with aromatic substances, appeared prominent. On those breasts, a variety of precious gems shone driving the sun's rays into defeat, and many chains made of pearls glittered, along with nail-marks etched with the tips of the nails. Their eyes became slanted, speech stuttered and their hands, having soaked in plenty of nectar, quivered causing the bangles to rattle with a jingling noise. Their beauty pervaded all over, and the anklets on their two flower-like feet made musical sounds. The delusory ecstacy overflew like a sea, and the mind was filled with blissful enjoyment. It was impossible to discern the dichotomy of a man and a woman in passionate union, and my mind was completely destroyed drowning in that flood. Even on such days, You have to kindly grant me the ways and means of comprehending and worshipping the highly revered repute of Your two hallowed feet, Your hands that hold the spear that could sever all my deeds, Your divine faces whose beauty could never be described in writing and Your infinite Grace, Oh Lord! Lord VishNu and Brahma gently massaged Your hallowed feet; the sea turned over and made a roaring noise; the strong vadavAmukAgni (the burning inferno in the north that bursts into flames during the end of an aeon) spewed fire profusely; the fiends assembled in a group; the stacked-up rows of flesh accumulated into a mountain; the percussion instruments were beaten loudly and non-stop; the strong eagles, crows and white-beaked eagles (garudan) gathered ceaselessly; a host of devils spread themselves wide and arrived at the bank of the wavy river of blood; on the bloody battlefield, BhairavAs (the army of Lord SivA) gathered raising a ruckus; everyday, the heads of the demons who were spread out were severed and felled on the earth making a huge heap; many mountains were uprooted and thrown reeling into orbit and ultimately falling on the ground; many peaks of sky-high mountains beyond description reverberated, hit by thunder; as You went around on a hunting spree, mounted on the peacock, Oh Valorous One! He has wide-spread and matted hair; to enable that Lord SivA to listen to the serene and silent method described in the old VEdAs, You stood as a Supreme Master, non-pareil, and preached to Him the True Knowledge, Oh Great One!

1202.english_meanings_list: ["Comparing their eyes with the triumphant spear held in the elegant hand and the fierce flowery arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love),", "their shoulders to the soft bamboo and their bosom to the lofty mountains,", "and declaring that the hair in their tuft has surpassed the dark cloud in blackness,", "I have been describing the beauty of the pretty whores with the choicest words in an euphoric manner; I do not want to be waiting constantly in the courtyards of those whores with a treacherous mind, wasting my time thinking only about them;", "instead, will I not be able to right away hold on to Your unblemished and hallowed feet so that my heart overflows with bliss and love?", "He once measured the earth with merely a foot (as VAmanan); when the elephant (GajEndran) screamed for help seeking Him while He was slumbering in the milky ocean, He appeared before the elephant to rescue him; when that Lord VishNu", "sought Your help, You confronted and ripped apart the broad mountain, Krouncha, and the demon SUran who was in the disguise of a mango tree by wielding Your spear sending shock waves throughout the mountainous regions, Oh Lord!", "When the evil poison AlakAlam gushed out with a roar, He gulped down that poison and stored it in His neck; He gave a part of His body to Goddess PArvathi who is concorporate on His left side;", "He is the Cosmic Dancer; He is the primordial Lord SivA; You are His son; You graciously bless Your devotees in the righteous path and offer them refuge whenever they are in peril, Oh Great One!"]
1202.english_pathavurai: Comparing their eyes with the triumphant spear held in the elegant hand and the fierce flowery arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love), their shoulders to the soft bamboo and their bosom to the lofty mountains, and declaring that the hair in their tuft has surpassed the dark cloud in blackness, I have been describing the beauty of the pretty whores with the choicest words in an euphoric manner; I do not want to be waiting constantly in the courtyards of those whores with a treacherous mind, wasting my time thinking only about them; instead, will I not be able to right away hold on to Your unblemished and hallowed feet so that my heart overflows with bliss and love? He once measured the earth with merely a foot (as VAmanan); when the elephant (GajEndran) screamed for help seeking Him while He was slumbering in the milky ocean, He appeared before the elephant to rescue him; when that Lord VishNu sought Your help, You confronted and ripped apart the broad mountain, Krouncha, and the demon SUran who was in the disguise of a mango tree by wielding Your spear sending shock waves throughout the mountainous regions, Oh Lord! When the evil poison AlakAlam gushed out with a roar, He gulped down that poison and stored it in His neck; He gave a part of His body to Goddess PArvathi who is concorporate on His left side; He is the Cosmic Dancer; He is the primordial Lord SivA; You are His son; You graciously bless Your devotees in the righteous path and offer them refuge whenever they are in peril, Oh Great One!

1203.english_pathavurai: If anyone abuses Your devotees making them disheartened, that offence will affect that abuser causing severe ailment; all the people will gather around ridiculing that person who will become a laughing-stock; and at the end, the person will be dead and consumed by fire. Similarly, all the three slags of the worthless me (namely, arrogance, karma and delusion), along with my two diseases (namely, good and bad deeds) and the poverty that has stuck to me should all perish, and, to my great delight, the cosmos of pure knowledge should be perceivable. For that to happen, You must appear for my sake, mounted on Your peacock, and kindly bless me to reach the ultimate goal of Liberation! He holds River Ganga on His tresses; He mounts the bull, Nandi; He is our Father, with the hue of pure fire; by His mere smile, He burnt down the three mounts of Thiripuram into powder; when Manmathan (God of Love) accosted Him, He, Lord SivA, destroyed his body by the fiery eye (in His forehead); and, one day, from the sparks emanating from SivA's fiery eye, You were born, Oh Master! To alleviate the agony suffered by the celestials, You mounted Your peacock and subdued the arrogance and atrocities of the wicked demons; then You came out performing Your victory dance! Her waist is as slender as the lightning or a thread, and she has lovely bosoms; She is VaLLi, the young damsel of the KuRavAs; and You love her immensely, Oh Great One!

1204.english_meanings_list: ["The corpse is lying still inside the house; not letting it remain there, before it begins to rot,", "people start saying \"Build a grand bier for the body in front of the house; send for drums, well bound with leather straps; stop this loud crying;", "before the corpse decays any further, take the body out\"; and then the relatives lay the body on the funeral pyre in the cremation ground; on that day,", "You must come fast, mounted on the peacock, along with Your consort, VaLLi, the virtuous damsel of the hunters, to save my life!", "He went all the way to the pond where the wild elephant, GajEndran, in pain from the bite of the attacking crocodile, beseeched for help and blew His conch-shell;", "He, with the complexion of the rain-bearing dark cloud, came mounted on the Garudan, the King of all birds; He is the leader of the entire world; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu who extols You!", "Lord SivA, with His dense and matted hair, who is the substance of all those believers in the existence of God, was exhilarated when You wielded, with rage, Your spear that drove the screaming demons into the sea and destroyed them!", "When IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs in the celestial land, prostrated at Your feet, You redeemed his kingdom and re-established him, Oh Great One!"]
1204.english_pathavurai: The corpse is lying still inside the house; not letting it remain there, before it begins to rot, people start saying "Build a grand bier for the body in front of the house; send for drums, well bound with leather straps; stop this loud crying; before the corpse decays any further, take the body out"; and then the relatives lay the body on the funeral pyre in the cremation ground; on that day, You must come fast, mounted on the peacock, along with Your consort, VaLLi, the virtuous damsel of the hunters, to save my life! He went all the way to the pond where the wild elephant, GajEndran, in pain from the bite of the attacking crocodile, beseeched for help and blew His conch-shell; He, with the complexion of the rain-bearing dark cloud, came mounted on the Garudan, the King of all birds; He is the leader of the entire world; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu who extols You! Lord SivA, with His dense and matted hair, who is the substance of all those believers in the existence of God, was exhilarated when You wielded, with rage, Your spear that drove the screaming demons into the sea and destroyed them! When IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs in the celestial land, prostrated at Your feet, You redeemed his kingdom and re-established him, Oh Great One!

1205.english_pathavurai: He meticulously created the upper seven worlds and the lower seven worlds*; He presides, seated on the lotus flower and pervades all the worlds; He is the Consort of Saraswathi, the Goddess of letters; according to my destiny predetermined by that BrahmA, I assumed births again and again; I took so many shapes in several bodies properly; in this way, I entered many wombs (84,00,000) to take birth and eventually die; I do not know for how many aeons I have to endure this cycle (of birth and death) struggling in this world. Hail to You, Oh Lord! Kindly bless me not to be born again. 1215.english_meanings_list: ["Women with poison-filled eyes crying repeatedly, for a long time, pouring their hearts out;", "the ritualistic drums being beaten loudly, and people coming to know (about the news of death) by watching all those dancers;", "arrangements being made to securely fasten the bier to be taken in a hurry to the cremation ground, with all the relatives going away thereafter;", "and before the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) presenting the message saying \"Your time is up; get ready to leave\", and securely taking my life away,", "in order to destroy this lust-filled life, kindly grant me the sagacity to contemplate, with love, Your hallowed feet, adorned with anklets, which is the safe haven of True Knowledge!", "Oh Lord with the spear, Oh benefactor of fame, Oh SaravaNabhava whom devotees with a pure mind worship,", "Oh MurugA, having Your abode in the Mount of Jupiter (namely, SwAmimalai),", "Oh Young Lord, assuming several* disguises (and without revealing Your true identity), You worshipped VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, guarding the millet-field in VaLLimalai which is the abode of the hunters!", "You were known as the child of six KArththigai maids whom the entire world worships, and You materialised in the pond (SaravaNa) full of reedy grass!", "When the senior Lord SivA, Your father, beseeched You saying \"Hail to You, Oh Master!\", You preached to Him the PraNava ManthrA that gives Knowledge of eternal bliss, Oh Great One!"]
1215.english_pathavurai: Women with poison-filled eyes crying repeatedly, for a long time, pouring their hearts out; the ritualistic drums being beaten loudly, and people coming to know (about the news of death) by watching all those dancers; arrangements being made to securely fasten the bier to be taken in a hurry to the cremation ground, with all the relatives going away thereafter; and before the messengers of Yaman (God of Death) presenting the message saying "Your time is up; get ready to leave", and securely taking my life away, in order to destroy this lust-filled life, kindly grant me the sagacity to contemplate, with love, Your hallowed feet, adorned with anklets, which is the safe haven of True Knowledge! You were known as the child of six KArththigai maids whom the entire world worships, and You materialised in the pond (SaravaNa) full of reedy grass! When the senior Lord SivA, Your father, beseeched You saying "Hail to You, Oh Master!", You preached to Him the PraNava ManthrA that gives Knowledge of eternal bliss, Oh Great One!

1224.english_pathavurai: In all those songs inscribed in palm leaves praising human beings and in some of those songs elaborately sung, I thought I found a nice source of income and went after rich people. But I never cared to share the great wealth so earned. I was simply bragging about how great was my lineage was! In the forests or countryside or even in my own household, everyone in this world decried me for my meanness. Finally, is it for feeding the crowds of crows, dogs, foxes and devils that my body is meant? Can I put an end to such death and decay of my body? In the Land of the great IndrA, with a thousand eyes, lives DEvayAnai, who was reared by AirAvatham, the white elephant with tusks; she is Your consort. The earth wears the ocean as clothing; in that ocean, SUran created havoc, and You fought with Your Spear with Peacock as Your vehicle. You reside in several mounts* in Kongu NAdu! The hunters living in the mounts hold large bows with taut strings; and You married VaLLi, the damsel of that tribe, who followed their tradition. Fresh flowers are showered daily at Your feet by DEvAs worshipping Your feet, Oh great One!

He is of a green complexion and dances upon the serpent (KALingan); that Lord VishNu is full of praise for Lord BrahmA, seated on the reddish lotus; He, along with IndrA, mounting the white elephant AirAvadham, who is endowed with a thousand eyes, together with a multitude of devotees and worthy celestials praised You with devotion when You defeated Mount Krouncha that fell shamefully and when You knocked down the branches of the giant mango tree (SUran in disguise) which had grown up gigantically in the middle of the sea serving as a wrap-around cloth for the earth, Oh Great One!

1227.english_meanings_list: ["As the leather-bound drums are beaten indicating mourning, young men related to the deceased will be engaged in preparing the bier with wooden logs in front of the house;", "using torn rags to tie the body to the bier, they will lay down the corpse and set fire to it with leaping flames; and all those people assembled at the cremation ground, will take a dip in the river after consigning the body to fire and go to their respective homes to rest.", "This kind of life is a total myth, lacking stability.", "In order that this cycle of birth, that is the cause for all miseries, is ended, kindly grant me Your reddish and hallowed feet that can confer eternal bliss!", "You shook up all the demons in the mountains in the eight directions by wielding the bright spear that removed the weakness of the celestials, Oh Lord!", "By coaxing and cajoling VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, You hugged her twin mountain-like bosom wearing pearl-necklace with Your bright and hallowed shoulders, Oh Lord!", "A combination of round garlands of kadappa and vetchi flowers, oozing honey, adorn Your prominent chest, Oh Lord!", "In the circular and wavy sea, the demons came to fight aggressively, and You defeated them by splitting their bodies apart, Oh Great One!"]
1227.english_pathavurai: As the leather-bound drums are beaten indicating mourning, young men related to the deceased will be engaged in preparing the bier with wooden logs in front of the house; using torn rags to tie the body to the bier, they will lay down the corpse and set fire to it with leaping flames; and all those people assembled at the cremation ground, will take a dip in the river after consigning the body to fire and go to their respective homes to rest. This kind of life is a total myth, lacking stability. In order that this cycle of birth, that is the cause for all miseries, is ended, kindly grant me Your reddish and hallowed feet that can confer eternal bliss! You shook up all the demons in the mountains in the eight directions by wielding the bright spear that removed the weakness of the celestials, Oh Lord! By coaxing and cajoling VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, You hugged her twin mountain-like bosom wearing pearl-necklace with Your bright and hallowed shoulders, Oh Lord! A combination of round garlands of kadappa and vetchi flowers, oozing honey, adorn Your prominent chest, Oh Lord! In the circular and wavy sea, the demons came to fight aggressively, and You defeated them by splitting their bodies apart, Oh Great One!

1232.english_meanings_list: ["The large and crafty shark gobbles up many a fish; (likewise) in order that I could excel with a vast and illustrious erudition to conquer many a poet,", "in order that I am able to restrain the stone-like ignorant mind of mine from rambling on its own course and steady it, making it derive the benefit of research of elders,", "and in order that I discern truths, slowly crossing over the wavy sea of birth, (this is what I have to do) -", "collecting the following, namely, kurA flower, viLA and Aththi (mountain ebony) leaves, vetchi and cool jasmine flowers, kuRu root, blue lily, lotus, kadappa flower and vilvam (bael) leaves,", "I must offer them at Your hallowed alli-like feet which are large, beautiful and shiny like gold, and prostrate at them singing Your glory; will there be a day when I can do that?", "When the Saivite sage, who had ridden himself of all surging desires, had union with the dotted deer in Mount VaLLimalai, the deer-like damsel, VaLLi, was born; You spoke to her sweet words of deep love, Oh Lord!", "He stood there without any boundary in sight, and beyond the comprehension of Lord VishNu, who slumbers on the old serpent AdhisEshan, and IndrA, the Lord of all sacrifices; You are the Master of that Lord SivA!", "He chants VEdAs musically in a clear tone and pitch; You banged the heads of that Lord BrahmA with Your knuckles; You are the great asset of all poets, well-versed in the three branches of Tamil language, Oh Lord!", "You are the younger brother of the Divine Elephant-God, VinAyagAr; You are the Master of the white celestial elephant, airAvadham; and You are the beloved consort of DEvayAnai, Oh Great One!"]
1232.english_pathavurai: The large and crafty shark gobbles up many a fish; (likewise) in order that I could excel with a vast and illustrious erudition to conquer many a poet, in order that I am able to restrain the stone-like ignorant mind of mine from rambling on its own course and steady it, making it derive the benefit of research of elders, and in order that I discern truths, slowly crossing over the wavy sea of birth, (this is what I have to do) - collecting the following, namely, kurA flower, viLA and Aththi (mountain ebony) leaves, vetchi and cool jasmine flowers, kuRu root, blue lily, lotus, kadappa flower and vilvam (bael) leaves, I must offer them at Your hallowed alli-like feet which are large, beautiful and shiny like gold, and prostrate at them singing Your glory; will there be a day when I can do that? When the Saivite sage, who had ridden himself of all surging desires, had union with the dotted deer in Mount VaLLimalai, the deer-like damsel, VaLLi, was born; You spoke to her sweet words of deep love, Oh Lord! He stood there without any boundary in sight, and beyond the comprehension of Lord VishNu, who slumbers on the old serpent AdhisEshan, and IndrA, the Lord of all sacrifices; You are the Master of that Lord SivA! He chants VEdAs musically in a clear tone and pitch; You banged the heads of that Lord BrahmA with Your knuckles; You are the great asset of all poets, well-versed in the three branches of Tamil language, Oh Lord! You are the younger brother of the Divine Elephant-God, VinAyagAr; You are the Master of the white celestial elephant, airAvadham; and You are the beloved consort of DEvayAnai, Oh Great One!

1239.english_meanings_list: ["The urine, the faeces, flesh full of dirt and germs,", "blood and bones are packed into this portly body;", "living in this body, I have been indulging in many deceitful acts;", "my body has grown huge like a wild elephant with a trunk;", "centering around my children, my wife, jewels, clothings,", "my education and my clan, my life grew up into a complete state of aggrandizement;", "Entering this woeful world through a womb, I felt happy following this futile path;", "I learnt so many diverse works of art and went through the daily drill of wandering about with pain;", "I am caught within the web of my bad deeds; will this misery never end?", "He kept PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn, on the left side of His body and the moon and River ganga inside His tresses;", "He held the pickaxe and fire in His hands;", "with the intention of destroying the enemies, the three demons of Thiripuram, He stretched the Mount Meru as a bow and held it in His left arm", "and burnt down Thiripuram by His mere smile, as the VEdAs stood worshipping; You are the Great Treasure of a Son of that Lord SivA!", "People in many directions trembled and lost their balance", "when You threw the powerful spear from Your strong arms at the Mount Krouncha, Oh Lord MurugA!", "Your devotees who praise Your glory, pursuing an impeccable path of penance, reach the exalted state because", "You cast Your gracious eyes on them, Oh Great One!"]
1239.english_pathavurai: The urine, the faeces, flesh full of dirt and germs, blood and bones are packed into this portly body; living in this body, I have been indulging in many deceitful acts; my body has grown huge like a wild elephant with a trunk; centering around my children, my wife, jewels, clothings, my education and my clan, my life grew up into a complete state of aggrandizement; Entering this woeful world through a womb, I felt happy following this futile path; I learnt so many diverse works of art and went through the daily drill of wandering about with pain; I am caught within the web of my bad deeds; will this misery never end? He kept PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn, on the left side of His body and the moon and River ganga inside His tresses; He held the pickaxe and fire in His hands; with the intention of destroying the enemies, the three demons of Thiripuram, He stretched the Mount Meru as a bow and held it in His left arm and burnt down Thiripuram by His mere smile, as the VEdAs stood worshipping; You are the Great Treasure of a Son of that Lord SivA! People in many directions trembled and lost their balance when You threw the powerful spear from Your strong arms at the Mount Krouncha, Oh Lord MurugA! Your devotees who praise Your glory, pursuing an impeccable path of penance, reach the exalted state because You cast Your gracious eyes on them, Oh Great One!

1240.english_pathavurai: These great men resemble* SivA who performed the cosmic dance with exalted bliss of wisdom to the music and beats of Sankari (PArvathi). These people have transcended the ultimate state of tranquility and are endowed with sharp acumen; they belong to the inner circle of SivA. Along with these blessed ones experiencing siva-gnAna, I too would like to have my eyes half-closed in a trance with my breath held in suspension* while the radiant effulgence induces my soul to merge with SivA; and to remain in that state of sublime silence as long as I wish; will You not kindly bless me accordingly? The bunches of plantains are huge as the elephant's hanging trunk; these trees are amidst paddy fields surrounded by large groves; climbing from the sides of the field, the monkeys jump about from neem trees causing juice to ooze from the ripe mangoes, sweet like honey; the monkeys devour the mangoes in the forests of Mount VaLLimalai. Here lived VaLLi, with creeper-like waist that could not bear the weight of her ornaments and her large bosoms; with that beautiful damsel of the KuRavAs, You had a merry relationship in the dark and lovely groves where You reside happily, Oh Great One!

1241.english_meanings_list: ["The Divine Union with ParAsakthi seated on the Lotus of Saivite Knowledge", "is the most auspicious Bliss which one should experience fully; and without realising this,", "I have been roaming around this world as a symbol of the three slags (namely arrogance, karma and delusion).", "I have been chasing whores and should my life be so ruined?", "Amidst a multitude of Your devotees who practise meditation and have done penance,", "I would like to mingle daily and enjoy their company.", "So that my three slags, the vicious cycle of birth and death, good and bad deeds, and all my diseases are scared away screaming,", "You must come before me daily at the appropriate time!", "She is ever helpful, known as KalyANi by Her devotees;", "She occupies the left side of our Lord SivA majestically and is known as Gowri and SivagAmi;", "Once, She gave the mAdhuLam (pomogranates) fruit to the Great VinAyagA, the elephant-faced;", "and She is UmA PArvathi - and You are Her Son!", "Even if my birth in this world is a waste, I pray for immortality", "and a seat in Your Divine Temple meant for Your devotees!", "Oh Handsome One, You excel in mountainous places mounting the Peacock!", "You love to stay in hilly regions, Oh Lord with the Great Spear!", "You are the beloved of all Your devotees who praise You, Oh Great One!"]
1241.english_pathavurai: The Divine Union with ParAsakthi seated on the Lotus of Saivite Knowledge is the most auspicious Bliss which one should experience fully; and without realising this, I have been roaming around this world as a symbol of the three slags (namely arrogance, karma and delusion). I have been chasing whores and should my life be so ruined? Amidst a multitude of Your devotees who practise meditation and have done penance, I would like to mingle daily and enjoy their company. So that my three slags, the vicious cycle of birth and death, good and bad deeds, and all my diseases are scared away screaming, You must come before me daily at the appropriate time! She is ever helpful, known as KalyANi by Her devotees; She occupies the left side of our Lord SivA majestically and is known as Gowri and SivagAmi; Once, She gave the mAdhuLam (pomogranates) fruit to the Great VinAyagA, the elephant-faced; and She is UmA PArvathi - and You are Her Son! Even if my birth in this world is a waste, I pray for immortality and a seat in Your Divine Temple meant for Your devotees! Oh Handsome One, You excel in mountainous places mounting the Peacock! You love to stay in hilly regions, Oh Lord with the Great Spear! You are the beloved of all Your devotees who praise You, Oh Great One!

1242.english_pathavurai: Every day, I used to be intimidated by those whores who rolled their eyes in anger; I roamed about prostrating at their feet, being passionately involved with them; I used to grandly shower gifts on them with pleasure, making sure that those were never repeated; that grandeur deteriorated due to my excessive indulgence in carnal pleasure; lest I suffer any more indigence, the One that cannot be described by any one and permeates in forty-eight tenets with additional forty-eight tenets (in all 96 tenets*) and which grows within the body as a bliss of effulgence, will It not sustain me as the life of my life and bless me? He developed an animosity against the DEvAs, soared high in the sky, making the celestial world shriek in pain and tore off all the cardinal directions; he was the demon SUran who drew his sword and fought aggressively; his strong chest and heart were scattered right up to the top of the sky; and the famous mounts of MEru and Krouncha were shattered by Your spear, Oh Lord! You do not have any blemish, and You are the warrior among all warriors, Oh KanthA! You were enchanted by the beauty of VaLLi, the damsel of the innocent hunters, who guarded the crop in the millet field; biding Your time for an opportune moment, You embraced her lovingly, Oh Lord! You are the Lord of the celestials, Oh Great One!

1243.english_meanings_list: ["I was like the fish revolving with desire around the baited-food in the hook.", "Looking at the glittering attire (of women), I compared their complexion to that of tender mango leaf.", "Lusting for women, my mind revolved around ways and means of garnering wealth (to shower on them).", "Yaman, God of Death, who never deviates from the path of fate predetermined by BrahmA,", "is sure to search for and come to me to take away my life; at that time,", "Oh Primordial (Adhi) MurugA, kindly remind me to utter Your name as \"Adhi MurugA, Adhi MurugA and Adhi MurugA!\"", "The mount Krouncha, around which moist clouds hover, was destroyed to pieces,", "and the demons who lived there screamed in anguish when You fought them with Your spear.", "Lord SivA, the Master represented by the ManthrA \"Om NamasivAya\" prostrated at Your feet", "when You emerged as the yOgA Master, Oh Lord who mounts the peacock!", "You are the child elating Your mother, the impeccable Goddess PArvathi!", "Oh Lord, You are the nephew of Raghuraman, the great mystic Hari!", "On this earth, You dwell in the hearts of Your devotees!", "Oh MurugA, You are the consort of the wise damsel, DEvayAnai, belonging to the celestial land,", "You graciously made it possible for the celestials to redeem their lost kingdom, Oh Great One!"]
1243.english_pathavurai: I was like the fish revolving with desire around the baited-food in the hook. Looking at the glittering attire (of women), I compared their complexion to that of tender mango leaf. Lusting for women, my mind revolved around ways and means of garnering wealth (to shower on them). Yaman, God of Death, who never deviates from the path of fate predetermined by BrahmA, is sure to search for and come to me to take away my life; at that time, Oh Primordial (Adhi) MurugA, kindly remind me to utter Your name as "Adhi MurugA, Adhi MurugA and Adhi MurugA!" The mount Krouncha, around which moist clouds hover, was destroyed to pieces, and the demons who lived there screamed in anguish when You fought them with Your spear. Lord SivA, the Master represented by the ManthrA "Om NamasivAya" prostrated at Your feet when You emerged as the yOgA Master, Oh Lord who mounts the peacock! You are the child elating Your mother, the impeccable Goddess PArvathi! Oh Lord, You are the nephew of Raghuraman, the great mystic Hari! On this earth, You dwell in the hearts of Your devotees! Oh MurugA, You are the consort of the wise damsel, DEvayAnai, belonging to the celestial land, You graciously made it possible for the celestials to redeem their lost kingdom, Oh Great One!

1244.english_meanings_list: ["Desire for solid gold, land and woman (known as the three desires)", "starts like a little bud later growing into a fullfledged blossom;", "the desire grows bigger and bigger and never leaves the mind,", "becoming an obsession; and I am like the devil possessed.", "I have a sick and wretched body with which I committed millions of sins.", "When Yaman (God Of Death) approaches to push me deep down under the seven hells, and I am about to shed this life,", "all my sins and misdeeds should be driven away swiftly;", "for that, You must come speedily mounting Your horse-like Peacock and", "speaking words of wisdom within my audible range!", "The crying DEvAs in millions were peacefully settled to live long in their celestial land", "because You rushed with rage to the cold and wide sea which shuddered at Your ferocious speed;", "Yaman (God of Death) dashed to the battlefield (to take the lives of the demons);", "when You wielded the sharp and highly decorated Spear of Yours, Oh Lord MurugA!", "In the rich forest, He grabbed the pretty clothes of women,", "and climbed the kurunthai tree (to hide their clothes); You are the nephew of that mystic Krishna (VishNu)!", "You entered the commune of the KuRavAs where the folksy song, KuRam, is sung,", "and wooed Your beloved consort, VaLLi, pleased with her virtuous qualities; then, You lived happily for ever with her, Oh Great One!"]
1244.english_pathavurai: Desire for solid gold, land and woman (known as the three desires) starts like a little bud later growing into a fullfledged blossom; the desire grows bigger and bigger and never leaves the mind, becoming an obsession; and I am like the devil possessed. I have a sick and wretched body with which I committed millions of sins. When Yaman (God Of Death) approaches to push me deep down under the seven hells, and I am about to shed this life, all my sins and misdeeds should be driven away swiftly; for that, You must come speedily mounting Your horse-like Peacock and speaking words of wisdom within my audible range! The crying DEvAs in millions were peacefully settled to live long in their celestial land because You rushed with rage to the cold and wide sea which shuddered at Your ferocious speed; Yaman (God of Death) dashed to the battlefield (to take the lives of the demons); when You wielded the sharp and highly decorated Spear of Yours, Oh Lord MurugA! In the rich forest, He grabbed the pretty clothes of women, and climbed the kurunthai tree (to hide their clothes); You are the nephew of that mystic Krishna (VishNu)! You entered the commune of the KuRavAs where the folksy song, KuRam, is sung, and wooed Your beloved consort, VaLLi, pleased with her virtuous qualities; then, You lived happily for ever with her, Oh Great One!

1248.english_meanings_list: ["Their bosom is afflicted by decolorisation (acne); sandalwood paste is constantly applied on it; their breasts are like the ivory tusks of an elephant in rage whose fierce juices are of three types (that flow on the jaws, on the trunk and from the mouth);", "they are also comparable to the mountain whose peak glows in brightness and beauty; they appear to be filled with the divine nectar upto the brim; they look like tender coconuts;", "They are the most appropriate quenchers of the thirst of passion; they have the quality of haunting wealthy young men; with breasts like two copper pots, these women have a stunning appearance; such whores, resembling a creeper,", "have trapped me in their net where I am spending day and night; putting an end to this plight, kindly bless me to praise Your glory, Oh Lord!", "BrahmA, the Lord seated on a lotus with a hundred petals, Lord VishNu, the noblest deity in human form, and Lord SivA, holding fire in His hand are unable to comprehend the Principle", "that is matchless, that is all kinds of things, that fits in everywhere and that is filled with truth, beauty, sharpness, and importance; that supreme true knowledge was once preached by You, Oh Lord!", "You fought with the demons who hid themselves under the eddies of the bright sea that contains pearls and corals, wielding Your powerful and dazzling spear, Oh Lord!", "Those poets who know that You are seated in the songs written by them thinking about You and those great people who can instantaneously compose poems are highly aided by You in their research, Oh Great One!"]
1248.english_pathavurai: Their bosom is afflicted by decolorisation (acne); sandalwood paste is constantly applied on it; their breasts are like the ivory tusks of an elephant in rage whose fierce juices are of three types (that flow on the jaws, on the trunk and from the mouth); they are also comparable to the mountain whose peak glows in brightness and beauty; they appear to be filled with the divine nectar upto the brim; they look like tender coconuts; They are the most appropriate quenchers of the thirst of passion; they have the quality of haunting wealthy young men; with breasts like two copper pots, these women have a stunning appearance; such whores, resembling a creeper, have trapped me in their net where I am spending day and night; putting an end to this plight, kindly bless me to praise Your glory, Oh Lord! BrahmA, the Lord seated on a lotus with a hundred petals, Lord VishNu, the noblest deity in human form, and Lord SivA, holding fire in His hand are unable to comprehend the Principle that is matchless, that is all kinds of things, that fits in everywhere and that is filled with truth, beauty, sharpness, and importance; that supreme true knowledge was once preached by You, Oh Lord! You fought with the demons who hid themselves under the eddies of the bright sea that contains pearls and corals, wielding Your powerful and dazzling spear, Oh Lord! Those poets who know that You are seated in the songs written by them thinking about You and those great people who can instantaneously compose poems are highly aided by You in their research, Oh Great One!

1249.english_meanings_list: ["The good and bad deeds, which follow me like waves in the sea as a result of my treacherous acts,", "my body which induces the greying of my hair and my three blemishes (namely - arrogance, karma and delusion) must all perish;", "I wish to dip myself in the River Ganga of SivA's nectar, immerse in it and swim around until", "the sacred principle called SivA takes a firm footing in my mind so that my form becomes identical with Your form;", "the effulgent celestials and the sages, along with BrahmA and Vishnu,", "must declare (me) as the Son of Lord SivA and the elephant-faced Ganapathi must be elated to accept (me) as His younger brother;", "to show Your infinite compassion for me, kindly mount Your peacock, holding the Spear in Your hand,", "and join with me in an unison like in Your father's great cosmic dance", "to graciously teach me as well, the rarest PraNava ManthrA!", "In a divine prank, He transformed the jackals into horses", "and made all the horses belonging to a PANdiya King die (overnight); He is Lord NadarAjan who came to Madhurai;", "just to save Himself from blame, He stands besides me all the time; He has a skin texture of the red lotus;", "One could also say that it is a coral hue; He is the Consort of UmAdEvi; You are the son of that Lord SivA!", "Mount Krouncha, which was eerily dark and notorious for its treachery, the demons living thereon, and our deeds (both good and bad)", "were all burnt down when You wielded the Spear!", "She dwells in my devotion; She lives happily in the valley of VaLLimalai; She is VaLLi, the vanji (rattan reed) creeper-like damsel of the KuRavAs; along with her,", "You get into Your venerable bed of soft cotton, Oh Great One!"]
1249.english_pathavurai: The good and bad deeds, which follow me like waves in the sea as a result of my treacherous acts, my body which induces the greying of my hair and my three blemishes (namely - arrogance, karma and delusion) must all perish; I wish to dip myself in the River Ganga of SivA's nectar, immerse in it and swim around until the sacred principle called SivA takes a firm footing in my mind so that my form becomes identical with Your form; the effulgent celestials and the sages, along with BrahmA and Vishnu, must declare (me) as the Son of Lord SivA and the elephant-faced Ganapathi must be elated to accept (me) as His younger brother; to show Your infinite compassion for me, kindly mount Your peacock, holding the Spear in Your hand, and join with me in an unison like in Your father's great cosmic dance to graciously teach me as well, the rarest PraNava ManthrA! In a divine prank, He transformed the jackals into horses and made all the horses belonging to a PANdiya King die (overnight); He is Lord NadarAjan who came to Madhurai; just to save Himself from blame, He stands besides me all the time; He has a skin texture of the red lotus; One could also say that it is a coral hue; He is the Consort of UmAdEvi; You are the son of that Lord SivA! Mount Krouncha, which was eerily dark and notorious for its treachery, the demons living thereon, and our deeds (both good and bad) were all burnt down when You wielded the Spear! She dwells in my devotion; She lives happily in the valley of VaLLimalai; She is VaLLi, the vanji (rattan reed) creeper-like damsel of the KuRavAs; along with her, You get into Your venerable bed of soft cotton, Oh Great One!

1250.english_meanings_list: ["The five elements consisting of fire, air, earth, water and the great sky constitute this body;", "it is but a bag of skin soaked in the mud of desire;", "I believe that this body alone is myself; not knowing how to get aid of this great delusion,", "I keenly nourish this body of mine, an eventual prey for devils, fiends, old vultures, jackals and crows that would tear it apart and devour;", "this facetious life led by the devil in myself", "can be terminated only by Your granting me of Your hallowed feet, please oblige!", "Into the forest of VaLLimalai, where hunters roam about with bows in their well-formed hands rather than holding bamboo flutes,", "You entered assuming several disguises in pursuit of the pretty damsel, VaLLi, with a desire to marry her;", "Your passion for her was unremitting as You went about with a raised spear as though You were on a spying mission, Oh Young One!", "Mounting the great peacock, You attacked the golden mount Krouncha and uprooted it;", "all the confronting and hostile demons were burnt down into ash and destroyed;", "and the lofty land of the celestials was rescued by You, Oh Great One!"]
1250.english_pathavurai: The five elements consisting of fire, air, earth, water and the great sky constitute this body; it is but a bag of skin soaked in the mud of desire; I believe that this body alone is myself; not knowing how to get aid of this great delusion, I keenly nourish this body of mine, an eventual prey for devils, fiends, old vultures, jackals and crows that would tear it apart and devour; this facetious life led by the devil in myself can be terminated only by Your granting me of Your hallowed feet, please oblige! Into the forest of VaLLimalai, where hunters roam about with bows in their well-formed hands rather than holding bamboo flutes, You entered assuming several disguises in pursuit of the pretty damsel, VaLLi, with a desire to marry her; Your passion for her was unremitting as You went about with a raised spear as though You were on a spying mission, Oh Young One! Mounting the great peacock, You attacked the golden mount Krouncha and uprooted it; all the confronting and hostile demons were burnt down into ash and destroyed; and the lofty land of the celestials was rescued by You, Oh Great One!

1251.english_meanings_list: ["With shuddering bodies, these religious fanatics indulge in unruly debates with sharp attacks against the opponents;", "to such typhoon-like crowd, It could retaliate with millions of counter-points;", "It could sever the seat of vicious power that presides over oppressive and vindictive acts; It is capable of wielding the spear that shears the bodies of the enemies;", "It is capable of shedding all the hair of the (arrogant) experts of the texts;", "It is the one that has not been fathomed by the heaps of scriptures which are so orderly compiled that everyone surrenders to them;", "It is that primordial substance whose nature I shall explain to all with clarity.", "(in turn) kindly teach me the meaning of the matchless PraNava ManthrA so that no one can point the finger at me!", "(In the battlefield) there were many fiends engaged in drinking blood; some scooped, and some soaked themselves in, blood; some danced in ecstasy;", "some dived into the thick sea of blood; some began to gauge the depth as a few merrily bathed in that sea; some onlooking fiends simply were overwhelmed with joy;", "in that mirth, some began to knock down the mountains; some began to sing songs and some chanted the glory of Lord Murugan while some concluded with the tail-pieces of those songs;", "while the multitude of fiends were having a ball with such pranks,", "You shattered the hostile and menacing demons into pieces in just a flash of a second and killed them in the war, Oh Great One!"]
1251.english_pathavurai: With shuddering bodies, these religious fanatics indulge in unruly debates with sharp attacks against the opponents; to such typhoon-like crowd, It could retaliate with millions of counter-points; It could sever the seat of vicious power that presides over oppressive and vindictive acts; It is capable of wielding the spear that shears the bodies of the enemies; It is capable of shedding all the hair of the (arrogant) experts of the texts; It is the one that has not been fathomed by the heaps of scriptures which are so orderly compiled that everyone surrenders to them; It is that primordial substance whose nature I shall explain to all with clarity. (in turn) kindly teach me the meaning of the matchless PraNava ManthrA so that no one can point the finger at me! (In the battlefield) there were many fiends engaged in drinking blood; some scooped, and some soaked themselves in, blood; some danced in ecstasy; some dived into the thick sea of blood; some began to gauge the depth as a few merrily bathed in that sea; some onlooking fiends simply were overwhelmed with joy; in that mirth, some began to knock down the mountains; some began to sing songs and some chanted the glory of Lord Murugan while some concluded with the tail-pieces of those songs; while the multitude of fiends were having a ball with such pranks, You shattered the hostile and menacing demons into pieces in just a flash of a second and killed them in the war, Oh Great One!

1252.english_meanings_list: ["The spotted and poisonous serpent, fresh and tender jasmine and nochchi flowers, vilwa leaves,", "white nectar-filled crescent moon with many phases, green mango leaves,", "pure blood-red flower of pAthiri, golden flower of kondRai (Indian laburnum), a scorpion,", "the celebrated river Gangai full of waves, blue lily,", "fresh flower of erukkai, the famous skull of BrahmA, bunches of aRugam (cynodon) grass, and cool and pretty flower of Umaththai -", "all these adorn the matted hair of Lord SivA; You preached to that SivA", "a sacred, famous, pure and truthful principle that represents the intellect, containing in itself the eight great sidhdhis* (miraculous deeds);", "will You kindly teach that to me as I am clinging to a transient life like that of a water bubble?", "Your peacock has a neat row of plumes and a beautiful green hue; You mounted from the side of that triumphant vehicle and flew around;", "You killed all those demons by stabbing them and making their split open jaws spew flesh;", "making the scared and screaming SUrapadhman**, the realised one, run for life,", "while the sea, a vast deluge, tossing pearls through its waves and containing plenty of fish, rose in agitation;", "the demon SUran in the disguise of a mango tree was terrified with its branches breaking and giving way;", "the countless conch shells that yield pearls and the eight elephants with trunks (guarding the eight directions) got scared and went into hiding;", "when You raised the staff of Rooster in Your hand, Oh valorous and Great One!"]
1252.english_pathavurai: The spotted and poisonous serpent, fresh and tender jasmine and nochchi flowers, vilwa leaves, white nectar-filled crescent moon with many phases, green mango leaves, pure blood-red flower of pAthiri, golden flower of kondRai (Indian laburnum), a scorpion, the celebrated river Gangai full of waves, blue lily, fresh flower of erukkai, the famous skull of BrahmA, bunches of aRugam (cynodon) grass, and cool and pretty flower of Umaththai - all these adorn the matted hair of Lord SivA; You preached to that SivA a sacred, famous, pure and truthful principle that represents the intellect, containing in itself the eight great sidhdhis* (miraculous deeds); will You kindly teach that to me as I am clinging to a transient life like that of a water bubble? Your peacock has a neat row of plumes and a beautiful green hue; You mounted from the side of that triumphant vehicle and flew around; You killed all those demons by stabbing them and making their split open jaws spew flesh; making the scared and screaming SUrapadhman**, the realised one, run for life, while the sea, a vast deluge, tossing pearls through its waves and containing plenty of fish, rose in agitation; the demon SUran in the disguise of a mango tree was terrified with its branches breaking and giving way; the countless conch shells that yield pearls and the eight elephants with trunks (guarding the eight directions) got scared and went into hiding; when You raised the staff of Rooster in Your hand, Oh valorous and Great One!

1253.english_meanings_list: ["(Right from my young age,) before my mind could comprehend the real extent of my right, if any, to my wife, children and wealth,", "and before my strength is drained out by the oppressive miseries and terrible confusions caused by the five angry and powerful sensory organs that besiege me captively,", "Oh, the good nephew of Lord Vishnu, who is the Supreme One slumbering on a slumping and coiled snake-bed in the middle of the milky ocean,", "kindly grant me the good sense to say, write and chant the words of Your unblemished glory and to speak only the truth everyday!", "The demons who inhabited the mount Krouncha and the seven hills and the demon SUran, who came to the battlefield like the flashy lightning and the thunder confronting together,", "were all pushed by You down the seven seas to drown, and You gave strength to the DEvAs in the celestial land, Oh Lord!", "Goddess PArvathi has been placed concorporate on His left side for the benefit of the world and in recognition of Her penance; to the full enlightenment of that Leader, Lord SivA, You preached to Him the true meaning of the PraNava ManthrA, Oh Lord!", "You are the One who is capable of keeping me on the righteous path of Knowledge; and You are good to Your devotees, Oh Great One!"]
1253.english_pathavurai: (Right from my young age,) before my mind could comprehend the real extent of my right, if any, to my wife, children and wealth, and before my strength is drained out by the oppressive miseries and terrible confusions caused by the five angry and powerful sensory organs that besiege me captively, Oh, the good nephew of Lord Vishnu, who is the Supreme One slumbering on a slumping and coiled snake-bed in the middle of the milky ocean, kindly grant me the good sense to say, write and chant the words of Your unblemished glory and to speak only the truth everyday! She is the Mother; She is the Goddess to all; She has a vanji (rattan reed) creeper-like waist; She is KALi, the Deity of the Villages; She is Goddess Saraswathi holding in Her arms the famous veeNA called Vipanchi; She is the most powerful and beautiful damsel; apirAmi She is the flourishing Consort loved by Lord SivA; during the end of the KalpA when destruction of the worlds takes place, this Goddess BAla holds Her five faces above the flood; She is UmAdEvi, the consort of Lord SivA who burnt down Thiripuram, concorporating snugly on the left side of that Lord; She is our dear Mother; She is the One who interpreted all the scriptures and the ancient epics; She is the younger sister of the blue-hued Lord VishNu, who killed the demon, Muran (hence named MurAri); She is the Mother who protects the fourteen worlds delivered by Her; with all His dancing attires vibrating, He danced on the (golden) stage fiercely against the background music; He is Lord SivA with matted hair, and She is His DEvi PArvathi who delivered You, Oh Great One!

1265.english_pathavurai: The body has taken this shape as if it is going to accomplish a big job. Taking keen interest in this body, the cause for all miseries a life entered the womb, and a child was born; he was lying down; he was sitting there; he was crawling; he was walking; he became tired and eventualy died, becoming a corpse. (People began to say) "Take away this corpse to the cremation ground and burn it"; Some even appreciated the adornment made to the dead body! Everyone took a dip in the water and left the cremation ground, forgetting the love and attachment to that body! For the sake of that destructible body, I have been roaming about aimlessly. Kindly bless me reassuring "Fear Not!" He went to the dense forest along with His younger brother, Lakshmanan; they searched for the damsel (Seetha who was missing) everywhere in the forest; He set fire to LankApuri through the help of the monkey, HanumAr; He is the great King Rama; and You are His nephew. They bear the battling bows in their arms; they are hunters, capable of wielding arrows and conquering those who are disrespectful to them; those hunters' millet-field was guarded by the beautiful damsel, VaLLi, and You are her consort. You are absolutely blemishless! You are the Lord of all the celestials who praise Your glory, Oh Great One!

1267.english_meanings_list: ["My children, mother, nephews, uncles, wife and other relatives living with me will all be saddened;", "causing misery due to delusion that is darker than black sea, I will become disheartened;", "Yaman, the God of Death, mounted on the black buffalo, will come in search of my place putting on airs of uppity;", "my speech will falter; before the determination of the remaining duration of my life (in other words, before my imminent death),", "to enable my mind to cease its activity and to leave me in a dreamless and wakeless state, will You kindly grant me, at least slightly, Your hallowed lotus feet?", "He assessed the action (of provoking lust) of Manmathan, God of Love, who held the bow of sugarcane; and He opened His third (fiery) eye upon Manmathan and burnt him down;", "then He sat in deep meditation (yOgA); to that Lord SivA,", "You taught happily the primordial principle of True Knowledge that is inconceivable even to the mystical Lord VishNu who pervades all sentient and insentient beings!", "Oh MurugA, Your heart simply melts for the songs of Your devotees who poignantly extol Your glory with deep affection!", "On Your (left) side is Your consort, DEvayAnai, the daughter of Lakshmi, with whom She lives in accord;", "She is VaLLi, who looks like a green deer, reared by the hunters; You are Her sweetheart, Oh Great One!"]
1267.english_pathavurai: My children, mother, nephews, uncles, wife and other relatives living with me will all be saddened; causing misery due to delusion that is darker than black sea, I will become disheartened; Yaman, the God of Death, mounted on the black buffalo, will come in search of my place putting on airs of uppity; my speech will falter; before the determination of the remaining duration of my life (in other words, before my imminent death), to enable my mind to cease its activity and to leave me in a dreamless and wakeless state, will You kindly grant me, at least slightly, Your hallowed lotus feet? He assessed the action (of provoking lust) of Manmathan, God of Love, who held the bow of sugarcane; and He opened His third (fiery) eye upon Manmathan and burnt him down; then He sat in deep meditation (yOgA); to that Lord SivA, You taught happily the primordial principle of True Knowledge that is inconceivable even to the mystical Lord VishNu who pervades all sentient and insentient beings! Oh MurugA, Your heart simply melts for the songs of Your devotees who poignantly extol Your glory with deep affection! On Your (left) side is Your consort, DEvayAnai, the daughter of Lakshmi, with whom She lives in accord; She is VaLLi, who looks like a green deer, reared by the hunters; You are Her sweetheart, Oh Great One!

1269.english_pathavurai: I am a sinner with no intelligence whatsoever; I am a hot-tempered one never following the directions of my master; I am a devil with an unsteady mind; I am a coward never giving up the useless methods arising from delusion; I am a ruffian who never thinks about doing penance at all; I am not destined to ponder how this body originated; I am a wicked miser; I do not have the guts to speak in public; and I am a worthless fellow incapable of freeing myself from the clutches of bad deeds. Kindly let me delve into the most supreme subject, namely, the path of True Knowledge and grant me the gift of Your Divine vision. The mighty SUran who confronted You in the battlefield was split into two by the Spear wielded by You so promptly, Oh Brave One, Kumaresa! Those wise ones who never forget to speak kind words will not enter another womb for rebirth, and are able to maintain their youth all the time because of Your blessing! You are the Master of the Supreme Lord SivA who wears Ganga River and snakes on His tresses. You have the peacock whose strides are fierce, Oh valorous One! You caress VaLLi, the smiling young damsel of the KuRavAs, who has wisdom! On Your chest dangles the necklace made of nine precious gems, Oh Great One!

1270.english_pathavurai: In this delusory life, the body is a nest with a collection of faeces, skin and water, along with plenty of bones; when this body swoons and suffers, and (ultimately) after the life gas (oxygen) meant for the benefit of the body departs, the father, the wife, the great mother and the relatives who are like brothers assemble and call out by name at the top of their voice; people who live in the same town gather in the cremation ground with a depressed heart and weep loudly; (even at that time,) kindly take charge of me so that I could hold on to Your hallowed feet firmly with love and purity in my heart and offer my prostration at those feet! Upon those devotees who touch the spot of Your hallowed feet and clasp it tight, and upon those loved ones who hail loudly Your holy feet deeming them to be a fresh flowery garden and a cool pond, prosperity is bestowed by Lord SivA, the dancing NadarAja, Who acclaims You happily with an applause; to that Lord SivA, You preached the great Text of VEdic Knowledge, Oh Great Treasure! When the palm-leaf on which You scribed the ManthrA (coming as ThirugnAna Sambandhar) went against the current of the flood water in the river, the ChamaNas who had challenged and vowed against you lost in both competitions on fire and water and felt emasculated by Your rage, Oh Lord with the spear! You grant boons to all those wakeful elders who have found a way to remain tireless so as to preserve the righteous path and to all the devotees who worship You, Oh Great One!

1271.english_pathavurai: My mind ponders over millions of miseries in a fraction of a second. Taunted by the God of Love, my mind indulges in lustful thoughts, hankering after exquisitely beautiful and young girls. I move about on this earth in total daze, having lost my sense and prestige. Being fenced in by the worst karma (bad deed), I roam around in this world aimlessly. On the final day when my body is rendered extremely weak due to the tricks played on me (by those women), will You kindly rush to my aid, mounting Your Peacock that has the speediest wings, and grant me blissful liberation; the Supreme Cosmos of Wisdom? You roved about in the hills and forests to reach the millet-field guarded by the hunters and finally surrendered at the feet of the innocent petite damsel, VaLLi, Oh Kumaresa! He built a bridge across the wavy seas and conquered the embattling King, Ravana; He is Rama (Vishnu), who killed the demon Muran to earn the name MurAri; His younger sister, PArvathi, delivered You as Her child! The sages, the DEvAs and all those in the celestial land were encircled and imprisoned by the powerful demons; their armies, with their entire families, were killed; their heads were shattered all over into millions of pieces to be devoured by eagles and vultures; such was the prowess of Your sharp spear, Oh Great One!

1272.english_meanings_list: ["Out of a passionate union with a woman, a dew-like drop of love enters the body; it goes through the gyration like a grain of lentil and soaks in the womb;", "it undergoes a metamorphosis, and a jack-fruit-like abdomen is carried which swells like the stomach of a pregnant cow;", "at the stipulated time of delivery, the belly loosens, and the baby is born, coming out and falling gently on the earth described in the scriptures;", "the crawling of the child is compared by people to the rolloing over of a swine; wearing bright ornaments embedded with gems, the child learns to toddle in many a gait;", "(growing up,) he roams about in several ways to wherever his mind directs, smearing many fragrant perfumes like the musk on his body; will I also be ensnared in the net spread out by the whores and eventually face my death?", "When the elephant (GajEndran) implored ardently calling Him \"Oh Primordial Lord, I seek refuge in You\", He destroyed the crocodile (that grabbed the elephant) by utterly splitting it into two with the disc held in His Hand; He is Lord VishNu;", "He incarnated as the turtle, kayal fish, the triumphant boar, the dwarf (VAmanar) and Narasimham (Man-Lion) with widespread hands; He is the Lord slumbering on a serpent-bed; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "He stood in ThiruvaNNAmalai in the form of a dazzling effulgence; He wears the crescent moon (on His matted hair); His abode is Mount KailAsh; and You are the child of that Lord SivA!", "She looks like the peacock with a beautiful plume; You lovingly hugged the shoulders of that VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and united with her, Oh Great One!"]
1272.english_pathavurai: Out of a passionate union with a woman, a dew-like drop of love enters the body; it goes through the gyration like a grain of lentil and soaks in the womb; it undergoes a metamorphosis, and a jack-fruit-like abdomen is carried which swells like the stomach of a pregnant cow; at the stipulated time of delivery, the belly loosens, and the baby is born, coming out and falling gently on the earth described in the scriptures; the crawling of the child is compared by people to the rolloing over of a swine; wearing bright ornaments embedded with gems, the child learns to toddle in many a gait; (growing up,) he roams about in several ways to wherever his mind directs, smearing many fragrant perfumes like the musk on his body; will I also be ensnared in the net spread out by the whores and eventually face my death? When the elephant (GajEndran) implored ardently calling Him "Oh Primordial Lord, I seek refuge in You", He destroyed the crocodile (that grabbed the elephant) by utterly splitting it into two with the disc held in His Hand; He is Lord VishNu; He incarnated as the turtle, kayal fish, the triumphant boar, the dwarf (VAmanar) and Narasimham (Man-Lion) with widespread hands; He is the Lord slumbering on a serpent-bed; and You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! He stood in ThiruvaNNAmalai in the form of a dazzling effulgence; He wears the crescent moon (on His matted hair); His abode is Mount KailAsh; and You are the child of that Lord SivA! She looks like the peacock with a beautiful plume; You lovingly hugged the shoulders of that VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, and united with her, Oh Great One!

1273.english_meanings_list: ["The bosom of the whores looks like two mountains adorned with snugly entwined necklaces studded with pearls and rubies and like raging elephants;", "upon being attacked by their sharp spear-like eyes on their full-moon-like face, my mind has been darkened by the shadow cast by the black cloud of ignorance;", "lest my clear and pure knowledge depart, making my action reckless and mischievous and my mind grief-stricken and confused,", "kindly bless me with the ability for my tongue to compose songs with several words in praise of You and to worship Your hallowed feet; for that, You will have to bestow compassionately, even if slightly, Your illustrious lotus feet!", "The bunch of ten heads (of RAvaNan) was felled down when He wielded His arrow aimed accurately; He is the enraged Lord, Rama, the mystic VishNu; and You are His valorous nephew!", "You are the one who spoke tantalising and passion-provoking words to the ordinary hunter-girl, VaLLi, who hailed from the lineage of the KuRavAs, Oh Lord Kumara!", "You are the core principle of the great VEdAs capable of removing Your devotees' attachment to their deeds, who extol You with deep contemplation and devotion!", "You are governed by the true love of those who sing Your glory and who have learnt words filled with devoutness and deep knowledge; You are the genuine principle cherished by the celestials, Oh Great One!"]
1273.english_pathavurai: The bosom of the whores looks like two mountains adorned with snugly entwined necklaces studded with pearls and rubies and like raging elephants; upon being attacked by their sharp spear-like eyes on their full-moon-like face, my mind has been darkened by the shadow cast by the black cloud of ignorance; lest my clear and pure knowledge depart, making my action reckless and mischievous and my mind grief-stricken and confused, kindly bless me with the ability for my tongue to compose songs with several words in praise of You and to worship Your hallowed feet; for that, You will have to bestow compassionately, even if slightly, Your illustrious lotus feet! The bunch of ten heads (of RAvaNan) was felled down when He wielded His arrow aimed accurately; He is the enraged Lord, Rama, the mystic VishNu; and You are His valorous nephew! You are the one who spoke tantalising and passion-provoking words to the ordinary hunter-girl, VaLLi, who hailed from the lineage of the KuRavAs, Oh Lord Kumara! You are the core principle of the great VEdAs capable of removing Your devotees' attachment to their deeds, who extol You with deep contemplation and devotion! You are governed by the true love of those who sing Your glory and who have learnt words filled with devoutness and deep knowledge; You are the genuine principle cherished by the celestials, Oh Great One!

1274.english_pathavurai: "Oh MurugA! You are the valiant one mounting the peacock! Oh SaravaNabhava! She is the mountain girl of VaLLimalai, guarding an abundant produce of millet; her beautiful breasts like the lotus bud are splashed with sandalwood paste; You are her ardent lover immersing Yourself in her bosom! Oh Master, You taught the crux of the three-some principle of God, Soul and Bondage (Pathi, Pasu, PAsam) to the old Lord SivA who burnt down Thiripuram!" - with these words, I wish to praise Your glory with a melting heart, dancing and singing, in pursuit of Your hallowed feet to place them on my head; my insight sometimes dodges me and, at certain other times, coincides with my thinking; in order that my attachment to the people on this earth is severed, kindly bless me with a steady and true knowledge and the pleasure of joining the company of Your devotees; will there be such an auspicious day for me? Without any consideration for the relationship to his nephew (Krishnan), the evil uncle, Kamsan, viciously plotted his murder; he sent the crafty and cruel fiend (PUthanai) whose life was sucked out by Him along with the poisonous milk from her breast; later, when the violent elephant KuvalayApeetam charged to kill, its ivory tusks were squeezed out by Him killing the elephant; (when another demon KabistAsuran menacingly took the disguise of a viLA tree,) the unripe and ripe viLA fruits were knocked down breaking the tree by His forceful throwing on him (of yet another demon DhenukAsuran disguised as a calf); He fought with the giant crane (Kesi) with huge feathers (and killed it by splitting its beaks open); He crawled (with His waist tied to a stone-barrel) amidst two large hideous marutha trees*, knocking them down; at that time, He kicked with His foot the giant wheel of a cart and killed the demon (CakatAsuran in disguise); He grappled with the state wrestlers (ChaNUran and Mushtikan) literally toying with them; performing so many miracles as a child's play, He grew among the shepherds; He is Krishna of the hue of dark cloud; and You are the nephew of that VishNu! You are the Lord praised by the great celestials living in the golden world of IndrA who holds the weapon, vajram, Oh Great One!
