1275.english_pathavurai: The forest of desire which grows in the mind, (withut spreading wildly) should transcend the flame far above the mUlAdhara Peetam* and realise the sublime silent state in several ways. The right path is shown by Your multiple mystical ways leading to salvation. Bless me with Your preaching of the secret discipline governed by moral code and grant me the benefit thereof. You are the eternal flame that never shows any diminishing, and You are the dispenser of justice! Tasting sweetly like nectar in several ways, the four great scriptures are chanted with meditation beeds by those saints who seek to do research in them, and their sufferings are removed by You. You are the nephew of NArAyana (who is chanted by the name of Hari Hari) and of Lakshmi! He holds the trident in His hand; He is the embodiment of Saivite Knowledge; and He kicked the God of Death (Yaman) by His foot. He is Lord SivA who blessed us with You, Oh Great Master! To the beat of "thOthee thikuthiku theethee seka" You dance as the brilliant light in this world, Oh Great One!

1276.english_meanings_list: ["Both their eyes, filled with capillary blood vessels, became very red; their circular face perspired, covered with little beads of sweat;", "their anklets, embedded with gems, made a jingling sound; their hair became loose, sliding down; they lost their self-control, being obsessed with passion;", "both their breasts shook; their waist caved in, becoming sore; imbibing their sweet saliva, I hugged the shoulders of those whores losing my mind; nonetheless,", "I would never forget Your golden and hallowed feet, Oh Lord!", "When the wide expanse of sea was stirred with great agitation, the celestials wondered if the AlakAla poison was forming again for the second time, becoming scared and losing their confidence;", "they fell on Your fragrant and hallowed feet and screamed asking if it were fair; they did not know what else to say and stood there in absolute shock with a depressed mind when You wielded Your Spear, Oh valorous One!", "All the great worlds shuddered when Your matchless peacock, named SikaNdi, flew with its feathers raised; mounting that peacock and seated on it elegantly, You protected the world, Oh Great One!"]
1276.english_pathavurai: Both their eyes, filled with capillary blood vessels, became very red; their circular face perspired, covered with little beads of sweat; their anklets, embedded with gems, made a jingling sound; their hair became loose, sliding down; they lost their self-control, being obsessed with passion; both their breasts shook; their waist caved in, becoming sore; imbibing their sweet saliva, I hugged the shoulders of those whores losing my mind; nonetheless, I would never forget Your golden and hallowed feet, Oh Lord! When the wide expanse of sea was stirred with great agitation, the celestials wondered if the AlakAla poison was forming again for the second time, becoming scared and losing their confidence; they fell on Your fragrant and hallowed feet and screamed asking if it were fair; they did not know what else to say and stood there in absolute shock with a depressed mind when You wielded Your Spear, Oh valorous One! All the great worlds shuddered when Your matchless peacock, named SikaNdi, flew with its feathers raised; mounting that peacock and seated on it elegantly, You protected the world, Oh Great One!

As the great Master of Lord SivA, You preached into His ear the PraNava ManthrA, Oh Treasure of all virtues! You are Lord MurugA with immense love and friendship! She is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs; on her plumpy and showy bosom, wearing a string of pearls, the pollen grains from the flowers of Your garlands rubs off, Oh Great One!

1278.english_pathavurai: Hacking to death the men and even the sages who fall for them, their hearts are also snatched away by those reddish spear-like eyes; their fragrant hair like the dark cloud, their smile, their large and wondrous bosom splashed with the paste of musk; their sweet voice; their concave navel shaped like a lotus; their (slender) waist; - with all these beautiful features, the whores offer carnal pleasure; roaming all around in search of it, my life is cut short by such cruel distractions. To end this miserable life and to eradicate the endless recurrence of birth, will You not kindly consider granting me Your hallowed and grand feet, the seat of matchless tranquility and supreme bliss? Your six hallowed faces whose beauty is beyond description, the elegant forehead, the exquisitely dainty jewels studded with diamonds, the twelve pure and long flower-like eyes showering compassion, the twelve graceful hanging ear-rings, the studs made of gems, lotus-like hands, the reddish golden sacred thread, the praiseworthy beads of gems on Your outfit, the waist-band, Your holy feet, Your lilting anklets with pearls set inside, Your beautiful Peacock, and the Spear in Your hand - all these aspects of Yours are splendid, Oh Kumara! You are the virtuous son of the three-eyed Lord SivA who dotes on PArvathi, the daughter of HimavAn! You are the Lord of all the celestials, Oh Great One!

1280.english_meanings_list: ["The eyes of the whores, determined to cause misery, may be compared with the spear, the sword, the evil poison AlakAlam and the arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love);", "playing dangerous erotic games with such whores, I have been passionately involved with them, losing my balance;", "in order to give up the many-faceted pompous gaiety and to direct myself to the righteous path and to get rid of the blemishes in my character,", "kindly show me that great path lit with true knowledge that is beyond comprehension, that is not easy to describe and that is supreme!", "Lord VishNu, coming as RAmA in Manu's lineage, thoughtfully wielded an arrow to pierce the heart of VAli and to knock down the seven gigantic trees;", "when IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs, screamed seeking refuge, He blew His conch shell whose sound was so overpowering that all the celestials swooned; He is the gracious Lord KrishnA* of blue complexion; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu!", "The glory of the mean and evil demons, who led a pompous life, was destroyed by You, Oh Young One!", "Enhancing Your love for her, You hug VaLLi, the peacock-like damsel of the KuRavAs, with Your strong shoulders whose valour is peerless and which are adorned by kadappa garland, Oh Great One!"]
1280.english_pathavurai: The eyes of the whores, determined to cause misery, may be compared with the spear, the sword, the evil poison AlakAlam and the arrows shot by Manmathan (God of Love); playing dangerous erotic games with such whores, I have been passionately involved with them, losing my balance; in order to give up the many-faceted pompous gaiety and to direct myself to the righteous path and to get rid of the blemishes in my character, kindly show me that great path lit with true knowledge that is beyond comprehension, that is not easy to describe and that is supreme! Lord VishNu, coming as RAmA in Manu's lineage, thoughtfully wielded an arrow to pierce the heart of VAli and to knock down the seven gigantic trees; when IndrA, the leader of the DEvAs, screamed seeking refuge, He blew His conch shell whose sound was so overpowering that all the celestials swooned; He is the gracious Lord KrishnA* of blue complexion; You are the nephew of that Lord VishNu! The glory of the mean and evil demons, who led a pompous life, was destroyed by You, Oh Young One! Enhancing Your love for her, You hug VaLLi, the peacock-like damsel of the KuRavAs, with Your strong shoulders whose valour is peerless and which are adorned by kadappa garland, Oh Great One!

1297.english_pathavurai: Attacking me with His flowery arrows, and at the same time being invisible, Manmathan (Love God) haunts me; the neighbouring women harrass me with their taunts; the rays from the moon scorch me while the moon itself remains bright and cold; and is it fair that I should be subjected to these pangs of separation from You? Your valour is matchless! The hostile and argumentative SUran and his clan were annihilated by You as their God of Death! Your vehicle Peacock's valour is absolutely uncontrollable! None else can ever be Your equal, Oh Great One!

1298.english_meanings_list: ["To go as a messenger several times to Paravai NAchchiyAr (on behalf of His devotee Sundarar)*,", "He was most willing; such was the reputation (of Your Father, Lord SivA).", "You too will have to be a Great One in accordance with the eminence of Your lineage;", "kindly come here to bestow upon me bountiful boons!", "You are the younger brother of Ganapathi, who has the sign of gushing saliva left behind on His elephant face and who is a benefactor like the wish-yielding tree, KaRpagam.", "You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, whose eyes are like the deer and the bow.", "You preached to Lord SivA the significance of eternal truth!", "You banged the heads of BrahmA with Your knuckles, Oh Great One!"]
1298.english_pathavurai: To go as a messenger several times to Paravai NAchchiyAr (on behalf of His devotee Sundarar)*, He was most willing; such was the reputation (of Your Father, Lord SivA). You too will have to be a Great One in accordance with the eminence of Your lineage; kindly come here to bestow upon me bountiful boons! You are the younger brother of Ganapathi, who has the sign of gushing saliva left behind on His elephant face and who is a benefactor like the wish-yielding tree, KaRpagam. You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, whose eyes are like the deer and the bow. You preached to Lord SivA the significance of eternal truth! You banged the heads of BrahmA with Your knuckles, Oh Great One!

1299.english_pathavurai: In order that I do not fall again into the wavy river of birth, and in order that I do not roam about aimlessly as per the dictates of Nature, I need Your firm and masterly interpretation of the Truth and the vision of Your hallowed feet. You are the essence of the scriptures of the six* sects of religion. For those who discern You in their intellect, You are the ocean of all virtues! You are the Lord of the three branches of Tamil, worshipped by the diminutive sage, Agasthya! Oh KumarA, the Master! You are adored by the KArththigai maids, Oh Great One!

1300.english_meanings_list: ["It is something that cannot be written down in books or palm leaves;", "I want You to show Its beauty elegantly to me;", "please make me realise the fortune of gracious Knowledge;", "and kindly think in terms of protecting me daintily by bestowing Your grace on me!", "She chased away the parrots from the millet-field by seeking them out; she lived in the forest;", "You wooed that VaLLi, praised her and attained great fame!", "Herds of humming flies and beetles can never penetrate the thick groves of", "KaRpaga trees in the celestial land which was rescued by You, Oh Great One!"]
1300.english_pathavurai: It is something that cannot be written down in books or palm leaves; I want You to show Its beauty elegantly to me; please make me realise the fortune of gracious Knowledge; and kindly think in terms of protecting me daintily by bestowing Your grace on me! She chased away the parrots from the millet-field by seeking them out; she lived in the forest; You wooed that VaLLi, praised her and attained great fame! Herds of humming flies and beetles can never penetrate the thick groves of KaRpaga trees in the celestial land which was rescued by You, Oh Great One!

1302.english_pathavurai: I do not know how to break away from the delusory web of wife, children and relatives. I, the lowly dog, pride myself on all my deeds and am squandering my life away; is this right? Dipping in and stirring the pond, She plays around a lot; She has an exquisite demeanour; and You are the consort of VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs. The celestials, who follow the righteous path everyday, were freed by You from their prison, Oh Great One!

1304.english_meanings_list: ["A combination of cosmos, water, earth, desire, air and fire", "has built this mystic edifice called my body. I do not want to be born in this illusory dwelling.", "To enable me to reach the pinnacle of Knowledge by praising You in beautiful and immortal Tamil language", "after learning the significance of Your great names (like Murugan, Guhan and Kandhan), You should kindly grant me the wisdom!", "You are indebted to protect the damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi roaming in the forest, whose speech is sweet like a child's lisping!", "You hold the Spear which shattered the golden and majestic hill Mount Krouncha into pieces!", "You wear the garland of chechchai flowers around which beetles roam seeking honey!", "You are the Emperor of the Heaven belonging to the DEvAs, Oh Great One!"]
1304.english_pathavurai: A combination of cosmos, water, earth, desire, air and fire has built this mystic edifice called my body. I do not want to be born in this illusory dwelling. To enable me to reach the pinnacle of Knowledge by praising You in beautiful and immortal Tamil language after learning the significance of Your great names (like Murugan, Guhan and Kandhan), You should kindly grant me the wisdom! You are indebted to protect the damsel of the KuRavAs, VaLLi roaming in the forest, whose speech is sweet like a child's lisping! You hold the Spear which shattered the golden and majestic hill Mount Krouncha into pieces! You wear the garland of chechchai flowers around which beetles roam seeking honey! You are the Emperor of the Heaven belonging to the DEvAs, Oh Great One!

1312.english_pathavurai: (If one begins to find comparisons for their bosom,) the elephant is incomparable as its face was once torn apart by Lord SivA and fell down; it cannot be compared to the lotus bud, as it droops after blossoming; comparing it with the huge mount Kailash is futile as it was once shaken (by RAvaNan); if one chose the crown of Manmathan, the God of Love, for comparison, it fell off when Lord SivA burnt him down; like the mount ChakravALa, it stands up erect reaching up to the celestial and terrestrial world; it makes even the great sages give up their righteous path; it surpasses the fullness of a huge pot and is smeared with cool paste of sandalwood; it belongs to the whores who take pleasure in passionate duels; will I ever leave their enchanting beds and begin to worship Your hallowed dancing feet? Will there be a day when I shall be referred to as one devoted to the worship of Your feet? (In this place,) there are thousands of monasteries where vEdAs are chanted and there are many streets filled with sites for sacrificial rites and penances; the lilting river flows like Gangai in the sky (known as ChilambARu) gushing into many branches and serenely touching the broad flight of stairs situated in the riverbank; decorative festoons flutter on top of the tall temple-towers which abound in this place along with vast halls studded with precious stones; shining like the sunlight, bright red palaces with golden walls are found in this town called Pazhamuthir cOlai where You are seated with relish, Oh Great One!

1313.english_pathavurai: In the square whose four sides are the four directions, there is a lotus (MUlAdhAra ChakrA) on which pleasant light spreads; the Pranic air (oxygen) that starts running from both sides of the chakrA (through the nAdis -nerves- called ida kala and pingala)* eagerly rises from the chakrA SwadhishtAnam** (navel) right up to AgnyA (between the eyebrows) flowing through all the five kinds of lotus; the golden shrine (where NadarAjar dances) is filled with moonlight; the air is properly held in the three zones (namely, the sun, the moon and the fire zones); the resultant effulgence spreads in the 1008 - petal lotus in [Brahmarandhiram (BindhumaNdalam, SahsrAram) plus the six chakrAs making] a total of seven centres - all of which are witnessed; over those centres, in the twelfth (DwAdhasAntha) centre which is enriched with red light, where the merged Siva-Sakthi unison is resonating with great music, and where the vision is like a matchless marble with a powerful reverberation; all of these merge to cause the nectar from the Moon Zone to gush out and seep through; in the celebrated light from the great Nandhi which is said to be the foundation of all the VEdAs, kindly bless and enlighten me, this dumb and mute one, so that I am liberated! For this, In the primordial gate known as Brahmarandhram, the yOgAs of eight kinds*** which are ebullient by Your kind grace, will have to be synchronised; please show me the method by which this can be accomplished. He came happily in the disguise of a horse-trader and took control of VadhavUrar (MAnikkavAacakar); He is the most compassionate one; His complexion is that of gold; in His hallowed reddish hands, He held many varieties of saddles and whips of the horses; He is Lord SivA; concorporate in half of His body is ParAsakthi, Gowri, Mother who prattles like a child; She has a complexion combining coral and emerald-green hues; She is the Consort of SivA; She severed my seven births filled with blemishes; She is UmAdEvi; and You are Her Treasure, Oh Lord! KAsi, RAmEswaram, Rathnagiri (ThiruvAtpOkki), the Snake Mountain (ThiruchchengkOdu), ThiruvArUr, Vellore, ThEvUr, KAnchipuram, Madhurai, ThiruppaRiyal, ThiruvAnaikkA, ThiruppunaivAsal, ThiruvaNNAmalai, ThiruththaNigai, ThiruchchendhUr, NagappatiNam, SeegAzhi, Vaitheeswaran KOyil (VELUr), Mount Pazhani, ThirukkuRukkai, ThirunAvalUr and ThiruveNNainallUr - these are a few places where You have Your abode, and Your favourite residing place is the mountain in Pazhamuthir cOlai; the realised souls living in all these centres praise You, Oh Great One!

1314.english_pathavurai: As a foetus, I grew up in the womb of my mother. I took shape with the growth of the legs, arms and other limbs like the sweet mouth, eyes, nose and ears. Ultimately, I landed in the hands of the midwife. I was made to sleep in the bed with utmost care by a very caring mother who breast-fed me with nectar-like milk, and I grew up as her darling. My own wife, the other relatives, my happy life, the insecure wealth and my hometown were all considered by me as everlasting, and my smartness lay in not thinking about You. I was an utter fool not knowing how to worship Your hallowed feet. Will there be a day when You will make me realise the true wisdom of praising Your glory? The heads, brains, fat and flesh of the multitude of demons who confronted You in the battlefield were devoured in a hurry by the fiends who were accompanied by the flock of obese devils. They were joined by the herds of foxes in drinking the gushing blood. Some kOttAns (owl-like birds) danced with joy. That is the way You destroyed the demons, Oh valorous One! She is worshipped by great scholars rare VEdAs (scriptures); She is DEvayAnai, the beautiful daughter of the Elephant; She is VaLLi, the damsel of the KuRavAs, around whose hair beetles gather (to taste the honey in the flowers); and You hug them both! The grand gold-laden terraces are so high that clouds hover on them and on the tall groves; and the mountain is full of wonders at the unwavering mountain in PazhamuthirchOlai* which is Your abode! You are the Lord of Your devotees, Oh Great One!

Tell me. Tell me"; kindly grant me Your hallowed feet, saying "These feet that you love are yours; take them; take them!" He wrote the MahAbhAratham on the outskirts of Mount MEru by breaking His own tusk for scribing; He is elephant-faced; His complexion is that of the sun; He is GaNapathi, whose vehicle is the little mouse; You are the younger brother of that Lord VinAyagA! Appearing in the form of the Tamil Deity, You preached, after considerable research, the Tamil language, full of many rich and beautiful poems, into the ears of the great Sage AgasthyA; You are naturally detached from all bonds, Oh Supreme Master of the VEdAs! When the mighty warrior SUran declared "I shall not give in; I shall not give in" and confronted You head-on, You wielded the spear with a banging sound to sever all the demons; at that time, blood gushed profusely on the earth as You threw Your weapon, Oh GuhA, Oh GuhA! 1316.english_pathavurai: Twitching due to painful diseases, the body is drained out. What used to be a robust physique is now afflicted with thick slimy mucus in the throat, cough, wheezing, rheumatism and biliousness. To keep these diseases away from me, I have to renounce this life of two kinds, namely, family life and ascetic life. I do not want to be burdened with the need to learn all pedantic works in this world. Rather than experiencing the blissful self-realisation and enjoying the status, I have been feeding the wretched stomach every day with varieties of food to fatten this body. Is this an achievement through yOgA, just extending the life? In the cosmos without any shape or form, in the milky way, You dance liltingly to the rhythmic music! Will I ever be able to attain Your hallowed dancing feet that symbolise True Knowledge? Hanuman, the son of VAyu (God of Air), who is capable of leaping with immense speed, and Angathan, the son of VAli, built a bridge to LankA by throwing many mountains on the sea; through that bridge He went to the enemy's land, destroyed armies of elephants and chariots in the battlefield and killed Ravana, the ten-headed one, with His arrow; He is Rama, and You are His nephew! The menacing demons, namely SUran, Padman, Singamukan and TharakAsuran* were killed, with their brains shattered to pieces, and then Your peacock danced a special dance (called thudi), Oh valorous One! Many sages and celestials attained enlightenment in this impeccable grove at this great mountain (PazhamuthirchOlai**), which is Your abode, Oh MurugA with the Spear! You are the son of ThyAgar (the Sacrificer, SivA), Oh Great One!

1325.english_pathavurai: Losing my speech; my tongue drying up; my eyes looking like cotton strands; the milk poured into my mouth by the sorrowing kith and kin standing still without entering in; the milk trickling from the corner of the mouth; my body, the subject of many miseries, becoming cold; my crippled arms and legs becoming taut at the sight of the rope (of attachment) wielded at me by Yaman (the God of Death); my obese body and pot-belly shrinking fast; after the physician comes and pronounces that there is no further hope; all my relatives and the womenfolk falling on my body banging their head and beginning to cry; this is the day of reckoning when Yaman has descended to take my life; (on this day), along with Your celebrated peacock with its beautiful plume, your twelve hallowed hands, the fragrant kadappa garland swaying on Your twelve strong mountain-like shoulders, and VaLLi and DEvayAnai, Your sophisticated consorts, both of them looking like a lightning in the forest, You must appear before me! Sugreevan, the son of the Sun, kindly sent his minister, HanumAn, the famous monkey, to assess the intelligence and capacity of RAghavan (Rama) who was wearing the outfit of an ascetic, HanumAn not only witnessed the grace of Rama but also informing Him "When the Emperor of the earth, (RAvaNan) forcibly abducted SitA and flew away in the sky in his plane (Pushpakam), the languishing and lamenting creeper-like lady, SitA, secretly dropped right throughout the route of the plane her jewels including the ear rings, bangles, anklets, foot-ornaments, golden bracelets, waist-bands, chains and balls of gems and pearls concealed in a cloth bundle; look, here is that bundle of jewels"; He is that Lord (in the incarnation as Thirivikrama) who assumed the tallest form like the mount MEru and measured the adjoining chain of skies with one foot; He is that NArAyaNan (VishNu); You are His favourite nephew, having Your abode in this southern town of Puna vAyil*, Oh Great One!

1326.english_pathavurai: The Brahmam is the complete, primeval principle of ONENESS (1) ; in a unique (1) form of Lord SivA (when His five faces are joined with the sixth, athOmugam), the two (2) characterstics, namely, Shakthi and Sivam, are combined to unite (1) as a single (1) manifestation; having the origin from the two (2) aspects, namely, Shakthi and Sivam You for ever remain youthful (mU refers to the number 3); Coming in the lineage of Brahmins (who are supposed to have two (2) births, one before the holy-thread ceremony and one after) You came as the unique (1) poet, ThirugnAna Sambandhar! (OrA has two meanings: one -1- and ignorant) Being ignorant of the meaning of the PraNava Manthra (OM) (irumai has two meanings: two -2- and pride) when proud Brahma walked past Murugan one day (munnAl has two meanings: three -3- and one day), the tuft of the four-faced (4) Brahma was instantaneously untangled (with Your knuckles); VishNu, SivA and IndrA, the three (3) Lords, approached You and prostrated at Your two (2) feet requesting compassion; then, You released Brahma from his unitary (1) prison-cell. In the matter of one (1) second, You mounted the peacock with two (2) wings; the earth wearing the seas, surrounded by water in three (3) sides as a robe, and consisting of four (4) major subdivisions, namely, mullai - the forests, kuRinji - the mountains, marutham - plains with paddy-fields, and neythal - the seaside, was terrified (anja has two meanings: the number five -5- and terrified); You flew around the world! The divine elephant, AirAvadham, has four (4) different tusks and is capable of being affected by three (3) kinds of frenzy; it has two (2) ears and a unique (1) trunk; that mountain-like elephant belongs to IndrA; and You wooed IndrA's daughter, DEvayAnai, and married her! In one (1) form of a special figure, He could come in two (2) different forms, namely an older elephant and a younger elephant; the older elephant has three (3) different discharges of bilious juices of frenzy (namely, through its cheeks, its trunk and its jaw); You became the older* brother of that older elephant; (nAlvAy has two meanings: four (4) and hanging mouth, (namely, trunk) he has a trunk hanging from His mouth; He has five (5) arms (four arms from the shoulders plus the trunk) He wears his favourite grass aRugam (cynodon) (Arugam has two meanings: the number six -6- and cynodon grass); He is Lord GaNapathi; You are the younger brother of that Lord; through the five (5) sacred letters of Lord SivA (namely, NamasivAya) the four (4) vEdAs declare Him to be the Lord Almighty; He has three (3) effulgent eyes (namely, the Sun, the Moon and the Fire - agni); He is the ultimate medicine for the two (2) kinds of deeds (namely, good and bad); He is Lord SivA; and You are the unique (1) Master of that Lord SivA! Once (1) upon a time, imbibing the holy milk from the two (2) hallowed breasts of Goddess UmA DEvi, he became an expert in all the three (3) branches of Tamil language (namely, literature, music and drama); he became the king of four (4) kinds of poetry** he conquered the five (5) sensory organs, without being subject to any of their influence; people referred to him as none other than Lord ShanmugA, with six (6) faces; he had an extraordinary youth and handsomness (ezhil has two meanings: the number -7- and handsomness); he was ThirugnAna Sambandhar; and You were born as him in SeegAzhi, Oh Lord! You came as the child of the six (6) KArthigai maids (represented by the six star-constellation, KArthigai); You became the emperor of the Celestial world that possesses five (5) wish-yielding trees (namely, kaRpagam, manthAram, pArijAtham, santhAnam and arichanthanam); this mountain has a secretive appearance like the four (4) vEdAs; it has three (3) distinctive reddish peaks as its crest; that mountain has the name of the bird anRil (KrounchA); it was split into two (2) when You wielded Your singularly (1) unique spear, Oh Lord! Choosing SwAmimalai, on the northern bank of River KAvEri, as Your lotus feet are extolled by VEdic priests chanting the six-lettered manthrA, SaravaNabava, You are seated with relish as the Lord of ThiruvEragam (SwAmimalai)!
